title: Fullstackutvecklare till företag i Jönköpingsområdet
description:
.NET-utvecklare till produktionsnära teamverktyg, uppdrag via Jappa

Jappa söker för en kunds räkning en fullstackutvecklare med stark .NET-bakgrund. Uppdragsgivaren är ett stort industriföretag, och uppdraget är placerat i Småland. Du ansluter till ett team som bygger digitala lösningar för att stötta tillverkningen av en av produktserierna, samt interna mjukvaruverktyg för utvecklingsorganisationen.

Så ser vardagen ut

Du arbetar i ett scrumteam med utvecklare, tekniska ledare, projektledare, arkitekter och testare. Samarbetet med andra utvecklingsteam och intressenter i organisationen är nära och ständigt pågående.

Teamet bestämmer i stor utsträckning själva vilka tekniker som passar bäst, och man vill gärna testa nya verktyg och metoder. Du får följa en produkt hela vägen, från idé och design till implementation, test och verifiering. Nyutveckling blandas med förvaltning och förbättring av system som redan används i verksamheten.

Vem vi tror att du är

Du gillar att jobba tillsammans med andra, är flexibel och tar gärna egna initiativ för att få saker att röra sig framåt. Du vill göra skillnad i en miljö där din kod hjälper produktionen att fungera bättre.

Du har:

en teknisk högskoleexamen (kandidat eller master), gärna kombinerad med några års yrkeserfarenhet
erfarenhet av fullstackutveckling i C# och .NET
erfarenhet av backend i .NET, till exempel ASP.NET Core och Blazor
kunskap om molntjänster och infrastruktur i Azure
goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift

Meriterande

WPF
Python
erfarenhet från tillverkande industri eller produktionsmiljö
automatiserade enhetstester
agila arbetssätt
embedded-utveckling

Plats och resande

Uppdraget är baserat i Jönköpingsområdet och kräver att du är på plats hos kunden, med viss möjlighet till hybridupplägg (ungefär 80 % på plats). Resor är en naturlig del av rollen, cirka 40 dagar per år, till produktionsanläggningar i Europa och Asien. Du behöver vara bekväm med att ibland resa med kort varsel.

Om Jappa

Vi har ersatt gammelmäklare med en smart marknadsplats, branschkunskap, kvalitetssäkrade processer och AI. Resultatet är tydligare matchningar, snabbare besked och nöjdare konsulter och kunder. Jappa är en talent-as-a-service-lösning där du som konsult står i centrum, och vi matchar dig med uppdrag där du kan göra skillnad och utvecklas.

Så här går det till

Skapa din konsultprofil på . Det tar 10-15 minuter. När profilen är klar kan du söka uppdraget, och din kompetens blir samtidigt synlig för andra uppdragsgivare som letar konsulter inför framtida projekt.

title: Key Account Director - Greece
description:
The Key Account Director is the single accountable business owner for one or more Gentrack customers with full end-to-end P&L responsibility. The KAD represents Gentrack at the customer and the customer inside Gentrack, orchestrating all sales, delivery, product and solution resources to drive growth, retention and customer satisfaction across their account portfolio.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • P&L Ownership: Full commercial accountability for assigned accounts: revenue, margin, renewal, forecasting and pipeline. Develop and own multi-year account plans balancing growth and defensive strategies. Manage contractual governance across complex multi-year frame agreements.
  • Strategic Account Leadership: Design and execute account strategies aligned to each customer's business roadmap. Drive upsell and cross-sell in close collaboration with CS&IT and Delivery service lines. Maintain deep knowledge of customer organisation, strategy, IT landscape and business performance.
  • Customer Engagement: Build and maintain executive-level relationships (CxO, SVP, VP) within assigned accounts. Ensure minimum 2 days per week on-site presence at customer premises. Serve as trusted advisor and primary escalation point for all issues affecting the account.
  • Internal Orchestration: Act as the customer's advocate inside Gentrack, and Gentrack's commercial representative in front of the customer. Orchestrate Delivery, CS&IT, Product, Finance and Legal resources to execute account plans. Drive alignment between commercial strategy and delivery execution.
  • Success measures: Revenue and ARR growth per account; Net Revenue Retention (NRR); customer satisfaction and NPS; contract renewal rate; on-site presence compliance; account plan quality and freshness.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5+ years in account management, customer success or commercial roles in enterprise software or utility services
  • Demonstrable track record of growing and retaining complex enterprise accounts
  • Experience managing or navigating multi-year contracts and commercial negotiations
  • Understanding of the utility sector (energy or water) strongly preferred
  • Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience
  • Commercial and contract negotiation skills
  • Executive stakeholder engagement and trusted advisor capability
  • Account planning and strategic thinking
  • Ability to orchestrate cross-functional teams without direct authority
  • Strong financial literacy and P&L understanding
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Resilience and delivery focus under pressure

What We Can Offer You

  • Competitive salary
  • Private medical insurance
  • Life and income protection
  • 24-days annual leave
  • Enhanced parental leave
  • Tailored learning and development opportunities
  • Flexible working hours and remote-work opportunities
Interested?
If this role sounds like a good fit for you, please click on the “Apply” button to submit your application.

To discover more about Gentrack and how we’re transforming energy and water utilities with innovative solutions, please visit our website and LinkedIn.

title: Software Quality Analyst
description:
About Us:

The Michigan Milk Producers Association (MMPA) is a member-owned and operated milk marketing cooperative known for producing high-quality, award-winning dairy products. Established in 1916, MMPA markets 5 billion pounds of milk annually and is the ninth largest dairy farmer-owned cooperative in the United States, serving members in Michigan, Ohio, Indiana and Wisconsin. At MMPA, commitment to milk quality begins on the farm and extends through five processing facilities and wholly owned subsidiary brands, Superior Dairy and Heritage Ridge Creamery. With seven sites across Michigan, Indiana and Ohio, MMPA continues to shape the future of the dairy industry through innovation, product diversification and strategic growth while returning value to its member-owners.

Why you’ll love working here:

  • Competitive salary
  • Health and wellness benefits with medical coverage through Blue Cross Blue Shield, including mental health benefits
  • Disability insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Retirement including 401k with employer contributions
  • Personal and professional growth opportunities
  • Employee appreciation events and recognition awards
  • Employee wellness initiatives
  • Employee feedback and suggestion forums

Position Summary

The Software Quality Analyst is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of business-critical applications, with a primary focus on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365FO) and custom .NET applications. This role designs, develops, and maintains regression testing assets, executes functional and integration testing, and validates system enhancements prior to release.

The ideal candidate combines strong business process knowledge with software testing expertise and a commitment to continuous improvement. Working closely with developers, business analysts, project managers, and end users, this position helps ensure applications meet business requirements and maintain stability as new functionality is introduced.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain regression testing suites for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365FO).
  • Create and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts for business processes across Finance, Supply Chain, Production, Warehouse Management, Transportation, and related functional areas.
  • Develop and maintain automated testing assets using Microsoft RSAT and other approved testing tools.
  • Validate system configurations, customizations, integrations, enhancements, and upgrades.
  • Identify, document, track, and retest software defects through resolution.
  • Review business and technical requirements and develop appropriate testing strategies.
  • Execute functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing for web applications, APIs, services, and system integrations.
  • Verify application functionality against business requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Collaborate with developers to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and support release readiness activities.
  • Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release validation.
  • Recommend opportunities for test automation and continuous improvement of software quality processes.
  • Develop testing documentation, standards, and best practices.
  • Produce testing metrics and status reports as needed.
  • Assist with root cause analysis and resolution of production issues.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three (3) years or more of software quality assurance or testing experience.
  • Experience testing enterprise business applications.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
  • Experience developing and executing regression test plans and test cases.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
  • Experience using SQL for data validation and testing activities.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft RSAT (Regression Suite Automation Tool).
  • Experience testing Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations customizations.
  • Experience testing APIs, Azure services, and third-party system integrations.
  • Familiarity with automated testing tools such as Playwright, Selenium, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, or equivalent work management tools.
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated testing practices.
  • Working knowledge of .NET/C# application environments.
  • Experience utilizing Microsoft Power Platform solutions.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each responsibility satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the responsibilities.

This job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive list of responsibilities that are required of the role. Responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

MMPA provides the opportunity for meaningful work that makes a difference in the dairy industry and in our communities. The diverse talents and perspectives of our employees help us to meet the needs of our member farms and the customers we serve.

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States.

MMPA is committed to maintaining a safe, healthy, and productive environment for all employees as one of our top priorities. As part of our commitment to your well-being and workplace safety, all applicants are required to undergo a drug screening and background check as part of the hiring process.

We are not accepting unsolicited candidate introductions, referrals, or résumés from third-party recruiters or staffing agencies for this position.

MMPA is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Theme Shop-Director
description:
Help Deliver the Kalahari Experience

At Kalahari Resorts & Conventions, we don’t just create vacations—we craft unforgettable experiences. Home to America’s Largest Indoor Waterparks, our African-inspired resorts offer world-class dining, luxurious spas, thrilling entertainment, and cutting-edge convention centers that redefine hospitality.

But we’re more than a resort. As a family-owned company, our Promise is simple: Lead with Love. This means caring deeply for our guests, associates, and communities—treating people like family, giving back generously, and creating spaces where everyone feels valued.

Through our partnership with charity: water, we’re also committed to bringing clean water to one million people in Africa.

Theme Shop Director
We welcome you to apply for the open position of Theme Shop Director. In this role, you will lead a team of artist/craftsmen creating custom themed projects for Kalahari Resorts. The Theme Shop Director will oversee ongoing projects by managing a production schedule, ensuring all projects are completed according to specifications, and ensuring safety standards are always met. Some travel is required.

Theme Shop Video

View Our Theme Shop Video Here

Essential Functions

  • Lead the in-house Theme Shop team supporting signage, theming, fabrication, and creative needs across five resort properties and a golf course.
  • Oversee theme shop production from concept through installation, including estimates, schedules, materials, purchasing, fabrication, and vendor coordination.
  • Manage and mentor a team of up to 25 artists, craftsmen, and fabricators while leading product development meetings and day-to-day project priorities.
  • Guide the design, creation, and installation of themed environments, signage, large-scale sculptures, installation art, and custom pieces for parks, restaurants, lobbies, convention spaces, and other venues.
  • Collaborate with ownership, internal departments, subcontractors, vendors, and tradespeople to bring creative ideas, renovations, remodels, and new projects to life.
  • Promote a safe, reliable, and efficient shop environment by following company policies, ensuring PPE and safety compliance, troubleshooting recurring issues, managing supplies, and supporting equipment maintenance.

Requirements

  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to read, understand, and follow technical instructions.
  • Hands-on knowledge of fabrication processes, commercial or construction fabrication techniques, and basic math.
  • Creative, detail-oriented problem solver who enjoys thinking outside the box and continuously learning.
  • Team-focused and dependable, with the ability to work independently while communicating and collaborating with production team members.
  • Committed to a safe work environment, including following OSHA regulations and consistently using required PPE such as face shields and gloves; OSHA 30-Hour training is preferred.

A Sampling of Our Benefits

Our team enjoys a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Career growth opportunities with promotion from within
  • 401(k) matching, paid time off, and holiday compensation
  • Health, dental, and vision coverage for full-time associates
  • Employee appreciation events, discounts, and perks at all resorts
  • Education assistance programs to help advance your career

Be Part of Something Extraordinary

At Kalahari, we believe the best leaders Lead with Love—because love builds trust, inspires growth, and creates experiences that last a lifetime. That’s why we’re proud to be recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Midsize Employers, America’s Best Employers for Women, and by USA TODAY as the #1 Best Indoor Water Park.

Here, careers thrive, innovation is encouraged, and every day brings new opportunities to create meaningful moments. Whether you’re delivering guest service, crafting memorable meals, or leading a team, your work makes a real impact.

title: Manufacturing Supervisor - 2nd Shift
description:
Who You Are

The Manufacturing Supervisor will be responsible for monitoring daily projects and ensuring work centers are on track to hit key milestone dates with emphasis on both quality and productivity. Maintains a high level of safety awareness and enforcement followed up with regular documented inspections. Ability to address manpower adjustments and scheduling changes to meet customer requirements. Conducts interviews and recruiting new individuals based on manpower needs and skill set requirements for specific areas.

This position requires flexibility to work a 2:00 PM to 10:30 PM schedule, with the ability to regularly work extended 10-hour shifts, overtime, and weekends as needed to support production demands. Occasional cross-shift meetings may require schedule overlaps. Overtime will be compensated in accordance with company policy.

What You'll Do
  • Leadership Accountability: Demonstrated the ability to motivate, coach, and develop employees through regular feedback, recognition, performance management, and corrective action while maintaining accurate and timely documentation
  • Leadership Communication: Maintain clear and consistent communication with technicians, ensuring understanding of operational goals, safety requirements, and performance expectations
  • Manufacturing Productivity - addressing technicians individual concerns, motivates technicians to stay focused
  • Manpower Scheduling - Provided input into the scheduling process to ensure correct skill sets are positioned on each activity. Plan and documented weekend schedule for all activities.
  • Continuous Improvement - Effectively monitors and improves processes, performance output, and working environment conditions.
  • Process Management - Establish and maintain documented procedures and work instructions for processes. Continually audit and measure technical performance.
  • Quality Inspection - Perform in-process audits and final quality inspections. Ensure product and workmanship meets FAC standards. Verify test results data is complete and within defined ranges.
  • Safe Work Environment - Ensure operational activities comply with State (MIOSHA), Federal, and FAC safety requirements. Take appropriate action on all incident violations.
  • Employee Training - Assess training needs regularly; maintain the plan for technicians and the required training, and cross-training efforts.
  • Development of Technicians - Stretch technicians into expanded roles via assignments and documented performance reviews.
  • Occasional travel between other FANUC facilities (10% or less) while most work is performed on 2nd shift at FANUC North Campus; business requirements may necessitate travel and assignments to other facilities or remote locations as needed
What You Need
  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Minimum of 5 years of manufacturing leadership experience driving production, quality, safety, and delivery performance
  • Proven ability to build relationships, influence teams, and drive performance in a manufacturing environment
  • Ability to organize and present technical and operational information clearly to diverse audiences, including internal and external customers
  • Proven experience driving Operational Excellence through Lean Manufacturing tools and continuous improvement initiatives, including 5S, standardized work, and waste reduction
  • Must be capable of handling and moving equipment, tools, and materials weighing up to 50 pounds as part of daily operations
  • Must possess a valid driver’s license and reliable transportation to travel between facilities and retrieve equipment as business needs require
  • Reliable consistent attendance with overtime coverage availability
What Would Be Even Better
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Industrial Technology, Engineering Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent manufacturing experience
  • Six or more years of experience in manufacturing with proven leadership abilities, or equivalent relevant experience
  • Familiarity with FANUC robotics, automation systems, and manufacturing processes
It's Your Move

At FANUC America, we are driven by a deep respect for our people and a commitment to building a workplace dedicated to integrity and excellence. We believe that great careers are built through opportunity, growth, and collaboration—and we’re excited to invite talented individuals like you to explore what’s possible with us.

If you're ready to take the next step in your career, we invite you to apply today. We look forward to learning more about you!

We offer market competitive pay and benefits programs, as well as opportunities for advancement, knowledge and skill development, and recognition of individual achievements. In addition, we offer the following benefits to our employees:

title: Technician-48
description:
About Company:

The Lube Technician plays a critical role in ensuring vehicles are cleaned to the highest standards, enhancing customer satisfaction and maintaining the reputation of the car wash facility. This position involves operating and maintaining car wash equipment, performing detailed cleaning tasks, and inspecting vehicles to guarantee quality results. The technician will work closely with team members to manage workflow efficiently and address any issues that arise during the cleaning process. Attention to detail and a commitment to safety are essential, as the role requires handling cleaning chemicals and machinery responsibly. Ultimately, the Technician contributes to a positive customer experience by delivering thorough and timely vehicle cleaning services.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Ability to operate car wash machinery and equipment safely.
  • Basic knowledge of vehicle cleaning techniques and products.
  • Physical ability to stand for extended periods and perform manual labor.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in a car wash or automotive detailing environment.
  • Familiarity with various cleaning chemicals and their safe usage.
  • Customer service experience.
  • Ability to troubleshoot minor equipment issues.
  • Valid driver’s license.

Responsibilities:

  • Operate automated and manual car wash equipment safely and efficiently.
  • Perform exterior and interior vehicle cleaning, including washing, drying, vacuuming, and detailing.
  • Inspect vehicles before and after cleaning to ensure quality standards are met.
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization of the work area and equipment.
  • Report any equipment malfunctions or safety hazards to management promptly.
  • Assist customers with inquiries and provide excellent service when needed.
  • Follow all safety protocols related to chemical handling and equipment operation.

Skills:

The Technician utilizes technical skills to operate and maintain car wash machinery effectively, ensuring smooth daily operations. Attention to detail is critical when inspecting vehicles and performing cleaning tasks to meet quality standards. Communication skills are employed when interacting with customers and team members to provide excellent service and coordinate workflow. Safety awareness is essential for handling cleaning chemicals and operating equipment without incident. Additionally, problem-solving skills help the technician address minor equipment malfunctions and maintain a safe working environment.

  • Knowledge of Ansible, Python, and GitLab.

  • Ability to design user-friendly interfaces and dashboards.

  • Strong networking and firewall technology knowledge.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in Agile methodologies.

  • Customer-oriented approach.

  • Strong teamwork capabilities.

  • Excellent communication skills and assertiveness.

title: Junior Technical Security Officer
description:
Jouw rol

Als Junior Technical Security Officer (TSO) krijg je de kans om je te ontwikkelen tot een veelzijdige securityspecialist binnen SIDN.

Je werkt samen met ervaren security professionals en ondersteunt bij het signaleren van beveiligingsrisico's, het uitvoeren van securitycontroles en het versterken van de digitale weerbaarheid van SIDN. Je leert hoe je securitymeldingen analyseert, risico's in kaart brengt en passende beveiligingsmaatregelen helpt voorbereiden. Daarnaast draag je bij aan security assessments, audits, incidentonderzoeken en projecten die zorgen voor een veilige en betrouwbare digitale infrastructuur die een belangrijke rol speelt in het Nederlandse internet. Je krijgt een buddy en begeleiding van ervaren securityspecialisten, zodat je jezelf stap voor stap kunt ontwikkelen binnen het securityvak.

In een team van 7 collega’s krijg je de unieke kans om mee te werken aan de beveiliging van de vitale infrastructuur van SIDN, terwijl je je ontwikkelt onder begeleiding van het team in kennis, verantwoordelijkheid en impact.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Ondersteunen bij het monitoren van de beveiliging van systemen, netwerken en cloudomgevingen;

  • Leren analyseren van securitymeldingen, kwetsbaarheden en incidenten, samen met ervaren collega’s;

  • Ondersteunen bij security assessments, scans en technische controles;

  • Bijdragen aan securityprojecten en helpen bij de implementatie van beveiligingsmaatregelen;

  • Meedenken over securityvraagstukken en je verdiepen in de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen cybersecurity.

Jouw vaardigheden

Je herkent je in onze kernwaarden: klantgericht, betrouwbaar, innovatief, onafhankelijk en professioneel. Je wilt blijven leren, ontwikkelen en je bent best een beetje eigenwijs. Als je jezelf hierin herkent, pas je goed bij ons! Want bij ons kan je echt jezelf zijn.

Ook heb je:

  • HBO of WO werk- en denkniveau;

  • Interesse in informatiebeveiliging, netwerken, systemen en cloud omgevingen;

  • Een analytische instelling, sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands, Engels en een leergierige houding;

  • Ambitie om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen cybersecurity, bijvoorbeeld richting ethical hacking, vulnerability management of security testing.

Mooi meegenomen:

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en stelt graag vragen om dingen écht te begrijpen;

  • Je durft initiatief te nemen en komt zelf met ideeën of verbeteringen;

  • De drive om jezelf continu te ontwikkelen.

Ervaring als Technical Security Officer is niet nodig. Heb je een sterke interesse in cybersecurity, een technische achtergrond en de motivatie om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen? Dan nodigen we je van harte uit om te reageren. Wij geloven dat talent, nieuwsgierigheid en leergierigheid minstens zo belangrijk zijn als ervaring. Neem contact op of solliciteer direct!

title: At Your Service Center Associate, Plaza Bonita - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

STORES00

title: Tekniker Fredericia
description:
Har du lyst til at blive en del af et stærkt team, hvor godt håndværk, samarbejde og en aktiv hverdag går hånd i hånd? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Lige nu mangler vi en dygtig tekniker til Fredericia.

Ansvar, indflydelse og udvikling
Stillingen kræver, at du har en solid mekanisk forståelse og erfaring med komplekse tekniske opgaver. Du er struktureret, selvstændig og arbejder med høj energi og ansvarlighed.

Som tekniker bliver du en central spiller på værkstedet, hvor du indgår i det lokale team ledet af vores dygtige Souschef og Værkstedschef. Din rolle kræver, at du kan tage ejerskab over opgaverne og være med til at sikre høj teknisk kvalitet og driftssikkerhed for kundernes biler.

Ud over almindelige mekaniske opgaver og serviceopgaver vil dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være:

  • Fejlfinding på mekaniske og elektriske systemer
  • Reparation og udskiftning af motorer, kæder og andre drivlinjekomponenter
  • Teknisk diagnosticering og dokumentation af fejl
  • Deltagelse i udviklingen af værkstedets faglige niveau gennem sparring og vidensdeling
  • Opnå en høj Kundetilfredshed gennem grundighed og kvalitetsarbejde

For at fortsat at sikre du forbliver den skarpeste skruenøgle på værkstedet kommer du efter 6 måneders ansættelse på ét af vores tre uddannelsesspor, hvilket et afhænger af din historik, som spænder fra Quickpoint Servicetekniker til Quickpoint EL- og Hybridtekniker.

Ud over vores tre uddannelsesspor har vi gode udviklingsmuligheder hos Quickpoint. Se og hør hvordan Christian gik fra at være Lærling til Værkstedschef i nedenstående video.

Vi tilbyder
Ud over gode udviklingsmuligheder tilbyder vi:

  • Attraktiv overenskomst
  • Fritvalgs-, pensions- og madordning
  • Bonus for den gode indsats

Interesseret?
Så klik på "Ansøg" forneden og udfyld dine oplysninger. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Værkstedschef Simon Lundgren Voss Rasmussen på sra@quickpoint.dk. Vi opfordrer alle til at søge, uanset køn, alder, etnicitet, religion eller seksualitet.

Vi afholder løbende samtaler og fjerner opslaget, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat, så vent ikke med at søge.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

title: Monteur Werktuigbouwkunde | Nexton Kemp | Amstelveen
description:
Monteur Werktuigbouwkunde | Nexton Kemp | Amstelveen

Ben jij onze toekomstige Monteur Werktuigbouwkunde?
Op zoek naar een afwisselende baan met veel verantwoordelijkheid? Wil jij samenwerken met een slim en enthousiast team van collega’s aan mooie en diverse projecten? Lees dan snel deze vacature van Monteur Werktuigbouwkunde!

Over Nexton| Kemp

Nexton is sinds november 2022 onderdeel van Dura Vermeer Divisie Techniek en bestaat uit een groep van zelfstandige bedrijven die zich richten op advies, ontwerp, productontwikkeling, uitvoering en onderhoud van gebouw gebonden installaties. Als geïntegreerd technisch dienstverlener voegt Nexton waarde toe op het gebied van smart buildings, energietransitie, circulariteit, duurzaamheid en as-a-service concepten. Daarnaast beschikt Nexton over ventures waarmee het bedrijf toegang heeft tot een netwerk van technologiepartijen met een breed scala aan innovatieve en slimme oplossingen.

Kemp Installatie, onderdeel van Nexton/Dura Vermeer, biedt slimme, duurzame en efficiënte klimaat technische en werkbouwkundige oplossingen, inclusief het inregelen en onderhoud. Met ons team van technisch specialisten op kantoor Amstelveen dragen wij bij aan projecten binnen de hotelbranche en exclusieve vastgoedlocaties in de Randstad. Op dit moment zijn wij onder andere actief bezig op het project Ypsilon Park in Den Haag en bouw van Hotel Eurostar in Rotterdam.

Dit wordt jouw baan


Nexton is actief in het ontwerpen, realiseren en onderhouden van complete, slimme (werktuigbouwbouwkundige) installaties in de gebouw gebonden installatietechniek.


Als Monteur Werktuigbouwkunde bij Nexton werk je aan verschillende soorten projecten. Geen project is hetzelfde! Dan weer werken jullie aan een groot herontwikkelingsproject van een groot bedrijfspand waar je met je team installaties oplevert, dan weer werk je aan de herontwikkeling van een huizencomplex in de randstad.

Op locatie werk je in een team van Monteurs, aangestuurd door een Leidinggevend Monteur, zelfstandig aan werktuigbouwkundige installaties. Samen stem je de dagelijkse werkzaamheden met elkaar af.

Jouw opdracht is geslaagd als jouw team op een fijne, veilige en efficiënte manier heeft kunnen samenwerken, de klant tevreden is en het project naar wens is afgerond.


Wij hebben op dit moment mooie projecten lopen. Denk aan de volgende projecten waar JIJ onderdeel van kan zijn:

  • WTC Toren Amsterdam

  • Meander Arnhem

  • Akzo Nobel Sassenheim

  • BNG Bank Den Haag

  • KLM Epcor

  • TNO Rijswijk


Jouw opdracht is geslaagd als jouw team op een fijne, veilige en efficiënte manier heeft kunnen samenwerken, de klant tevreden is en het project naar wens is afgerond.

Voor de functie van Monteur Werktuigbouwkunde vinden wij het belangrijk dat je gemakkelijk communiceert met je team aan monteurs, de uitvoerders op locatie en de verschillende projectleiders. Wij vinden het immers belangrijk dat je in contact staat met elkaar.

Ook zien we je graag zelf initiatieven nemen in je functie. Als jij een onderdeel ziet in je werk dat je graag wil verbeteren dan pak je dat aan, want je bent niet bang om fouten te maken. Wij vinden het namelijk niet erg als er fouten gemaakt worden.


Verder helpt het je als:

  • Je een afgeronde mbo-opleiding binnen de werktuigbouwkunde hebt;

  • Je leergierig bent. Wat je niet weet, leren we je graag;

  • Je een aantal jaar ervaring hebt als Monteur Werktuigbouwkunde;

  • Je je rijbewijs B hebt, aangevuld met bereidwilligheid tot landelijke klantbezoeken;

  • Je klantgericht bent en een goed kan samenwerken;

  • Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift.

In deze functie krijg je de ruimte om je te ontwikkelen. Je krijgt namelijk begeleiding als het nodig is maar als je dat wil ook veel vrijheden. Bovendien is er genoeg ruimte binnen de organisatie tot het volgen van (management) trainingen en of opleidingen. In samenwerking met je leidinggevende maak je je eigen ontwikkelplan.

Wat levert deze transfer jou op?

Als Kemp | Nexton organisatie hebben wij het beste met onze mensen voor en daar hoort ook een goed en volledig arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket bij.

  • Een goed salaris passend bij de functie en jouw expertise als Monteur Werktuigbouwkunde. Op deze functie is de CAO van Metaal en Techniek van toepassing

  • Je krijgt jaarlijks 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV dagen per vakantie jaar

  • Een goede pensioenregeling bij PMT

  • Voor deze functie krijg je de beschikking over een representatieve (elektrische) bedrijfsbus, laptop en telefoon. Ook bieden wij een aantrekkelijke fietsplan regeling.

  • Je komt te werken in Amstelveen met enthousiaste collega’s, in een fijne werkomgeving waarbij er door het jaar heen geregeld leuke evenementen georganiseerd worden. Samen maken we er elke dag wat leuks van om de sfeer erin te houden.

Wil je meer weten over deze functie? Wij nodigen je uit voor een kennismaking en een kop koffie op één van onze projecten om daarmee direct te ontdekken wat Nexton jou te bieden heeft. Stuur je sollicitatie en laten we samen kijken naar de mogelijkheden binnen ons team.

Contactpersoon: 📞 Jorn Trousselot, Technical Project Recruiter – 06 22 05 40 80 ✉ j.trousselot@nexton.nu

Wij werven graag onze eigen toekomstige collega’s. Ongevraagd meezoeken en kandidaten voorstellen zonder leveringsafspraken wordt niet geaccepteerd. Op ongevraagd voorgestelde kandidaten kan geen enkel recht aan ontleend worden. Bedankt voor het begrip

title: Lead Integration Developer (.NET / APIs / Cloud) for Emply
description:
**JOIN PAYCHEX EUROPE (Boilerplate text)

**At Paychex Europe, we simplify payroll, HR and workforce management for businesses across Europe. We believe great results come from people who take ownership, share knowledge, challenge the status quo and treat colleagues and customers with honesty and respect. These behaviors shape our culture and reflect the values we live by: Integrity, Respect, Partnership, Curiosity, Accountability and Service.

When you join our team, you can make a mark by helping us deliver solutions that make work easier for businesses and their employees.

**Lead Integration Developer (.NET / APIs / Cloud) for Emply

**We're modernising the platform behind our rapidly growing HCM product, Emply People. As our Lead Integration Developer, you'll define the technical direction for APIs and integrations while helping evolve the platform towards a cloud-native architecture.

As a senior team member, you will be involved in hands-on coding, design, development, customization, configuration, testing, and deployment of enterprise software solutions. Additionally, you will mentor and coach colleagues while making key technical decisions, combining hands-on development with technical leadership.

Emply People is a flexible HR solution for small and medium-sized businesses, supporting the full employee journey, from recruitment and onboarding to performance, time and absence management, and offboarding.

We're transitioning to modern technologies including microservices, containerisation and serverless architectures. You'll play a key role in this transformation from an integration perspective, helping build a more scalable, efficient and agile platform.

We're looking for a Lead Developer with strong hands-on experience building enterprise-grade integrations using the .NET stack.

**What You Will Do

**Besides your daily role in Emply, you'll be part of a team of seven Lead Developers across Paychex. You'll work closely with our Architect, Product Owner/Specialist, Scrum Master, and development teams in Poland and Ukraine to design, develop, and support our browser-based product within an agile Scrum framework.

**As Lead Integration Developer, You'll Be Responsible For

**

  • Defining integration architecture in collaboration with the Architect.
  • Owning integration patterns and standards.
  • Designing scalable APIs and integration services.
  • Improving technical implementations, simplifying the codebase, and promoting coding best practices.
  • Improving reliability, performance, and observability.
  • Guiding the migration towards cloud-native services.
  • Mentoring developers and raising engineering standards.

**What Will Help You Succeed

**We encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every single box. The following experience and skills will help you succeed in this role:

  • 10+ years of proven experience designing and developing enterprise applications.
  • Experience modernising legacy codebases and working with non-functional requirements such as security, performance, and scalability.
  • Strong ownership of architecture and the ability to drive critical technical decisions.
  • Hands-on experience with C#/.NET, MS SQL, Hangfire, REST, and GraphQL.
  • Experience with API/interface modelling using OpenAPI.
  • Strong understanding of integration, including enterprise integration patterns, synchronous vs. asynchronous integration, and related trade-offs.
  • Experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Experience with Git and development tools such as Azure DevOps and Jira.
  • A proactive approach, with the ability to work independently and take ownership.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in clear business terms and act as a technical sparring partner and mentor to other developers.
  • Excellent written and spoken English

**What We Offer

**In addition to Emply's incredible people and mission, we strive to foster a motivating and uplifting culture. Our offices are bright and open, with locations in Denmark and Germany. We work closely across teams and encourage a social culture, believing that working together socially makes tackling challenges more enjoyable. You will work in our Østerbro office, in a team that cares about its members and enjoys a good laugh. In short, you’ll experience plenty of learning and exciting challenges in a great work environment.

Emply is part of Paychex Europe, a leading provider of HCM solutions. Paychex Europe is growing rapidly and expanding into the European market, constantly seeking passionate talent to join them on this exciting journey. Find out more at www.emply.com.

We value different perspectives and believe diverse teams make better decisions. If this role interests you and you can see yourself contributing to our team, we encourage you to apply!

For questions about the role, please do not hesitate to contact Jacob Borella jborella@paychex.eu. Applications are reviewed continuously, and we look forward to meeting candidates who are excited about this opportunity.

Respect and partnership are at the heart of how we work together. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, religion or background. At Paychex Europe, we strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute and thrive. Our hiring decisions are based on skills, experience and potential.

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Østerbro (Hybrid)

Full time, 40 hours per week.

**PAYCHEX EUROPE

**Paychex Europe delivers Payroll, HR, and Workforce Management solutions that simplify processes, save time, and provide insights that help businesses support their people and drive success. Built on over 50 years of expertise, our solutions adapt to changing needs — helping businesses run more efficiently, today and tomorrow.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Are you skilled at collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive impactful business solutions? Do you excel in gathering and documenting detailed business requirements, as well as translating them into clear technical specifications?
We are seeking a detail-oriented Business Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will serve as a crucial link between business objectives and technology solutions by analyzing business processes, identifying improvement opportunities, and driving the implementation of effective solutions. This role involves close collaboration with stakeholders to gather and document requirements, streamline processes, and ensure successful project delivery.
  • Elicit and Document Requirements: Collaborate with stakeholders to gather, document, and prioritize business requirements.
  • Analyze and Improve Processes: Evaluate existing business processes, analyze data to identify trends and insights, and recommend improvements.
  • Assess Risks and Priorities: Evaluate the risks associated with various solutions and designs, and prioritize competing business demands effectively.
  • Develop Process Models: Create process models and workflows to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Recommend Innovative Solutions: Propose innovative solutions to optimize and streamline business operations.
  • Design and Implement Solutions: Work with technical teams to design and implement solutions that align with business requirements.
  • Create Specifications and Use Cases: Develop functional specifications, use cases, and user stories to guide the development process.
  • Ensure Quality Standards: Validate that solutions are thoroughly tested and meet established quality standards.
  • Facilitate Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate across functions during specification, testing, and initial implementation phases to ensure seamless delivery.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Prior experience working as a Business Analyst in Shipping and Logistics.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and generate actionable insights.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of engaging effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including business teams and external partners.
  • Keen attention to detail in identifying and implementing improved workflows and solutions within software applications, with a collaborative approach to team ideas and product development.
  • Proficiency in business analysis tools and software (e.g., Microsoft Visio, JIRA, and SQL).
  • Familiarity with project management methodologies (e.g., Agile and Waterfall).
  • Knowledge of SoapUI and Postman is a plus.
At Scan-IT, we pride ourselves on our vibrant and supportive culture. Join our dynamic, international team and take on meaningful responsibilities from day one.

Innovative Environment: Explore new technologies in the transportation and logistics industry.
Collaborative Culture: Work with some of the industry’s best in an open and creative environment.
Professional Growth: Benefit from continuous learning, mentorship, and career advancement.
Impactful Work: Enhance efficiency and drive global success.
Inclusive Workplace: Thrive in a diverse and supportive environment.
Competitive Compensation: Receive a salary that reflects your expertise.
Growth Opportunities: Achieve your full potential with ample professional and personal development opportunities.

Join Scan-IT and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of the transportation and logistics industry.

Visit and follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook and X.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
description:
Williams Commerce is a digital agency, established for 15 years and part of the Next15 Communications group, a UK PLC with a global footprint across 50 offices in 15 countries. We help brands grow by redefining and accelerating the digital customer experience, creating rapid value and enabling future digital business.

Role overview

We are looking for a Junior Frontend Developer to join our growing digital team. Reporting to our Frontend Lead / Development Manager, you will work with designers, backend developers, and project managers to build and maintain high-quality, user-friendly websites.

You will have the opportunity to develop your skills and gain valuable experience in a supportive, fast-paced environment; perfect if you are at an early stage in your career.

Our hybrid working model is 4 days per week working from our Leicester office and 1 day remote within the UK.

As a Junior Frontend Developer at Williams Commerce, you will:

  • Develop responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces using a wide variety of frontend technologies.

  • Collaborate with UX/UI designers to translate designs into functional web components.

  • Maintain and improve existing codebases and contribute to new projects.

  • Participate in code reviews and follow established coding standards and best practices.

  • Debug and resolve frontend issues across browsers and devices.

  • Stay up-to-date with emerging frontend trends and technologies.

title: Senior Product Designer, Security (24 months FTC)
description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

IMPORTANT - this role is initially offered as a 24-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of an extension depending on business needs.

We see design as a crucial element of achieving our mission, so designers are represented at all levels, including senior leadership. As our new Senior Product Designer, you will be empowered to concentrate on design solutions for people’s needs. The design organisation is well established and our impact is highly valued. That means you will be able to fully focus on your contribution to our success.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Product Designer to join our Security domain. The team works to keep Vinted safe and trusted without compromising the member experience. This work goes beyond preventing fraud and abuse: you’ll also shape a new, high-impact member-facing experience that broadens how people can safely access and use Vinted.

As a Senior Product Designer in Security, you’ll own complex, ambiguous product problems from discovery through delivery, turning questions around trust, access, and protection into intuitive, accessible, and easy-to-use solutions. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, data analysts, content designers, and other designers, balancing strong safeguards with clarity and ease for millions of members.

In this position, you’ll

  • Work with cross-functional partners to be the voice of our members, define problems and goals, map flows, prototype interactions, and support the development process.
  • Own complex product work end to end, from framing the right problem and defining the experience architecture through prototyping, implementation, launch, and iteration.
  • Use AI-assisted building tools to turn ideas into working experiences, test assumptions early, and accelerate delivery, while critically assessing their output and knowing when human judgement is essential.
  • Partner up with other domain designers to work on initiatives that keep raising design quality and user-centeredness maturity.
  • Conduct usability tests to assess and validate design ideas and collaborate with User Researchers on discovery and generative studies.
  • Give and solicit feedback from designers and cross-functional partners.
  • Be part of our Security domain and report to the Product Design Director.

About you

  • Strong proven experience (typically 5+ years) designing complex web or native mobile products and taking them from ambiguous problem spaces through implementation, launch, and measurable outcomes.
  • Interaction design, visual design and evaluative user research skills.
  • Good at working with complex systems
  • Excellent communication skills, including excellent written and spoken English.
  • Good understanding of the design process, designing with qualitative and quantitative insights.
  • A strong collaborator with cross-functional peers.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted prototyping or building tools to create, test, and ship working product experiences.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strategic impact, complex problem-solving, and proof of shipping, including your personal contribution, delivery trade-offs, collaboration through implementation, and what changed after launch.
  • Experience contributing code-based prototypes or pull requests within an engineering workflow is a plus.

Work perks

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 working days of holiday
  • Access to all the tools & tech needed for work
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Private health insurance
  • Pension plan with flexible contribution options and a matching contribution from Vinted
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • A dog-friendly office
  • In Vilnius office: gym & in-house meals at friendly prices
  • In Kaunas office: a monthly lunch allowance, and a once-a-week provided in-house lunch and breakfast

Working at Vinted

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The gross monthly salary range for this position is:
€5.525—€7.475 EUR

title: Salgsleder - 30 timer - Ishøj
description:
Introduktion

Kan du tage medansvar for den daglige drift i butikken og bidrage til, at kunderne får en fremragende indkøbsoplevelse? Så er du måske vores nye salgsleder!

På #teamlidl bliver du en del af et verdensklasse sammenhold, og sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, når det kommer til dagligvareindkøb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi høje ambitioner til fælles – i verden og i hverdagen – med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig. Vi investerer i dig som medarbejder, og derfor er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt du kan nå.

Som salgsleder i Lidl får du ansvarsfulde opgaver, som vi selvfølgelig klæder dig på til fra start gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, ligesom du får adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt.

Om jobbet

Som salgsleder har du en vigtig rolle i butikken. Du bliver en del af lederteamet og er medansvarlig for den daglige drift. Dine opgaver bliver derudover blandt andet at:

  • Give vores kunder fremragende service under hele deres indkøbsoplevelse
  • Betjene kunderne ved kassen
  • Sørge for, at butikken altid er flot og skinnende ren
  • Fylde varer op på hylderne
  • Åbne og/eller lukke butikken
  • Bestille varer hjem til butikken

Om dig

Når du starter i Lidl, har du allerede erfaring fra branchen. Den erfaring bruger du sammen med vores grundige oplæringsforløb, hvor du får styr på vores butikskoncepter og processer.
Derudover forventer vi, at du:

  • Er smilende og glad for kundekontakt
  • Tager initiativ og er hjælpsom
  • Ser butikken som et team, der arbejder sammen
  • Forstår hvordan teamet består af individuelle roller og ansvar
  • Holder af faste rammer og har fokus på detaljen
  • Trives med en travl hverdag
  • Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter

Vi tilbyder

Som salgsleder i Lidl får du:

  • Ansvarsfulde opgaver, og mulighed for at gøre en positiv forskel for vores kunder
  • Verdensklasse sammenhold
  • En konkurrencedygtig løn på 154,03 kr. i timen som faglært og 144,67 kr. i timen som ufaglært
  • Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage
  • Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst med HK
  • En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter
  • Garanteret udvikling og uddannelse
  • Gode karrieremuligheder, hvis du har ambitioner om mere
  • Mulighed for sundhedsordning
  • Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.

Vil du med på #teamlidl?
Sådan søger du stillingen:

  • Klik på ”Søg nu”
  • Udfyld formularen
  • Vedhæft dit motiverede CV

Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på jobilidloest@lidl.dk eller tlf. 7635 0635, mandag – torsdag 8.00 – 15.00/ fredag 08.00 – 14.00.

Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV!

title: Administrationsleder med ansvar for personale, økonomi og udvikling i Skanderborg Sogn
description:
Skanderborg Sogn søger en administrationsleder til en spændende og alsidig stilling på 37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse den 1. januar 2027.

Vi tilbyder

Som administrationsleder bliver du en central leder og nøgleperson i et stort og veldrevet sogn, hvor vi har ansvar for planlægning og afvikling af kirkelige handlinger, gudstjenester og en lang række aktiviteter i vores kirker og kirkecentre.

Du får:

  • det daglige ledelsesansvar for vores engagerede musikere, kirketjenere og administrative medarbejdere
  • et tæt samarbejde med menighedsråd, præster og medarbejdere samt mulighed for at præge udviklingen af administration og arbejdsprocesser
  • ansvar for ugentlige personalemøder, hvor kommende aktiviteter planlægges og koordineres
  • ledelsesansvar for en medarbejdergruppe med høj faglighed, stærkt samarbejde og et godt socialt miljø
  • arbejdsplads i moderne kontorfaciliteter centralt i Skanderborg sammen med det øvrige administrative personale

Dine hovedopgaver

Stillingen omfatter særligt følgende områder:

Personaleledelse

Du har ansvar for ca. 10 medarbejdere ansat på forskellige overenskomster. Opgaverne omfatter blandt andet arbejdstidsplanlægning, vikardækning og øvrige personalerelaterede opgaver. Ansættelser, afskedigelser og lønforhandlinger sker i samarbejde med menighedsrådet. Du kan trække på rådgivning fra provstiets personalekonsulent.

Understøttelse af menighedsrådets arbejde

Du fungerer som sekretariatsleder i tæt samarbejde med menighedsrådets formand og deltager i forretningsudvalgs- og menighedsrådsmøder.

Økonomistyring

I samarbejde med menighedsrådets kasserer har du ansvar for budgetlægning, regnskab, økonomiopfølgning og den løbende økonomiske styring.

Koordination og planlægning

Du understøtter præsterne i planlægningen af gudstjenester, konfirmandforløb og øvrige aktiviteter. Du har det overordnede overblik over kalender og aktiviteter. Erfaring med eller mulighed for at varetage personregistreringsopgaver vil være en fordel.

Arbejdsmiljø, sikkerhed og IT

Du har ansvar for arbejdet vedr. arbejdsmiljø, herunder APV, MUS-samtaler og øvrige medarbejdersamtaler i samarbejde med menighedsrådets personaleansvarlige. Derudover har du ansvar for sikkerheds- og IT-relaterede opgaver.

Der må forventes aften- og weekendarbejde, herunder 1-2 aftenmøder om måneden.

Vi søger en leder, der

  • har dokumenteret erfaring med personaleledelse og formår at skabe trivsel, motivation og fælles retning
  • gerne har erfaring fra en offentlig organisation
  • har stærke kompetencer inden for økonomi og regnskab og kan formidle komplekst talmateriale på en overskuelig måde
  • er udadvendt, tillidsvækkende og trives i samarbejdet med mange forskellige mennesker
  • kan kombinere respekt for traditioner med lyst til udvikling og fornyelse
  • kommunikerer klart og professionelt både mundtligt og skriftligt
  • arbejder struktureret, bevarer overblikket og finder løsninger i en varieret hverdag
  • har stærke digitale kompetencer og let ved at tilegne sig nye systemer
  • er indstillet på at gennemføre kordegneuddannelsen, hvis du ikke allerede har den

Yderligere information

Vil du høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Rasmus Kolding, Menighedsrådets personaleansvarlige, på tlf. 40 24 79 20

Anny D. Jessen, Formand for Menighedsrådet, på tlf. 22 25 11 50

Læs mere om os på www.kirker-skanderborg.dk

Ansøgning og samtaler

Ansøgningen med relevante bilag sendes via Jobindex

Administrationsleder med ansvar for personale, økonomi og udvikling i Skanderborg Sogn - 1708252 | Jobindex

Ansøgningsfristen er 13. november 2026 kl. 10.00

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes i Kirkecenter Højvangen:

23.11.2026 kl. 9-16 (1. runde)

25.11.2026 kl. 9-12.30 (2. runde)

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning!

Om løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen vil være omfattet af Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og CO10 – Centralorganisationen af 2010 og Organisationsaftale mellem Kirkeministeriet og CO10 – Centralorganisationen af 2010 for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som henholdsvis kordegn, sognemedhjælper/kirke- og kulturmedarbejder eller kirkemusiker og det tilhørende protokollat for kordegne.

Aftalerne kan ses på www.folkekirkensintranet.dk

Stillingen er indplaceret i løngruppe 3.

Årslønnen aftales inden for intervallet 417.184-500.621 kr.(nutidskroner). Hertil kommer et rådighedstillæg, der årligt udgør 39.597 kr. samt et OK tillæg på årligt 3.476 kr. (Alle beløb er opgivet i nutidskroner pr. 1.8.26).

Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem Menighedsrådet og Danmarks Kordegneforening.

Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte kordegne har ret til at bevare deres tjenestemandsstatus ved ansættelse med direkte overgang. Der skal i så fald ske en klassificering af stillingen.

Hvis du ikke har kordegneuddannelsen, er det en betingelse, at den obligatoriske 5 ugers uddannelse for kordegne gennemføres indenfor 2 år efter ansættelsens start.

Menighedsrådet kan oplyse, at der vil blive indhentet straffeattest og børneattest samt og efter aftale referencer.

title: Project Manager
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Project Manager

Job Summary

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and an effective communicator who can manage competing priorities and drive coordination across multiple teams and business lines.

  • Program Governance & Reporting: Maintain program plans, status reports, RAID logs and management reporting to provide visibility into progress, key milestones, and areas requiring attention.

title: Associate Director, Enterprise Data Governance
description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:


BeOne is seeking an Associate Director, Enterprise Data Governance to build, enable, and scale enterprise data governance and stewardship capabilities across the organization. This role is a key member of the Enterprise Data Governance function and is responsible for operationalizing data stewardship within a federated governance model.


Working closely with the Head of Enterprise Data Governance, this position will serve as a subject matter expert (SME), translating governance strategy, policy, and regulatory requirements into practical, scalable business processes. The Associate Director will lead domain onboarding, drive stewardship adoption, and oversee strategic governance initiatives.


This role partners across business, technology, security, privacy, legal, and compliance teams to establish trusted, compliant, and well-governed data assets that support analytics, AI readiness, regulatory compliance, and business decision-making. The position will also provide leadership to managed service providers and junior governance resources while monitoring stewardship effectiveness through defined metrics and reporting.


Essential Functions of the Job:


  • Serve as a SME for enterprise data governance and data stewardship, contributing to governance operating models, policies, standards, processes, and best practices.
  • Lead onboarding of business and data domains into the federated governance framework, including role enablement, stewardship adoption, and governance process implementation.
  • Enable enterprise data discovery, transparency, and reuse through metadata management, data catalog, and data marketplace capabilities.
  • Implement metadata management, business glossary curation, and stewardship workflows.
  • Integrate governance processes across enterprise platforms and business workflows.
  • Influence the adoption of governance and stewardship practices without direct authority by building trusted relationships and aligning stakeholders around shared objectives.
  • Leverage automation and AI-enabled capabilities to improve stewardship efficiency and governance effectiveness.
  • Establish, monitor, and report governance KPIs, initiative progress, stewardship outcomes, risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Partner with platform owners, architects, and data teams to ensure governance technologies effectively support stewardship, metadata management, data quality, and compliance requirements.
  • Author governance policies, standards, procedures, and operating models aligned with enterprise data management best practices.
  • Lead stakeholder engagement sessions, governance working groups, and training programs that drive accountability, stewardship, and sustained adoption.

Required Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree and 8+ years of experience in data governance, data stewardship, enterprise data management, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience serving as a data governance SME within a federated, matrixed, or enterprise-scale operating model.
  • Proven ability to influence outcomes and drive adoption of governance processes, standards, and platforms without formal authority.
  • Experience leading cross-functional governance initiatives involving business, technology, and compliance stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and driving adoption of enterprise data governance platforms such as Informatica, Atlan, Alation, or similar solutions.
  • Experience enabling and training data stewards, data owners, and business stakeholders on governance processes and tools.
  • Experience with data classification, metadata management, data quality, and regulatory-aligned governance practices.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to navigate competing priorities across business and technology organizations.
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating team members, managed service providers, or governance resources.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate governance strategy, policy, and regulatory requirements into practical, scalable operating processes.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience leading governance platform implementations and stewardship adoption initiatives (Informatica, Atlan, Collibra, Alation, etc…).
  • Strong facilitation skills, including governance workshops, onboarding sessions, and working groups.
  • Experience supporting Data-as-a-Product operating models on modern data platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake.
  • Experience governing data within regulated environments, including GxP, clinical, R&D, or pharmaceutical domains.
  • Experience defining and reporting governance and stewardship KPIs to senior leadership.
  • Understanding of how metadata, stewardship, and data quality capabilities enable analytics, AI, and business outcomes.
  • Relevant certifications such as CDMP, DGSP, DCAM, DAMA, or equivalent credentials.

Supervisory Responsibilities:


  • Supervisory responsibilities are delivery-focused and include leading and providing direction for our managed service providers on certain projects, while providing strategic oversight and direction to junior data governance resources.

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis

title: Cluster Release Manager - (location: Zurich) 100%
description:
The Cluster Release Manager will play a critical role in enabling end-to-end coordination of integrated software deliveries across 25 interdependent value chains (similar to projects) within a major transformation programme at Julius Baer.
This individual will be part of the Release Management Team and ensures that all relevant processes related to Release Management such as Release Planning, Dependency Management, Deployment Management, Release Note Creation, Quality Gate Adherence and Communication are correctly performed.
Operating in a highly matrixed environment, the Cluster Release Manager will act as a central orchestrator between different stakeholders on different levels (senior management, project leads, technical teams, testing groups, application leads, infrastructure providers, and business stakeholders to deliver coordinated, traceable, and quality-assured releases.
Additionally, this role also requires the willingness to work extra hours and weekends overwatching specific activities such as Data Refresh or Dress Rehearsal Activities.

Key Responsibilities

• Responsible for the Release Management discipline for up to 5 projects in parallel (together with Release Coordinator)
• Develop and maintain a comprehensive release plan aligned with delivery timelines, dependencies, risk profiles, and environment availability.
• Coordinate all aspects of release management execution across multiple projects and suppliers, ensuring alignment with enterprise change management principles
• Chair regular release coordination meetings with stakeholders to track progress, resolve blockers, and manage risks.
• Ensure full traceability from requirements → design → development → test cases → defects → deployments, leveraging tools such as JIRA, Confluence, or similar ALM platforms.
• Oversee the dependencies and risks related to releases in scope being deployed to the environments
• Oversee staging and promotion of code and configuration changes into environments collaborating closely with Environment Management.
• Monitor release health via KPIs such as defect leakage, regression pass rate, rollback frequency, and deployment success rates.
• Prepare reporting on release status, risks, and key milestones for Release Management Leadership
• Support readiness assessments prior to each test cycle and contribute to lessons learned after each release.


Professional Experience

• Worked in a similar role before
• Experience in adjusting processes to programmes need
• Minimum of 8 years’ experience in IT project delivery within complex banking or financial services organisations with 500 – 1000 applications over several booking centres.
• Proven track record as a Release Manager in small- mid-sized transformation projects
• Direct experience managing multi-project release trains across SIT and UAT cycles in regulated environments.
• Familiarity with system landscape architectures commonly found in wealth management or private banking infrastructures.
• Banking experience and a profound understanding of Private banking products


Technical Understanding

• Strong grasp of SDLC methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, SAFe, hybrid models).
• Understanding of release management tools and technologies (e.g., JIRA)


Soft Skills & Personal Attributes

• Pragmatic & solution driven mindset
• Good stakeholder engagement abilities across technical and non-technical audiences on different levels
• High emotional intelligence and diplomacy when navigating conflicting priorities in a matrix organisation.
• Results-oriented mindset with attention to detail and structured problem-solving capability.
• Ability to operate autonomously under pressure, meeting tight deadlines without compromising quality.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; German or other languages beneficial.
• High willingness to contribute to the programmes success and to work on weekends


Education & Certifications

University degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field.
