title: Smed til mekanisk sikring i Lystrup
description:
Er du smed og vil du arbejde med mekanisk sikring og montage?



Her får du fast arbejde i Lystrup med firmabil og feltarbejde.



Du bliver en del af en sikringsvirksomhed, hvor smedearbejdet hænger tæt sammen med brand- og tyverisikring. Kunderne er især erhverv, institutioner og byggeprojekter, hvor løsningen skal passe til bygningen og sikkerhedskravene. Det betyder, at arbejdet ikke kun handler om at svejse og samle - det skal også kunne monteres ordentligt ude i virkeligheden.

Rollen passer til dig, der kan tage en opgave fra konstruktion til montage og stadig holde hovedet koldt, når noget skal justeres på pladsen. Du får firmabil, og kørekort er nødvendigt, fordi der er montage og feltarbejde i rollen. Det er et job for en erfaren smed, der kan lide at se sit håndværk blive brugt til noget konkret.

Det får du

Løn: 205-225 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Lystrup og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Konstruktion, montage og service

Din hverdag

Dagen veksler mellem værkstedsopgaver, montage og serviceopgaver. Du fremstiller og samler konstruktioner, og når noget skal monteres eller repareres ude hos kunden, tager du ansvar for at få det løst ordentligt. Firmabilen gør feltarbejdet lettere, men opgaverne starter med, at du har styr på det håndværk der skal ud ad døren.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Fremstiller og samler konstruktioner efter opgaven
  • Monterer løsninger ude på pladsen
  • Reparerer og servicerer eksisterende løsninger
  • Tilpasser, borer og skærer emner så de passer
  • Arbejder med konstruktioner i stål og metal

Her er der kort vej fra en idé på værkstedet til en løsning der skal virke i en bygning. Derfor skal du være typen der siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer, i stedet for bare at få det ud ad døren.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 4 års erfaring som smed
  • Har kørekort
  • Kan fremstille og samle konstruktioner
  • Kan tage ansvar på montage- og serviceopgaver
  • Møder stabilt og siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet feltarbejde før. Det vigtigste er, at du kan levere solidt smedearbejde og tale ordentligt med kunderne.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.



Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Opstart er hurtigst muligt, hvis det her lyder som noget for dig.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.



Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.



Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

title: Customer Collections Representative
description:
Our Customer Collections Representatives are an integral part of the Operations department, and we are looking for individuals who enjoy working in a fast-paced and challenging environment and have a real interest in learning new things.

Our Representatives are responsible for ensuring overdue debt is kept to a minimum and that customer payments are made in a timely manner. The successful candidate will support vulnerable and non-vulnerable customers by identifying appropriate arrears solutions and build effective relationships with customers, clients and colleagues whilst demonstrating best business practices.

Roles/Responsibilities


  • Manage allocated list of DR sites to keep debt levels as low as possible by contacting residents by phone/email/letter.
  • Where appropriate, ensure supplies are disconnected pending payment.
  • Negotiate cancellation or disconnection / reconnection of services to properties within agreed guidelines, and where appropriate liaise with Field Services to arrange reconnection.
  • Issue Aged Debt Reports to an allocated list of clients on a monthly basis.
  • Assist with collating information about debt to clients and providing effective updates.
  • Provide full support to the Billing /Customer Services Team when needed.
  • Ensure that all written communication (whether email or letter) adheres to company standards and complies with Client requirements.
  • Handle all telephone calls in a manner that adheres to company standards and is compliant with client requirements.
  • Become fully aware of the processes, procedures, systems and legislative requirements within our industry.

Key Skills and Behaviours Required


We require the applicant to have:

  • Excellent communication and writing skills.
  • Ability to listen and display empathy.
  • Ability to manage conflict and conflict resolution
  • ideally have experience in credit control and/or debt recovery.
  • Negotiation skills
  • Pro-Active attitude - use their initiative to help deliver resolutions.
  • Motivated by hitting and exceeding targets.
  • A willingness to learn is essential along with a genuine focus for doing what's right for customers.
  • Ability to respond appropriately under pressure.
  • Proficient in Microsoft office suite
  • Proficient in navigating social media platforms.
  • Real Team Player – we adopt a collaborative approach, and you must enjoy working as a part of a team.
  • Genuine passion to help people and problem solve.


Our Company Values

At Switch2, our values guide how we work, collaborate, and deliver for our customers and each other.


Commitment – Passion with purpose

Innovation – Delivering today, shaping tomorrow.

Teamwork – Empowering individually to achieve collectively

Together – Strong relationships, stronger outcomes

Resilience – Facing challenges, embracing change

title: Data Scientist
description:
Nordnet redefined the financial world as the first digital bank in Europe. Now we are about to do it again—this time by putting AI at the heart of our strategy. You'll embark on a challenging journey alongside skillful teams of sharp and committed colleagues.

We're searching for a Data Scientist to join Nordnet's AIR (AI & Research) function, working embedded within one of our cross-functional teams. Your mission: Bring the best possible AI capabilities to life as robust solutions, both internally and for our customers.

The Setup

You'll be working in a full-stack team with different competencies and together tackle the full lifecycle—from exploring possibilities to deploying production features. Our technical foundation is Google Cloud Platform, where we've deployed internal and customer facing GenAI features. Now we're scaling what works and developing new capabilities.

This is not a theoretical role; you're a builder and problem-solver who thrives on iteration. You'll report to our Data Science Manager while working daily with developers, analysts and designers.

What You'll Do

Build and maintain production AI pipelines from experimentation through deployment and monitoring.

Collaborate with engineers throughout the development cycle—you'll work together on architecture and implementation in an iterative fashion.

Drive quality through evaluation, metrics, and testing of AI solutions.

Champion AI Governance - Ensure compliance with the bank's regulatory framework by clarifying AI concepts and risks

This is you

You take pride in your work and are driven by curiosity—you want to continuously learn and grow.

You likely have:



Experience with LLMs, GenAI and agentic AI



Python skills for both exploration and production code.



SQL proficiency for data analysis and pipeline building.



Knowledge of ML/AI evaluation, metrics, and best practices.



Experience with ML/AI in cloud environments (GCP experience is a plus).

We also get excited if you have:



Experience working embedded.



Comfort presenting technical work to diverse audiences.



Interest in finance, investing, or personal finance.

We think that you have 3+ years experience working as a Data Scientist, ML Engineer or AI Engineer with a University degree in data science, computer science, mathematics, engineering or similar field.

We offer



Work in a product-focused environment with direct impact



Growth opportunities as a data scientist in a fast-moving AI space



Competitive salary and compensation

You'll work in a Nordic environment with high ambitions and a strong focus on delivery, product development, and technology.

Culture is built and cared for, each day by everyone. We're proud of ours. Having a flat organization where anyone can talk to anyone creates a warm and friendly atmosphere worth protecting. We believe in a culture where every effort counts and where everyone is recognized—a culture embracing our core values of passion, simplicity, and transparency on all levels, no matter who you are or what you do.

We are over 900 employees in Stockholm, Oslo, Helsinki, Copenhagen and Frankfurt.

Visit us on , , , and .

Application

We will start interviewing immediately. Please note that we do only accept applications through our recruitment system, hence no email applications will be considered.

If you have questions, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner lovisa.malmberg@nordnet.se

We want to inform you that Nordnet conducts credit and background checks as well as a drug test on the final candidate.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Senior Software Engineer, Outbound Capabilities
description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.

At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

Outbound Capabilities gives Aircall customers a first-class outbound calling experience. Users build campaigns from contact lists, the system dials automatically for agents (human or AI Voice Agent), and outcomes flow back to CRMs and analytics. The product is live with hundreds of companies and growing fast. In this role you own how it's built and how it runs.

  • Set the technical direction of the team: architecture, standards, and the trade-offs between speed and quality
  • Lead design and delivery of the team's biggest initiatives, from proposal to production, and break them into work the team can ship in small steps
  • Stay hands-on: write and review production code across the backend and the React frontend
  • Make AI a core part of how the team builds: use AI coding assistants and agents every day, shape workflows that keep quality high, and help others adopt them well
  • Bring AI into the product where it helps customers, working with the AI Voice Agents team on campaigns run by AI agents
  • Raise the bar for the team through code review, design reviews, pairing and coaching
  • Mentor engineers and grow technical leadership across the team, so good decisions don't depend on one person
  • Own operational excellence: observability, alerting that people trust, runbooks, incident response and root-cause analysis
  • Partner with the Product Manager and Designer to turn product goals into technical plans, and push back when a technical choice would hurt customers
  • Coordinate with the teams we depend on: Calls & Routing, Number Management, AI Voice Agents, Integrations and Data Platform

You should have proven experience with

  • TypeScript and Node.js, production-grade
  • React, owning components end-to-end, not just familiarity
  • AWS and cloud architectures (we run on EKS)
  • GraphQL APIs (AppSync) and event-driven patterns (SQS/SNS workers)
  • PostgreSQL
  • Observability with Datadog or similar: designing metrics, monitors and dashboards, not just reading them
  • Leading the technical work of a team or a multi-quarter initiative: architecture decisions, design reviews, delivery and quality
  • Mentoring engineers and raising the standard of a team's code, design and operations
  • Using AI coding assistants or agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) daily to design, build, test and debug, with a clear way of checking what they produce

It would be great if you also have

  • Telephony or dialer experience (SIP, call routing), or CRM integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Twilio calling: Programmable Voice, TwiML, call status webhooks or conferences
  • Building AI or LLM features in production: prompt and tool design, evaluations, and monitoring quality and cost

About you

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering, including time leading the technical work of a team
  • Genuinely full-stack: you can own a backend service and its React frontend end-to-end
  • AI-native: AI is part of how you design, code, test and debug every day. You know where it helps and where it fails, how you check its output, and you help others adopt it well
  • You lead by influence: engineers follow your technical direction because it's clear and well reasoned
  • Product-oriented: you think about customer impact, not just technical elegance
  • Ownership mindset: you drive work forward and are comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities
  • Personable and collaborative, with clear communication to engineers and non-engineers
  • Growth mindset: you develop yourself and the people around you, and you give and receive feedback well

title: Bliv vores nye projektleder for vand og klimasikring
description:
Nye muligheder forude! - Sæt dit præg hos SYSTRA Danmark

Vil du være med til at drive fremtidens projekter og bidrage til videreudviklingen af vores dygtige vandgruppe? Trives du i et arbejdsmiljø, hvor medarbejdernes trivsel og engagement bliver prioriteret højt? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig!

Context

SYSTRA Danmark – hvor arbejdsglæde, udvikling og sammenhold er i fokus

Hos SYSTRA Danmark er vi kendt for innovation, fremsynethed og et stærkt fokus på bæredygtighed – både i vores projekter og arbejdet med miljøet. Som en central spiller på infrastruktur- og mobilitetsområdet sætter vi medarbejderen i centrum. Det blev også bekræftet i årets Global People Survey, hvor medarbejderne fremhævede vores gode samarbejde, stærke fællesskabsfølelse og muligheder for faglig udvikling som væsentlige styrker ved SYSTRA Danmark.

Missions/Main Duties

Stærkt fællesskab og spændende projekter

I vores afdeling Miljø, Vand og Areal arbejder vi med state-of-the-art løsninger til afvanding og klimasikring på spændende og komplekse projekter – blandt andet ny jernbane over Vestfyn, Udskiftning af banebro på Tuborgvej, kontrol- og vedligeholdelsescenter til metrolinje M5, og klimasikring af byområder som Vartegn Vandpark i Ishøj. Vores medarbejdere sætter især pris på den indflydelse, man får i projekterne, og det tætte samarbejde på tværs af teams.

Vores vandgruppe er i fuld fart med mange spændende opgaver, og vi har brug for flere engagerede kolleger med energi og lyst til at hjælpe os videre.

Din rolle hos os

Som kommende projektleder får du en central rolle i arbejdet med afvanding og klimasikring. Vi søger en erfaren kollega med ambitioner om at tage ledende eller faglig ansvar på projekter. Du motiveres af at arbejde i et dynamisk team, hvor videndeling og sparring med kollegerne er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Projektering af afløbs- og klimasikringsopgaver

  • Sparring, videndeling og udvikling af teamet

  • Understøtte udviklingen af værktøjer og processer efter behov og kompetencer

  • Bidrage til faglige og tidsmæssige estimater i tilbudsgivning

Har du yderligere ønsker til opgaver, er vi åbne og fleksible – du får mulighed for at præge din egen rolle.

Profile/Skills

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 5 års erfaring med projektering af afvandings- og klimasikringsopgaver

  • Har kendskab til hele projektforløbet fra tilbud og skitse til udbud og udførelse

  • Er en teamplayer, der brænder for at bidrage til gruppens fortsatte udvikling

Vi tilbyder

SYSTRA Danmark tilbyder et inspirerende og udfordrende arbejdsmiljø, hvor fokus på arbejdsglæde og trivsel er helt centralt. Vores medarbejdere fremhæver især det stærke sammenhold, åbenhed over for nye initiativer og muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling. Vi har kort vej til ledelsen, fleksibilitet i tilrettelæggelsen af arbejdet og stor frihed under ansvar. Du kan arbejde fra vores kontorer i Horsens eller Aarhus alt efter, hvad der passer dig bedst.

Ansøgning

Vil du med på SYSTRA Danmarks rejse og være med til at definere fremtidens infrastruktur? Du skal ikke skrive ansøgning til stillingen, skynd dig blot at sende dit CV – vi indkalder løbende til samtale. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte gruppeleder Martin Vilhelmsen på tlf. 52 51 95 96.

title: Elektriker til industri og automation i Rudkøbing
description:
Er du elektriker og klar på industri, erhverv og firmabil?



Vi mangler en elektriker i Rudkøbing til nybyg og installationer.



Du bliver en del af en større installationsforretning, hvor el, køl, VVS, ventilation og automation ligger tæt på hinanden. Arbejdet ligger i Rudkøbing og omegn, med opgaver på erhverv, industri og nybyg. Der er et fagligt miljø omkring tekniske installationer, så elopgaverne ofte hænger sammen med andre fag på pladsen.

Her passer du ind, hvis du kan tage ansvar for dit arbejde og sige til, når noget skal afklares. Du får firmabil, og kørekort er et krav. Det er et job for dig, der gerne vil have ordnede forhold og arbejde med mere end standardopgaver i private boliger.

Det får du

Løn: 210-230 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Rudkøbing og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Industri, erhverv og nybyg

Din hverdag

Dagen handler om at få elinstallationerne til at spille, så drift, produktion eller byggeplads kan komme videre. Du arbejder efter de aftaler der ligger for opgaven, og du siger til hvis noget ikke stemmer med virkeligheden på pladsen.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Laver elarbejde på industri- og erhvervsopgaver
  • Udfører elinstallationer på nybyg
  • Fremfører kabler og ledninger
  • Monterer belysning og armaturer
  • Opsætter og tilslutter eltavler

Når elopgaven støder op mod automation, køl eller ventilation, er der andre fagligheder tæt på at sparre med. Det giver en hverdag hvor du ikke kun står med standardinstallationer.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har gerne mindst 2 års erfaring som elektriker
  • Kan arbejde sikkert på industri- og erhvervsopgaver
  • Møder stabilt og holder dine aftaler
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med industri, erhverv, nybyg, tavler eller belysning. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan tage ansvar på pladsen og levere ordentligt arbejde.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.



Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.



Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.



Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Tag fat nu - vi skal bruge en elektriker mere i Rudkøbing, og det kunne sagtens være dig.

title: Principal Software Engineer- Growth
description:
Job Description

A bit more about this role:

The Growth team works across marketing, telesales, and sales operations to help enroll new members. We do lots of different things, from making internal operations more efficient to building out consumer shopping experiences. We get excited by sitting close to our partners, naming problems with them, and working towards better outcomes.

Our north star is not a specific technology, but rather the goal of continually increasing the leverage of every member of the team. We’re currently building with Go, PostgreSQL, gRPC, GraphQL, React, TypeScript, Terraform, and AWS, and we think it’s a pretty awesome stack. We use LLM coding tools when they help us. The rest of the business uses LLM-powered tools, too. It helps to understand what this technology does and doesn’t do well so we can maintain our commitment to treating members as family.

We want engineer-owners with the judgment to simultaneously solve for short and long-term business value. We’re looking for folks who have worked in complex domains and systems, and come through it with some wisdom but most importantly humility. We want people who are passionate about building great technology to solve problems for users—our members, our colleagues, and ourselves.

Whether you have a health care background or not, we are excited to learn from and share knowledge with you. Our engineering leadership team includes seasoned alumni of health care and technology organizations spanning the public and private sector. Our co-founders deeply understand and care about good technology: Todd Park co-founded Athenahealth, a multi-billion-dollar health care technology company, and served as CTO of the U.S.; Ed Park was Athenahealth's founding engineer and served as its CTO, COO, and President of Services.

Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

title: 3D Motion Designer & Video Editor (Unreal Engine / After Effects)
description:
(!) This role focuses on video editing, scene composition, lighting, camera work, and UA ad assembly using existing 3D assets. You will not be required to model 3D assets from scratch.

Additionally, creating video ads tailored for performance channels like Facebook, Google Ads, TikTok, YouTube, and others.

Innovation:

How to proceed

title: Business Data Lead, Lund
description:
Do you want to help people across a global organization trust the data they work with? As our Business Data Lead in Axis Global Supply Chain, you'll make sure data is high quality across a range of cross-functional data entities. This is a unique opportunity to shape how data quality is managed across a global supply chain organization. The position is based in Lund, Sweden.

What you'll do here as Business Data Lead?
As a Business Data Lead within Axis Global Supply Chain, you will be responsible for ensuring high data quality across a range of cross functional data entities.

You drive data quality governance across Global Supply Chain to clarify data ownership, establish common definitions and standards, and improve the quality and transparency of data across selected entities.

You will define how data quality is measured and monitored cross functionally within Global Supply Chain, and lead efforts to address data quality issues and their root causes. You will ensure that data requirements are understood and reflected in business processes and systems. Your work will help data consumers understand and trust the data they use, and ensure that it is complete, consistent, timely, and valid.

The Axis Operations data strategy supports Axis' business strategy and ambitious growth targets. It focuses on improving data quality and ownership, and on automating data flows.

This is a unique opportunity to shape how data quality is managed across a global supply chain organization.

While data quality will be your primary focus, you will also lead various Supply Chain related initiatives, contributing to automated Supply Chain processes within Global Supply Chain.

Who is your future team?
You will join Global Supply Chain Development, a team within the Global Supply Chain organization that drives cross-functional business development.

The team consists of seven specialists in project management, end-to-end process management, analytics, ERP, continuous improvement, metrics management, and internal communication. Together, we help strengthen Global Supply Chain's ability to deliver on its mission and long-term strategy, while contributing to Axis' global efficiency and success.

Today we are around 150 people working within Global Supply Chain. Based in Lund, we interact with other Operations departments and a worldwide network of customers, distributors, suppliers, manufacturing partners, and our configuration and logistics centers.

Your main responsibilities within Global Supply Chain include:

Establish and drive data quality governance across Global Supply Chain, aligning functions on data ownership, governance roles, responsibilities, standards and processes.
Define and document cross-functional data definitions and standards for assigned data entities and attributes.
Define data quality measurement approaches, maintain relevant KPIs, and monitor performance for assigned data entities and attributes.
Create transparency across the Global Supply Chain data landscape, including data flows, master systems, and the relationships between them.
Coordinate stakeholders across functions to embed data quality governance into business processes and ways of working.
Identify systemic root causes behind recurring data quality issues and lead cross-functional continuous improvement activities.
Promote a data-driven culture across Global Supply Chain and act as an ambassador for our data transformation journey.
Promote and support the application of data governance requirements in day-to-day operations.
Collaborate with the Operations Data Lead and IT teams to implement data standards, validations, and controls

Who are we looking for?

You select and adapt relevant frameworks to bring structure to complex situations.
You combine analytical thinking with the ability to influence decisions and bring people together around shared goals.
You are curious, positive, self-driven, and structured, and you can plan and manage your own work to deliver high-quality outcomes.

We expect you to have:

A relevant university degree, at least at BSc level, in computer science, information technology, or a related field.
At least three years of experience in a similar role in Supply Chain.
Experience working with ERP systems. Experience with IFS and/or Microsoft Dynamics 365 is considered a merit.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

What Axis has to offer
We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact.

As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.

Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal "fika" chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle.

Ready to Act?
We go through applications continuously so don't wait - send in your application today! We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible.

title: AMU-Fyn søger 2 faglærere til bygge- og anlægsområdet

Du skal undervise på både erhvervsuddannelser (EUD) og arbejdsmarkedsuddannelser (AMU). Dine elever og kursister vil være både lærlinge, faglærte og ufaglærte samt beskæftigede og ledige.

title: PhD Autonomous & Decentralized Air Traffic Management
description:
Background

Air Traffic Management (ATM) and Communications, Navigation, and Surveillance (CNS) systems form the operational foundation of civil aviation. Current operations depend heavily on centralized ground facilities and satellite services for surveillance and management. This system is vulnerable for a range of disruptions including infrastructure failures, GNSS outages or cyber incidents. These vulnerabilities can degrade or even halt civil aviation.

Project ORION (Onboard Resilient Infrastructure-free Operational Network) investigates an alternative ATM/CNS architecture designed to function without reliance on ground- or space-based infrastructure. By utilizing an aeronautical ad-hoc network for communication, relative positioning, and surveillance, ORION aims to enable aircraft to self-organize and maintain safe separation thus ensuring a minimum service level even during (large scale) disruptions.

Project description

This PhD project is fundamentally multidisciplinary. As a PhD candidate, you will design, model, and evaluate a decentralized ATM/CNS architecture. The research focuses on determining how core traffic management functions can be sustained through cooperation using an aeronautical network when centralized ground and satellite services are unavailable.

In the first phase of the research, you will determine a set of use cases and design the underlying aeronautical ad-hoc networking concept layer to enable direct airborne data exchange, cooperative relative localization, and cooperative surveillance.

Next, building on this network layer, you will formulate distributed algorithms for fundamental traffic management functions, including aircraft-as-a-sensor (mesh network), separation assurance, conflict detection and resolution, and traffic sequencing.

Finally, to evaluate the operational feasibility of the architecture, you will implement the models within an ATM simulation platform, such as the open-source simulator BlueSky. For this you will extend the platform to include the ad-hoc networking functionality. Using this environment, you will stress-test the system under severe disruption scenarios by comparing the overall performance directly against conventional centralized ATM/CNS operations. This will provide evidence of the performance of the models for the various use-cases.

Your profile

  • Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field;

  • Strong analytical and mathematical foundation, with experience in or a keen aptitude for complex systems modelling and distributed systems;

  • Multidisciplinary mindset with the ability to bridge distinct domains: connecting operational ATM concepts with distributed network protocols and algorithm design;

  • Strong background in programming, using Python or other relevant programming languages;

  • Good scientific reporting and communication skills in written and spoken English.

What we offer you

You will receive a 4-year research contract from NLR and will join the Air Traffic department. In addition, you will be enrolled in the Doctoral Education programme of the Graduate School at Delft University of Technology (TU Delft). During this period, you will work closely with NLR colleagues in Amsterdam and with academic supervisors from TU Delft. Your working week will ideally be divided into: 2 days in Amsterdam, 2 days in Delft, and 1 day from home.

In addition, we offer:

  • No fewer than 45 days off (with full-time employment);

  • A fixed end-of-year bonus of 8%;

  • A contribution towards your healthcare costs;

  • Extra paid parental leave;

  • The possibility to work from home where possible.

Would you like to know more?

Please visit for more information on the graduate school.

For more information about the recruitment procedure, contact Pien Moller (recruiter) via pien.moller@nlr.nl.

Would you like to apply?

Great, we are curious about you! Send your motivation letter and CV via the apply button!

title: Small Business Consultant
description:
The primary role of this position is to provide direct, one-on-one, management and business skills consulting services to startup and existing small businesses located throughout our 7-state service area, with primary emphasis in the region around their office location. Position assignments include developing content for trainings and topic facilitation for webinars and workshops related to small business start and growth and building relationships with local community leaders to facilitate economic development activities related to small business growth and development.

We're looking for someone who has owned or runs/ran a small business and wants to help other owners do it well. You'll work one-on-one with startup and existing small business owners, mostly in rural and underserved communities, on cash flow, pricing, hiring, record-keeping, and getting ready to borrow.

Work Location: An ideal candidate will work from home; however, candidate must currently reside in the Texarkana area.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Health Savings Account with annual employer contributions
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Company-paid Short-Term & Long-Term Disability and Basic Life Insurance
  • Employer 401k Match
  • Paid holiday, vacation and sick time.

    • Option A: Master’s degree in business, management, finance, administration, or a related field and at least 1 year experience in business ownership, startups, business development, operations, finance, consulting, or leadership roles supporting business growth or turnaround efforts.
    • Option B: Bachelor’s degree in business, management, finance, administration, or a related field and at least 5 years' experience in business ownership, startups, business development, operations, finance, consulting, or leadership roles supporting business growth or turnaround efforts.

Small Business Consultant Duties:

  • Conduct financial and operational assessments for small business clients, identify growth challenges, and recommend strategies to improve business performance and sustainability.
  • Develop scopes of services, financial projections, and actionable plans while delivering consulting services and financial literacy education to business owners.
  • Analyze financial data, including ratio analysis, to support decision-making and guide clients toward positive business growth outcomes.
  • Build and maintain relationships with community leaders, business owners, and partners while promoting economic development resources and identifying new funding or partnership opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate client documentation, reporting, timekeeping, and communication while supporting team collaboration, staff training, and organizational initiatives.

title: Pædagog til skole og SFO2 – 37 timer
description:
Pædagog til skole og SFO2 – 37 timer

Brænder du for at skabe spændende fritidsfællesskaber for børn i 4.–6. klasse? Har du idéer, engagement og lyst til at give børnene en hverdag fyldt med muligheder, medbestemmelse og gode oplevelser?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!


På Vejlebroskolen i Ishøj søger vi en pædagog på 37 timer, som vil være med til at udvikle en spændende og meningsfuld hverdag for vores børn – både i undervisningen og i SFO2.


Vi søger en pædagog, der har blik for de ældre børns behov, interesser og fællesskaber. Du kan skabe rammer, hvor børnene både føler sig trygge, får indflydelse og har mulighed for at prøve nye ting.

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele. Måske brænder du for musik, teater, kreative projekter, makerspace, gaming, bevægelse eller udeliv. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at bruge dine interesser og idéer til at skabe aktiviteter, der engagerer børnene.


Dine opgaver

Du bliver tilknyttet 5. årgang, hvor du sammen med årgangsteamet understøtter elevernes faglige, sociale og personlige udvikling. Du indgår i undervisningen og bidrager til en skoledag med tydelige rammer og gode muligheder for, at alle elever kan deltage.


På Vejlebroskolen arbejder vi med co-teaching og tydelig klasseledelse. Det kræver et tæt samarbejde mellem lærere og pædagoger, hvor vi planlægger, gennemfører og udvikler undervisningen sammen.

I SFO2 får du mulighed for at præge fritidstilbuddet og sætte dine egne kompetencer i spil. Vi vil gerne skabe et miljø, hvor børnene kan fordybe sig i interesser, deltage i spændende aktiviteter og være med til at forme deres egen fritid. Her er der plads til både nye initiativer, kreative projekter og idéer, der opstår sammen med børnene.


Vi søger dig, der

  • er uddannet pædagog og trives med børn i 4.–6. klasse
  • er tydelig, initiativrig og god til at skabe kontakt til børnene
  • kan omsætte idéer til aktiviteter, som vækker børnenes interesse
  • har lyst til at bidrage med egne interesser og kompetencer
  • kan tilpasse din pædagogiske tilgang til børn med forskellige behov
  • samarbejder åbent og konstruktivt med kollegaer og forældre
  • er fleksibel, tager ansvar og bidrager aktivt til teamets fælles opgaver.

Vi tilbyder

  • en engageret personalegruppe med fokus på faglighed og trivsel
  • en arbejdsplads i udvikling, hvor der er plads til at afprøve nye idéer
  • faglig sparring, refleksion og mulighed for kompetenceudvikling
  • mulighed for at sætte dit præg på SFO2 og udvikle aktiviteter med udgangspunkt i børnenes interesser
  • gode udearealer og adgang til spændende muligheder i lokalområdet
  • uddannelse i ICDP
  • samarbejde med blandt andre Naturcentret, Ishøj Svømmehal, Kulturskolen og Ungdomsskolen.


Om Vejlebroskolen

Vejlebroskolen er en tosporet, afdelingsopdelt skole med ca. 460 elever. Skole og SFO ligger på samme matrikel tæt ved Strandparken, og vi bruger gerne naturen og lokalområdet som en del af børnenes hverdag.

Vi arbejder for, at alle børn oplever sig som en del af et fællesskab, hvor de kan udvikle sig, lære og trives.


Ansættelse

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt med ansættelse pr. 1. november 2026.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst med BUPL.


Ansøgningsfrist: Fredag den 23. Oktober 2026 kl. 12.00.


Vil du vide mere?

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte SFO-ansvarlig Sisse Fugl på telefon 43 57 40 02 for at høre mere om stillingen eller aftale et besøg på skolen.


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Senior Estimator
description: W3.CSS BW Offshore leverages more than four decades of experience in operating advanced offshore production systems and executing complex projects. We are proud to have executed 40 FPSO and FSO projects, and have cultivated a culture of thorough engineering, trust and teamwork throughout the organisation. BW Offshore is actively engaged in the energy transition by developing clean energy production solutions, applying our offshore engineering and operations capabilities to drive future value creation. Our aim is to create tailored energy solutions for evolving global energy markets. The Senior Estimator prepares, reviews and maintains reliable cost estimates for BWO’s FPSO CAPEX and EPCI projects, covering the concept, Pre-FEED and FEED (front-end engineering and design) and execution tenders. The role provides the cost basis for tender submissions, investment decisions and project execution. The Senior Estimator works with project management, engineering, procurement, commercial and finance colleagues to ensure that estimates are complete, consistent and defensible, and acts as the technical reference for estimating methodology on assigned bids. Key Tasks and Responsibilities: Lead the preparation of complete and traceable cost estimates for assigned FPSO opportunities and projects, from concept, Pre-FEED and FEED stages to execution tender Coordinate input from engineering, procurement, planning and operations disciplines and consolidate it into 1 estimate Obtain, evaluate and compare vendor, yard and subcontractor quotations Review and challenge estimate inputs from others for accuracy, consistency and completeness Present estimates, assumptions and risks to management at review and decision-gate meetings Ensure estimating work follows company procedures, the management system and applicable quality, health, safety and environmental requirements Qualifications: Degree in engineering (mechanical, marine, naval architecture, offshore or similar) Other relevant education and/or extensive relevant experience may replace formal education More than 10 years of cost estimating or cost engineering experience in offshore oil and gas, including FPSO CAPEX or EPCI projects Experience of preparing estimates for concept, Pre-FEED, FEED and execution EPCI tender pricing Skills: Clear communication, including presenting to senior management Collaboration across disciplines and the ability to build trust with project teams Ability to deliver to tight tender deadlines without compromising quality Integrity in handling confidential commercial information Working knowledge of estimate classification and cost risk methods, such as those published by AACE International Strong analytical and numerical skills, with attention to detail Commercial awareness and an understanding of how cost drivers affect project value Proficiency in Excel and in estimating and cost risk analysis software Fluent written and spoken English Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion BW Offshore is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all. We believe in fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of age, gender, disability, religion, or ethnic background.

title: 🚛 Kranfører i Regstrup – 45 tonsmeter, forlænger og masser af kilometer på vejen!
description:
🚛 Kranfører i Regstrup – 45 tonsmeter, forlænger og fuld fart på arbejdsdagen!

Er du typen, der hellere vil have 10 timer på farten end 8 timer på den samme byggeplads? Så læs med! 😎🏗️

Vi søger erfarne kranførere i Regstrup, der har styr på en kran på 45 tonsmeter med forlænger og trives med en arbejdsdag, hvor der sker noget.

Her skal du ikke sidde stille på den samme plads hele dagen. Du kommer rundt til forskellige leveringssteder og løfteopgaver, hvor du får brug for både dine evner bag rattet og din erfaring med kranen.

Du skal kunne lide at arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar og have en hverdag med fart på.

Arbejdsdagene er typisk omkring 10 timer, så der er rig mulighed for at få brugt både kranen og arbejdshandskerne! 💪

🏗️ Hvad kommer du til at lave?

Dine arbejdsopgaver bliver blandt andet:

  • 🚛 Transport og levering af materialer til forskellige adresser.

  • 🪨 Levering og aflæsning af grus og andre byggematerialer.

  • 🪵 Levering og håndtering af spær.

  • 🏗️ Kranarbejde med 45 tonsmeter kran og forlænger.

  • 📍 Kørsel mellem forskellige opgaver og leveringssteder i løbet af dagen.

Kort sagt: Du får en varieret arbejdsdag, hvor du både skal kunne køre lastbil og betjene kranen sikkert og effektivt.

👷 Hvem leder vi efter?

Vi søger kranførere, der har erfaring med større kraner og ved, hvordan man håndterer både tunge materialer og forskellige løfteopgaver.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • ✅ Har erfaring med 45 tonsmeter kran og forlænger – et krav.

  • ✅ Har gyldigt EU-kvalifikationsbevis (EU-bevis) – et krav.

title: QA/QC Engineer
description:
Location: Sariaya,Calabarzon,Philippines

The QA/QC Engineer will be responsible for designing quality standards, inspecting materials, equipment, processes, and products, developing quality control systems, and determining corrective actions to ensure specific quality standards are constantly met at all levels of construction projects.

You must be willing to relocate to any of our project sites.

Key responsibilities:

  • Prepare QA/QC plans for new construction and refurbishment work
  • Ensure the establishment of quality procedures including time limits for inspection, sampling and testing of works and other QA/QC requirements
  • Oversee and manage the quality assessment of materials through regular and rigid laboratory tests
  • In consultation with the project staff, review technical specifications and recommend standard construction specifications for all items of works for their effective use in projects’ works
  • Review all standard test forms to be used during laboratory tests, QA testing schedules and procedures and evaluate results as appropriate
  • Review contractor practices and conventional methodologies and make recommendations where remedial action is required
  • Work with project engineers and design consultants for establishing procedures with time limits for the inspection, sampling and testing of works and all other QA/QC requirements
  • Conduct initial survey queries on sources to materials, ensuring quality and quantity is of economic value to the project
  • Performs other responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate.

Qualifications To be successful in the role:

  • Licensed Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in large infrastructure projects.
  • Preferably with Construction Quality Management (CQM) for Contractors certification.
  • Minimum 5 years of onsite construction quality assurance and construction safety surveillance experience on a commercial or military infrastructure project.
  • Demonstrated experience in pre-stressing works and quality control, and experience in different classes of concrete mix-design, under different conditions of construction procedures.
  • Excellent English in written and verbal communication skills.
  • With a valid driver’s license.

Why Planate?

Planate Management Group South East Asia Corp (PMG SEAC) is a multi-disciplinary team of highly skilled and experienced professionals dedicated to providing comprehensive support to our clients. Our mission is to deliver the highest quality and most cost-efficient business support services, contributing to the success of our clients and their organizations globally. We strive to become one of the most reliable and trusted providers of business support services.

Joining the Planate team opens you to an experience working for a Global company where you are among a team that is considered a premier trusted partner for planning, design, engineering, asset management, and professional service solutions anytime, anywhere. We Take Care of Our Own; Personally and Professionally, Up and Down The Line.

We’d love for you to be a part of our Global workforce, helping us serve as an effective and integrated partner to advance every client's mission!

description:

title: Windows Altyapı Sistem Uzmanı
description:
Şirket Hakkında

1999 yılında İstanbul’da kurulan Natro, alan adı servisleri, web hosting, sunucu kiralama ve barındırma, e-mail servisleri, güvenlik çözümleri gibi ürünlerle uluslararası web hosting sektöründe hizmet vermektedir.

2004 yılında İzmit’te kurulan Turhost, domain tescil işlemleri, hosting, e-mail servisleri, sanal sunucu servisleri, streaming servisleri ve online ticaret projeleri alanlarında hizmet vermektedir.

Natro ve Turhost Avrupa’nın önde gelen dijital servis sağlayıcılarından biri olan ekosisteminin bir parçasıdır.

; 60’tan fazla marka, 4.000’den fazla çalışan ve 3,5 milyondan fazla müşteri ile güçlü bir global yapıyı temsil etmektedir. Bu ekosistemin bir parçası olarak, Avrupa değerleri olan gizlilik, şeffaflık ve yerel destek ilkelerini tüm iş yapış şekillerimizin merkezine alıyoruz.

Natro markamızın Altyapı departmanında görev almak üzere; Windows altyapıları konusunda deneyimli, sistem sürekliliğini ön planda tutan ve teknik problemlere çözüm odaklı yaklaşan bir "Windows Altyapı Sistem Uzmanı" arıyoruz.

title: Inventory Controller
description:
About us

Treasury Wine Estates (TWE) is one of the world’s largest wine companies. At TWE we are led everyday by our purpose, Boldly Cultivating. We are boldly cultivating value through our brands, wine, people & environment for enriched & joyful communities.

At TWE we cultivate our teams to be their very best. And in turn, our people push us to make bigger and bolder decisions. Our focus on Boldly Cultivating unites us as a global team and fuels our vision to become the world’s most desirable luxury wine company – known for the experiences we create for our consumers, customers, partners, suppliers and our people.

To learn more about our purpose and our renowned portfolio of global brands, click here.

About the Role

Reporting to the ANZ Warehouse and Inventory Manager, the Inventory Controller is accountable for controlling inventory accuracy and warehouse administration activities across TWE and 3PL sites. This includes finished wine stock, dry goods, hired pallets and warehouse consumables.

You'll investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies, manage stock holds and releases, coordinate stocktake activities and monitor inventory-related risks and cost exposures across the network.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a critical role in maintaining inventory integrity across multiple TWE and third-party warehousing locations. You'll partner closely with operations, planning, quality, finance and external logistics providers to ensure inventory accuracy, minimise risk and support efficient warehouse operations.

Key Responsibilities

In this role you will:

  • Manage inventory holds and releases in line with quality, compliance and operational requirements.
  • Investigate and resolve stock discrepancies, inventory corrections and adjustment requests.
  • Conduct root cause analysis on recurring inventory issues and support corrective actions.
  • Coordinate cycle counts and stocktakes, ensuring timely reconciliation of variances.
  • Maintain inventory visibility and control across multiple TWE and 3PL locations.
  • Manage pallet control activities, reconciliations and trading partner interactions.
  • Support warehouse consumables management and supplier invoice processing.
  • Partner with warehouse teams, transport providers and 3PL partners to resolve operational issues.
  • Monitor inventory risks including ageing stock, blocked stock, write-offs and pallet hire exposure.
  • Maintain compliance with health, safety, food quality and regulatory requirements.

About You

To be successful in this role, you'll bring:

  • Experience in inventory control, warehousing or supply chain environments.
  • Strong understanding of inventory processes, stock reconciliations and warehouse systems.
  • Experience working with ERP and/or WMS platforms, with JDE, SAP or similar systems highly regarded.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and implement solutions.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, with Power BI experience advantageous.
  • A collaborative approach and commitment to continuous improvement.

Why you’ll love it here:

  • Our culture is built on bringing our whole selves, being courageous and delivering together – it’s our DNA and the heart of who we are at TWE.

  • We prioritise your growth with access to global career opportunities and structured programs designed to support your health, wellbeing and career development.

  • Enjoy the world’s most desirable wines through our generous employee product allowance

  • Plus, you’ll get an extra day off each year with your “TWEforME Day” – a day to spend however you choose!

We offer a range of great benefits such as flexibility, rewards and discounts and health and wellbeing initiatives. To find out more, click here.

It takes all varietals!

At TWE, we proudly celebrate diversity and are committed to being an equal opportunity employer. Our goal is to build a workforce that reflects the diversity of the consumers who enjoy our products.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of age, race, colour, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability. If you require any assistance to be included in our process, please contact recruitment@tweglobal.com, quoting the job title and reference number.

How to apply

We do move quickly at TWE and continually review applications, so if you don’t want to miss out, apply today

title: Säkerhetsspecialist
description:
Säkerhetsspecialist

Vill du bidra till utvecklingen av framtidens svenska järnväg? Trafikverket söker nu en senior Säkerhetsspecialist till det strategiskt viktiga initiativet Nationellt tågledningssystem (NTLS), som är en del av programmet Framtidens Nationella Järnvägstrafik (FRAM).

I rollen blir du specialiststöd och rådgivare inom säkerhetsskydd och informationssäkerhet för ett av Sveriges största utvecklingsprojekt inom trafikledning och järnvägsinfrastruktur.

Uppdraget är ett konsultuppdrag på heltid med placering i Stockholm, Borlänge, Göteborg eller Gävle. Distansarbete kan förekomma upp till 40 % efter överenskommelse.

Uppdragsstart sker snarast efter kontraktstecknande och genomförd säkerhetsprövning.

Om företaget

Trafikverket ansvarar för den långsiktiga planeringen av transportsystemet för vägtrafik, järnvägstrafik, sjöfart och luftfart. Inom satsningen Nationellt tågledningssystem utvecklas framtidens trafikledning för svensk järnväg med målet att skapa bättre överblick, ökad flexibilitet och effektivare styrning av tågtrafiken över hela landet.

Om rollen

Som Säkerhetsspecialist tillhör du uppdraget Nationellt tågledningssystem (NTLS) och fungerar som senior specialist inom säkerhetsskydd och informationssäkerhet. Du arbetar nära projektledningar, säkerhetsorganisationer, IT-arkitekter och andra säkerhetsfunktioner för att säkerställa att säkerhetskrav integreras i uppdragets olika initiativ och projekt.

Rollen omfattar även dialog med och granskning av externa leverantörer som utvecklar och förvaltar tågledningssystemet.

Roll och ansvar

Vara specialiststöd, rådgivare och ledande funktion inom säkerhetsskydds- och informationssäkerhetsfrågor.
Genomföra informationssäkerhetsklassificeringar.
Genomföra och stödja riskanalyser.
Upprätta säkerhetsskyddsbedömningar.
Arbeta med säkerhetsskyddsplanering.
Genomföra utbildning och informationsinsatser för berörda medarbetare.
Utveckla arbetssätt inom säkerhetsområdet.
Följa upp incidenthantering kopplat till säkerhetsskydd.
Samverka med IT-arkitekter, IT-säkerhetsspecialister och andra säkerhetsfunktioner.
Granska externa leverantörers säkerhetsarbete.
Bidra till kunskapsöverföring till Trafikverkets medarbetare.
Delta i möten och tjänsteresor vid behov.

Kompetenskrav

1. Akademisk utbildning om minst 180 hp inom relevant område eller motsvarande kompetens genom utbildning och erfarenhet.

2. Kunskap om svensk offentlig förvaltningsstruktur och myndigheters roller.

3. Kunskap om myndigheternas roller i fred, kris och krig.

4. Kunskap om svensk kris- och krigslagstiftning.

5. Erfarenhet av samverkan mellan offentliga aktörer.

6. Minst tio års dokumenterad erfarenhet eller utbildning inom informationssäkerhet, cybersäkerhet och säkerhetsskydd kopplat till samhällsviktig verksamhet.

7. Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka sig på svenska i tal och skrift.

8. Erfarenhet av att självständigt leda och genomföra analyser, utredningar eller studier vid bevakningsansvarig myndighet eller länsstyrelse.

9. Kunskap om säkerhetsprövningar och tillhörande administration.

10. Kunskap om administration och upprättande av säkerhetsskyddsavtal.

11. Erfarenhet av införande, utveckling eller vidmakthållande av säkerhetsskydd och informationssäkerhet inom statlig myndighet.

12. Erfarenhet från samhällsviktig verksamhet inom exempelvis infrastruktur, transport eller energiförsörjning.

13. Erfarenhet av signalskyddsarbete eller arbete med signalskyddssystem och signalskyddsåtgärder.

Mervärdeskrav

1. Erfarenhet från uppdrag inom samhällsviktig verksamhet kopplad till järnväg.

Uppdragsinformation

Uppdragsperiod: 1 år med option om förlängning 6 + 6 månader.
Omfattning: 100 % (cirka 1 700 timmar per år).
Placeringsort: Stockholm, Borlänge, Göteborg eller Gävle.
Distansarbete: Upp till 40 % efter överenskommelse.
Säkerhetsprövning och säkerhetsskyddsavtal krävs före uppdragsstart.

Om Kraftsam

Kraftsam Rekrytering & Bemanning hjälper företag och offentliga verksamheter att hitta rätt kompetens för både specialist- och ledande roller. Genom personligt engagemang, hög kvalitet och nära samarbete skapar vi långsiktiga matchningar mellan arbetsgivare och kandidater. Vi arbetar med rekrytering, bemanning och konsultlösningar över hela Sverige.

Ansökan

Skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt då tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Har du frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare på anbud@kraftsam.se.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Retail Customer Experience Associate, Ventura Pacific View - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Customer Experience Colleague, you will create exceptional, personalized shopping experiences for our customers. You’ll prioritize customer satisfaction by actively engaging with shoppers across all touchpoints - both in-store and online - and drive cross-category sales to support overall business goals. With a deep understanding of fashion, fit, and function, you will make tailored product recommendations and leverage digital tools to enhance the customer journey. You also will work across different departments daily, often transitioning between multiple areas throughout the day.

In this role, you’ll also play a key part in client relationship building through outreach tools like My Client and social media. Your collaborative approach with peers, store leaders, and brand partners will help identify opportunities, resolve challenges, and elevate the overall customer experience. In addition to service and selling, you’ll support operational excellence through floor readiness, event execution, merchandise setup, and opening/closing procedures.

A positive, can-do attitude, strong communication skills, and a passion for delivering high-caliber service will be key to your success in this role.

How Our Selling Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They wear their name badge with pride, greet teammates with a warm hello, and help ensure the sales floor is clean, organized, and prepared for customers. Before getting started, they review their sales goals, learn about new arrivals and top-selling items, and stay up to date on current trends and promotions - so they’re fully informed and ready to engage, educate, and sell with confidence.
  • On the floor, they focus on the customer - offering a warm welcome, making eye contact, and creating friendly, personal conversations to create customer relationships to bring the customers back.
  • Throughout the day, they maintain a shoppable space by recovering the floor and fitting rooms, updating signs and pricing, and supporting any needed merchandise moves.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem
  • At least 2 years of selling or customer experience preferred

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Intresse för felsökning av lågspänningskretsar.



B-körkort.

Erfarenhet av montage- eller installationsarbete i fordon.



Erfarenhet av teknisk felsökning inom elektronik, el eller fordonsnära system.

GoldOller is always looking for talent to join our team. This posting is designed to build a pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future opportunities throughout our portfolio. While there may not be an immediate opening in every location, applicants will be considered as positions become available.


Position Purpose:

The GoldOller Leasing Consultant serves as the primary point of contact for prospective and current residents, delivering exceptional customer service and fostering positive resident relationships. This position is responsible for leasing available apartment homes, supporting marketing initiatives, resident retention efforts, and ensuring a welcoming and professional representation of the community.

This position has the potential to earn over $1,000 in commissions per month!

Duties & Responsibilities

Financial

  • Support the Community Manager in meeting occupancy, rental income, and renewal goals.

  • Promptly collect and post all revenue (application fees, admin fees, deposits).

  • Assist in following up on delinquencies and preparing/delivering notices.

  • Identify and report lease violations; assist with corrective actions as directed.

General Administrative / Office

  • Serve as a positive representative of GoldOller at all times.

  • Communicate regularly with the Community Director regarding community needs.

  • Enforce lease agreements, Fair Housing laws, safety codes, and local ordinances.

  • Maintain professional appearance and positive attitude.

  • Complete all reports and software entries accurately and on schedule.

  • Keep the leasing office clean, organized, and businesslike.

  • Use company equipment responsibly.

  • Attend meetings, required training, and complete safety checklists.

  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Team Support, Recruiting & Employee Development

  • Promote strong resident relations by assisting with complaints and rent collection.

  • Encourage teamwork to help the community reach its goals.

  • Support training by reinforcing company policies, values, and best practices.

Customer Service, Leasing & Marketing

  • Maintain a closing ratio of 25% or higher.

  • Maintain 80%+ on employee shopping reports.

  • Complete The Daily checklist each day.

  • Walk the property regularly, including amenities, tour paths, and vacant units.

  • Ensure move-in apartments are inspected, photographed, and documented before move-in.

  • Provide a positive experience for every applicant and new resident.

  • Monitor and respond to leads within 24 hours and follow CRM guidelines for follow-up.

  • Answer calls promptly and professionally; greet walk-ins enthusiastically.

  • Show apartments using professional leasing procedures and approved rates.

  • Respond to all phone, email, text, and online inquiries promptly (within 24 hours).

  • Screen applicants using approved credit/criminal systems.

  • Complete lease files, renewal agreements, and all required addendums.

  • Review weekly advertising sources and notify management of issues or opportunities.

  • Address resident concerns quickly and professionally.

  • Conduct market surveys as assigned and monitor neighborhood trends.

  • Ensure all community postings and signage are branded and professionally displayed.

General Maintenance Support

  • Walk the property regularly, including vacant units.

  • Help oversee grounds, trash areas, and common areas; ensure they remain clean and debris-free.

  • Enter all resident service requests, dispatch maintenance promptly, and complete quality-check calls.

Resident Relations

  • Proactively contact residents with upcoming lease expirations and maintain 60%+ retention.

  • Upload Notices to Vacate immediately and communicate renewal opportunities to management.

  • Provide residents with professional, clear notices and communication.

  • Refer residents to supportive service groups when appropriate.

  • Help develop newsletters, outreach programs, move-in gifts, and resident events.

  • Assist in planning and attending monthly resident activities.

  • Ensure move-ins are smooth and complete move-in inspections properly.

  • Address service requests, noise complaints, and other issues promptly.

  • Help resolve resident conflicts professionally.

  • Participate in court hearings and appeals when required.

Skills Required

  • Outgoing, personable, and compassionate—able to connect with people from all backgrounds.

  • Strong sales and customer service skills.

  • Property management knowledge preferred.

  • Proficient with Microsoft Office.

  • Experience with RealPage systems (OneSite, AIRM) preferred.

  • Strong multitasking and organizational abilities.

  • Working knowledge of Fair Housing.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-demand environment.

  • Skilled in conflict resolution with a calm, direct, and empathetic approach.

  • Strong relationship-building skills with residents, coworkers, and vendors.


Interested so far? Lets tell you a little bit about us….

GoldOller Real Estate Investments is a growing real estate investment company that acquires, develops, and operates multifamily communities throughout the country. The firm has been phenomenally successful over the years and currently owns and diligently manages approximately 40,000 units across 12 states, representing over $2.6 billion in assets under management.

Our commitment and strides to stand out, think creatively and do things from our own perspective and expertise! If you are looking for a career path that includes growth and having a sense of purpose, then this is your new “home”!

title: Management Trainee til Food - Roskilde
description:
Management Trainee til food

Management Trainee uddannelsen er det helt oplagte valg til dig som har en dygtig leder gemt i maven – her integrerer vi et akademifag som en overbygning til din salgselevuddannelse. Med andre ord sparker vi for alvor gang i dine muligheder - og så i en af detailbranchens største kæder, føtex – what’s not to like?
føtex er en arbejdsplads, hvor man som medarbejder bliver en del af et stærkt fællesskab. Hos os står mulighederne i kø - karriere, kompetencer og kammerater er bare nogle af de mange muligheder, man kan få når man trækker i den blå uniform.

Som medarbejder hos føtex bliver din rygsæk fyldt med erfaringer – dem kan du bruge nu, sammen med os, men også senere hen i din karriere. Du bliver en del af et team af både fuldtids- og deltidsmedarbejdere i varehuset. Vi arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af varehusets afdelinger, og du får derfor erfaring med at samarbejde med mange forskellige mennesker. Vi har et rigtig godt sammenhold, hvor vi bakker hinanden op og løfter i flok. Vi sørger naturligvis for den helt rette træning, så du kan føle dig tryg og kompetent i jobbet.

Som Management Trainee indgår du i et forløb med et udfordrende læringsmiljø med garanti for en stejl læringskurve. Det er alene dig, der sætter begrænsningen for din udvikling - her er der højt til loftet og mange muligheder for både personlig og faglig udvikling. Når du bliver optaget på uddannelsen tror vi på dig og din succes og vi går langt for at støtte dig, sådan at du efter endt uddannelse har mulighed for at tiltræde en lederstilling i føtex og være med til at forme fremtiden for andre dygtige talenter.

Nogle af de mange gode fordele ved at tage uddannelsen i føtex:

  • fleksibilitet og indflydelse på din arbejdsplan og i jobbet som helhed
  • en app hvor du kan se din arbejdsplan og hvor du modtager relevant information
  • en arbejdsplads med stærkt fællesskab hvor der er plads til alle og til at være præcis den du er. Du vil med andre ord også kunne skabe dig et godt socialt netværk og møde nye venner.
  • et hav af medarbejdergoder, bl.a.: personalerabatter, koncerter og festlige events.
  • Uddannelsen sætter for alvor strøm til dine ambitioner om en karriere som leder.

**Om Food afdelingen
**I Food beskæftiger vi os med fødevarer inden for køl, frost, tør og drikkevarer. føtex er jo et af de supermarkeder med stort udvalg og vi kan derfor altid leverer det ene kvalitetsprodukt efter det andet. Her sørger vi for at afdelingen fremstår pæn og indbydende, så vores kunder bliver inspireret. Vi har vareopfyldning, ordenpå lager, planlægning af varer fra tilbudsavisen og god kundeservice som nogle af de vigtigste opgaver.

Følg med her, hvor Line fortæller om jobbet og uddannelsen i føtex!

Kassemedarbejder

Hvordan bliver du Management Trainee?

Du har færdiggjort én af følgende eksaminer:

  • EUD/EUX Business-eksamen
  • HHX-eksamen
  • Studentereksamen, HF-eksamen eller HTX-eksamen, kombineret med 5-ugers EUD/HGS

Kommer du med en EUD Business-baggrund lægger vi vægt på, at uddannelsen skal være gennemført med meget gode resultater. Vi lægger også vægt på, at du har minimum et års erhvervserfaring, har været ved militæret, har tilbragt et år i udlandet eller tilsvarende.

Du har fornemmelse for ledelse, tror på egne evner og forstår vigtigheden i at samarbejde og kommunikere. Du udvikler dig fagligt, tager ansvar, leverer resultater, stræber efter forbedringer og er en holdspiller.

Du har en god energi og personlighed som sætter et positivt præg på arbejdet og dine kollegaer

**Er du klar til at sende din ansøgning afsted?**Hvis du stadig er nysgerrig på de mange muligheder føtex kan tilbyde, og er klar til at give den fuld gas i føtex’ blå uniform, så klik på linket nedenfor og lad os høre mere om, hvem du er. Vi glæder os meget til at høre fra dig :)

Har du spørgsmål?
Du kan læse mere om Trainee-uddannelsen her.

Du bliver del af en mangfoldig arbejdsplads med 60.000 medarbejdere i Danmark, Tyskland og Polen.

Vi driver butikker, varehuse, cafeer, spisesteder og webshops med vægt på kvalitet, service og omtanke for de samfund og den klode, vi er en del af.

Vi brænder for at gøre hverdagen bedre for vores kunder
