title: Facility Engineer
description:
About Us:

SMC Ltd. is a globally recognized premium supplier to the medical market with locations throughout the world. People committed to speed, technology, and exceptional performance are the cornerstone of our organization. Comprised of dedicated people and decades of manufacturing experience, we have continued to experience strong growth and currently have outstanding career opportunities for equally dedicated people.

Job Summary: Facilities engineers are responsible for planning, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and equipment of buildings and facilities. They perform analyses of operational processes, resource allocation, energy use, and safety processes, and recommend and implement improvements. They should possess extraordinary communication skills and the ability to work in a team environment. They should also possess good organizational skills as well as excellent project management skills.


Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Understanding of engineering principles to include; basic electrical, HVAC, facility management systems, hydraulics, and basic construction techniques.
  • Have experience managing multi-discipline projects, programming, writing technical instructions and basic drafting.
  • Analyze problems and gather data to see how engineered solutions may benefit the facility operations, and maintenance.
  • Participate on and or lead project teams as assigned to support ongoing projects to satisfy customer’s needs, keeping cost, deliveries, and rework under control against budget of project.
  • Recommend and implement cost reductions.
  • Site planning/propose updates to facility systems to meet growth and sustained needs of the company. Develop and propose facility improvements (infrastructure, utilities, equipment, systems, BMS) to support ongoing business goals of the organization.
  • Meet with contractors on proposed new technology for the building facilities to determine applicability and understand pros/cons of the proposed.
  • Maintain paper and electronic drawings files of the facility for quick references during plant planning, equipment layout, and troubleshooting.
  • Update facility drawings to include undocumented information that is needed for plant development and standardization with trouble shooting on, off of new installations, and facility system failures.
  • Develop and maintain preventive maintenance documents in collaboration with sub-contractors and internal organization departments that support the facility needs.
  • Monitor and maintain preventative maintenance program through ERP.
  • Develop and maintain preventive maintenance documents in collaboration with sub-contractors and internal organization departments that support the facility needs.
  • Proficiency in servicing, troubleshooting, cleaning heating and cooling equipment and related equipment.
  • Strong electrical, electronic, and mechanical troubleshooting skills.
  • Maintain, service and setup service equipment and rigging equipment.
  • Specify and order replacement components for repairs and restock inventory.
  • Must be able to climb up and down ladders from all heights within OSHA regulations.
  • Work is performed in a variety of environmental conditions with exposure to outdoor temperature variations, noise, vibrations, gas or fumes, grease cleaning solvents, degreasing agents, machinery and its moving parts, odors, and dust particles.
  • Ability to communicate effectively and clearly with management team, vendors, associates, and visitors.
  • Possess and maintain a valid and current driver license and be insurable by the company’s insurance carrier.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned or needed.

Essential Qualifications:

  • Two-year technical degree or a minimum of three years of industrial facility maintenance experience.
  • Professional appearance and proficiency in computer and internet usage.
  • Comply with safety regulations and maintain clean and orderly work areas.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Mechanical aptitude.
  • Previous ISO experience
  • Experience within the medical device industry.
  • Ability to lead and train others
  • Ability to multi-task, organize, and prioritize work
  • Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills; hands on in the field.
  • Strong interpersonal skills; be a team player and have the ability to develop and maintain a team atmosphere. Must be able to communicate with all levels of staff, contractors, and management. Excellent customer service skills required.
  • Ensuring compliance with relevant regulations, building codes, health and safety standards.
  • Must be able to work effectively when alone.
  • Proficient PC skills in a window environment.

Desirable Qualifications:

  • Bachelors’ degree in Engineering (preferably in mechanical engineering) and or minimum of five years of experience in this field preferred. (Technical knowledge of electrical, mechanical, drafting, and programming disciplines)

ADA Requirements:

  • Bend, squat, climb, grasp, reach, lift or otherwise move frequently for extended periods.
  • Lift, move or otherwise transfer up to 50 lbs. frequently, or more occasionally.
  • Walk, stand or otherwise move about continuously.
  • Exposure to machine shop physical hazards including chemicals which may require respiratory protection.

title: ADK-Specialist til Facility Management
description:
ADK-specialist til Facility Management

Vil du være med til at sikre, at kommunens bygninger er tilgængelige, sikre og velfungerende?

Facility Management i Faaborg-Midtfyn Kommune søger en ADK-specialist til vores Sikringsteam.

Du bliver den ene af kommunens to specialister inden for adgangskontrol (ADK) og får sammen med din kollega det faglige ansvar for adgangskontrol på tværs af kommunens bygninger.

Samtidig bliver du en vigtig del af Sikringsteamet, som arbejder med kommunens samlede sikrings- og bygningssystemer.

Stillingen er for dig, der trives med teknik, systemer og koordinering, og som motiveres af at skabe stabile og brugervenlige løsninger i en organisation med mange forskellige brugere og behov.



Dine primære opgaver

Som ADK-specialist bliver din vigtigste opgave at sikre en stabil og effektiv drift af kommunens adgangskontrolsystemer.

• Drift, administration og udvikling af kommunens ADK-systemer.

• Oprettelse, ændring og vedligeholdelse af adgangsrettigheder.

• Behandling og koordinering af fejlmeldinger, serviceopgaver og ændringsønsker.

• Samarbejde med brugere, ledere, IT, håndværkere og eksterne leverandører.

• Programmering, test og idriftsættelse af nye anlæg og løsninger.

• Dokumentation af anlæg, konfigurationer, procedurer og arbejdsgange.

• Standardisering og optimering af adgangskontrol på tværs af kommunen.

• Deltagelse i projekter ved nybyggeri, ombygninger og renoveringer.

• Bidrage til den fortsatte udvikling af Sikringsteamet.



Øvrige opgaver i Sikringsteamet

Selvom ADK er dit primære ansvarsområde, vil du også blive involveret i drift og udvikling af andre tekniske systemer, herunder:

• AIA (automatisk indbrudsalarm).

• ABA (automatisk brandalarm).

• ADBL (automatisk branddørslukning).

• ABV (automatisk brandventilation).

• BMS (Building Management Systems), herunder CTS og Danfoss Leanheat.

• Elevatoralarmer.

• Elektriske døre og dørautomatik.

• Nød-, flugtvejs- og panikbelysning.



Vi forestiller os, at du

• Har teknisk forståelse og interesse for tekniske installationer, adgangskontrol og

sikkerhedssystemer.

• Gerne har erfaring som elektriker eller fra arbejde med tekniske installationer, adgangskontrol, automatik eller sikringsanlæg.

• Har lyst til at lære og udvikle dig inden for adgangskontrol og sikringssystemer.

• Arbejder struktureret og systematisk.

• Kan bevare overblikket og følge opgaver helt til dørs.

• Trives med både driftsopgaver og udviklingsopgaver.

• Er god til at samarbejde med mange forskellige faggrupper.

• Kan omsætte tekniske problemstillinger til praktiske løsninger.

• Har fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhed.

Vi lægger større vægt på din tekniske forståelse, interesse og lyst til at lære end på din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund.



Vi tilbyder

• En specialiststilling med stor betydning for kommunens drift og sikkerhed.

• Mulighed for at blive en af kommunens faglige nøglepersoner inden for adgangskontrol.

• En central rolle i udviklingen af Sikringsteamet.

• Stor selvstændighed og indflydelse på eget arbejdsområde.

• Mulighed for relevante kurser og kompetenceudvikling.

• Et stærkt fagligt miljø med engagerede kolleger.

• Samarbejde på tværs af Facility Management, IT, Anlæg og kommunens øvrige fagområder.



Om os

Facility Management driver og udvikler kommunens bygninger og tekniske anlæg. I Sikringsteamet har vi ansvaret for kommunens centrale sikringssystemer og arbejder hver dag for at skabe trygge, sikre og velfungerende rammer for borgere, medarbejdere og samarbejdspartnere.

Vi lægger vægt på høj faglighed, godt samarbejde og en praktisk tilgang til opgaverne. Samtidig er vi i gang med at udvikle området, hvilket giver mulighed for at præge både arbejdsgange og fremtidige løsninger.

title: Lead IT Systems Engineer - REMOTE
description:
Reflect Health is the evolution of S&S Health, a trusted independent third-party administrator founded in 1994 to meet the growing need for access, simplified connectivity, and benefits administration. Headquartered in Mason, OH, we have built a reputation based on innovation, service excellence, and a deep understanding of how to drive better outcomes at lower cost. Over the years, we grew into a national presence serving employers, TPAs, health systems, and benefit consultants across all 50 states. We developed proprietary claims technology, expanded our offerings to include level-funded and fully funded programs, and delivered tangible savings and enhanced experiences for millions of members.

We are seeking a Lead IT Systems Engineer to modernize and optimize identity management, workflow automation, and employee technology experience. This hands-on technical leadership role will oversee identity and access management, IT workflow engineering, onboarding automation, and virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) while driving operational efficiency, security, and service excellence. The ideal candidate is an experienced IT professional with strong expertise in automation, systems engineering, identity management, and infrastructure who is passionate about improving employee experiences through scalable technology solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Identity & Access Management: Design, implement, and manage automated identity lifecycle processes, including user provisioning, role changes, and deprovisioning across cloud and business applications. Develop role-based access controls, automate approval workflows, enforce least-privilege access, and support periodic access reviews to maintain security and compliance.
  • Workflow Engineering: Design, configure, and optimize Jira and Jira Service Management workflows, intake processes, automation rules, service queues, dashboards, and reporting. Streamline request management through standardized templates, intelligent routing, and automation to improve visibility, efficiency, and service delivery.
  • Employee Onboarding Automation: Develop and maintain automated onboarding processes that ensure user accounts, system access, hardware, and software are prepared prior to employees' first day. Coordinate workflow automation between IT, Human Resources, and hiring managers while creating user-friendly onboarding resources that enhance the employee experience.
  • Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI): Engineer, deploy, administer, and support Reflect Health's virtual desktop infrastructure environment. Design standardized desktop images, application delivery processes, user profile management, monitoring, patching, capacity planning, and operational documentation to ensure a secure, reliable, and scalable platform.
  • Automation & Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to automate manual IT processes, integrate enterprise systems using APIs and scripting, and implement solutions that improve operational efficiency, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance service quality.
  • Security & Compliance: Support identity governance, access management, infrastructure security, and compliance initiatives by implementing security best practices, maintaining audit readiness, and protecting sensitive business and member information.
  • Reporting & Documentation: Develop operational dashboards, system documentation, technical standards, workflows, and reporting to support performance monitoring, issue tracking, capacity planning, and continuous process improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Human Resources, Operations, and business stakeholders to deliver technology solutions that improve employee productivity, strengthen security, and support organizational growth.

Qualifications

  • Education & Experience: Background in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in IT engineering or systems administration, including experience in a senior or lead technical role.
  • Identity & Access Management: Strong experience administering identity and access management platforms and directory services, including Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), Active Directory, or similar technologies. Experience implementing automated identity lifecycle management and role-based access controls preferred.
  • Workflow & Automation: Experience configuring Jira and Jira Service Management, including workflow design, automation, dashboards, and service management processes. Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, APIs, or similar technologies.
  • Infrastructure & Virtual Desktop Experience: Hands-on experience designing, implementing, or supporting virtual desktop infrastructure platforms such as Azure Virtual Desktop, Citrix, VMware Horizon, Windows 365, or similar technologies.
  • Technical Skills: Experience integrating enterprise systems through APIs, automating business processes, and supporting modern cloud infrastructure and endpoint management technologies. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools preferred.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities with experience identifying operational inefficiencies, designing scalable technical solutions, and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Project Management Skills: Ability to manage multiple technical initiatives simultaneously, prioritize competing demands, maintain documentation, and successfully deliver projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts, collaborate across departments, and provide exceptional internal customer service.
  • Industry Experience: Experience within healthcare, health insurance, benefits administration, or another highly regulated industry is preferred. Familiarity with security frameworks, compliance requirements, and protection of sensitive information, including Protected Health Information (PHI), is highly desirable.

Reflect Health is committed to providing a safe and secure workplace for all employees. All final candidates will be subject to background checks and drug screening as part of the hiring process.

title: Sightline Institute Principal Director, Program Development
description:
Location: Seattle,Washington,United States

Sightline Institute Principal Director, Program Development

POSTING DATE: October 15, 2026

DEADLINE: The application deadline is November 15, and applications received by that date will be given priority. We will accept and review applications until the position is filled. Interviews will take place from mid-November to mid-December, and we will likely invite finalists to complete a work assignment that is designed to test their skills in the specific functions required for the position. We anticipate extending an offer in late December or early January.

SALARY RANGE: $166,000-185,000

Sightline Institute is hiring a Principal Director, Program Development, to build our next research program, and then the one after that. This position is new, created to identify and launch new research areas. The Principal Director scouts, vets, and recommends each new program area. Then they launch it: conducting and publishing the original research that establishes Sightline’s credibility in the field, developing the strategy, anchoring early fundraising, and helping recruit the program’s permanent director. Once that director is in place, the Principal Director begins again with the next area, in a recurring three- to five-year cycle. The handoff is by design. The goal is a new program that stands on its own, led by someone hired to carry it forward, so the Principal Director can start the next one. The Principal Director is an accomplished researcher, a skilled writer and speaker, and an experienced program builder. Because the subject changes every few years, we are less interested in deep expertise in any one field than in range. You would be joining an organization of experienced staff members, fully remote across Cascadia. New programs have always come out of our team of researchers and communicators, kicking ideas around until someone finds the angle. We are more a guild of artisans than a factory, and this role is also built to work that way: you would be working in collaboration with colleagues who know the region and its politics well. This full-time, salaried role reports to the Executive Director and works in close partnership with Sightline’s senior staff. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a respected organization with an established track record of success while ushering in expanded areas of impact and reach. This is a unique, dynamic position that will directly contribute to Sightline’s impact and to creating strong communities, a green economy and a healthy environment throughout Cascadia.

About Sightline Institute

Our mission is to make Cascadia, the region stretching from Alaska to northern California and the Pacific to the Rocky Mountain States, a global model of sustainability— with strong communities, a green economy, and a healthy environment. Founded in 1993, Sightline is one of the region’s most influential public policy think tanks. In 2026 alone, we helped pass six housing laws in Idaho, four in Washington, and two in Oregon, along with Missoula’s new zoning code and a major clean energy law in Washington. Several of these were US firsts. Our work on election reform has helped shape how Alaska, Portland, and Seattle run their elections.

In our programs on climate and energy, housing and cities, and democracy and elections, we identify and promote reforms that yield outsized improvements for the region’s people and places. A nonprofit, nonpartisan, and independent public policy research center, Sightline provides research, articles, and commentary; maps, graphics, and tools; and framing and messaging guidance. Sightline’s influence depends on the depth and breadth of our researchers’ expertise and their persuasiveness in presenting analysis and arguments. We aim to draw attention to and build support for data-backed solutions to specific public problems through close engagement in policy debates. We advise and inform public officials, advocates, and the media. We also help organize unusual coalitions, advocate to leaders, and lobby lawmakers, usually at the state level.

Our combination of deep expertise; trusted resources for leaders, advocates, and journalists; practical, research-based policy recommendations; powerful case making and persuasive argumentation; and strategic engagement in unusual coalitions have made Sightline extremely effective at advancing progress toward our mission.

Learn more at .

Why now?

Sightline has been doing this work in Cascadia for 33 years. We have grown steadily, doubling in budget over the past decade and accumulating financial reserves that provide us with stability and options. Generously supported by families and charitable foundations from Cascadia and beyond, we are in the strongest financial position of our history, with a seasoned staff and systems built to support a larger team.

Even so, our region has 21 million people and we have 21 staff. Gradual growth has been good for our culture and our effectiveness, but at this pace, we will never make Cascadia the global model of sustainability we exist to build. So we are trying something different: rather than growing new programs slowly from within, as we always have, we are hiring someone to build them.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Scouts, plans, and builds new research programs for Sightline, developing and refining an institutional system for expanding into new issue areas
  • Vets potential program areas against Sightline’s program-selection criteria and leads a selection process that draws on input from across the organization, recommending a new program area for the Executive Director’s decision
  • Conducts preliminary research and produces ground-breaking articles and analyses that establish Sightline’s presence and reputation in each new issue area
  • Plans a maximally impactful strategy for each new program that draws on Sightline’s strengths in research, communications, and coalition building, and begins stitching together a coalition in support of it
  • Serves as a senior spokesperson for Sightline; writes and publishes research, speaks publicly and to the media, and meets with policymakers, allies, and other stakeholders
  • Anchors fundraising for each new program, working with the development team to identify, cultivate, and secure support from prospective funders
  • Leads recruitment and staffing for each new program, including hiring and mentoring the director who will lead it, then guides that director through a transition and hands off leadership
  • Helps build and manage each program’s budget and staffing in collaboration with the operations team, and refines Sightline’s method for program development with each cycle

An incomplete list of new program ideas that Sightline has considered, and that the Principal Director could add to, scout and vet includes:

  1. Transportation. Reviving and expanding Sightline’s past work: congestion pricing, building transit and infrastructure far more affordably, autonomous vehicles of all kinds, traffic safety, e-bikes.
  2. Climate migration, population, and demographic change. Sightline has started preliminary research in this area
  3. Rural Cascadia. A reboot of Sightline’s former Farms and Forests program: alternative meats, a critical rethinking of the usual green narrative on agriculture (e.g., We Are Eating the Earth), virtual fencing in place of barbed wire, beaver reintroduction for watershed restoration.
  4. Biological diversity. An area we have neglected in recent years: orcas and salmon, amphibians, birds, bats, and the “insect apocalypse.” Maybe even proposing to rewild half of Cascadia, after E.O. Wilson’s Half Earth.
  5. Artificial intelligence. What it means for our future. How our region should respond. What states can do while the federal government equivocates. And the environmental costs and benefits of data centers.

These are starting points, not a shortlist. Vetting them, and surfacing areas we haven’t considered, is work the Principal Director would do in collaboration with our research staff and senior colleagues.

Desired Skills and Experience

  • Substantial experience at a senior level in policy research, advocacy, journalism, or a related field, including work you initiated rather than inherited
  • Track record of conducting and publishing original, in-depth policy research that changed minds, with demonstrated ability to become credible quickly in fields that are new to you
  • Skilled writer and public speaker, comfortable serving as a senior spokesperson with media, policymakers, and other stakeholders
  • Strong strategic thinker who divines smart ways to influence policy through research, communications, and advocacy
  • Experience contributing to fundraising, including identifying and cultivating relationships with prospective funders and writing proposals and reports
  • Experience engaging policymakers to translate research into policy influence; competence in building unusual coalitions is a plus
  • Experience leading a new initiative, program, or team from early concept through launch— setting strategy, defining goals, and building a team
  • Commitment to Sightline’s mission and values.

Deep subject-matter expertise in one of Sightline’s current or potential program areas is a bonus, not a requirement. Sightline believes in mentoring talent and providing opportunities for growth. We’ve intentionally built flexibility into this role, and we’re open to candidates who may not yet meet every qualification listed, if they bring strong foundational skills, sharp instincts, and a clear ability to grow into the responsibilities described. If you see yourself in this work, we encourage you to apply.

Your First Year:

The early months will be about getting to know Sightline: how we work, how we choose what to work on, and how our research, communications, and advocacy fit together. At the same time, you’ll work with the Executive Director to identify and vet possible program areas against our criteria, then bring a recommendation forward. Once an area is chosen, your focus will shift to original research and publishing, building the program’s strategy, and beginning to cultivate funders and coalition partners. Throughout, you’ll work closely with our communications, development, and research teams.

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for the Principal Director level is $166,000-185,000, plus a 401K employer contribution of 10 percent of salary with no match required. That contribution is added to pay, not subtracted from it: someone earning $170,000 receives an additional $17,000 in their retirement account, for total compensation of $187,000.

As part of our commitment to equity and to reduce bias, Sightline has salary bands for each position level. Employees can earn annual merit raises and periodic promotions, and we support team members along their career pathways with mentoring, training, and learning opportunities.

Benefits also include:

  • 95% premium coverage for medical, dental, and vision insurance for the employee and partial coverage for dependents
  • 4 weeks of paid vacation
  • 12 paid holidays annually
  • 2 weeks of paid health, wellness, and care leave, plus access to a shared pool of additional leave for special circumstances
  • 12 weeks paid parental leave
  • A 3-month paid sabbatical every 7 years
  • A $200 monthly remote work stipend
  • Regular staff gatherings for in-person connection

As a nonprofit, Sightline is a qualifying employer for the federal Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) program. Our staff work hard and enjoy balanced lives and a collegial organizational culture.

Location:

Sightline is a virtual-first organization. Our staff, contractors, and fellows live and work in all parts of Cascadia. This position is therefore remote, and you may work at home or in a co-working facility of your choice, but you must live and work in Cascadia: Alaska, British Columbia, Idaho, Montana, Oregon, or Washington. The role requires travel to represent Sightline with policymakers, funders, and allies as well as participation in Sightline retreats and meetings.

To Apply

Please include, in this order:

  • A cover letter expressing your qualification for this position along with why you want it. Sightline is a mission-driven organization; we take seriously your motivation and ability to communicate it persuasively.
  • Your resume
  • A brief, published writing sample that showcases your ability to write clearly, succinctly, and compellingly in a style similar to Sightline’s. You may attach the sample or include a link. Our preference is for writing samples that include analysis or recommendations related to a public policy issue. Sightline takes excellent quality research and writing extremely seriously—we’re a think tank!—so your writing sample is key in your evaluation.

None of your application packet should be written by artificial intelligence; Sightline uses A.I. in several ways but not for composing text.

Please assemble all application materials in a single PDF with the naming convention LastName_FirstName_Position. We review applications that include all three; please reach out if the format is a barrier. Please click Apply, fi ll out the form and submit your single PDF.

The application deadline is November 15, and applications received by that date will be given priority. We will accept and review applications until the position is filled. Interviews will take place from mid-November to mid-December, and we will likely invite finalists to complete a work assignment that is designed to test their skills in the specific functions required for the position. We anticipate extending an offer in late December or early January.

Sightline Institute is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified candidates are encouraged to apply. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition or any protected category prohibited by local, state or federal laws.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.

We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a Analytics Engineer in our Stockholm office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?

The Role

As an Analytics Engineer at Viaplay Group, you will build and maintain data pipelines and models that support reporting and analytics across the business. You will take ownership of the pipelines feeding our BI system, ThoughtSpot, and create reliable, reusable tables for analysis. Working closely with analysts and business stakeholders, you will translate business needs into well-structured data that helps us understand user engagement, content performance, and our operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Pipelines: Develop, maintain, and improve pipelines that deliver accurate and timely data to ThoughtSpot and analytical tables

  • Data Modeling: Use SQL and dbt to transform source data into well-structured, reusable models with consistent business logic

  • Development: Use Python to support data processing and automate recurring tasks across analytics workflows

  • Data Quality: Build automated tests and validation checks to identify data issues and ensure reliable datasets for reporting and analytics

  • Reliability and Performance: Monitor pipeline runs, investigate failures, and resolve data freshness and performance issues. Improve workflows as data volumes and business needs grow

  • Collaboration: Work with analysts and business stakeholders to understand their needs, define data requirements, and deliver datasets that answer relevant business questions

  • Documentation: Document data models, business definitions, and pipeline dependencies so colleagues can understand, use, and maintain the data.

What we’re looking for

We are looking for someone who enjoys building reliable data solutions, takes ownership of their work, and collaborates well with others. We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have some experience in the following:

  • Practical experience with SQL, including writing and maintaining queries for data transformation and modeling

  • Hands-on experience with dbt for building and maintaining data transformation models

  • Experience using Python for data processing or automation

  • An understanding of data modeling and how to structure tables for BI reporting and data analytics

  • A structured approach to data quality, with the ability to investigate issues and develop reliable solutions

  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and an interest in making data pipelines easier to maintain and scale

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to translate business needs into data requirements and explain technical concepts clearly

It’s a bonus if you have:

  • Experience working with Databricks

  • Background in the streaming or media industry

What we offer you

  • We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.

  • Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.

  • Flexibility that works. We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.

  • A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.

  • An innovative environment with Hack Days once a year. This week-long initiative allows you to think outside the box and deliver creative, technical solutions that (more often than not) go on to be implemented, either in our product or our ways of working.

  • Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including serier & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.

Hit play today

If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.

Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: Ungarbejder - 7 timer - Frederiksberg
description:
Introduktion

Er du under 18 år? Og drømmer du om at få et job, der giver lidt ekstra penge til dig selv hver måned? Så er du måske vores nye ungarbejder!

På #teamlidl bliver du en del af et seriøst godt sammenhold. Og som ungarbejder i Lidl får du et Lidl-tillæg på 5 kr. mere i timen.*

Mød din nye kollega Katrine
”Jeg er så glad for at arbejde i Lidl! Her er plads til alle, og alle bliver hørt. Vi har et rigtig godt team, hvor alle er gode til at hjælpe hinanden. Selve arbejdsmiljøet består af gode kunder, søde kollegaer og en flot butik,” fortæller Katrine, der er 17 år gammel og ungarbejder i Lidl.
Kan du bidrage til godt humør, fællesskab og en god service? Så er det måske dig, vi står og mangler!
På #teamlidl kommer du på hold med verdensklasse kollegaer. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter. Vi går nemlig op i, at du lærer tingene rigtigt fra start, at du lykkes i dit job, og at du bidrager til et stærkt sammenhold med dine kollegaer.

Grænseløse karrieremuligheder

Som ungarbejder er der mange forskellige udviklingsmuligheder hos os. Har du f.eks. ambitioner om at gøre karriere i dagligvarebranchen? Så er jobbet som ungarbejder det perfekte sted at starte. Din erfaring som ungarbejder vil nemlig kun være en fordel, hvis du senere ønsker at søge ind på vores elevuddannelse, som vi mener, er Danmarks suverænt bedste! Det er ligeledes en stor fordel at have butikserfaring, hvis du drømmer om at arbejde på vores hovedkontor.

* Ift. den overenskomstmæssig takst pr. marts 2026.

Om jobbet

Som ungarbejder hos os skal du, først og fremmest, hjælpe dine kollegaer, så vores kunder altid får en god indkøbsoplevelse i butikken. Du ved, at du har gjort dit arbejde godt, når du har ydet en god service – og det gør dig glad! Dine opgaver er blandt andet at:

  • Give vores kunder en god oplevelse i butikken sammen med dine kollegaer
  • Få butikken til at shine, ved at fylde op og trimme hylderne så de altid står snorlige
  • Få varerne scannet hurtigt gennem kasseapparatet med et smil på læben
  • Svinge moppen, når gulvet er beskidt

Om dig

Når du starter i Lidl, får du en grundig oplæring i butikken. Derfor er det ikke afgørende for os, at du har erfaring, men vi forventer, at du:

  • Er under 18 år, dog ikke yngre end 15 år
  • Har afsluttet 9. klasse
  • Er smilende og har masser af god energi
  • Har gåpåmod, klør på og vægter teamspirit højt
  • Møder til tiden og er interesseret i at gøre dit arbejde godt
  • Har mulighed for at arbejde eftermiddag, aften og i weekenden

Vi tilbyder

Udover at du får verdensklasse kollegaer, får du som ungarbejder også:

  • Et Lidl-tillæg på 5 kr. mere i timen*
  • Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage
  • Løn og vilkår efter gældende overenskomst med HK
  • Erfaring med at samarbejde i et team og erfaring med service - hvilket vil give dig en stor fordel i dit videre arbejdsliv
  • Fleksible arbejdstider, så du let kan kombinere jobbet med skole og fritidsaktiviteter
  • Et spændende og varieret job med fart over feltet!
  • Gode karrieremuligheder, hvor du får forudsætningerne for at lykkes
  • Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.

Vil du med på #teamlidl?

Nu ved du forhåbentlig endnu mere om #teamlidl og jobbet som ungarbejder, end du gjorde i forvejen! Er jobbet som ungarbejder i Lidl noget for dig? Så send dit motiverede CV allerede i dag!

Sådan søger du stillingen:

  • Klik på ”Søg nu”
  • Udfyld formularen
  • Vedhæft dit motiverede CV

Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på jobilidloest@lidl.dk eller tlf. 7635 0635, mandag – torsdag 8.00 – 15.00/ fredag 08.00 – 14.00.

Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV!

title: Institutionsmedarbejdere til Udrejsecenter Kærshovedgård
description:
Vi opnormerer, så derfor søger vi Institutionsmedarbejder til Udrejsecenter Kærshovedgård



Er du empatisk, robust og har lyst til at gøre en forskel i arbejdet med udsatte mennesker? Udrejsecenter Kærshovedgård søger engagerede og handlekraftige institutionsmedarbejdere, der ønsker at bidrage til en mere tryg og værdig hverdag for vores beboere, som er op imod 400 afviste asylansøgere.



Har du viljen og lysten til, sammen med ca. 70 engagerede kollegaer at løfte en vigtig samfundsmæssig opgave, med rig mulighed for at bringe din erfaring og faglighed i spil? Så har du chancen for at komme med til vores informationsmøde omkring jobbet som Institutionsmedarbejder på Kærshovedgård.



Informationsmøde om jobbet som institutionsmedarbejder afholdes

tirsdag den 17.november 2026 kl. 19:00-20:30

på Udrejsecenter Kærshovedgård, Kærshovedgård 17, 7430 Ikast.

Du tilmelder dig ved at sende en mail til enhedschef Jørn Støvring på JørnStøvring.kristensen@dkf.dk



Dine ansvarsområder

Som Institutionsmedarbejder på Udrejsecenter Kærshovedgård vil du spille en central rolle i at opretholde en tryg og struktureret hverdag på centret. Dine primære opgaver vil omfatte:

Modtagelse og introduktion af nye beboere samt håndtering af adgangs- og tilstedeværelseskontrol

  • Gennemførelse af visitations- og runderingsopgaver samt diverse opgaver forbundet med indkvarteringsfunktionen.
  • Understøttelse af beboeraktiviteter og deltagelse i servicefunktioner, der sikrer en værdig tilværelse.
  • Medvirken til at opretholde ro og orden, forebygge kriminalitet og skabe tryghed for beboerne.
  • Udførelse af lettere administrativt arbejde og håndtering af verbal konflikthåndtering.
  • Gennemførelse af kørselsopgaver og indgåelse i vagter på omsorgsafdelingen.


Om dig

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Har gennemført minimum 9. klasse eller tilsvarende og er tålmodig, men samtidig i stand til at sætte grænser og kommunikere tydeligt.
  • Har en robust personlighed og ønsker at arbejde med udsatte mennesker.
  • Er samarbejdsvillig, men også beslutningsdygtig inden for givne rammer.
  • Behersker dansk i skrift og tale; beherskelse af andre sprog er et plus.
  • Har basale IT-færdigheder og trives med alsidige praktiske opgaver.
  • Kan arbejde professionelt og løse opgaver effektivt, også når personlige holdninger udfordres.


Vi tilbyder

Tre gode grunde til at arbejde hos os:

  • En spændende og selvstændig hverdag, hvor du kan bidrage til at forme arbejdspladsen.
  • Et obligatorisk uddannelsesforløb, der forbereder dig grundigt til din nye rolle.
  • Muligheden for at tage del i en samfundsopgave med stor betydning og påvirkning


Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelse og aflønning sker i henhold fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer samt organisationsaftale for institutionsmedarbejdere i Kriminalforsorgen og de hertil indgåede lokalaftaler. Basislønnen, eksklusive pension, inklusive funktionstillæg udgør 27.618,13 kr. om måneden i aktuelt niveau. Efter 2 års ansættelse stiger lønnen til 30.072,23 kr. om måneden. Dertil kommer særlige ydelser for ubekvemt arbejdstid.

  • Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling med en gennemsnitlig arbejdstid på 37 timer om ugen.
  • 365 dage om året er der døgnbemanding på udrejsecentrene, og du skal forvente at arbejde på alle tider af døgnet i vagter op til 12 timer ad gangen. Der vil være mulighed for fleksibilitet i vagtplanlægningen.
  • Ansættelsesområdet er Danmarks Fængsler.
  • Dit primære tjenestested vil indtil videre være Institution Enner Mark, Udrejsecenter Kærshovedgård, Kærshovedgård 17, 7430 Ikast.
  • Du vil referere til enhedschefen.
  • Stillingerne forventes besat 1. december 2026, 1. januar 2027, 1. februar 2027 eller snarest derefter.


Om os

Udrejsecentret Kærshovedgård skal kunne huse op til 400 personer, der har fået endeligt afslag på asyl, samt gruppen af udvisningsdømte kriminelle og personer på tålt ophold. Beboerne er generelt ikke frihedsberøvet, men er pålagt opholds-, melde- og underretningspligt. På centret er der en døgnbemandet politienhed fra Midt- og Vestjyllands Politi, som sammen med Danmarks Fængsler, har ansvaret for tryghed på udrejsecentret. Herudover driver Røde Kors en syge- og omsorgsafdeling og er leverandør af undervisnings-, aktiverings- og sundhedsfaglige ydelser, ligesom Hjemrejsestyrelsen har en afdeling på centeret.

Som institutionsmedarbejder i udrejsecenteret skal du i samarbejde med udrejsecentrets øvrige personale understøtte beboerne og bidrage til, at de får en tryg og værdig hverdag. Du vil have opsynsopgaver, adgangs- og tilstedeværelseskontroller samt forefaldende administrative opgaver i udrejsecentrets servicefunktioner. Du skal have kørekort, da der er en del kørsler forbundet med arbejdet, og vi forventer desuden, at du er i stand til at bevæge dig rundt i bygningerne og området til fods.

Du vil snarest muligt efter ansættelsen gennemgå et kort uddannelsesforløb, så du bliver klædt på til opgaverne. Uddannelsen vil bl.a. indeholde en introduktion til regler og retningslinjer for at sikre, at opgavevaretagelsen er professionel og i overensstemmelse med kriminalforsorgens procedurer og værdiprogram.

Der vil være en høj grad af variation i opgaverne, og arbejdspladsen er kendetegnet ved mange forskellige nationaliteter og kulturer.



Ansøgning

Du søger stillingen via linket "Søg stillingen”.

Din ansøgning med CV og dokumentation for eventuel uddannelse og forudgående erfaring samt andet relevant materiale skal være modtaget senest den 20. november 2026.

Vi forventer at holde løbende samtaler fra uge 44 til og med uge 48.

Hvis du indkaldes til samtale, skal du til samtalen medbringe billedidentifikation, f.eks. pas eller kørekort.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du i forbindelse med samtalen giver dit samtykke til, at kriminalforsorgen må indhente og vurdere oplysninger om dig i det Centrale Kriminalregister. Inden ansættelse skal vi modtage dokumentation for CV.

Alle interesserede uanset personlig baggrund opfordres til at søge.



Yderligere oplysninger

Har du spørgsmål til stillingerne som institutionsmedarbejder, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionschef Marianne Klarholt 7255 6190, eller enhedschef Jørn Støvring på 7255 6170.

title: Low-Voltage Technician
description:

title: Senior Software Engineer (C#, .Net, Advanced SQL - Sports Domain Experience)
description:
Role Summary
The Stats Developer builds, supports, and improves the systems and integrations that power live sports statistics across DAZN/Fox Sports products and broadcast workflows. The role focuses on ingesting, validating, transforming, and publishing sports data from third-party providers and internal capture systems so it can be used reliably by digital products, broadcast graphics, and internal stakeholders.
This role sits at the intersection of sports data, live operations, product delivery, and stakeholder support — covering provider integrations, internal capture platforms, broadcast data feeds, and operational support for a 24x7 sports data environment.
Sports Data Integrations
  • Build, maintain, and support integrations with external sports data providers including, but not limited to Sport radar and Champion Data.
  • Support real-time and near-real-time ingestion pipelines for sports such as AFL, Netball, NRL, Cricket, Football, Basketball, Motorsport, and others as required
  • Map provider data into internal schemas and publishing models used by APIs, widgets, broadcast systems, and internal tools
  • Investigate and resolve issues with incoming feeds, data quality, sequencing, match states, and downstream publishing
  • Support changes required when providers update feed structures, fields, or delivery patterns
Internal Stats Capture Support
  • Support and enhance in-house stats capture systems used for sports including NRL and Cricket
  • Work closely with the internal stats division to ensure captured data is correctly stored, validated, published, and displayed
  • Help maintain the tools and workflows used for live capture, correction, validation, and display of match statistics
  • Support internal users of capture and display systems during live events and operational windows
  • Assist with issue triage, defect resolution, and continuous improvement of internal stats workflow
Broadcast and Graphics Support
  • Support data delivery for OB graphics and related broadcast workflows, including integrations that feed systems such as Virtual Eye
  • Ensure live and post-match data is available in the correct format and at the right time for on-air and production use
  • Troubleshoot issues affecting graphics, overlays, scoreboards, and other production-facing data outputs
  • Work with broadcast, production, and operational stakeholders to support live event requirements
Internal Stakeholder Support
  • Support internal stakeholders across stats operations, editorial, digital, product, broadcast, and production
  • Help deliver and maintain data used in scoreboards, match centres, fixtures, ladders, player stats, breakdowns, and related sports experiences
  • Collaborate with product managers, developers, QA, and operations teams to improve reliability and usability of stats products
  • Investigate and resolve data issues raised by internal users and business teams
  • Provide technical support and clear communication during incidents, live issues, and post-event review
Platform Support, Operations, and On-Call
  • Support a 24x7 sports data platform that underpins live scores, statistics, capture, and broadcast data services
  • Participate in an on-call roster to support live and business-critical sports data systems outside standard business hours
  • Monitor and respond to incidents affecting provider integrations, internal capture systems, publishing pipelines, and downstream consumers
  • Perform production support, issue triage, root cause analysis, and service recovery during live sporting events
  • Support planned sporting calendars, peak event periods, and critical match windows where operational responsiveness is essential
  • Contribute to operational readiness, support documentation, and continuous improvement of platform reliability
Typical Project Areas
  • Integrating and supporting Sportradar feeds for schedules, scores, standings, and player/team data
  • Integrating and supporting Champion Data feeds for sports such as AFL and Netball
  • Supporting internal capture platforms for NRL and Cricket
  • Delivering and maintaining data feeds for OB graphics and Virtual Eye
  • Supporting internal stats products used by editorial, digital, production, and operations teams
  • Improving the reliability and usability of live stats capture and display workflows
  • Supporting platform operations, incident response, and live-event troubleshooting in a 24x7 environment
  • Assisting with new sports, new competitions, and changes to provider data structures or
    downstream requirements
Core Technical Skills
  • Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server
  • Strong SQL skills including:
    o query writing
    o stored procedures
    o views
    o triggers
    o data investigation and troubleshooting
    o performance-aware database development
  • Experience working with .NET / C# applications
  • Experience supporting or developing desktop applications used for operational or capture
    workflows
  • Experience working with data integration services, import processes, and real-time or near-realtime data pipelines
  • Experience with XML, JSON, and API/data-feed integration patterns
  • Experience troubleshooting production issues across application, database, and integration layers
  • CI/CD and Github actions
  • Expertise in EKS, Argo and AWS suite
Sports Data / Platform Experience
  • Experience working with sports data, live data feeds, or real-time integrations
  • Experience integrating third-party providers such as Sportradar, Champion Data, or similar
  • Experience supporting systems used in broadcast, graphics, digital sports products, or sports statistics platforms
  • Experience supporting operational or live-event systems where timeliness and accuracy are critical
  • Ability to work closely with internal operational stakeholders in high-pressure live environments
.NET / Application Stack
  • Based on the nature of the platform and internal tooling, the role should be comfortable working across:
    o C# / .NET applications
    o Microsoft SQL Server-backed applications
    o Desktop applications used by internal stats/capture teams
    o Service and integration applications that support ingestion, transformation, and publishing of sports data
    o SQL Server in production environments
    o Experience with modern and legacy .NET application stacks
  • Experience in a sports broadcast, sports media, or live operations environment
  • Familiarity with OB graphics, Virtual Eye, or other production graphics/data workflows
  • Experience supporting capture and display tools used by internal operational teams
  • Knowledge of sports data products such as scoreboards, ladders, player stats, match
    breakdowns, and fixtures
  • Experience participating in on-call support or supporting 24x7 production platforms
  • Experience with incident management, service recovery, and post-incident review processes

title: Manual Operator
description:
Job Description:
To aid the future growth of the business, we are looking for a Manual Operator to add to our Advanced Manufacturing Centre team, based in Northampton. The role will be responsible producing components to the company standard in the most efficient and cost effective manner.

The Role:

title: Smerup, Spjellerup, Hellested og Vemmetofte sogne – De Fire Kirker – søger en engageret kirke- og kulturmedarbejder
description:
Smerup, Spjellerup, Hellested og Vemmetofte sogne – De Fire Kirker – søger en engageret kirke- og kulturmedarbejder

Bliv en del af et levende kirkeliv i Tryggevælde Provsti – 20 timer om ugen.

Kirke- og kulturmedarbejder med blik for idéer, kommunikation og administration

Har du lyst til at skabe liv og fællesskab omkring fire forskellige kirker – og er du samtidig god til at holde styr på de praktiske og administrative tråde?

Stillingen kombinerer kirke- og kulturarbejde, kommunikation, koordinering og administration – med gode muligheder for selv at præge jobbet.

Dine opgaver

Du bliver medspiller i arbejdet med at skabe levende og åbne kirker og samtidig få hverdagen omkring fire kirker til at hænge sammen.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • aktiviteter og arrangementer – især for børn og familier

  • minikonfirmander og medvirken ved konfirmandundervisning

  • samarbejde med skoler, foreninger, frivillige og lokale aktører

  • udvikling af nye aktiviteter og fællesskaber

  • kalender og koordinering af gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger og arrangementer

  • hjemmeside, kommunikation og koordinering af kirkeblad.

Vi søger dig, der

  • har lyst til at arbejde med mennesker, kirkeliv og fællesskaber og gerne har erfaring med børn og unge

  • har idéer og kan omsætte dem til handling

  • har sans for struktur, administration og koordinering og følger opgaver til dørs

  • kommunikerer godt og er fortrolig med IT og digitale systemer

  • kan arbejde både selvstændigt og sammen med andre.

Du behøver ikke have en bestemt uddannelsesmæssig baggrund. Det vigtigste er dine kompetencer og dit engagement.

Om De Fire Kirker

Vi er fire forskellige landsogne med hver vores særpræg og et aktivt lokalt liv. Vi ønsker åbne kirker med plads til både traditioner, nye idéer og mennesker, der ikke nødvendigvis er vant til at komme i kirken.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er på 20 timer ugentligt.

Ansættelsen er omfattet af Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og Statstjenestemændenes Centralorganisation af 2010 (CO10) samt organisationsaftalen for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som bl.a. kirke- og kulturmedarbejder.

Medarbejdere, der opfylder kompetencekravet, aflønnes i løngruppe 2 med en årsløn for fuldtidsansatte inden for intervallet 367.122 – 500.621 kr. (nutidskroner). Medarbejdere, der ikke opfylder kompetencekravet, aflønnes i løngruppe 1 inden for intervallet 350.435 – 442.216 kr. (nutidskroner). Hertil kommer OK-24-tillæg på 3.654,10 kr. årligt (nutidskroner). Lønnen forholdes efter stillingens beskæftigelsesgrad. Tallene er udregnet for en fuldtidsstilling og vil blive reguleret til det faktuelle timetal man bliver ansat med.

Lønindplacering aftales mellem menighedsrådet og .

Der må påregnes skiftende arbejdstider, og der ydes tillæg for aftenarbejde efter gældende regler. Der er tre måneders prøvetid, og der indhentes børneattest.

Kørekort er nødvendigt, og du skal være villig til at benytte egen bil i arbejdet.

Praktiske oplysninger:

Stillingen er på 20 timer ugentligt.
Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027
Ansøgningsfrist: 9. november 2026
Ansættelsessamtaler: 16. og 17. november 2027

title: Tecnico Veterinario (VA)
description:
R-258773 Animal Care Assistant I (VA) (Open)

Luogo – Clinica Veterinaria Malpensa, Samarate (VA)

Orario – 40 ore settimanali. Disponibilità per turni notturni e nei weekend, a rotazione.


Perché unirsi a noi?

  • Entrerai a far parte di un team multidisciplinare, collaborando quotidianamente con professionisti altamente qualificati in un ambiente orientato alla condivisione delle competenze.

  • Avrai accesso a percorsi di formazione continua, per sviluppare e consolidare le tue competenze tecniche e professionali nel settore veterinario.

  • Lavorerai in una struttura moderna e sicura, dotata di tecnologie all’avanguardia e di avanzate opzioni diagnostiche e terapeutiche.


Attività previste dal ruolo:

  • Monitoraggio delle condizioni degli animali ricoverati;

  • Somministrazione di farmaci sotto la supervisione del Medico Veterinario;

  • Esecuzione di prelievi e gestione della fluidoterapia;

  • Controllo e mantenimento degli standard igienico-sanitari degli ambienti clinici, nel rispetto delle linee guida AniCura;

  • Supporto alle attività di front office e accoglienza dei clienti.

Il team

La Clinica Veterinaria Malpensa dispone di tecnologie diagnostiche e terapeutiche di ultima generazione, tra cui risonanza magnetica Siemens 1.5 Tesla, TC a 128 strati, apparecchiature di elettrodiagnostica, ecografia, radiologia digitale, ecocardiografia, ECG digitale, sistemi Holter digitali, laboratorio di elettrofisiologia ed endoscopia rigida e flessibile. Completano la struttura il laboratorio analisi interno, l'Unità di Terapia Intensiva e Rianimazione e il reparto di degenza.

Lo staff comprende numerosi professionisti con Diplomi Europei e Americani, favorendo un ambiente altamente specialistico e orientato alla formazione continua. La clinica gestisce un volume di circa 10.000 casi all'anno, offrendo un'esposizione clinica ampia e diversificata.

AniCura Clinica Veterinaria Malpensa è una struttura di referenza aperta 24 ore su 24, situata in posizione strategica in provincia di Varese, nelle vicinanze dell'Aeroporto di Milano Malpensa.

Cosa cerchiamo

  • Esperienza di almeno 6 mesi nel ruolo di Tecnico Veterinario, maturata in contesti clinici o ospedalieri veterinari.

  • Certificazione Abivet o titolo di studio equiparabile, requisito essenziale per l'esercizio della professione.

  • Spiccate capacità comunicative e relazionali, con attitudine a interagire in modo professionale ed empatico sia con i clienti sia con il team medico-sanitario.

  • Predisposizione al lavoro di squadra, con approccio collaborativo e orientamento al supporto reciproco in un contesto multidisciplinare.

  • Forte motivazione alla crescita professionale e all'aggiornamento continuo delle proprie competenze.


Cosa offriamo

  • Contratto iniziale a tempo determinato di 6 mesi, prorogabile.

  • Retribuzione iniziale: a partire da €23,165.80 lordi annui all’inizio del rapporto di lavoro. La retribuzione base offerta potrà variare in funzione di diversi fattori individuali, inclusi, a titolo esemplificativo e non esaustivo, conoscenze, competenze ed esperienza rilevanti per il ruolo, nonché eventuali contratti collettivi applicabili.

  • Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di Lavoro (CCNL) applicabile: Studi Professionali

  • Livello di inquadramento: 4S

  • Disposizioni pertinenti del CCNL: Il pacchetto retributivo totale per questa posizione può includere anche altri elementi, se previsti, tra cui retribuzione variabile e indennità generali (a seconda della posizione e dell'orario di lavoro del dipendente).

  • Possibilità di usufruire di sconti dedicati sui servizi clinici AniCura e presso partner selezionati, tra cui Royal Canin.

  • Accesso alla piattaforma di convenzioni, che offre sconti e offerte speciali su un'ampia gamma di prodotti e servizi.

  • Opportunità di partecipare a seminari e conferenze che favoriscono il continuo aggiornamento professionale e consentono di mantenere le proprie competenze costantemente aggiornate.

  • Formazione continua attraverso programmi di e-learning e percorsi formativi dedicati.

  • Programma di wellbeing con supporto psicologico, coaching e consulenza specialistica.


Pronto per il tuo prossimo passo? Candidati oggi e diventa parte della creazione di UN MONDO MIGLIORE PER GLI ANIMALI DOMESTICI.

Chi siamo

AniCura è uno dei principali fornitori europei di cure veterinarie, che riunisce una rete di cliniche e ospedali veterinari dedicati alla salute e al benessere degli animali da compagnia. La nostra ambizione è plasmare il futuro della medicina veterinaria attraverso la collaborazione continua, la condivisione delle migliori pratiche e l'impegno verso i nostri valori fondamentali.

Facciamo parte di Mars Veterinary Health, la più grande azienda veterinaria a conduzione familiare al mondo. Come parte di questa rete globale connessa, ogni anno aiutiamo a curare milioni di animali domestici e sosteniamo le persone che li amano. Essere di proprietà privata ci consente di rimanere concentrati sul nostro Scopo - UN MONDO MIGLIORE PER GLI ANIMALI DOMESTICI - e di investire nell'erogazione di cure veterinarie di alta qualità in ogni fase.

In AniCura, prendersi cura degli animali inizia dal prendersi cura delle nostre persone. Siamo orgogliosi di una cultura basata sulla collaborazione, sull'apprendimento e sul supporto, in cui i colleghi sono incoraggiati a svilupparsi sia personalmente sia professionalmente. Le nostre persone sono al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo e sono ciò che ci distingue davvero. Quando ti unisci ad AniCura, diventi parte di qualcosa di più grande: un'organizzazione internazionale in crescita che sta contribuendo a creare un futuro prospero per le cure veterinarie e per i professionisti che le rendono possibili.

AniCura è un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità e tutti i candidati qualificati saranno presi in considerazione per l'assunzione indipendentemente da razza, colore, religione, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, stato di disabilità, appartenenza alle categorie protette o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge. Se hai bisogno di assistenza o di un adattamento durante il processo di candidatura a causa di una disabilità, tale assistenza è disponibile su richiesta scrivendo a giada.malerba@anicura.it. AniCura è lieta di fornire tale assistenza e nessun candidato sarà penalizzato a seguito di tale richiesta.

title: Network & Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
About Rocket Factory Augsburg

At Rocket Factory Augsburg (RFA), we have one clear goal: to create low-cost, flexible, and reliable access to space. We specialize in building small launch vehicles designed to deploy satellites into Low Earth Orbit (LEO) and beyond. Together with you, we aim to revolutionize space services and help improve life on Earth. Sounds interesting? Then join our journey and become part of the team driving the New Space movement in Europe.

About the Team

At Rocket Factory Augsburg (RFA), we're building the infrastructure that enables affordable access to space. As a Network & Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d), you will play a critical role in ensuring that our IT systems are secure, scalable, and highly available across our engineering, manufacturing, and test facilities.
You'll join a collaborative and hands-on IT team that supports a fast-growing aerospace company where reliability, performance, and innovation matter every day. This role offers the opportunity to work across networking, virtualization, storage, infrastructure resilience, and automation while helping shape the future of our IT landscape.
If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working with modern infrastructure technologies, and contributing to a mission that pushes technological boundaries, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Tasks

  • Design, implement, and maintain secure and reliable network infrastructure, including firewalls, routers, switches, VPNs, and related services.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize Layer 2 and Layer 3 network environments to ensure high performance, stability, and security.
  • Manage and enhance virtualized infrastructure environments based on VMware, Proxmox technologies and associated storage platforms.
  • Ensure high availability, business continuity, and disaster recovery readiness across multiple company locations.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to support Linux-based systems, infrastructure automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Investigate and resolve networking and infrastructure incidents while providing technical support and root-cause analysis.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date technical documentation, operational procedures, and infrastructure standards.

Your Qualifications

Must-Have Skills

title: Souschef - Fuldtid - Souschef
description:
Kan du motivere branchens bedste kolleger og bidrage til, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar? Så er du måske vores nye souschef.

Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 170+ butikker i Danmark. Sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, og på #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse – på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles. Vi har brug for stærke ledere, der giver vores medarbejdere retning og overskud, så vi sammen skaber rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse.
Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles – i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.

Om jobbet

Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen:

  • Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver
  • Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter
  • Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job
  • Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes
  • Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede

Om dig

Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar.
Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du:

  • Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling
  • Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder
  • Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning
  • Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel
  • Har overblik og fokus på detaljen
  • Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp
  • Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter

Vi tilbyder

Som souschef i Lidl får du:

  • En udfordrende rolle, hvor tingene går stærkt
  • Verdensklasse sammenhold
  • En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke på 26.000 – 32.500 kr. brutto om måneden
  • Vi yder ekstraordinært et forskudttidstillæg, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter (fx aftener, weekender og helligdage), i henhold til de gældende regler og satser i butiksoverenskomsten.
  • Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst med HK
  • En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter
  • Adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt
  • Mulighed for sundhedsordning
  • Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.

Vil du med på #teamlidl?
Sådan søger du stillingen:

  • Klik på ”Søg nu”

Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken.

title: Product Owner Negolyte (all genders)
description:
We pioneered the Organic SolidFlow battery

CMBlu Energy is on an exciting journey towards becoming a global cleantech company. Our mission is to enable unlimited energy storage modelled on nature - for everyone, worldwide.

What are SolidFlow batteries?

SolidFlow batteries store energy in organic molecules. The absence of explosive materials makes them safe, the use of socially and ecologically conflict-free raw materials makes them sustainable and the almost unlimited availability of materials makes them scalable and cheap to procure. This makes our patented SolidFlow technology a game changer in the development of a global climate-neutral energy system.

From start-up to scale-up: we're tackling it together

CMBlu Energy is developing from a start-up focussing on research into a manufacturing scale-up that is on its way to series production. Around 240 employees are working towards this goal at CMBlu Energy. Our head office is in Alzenau near Frankfurt, with a branch office in Obernburg. There are also subsidiaries in Athens, Greece and Petaluma, USA.

Your Responsibilities

  • You define, prioritize, and steer the technical tasks of the negolyte development team in our agile framework, and you own the team backlog and translate company objectives into data-driven development priorities.
  • You make transparent, data- and fact-based prioritization decisions and drive rapid build-measure-learn iterations with clear traceability, fostering an outcome-oriented, collaborative way of working.
  • You are the central point of technical accountability in the project team and ensure visibility and shared understanding of backlog, roadmap, and development priorities.
  • You drive technical trade-off decisions between development teams and system design, balancing performance, stability, manufacturability, and cost, and ensure component-level development is compatible with the overall system.
  • You identify and mitigate scale-up, sourcing, and processing risks early and support pilot-scale validation.
  • You contribute to the IP strategy, including filing your own patent applications and assessing the IP landscape of competitors.

Your Profile

  • Completed doctorate or master’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or comparable qualification
  • Experience in product ownership, R&D project management, or technical program management in a complex development environment
  • Experience with agile development methods, backlog management, and cross-functional collaboration
  • Solid understanding of electrochemistry, battery systems, or materials development is an advantage
  • Strong prioritization and outcome-focused decision-making skills, combined with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Structured, collaborative, and solution-oriented way of working, with the ability to balance technical, organizational, and business requirements

Your benefits at CMBLU Energy AG

  • More net pay for you: Enjoy an extra €50 tax-free every month with your Spendit Card (pro-rata for part-time employees). Use it flexibly at numerous Visa acceptance points in your region – wherever it suits you. Your Spendit Card also gives you access to Wellhub, connecting you with gyms, fitness classes and wellness offers across Germany.
  • Sustainable mobility: We cover the full cost of your Deutschland-Ticket, a nationwide public transport pass valid on all local and regional trains, buses, trams, and subways across Germany. Additionally, you can lease the bike of your choice at attractive rates through JobRad. Whether you prefer train or bike, we make it easier for you to travel comfortably and sustainably.
  • Share in our success: Our Virtual Stock Option Program (VSOP) gives you the opportunity to share in CMBLU’s success and growth. Simply put, you receive virtual shares without having to make a personal investment and without voting rights. As CMBLU grows in value, you can benefit financially from that growth.
  • Fresh and delicious food for your workday: At our Alzenau site, you can enjoy fresh, subsidized meals every day from our freshtaste meal vending machine.
  • Learn languages your way: With Busuu, you can improve your language skills at your own pace and with maximum flexibility. We provide you with free access to the language-learning platform.
  • Purpose that drives you: Help shape the energy transition with us and contribute to the further development of our SolidFlow battery. Since 2026, CMBLU has been a unicorn, meaning our company is valued at more than one billion euros. Through your work, you actively help shape this growth.
  • A culture that connects: At CMBLU, the values of reliability, innovation, and relentlessness shape our collaboration. This is also lived out beyond everyday work: at a shared BBQ, an end-of-year celebration, or team sports activities. We celebrate our successes together, because they are the result of teamwork.

We look forward to reimagining the future of energy together with you.

Apply now and be a part of our exciting journey.

title: Medical Billing Specialist
description:
About Medserv:

Medserv, an Irish company, has quickly established itself as the market leader in providing Medical billing and Practice management services throughout Ireland and the UK. Our clients include individual and group consultants, GP practices as well as private clinics and hospitals. Inspired by our values of Always innovating, Being trustworthy, Collaborating positively and Delivering results, we strive to ensure on-going client satisfaction by combining our innovative technology solutions with highly skilled teams.


About the role:

As a Medical Billing Specialist, the core of the role will revolve around the daily processing of invoices and claim forms for all patient claims, to following up on outstanding accounts with clients such as doctors, hospitals, and insurers. Your day can vary, though, from data extraction and analysis to training new team members or learning how to use a new system.


Responsibilities:

  • Reviewing, processing, and managing patient claims while ensuring accuracy and compliance with client, hospital, and insurer requirements.
  • Following up on unpaid invoices and claims with hospitals, insurers, and patients, identifying trends and resolving issues to maximise reimbursement and reduce payment delays.
  • Ensuring all claims meet the standards, rules, and requirements of insurance companies, hospitals, and clients to achieve maximum reimbursement and maintain high levels of client satisfaction.
  • Handling insurer and hospital returns, corrections, and claim-related queries, ensuring timely and accurate resolution.
  • Answering internal and external telephone enquiries from colleagues, clients, hospitals, and insurers, maintaining a professional approach and providing accurate information.
  • Responding to daily email and ticketing system queries from internal and external stakeholders within agreed timeframes, while managing additional correspondence as required.
  • Establishing and maintaining strong working relationships with clients, hospitals, insurers, and other key stakeholders.
  • Attending and participating in training programmes, while providing guidance, mentorship, and support to less experienced team members.
  • Performing additional duties and projects as assigned by management to support departmental and organisational objectives

Desirable (but not essential)

  • Experience in healthcare or insurance sector

Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and general PC applications.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Effective time management and prioritisation skills.

  • Healthy food with comfortable on-site recreational facilities
