title: Industritekniker til CNC-bearbejdning i Brønderslev
description:
Er du industritekniker og klar på CNC og måleteknik?

Her får du fast arbejde i Brønderslev med udfordring i hverdagen.

Du lander i et større produktionsmiljø, hvor bearbejdning, laserskæring og svejsning spiller sammen i hverdagen. Arbejdet retter sig mod maskinindustrien, så emnerne skal kunne holde til mere end bare et hurtigt kig. Der er både sorte og rustfrie materialer i huset, og det giver en hverdag hvor præcision og ordentlig kontrol betyder noget.

Rollen passer til dig, der kan lide at stå selv med en opgave og få den afleveret rigtigt. CNC-bearbejdning og måleteknik er kernen, men det er ikke et sted hvor du bare trykker start og slår hovedet fra. Når noget ikke stemmer, forventes det at du siger til og får det rettet, før emnet går videre.

Det får du

Løn: 180-200 kr. i timen

Arbejdsområde: Brønderslev og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: CNC, måleteknik og kvalitetssikring

Din hverdag

Dagen ligger i produktionen, hvor emnerne skal bearbejdes, måles og tjekkes, før de sendes videre. Du arbejder selvstændigt med dine opgaver og holder styr på, at mål og kvalitet passer. Når en opgave kræver ekstra vurdering, tager du fat i de rigtige folk i stedet for at gætte dig frem.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • CNC-bearbejdning af emner
  • Måleteknik og kvalitetssikring
  • Opstilling, indkøring og justering
  • Kvalitetskontrol med måleværktøj
  • Bearbejdning i produktionsopgaver til industrien

Der er udfordring i hverdagen, fordi opgaverne kræver at du bruger hovedet og ikke kun hænderne. Det vigtigste er, at du afleverer noget du kan stå inde for.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har erfaring som industritekniker eller maskinarbejder
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt i produktionen
  • Er grundig med måling og kvalitet
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med CNC i produktion før. Men det vigtigste er, at du er stabil, nysgerrig og tager ansvar for det emne du har foran dig.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

title: Greeter / Asiakaspalvelija Seinäjoki

title: People and Culture Specialist (d/f/m)
description:
Why us

Aignostics is a spin-off from one of Europe’s largest and most prestigious university hospitals (Charité), with employees in Berlin and New York. We have received over €50M in funding from leading investors and are a growing team of over 80 interdisciplinary professionals. We work with leading global life sciences companies as well as academic partners.

We believe that AI has the potential to revolutionize how cancer and other complex diseases are diagnosed and treated. Without access to high quality data and a scientifically rigorous, transparent approach to model development, AI is just a buzzword. That’s where we come in.

The role

You'll be the main contact for our employees and managers on everything across the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding. Your work will keep our people operations running smoothly and support a culture where employees can do their best work.

This is a chance to own day-to-day People operations at a mission-driven scale-up, contribute to ongoing projects and help shape how we grow as an organization. The right candidate brings sound judgment, discretion, a collaborative mindset and the ability to turn complex people topics into clear, practical solutions.

What you will do

  • Own the employee lifecycle: Manage onboarding, contract changes, leaves, and offboarding, making sure every employee has a smooth, well-organized experience.

  • Run people operations: Draft employment contracts, amendments and reference letters, maintain accurate employee data in our HRIS, and prepare monthly payroll inputs with our external payroll provider.

  • Advise employees and managers: Be the first point of contact for questions on policies, working time, leave, benefits and employee relations, and give pragmatic advice grounded in German labor law.

  • Drive people programs: Help run performance and feedback cycles, engagement initiatives and team events that strengthen our culture.

  • Improve processes: Find ways to make our policies, tools and workflows simpler and more scalable and help put them into practice.

  • Contribute to team success: Share knowledge, support teammates and help create a positive, inclusive and high-performing work environment.

What we are looking for

title: Supervisor - Espergærde
description:
Supervisor i Netto – Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for kollegaer og kunder i weekenden ?

Er du klar til at tage ansvar og udvikle dig i et stærkt fællesskab? Som supervisor i Netto får du muligheden for at prøve kræfter med at have ansvar og du er både rollemodel og sparringspartner for dine kollegaer. Du bliver en central del af teamet og er med til at sikre, at butikken altid leverer gode oplevelser for vores kunder – hver dag.

Hvad indebærer jobbet?
Som supervisor har du ansvaret for at butikken er salgsklar og indbydende. Du bidrager til at motivere og støtte dine kollegaer. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Koordinering af vareopfyldning og trimning
  • Sikre korrekt skiltning
  • Kundeservice og betjening ved kassen
  • Bidrage til rengøring, orden i butik og baglokale
  • Områdeansvarlig for et eller flere udvalgte områder
  • Deltage i oplæring af nye kollegaer

Du får en grundig oplæring i Nettos koncepter, så du er godt klædt på til at tage ansvar for kollegaer og opgaver. Du vil på udvalgte vagter skulle være alene om ansvaret åbne eller lukke butikken – og synes at det er en spændende udfordring.

Hvorfor vælge Netto?
Hos os bliver du en del af et stærkt fællesskab med fokus på samarbejde, ansvar, feedback og fleksibilitet. Du får mulighed for at udvikle dig i rollen, lære om detailhandel og tage næste skridt i din karriere.

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er serviceminded og trives med kundekontakt
  • Har lyst til at tage ansvar
  • Kan motivere og støtte et team, hvor vi løfter i flok
  • Er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider (aften og weekend)
  • Har gåpåmod og lyst til at lære nyt

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et job med ansvar og gode udviklingsmuligheder
  • At du kan blive en del af et stærkt team – hvor vi samarbejder og hjælper hinanden
  • Et positivt arbejdsmiljø
  • Feedback fra chefer og kollegaer
  • Fleksible arbejdstider og en stærk teamkultur

Alle de gode grunde til at blive supervisor i Netto
Du får typisk mellem 20 – 40 kollegaer i butikken, og vi oplever ofte, at kollegaskabet udvikler sig til venskaber.

Du kan også glæde dig til:

  • Løn og arbejdsvilkår der følger HK overenskomst
  • Pensionsordning
  • Sundhedsforsikring
  • Masser af gode personalegoder, fx rabatter i Bilka, føtex, Netto, Carl’s Jr. og Starbucks
  • Mulighed for leje af vores feriehuse og lejligheder i ind- og udland
  • Adgang til Salling online personaleshop med 35% rabat
  • Mulighed for at handle i vores fysiske Salling varehuse i Aalborg, Aarhus og snart i København, hvor vi åbner i 2026 med 35% rabat

Bliv en del af Netto-ånden: Sammenhold, engagement og fællesskab
I Netto fylder sammenhold, engagement og fællesskab rigtig meget. Vi kalder det Netto-ånden, og den bliver man hurtigt bidt af. Det er den hjælpende hånd, smilet der stadig sidder fast efter en lang dag, og det er sammenholdet, der får os til at løfte i flok.

Hos Netto skal alle medarbejdere opleve, at de er en del af et stærkt team, hvor de føler sig respekteret, og deres indsats er højt værdsat. Vi tilbyder varierende opgaver, der motiverer og udvikler dig – både til gavn for din fremtid hos os eller andre steder. Vi tager et stort ansvar for at gøre hverdagen bedre for medarbejdere, kunder og det samfund, vi er en del af.

title: Oracle PL SQL Developer
description:
Job Description: Oracle PL/SQL Developer (with Unix Shell Scripting)

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Oracle PL/SQL Developer with a strong background in Unix Shell Scripting . In this role, you will be responsible for developing database objects, optimizing query performance, and writing automated Unix scripts to handle batch processing and data integration tasks. The ideal candidate thrives in a backend environment, possesses excellent troubleshooting skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Database Development: Design and develop highly efficient Oracle database code including stored procedures, functions, packages, triggers, and views to support complex business logic.
  • Automation & Scripting: Create, maintain, and debug complex Unix/Linux shell scripts (Wrapper Programs) to automate routine PL/SQL Programs, and scheduled batch jobs.
  • Performance Tuning: Monitor and optimize code performance by tuning complex SQL statements and PL/SQL blocks using tools like EXPLAIN PLAN, TKPROF, Oracle Hints, and indexing strategies.

· ETL & Data Integration: Design and manage Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) data pipelines using SQL*Loader, external tables, or native PL/SQL to migrate data from legacy systems and external sources.

· Data Modeling & Architecture: Participate in relational database design, table partitioning, and data modeling to ensure data integrity and scalable performance.

· Production Support & Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve, failing batch jobs, and performance bottlenecks in a timely manner.

· Collaboration**:** Partner with System Analysts, Quality Assurance teams, and System Administrators to migrate code across environments and support testing team

title: Senior HR Business Consultant
description:
Jij maakt het mogelijk

Een CEO die met 80 mensen een reorganisatie in moet en jou belt voordat hij het zijn MT vertelt. Een leiderschapsteam dat jouw hulp inroept omdat het na twee jaar hard groeien merkt dat de oude manier van werken vastloopt. Een collega-VIE'er die bij een eerste groot veranderproject even met je wil sparren over hoe ze de weerstand in het team aanpakt. En dat is slechts een deel van je werkweek.

Als Senior HR Business Consultant ben je de sparringpartner van founders, CEO's en MT's van ambitieuze groeibedrijven en werk je voor meerdere bedrijven tegelijkertijd. Je weet wat er speelt als een organisatie van 40 naar 150 mensen gaat en je helpt ze daar doorheen: organisatie-inrichting, leiderschap, cultuur, performance. Vooral verandering is jouw ding. Je weet dat een nieuwe structuur bedenken makkelijk is en dat het echte werk begint zodra mensen er iets van gaan vinden.

Je kijkt ook verder dan je eigen opdrachten: waar kunnen we een klant nog beter helpen, welke nieuwe klant past bij ons, wat hebben we nodig om te groeien? VIE staat voor een volgende stap en we willen dat jij een van de mensen bent die mee gaat bouwen aan onze organisatie.

Jij hebt het

Je hebt ruime ervaring in HR, als HR-lead , HR-manager, coach, veranderkundige of consultant, en je hebt aan tafel gezeten bij een MT. Je hebt organisaties zien groeien, krimpen of veranderen en kan goed tegen verandering. Verder herken je jezelf hierin:

  • Je hebt mensen aangestuurd en je vindt het oprecht leuk om anderen beter te maken. Je geeft feedback die ergens over gaat en je trekt je team mee zonder alles zelf te willen doen.

  • Je denkt commercieel. Je ziet kansen bij klanten, je durft het gesprek over een vervolgopdracht aan te gaan en je vindt het niet vies om over omzet te praten.

  • Je hebt verandertrajecten geleid en weet hoe je een organisatie meekrijgt.

  • Je bent ondernemend en wacht niet tot iemand je vertelt wat er moet gebeuren.

  • Je gelooft meer in de waarde van een goede confrontatie dan in de status quo behouden. Daarom stel je de vraag achter de vraag, ook als dat ongemakkelijk is. En als je vastloopt, vraag je hulp.

  • Je gebruikt tech en AI in je werk omdat je snapt dat het je tijd geeft voor wat er echt toe doet.

  • Je begrijpt hoe organisaties werken en kan HR-overstijgend meedenken en kijken.

  • Je voelt je thuis bij onze kernwaarden: samen doen, oprecht direct en beter maken.

Dit verdien jij

  • Een team collega's met samen honderden jaren People & Culture-ervaring, en een plek waar je die ervaring zelf ook doorgeeft

  • Werk bij uiteenlopende groeibedrijven, met ondernemers die weten wat ze willen (of juist niet, en daar help je dan bij)

  • Regie over je eigen agenda en de vrijheid om nationale feestdagen op te nemen wanneer het voor jou belangrijk is en autonomie over je eigen werk

  • Tijd om je in te zetten voor een goed doel of vrijwilligerswerk. We zijn niet voor niets een B Corp

  • Een salaris dat past bij je ervaring en bij deze rol binnen de range van € 5.083 - € 6.877, plus de rest van onze voorwaarden die je hier vindt

Hoe verder?

Nieuwsgierig? Laten we koffie drinken, gerust eerst gewoon om kennis te maken. Neem direct contact op met Wouter, CEO van VIE People, via wouter@viepeople.com of +31 (0) 6 506 025 72.

title: Lead Mechanical Systems Engineer / Engineering Project Manager
description:
📍 Mollet del Valles (Barcelona), Spain

🏠 Hybrid Working

🌎 Global tech company founded in 2011

🌱 Our mission is to shape the future through technology

The role

We are looking for a highly driven, hands-on Engineering Project Manager / Lead Mechanical Systems Engineer who thrives at the intersection of complex mechanical design, system architecture, and technical leadership. You won't just be managing from afar; you will get your hands dirty, working directly with the physical product and shaping it from end to end.

In this role, you will be the bridge between our customers' needs and our engineering realities. You will oversee the entire product lifecycle—from initial customer conceptualization to industrialization—leading multidisciplinary teams and ensuring the successful delivery of complex, multi-component machines and systems.

Key responsibilities

  • End-to-End System Leadership: Take full ownership of the product lifecycle for complex machines and complete systems, maintaining a holistic vision from initial customer contact and concept definition through to final manufacturing.

  • Hands-on Engineering & Problem Solving: Stay deeply involved with the product. Get on the floor, work with prototypes, troubleshoot complex system interactions, and drive technical solutions firsthand.

  • Customer Facing & Requirements Management: Act as the primary technical point of contact for clients. Translate complex customer needs into robust technical specifications and manage expectations throughout the project milestones.

  • Multidisciplinary Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and synchronize cross-functional teams (mechanical, hardware, software, quality, and manufacturing) to ensure seamless system integration and alignment.

  • BOM & System Architecture Management: Oversee and manage complex Bills of Materials (BOMs), ensuring accurate tracking of intricate assemblies, cost optimization, and supply chain alignment.

  • Design & Architecture Oversight: Shift focus from designing individual parts to overseeing the macro-level mechanical architecture. Guide design teams, conduct rigorous system-level design reviews, and ensure DFM/DFA principles are met.

  • Risk Analysis: Drive proactive risk analysis (DFMEA/PFMEA at the system level) and manage engineering changes with a clear understanding of their impact on the entire machine.

  • Testing, Validation & Industrialization: Lead system-level testing, analyze performance data, and partner closely with manufacturing to guarantee a smooth transition into mass production.

(*) The described functions are only the most representative for this position; therefore, they should not be understood as all the inherent functions related to this job position.

  • 8+ years of proven experience in product engineering, specifically dealing with complete, complex products, machines, or electro-mechanical systems (not just isolated parts).

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • Proven track record of leading multidisciplinary engineering projects and cross-functional teams.

  • Hands-on mentality: strong willingness to interact directly with the physical product, prototypes, and manufacturing processes.

  • Expertise in managing complex BOMs and overseeing system-level architecture (proficiency in 3D/2D CAD tools is expected to review and guide, but the daily focus is on system integration).

  • Experience in customer-facing roles, with strong communication skills to manage technical discussions and negotiations.

  • English advanced level.

We are engineering the future 🚀

title: C-Store Supervisor
description:
Blue Lake Casino & Hotel

POSITION DESCRIPTION

MANAGEMENT RETAINS THE RIGHT TO CHANGE JOB DESCRIPTION AS DEEMED NECESSARY


Job Title: C-Store Supervisor

Department: Convenience Store

Reports To: Fuel Mart Manager

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Prepared By: Fuel Mart Manager

Last Revised: October 15, 2026

Approved By: President – Director of Operations

Approved Date: October 15, 2026

JOB SUMMARY

This position is responsible for assisting with the day-today operations of the Blue Lake Fuel & Fun. It is under general direction of the Fuel Mart Manager and the primary function is to supervise subordinates, maintain operations, and assist management with projects as needed. This role also performs all duties of a C-Store Attendant. This position assumes the responsibilities of management in their absence.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee daily operations of the Blue Lake Fuel & Fun and property.
  • Maintain, at all times, a courteous, tactful relationship with our guests.
  • Maintain, at all times, a clean, well-lighted environment for our guests including the pump islands, landscaping, driveways and parking lot, interior of building, floors, shelves, coolers, storage areas, eating areas and restrooms.
  • Establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with staff.
  • Responsible for overall site safety in all areas and functions including dispensing of fuels, storage of fuels, spill management, fire safety, site emergency response procedures, food safety, and the general safety of all guests and Team Members.
  • Responsible for all aspects of food safety including cleanliness and hygiene standards, hygienic preparation of food items, sterilization of all food surfaces, proper cold and hot food storage, food temperature and hold time monitoring, HACCP, and all other duties related to food safety.
  • Acts as the designated Safety Officer for the Blue Lake Fuel & Fun, when the manager is not on-site, and is responsible for training staff, and ensuring compliance with all safety standards.
  • Place orders for fuel, food, snack items, beverage, tobacco and alcohol orders for replenishment of inventory.
  • Ensure that items are placed in optimal visual locations for fast turnover.
  • Ensure that all delivery of food, tobacco and beverage items are properly received by personnel and correctly recorded in to inventory.
  • Learn policies, rules & regulations and apply them using fairness and good judgment.
  • Carry out verbal and written instructions from the Manager and follow-through in the completion of all assignments.
  • Identify problems, analyze data, and propose solutions to the Manager.
  • Protect the assets of Blue Lake Fuel & Fun and the Blue Lake Rancheria.
  • This position performs all of the duties and responsibilities of a C-Store Attendant, as needed.
  • This position performs all of the duties and responsibilities of a Line Cook – C-Store as needed.
  • Protect the assets of the Blue Lake Fuel & Fun and Blue Lake Rancheria.
  • Other duties as assigned by management, including any supervisor, manager, or executive.


Promotes the following within the department and among all Team Members:

  • Creates an atmosphere of FUN for all casino guests.
  • Encourages mutual respect, dignity and integrity with all Team Members, by setting positive examples at all times.
  • Maintains a professional departmental, company and community reputation.


BLCH requires Team Members, on a continual basis:

  • To provide a safe work environment for Team Members, through compliance with established safety guidelines, identifying potential safety hazards, and reporting same to the appropriate person for proper resolution.
  • To maintain a professional departmental, company and community reputation.
  • To enforce performance standards, policies and procedures as they relate to the department.
  • To maintain a consistent, regular attendance record.


SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Directly supervises 7 to 10 Team Members at the Blue Lake Fuel & Fun. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training Team Members; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining Team Members; addressing complaints and resolving problems. Assist with payroll when needed.


QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or GED equivalent, with one-year experience working in a convenience store or closely related business. Prefer candidate with at least one-year employment at the Blue Lake Fuel & Fun, with good attendance and dependability.


MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume. Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.

SPECIFIC SKILL, KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

  • Basic computer literacy including use of computerized service station software, point-of -sale (POS) systems, and inventory management software.
  • Knowledge of office equipment including telephone, fax, credit card processors and cash register/POS systems.
  • Basic computer literacy including use of computerized software systems.
  • Ability to relate with visitors and staff; maintain a positive attitude and sense of humor at all times. Excellent interpersonal skills in relating with guests and staff.
  • Knowledge of office equipment including telephone, fax, photocopier, credit card processors, and cash register, and POS systems.


REASONING ABILITY

Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

  • While employed, must maintain a valid and active Blue Lake Tribal Gaming Commission License.
  • Must obtain and maintain credential in Underground Storage Training for Attendants within 30 days of employment.
  • Must obtain and maintain credential in Propane Dispensing Training within 30 days of employment.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is regularly required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; talk or hear; and taste or smell. The Team Member frequently is required to walk. The Team Member is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The Team Member must frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.


WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a Team Member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles and outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

title: Program Project Manager
company: Catholic Charities of the Archdiocese of Omaha
description:
ABOUT US

Catholic Charities began in 1926. Nearly a century later, we’re still working to promote the dignity of all people through our programs and services. In 2024, we served 325,000 people through programs that respond to poverty, unemployment, loneliness, mental illness, domestic violence, and family separation. Our dynamic programs serve all, regardless of race, religion, creed, or socioeconomic status. Our programs are anchored at the St. Martin de Porres Center in North Omaha, the St. Juan Diego Center in South Omaha, and the St. Teresa of Calcutta Campus in Northwest Omaha.

ABOUT THIS POSITION

You’ll join a mission-driven team dedicated to empowering human dignity. Though our Catholic faith guides our work, you do not have to be Catholic to join our team or receive services. As Microbusiness and Asset Development Manager, you will play a critical leadership role in strengthening local economic empowerment. You will:

Expand and Enhance Microbusiness Development

  • Oversee and develop programs that support emerging entrepreneurs and small business owners.
  • Update and continually improve on the class curriculum and workbooks, manage a team of contracted instructors, and expand the classes.
  • Increase the geographic footprint of the entrepreneurial classes both in Omaha and via the Catholic Charities network.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with community partners, financial institutions, and other stakeholders to secure ongoing funding and resources.

Champion Economic Empowerment

  • Serve as an advocate for individuals striving to establish or expand small businesses, especially in underserved communities.
  • Identify and cultivate new partnerships with businesses, local government agencies, and nonprofit organizations to broaden support networks for clients.
  • Promote public awareness of microbusiness and asset development initiatives, highlighting program successes and participant stories.
  • Transform past participants into an active support community for future entrepreneurs.

Lead and Supervise a Dedicated Team

  • Ensuring operational stability through a reliable pool of instructors and industry-specific mentor volunteers.
  • Coordinate grant activities, data collection, and reporting to ensure compliance and measure outcomes effectively.
  • Foster an environment of continuous learning, innovation, and collaboration.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
  • Experience: At least two years of professional experience in microenterprise development, economic empowerment programs, community development, or related areas (preferred).
  • Leadership Skills: Demonstrated success in supervising or coaching teams, managing programs, and working cross-functionally to achieve goals.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong understanding of business planning, financial analysis, and funding mechanisms.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to foster positive relationships with diverse stakeholders.
  • Commitment: Passionate about serving vulnerable populations with cultural competency and empathy.
  • Language Skills: Bilingual (Spanish/English) is highly preferred.

WHAT YOUR DAY WILL LOOK LIKE

  • Office Collaboration: Work on-site at our local campuses (both 9223 Bedford Ave and 5211 S 31st).
  • Program Management: Lead the planning, implementation, and evaluation of microbusiness and asset development initiatives.
  • Community Outreach: Schedule and conduct group workshops, networking events, and additional classes. Some evenings or weekends may be required to meet community needs.
  • Continuous Improvement: Review and refine program strategies based on data, participant feedback, and community input.
  • Impactful Work: Engage directly with aspiring entrepreneurs, helping them secure capital, develop effective business plans, and grow their ventures.

WHY JOIN CATHOLIC CHARITIES?

  • Competitive Compensation: Earn a salary that reflects your expertise and dedication.
  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Access to health, dental, and vision insurance to support your well-being.
  • Work-Life Balance: Enjoy paid time off, recognized holidays, and retirement benefits to support your future.
  • Growth & Development: Take advantage of professional development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career.
  • Mission-Driven Work Environment: Be part of a team that is changing lives and making a real impact in the community every day.

This is more than a job—it’s a calling. At Catholic Charities, you’ll work in a supportive, mission-driven environment where your expertise and dedication will help individuals and families achieve financial independence, stability, and hope for the future. If you are passionate and ready to be part of a movement that fosters economic empowerment, we invite you to apply today.

title: Kundemodtager til Semler Mobility Højbjerg
description:
Triner du i en udadvendt rolle, og er du motiveret af at yde kundeservice på højt plan?

Om stillingen
Din vigtigste opgave er at sikre gode kundeoplevelser og levere kundebetjening på højeste niveau, når kunden afleverer sin bil til service eller reparation. Du indgår i vores team af engagerede kolleger.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver er:

  • Betjening af kunder i indskrivningen
  • Daglig håndtering af ordrer
  • Status opkald til kunder i løbet af dagen
  • Klarmelding og fakturering
  • Udlevering af biler
  • Diverse administrativt arbejde

Om dig
Du kan bidrage til teamet med din strukturerede arbejdsstil og gode samarbejdsevner. Du modtager kunden professionelt, lyttende og med godt humør.

Med dit gå-på-mod formår du at holde fokus på såvel kundemodtagelsen i et til tider hektisk miljø som på de administrative opgaver, der kræver dit overblik og sans for detaljer.

Kendskab til bilbranchen er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Det er en forudsætning for stillingen, at du har kørekort i kategori B.

Om os
Semler Mobility Højbjerg er en del af Semler Gruppen, som er Danmarks største bilkoncern med over 100 års erfaring inden for import og salg af biler. Vi tilbyder et udfordrende og alsidigt job i en spændende organisation, med dedikeret kolleger og mulighed for at sætte sit eget præg på hverdagen, så vi sammen når de opstillede mål.

Vi tilbyder løn efter kvalifikationer, pension, sundhedssikring og andre fordelagtige medarbejdergoder.

Hvad kan du forvente af mig som leder?
Som leder kan du forvente, at jeg er målrettet og fokuseret på vores fælles succes. Jeg tror på, at vi alle lærer bedst gennem erfaring, så jeg opfordrer til, at du griber nye udfordringer og opgaver med begge hænder – hvis du har lyst! Jeg bestræber mig på altid at være der for dig og på at være nærværende i hverdagen, så du kan få den støtte og vejledning, du har brug for. Sammen skaber vi en arbejdsplads, hvor der er plads til både udvikling og sjov.

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Ansøgninger behandles løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Rasmus Kastbjerg på tlf. +45 24 45 57 55

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Din vej. Fælles fremtid

Som ny kollega i Semler Gruppen bliver du en del af et stort fællesskab på mere end 3000 kollegaer. Vi er fordelt over hele landet, og arbejder med alt fra landbrugets tungeste maskiner til selvkørende teknologi og delebiler.

At være en del af en stor organisation betyder, at der er talrige muligheder for at udvikle sig både fagligt og personligt. Vi har f.eks. en hel uddannelsesafdeling, som tilbyder efteruddannelse og certificeringer i samarbejde med vores producenter. Sidst men ikke mindst kan vi hjælpe dig på vej med vores udviklingsværktøj GROW, som intelligent og systematisk matcher dine kompetencer op imod udviklingsmulighederne i Semler Gruppen.

Alle er vi forenet af et sæt fælles værdier, der fungerer som den daglige gps for vores måde at arbejde på.

Vi er ordentlige. Vi holder hvad vi lover, også når det kræver en omvej. Sådan er det, når ambitionen er at have de mest tilfredse kunder og leverandører i de brancher vi opererer i.

Vi er dedikerede. Vi står distancen og kommer i mål.

Vi er nytænkende. Fordi man ikke bliver Danmarks største bilaktør af at køre på autopilot.

Vi har glimt i øjet. Med respekt for hinanden og godt humør bliver det rarere at gå på arbejde.

title: Process & Management System Specialist
description:
Nobia – en førende europæisk køkkenspecialist noteret på Nasdaq Stockholm – søger en Process & Management System Specialist til vores QHSE-team i Ølgod. Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe struktur, kvalitet og sikkerhed på tværs af Nobia Danmark.

Forestil dig at blive en del af en afdeling, hvor nysgerrighed på forskellige perspektiver værdsættes, og hvor samarbejde og faglig sparring er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vores fælles ambition er at gøre komplekse ledelsessystemer tilgængelige, praktiske og værdifulde for alle.

Du vil arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger inden for Produktion, Salg, Ledelse og forskellige supportfunktioner, hvor du hurtigt bliver en betroet og synlig samarbejdspartner på tværs af organisationen.

Stillingen er baseret på vores lokation i Ølgod, Danmark, og indebærer ca. 20 rejsedage om året.

Om rollen

Du vil arbejde på tværs af organisationen og bidrage til virksomhedens strategi og mål gennem løbende udvikling og vedligeholdelse af QHSE-systemerne. Du vil koordinere og facilitere centrale opgaver inden for ledelsessystemet for Nobia Danmark.

Dine primære ansvarsområder vil blandt andet være:

  • Lede tværfunktionelle projekter med fokus på at udvikle og løbende forbedre vores ledelsessystemer.

  • Understøtte organisationen i en effektiv anvendelse af ledelsessystemer og forretningsprocesser.

  • Planlægge, koordinere og gennemføre interne audits på tværs af ISO-standarder og FSC-krav.

  • Administrere og udvikle de supportfunktioner, der understøtter arbejdet med ledelsessystemet, fx træningsmaterialer, Power Apps og SharePoint.

  • Sikre dokumentation af høj kvalitet, strukturerede processer og standardiserede arbejdsgange.

  • Facilitere eksterne audits og være den primære kontaktperson for eksterne auditorer.

  • Udvikle værktøjer, skabeloner og supportmaterialer, der gør systemerne nemme og anvendelige i hverdagen.

  • Koordinere anvendelsen og udviklingen af Canea-ledelsessystemet i samarbejde med QHSE-kolleger på tværs af den nordiske organisation.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger en struktureret og kvalitetsbevidst profil, der trives med at drive projekter og sikre høje standarder på tværs af organisationen. Du har stærke administrative kompetencer, motiveres af at skabe struktur og fremdrift og er i stand til at kommunikere effektivt med interessenter på alle niveauer i organisationen.

Du er samtidig nysgerrig på IT-systemer og ser teknologi som en mulighed for at understøtte løbende forbedringer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med at gennemføre interne audits.

  • Har kendskab til og praktisk erfaring med ISO 9001.

  • Er certificeret ISO 9001 Lead Auditor eller er indstillet på at opnå certificeringen.

  • Har erfaring med at drive projekter fra planlægning til implementering.

  • Kommunikerer klart og sikkert, både mundtligt og skriftligt, med interessenter på alle niveauer i organisationen.

Vi tilbyder

Du bliver en del af et team og en organisation, hvor samarbejde, videndeling og det at hjælpe hinanden er en naturlig del af vores måde at arbejde på. Vi har tætte relationer på tværs af organisationen og tilbyder desuden:

  • En central rolle med stor indflydelse på Nobia Danmarks ledelsessystemer.

  • Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på processer, værktøjer og arbejdsgange.

  • Et støttende arbejdsmiljø, der opfordrer til både faglig og personlig udvikling.

  • En alsidig rolle, der kombinerer operationelle opgaver med udviklings- og forbedringsinitiativer.

Nysgerrig på mere?

Få et indblik i, hvordan det er at være en del af Nobia lige her.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

En ansøgning er ikke nødvendig, men vi vil gerne have, at du inkluderer en kort motivation i dit CV.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende, så vi opfordrer dig til at sende dit CV hurtigst muligt.

title: Seasonal Retail At Your Service Associate, Southlake Mall - IN
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Project Management Expert
company: Botnar Institute of Immune Engineering - BIIE
description:
We are seeking an experienced Project Management Expert (100%) to strengthen the planning and delivery of complex translational projects and strategic initiatives across the Botnar Institute of Immune Engineering.

The role is the first position in BIIE’s newly established Global Translation and Partnership Management (GTPM), which monitors and coordinates the institute’s translational projects as they progress through its readiness gates. Reporting to the Director of Administrative Operations and working closely with the Clinical Operations Unit, the successful candidate will be the institute’s go-to resource for project management.

Working with scientific and operational leadership, project teams, core services and external partners, the role will translate research, development and clinical activities into coherent, executable plans with clear objectives, deliverables, milestones, dependencies and responsibilities, and ensure that activities and decisions remain aligned with program objectives.

Beyond providing hands-on project management support, the successful candidate will help shape how the GTPM works and, over time, strengthen project and program management capabilities across the institute.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Organisational Development

  • Establish fit-for-purpose project management approaches, tools and reporting that enable transparency, collaboration and effective delivery without unnecessary administrative complexity.
  • Build the GTPM's working practices, interfaces and project records as the institute grows, including joint planning and reporting with the Clinical Operations Unit.
  • Prepare project status, risk, scenario and decision materials for project teams and institute leadership including materials for readiness-gate reviews.
  • Coach and support project contributors and emerging project leaders in effective project management practices.
  • Capture learnings and develop scalable ways of working that can strengthen project and program management capabilities across BIIE as the institute grows.
  • Contribute flexibly to broader strategic and operational initiatives where project leadership and structured problem solving can add value.

Planning & Delivery Support

  • Support scientific staff in turning objectives into integrated project strategies, plans, milestones, deliverables and decision points in partnership with project teams.
  • Develop scenarios and value-building pathways and proactively identify project risks, dependencies and mitigation strategies.
  • Coordinate the development of target product profiles with partners in the countries of intended use and keep project plans aligned to them.
  • Work with responsible subject-matter experts and external partners to identify and resolve operational bottlenecks affecting project delivery.
  • Establish transparency on progress, critical paths, responsibilities and upcoming decisions across multiple workstreams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Establish clarity around roles, responsibilities, interfaces and decision pathways.
  • Identify gaps, conflicting expectations and cross-functional dependencies and facilitate their resolution with the relevant experts.
  • Enable effective decision-making by translating complex information, risks and alternatives into clear recommendations and next steps.

Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Life Sciences or a related field, with the scientific background required to work effectively with multidisciplinary research and clinical teams.
  • Significant program and/or project management experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, academic research or another complex life-science R&D environment.
  • Demonstrated experience translating complex objectives into project strategies, milestones, scenarios and executable plans.
  • Strong project planning, risk management, cross-functional leadership and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and build alignment across multidisciplinary matrix teams.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills and the ability to challenge assumptions constructively.
  • Pragmatic, collaborative and hands-on working style, comfortable moving between strategic questions and operational challenges.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and facilitation skills.
  • Experience with target product profiles, stage-gate governance or product development for global health settings is an advantage.
  • Formal project management certification (e.g., PMP®) is an advantage.
  • Fluent English; additional languages and experience in international or multicultural environments are an advantage.

title: Senior Software QA Specialist – FortiGate Cloud
description:
Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are currently seeking a dynamic Senior Software QA Specialist to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business.

You would act a Senior Software QA Specialist for FortiGate Cloud team where we are revolutionizing the cybersecurity landscape by providing world-class cloud solutions. You’ll help drive our commitment to software quality, ensuring that our cloud-based security products meet the highest standards. This is an exciting opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and contribute to delivering exceptional cloud security solutions to our clients.

As a Senior Software QA Specialist, your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, develop, and execute test cases for FortiGate Cloud products, with a strong focus on Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) testing.
  • Perform end-to-end testing of new and existing features, ensuring all components of the platform function seamlessly.
  • Work closely with product management and development teams to identify and resolve software defects.
  • Collaborate in reviewing and refining documentation, ensuring that test procedures, test cases, and bug reports are thoroughly detailed.
  • Execute manual and automated tests on APIs, databases, and networking components.
  • Identify and analyze root causes of defects, providing actionable insights to improve product quality.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of networking, database technologies, and cloud-based applications.
  • Contribute to process improvements and best practices in software quality assurance.

We are looking for:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in software testing, particularly with SaaS platforms.
  • Networking Knowledge: Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols.
  • Database Knowledge: Familiarity with database technologies and query languages (SQL, etc.).
  • API Testing: Hands-on experience with API testing using tools such as Postman, SoapUI, or similar.
  • Attention to Detail: Exceptional focus on identifying even the smallest inconsistencies or potential defects.
  • Documentation Skills: Strong documentation habits with a keen eye for writing clear, concise, and actionable reports.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.
  • Test Automation (a plus): Experience with test automation frameworks and scripting (e.g., Selenium, Python, etc.) is highly desirable.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with cloud-based solutions and services, especially in the cybersecurity domain.
  • Experience working in agile environments and using version control tools like Git.

About Our Team:

Join our team, known for its collaborative ethos, working seamlessly with global customers, internal engineering teams and product development groups. Our team culture emphasizes continuous learning, innovation, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction. We embrace Fortinet’s core values of openness, teamwork and innovation, fostering an environment where team members support each other, share knowledge, and leverage AI to solve complex technical challenges. Our inclusive and dynamic team thrives on collaboration and is driven by the shared goal of maintaining Fortinet’s high standards of excellence in cybersecurity solutions.

The Canada base salary range for this full-time position is expected to be between $101,000- $124,000 annually. Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate’s subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, and experience.

Fortinet strives to provide you and your family with a comprehensive benefits package. Benefits eligibility starts on your first day of hire and comprises of 100% company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage, including a Health Spending Account and a Personal Spending Account that gives you flexibility to spend where you need it the most. Our Employee & Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) offers you and your family access to various services like counseling, legal advice, mental health resources etc. We also provide critical illness, disability, and life insurance, as well as a Group Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with a company match to help you save faster for retirement. We offer competitive Paid Time Off and flexible leave policies, including paid health days, to help you take care of yourself and your family members.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program. Bonus eligibility is reviewed at time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion.

title: Lead Business Analyst
description:
What happens when you have fascinating clients with challenging problems on the one hand and passionate software developers looking to build future-focused solutions on the other? This in-between is where Business Analysts reside, acting as a bridge between the client and team. You will establish the outcomes software must achieve, assess how it will be used, and then generate bold ideas with our developers to create custom applications. You will work with clients across a variety of sectors and ensure the business-critical software solutions we develop deliver real business value every time.

Due to the nature of the projects and specific client security clearance, this role requires the successful candidate to be a Singapore Citizen or PR of Singapore.

Job responsibilities

  • Understand a client's business problems in order to build, maintain, and evolve product roadmaps to generate impactful solutions
  • Assure effective collaboration between Thoughtworks' and the client's teams, encouraging open communication and advocating for shared outcomes
  • You will assess the as-is situation and collaborate with clients to create artifacts (personas, epics, stories, etc.) to maximize value
  • You will facilitate analysis workshops through “innovation games” with senior client stakeholders to outline business vision, objective, product roadmap and a project release plan.
  • You will help companies from a variety of industries achieve true, differentiating outcomes and engage with and influence senior business stakeholders on the client side.
  • You will liaise between the client and your team, consisting of SMEs, C-suite executives, developers, quality analysts, tech architects, user experience designers, project managers, etc to manage the product backlog and keep an eye on software delivery
  • You will work in agile teams that facilitate organizational transformations for medium- and large-scale businesses
  • You will be involved in the Analyst community to share knowledge, mentor and evangelize Agile, Lean, and Continuous Development analysis best practices

Job qualifications

Technical skills

  • You have a track record of delivering impactful software, ideally on a collaborative software delivery team
  • You have attention to detail, a practical approach to the day-to-day work of story-writing and delivery and can draw a line directly from an overarching client strategy to your team's outcomes
  • You enjoy unearthing the root cause(s) of a client's pain points, validating a business opportunity or problem and partnering to deliver a solution
  • You are well versed with Agile, Lean and Continuous Delivery methodologies and love to mentor others
  • You understand how businesses operate and have experience modeling business processes using a variety of tools and techniques to facilitate requirement elicitation sessions
  • You design and facilitate workshops with business stakeholders to outline the business vision, objective, product roadmap and a project release plan
  • You are well-versed with tech trends and can relate them to real-world business challenges at a program or project level

Professional skills

  • You enjoy coaching, have led a team and are an advocate for sharing knowledge with others
  • You have a knack for prioritization, obtaining buy-in from stakeholders and resolving conflicts as they arise
  • You're resilient and flexible in ambiguous situations and enjoy solving problems from technical and business perspectives

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment

At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.

Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.

We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment.

About Thoughtworks

Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.

title: Member of Product, Tokenization
description:
At Anchorage Digital, we are building the world’s most advanced digital asset platform for institutions to participate in crypto.
Anchorage Digital is a crypto platform that enables institutions to participate in digital assets through custody, staking, trading, governance, settlement, and the industry's leading security infrastructure. Home to Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., the first federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S., Anchorage Digital also serves institutions through Anchorage Digital Singapore, Porto by Anchorage Digital, and other offerings.
The company is funded by leading institutions including Andreessen Horowitz, GIC, Goldman Sachs, KKR, and Visa, with its Series D valuation over $3 billion. Founded in 2017 in San Francisco, California, Anchorage Digital has offices in New York, New York; Porto, Portugal; Singapore; and Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Learn more at anchorage.com, on X @Anchorage, and on LinkedIn.

With the evolving landscape of digital threats and an increasing volume of sophisticated attacks by malicious actors, we have a security policy mandating all new hires complete an in-person onboarding process - no exceptions. Security is our foundation and we prioritize physical identity verification and secure IT setup. While our security and IT logistics require physical presence to protect our infrastructure from sophisticated global threats, this move is equally about our Village culture. We believe that a laptop can be shipped, but our culture cannot.

Anchorage Digital is seeking a Product Manager to help build the leading RWA tokenization hub on Anchorage's core platform. Reporting to the Head of Tokenization, this role sits at the intersection of regulated capital markets and on-chain infrastructure: partnering directly with the business lead on product design, owning the technical roadmap with engineering, and shaping both the investor and the issuer experience across money market funds, tokenized MMFs, broker-dealer activity, transfer agency, fixed income, and equities.

You’ll partner with the Head of Tokenization to co-own product design and the end-to-end technical roadmap for Anchorage’s RWA tokenization hub, turning business strategy and client demand into prioritized product bets. You’ll design both sides of the platform: how issuers onboard, structure, mint, and service tokenized assets, and how institutional investors discover, allocate to, settle, and report on them. Your work will span money market funds (including tokenized MMFs), broker-dealer activity, transfer agency, fixed income, and equities, with a focus on building reusable foundations that work across asset classes instead of one-off integrations. You’ll work closely with engineering to scope problems and build solutions together, translating between technical, business, and regulatory concepts. You’ll also meet directly with issuers and investors to understand their needs and test product direction, and you’ll join the commercial team on live deals as the product expert who can go deep on both regulatory structure and on-chain mechanics.

This role will accelerate the candidate into a leading product voice at the intersection of banking, capital markets, and tokenization.

Below, we define our Factors of Growth & Impact to help Anchorage Villagers to better measure impact and articulate coaching, feedback, and the rich and rewarding learning that happens while exploring, developing, and mastering the capabilities and contributions within and outside of the Member of Product, Tokenization role:

Technical Skills:

  • Define tokenization product strategy, primitives, and roadmap across issuance, lifecycle management, custody, settlement, reporting, and investor/issuer workflows.
  • Translate complex regulatory, capital markets, and blockchain constraints into clear product requirements.

Complexity and Impact of Work:

  • Lead product delivery across a multi-asset-class roadmap (MMFs, commodities, fixed income, equities, etc) in a highly regulated environment.
  • Drive outcomes that scale issuer onboarding, deepen the investor experience, and build reusable primitives rather than bespoke integrations.

Organizational Knowledge:

  • Navigate OCC/banking-grade governance, controls, and risk management expectations.
  • Build operating rhythms with engineering, legal, compliance, and client-facing teams that keep delivery moving without compromising controls.

Communication and Influence:

  • Translate fluently between business and engineering audiences in both directions.
  • Influence senior stakeholders (issuers, investors, internal leadership) through crisp narratives and tradeoff framing
  • Credibly represent the product in front of institutional issuers and investors; convert what you hear in those rooms into roadmap signal.

You may be a fit for this role if you have:

  • A track record owning a technical product roadmap end-to-end in regulated financial services (capital markets, payments, asset management, or banking).
  • A deep working knowledge of blockchain infrastructure and institutional digital asset products
  • Demonstrated ability to translate between technical and business audiences, not just document the hand-off, but make both sides sharper.
  • Experience shipping platform products with meaningful partner, regulatory, and engineering dependencies.
  • Comfort and appetite for client-facing work, meeting with institutional prospects and clients to discover needs, demo product direction, and influence commercial outcomes.
  • Bias for ownership and execution in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • At least two of the following three: (a) direct experience with tokenization, tokenized MMFs, transfer agency, broker-dealer tech, or securities issuance platforms; (b) prior work at a regulated financial institution, trust company, or capital markets infrastructure firm; or (c) prior experience in a product role that was explicitly commercial-adjacent (solutions, pre-sales, or client-facing PM).

Although not a requirement, bonus points if:

  • You have product design judgment across two-sided experiences (investor-facing and issuer-facing).
  • Claude or other AI tools have become part of your core tools for work.
  • You have strong opinions on how capital markets will move on-chain.
  • You have navigated a regulator directly on a product launch.

About Anchorage Digital: Who we are

The Anchorage Village, what we call our team, brings together the brightest minds from platform security, financial services, and distributed ledger technology to provide the building blocks that empower institutions to safely participate in the evolving digital asset ecosystem. As a diverse team of more than 600 members, we are united in one common goal: building the future of finance by providing the foundation upon which value moves safely in the new global economy.
Anchorage Digital is committed to being a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone, and we are intentional about making sure people feel respected, supported, and connected at work—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We value and celebrate our differences and we believe being open about who we are allows us to do the best work of our lives.
Anchorage Digital is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. Anchorage Digital considers qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with other legal requirements. “Anchorage Digital” refers to services that are offered either through Anchorage Digital Bank National Association, an OCC-chartered national trust bank, or Anchorage Lending CA, LLC a finance lender licensed by the California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation, License No. 60DBO-11976, or Anchorage Digital Singapore Pte Ltd, a Singapore private limited company, all wholly-owned subsidiaries of Anchor Labs, Inc., a Delaware corporation.
Protecting your privacy rights is important to Anchorage Digital, and we work to maintain the trust and confidence of our clients when handling personal or financial information. Please see our privacy policy notices here.

title: AR Research & Resolution Representative

Where do you belong?

Your career is more than just a job, it's part of your life. Whether you’re a clinician, or non-clinical professional, at USACS you'll feel a sense of connection working with clinicians and office staff who share your interests and values. We want you to love coming to work each day because you believe in what you do and the people with whom you work. We care about your success.

USACS also understands that location is important. We offer career opportunities for clinicians and non-clinical support staff from New York to Hawaii and numerous points in between. Our supportive culture, outstanding benefits and competitive compensation package is best in class.

Job Description

The AR Research & Resolution Representative is responsible for researching and resolving claims to maximize cash collections, minimizing denials and lost revenue, modeling the organization's values, and working on individual and project denial and claim assignments.

Location: Remote

title: Bliv flymekaniker hos Jettime og hold vores Boeing 737 NG-flåde flyvende
description:
Vil du være en del af holdet i vores tekniske afdeling i Københavns Lufthavn?

Kan du lide at arbejde tæt på operationen, hvor kvalitet, sikkerhed og godt kollegaskab går hånd i hånd?

Hos Jettime søger vi flymekanikere til vores tekniske afdeling i Københavns Lufthavn. Vi vokser, udvider flåden og har brug for flere dygtige kolleger, der vil være med til at holde vores Boeing 737 NG-fly sikre og klar til næste afgang.

Jettime opererer charterflyvninger og ACMI-flyvninger på vegne af nogle af Nordens største rejsearrangører og stærke ruteselskaber. Det stiller høje krav til kvalitet, driftssikkerhed og samarbejde, og det er netop her, du kommer ind i billedet.

Kort om stillingen

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling med start hurtigst muligt
  • Arbejdssted i Københavns Lufthavn Syd i Dragør
  • Vedligeholdelse og fejlsøgning på Boeing 737 NG
  • Et tæt samarbejde med engagerede kolleger i en flad organisation

En hverdag tæt på operationen

Hos Jettime bliver du en del af et team, hvor faglig stolthed, hjælpsomhed og godt humør er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vi har kort vej fra idé til handling, og vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger findes tæt på driften. Derfor får du mulighed for at tage ansvar og gøre en forskel, samtidig med at vi hjælper hinanden, når opgaverne kræver det.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver

  • Vedligeholdelse af Jettimes Boeing 737 NG-flåde, også uden for CPH ved eksempelvis AOG-situationer
  • Fejlsøgning og fejlretning
  • Registrering af udførte aktiviteter i vores IT-systemer
  • Rapportering af utilsigtede hændelser
  • Arbejde i overensstemmelse med gældende manualer og procedurer

Det skal du have med dig

  • Et gyldigt Aircraft Maintenance License (AML), EASA Part-66
  • Certificeret på Boeing 737 NG (CFM56) B1 og/eller B2 er en fordel – dog ikke et krav
  • Gerne 6 måneders relevant erfaring inden for de sidste 2 år
  • Gode dansk- og engelskkundskaber, både skriftligt og mundtligt
  • Gyldigt kørekort til bil
  • Mulighed for at blive sikkerhedsgodkendt til Københavns Lufthavn, herunder bestå et baggrundstjek for de seneste fem år
  • Et godt kendskab til IT-systemer, herunder Microsoft Office

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du trives i et miljø, hvor kvalitet og sikkerhed altid kommer først. Du bevarer overblikket og det gode humør, også når tempoet er højt, og du arbejder lige godt selvstændigt som i et stærkt team.

Har du erfaring med Boeing 737 NG (CFM56) og en B1- og/eller B2-typecertificering, er det bestemt en fordel. Det samme gælder, hvis du har arbejdet med flyvedligeholdelse inden for de seneste år. Har du ikke alle de ønskede kvalifikationer, hører vi dog stadig meget gerne fra dig, hvis du har det rette faglige fundament og motivationen til at blive en del af holdet.

Du kommunikerer klart og professionelt med dine kolleger og tager ansvar for de opgaver, du løser. Som kollega er du fleksibel, hjælpsom og parat til at yde en ekstra indsats, når situationen kræver det, eksempelvis ved en AOG-situation.

Derfor skal du vælge Jettime

Hos Jettime får du et udfordrende og alsidigt job tæt på en dynamisk flyoperation. Du bliver en del af et team med dygtige, engagerede og hjælpsomme kolleger, hvor omgangstonen er uformel, og hvor der er plads til både faglig stolthed og humor.

Vi tilbyder pensionsordning, ID-billetter, kantineordning samt parkering ved hangaren. Samtidig værdsætter vi fleksibilitet og arbejder for en god balance mellem arbejde og privatliv, når driften tillader det. Vores flade organisation betyder, at der er kort vej fra tanke til handling, og at du får mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel i hverdagen.

Vil du vide mere?

title: Compliance Coordinator (all genders)
description:
Become part of Fairmas as a Junior Compliance Coordinator (all genders) and help us build a solid foundation for our information security management system. The role sits at the intersection of compliance, information security, process management, and documentation — coordinating requirements, structuring evidence, and making our processes audit-ready. You will work closely with management, IT, HR, legal, and data protection, acting as a coordinating and documenting function rather than the sole owner of all information security.

Location:
Based in Berlin | Full-time or part-time | Monday to Friday | Work-life balance guaranteed.
Do you have a sharp eye for detail, a talent for turning complex requirements into clear documentation, and a genuine interest in information security and compliance? Do you enjoy staying on top of open tasks, deadlines, and responsibilities across multiple teams?
Then Fairmas is the right place for you.
  • Balance: No weekend work, no shifts, no overtime.
  • Appreciation: Fair pay and a safe working environment.
  • Flexibility: Work remotely and from our modern Berlin office – 3 days/week in the office required.
  • Understanding: Many of us come from the hotel industry ourselves.
  • Purpose: Help hotels around the world stay economically successful.
  • Sustainability: Our offices are eco-friendly and perfectly connected.
  • Mobility: We subsidize your Deutschlandticket.
  • Growth: Through team events and personal development – we support what makes you unique.
  • Foundation: Degree/ background in business law, IT law, business informatics, compliance, quality management, or a related field — or a relevant lateral entry from data protection, audit support, or process management.
  • Compliance mindset: Ability to read, understand, and translate requirements from standards, contracts, and regulations into tasks and documentation.
  • Security interest: First exposure to ISO 27001, information security, data protection, or audit processes is a plus
  • IT fluency: You don’t need to be a sysadmin, but you understand basic IT and security concepts such as user and access management, cloud systems, backup, change management, and incident management, and communicate confidently with technical colleagues.
  • Writing strength: Excellent written German and English; able to document complex topics clearly, precisely, and in an audit-ready way.
  • Structure: Systematic, thorough, and reliable — you keep track of open points, deadlines, and responsibilities without being prompted.
  • Collaboration: Professional and clear communicator with management, IT, legal, HR, and data protection stakeholders.
  • Discretion: High sense of responsibility when handling sensitive information.
  • Tools: Experience with tools such as Confluence, Jira, SharePoint, Notion, Excel, or GRC tools is a benefit.
  • Regulatory knowledge: Basic knowledge of GDPR, IT law, data protection law, or contract review is a plus
  • Industry background: Experience in a software, SaaS, or IT-oriented company is an advantage.
  • Employment Eligibility: Must be legally authorized to in Germany.
  • ISMS Development: Support the setup, structuring, and maintenance of our ISO 27001-compliant information security management system — as a coordinating and documenting function in close exchange with management, IT, HR, legal, and data protection.
  • Requirements Analysis: Break down ISO 27001 controls, identify gaps, assign responsibilities, and track required evidence.
  • Documentation: Create, revise, and maintain policies, process descriptions, work instructions, checklists, and audit evidence documents.
  • Audit Preparation: Compile and organize audit materials; ensure all required evidence is in place and traceable.
  • Task Tracking: Maintain an up-to-date action and task plan including status, owners, deadlines, and open items.
  • Risk Management: Assist with gap analyses, risk assessments, and documenting risk treatment measures.
  • Cross-Team Coordination: Gather information and coordinate with IT, HR, legal, data protection, management, and relevant departments.
  • Process Documentation: Document security processes such as access management, change management, incident management, backup, vendor management, asset management, and awareness programs.
  • Follow-Through: Track and close open points from internal reviews, external consultations, audits, and management decisions.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Prepare clear decision bases and summaries for management and business units.
Ready to Join Us?
Send us your CV – feel free to include your earliest possible start date. If you have any questions, reach out to us at hr@fairmas.com – we’re happy to help.
You don’t meet every single requirement or have gaps in your resume? No problem!
Apply anyway – what matters most to us are your motivation, values, and personality.
