title: Braider
description:
Diversity matters
We are building a brand that represents the people of the world. It’s what you do that counts, and we are always looking to expand perspectives and voices to shape our future.

We see you, we celebrate you, we want you!

Who we are
You might know us as the inventors of the bath bomb, but there’s more to this great-smelling, partly employee-owned, family-run company than pioneering cosmetics. We believe our business should put more back into the world than it takes and demonstrate that capitalism can be a force for good.

The Living Wage Foundation’s statement 'a hard day's work deserves a fair day's pay' is one that we are proud to commit to in the UK. As an accredited Living Wage employer, we put our people first and fight cruel practices like animal testing, promote regeneration, and show that it is what’s inside that counts - whether that’s an ingredient in a product, or the minerals in a smartphone.

The magic behind the Lush HairLab

Committed to assembling a team of skilled specialists, we hold a deep appreciation for the artistry of hairdressing and believe in empowering our stylists to showcase their unique talents.

We want a diverse team that reflects the broad range of our products and caters to all hair types. By doing so, we aim to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels embraced and their individual needs are met when they visit our salons. We are committed to assembling a team of skilled specialists. We hold a deep appreciation for the artistry of hairdressing and strongly believe in empowering our stylists to showcase their unique talents. Our objective is to create a diverse team that reflects the broad range of our products and caters to all hair types. By doing so, we aim to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels embraced and their individual needs are met when they visit our salons.

At Lush HairLab, we take pride in providing an exceptional salon experience, tailoring our services to meet the unique needs of each client's hair and scalp. Our dedication to one-on-one attention allows us to achieve authentic results that align with our clients' personal style. By providing an enriching and educational journey for our clients, we empower them with knowledge about their hair and scalp health while leaving them feeling fabulous both inside and out.

Our primary objective is to offer an enriching and educational journey for our clients, empowering them with knowledge about their hair and scalp health while leaving them feeling fabulous both inside and out.

Key Information
Braider
Hours available: Option of 24, 32 or 40 hours per week

As an Afro Hairdressing Specialist, you will have developed a high standard skill set in Afro hairdressing, including protective styling such as braiding (cornrows, knotless, box braids, stitch, feed-in and creative designs), blow outs and silk pressing, hair cutting on various lengths and textures, confidently welcoming clients with extensions or weaves, offering excellent haircuts, washes and styling, skilled in preparing hair for braid extensions and maintaining scalp health during long-term braided styles.

  • Minimum 3 years of industry experience, or able to demonstrate why we should consider you!
  • Experience with running a column of clients
  • Established client base local to Brighton is a bonus but not essential
  • Present up-to-date skills and techniques
  • Someone passionate about bringing extra creativity and protective styling skills to the floor.
  • To have developed a high standard skill set in Afro hairdressing
  • Demonstrate knowledge of braid preparation, tension control and safe takedown techniques
  • Have an understanding of how to care for and maintain Locs
  • An open-minded approach to receiving further training in the HairLab way
  • To be excited to enhance natural Afro hair textures with the use of our specialist products
  • Exceptional customer service skills
  • Organised approach to salon life
  • Professional, reliable, and client-focused
  • Qualifications or experience in educating in your specialist field to other hairdressers is beneficial but not essential

  • Learn and provide Lush HairLab services; you will be performing the full client journey including consultation, hair washing, styling.
  • Collaborating with your clients, not pushing an aesthetic onto them but carving out their true hair identity. Building rapport, being inquisitive, asking questions and sharing your knowledge with them.
  • Confidently deliver a range of braiding services to a high standard and with consideration for hair health and client comfort
  • Educate the client in what they need to create the style and effect at home
  • Communication is key to a successful salon and team. As part of this role, you would be expected to contribute to and maintain this supportive working environment.
  • You would be expected to maintain standards of both personal and workspace presentation and hygiene
  • Assist retail sales and have 5* consultations with customers on the shop floor area when not with clients
  • Support shops & attend events (internal and external) to promote new hair care product or service launches
  • Using specialist skills and knowledge to support the Lush PR team to promote the Lush HairLab
  • Showcase a can-do attitude and attention to detail
  • The ability to share Lush’s buying stories, ethics and product knowledge throughout the customer journey
  • Confident and decisive to ensure the client feels safe in expert hands
  • Must be motivated, trustworthy, and driven
  • Must be open-minded to our new approach to hairdressing
  • Accepting of being an equal in the salon
  • Be open to adopting new ways of describing hair by using positive language
What you’ll get
You will receive complete training from our team of Product Experts and Hair Stylists with the correct tools and guidance on all things Lush and Lush HairLab. You will be an ambassador for the Lush HairLab as we pride ourselves on excellent customer service, displaying excellent product knowledge, consultation skills and education for the hair and scalp.

Let's Talk Salary & Perks:
At Lush HairLab, we do things differently. While many salons operate on a commission-only model, we're proud to offer you a guaranteed base salary of at least £28,000 per year for a five-day work week - so you've always got security and full employment status.

On top of that, you'll receive 15% commission on all services you perform, paid monthly.

Additionally, we also provide bonuses based on the overall performance of the salon space to all staff, including when the salon hits targets on product sales.

Other perks include:
  • One-to-one time with your guests - no conveyor belt vibes here
  • Wear your own clothes, of any colour
  • Holiday allowance
  • 50% discount on Lush products and spa treatments
  • Profit-based bonus
  • Complimentary spa treatment*
  • Pension scheme
  • Paid day off for your birthday
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Discounted rail and bus season tickets
  • Employee assistance programme
  • 6 months’ full pay for parental leave (primary caregiver)*
  • Enhanced paternity leave*
  • Flexible working
  • Access to employee-led Community Networks, including Disability and Chronic Illness, Family Support, Global Majority (Race and Ethnicity), LGBTQIA+, Menopause and Neurodiversity communities.
  • Tailored gender affirming care*
Qualifying period/hours required*

We believe that your information is yours and that it is Lush's responsibility to process your personal information in a secure, fair and accurate manner. Every individual processed by LUSH has certain rights over their data, which are detailed in our Privacy Notice here.


We see you, we celebrate you, and we want you! Please submit your CV and a covering letter, including:

We are so excited to expand our team, and we can not wait to have you on board as part of this innovative creation.

title: IT Operations Engineer
description:
Join the Movement

At Enhanced, we believe optimal health shouldn't be complicated, expensive, or reserved for the few who can afford a team of specialists. Our mission is to give everyone the opportunity to live Enhanced. We believe everyone should have access to the tools, insights, and support they need to look better, feel better and be the best version of themselves.

We're building a company that sits on science-backed supplements which cut through industry noise and deliver real, measurable results. No gimmicks or fads, just what actually works, made accessible to everyone.

We're a team of doctors, athletes and passionate operators driven by curiosity and a genuine obsession with human performance. If you're excited about building products that help people become the best version of themselves, we'd love to have you on the team.


About You

You’re a hands-on operator who thrives in lean, fast-moving environments. As Enhanced scales as a public company, security, IT and administration need to move to a systematic, documented function, and you know how to make that happen. You’ve run IT operations in a growing business - ideally one that has been through an audit or is working toward a compliance framework - and understand how to balance keeping the day-to-day running with building the systems that make it scalable.

You’re excited by being the person who makes audits faster, keeps budgets and assets under control, and enables teams to deliver on their work through structured and streamlined processes. You’re technically fluent, process-driven, AI-curious, and energized by building an IT function from the ground up. This is an operator seat first - the priority is owning and systematizing current operations - and as the function matures, we expect to build a team around it, including senior leadership and further operational hires.


This role is based in the UK. Must have the right to work in the United Kingdom (no sponsorship required).


What You’ll Do

title: Commodity buyer
description:
About Piab Group
At Piab Group we improve our customers' productivity, sustainability, and safety through evolving industrial automation and have done so since 1951. We believe in an automated world where no resources are wasted, and no humans are injured. With annual sales of ~3 billion SEK and more than 1400 employees, Piab is a global organization, serving customers in more than 100 countries from a vast network of subsidiaries and channel partners. Since 2018, Piab Group has been owned by Patricia Industries, part of Investor AB.
Piab serves a wide range of industries, including e-commerce logistics, food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, and automotive, providing innovative vacuum automation solutions tailored to each sector.

You can expect the following with us
Innovative Culture: Be part of a team that thrives on creativity and innovation.
Global Impact: Work with a company that is a world leader in vacuum transport solutions.
Global Presence: Piab has 25+ sales offices and over 900 partners worldwide, ensuring a vast network and global reach.
Sustainable Vision: Contribute to an automated world, promoting safety and efficiency.
Professional Growth: Access opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.
Diverse and Inclusive: Join a workplace that values diversity and fosters an inclusive environment.
Stable employer: As part of Patricia Industries and connected to the Wallenberg family, Piab benefits from strong support and a commitment to long-term growth and sustainability.

Job Mission
As a Commodity Buyer at Piab, you will lead sourcing activities for new projects from RFQ through supplier nomination and handover to the organization. You will be responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies that support Piab’s business objectives, ensuring competitive total cost, strong supplier performance, and successful industrialization towards SOP.
This role requires a commercially strong, analytical, and proactive person who can manage multiple sourcing projects in parallel and drive activities across Purchasing, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Logistics, and suppliers. You will play a key role in challenging the status quo, identifying cost reduction opportunities, and creating long-term value through fact-based supplier selection and professional stakeholder management.
We are looking for a result-oriented and solution-focused person who takes ownership, communicates clearly, and is comfortable working in a fast-paced, international environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead sourcing activities for new projects from RFQ through supplier nomination and handover to the organization.
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies based on cost, quality, delivery, technology, and supplier capabilities.
  • Prepare and manage RFQs, supplier evaluations, commercial negotiations, and sourcing recommendations.
  • Drive supplier selection and ensure competitive total cost and commercial conditions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional sourcing activities with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Logistics, and other stakeholders.
  • Ensure supplier readiness and successful industrialization towards SOP, including a clear handover to the Commodity Buyer / operational purchasing organization.
  • Challenge suppliers and internal stakeholders to identify cost reduction and value creation opportunities.
  • Monitor sourcing project progress, risks, timing, and savings, ensuring alignment with project targets.
  • Build and maintain strong supplier relationships while ensuring professional and fact-based commercial management.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Piab’s sourcing processes, tools, and ways of working.

Preferred Competencies
  • Strong commercial and analytical skills.
  • Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach.
  • Ability to manage multiple sourcing projects in parallel.
  • Strong negotiation skills and confidence in supplier discussions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across Purchasing, Engineering, Operations, and suppliers.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to turn complex information into clear recommendations and decisions.
  • Result-oriented mindset with the ability to take ownership and drive progress.
  • Ability to challenge existing ways of working and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced and international environment.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

Experience and Education
  • Experience from purchasing, sourcing, commodity management, project purchasing, or strategic procurement, preferably in an international industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Proven experience in RFQ management, supplier evaluation, negotiations, and supplier nomination processes.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Logistics, or similar functions.
  • Understanding of cost drivers, supplier capabilities, total cost analysis, and commercial terms.
  • Experience with sourcing projects related to new product development, industrialization, or project purchasing is considered an advantage.
  • Relevant university degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Purchasing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

This is what our employees say about us
"At Piab, I have the chance to leave my own footprint. The low hierarchy means my ideas are heard and valued. #LoveWhereIWork"

title: Data Center Technician III, AI Infrastructure - Eemshaven or Groningen
description:
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. As a Data Center Technician in Data Center (DC) Technical Operations, you will execute and complete operational tasks related to deploying and launching new data center infrastructure across projects. You will apply standard tools, resources, and processes to solve defined problems, and leverage debugging tools and perform troubleshooting to resolve technical challenges and teach others to do the same. You will include diagnose, repair, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, or infrastructure. You will be engaging in community contributions to improve and sustain our culture and operations.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Netherlands: €82000 - €84000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across teams.

title: Project Controls Lead

title: Afro Hair Specialist
description:
Diversity matters
We are building a brand that represents the people of the world. It’s what you do that counts, and we are always looking to expand perspectives and voices to shape our future.

We see you, we celebrate you, we want you!

Who we are
You might know us as the inventors of the bath bomb, but there’s more to this great-smelling, partly employee-owned, family-run company than pioneering cosmetics. We believe our business should put more back into the world than it takes and demonstrate that capitalism can be a force for good.

The Living Wage Foundation’s statement 'a hard day's work deserves a fair day's pay' is one that we are proud to commit to in the UK. As an accredited Living Wage employer, we put our people first and fight cruel practices like animal testing, promote regeneration, and show that it is what’s inside that counts - whether that’s an ingredient in a product, or the minerals in a smartphone.

The magic behind the Lush HairLab

Committed to assembling a team of skilled specialists, we hold a deep appreciation for the artistry of hairdressing and believe in empowering our stylists to showcase their unique talents.

We want a diverse team that reflects the broad range of our products and caters to all hair types. By doing so, we aim to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels embraced and their individual needs are met when they visit our salons. We are committed to assembling a team of skilled specialists. We hold a deep appreciation for the artistry of hairdressing and strongly believe in empowering our stylists to showcase their unique talents. By doing so, we aim to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels embraced and their individual needs are met when they visit our salons.

Our primary objective is to offer an enriching and educational journey for our clients, empowering them with knowledge about their hair and scalp health while leaving them feeling fabulous both inside and out.

Curly/Afro Hair Stylist

  • Confident and decisive to ensure the client feels safe in expert hands
  • Motivated and driven, with an open mind to our new approach to hairdressing.
What you’ll get
You will receive complete training from our team of Product Experts and Hair Stylists with the correct tools and guidance on all things Lush and Lush HairLab. You will be an ambassador for the Lush HairLab as we pride ourselves on excellent customer service, displaying excellent product knowledge, consultation skills and education for the hair and scalp.

On top of that, you'll receive 15% commission on all services you perform, paid monthly.

Additionally, we also provide bonuses based on the overall performance of the salon space to all staff, including when the salon hits targets on product sales.

Other perks include:

  • Profit-based bonus
  • Complimentary spa treatment*
  • Pension scheme
  • Paid day off for your birthday
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Discounted rail and bus season tickets
  • Employee assistance programme

  • Enhanced paternity leave*
  • Flexible working
  • Access to employee-led Community Networks, including Disability and Chronic Illness, Family Support, Global Majority (Race and Ethnicity), LGBTQIA+, Menopause and Neurodiversity communities.
  • Tailored gender affirming care*
Qualifying period/hours required*

We believe that your information is yours and that it is Lush's responsibility to process your personal information in a secure, fair and accurate manner. Every individual processed by LUSH has certain rights over their data, which are detailed in our Privacy Notice here.


We see you, we celebrate you, and we want you! Please submit your CV and a covering letter, including:

title: CTO/VP of Engineering
description:
Company is the first Solana-native verifiable computation framework that allows developers to outsource complex computations off-chain while generating cryptographic proofs that can be verified on-chain. It contains a suite of developer tools and a prover network, allowing builders to easily create and deploy verifiable applications with direct integration into a decentralized proof network. We currently support the RISC Zero zkVM with plans to expand in the future. Bonsol transforms Solana into a ZK-capable chain enabling privacy-focused, high-complexity use cases for Solana applications that are otherwise not possible today.

Position Overview:

Were looking to onboard a talented CTO to help us build and scale the engineering team. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption of verifiable computation on Solana and to add safety, verifiability and trustlessness to its vision of internet capital markets. As the leader of our engineering team, you will be critical in helping us shape the future of Solana while developing the most performant, scalable, and decentralized computation network. If you have a passion for open-source, building useful things and thrive in a high-ownership environment, wed love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead our technical roadmap, participate in code reviews and help shape our engineering culture
  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance backend systems and APIs to support our proving service integrations and infrastructure platform
  • Identify bottlenecks and optimize infrastructure performance to handle increasing proof request volumes and user demands
  • Support developer teams building on Bonsol to ensure seamless integration of infrastructure components with different applications
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to open-source best practices
  • Continuously improve system architecture, security, and best practices to stay up-to-date with industry standards and emerging cryptographic primitives

Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of experience with Rust.
  • 3+ years of experience building and maintaining high-scale production systems or Solana infrastructure tools
  • Solid previous/current experience writing Solana programs (Anchor and Pinocchio)
  • 2+ years of experience working in a technical leadership role
  • 1+ years of experience with zkVMs and writing zk programs (preferably Risc0, Succinct and Groth16)
  • Proficiency with cloud services (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, execute at speed, with excellent communication and collaboration skills in a remote work environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for staying at the forefront of technology

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with building prover networks
  • Prior experience in a startup or fast-paced environment
  • Shared vision of how verifiable computation contributes towards Solanas thesis of Internet Capital Markets

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive USD base salary, equity and a benefits package
  • Flexible work hours with a remote-friendly environment
  • Opportunities for professional development and career advancement in a rapidly growing field
  • Work on impactful projects that contribute to defining the future of Solana

title: EAM Release Scheduler / Coordinator
description:

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
About Us

The Michigan Milk Producers Association (MMPA) is a member-owned and operated milk marketing cooperative known for producing high-quality, award-winning dairy products. Established in 1916, MMPA markets 5 billion pounds of milk annually and is the ninth largest dairy farmer-owned cooperative in the United States, serving members in Michigan, Ohio, Indiana and Wisconsin. At MMPA, commitment to milk quality begins on the farm and extends through five processing facilities and wholly owned subsidiary brands, Superior Dairy and Heritage Ridge Creamery. With seven sites across Michigan, Indiana and Ohio, MMPA continues to shape the future of the dairy industry through innovation, product diversification and strategic growth while returning value to its member-owners.

Why you’ll love working here

  • Competitive salary
  • Health and wellness benefits with medical coverage through Blue Cross Blue Shield, including mental health benefits
  • Disability insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Retirement including 401k with employer contributions
  • Personal and professional growth opportunities
  • Employee appreciation events and recognition awards
  • Employee wellness initiatives
  • Employee feedback and suggestion forums

Position Summary

MMPA is seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead and deliver strategic technology initiatives across the organization. This role is responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing projects involving enterprise business systems, infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, cloud technologies, operational technology integrations, and IT governance initiatives.

The Technical Project Manager will work closely with business stakeholders, IT leadership, vendors, and technical teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget while adhering to MMPA standards and project governance methodologies. The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader who can translate business priorities into executable technology solutions, effectively manage competing priorities, and drive results across cross-functional teams. This individual must possess strong leadership, communication, organizational, and technical skills and be comfortable managing multiple concurrent initiatives across a diverse technology portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead technology projects through the full project lifecycle, from initiation and planning through implementation, deployment, and stabilization.
  • Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines, budgets, resource requirements, and success metrics.
  • Facilitate project planning sessions, requirements-gathering workshops, project reviews, and stakeholder communications.
  • Partner with business and IT leaders to align project goals with organizational priorities and strategic initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain project documentation, including project charters, business cases, project plans, status reports, risk registers, and resource forecasts.
  • Manage project schedules, budgets, resources, risks, issues, and dependencies to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Coordinate internal teams, external vendors, consultants, and business stakeholders throughout project execution.
  • Apply Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project management methodologies based on project needs and organizational objectives.
  • Ensure compliance with project governance standards, IT policies, and established project management best practices.
  • Monitor project financial performance and maintain accountability for approved budgets.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks while escalating critical issues as appropriate.
  • Support technology initiatives including:
    • Enterprise Applications and Business Systems
    • Dynamics 365 and ERP Platforms
    • Infrastructure and Cloud Services
    • Network Modernization
    • Cybersecurity Programs
    • Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity
    • Data and Analytics Initiatives
    • IT Governance and Compliance Programs
  • Drive continuous improvement in project delivery processes, documentation standards, and organizational change management practices.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Seven (7) or more years of project management experience leading enterprise technology initiatives.
  • Proven experience managing projects involving business applications, infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, and cloud technologies.
  • Strong understanding of project management methodologies, governance frameworks, and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) practices.
  • Experience managing project budgets, timelines, resources, scope, and vendor relationships.
  • Strong leadership, communication, facilitation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Jira, Microsoft Planner, or similar platforms.

Preferred

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or comparable Agile certification.
  • Experience within manufacturing, food production, agriculture, supply chain, or cooperative organizations.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft technologies, including Microsoft 365, Azure, Power Platform, Dynamics 365, and cybersecurity solutions.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each responsibility satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the responsibilities.

This job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive list of responsibilities that are required of the role. Responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

MMPA provides the opportunity for meaningful work that makes a difference in the dairy industry and in our communities. The diverse talents and perspectives of our employees help us to meet the needs of our member farms and the customers we serve.

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States.

MMPA is committed to maintaining a safe, healthy, and productive environment for all employees as one of our top priorities. As part of our commitment to your well-being and workplace safety, all applicants are required to undergo a drug screening and background check as part of the hiring process.

We are not accepting unsolicited candidate introductions, referrals, or résumés from third-party recruiters or staffing agencies for this position.

MMPA is an equal opportunity employer.

title: AV-tekniker
description:
Vi søger en AV-tekniker på Danmarks største universitet i en spændende IT-afdeling

Vil du gøre en forskel for 40.000 studerende og 10.000 ansatte på Københavns Universitet? Vil du have ca. 350 dygtige IT-kolleger, som selv drifter, tilpasser, udvikler og supporterer et væld af IT-løsninger? Og vil du sikre dig, at du kan holde dig fagligt opdateret via løbende kompetenceudvikling? Så har vi jobbet til dig i KU IT, universitetets IT-afdeling.

KU IT søger en kollega til at indgå i AV-teamet, der består af en række engagerede AV-teknikere, hvis mål er at levere gode AV-services til KU. Sammen udgør vi et team, som er drevet af at levere velfunderede standardiserede AV-løsninger på et fagligt højt niveau med automatisering og nye teknologier for øje i videst mulige omfang.

Sådan ser din nye arbejdsdag ud Du bliver en del af ’Infrastruktur og platforme’ med en bred berøringsflade til resten af organisationen.
Teamets og dermed også dine primære arbejdsopgaver består i at være med til at levere AV-løsninger, herunder opsætning af undervisnings-, møde- og konferenceudstyr samt at supportere KU’s medarbejdere over telefonen og personligt on location, hvis der opstår tekniske problemer med udstyret. Dine primære opgaver bliver følgende:
  • AV-design og implementering
  • Vedligehold af undervisnings- og mødelokaler samt auditorier
  • AV-diagnosticering
  • Integration med KU’s netværk
  • Sørge for nyanskaffelser, opgraderinger og vedligeholdelse af AV-udstyr
På denne side kan du i nogle korte videoer få indtryk af KU som IT-arbejdsplads og møde repræsentanter fra nogle af de mange faggrupper, der er ansat i KU IT.

Hvem er du? Vi er åbne for ansøgninger fra både nyuddannede og mere erfarne kandidater. Måske er du lige blevet færdig med din uddannelse som AV-tekniker og er på udkig efter dit første job, eller måske har du været i branchen et stykke tid og trænger til forandringer.
Vi leder efter en kollega, der er servicemindede og god til at tale med brugere på alle niveauer. Derudover er det en fordel, hvis du har erfaring indenfor nogle af nedenstående områder:
  • Du har både vidt forgrenede og specifikke AV- og IT-kompetencer
  • Du frygter hverken Windows, MacOS eller TCP/UDP-protokoller - uden nødvendigvis at være ekspert på dem alle
  • Du har kendskab til Network Audio protokoller fx Dante, AVB. m.fl.
  • Betjening og programmering af AV-styringssystemer
  • En forståelse for hybridmøder, MTR og trådløs præsentationsteknologi
  • Du er systematisk og god til at dokumentere og kommunikere på dansk og engelsk
Mangler du erfaring på nogle af områderne, sørger vi for at klæde dig på - både når du starter og løbende igennem din ansættelse.


Om KU-IT som arbejdsplads

KU IT holder til i Niels Bohr Bygningen på Jagtvej 132 KBH N, og der er mulighed for gratis parkering. KU IT leverer og supporterer en bred palet af IT-løsninger til forskning, undervisning og administration på Københavns Universitet. Derudover rådgiver KU IT universitets ledelse og forskere om alt fra IT-udstyr til IT-sikkerhed og digitalisering. Vores brugere er mangfoldige og tæller 40.000 studerende og 10.000 ansatte på universitetet. Vi garanterer derfor en spændende arbejdsdag, hvor du hver dag bidrager til Københavns Universitets målsætning om at være et universitet i verdensklasse.

KU IT er en familievenlig arbejdsplads med fokus på trivsel og løbende kompetenceudvikling. Der er mulighed for hjemmearbejdsdage, og samtidigt prioriterer vi kollegaskabet højt - bl.a. ved at arrangere fredagsbar for hele KU IT. KU afholder sågar en årlig musikfestival for alle ansatte og studerende.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Den ugentlige arbejdstid er 37 timer inklusive frokost.
Ansættelsen sker i henhold til Cirkulære om Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Lærernes Centralorganisation (LC) og Centralorganisationen af 2010 (CO10) og Cirkulære om organisationsaftale for it-medarbejdere (PROSA) i statens tjeneste med indplacering i løngruppe 2 eller 3 afhængig af erfaring og kompetencer, eller eventuelt anden faglig relevant overenskomst.
Der vil være mulighed for forhandling af tillæg efter kvalifikationer.

Yderligere oplysninger

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen eller om KU IT, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte sektionsleder Micael Pedersen på tlf. 28 75 70 68 eller mica@adm.ku.dk

Sådan søger du jobbet

Send din ansøgning med CV og andre relevante dokumenter senest den 10. november 2026. Vi afholder dog samtaler løbende. Ansættelse forventes at være 1. januar 2027 eller hurtigst muligt.

Vi ønsker at afspejle det omgivende samfund og opfordrer alle uanset personlig baggrund til at søge stillingen.

title: Finance Business Partner / Business Controller
description:
Nobia - a leading European kitchen specialist listed on Nasdaq Stockholm – is looking for a Finance Business Partner / Business Controller to join our Finance function in Aarhus. This is not a traditional controlling role. We are building the finance function of the future: one where data, AI and sharp business insight come together to drive real value across our Nordic brands.

This is a business finance role where you will combine financial controlling, analysis and business partnering. You will play an important role in understanding and challenging business performance, supporting leaders with financial insights and turning data into actions.

You will work closely with Finance leadership and stakeholders across the business, with plenty of opportunity to influence how we work with performance management, reporting and analysis.

What you’ll do

You will be a key finance partner to the business, connecting financial results with the commercial reality behind the numbers.

Concretely, you will:

  • Drive and support the monthly closing, forecasts and performance management process, ensuring accurate reporting, explaining variances and identifying key drivers behind the results.

  • Act as a Finance Business Partner, providing proactive sparring to managers and leaders and challenging assumptions and decisions from a financial perspective.

  • Analyse business performance across revenue, margin, costs, customers and products, turning data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.

  • Prepare and communicate management reporting and performance insights, making complex financial information easy to understand and act upon.

  • Taking ownership and challenging the status quo – continuously improving our processes and strengthening our data-driven decision-making.

  • Contribute to building the analytical foundation and tooling that our finance function will rely on for years to come.

  • Identify and optimize processes – think beyond today's way of working and explore how AI, SQL, BI, automation, and advanced analytics can help us work smarter, faster, and with greater insight.

Who you are

You are commercially minded and enjoy being close to the business. You are comfortable working with numbers, but even more interested in understanding what is behind the numbers and what they mean for the business.

You take a proactive approach and naturally ask why did this happen, what does it mean and what should we do about it in the future.

You enjoy being a sparring partner to the business and are confident challenging stakeholders in a constructive way. You can communicate financial topics clearly to people who are not finance specialists and turn analysis into action.

We expect that you bring:

  • Relevant experience within business controlling, FP&A or a similar partnering role.

  • Understanding of month-end closing, financial reporting, budget, forecasting, and variance analysis.

  • Experience working closely with the business as a finance or business partner.

  • Stay curious, challenge existing ways of working, and actively look for opportunities to improve processes and outcomes.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn financial and business data into clear insights and recommendations.

  • Strong Excel skills and experience with reporting/BI tools and hands-on experience with modern AI tools (Copilot, Claude or similar) - and an active interest in how AI changes the way finance works.

  • A relevant academic background, e.g. cand.merc., cand.oecon., cand.polit. or similar.

What we offer

We offer a business-critical role with close exposure to senior Finance and business leadership with opportunity to influence decisions and make a visible impact on the business. We offer a role that combines business partnering, controlling and analysis, with room to shape your own area of responsibility. There will be plenty of opportunity to develop alongside a Finance function that is going through an exciting transformation. You will have a workplace based in Tilst with strong flexibility around how and where you work.

Curious for more?

Get a glimpse of what life is like at Nobia right here!

We look forward to hearing from you!
If you have any questions about the position, feel free to reach out to our Head of Internal Reporting and Performance Systems, Casper Kunz on cik@nobia.dk

A cover letter is not necessary, but please include a short motivation in your CV. We process applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to send your CV as soon as possible.

Start date: As soon as possible - we are ready when you are.

title: Software Engineer for AI Project

Main Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, scalable, and maintainable Python applications.

  • Contribute to architecture and technical design discussions, with an eye toward performance, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

  • Write clean, well-tested, and well-documented code, following team standards and best practices.

  • Participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and continuously raising code quality.

  • Integrate, test, debug, and maintain software across development, staging, and production environments.

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate requirements into technical solutions.

  • Evaluate, estimate, and help prioritize feature and technical improvement requests.

  • 3+ years of professional experience developing software with Python.

  • Solid experience working with relational and/or NoSQL databases.

  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows (pull requests, code reviews).

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

  • Good understanding of testing practices (unit, integration, automated testing).

  • Experience deploying or operating applications on cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure).

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work autonomously.

Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

  • Interest in system performance, observability, and reliability.

  • A growth mindset, curiosity, and willingness to learn new technologies.

Other Details:

This position offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment, focusing on AI technology.

title: Senior Security Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
We prioritise privacy as a fundamental right, delivering the most secure communication experience across various industries. Our cutting-edge encryption technology and robust security measures have made us a trusted partner in the technology, finance, healthcare, and government sectors. If you are passionate about redefining secure communication and want to be part of an innovative team, join us as a Senior Product Manager within our Product Engineering organisation. Together, let us build a world where privacy and security shape the future of communication.

  • Employment Type: 12-month contract with the possibility of extension

  • Previous working experience: 5-7 years in Product Security

  • Working hours: 40hrs/week

  • Working Location: Remote EU / Berlin

  • Desired start date: As soon as possible

Be ready to play an essential role by joining our Information Security Team. You will become a pioneer in transforming how organisations and governments communicate securely. You will work closely with the Director of Information Security and interact with the engineering, product, and other teams regularly. Your areas of work are:

Product Security

  • You review security- or privacy-critical changes and implement or propose solutions to potential issues

  • You help to maintain security documentation of the product with focus on product certifications

  • You communicate with internal and external stakeholders regarding product security topics

  • You support new feature development from a security point of view to identify possible security or privacy pitfalls early in the process

  • You contribute to internal security audits, risk assessments and threat modelling workshops

  • You conduct security awareness trainings regarding your field of responsibility

Platform Security

  • You are responsible for our Platform Security controls

  • You support technical due diligence to ensure compliance with information security and data protection requirements

  • You oversee the incident management process and team members involved in resolving the incident

  • You help to maintain documentation of security- and privacy-related processes

  • You support Wire’s identity and access management

  • You drive the implementation and maintenance of SecOps measures for our Platform

Essential requirements

  • Proficient understanding of secure software development practices, including threat modelling and security architecture review for products.

  • Hands-on experience assessing security and privacy risks in product features (e.g., authentication, encryption, data handling, APIs).

  • Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals (e.g., AWS) and common infrastructure tools (Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm).

  • Experience supporting security certifications/compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR).

  • Strong communication skills and experience engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders on security and privacy topics.

Strong plus

  • Ideally, you have relevant security and/or DevOps certifications, such as CKS, etc.

  • You are familiar with GitHub, Jira and Confluence.

Further qualifications and skills

  • You are a good communicator and you like to work in a team.

  • You are interested in and keep up with trends and news from the InfoSec world.

  • You are self-motivated to identify security problems and engage with teams to find solutions.

  • You like to do in-depth research on your own and present the results to the team.

  • You have programming experience, preferably with one or more of JavaScript, TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin, Java, Rust and Haskell.

  • You have a thorough understanding of security code reviews, bug triage based on common metrics like CVSS, and vulnerability management.

  • You have a practical, working understanding of basic cryptographic ciphers/algorithms and understand protocols or concepts like Elliptic Curve, TLS, Public Key Infrastructure and Messaging Layer Security.

  • You have a strong understanding of application security frameworks like OWASP Top 10.

  • You bring thorough knowledge of OAuth, SSO, Identity and Access Management systems.

  • You are willing to subject yourself to the S2 security check of the German Government.

This role can be performed remotely from Germany or another EU country. Regular travel to our Berlin office for workshops, and selected in-person collaboration sessions is expected.

  • Join a market-proven company with more than 1,000 customers and help Wire become the trusted secure communications partner for organisations that care deeply about security and privacy.
  • Participate in Wire’s long-term success through VSOPs.
  • 30 days of vacation entitlement, allowing you to take well-deserved time off and maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  • With an Urban Sports Club subscription, stay balanced and mentally and physically healthy.
  • Investment in professional development with an annual education budget of €1,000 and access to top-notch learning resources.
  • Work from a beautiful office in the heart of Berlin or choose a mix of working from anywhere vs. spending selected days together in our office to connect on a personal level.
  • Enjoy fresh breakfast in the office, daily fruits, snacks, free soft drinks, and a nice Barista coffee machine.
  • Wire is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability or race.
Join us in shaping the future of secure communication. Click Apply now to submit your CV - we look forward to meeting you!

title: Head of BI & Data
description:
About us

At Xelix, we work with some of the world’s largest companies to automate and strengthen their financial controls. Our AI solutions redefine how Accounts Payable teams operate – moving from manual processes to automated, intelligent workflows.

Xelix is a fast-paced scale-up – things move fast and expectations are high. We raised our Series B with Insight Partners in June 2025 and are expanding aggressively. We have a team of over 150 talented people pulling together to achieve our goals. Everyone is trusted to take ownership, move fast and have a meaningful impact. We prioritise personal and professional growth, keep things fun, and love to celebrate a milestone together.

In this role you’ll grow, be challenged and help shape the future of Xelix. If you’re excited about building something special with us, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role

We are now hiring for a Head of BI & Data to build and lead our new BI / Data team, initially reporting to our CTO. This role is an exciting opportunity to own Xelix's single source of truth from day one: the data lake, data warehouse and metrics that every team, AI feature and data product will rely on.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and lead the BI / Data team: hire a Data Engineer and an Analytics Engineer, and shape how the team works with Finance, RevOps, Commercial, Product, Engineering and Services

  • Own the data platform end to end: data lake, Snowflake data warehouse, ingestion and governed company KPIs such as ARR, customer retention, realised customer value, touchless rate and cost to serve

  • Deliver, with RevOps and Account Management, a joined customer dataset within your first three months (product usage, realised value, contracts and cost alongside CRM data) so they can answer which customers get value, renew or expand, and what they cost to serve

  • Set data governance with InfoSec: access controls, retention and deletion, and clear ownership for every data source

  • Make our data AI-ready: evaluation datasets for AI Engineering, trusted context for agents, and clean data for data products

  • Partner with the platform team on data contracts, change data capture and moving analytics off production databases

What you’ll bring

Interview Process

We strive to make the process clear, efficient, and respectful of your time.

We welcome the responsible use of AI for research and interview preparation, but ask that it isn't used to generate answers during live interviews. We also believe in being transparent - we use Metaview's AI note-taker during interviews so our interviewers can stay fully present. If you'd prefer us not to use it, just let your interviewer know. While you may need to answer eligibility questions as part of your application, we do not use AI to review or make decisions on applications - every application is reviewed fairly by a member of our Talent team.

title: Site Reliability Engineer, Delivery Platforms
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL

You? A curious and collaborative individual eager to learn, share knowledge, and help developer teams succeed.

Role? Site Reliability Engineer (SRE). You will maintain and evolve our platform, keeping services highly available while making life easier for our developers.

Tech stack? Kubernetes, Google Cloud (GCP), PostgreSQL, Kafka, Elastic, Prometheus, Grafana, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code, and observability tooling.

Location? Join us in our Stockholm or Oslo office with the flexibility to work 3 days per wee

Company? Vend Marketplaces, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen, where millions of people across the Nordics connect to find what they need, whether it’s a job, a home, a way to move, or a fresh start!

Why us? This is your chance to make a meaningful impact by supporting over a thousand production changes weekly in a supportive, diverse environment. Enjoy a healthy work-life balance where overtime is rare, continuous learning opportunities, and work with technologies that empower millions across the Nordics.

Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!

WHO ARE YOU?

Engineering background: You have shipped code to production and operated services in cloud environments. You know the difference between code that works and code that runs reliably.
Strong communicator: You explain technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences and proactively keep stakeholders informed.
Curious and adaptable: You don't need to arrive knowing everything, but you have a strong desire to learn new technologies and develop your skills continuously.
Collaborative team player: You enjoy working with others towards a common goal and find it motivating to help your colleagues succeed in a diverse and inclusive environment.
Knowledge sharer: You actively contribute to discussions about technology and thrive when sharing your expertise to uplift the team.
Problem solver: You approach advising, planning, monitoring, and diagnosing problems with a flexible mindset.
English Fluency: You write and speak English well. It is the working language across our teams in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Poland, and Finland.
Education: A degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. We value different paths into SRE.

WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE?

Goal and mission: Keep our services highly available and provide an effective, automated platform for all our developers to work with.
Day-to-day: You will be involved in a variety of tasks ranging from advising and planning to the deployment of new services, as well as monitoring and diagnosing problems. You'll focus heavily on automation, infrastructure as code, and continuous delivery.
Current projects: Empowering developer workflows through building platforms, scaling our Kubernetes setup in Google Cloud, and exploring/deploying new technologies to support over a thousand weekly production pushes.
Stakeholders: You'll work closely with internal developers, the wider infrastructure team, and stakeholders across our Nordic marketplaces.
Communication: Communication is central—you'll collaborate daily with developers, participate in incident response, and help teams understand platform capabilities.
Observability: You'll help teams understand their systems — building dashboards, refining alerts, and improving logging so developers can troubleshoot faster and ship with confidence.
AI-assisted workflows: We actively use AI tools to enhance how we work - from troubleshooting and automation to learning and documentation. We're always exploring how to leverage these tools better. You’ll help shape that.

A few words from Birgir Stefansson, Engineering Manager

" We're a team within Vend's Delivery Platforms, distributed across Oslo, Stockholm, and Aarhus, supporting developers across FINN, Blocket, DBA, Tori, and our other Nordic marketplaces.

Our team brings together different backgrounds, experiences, and cultures — and that diversity makes us stronger. Being distributed means clear communication is how we work: pairing on solving problems, sharing context openly, and celebrating each other's wins. If you're curious, collaborative, and want to help shape how hundreds of developers ship code every day, I'd love to hear from you."

Want to get a feel for our culture and what drives us? Take a peek behind the scenes at our Career Page!

GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you!

Make sure to apply by the 31st of October 2026

QUESTIONS?

Birgir Stefansson, Senior Engineering Manager, is happy to provide information about the daily work and answer any questions you may have about the role via birgir.stefansson@vend.com. You can also contact Clayton Don Corda, Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, if you have questions about the process.

We’re here to make sustainable living effortless through seamless digital experiences. As part of a dynamic family of marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Bytbil, Oikotie, Bilbasen, and DBA, we connect people with services and products that matter.

Driven by purpose and curiosity, we constantly evolve to meet today’s needs and shape a smarter, more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Associate Engineer
description:
Who You Are

The Engineer (Robotic Applications) will provide strong and consistent robot application engineering support to FANUC’s automotive customers who deploy robots into their automotive manufacturing facilities. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker and problem-solver, experienced with FANUC technology, automotive applications and skilled in navigating complex engineering challenges while actively supporting the broader objectives of the Automotive Solutions Engineering (ASE) team.

How It’s Done

  • Establish and foster strong application focused relationships across automotive customers and FANUC internal teams.
  • Maintain awareness and technical understanding of automotive customer applications, processes, challenges and issues.
  • Collaborate closely with cross departmental teams to drive resolution of outstanding application issues.
  • Collaborate with automotive customers to understand their application challenges to identify and/or evaluate possible solution concepts.
  • Collaborate with Segment, Innovation Lab and GSSV teams to prepare material that enables FAC automotive sales to promote features, benefits, advantages and business value of new and existing FANUC products, engineering services and application solutions.
  • Work with Automotive Application Engineering (AAE) engineers to develop, validate, and present new application solutions to automotive customers.
  • Support FAC sales by preparing and presenting material or coordinating coverage from the appropriate segment/AAE engineer on the application of FANUC products for customer visits to FAC and sales visits to customer sites.
  • Escalate product application issues/requests with other FANUC departments to meet customer and project needs.
  • Negotiate issue resolutions, establish and communicate business priorities, and collaborate with Segment to prepare clear and complete functional requirements for customer requested application developments.

What You Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (mechanical, electrical, software) or equivalent, relevant experience.
  • Minimum 1 year of experience with automated systems and applications (actual equipment integration, installation, and production experience a plus).
  • Experience with Automotive processes such as spot welding, stud welding, dispensing, riveting etc.
  • Experience with simulation tools including FANUC ROBOGUIDE, Process Simulate, Emulate3D and others.
  • Experience with vision applications including FANUC iRVision.
  • Understanding of FANUC products and applications.
  • Robotic application knowledge and experience.

What Would Be Even Better

  • 3+ years of related experience.
  • Segment / Project Management / Product Management / Application Engineering experience related to robot application, system or product implementation.
  • Customer and application experience to effectively identify and promote new application concepts across strategic customer initiatives.
  • Familiarity with multiple automotive robotic applications used in Body Shop, General Assembly, and Powertrain.

It’s Your Move

At FANUC America, we are driven by a deep respect for our people and a commitment to building a workplace dedicated to integrity and excellence. We believe that great careers are built through opportunity, growth, and collaboration—and we’re excited to invite talented individuals like you to explore what’s possible with us.

title: Projektleder til projektering og vedligehold af elnettet - Frederikshavn Forsyning
description:
Vil du arbejde med projekter, der sikrer fremtidens elforsyning? Frederikshavn Forsyning søger en projektleder med en solid el-teknisk baggrund, der vil være med til at udvikle, vedligeholde og fremtidssikre elnettet i lokalområdet.

Du bliver en del af en afdeling med dygtige og erfarne kolleger, hvor der venter en række spændende projekter i de kommende år. Du får mulighed for at arbejde med både tekniske løsninger, projektering og projektstyring – og samtidig være med til at sikre en stabil og driftssikker elforsyning.

Din rolle

Som projektleder får du ansvar for at planlægge, koordinere og følge projekter fra de indledende beskrivelser til den færdige løsning. Opgaverne spænder fra nettilslutninger og reinvesteringer til udvikling og vedligeholdelse af eksisterende anlæg.

En stor del af jobbet handler om projektstyring, dokumentation og koordinering med rådgivere, leverandører og myndigheder. Du skal derfor trives med at skabe struktur, holde overblik og sikre fremdrift i projekterne.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Projektering og projektledelse af opgaver på elnettet
  • Planlægning og gennemførelse af reinvesteringer og nettilslutninger
  • Udarbejdelse af projektbeskrivelser, dokumentation og myndighedsmateriale
  • Indkøb og koordinering med eksterne rådgivere og leverandører
  • Opfølgning på økonomi, tidsplaner, kvalitet og sikkerhed
  • Deltagelse i tekniske vurderinger, netberegninger og idriftsættelse

Du bliver en del af en vagtordning, som aflønnes særskilt. Vagten går på skift mellem kollegerne og ligger typisk én uge hver fjerde til femte uge.

Hvem er du?

Du har en el-teknisk uddannelse som eksempelvis elinstallatør, stærkstrømstekniker, elingeniør, maskinmester eller tilsvarende.

Du har en god teknisk forståelse og interesse for elforsyning, men behøver ikke have arbejdet i branchen tidligere. Det vigtigste er, at du har et solidt fagligt fundament, arbejder systematisk og har lyst til at sætte dig ind i de tekniske og administrative opgaver, der følger med projekterne.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med tekniske projekter, projektering eller projektledelse
  • Arbejder struktureret og kan styre opgaver efter budgetter og tidsplaner
  • Trives med både tekniske problemstillinger og dokumentation
  • Er god til at samarbejde og kommunikere med forskellige faggrupper
  • Har fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhed og løsninger, der fungerer i praksis
  • Har kørekort til personbil

Erfaring med højspænding, elnet eller relæbeskyttelse vil være en fordel, men er ikke et krav.

Du skal kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og kunne fremvise en straffeattest.

Et job med faglig udvikling og gode rammer

Hos Frederikshavn Forsyning bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads med en flad ledelsesstruktur, en uformel omgangstone og et godt samarbejde på tværs af organisationen.

Du får en grundig introduktion til opgaverne og mulighed for løbende at opbygge din viden om elforsyning. Det sker både gennem samarbejdet med erfarne kolleger, relevante kurser og deltagelse i faglige ERFA-grupper.

Der lægges vægt på gennemprøvede tekniske løsninger, høj kvalitet og sikkerhed i arbejdet. Samtidig prioriteres en sund balance mellem arbejde og fritid.

Derudover tilbydes du:

  • En attraktiv lønpakke med en god pensionsordning
  • Sundhedsforsikring
  • Medarbejderbredbånd og mobiltelefon
  • Kantineordning
  • Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og efteruddannelse
Om Frederikshavn Forsyning

Frederikshavn Forsyning arbejder med at sikre en stabil og velfungerende forsyning til borgere og virksomheder i lokalområdet. På elområdet venter en række investeringer og udviklingsprojekter, som skal sikre, at elnettet også i fremtiden kan imødekomme behovene.

Virksomheden er kendetegnet ved en praktisk tilgang til opgaverne, hvor ordentlighed, kvalitet og sikkerhed er centrale elementer i det daglige arbejde.

Interesseret?

Kan du se dig selv i stillingen, så send din ansøgning og CV via linket til højre.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Anders Heslop fra MatchMind på tlf. 30214511 eller på mail: ahc@matchmind.dk

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, men venter gerne på den rette.

Klik på "Send ansøgning" til højre, hvis du ønsker at komme i betragtning til dette job. Når du klikker på linket føres du automatisk over i MatchMinds system, hvor din ansøgning, CV og øvrige bilag kan uploades. Vi får automatisk besked, når materialet er uploadet. Det er vigtigt, at du følger denne fremgangsmåde, idet vi på denne måde kan tilbyde en langt bedre sikkerhed og dermed højere beskyttelse af dine personoplysninger, end hvis du eksempelvis sender dokumenterne i en usikret email. Vi har ligeledes brug for dit samtykke til bl.a. at dele dine oplysninger med den virksomhed, vi rekrutterer på vegne af, og dette kan vi sikre ved, at du benytter ovennævnte fremgangsmåde.

title: Senior Civil Project Manager
description:
* This position is posted through Core States Group, which recently acquired Hurley & Stewart, a civil engineering firm based in Michigan. Over the coming year, Hurley & Stewart and Core States Group will continue coming together as one team, with increasing alignment across people, systems, and ways of working. The successful candidate will work closely with the Hurley & Stewart team while benefiting from the resources, expertise, and growth opportunities of Core States Group.


At Core States Group, the work you do matters to the clients we serve, the communities we support, and the teams who rely on one another to deliver with excellence. Our Cause is powerful: to create a world where all environments improve everyday life.


Why Professionals Choose Core States Group

Here’s what you can expect:

  • VALUES-DRIVEN CULTURE – A workplace rooted in Integrity, Service, Inclusion, Excellence, and Innovation. Our Core Values guide how we work, how we treat each other, and how we show up for our clients every day.
  • COMPENSATION – Competitive wages and bonus programs, including professional licensure bonuses.
  • RETIREMENT – A strong 401(k) match, with immediate vesting, to help you invest in your future and build your retirement savings with confidence.
  • HEALTHCARE – Competitive health benefits including HSA with employer contribution, life insurance options, and supplemental coverage options, giving you the flexibility to select the coverage that best fits your needs and lifestyle.
  • VACATION – Generous PTO to help you recharge, relax, and maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  • PERKS – Team wellness challenges, free virtual gym app, wholesale club membership reimbursement, employee recognition programs, paid parental leave and much more!
  • FLEXIBLE WORK ENVIRONMENT – A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work, whether you’re in the office, working remotely, or blending both to support your responsibilities.
  • TUITION REIMBURSEMENT – support your growth with tuition reimbursement to help advance your education and professional development.


Summary of the Role

As a Senior Civil Project Manager, you will be responsible for managing a variety of Civil Engineering projects from conception to completion. You will apply your experience to all aspects of the project including but not limited to; field observation, due diligence research with authorities, site layout design, utility, and stormwater design techniques, and permitting, along with responses to inquiries during construction administration. As part of a multi-disciplined firm, you will be coordinating with Architectural, Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Structural Engineering departments for development of the construction documents. Duties will also include communication with client(s) throughout the life of the projects. You will be responsible for assigning tasks to team members, checking task progress, and ensuring that each project is completed on time and to the highest standard.


Responsibilities

  • Manage multiple projects with multiple clients simultaneously, while ensuring that timelines are met and communicated.
  • Serve as the lead point of contact for clients.
  • Manage the financial performance for projects including profit and efficiency evaluations and managing accounts receivable.
  • Prepare and negotiate proposals and contracts with clients and sub-consultants.
  • Manage project plans including allocating resources, preparing and monitoring project budgets, and scheduling within project parameters.
  • Identify design criteria and oversee efficient design and plan preparation.
  • Solve design problems using engineering calculations and following general design standards
  • Coordinate with internal disciplines and external project team.
  • Manage, develop, and mentor Project Engineers and Designers.
  • Follow QA/QC practices and procedures while continuing to look for opportunities for improvement of quality and efficiency.
  • Responsible for fostering continued client relationships and looking for avenues of growth with those clients.
  • Participate in new client pursuits.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of constructability and complex design and identify liability issues related to design and construction.
  • Able to provide risk assessment on projects, estimate potential risks along with costs and probabilities.


Qualifications

We’re looking for talented professionals who are eager to grow their skills and contribute to high-quality, meaningful work. If you’re driven, collaborative, and ready to take the next step in your career, we want to hear from you. The following qualifications will help you succeed in this role:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering required
  • P.E. would be a plus, but not required
  • 10+ years of Civil Engineering Project Management experience in site/civil production, preferably with commercial projects such as retail, hospitality, and/or fueling
  • MS Office Required
  • Experience working in Civil 3D and AutoCAD
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to identify practical uses for company-approved AI tools to improve team processes, support better decisions, and increase efficiency
  • Demonstrated ability to review AI-generated content for accuracy, protect confidential information, and remain responsible for the final work product


Work Location

This position is based out of our Grand Rapids, MI office.


Company Overview

Core States Group is an industry-leading architecture, engineering, and construction (A/E/C) firm trusted by many of the world’s most notable brands. With 26 offices across the United States and Canada, the firm delivers speed to market, cost certainty, and compelling design for national multisite programs and projects.

Established in 1999, Core States Group drives innovation and improves everyday life for countless people across several markets, including Convenience, Distributed Generation, Financial, Grocery, Housing, Industrial, Restaurants, Retail, Semiconductor, Zero-Emission Vehicle (ZEV) Infrastructure, and more.


A Note to Candidates

Please do not be concerned if you do not meet every requirement. At Core States Group, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

This position will remain open until it is filled.

title: Aircraft Painter
description:
Who we are and where we are going:

Ascent Aviation Services is one of the largest aviation maintenance, repair, overhaul, storage and reclamation operations in the world. Our strength comes from our talented and professional employees who excel through teamwork and enthusiasm. Ascent Aviation Services continues to grow and are continually looking for motivated and career-minded aviation professionals who will support our vision and goals.

We are currently seeking an Aircraft Painter. The Aircraft Painter will perform functions assigned in the painting and stripping process of aircraft and equipment.

As a 24/7 operation, we have openings across all shifts, including days, evenings, weekends, and 12-hour schedules. Candidates must be flexible and willing to work any shift based on operational needs. Preference is given to those available between 2:30 PM and 7:00 AM, including overnights and weekends. Some schedules may qualify for shift differential. Overtime—both scheduled and unscheduled, including holidays—may also be required.

DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Research technical data and performs aircraft painting functions applying knowledge of surface preparation and painting techniques in accordance with applicable maintenance manuals, FAA regulations and Ascent Aviation policies and procedures.
  • Cleans, sands, and applies chemical solutions to prepare and condition surfaces prior to painting.
  • Mixes and thins paint or other coatings to specified color and consistency according to standard formulas or color charts.
  • Masks and covers surface not to be painted.
  • Sprays specified amount of thickness of primer, protective, decorative, or finish coatings, such as paint, lacquer, sealer, or enamel onto prepared surfaces using spray equipment.
  • Performs maintenance work such as repair and maintenance of company equipment and shop housecleaning.
  • Strips, Sands masks, and insignias, symbols, designs, or other markings on aircraft according to blueprints or specifications, using stencils patterns, measuring instruments, brushes, or spray equipment.
  • Regulates controls on equipment to cure and dry paint or other coatings.
  • Sets up portable ventilators, exhaust units, ladders, and scaffolding prior to painting.
  • Ensures that proper documentation is made on training record for training received, and signed by Lead, Supervisor, or Manager.
  • Operates lifting and moving devices to move materials and equipment and access areas to be painted.
  • Performs duties of the Lead Painter in his/her absence.

YOU WILL GET MORE THAN JUST COMPENSATION:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance
  • 401k with Company Match
  • PTO - Eligible for 4 Weeks in your First Year, in Addition to 7 Paid Company Holidays
  • Company-Provided Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Development and Career Growth Opportunities

REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES:

  • 1-3 years of painting experience
  • Capable of working independently or under supervision.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Excellent attention to detail and mathematical proficiency
  • Ability to read, write and comprehend English with the capability to follow written instructions

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods of time.
  • Frequent bending, stooping, squatting, crouching, kneeling, balancing, and reaching above shoulder level.
  • Occasional crawling, climbing, lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling up to 50 lbs. unassisted.
  • Requires eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity.
  • Corrected vision and hearing to normal range.

EQUIPMENT OPERATED:

  • Protective equipment required: Goggles, safety glasses, face shields, ear protection, apron, gloves, safety harness, breathing equipment.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • The work location will include aircraft Maintenance hangars, the flightline, and Avionics shop.
  • Potential hazards include exposure to high intensity noise levels, extreme changes in temperature, electrical charges and radar waves, materials identified on the Safety Data Sheets, and working around moving machinery.

OTHER DUTIES:
