title: Vice President, Protective Services
description:
Summary

Guidepost is seeking a Vice President for their Protective Services Division. The successful candidate will assist the Senior VP and team with identification, development, implementation and management of global security strategies and programs for new and current clients. This leader will directly oversee business development and management of physical security operations, executive protection, digital vulnerability and threat assessments, crisis management, and overall security programs. Additionally, the Vice President will start, build, and nurture relationships across a wide range of banks, law firms, family offices, and sports and entertainment entities with the key focus of pursuing and closing business opportunities with in-house subject matter experts while managing all operational aspects of the engagement. This is a hybrid role, combining business development and hands-on management of client engagements.

Core Responsibilities

Business Development

  • Develop strong, trust-based relationships with CSO’s and senior Security stakeholders, positioning Guidepost Solutions as a foundational element of their security and investigative practice areas.
  • Generate leads by building and maintaining relationships throughout the industry
  • Support priority client development through targeting, planning, and relationship growth
  • Evaluate customer needs and collaborate with teammates/management to identify the appropriate solutions based on our portfolio of products and services.
  • Ability to effectively communicate across all levels of the organization and work with cross-functional teams to identify and address program opportunities to further the client goals.
  • Establish customer relationships that enable the firm to be viewed as a trusted advisor.
  • Work closely with PSD leadership to develop and maintain client base and implement growth strategies
  • Build an effective pipeline and execute on each phase of the sales process
  • Prepare, present, and negotiate proposals and contracts

Operational Management

  • Work with other practice areas and subject matter experts within Guidepost, lead client efforts with regards to internal investigations, digital vulnerability and threat assessments, Independent Security Studies (IRS Code 26, section 132), threat and vulnerability assessments, travel risk, and cyber engagements.
  • Develop and direct effective strategies to assess and mitigate global security-related risks, manage crises and incidents, and safeguard the client’s personnel and property
  • Coordinate and manage multi-faceted, international executive protection engagements
  • Develop your current professional network as a source of business and become a reliable partner trusted to advise clients, wealth advisors, or family offices on their needs and ensure seamless implementation of complex tasks
  • Prepare and execute on business development plans and strategies, including spearheading new initiatives and preparing and providing proposals to current and potential clients
  • Work with trusted contacts in the military, law enforcement, and intelligence community, to provide travel risk reporting for client’s international travel.


Competencies

  • Business development expertise
  • Operational management
  • Client relationships
  • Executive protection for high net worth individual
  • Risk management
  • Emergency planning
  • Digital vulnerability
  • Ethical Practice

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Candidates will have 10 -15+ years of prior work experience, preferably with another risk management consultancy, security firm, law enforcement agency, intelligence agency, or military branch.
  • Significant track record of solution-based business development across the East Coast market and throughout Latin America
  • A strong network within banks, international law firms, and tech companies
  • Experience working in security consulting.
  • Experience working with high-net-worth clients
  • Excellent teamworking and consulting skills
  • Highly responsive, able to respond to emerging issues after hours, on weekends, or on holidays.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a complex and growing global matrix structure.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position with days and hours of work generally Monday through Friday. This position may require long hours and weekend work.


Travel

Travel as needed will be expected.


Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this job, much of the work may be performed while sitting at a desk, using a computer, typing, handling calls and using standard office equipment. The employee must occasionally lift or move office products and supplies weighing up to 20 pounds.


Other Duties

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time, with or without notice.


Compensation

The base annual salary range offered for this position is based on numerous factors, including job-related skills and knowledge, experience, specific location, relevant education and/or training. In addition to the annual salary, we offer a full benefits package.


Guidepost Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Children's Residential Care Workers - Cumbria
description:
Children's Residential Care Workers Needed

Looking for a Meaningful New Career? No Experience Required.


At New Reflexions, we don't just look at experience – we look at potential.

If you're caring, resilient, and passionate about helping young people thrive, we'll provide everything else. From day one, you'll receive full training, ongoing support, and fully funded qualifications, helping you build a rewarding long-term career in residential childcare.


Exciting Opportunities in Cumbria

We're expanding our services and are looking for dedicated individuals to join our established and supportive teams.


Our opportunities include:

Activity-Based Response Children's Homes - Wigton

Work in a unique therapeutic environment where outdoor adventure, exploration, and learning play a key role in helping young people achieve positive outcomes. If you enjoy being active and spending time outdoors, this could be the perfect role for you.


Residential Care Services - Kirkby Stephen

Work in a supportive and therapeutic residential environment, helping children and young people who have experienced trauma, emotional difficulties, and behavioural challenges. As part of a dedicated team, you will build positive relationships, provide stability and nurture, and support young people to develop resilience, independence, and confidence in a safe and caring home environment.



Learning Disability Services - Keswick

Support children with complex learning disabilities in a warm, nurturing environment where individuality is recognised and celebrated. Working alongside an experienced team, you will help young people develop communication, independence, and essential life skills through tailored support programmes designed to maximise their opportunities and achieve positive outcomes.


Why Choose New Reflexions?

At New Reflexions, you'll be joining a settled, experienced, and highly supportive staff team who are passionate about making a difference. Our homes provide children with stability, consistency, and positive role models.

The children and young people we support are encouraged to participate fully in their local communities, and all children attend local schools, helping them build relationships, confidence, and a sense of belonging.

You'll be working in beautifully maintained homes where children receive therapeutic care, education, and support that enables them to flourish.


About Us

New Reflexions is a specialist childcare organisation providing high-quality care, education, and therapeutic services for children and young people who have experienced trauma and adversity.

Our residential services offer both short and long-term therapeutic placements for children and young people up to the age of 18, focusing on building positive relationships, developing independence, and helping every child achieve their full potential.


What You'll Be Doing

As a Residential Care Worker, you'll play an important role in supporting children and young people aged up to 18 who may have emotional and behavioural needs or learning disabilities.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Building positive, nurturing, and trusting relationships
  • Supporting day-to-day routines, including meals, personal care, and homework
  • Helping young people develop confidence, independence, and life skills
  • Encouraging participation in education, hobbies, and community activities
  • Supporting emotional wellbeing and responding calmly to challenging situations
  • Working as part of a therapeutic team to provide consistency and stability
  • Creating a safe, caring, and homely environment
  • Following a shift pattern that includes sleep-ins


What We're Looking For

You don't need previous experience in residential childcare – just the right values and attitude.

We're looking for people who are:

  • Compassionate, patient, and caring
  • Reliable and calm under pressure
  • Motivated to support young people to achieve their potential
  • Willing to complete a fully funded Level 3 qualification
  • Hold a full UK manual driving licence
  • Have access to their own transport

o Borth

o Tenby

o Morecambe

  • Fully funded Level 3 and Level 5 qualifications
  • Clear career progression to Senior, Deputy Manager, and Registered Manager roles
  • Employee wellbeing and support resources

Essential Requirements

  • A genuine passion for helping children and young people succeed
  • Full UK manual driving licence

Ready to Make a Real Difference?

If you're looking for a career where every day matters, where you'll be supported to grow professionally, and where you can genuinely change young lives for the better, we'd love to hear from you.

New Reflexions | High-Quality Children's Residential Care & Education

title: Solution Sales Engineer - APAC
description:
Solution Sales Engineer

Context & Impact:

As Lansweeper continues to evolve into a broader Technology Asset and Network Intelligence platform—especially following the Redjack acquisition—we’re expanding our Presales team to elevate our business impact across IT, cybersecurity, and governance domains.

We’re seeking a Solution Engineer who blends business acumen, business storytelling, and technical credibility. You will not just deliver demos—you’ll co‑create strategic solutions that address real business challenges like cyber risk, visibility gaps, compliance, and operational efficiency.

This is a strategic role where you’ll directly influence how enterprises adopt and realise the value of Lansweeper, including new cyber visibility and network intelligence use cases stemming from Redjack’s technology.

Challenge:

The main challenges you'll face are:

  • Bridging business needs and technical capabilities into compelling strategic value propositions.

  • Help manage complex enterprise sales cycles from a technical perspective with multiple business and technical stakeholders.

  • Driving commercial momentum through consultative discovery and value articulation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive discovery & qualification: Uncover customer challenges, quantify business impact, and map opportunities in visibility, cyber hygiene, or governance.

  • Identify & articulate business value: Engage confidently with both IT and executive stakeholders, connecting Lansweeper’s platform (including Redjack’s network intelligence) to measurable ROI, risk reduction, and operational outcomes.

  • Own the presales journey: Partner with Account Executives on deal strategy, proof points, and success criteria from qualification to close.

  • Deliver value storytelling, not just demos: Craft customer‑specific narratives demonstrating how our intelligence platform solves real business problems across hybrid IT, cloud, and security landscapes.

  • Collaborate across GTM and Product teams: Work with Product Management, Engineering, and GTM teams to translate customer needs into product improvements and post‑sale success.

  • Champion cross‑solution integration: Identify opportunities to extend Lansweeper’s footprint across ITSM, SecOps, cloud, and cyber‑risk management ecosystems.

Key Requirements:

Hard skills:

  • 3–7+ years as a Solution / Sales Engineer, Pre‑Sales Consultant, or Technical Account Manager in enterprises.

  • Strong grasp of enterprise IT environments, cybersecurity architectures, and network visibility platforms (experience with Redjack‑type intelligence solutions is a plus).

  • Proven track record in value‑based selling, building ROI/TCO discussions into the sales process.

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills for C‑level and technical audiences.

  • Experience in complex, multi‑stakeholder enterprise sales.

Soft skills:

  • Active listening – uncover strategic challenges and frame them in business terms.

  • Business acumen and storytelling – connect ROI, TCO, and business outcomes naturally in client engagements.

  • Entrepreunerial mindset & collaboration – act as a co‑owner of deals and a trusted partner to both clients and internal teams.

Our Offer:

  • Competitive salary aligned with market benchmarks + Benefits.

  • Opportunities for growth and learning across Lansweeper’s expanding cyber intelligence mission.

Company Info:

Lansweeper is the Technology Asset Intelligence platform that transforms raw asset and network data into trusted, actionable insights—spanning hardware, software, cloud, IoT, OT, and cybersecurity visibility

With a single solution, organizations gain full visibility across their technology estate, empowering IT, security, operations, and finance teams to make smarter, faster decisions.

We help our customers:

  • Tame hybrid infrastructures

  • Manage compliance and cyber‑risk

Our culture is built on four values:

  • One Team – united across boundaries

You’ll join the Global GTM Solution Engineering team, collaborating daily with Account Executives, Product Management, Customer Success, and Marketing.

Call to Action:

Ready to help enterprises solve strategic business problems through real‑world technology and intelligence?
Apply now or share this opportunity with someone in your network.

title: Dagplejer
description:
Dagplejer – Små børn, store øjeblikke – bliv dagplejer hos os

Bor du I Brøndby kommune og er du passioneret for at give de mindste børn en tryg og nærværende hverdag? Ønsker du et fleksibelt job med stor frihed og mulighed for at gøre en meningsfuld forskel? Så er jobbet som dagplejer i Brøndby Kommune måske noget for dig!

Som dagplejer arbejder du i dit eget hjem og skaber trygge rammer for børnene, samtidig med at du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor du kan få sparring og støtte til din udvikling.

Hvad kan du forvente?

  • Fleksibilitet og selvbestemmelse: Du planlægger selv din arbejdsdag med aktiviteter, der stimulerer børns læring og udvikling. Fra kreative stunder derhjemme til turer på legepladsen eller i skoven.
  • Meningsfuldt arbejde: Du giver børnene en tryg og stimulerende hverdag, hvor de føler sig set og hørt – du er med til at forme deres første år, som er afgørende for deres udvikling.
  • Trygt fællesskab: Du får støtte fra dygtige kollegaer, dagplejepædagoger og leder, som er til rådighed for sparring og vejledning. Vi udvikler løbende vores faglighed gennem møder og kurser.

Din arbejdsdag:

  • Dagen starter tidligt, hvor børnene ankommer omkring kl. 6.45, og I spiser morgenmad.
  • I løbet af dagen deltager børnene i både indendørs og udendørs aktiviteter som cykelture, kreative stunder, massere af leg og bevægelse mm.
  • Der er også en fast dag i ugen, hvor du samles med andre dagplejere og børn i vores legestue.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger en engageret person, som:

  • Har pædagogisk erfaring
  • Er indstillet på at arbejde hjemmefra og skabe et trygt og udviklende miljø
  • Det er et krav, at du er bosiddende i Brøndby Kommune (vester og øster området)
  • Det er et krav, at du har et røgfrit hjem og
  • Det er et krav, at du kan være en dansk sproglig rollemodel.

Fordele ved jobbet:

  • Fleksibilitet og stor selvbestemmelse
  • Et berigende job, hvor du gør en forskel i børns liv
  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og støtte fra kollegaer
  • En arbejdsdag i eget hjem, uden transporttid
  • Du arbejder 48 timer om ugen. Til gengæld får du 7 ekstra fridage årligt
  • Som dagplejer har du, sammen med dit personlige fradrag, et skattefradrag på 60%, fordi du har udgifter til børnenes kost og slitage på hjemmet. De 60% i fradrag kommer efter træk af AM-bidrag, pensionsbidrag mv herunder ATP.

Er du klar til at gøre en forskel for små børn?

Send din ansøgning til os i dag og vær med til at skabe en hverdag fyldt med varme, nærvær og leg.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Vil du vide mere: Du er mere end velkommen til at ringe til leder af dagplejen Malene Rasmussen på 43282599 eller souschef Anette skov Nørby 43282598 og høre mere om jobbet som dagplejer.

Ellers send dit CV og en kort motiveret ansøgning. Du søger jobbet ved at klikke på ”ANSØG”-knappen.

Ansøgningsfrist:

Vi ansætter løbende


Søg stillingen via 'ansøg'-knappen. Her kan du uploade din ansøgning og CV samt evt. relevant dokumentation.

Alle interesserede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, handicap, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold opfordres til at søge stillingen.

I Brøndby Kommune er der en generel politik om, at nyansatte skal forevise straffeattest. Ved beskæftigelse og direkte kontakt med børn under 15 år, indhentes der også en børneattest.

Brøndby Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid.

Brøndby er en centralt beliggende hovedstadskommune med cirka 40.000 indbyggere. Byens puls er præget af fællesskab, mangfoldighed og en stærk idrætskultur. Vi er en kommune med kant og spændende kontraster med bolig- og erhvervsområder, skove, grønne områder og Strandparken med havet og indsøerne.

title: Pædagogiske medarbejdere til Skodsborg – en døgninstitution for børn og unge mellem 12-17 år
description:
Genopslag

Har du ambitioner på de unges vegne og tror på, at alle kan udrette noget stort, hvis de får den rette støtte? Så vil du trives hos os.

Skodsborg søger pædagoger eller pædagogiske assistenter, som ligesom os brænder for at gøre en forskel for nogle af de mest sårbare og udsatte unge i Københavns Kommune.

Om stillingerne
Skodsborg har fået mulighed for at opnormere med mere pædagogisk personale, og det betyder, at der er mere tid til kerneopgaven. Du vil fungere som kontaktperson for nogle af de unge og vil samtidig være tilknyttet et team med 6-7 kollegaer samt være en del af den øvrige pædagogiske drift i huset.

Arbejdsopgaverne består bl.a. af motivationsarbejde, kognitiv adfærdsbehandling, miljøbehandling, botræning, skriftlig dokumentation, sundhedsfaglige opgaver samt praktiske opgaver.

Du skal forvente en hel del skriftligt arbejde, da vi dokumenterer alt i DOMUS og udarbejder behandlingsplaner og statusskriv.

På Skodsborg er to arbejdsdage aldrig ens. Du skal have lyst og evner til at stå i et til tider kaotisk miljø, hvor du kan bibeholde roen og fortsat skabe trygge, tydelige og omsorgsfulde rammer for de unge.

Om os
Specialinstitutionen Skodsborg er en døgninstitution for børn og unge i aldersgruppen 12-17 år. De har oftest udadreagerende og selvskadende adfærd, komplekse psykiske og psykiatriske vanskeligheder og evt. misbrug af stoffer og/eller alkohol.

Institutionen har plads til otte unge. På institutionen er der to delvis lukkede afdelinger (jf. barnets lov § 61), som kan rumme op til tre unge ad gangen. Du får ca. 40 engagerede medarbejdere, fordelt på fast personale, faste afløsere og vikarer. Personalegruppen består primært af pædagoger, sundhedsfaglige kollegaer, en socialrådgiver samt en psykolog, som blandt andet støtter medarbejderne med selvrefleksion og debriefing.

Institutionen arbejder socialpædagogisk, og behandlingsarbejdet er baseret på kognitive behandlingsprincipper, motiverende samtaler (MI) og Low Arousal. Vi tager udgangspunkt i den enkelte unges særlige behov og vanskeligheder og har stort fokus på samarbejdet med den unge og den unges familie og/eller andre nære relationer. Vi prøver altid at undgå magtanvendelser, men når det forekommer, udøves det i omsorg for den unge og er noget, vi drøfter efterfølgende og tager ved lære af.

Institutionen ligger på Skodsborg Strandvej i naturskønne omgivelser med vandet i baghaven, skoven lige overfor og en halv times kørsel fra København. Organisatorisk hører vi til i Center for Børn og Unge i Københavns Kommunes socialforvaltning.

Vores ønsker til dig

  • uddannet pædagog eller pædagogisk assistent
  • erfaring med psykiatri
  • kendskab til behandlingsarbejde med unge
  • erfaring med Low Arousal og kognitiv miljøterapi
  • kørekort til almindelig bil (det er en fordel, men ikke et krav)
  • trives med at have mange forskelligartede opgaver
  • er engageret, ansvarlig og respektfuld
  • er fysisk og psykisk robust og tolerant
Vi kan tilbyde

  • et spændende og udfordrende arbejde med en kompleks målgruppe
  • gode og dygtige kollegaer, som passer på hinanden
  • fast onboardingprogram med mentor for nyansatte
  • faglig udvikling og sparring med vores psykolog
  • en arbejdsplads, som er nysgerrig, innovativ og udviklende, og som du kan være med til at præge
  • supervision – både intern, ekstern og individuelt ved behov
  • kurser og uddannelse i relevante tilgange og metoder
Ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter overenskomst for pædagogisk personale. Den gennemsnitlige arbejdstid er 37 timer ugentligt, og du indgår i et vagtskema med dag- og aftenvagter samt weekendvagter (der er forskellige rul ift. weekendvagter, nogle arbejder næsten hver anden weekend og andre hver 3. weekend). Vagterne vil have varierende længde mellem 8 og 14 timer.

Ansættelsesstart snarest muligt.

title: Revenue Cycle Optimization Analyst

description:
Position Title

Revenue Cycle Optimization AnalystDays - Full TimeRemote

Position Summary / Career Interest:

Revenue Cycle Informatics is a specialty that integrates revenue cycle operations, computer science, and information science to manage and communicate data, information, knowledge, and process insights. This role reports to the Revenue Cycle Advanced Technology Hub leadership team. The position requires foundational informatics skills to support system value through accuracy, compliance, operational efficiency, automation, and user experience. The analyst applies workflow design, and process optimization principles to improve revenue cycle performance. Responsibilities include developing standards and best practices, ensuring staff efficiency, and aligning operational needs with upcoming technology. The analyst partners cross-functionally across departments, incorporating automation and AI opportunities, and promotes system adoption through effective collaboration and communication. The goal of this role is to use informatics knowledge to drive measurable improvements in revenue cycle outcomes, ensuring optimized workflows, improved interoperability, and financial performance.Responsibilities and Essential Job Functions
  • Standards and Workflow Design: Develops and maintains revenue cycle standards and best practices for technology use, documentation, and process execution. Designs and optimizes workflows to improve accuracy, efficiency, compliance, and staff productivity. Ensures workflows align with Epic best practice, organizational policies, and operational needs.
  • Analysis and Optimization: Demonstrates foundational analysis skills. Analyzes current workflows against desired future state to identify opportunities for process assessment and optimization. Applies data analysis concepts to support automation, AI integration, and informed decision-making. Completes root cause analysis for performance issues and recommends solutions that enhance operational and financial outcomes.
  • Cross-Functional and Stakeholder Collaboration: Serves as the centralized intake and initial point of contact for revenue cycle informatics requests or issue investigation for assigned areas. Works cross-functionally with stakeholders across the revenue cycle to ensure alignment between operational requirements and technology solutions. Facilitates collaboration to support successful system adoption.
  • Automation, AI, and Technology Alignment: Identifies and implements opportunities for automation and AI to improve staff efficiency, reduce manual work, and optimize workflows. Aligns operational needs with upcoming technology advancements and revenue cycle roadmap initiatives.
  • Performance Monitoring and Documentation: Monitors the performance of implementations to ensure intended outcomes are achieved. Maintains comprehensive documentation of workflows, standards, system changes, and configuration updates.
  • Quality, Compliance, and Best Practice: Ensures workflows and processes meet regulatory requirements, billing compliance, payer guidelines, and quality initiatives. Applies continuous process improvement methodologies to foster operational excellence. Conducts usability reviews to identify and address workflow inefficiencies and promote Epic best practice adoption.
  • Usability and Change Management: Observes end users to identify opportunities to improve the system or user knowledge, promoting greater adoption and efficiency. Leads non–enterprise-wide change requests from initiation to completion, ensuring stakeholder engagement and end user readiness. Supports pre- and post-implementation education efforts to drive adoption of changes.
  • Professional Growth and Knowledge: Maintains and expands knowledge of Epic best practice, revenue cycle operations, automation, AI, and informatics industry trends. Participates in training, self-study, and cross-departmental learning opportunities to advance skills and support organizational strategic goals.
  • Distributed Build: Responsible for limited build through the distributed build program after trained and/or certified as appropriate for the software supported.
  • Process Adherence: Complies with defined framework for system implementation for developing, reviewing, approving and disseminating changes.
  • Information System Knowledge: Applies basic understanding of the technical capabilities of our current systems to facilitate end user education and customization. Obtains required application training and demonstrates competency. Uses resources available to further enhance knowledge deficits.
  • Must be able to perform the professional, clinical and or technical competencies of the assigned unit or department.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Help shape the future of cloud engineering for critical public services that support individuals, businesses and the wider UK economy.

The Insolvency Service, in partnership with Inspire People, is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer with expertise in Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, platform engineering and cloud operations to help drive the organisation's transition to a fully in-house DevOps capability. Based in Birmingham, Cardiff, Edinburgh, Exeter, Ipswich, Leeds, Manchester, Newcastle or Nottingham on a permanent SEO appointment, this role offers hybrid working (60% in office over a month), a salary of £48,429 to £52,222 (national), plus a discretionary Recruitment & Retention allowance of up to £11,000.

Building the Future of DevOps at the Insolvency Service

Digital Services has recently transitioned from a third-party DevOps model to an in-house engineering capability. As part of the Insolvency Service's wider technology modernisation programme, you'll help standardise and consolidate the technology estate, improve engineering practices, and build secure, resilient cloud platforms that support key public services. This is an opportunity to influence the future direction of DevOps across the organisation while working with modern Azure technologies at enterprise scale.

As a Senior DevOps Engineer you will:

  • Provide technical leadership and subject matter expertise across Microsoft Azure
  • Build, maintain and optimise Infrastructure as Code solutions and CI/CD pipelines
  • Improve monitoring, observability and operational performance across digital services
  • Ensure the security, stability and availability of production and non-production environments

Essential skills for the Senior DevOps Engineer include:

  • Possess extensive experience in a similar role using Microsoft Azure
  • Possess significant CI/CD experience using Azure DevOps (ADO)/Team Foundation Server (TFS)
  • Have extensive experience creating, maintaining and monitoring both Azure PaaS and IaaS resources
  • Have demonstrable experience of running multiple applications in multiple environments in a large enterprise
  • Have experience is writing and maintaining bicep IaC at an expert level
  • Have an active Security Clearance or be committed to gaining clearance within the first 6 months of joining

Desirable skills for the Senior DevOps Engineer include:

  • Using Terraform to build, manage and maintain infrastructure as code
  • Working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 environments or integrations
  • Using PowerShell to automate deployment, configuration, monitoring or operational tasks
  • Developing or supporting applications using C#/.NET
  • Working with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate or related services

In return, you can expect a flexible working culture, including:

  • Hybrid and flexible working arrangements
  • Civil Service pension with employer contributions of 28.97%
  • 25 days annual leave, increasing to 30 days with service
  • Public holidays plus additional privilege leave
  • Five days paid learning and development leave annually
  • Cycle to Work scheme
  • Employee Assistance Programme and wellbeing support services
  • Ongoing training, career development and progression opportunities

Why Join The Insolvency Service?

This is a rare opportunity to join at a pivotal moment in the evolution of the Insolvency Service's technology function. You'll play a leading role in building a modern DevOps capability, influencing engineering standards, cloud strategy and platform operations across a major government organisation. Your work will directly support the delivery of resilient, secure and user-focused digital services relied upon across the UK.

title: Salgsassistent til Food og Nearfood - København S
description:
Salgsassistent til Food og Nearfood

Bilka ønsker at skabe tilfredse kunder og en fremragende indkøbsoplevelse for alle. Vi stræber efter at gøre hver dag speciel for vores kunder med formålet: Vi inspirerer til flere værdifulde øjeblikke. Gennem vores udvalg, konkurrencedygtige priser og engagerede medarbejdere skaber vi en indkøbsoplevelse, der både opfylder behov og bringer glæde. Er du begejstret for mode, sport og kvalitet? Og vil du være med til at skabe inspirerende og stilfulde oplevelser for Bilkas kunder? Så er du måske Bilkas næste salgsassistent i Food og Nearfood.

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

Som medarbejder i Bilka – uanset niveau – bliver du en del af et solidt fællesskab med gode kolleger. Du indgår i et team, hvor holdånden er høj, og du er en del af fællesskabet i hele butikken og virksomheden.

Du får værdifuld erfaring, som du kan tilføje dit CV. Du lærer at navigere i dagligdagen i en detailbutik, arbejde selvstændigt, men samtidig også samarbejde med dine kolleger, om de bedste løsninger.

Med vores digitale medarbejderapp har du altid din vagtplan ved hånden, samt adgang til informationer og personalegoder. Vi bestræber os på, at din vagtplan passer med eventuel studie og fritidsaktiviteter.

Som salgsassistent i Food og Nearfood bliver du mødt af en varieret arbejdsdag, hvor du håndterer forskelligartede opgaver, nogle alene og andre sammen med dit team.

I Food sikrer vi, at vi hver dag kan tilbyde alt hvad hjertet begærer for vores kunder. Vi har naturligvis alle klassikerne og basisvarerne, men vi har også en lang række spændende specialvarer, som vi er stolte af, og som kunderne sætter stor pris på. Vores udvalg er stort og inkluderer bl.a. brød og kager, slik og chokolade, konserves, dyremad, øl og vand, ligesom vi tilbyder vores kunder masser af økologi, vegetariske/veganske alternativer og produkter fri for gluten og sukker.

Nearfood dækker fx over læbestifter, neglelak, parfume, hårspænder og mange andre produkter til personlig pleje - såvel det nye og trendy som det velkendte og klassiske. Vi arbejder med et bredt sortiment, hvor der er produkter til enhver – uanset stil, alder og miljøholdninger.

Hvad bringer du med dig?

Vi leder efter dig der har en venlig og imødekommende personlighed. Og så er vi på udkig efter dig, som gerne giver dine kolleger en ekstra hånd, når I sammen leverer den fælles indsats, der skal til, for at I med stolthed kan tage godt imod kunderne i afdelingen. Med dit gode overblik tager du gerne ejerskab – og også lederskab, hvis der er behov for det.

Der kan være mange veje ind i jobbet, og vi er åbne overfor forskellighed. Derfor opfordrer vi kandidater med forskellige baggrunde til at søge.

Griber du chancen?

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send os din ansøgning med det samme gennem linket her på siden. Vi screener og kalder til samtaler løbende.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Bilka er et hypermarked i konstant vækst. Vi har en brændende ambition om at være den mest attraktive arbejdsplads i dansk detailhandel. Så grib chancen, realiser dit potentiale og få 9.500 motiverede kolleger, der slet ikke kan lade være med at udvikle og forbedre.

title: Vuggestuen i Højbjerggård søger pædagogisk personale!
description:
Vil du være en del af et børnehus med store udfoldelses- og udviklingsmuligheder?

Om jobbet

Vuggestuen i Børnehuset Højbjerggård søger pædagogisk personale, der har lyst til at blive en del af et omsorgsfuldt, nærværende og fagligt stærkt team. Vi arbejder med de yngste børn fra 0–3 år, og du får mulighed for at være med til at skabe pædagogiske rammer, der giver små børn en tryg og rolig start på livet i dagtilbud samt skabe et godt børneliv.

Vores børnetal stiger, og derfor har vi brug for flere omsorgsfulde hænder, der kan tage imod nye børn og være med til at skabe de bedste betingelser for børnenes opstart og trivsel.

Vi ligger i Holte, omgivet af skov med en naturskøn legeplads, som vi bruger aktivt i hverdagen. I vuggestuen arbejder vi med langsom pædagogik, hvor ro og nærvær er helt igennem grundlæggende. Derfor sætter vi TID af til fordybelse. Vores børn har brug for at møde nærværende voksne, der forstår deres verden og udvider den.

Derfor vil du komme til at arbejde med det vi kalder ø-tid og puljer, så du har mulighed for forberedelse udenfor for børnetiden. Det giver optimale forhold til, at reflektere fagligt om pædagogikken og til at være helt til stede, når du er sammen med børnene.

Vi arbejder med skemalagte stue-møder og ledelsesstyret supervision, så du får mulighed for at udvikle den pædagogiske praksis uden at stå med ansvaret alene.

Vi lykkes nemlig kun i fællesskab.

Om dig

Vi søger pædagogisk personale som har lyst til at være en nærværende og omsorgsfulde voksne for de yngste børn. Du skal kunne skabe trygge relationer, samarbejde med forældrene om deres barns trivsel og udvikling.

Du har en menneskevenlig tilgang til forældre og kollegaer.

Du skal kunne oversætte børnenes følelsesmæssige signaler til pædagogisk handling. Det er vigtigt for os, at du kan lide at være helt nede på gulvet, lege, være til stede og skabe en hverdag, hvor børnene mærker ro, glæde og omsorg.

Omsorg er helt central i dit læringssyn.

Om Højbjerggård

I Børnehuset Højbjerggård arbejder vi med Ø-tid, som giver mulighed for forberedelse og faglig refleksion udenfor børnetiden. Det sikrer kvalitet i arbejdet, da du vil kunne få tid til andet arbejde uden for børnetiden. Vi har et godt arbejdsmiljø og arbejder målrettet på at vedligeholde medarbejdernes trivsel og udvikling. Vores mantra i Højbjerggård er:

Fejl

Er

Justerbar

Læring

Uddannelse er en selvfølge - ikke et gode

Vi prioriterer at kompetenceudvikle alle vores pædagoger og pædagogmedhjælpere.

Om Rudersdal Kommune

I Rudersdal Kommune tror vi på, at vi kun lykkes i fællesskab. Derfor er det vores mål, at alle kommunens medarbejdere og ledere i alle opgaver - og i fællesskab - arbejder for at skabe bæredygtige løsninger, der giver værdi for borgerne, virksomheden og det samfund, vi er en del af. Se vores film om Rudersdal Kommunes strategi og værdier ”Vi lykkes kun i fællesskab” HER

Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuldtid og start snarest muligt. Ansættelse sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

Ansøgning, samtale og kontakt

Du søger jobbet ved at klikke på knappen "Søg stilling" nedenfor.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Center PhysICS and OT Health
location: Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Austin, TX, USA; Addison, TX, USA; Kirkland, WA, USA; New York, NY, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Seattle, WA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
description:
The Infrastructure Development and Delivery (ID2) team designs, builds and operates many gigawatts of reliable, efficient, flexible data centers around the world. Our data centers are the foundation of all Google services and infrastructure, from classic servers and networking to bespoke storage and advanced AI hardware. Google data centers lead the industry in efficiency and carbon footprint, and regularly introduce innovative new technologies and approaches in our quest for the ideal data center portfolio.

Google's Data Center Operations team acts as the stewards of the physical infrastructure that powers the world’s information. We operate the mechanical, electrical, and control systems that keep our servers running 24/7/365.

Data Center Central Ops is the global operational governance, engineering support, and business operations team, supporting efficient growth and operation of Google’s data center fleet.

As the Senior Program Manager for Data Center Physical Infrastructure Controls Security (PhysICS) and OT Health, you will lead the strategic operational programs keeping Infrastructure Development and Delivery power and cooling engines running safely, securely, and reliably 24x7. You will be a people manager responsible for hiring, coaching, and developing a globally distributed team of senior Technical Program Managers, Program Managers, and Operations Engineers.

You will act as principal strategic liaison between Central Operations, Plant Engineering, local site teams, and security governance organizations including Compliance, Strategy, and Risk Management (CSRM), Operational Technology Security (OTS) and Cloud CISO Security Engineering (CCSE). Your mission is to define the strategic roadmap to verifiably reduce cybersecurity risk on mission-critical Infrastructure Controls Security (ICS) and Operational Technology (OT), effectively hardening standard OT environments against IT-based threats.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $240000 - $333000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Define, articulate, and execute the multi-year strategic roadmap for OT Health and PhysICS security hygiene, tailoring program priorities to anticipate emerging cybersecurity threats and business constraints.
  • Manage, coach, and scale a high-performing, globally distributed team. Guide them through ambiguous, high-stakes, and highly complex technical bottlenecks, leveraging data-driven insights to unblock migrations and maintain strict security SLOs.
  • Oversee the deployment, sustainment, and life cycle of critical security boundaries (e.g., Next Generation Infrastructure Controls Network and upgrading our hardware and software solution to secure ICN networks and devices).
  • Direct programs auditing and monitoring data center OT equipment configurations, PLC updates, OTHP virtualization, and asset inventory completeness to proactively drive reliability and reduce mean time to repair.
  • Serve as the central operational custodian bridging communication pathways between upstream security and design teams and downstream local operational stakeholders.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in program management.
  • 7 years of experience in leadership roles with/without direct reports.
  • Experience in risk management, and domain authority in OT cybersecurity.
  • Experience automating legacy workflows and migrating legacy systems onto centrally managed virtualization platforms (e.g., Kubernetes).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Engineering Management, or an MBA.
  • Certification in CSSA, GICSP, GRID, CISSP, or equivalent.
  • 10 years of experience managing cross-functional/team projects.
  • Deep knowledge of Google Plan of Record (gPOR) infrastructure topologies, Purdue model compliance, or advanced zero-trust network architectures.
  • Practical understanding of SCADA architectures, Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), and Facilities Network Routing.
  • Sound understanding of vendor management, OpEx/CapEx budgets, and headcount allocation.

title: Volleyball Specialist Brooklyn
description:
ABOUT US

New York Edge is the largest provider of after-school and summer camp programs in New York City public schools. Each year, academic programs, including STEM, the arts, sports and wellness, and college access, help 40,000 students develop leadership skills and succeed in school. Working parents count on our programs to provide safe and enriching environments for their children.

SUMMARY

New York Edge is seeking passionate and enthusiastic people to fill the role of Volleyball Specialist. In this role, you will be critical in providing targeted, skill- and age-appropriate instruction, coaching, and mentorship to youth in New York Edge’s after-school day camp programs. Volleyball Specialists organize and lead physical activity programming at their site, ensuring the safety of all program participants.


WORK SCHEDULE

  • 9-15 hours per week.

  • Monday through Friday -- 2:30 pm - 5:30 pm


WORK SITE LOCATION

  • 956 E 82nd St, Brooklyn, NY 11236


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Motivate students to be active daily.

  • Ensure daily activity lesson plans and projects are structured, age-appropriate, and have clear learning goals based on the provided sports and physical activity guide.

  • Maintain communication with the Program Director and Center for Sports and Wellness regarding the calendar of programs, leagues, tournaments, and special events.

  • Motivate and encourage students to participate in organization-wide sports activities.

  • Establish and enforce safety rules for behavior and procedures for maintaining order among the students for whom they are responsible.

  • Instruct participants on the activities' principles, techniques, and safety procedures and show how to use materials and equipment properly.

  • Establish clear objectives for all lessons, units, and projects, and communicate those objectives to students.

  • Prepare facilities for group activities.

  • Evaluate activities to determine if they are producing the desired results.

  • Adapt teaching methods and instructional materials to meet students' needs and interests.

  • Promote and ensure the progressive development of student skills and character development in all youth.

  • Most New York Edge Sports Specialists are expected to provide support during Academic hours.

  • Adapt each activity to ensure safe participation in the space provided.


REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Must be knowledgeable and skilled in Volleyball and have prior experience successfully teaching and instructing youth.

  • Prior experience teaching and instructing youth preferred

  • Must be able to follow a curriculum

  • Must be responsible, reliable, and punctual!

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are required.

  • May be required to walk up and down stairs.

  • May have to lift or move objects/materials as needed.

  • Work is performed mostly within a New York City Public School but may be required to interact with the community at-large during trips or events.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent required; some college preferred

  • A minimum of one year of work-related skill, knowledge, or experience is required.

  • A minimum of one year of teaching experience is required.

  • Must have passion for New York Edge's mission and demonstrated interest in education and youth development.

  • Candidates qualified to lead instruction in more than one activity are also preferred.


The Volleyball Specialist will be required to report to the school building and interact with staff, students, parents, and school administration.

At the time of offer and acceptance, the job requires safety and security clearances through the Department of Education and Department of Health.
