description:
As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world. Google Research is building the next generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. To achieve this, we’re working on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software developers and research scientists. Google Research teams collaborate closely with other teams across Google, maintaining the flexibility and versatility required to adapt new projects and foci that meet the demands of the world's fast-paced business needs.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Define and drive research directions in AI and computer vision that push the boundaries of real-time 3D telepresence.
  • Formulate novel approaches to open problems, translating fundamental research insights into transformative product experiences.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across hardware, software, and product to shape the technical direction and roadmap.
  • Conduct rigorous experiments to validate hypotheses, de-risk new technical directions, and inform strategic decisions through prototypes and data-driven evaluations.
  • Publish and present research and represent Google in the broader research community.

Minimum qualifications:

  • PhD in Computer Science, or a related field, with a focus on computer vision, machine learning, or computer graphics, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in Python and deep learning frameworks (e.g., JAX, Flax, Gemma, or Pytorch)
  • One or more scientific publication submission(s) for conferences, journals, or public repositories (such as CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, SIGGRAPH etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Research experience with track record in one or more of: neural rendering, generative models, 3D reconstruction, video models, or real-time vision systems.
  • Experience building real-time AI or computer vision systems with strict latency and performance constraints, especially on edge devices or resource-constrained hardware.
  • Experience tech-leading a team, including setting research roadmaps, mentoring researchers, and driving technical decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous program goals into staged milestones and deliver end-to-end from research concept to shipped product.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Parks Trades and Grounds Worker II - City
description:
PAY AND FAIR LABOR STANDARDS ACT (FLSA) STATUS:

Pay Range: 414

Hourly Rate: $22.65 - $35.06

Annual Rate: $47,293.20 - $73,205.28

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

The normal starting pay for this position is the minimum of the pay range listed above. A higher rate of pay may be considered, dependent on the qualifications and experience of the selected applicant and/or the City’s step placement policy.

ELIGIBILITY LIST PREFERENCE ORDER

Full-time City employees will receive preference in the following order: major division first, then department, then all other full-time City employees. Part-time/year-round City employees will receive preference next. If there are no qualified full-time City employees or part-time/year-round City employees, external applicants will then be considered (when the vacancy is open to external applicants).

APPLICATION, HIRING, AND BACKGROUND

  • When completing the application, applicants will be asked to respond to application questions. These application questions are based on the Job Requirements for the position.
  • Completion of the application questions is required.
  • Applicant responses to the application questions must specifically answer the questions asked.
  • Responses to application questions must be supported by work history/information listed on the application/resume, sufficient to demonstrate qualifications for the position.
  • Applicants may upload only two attachments. Attachments may include, but are not limited to a resume, cover letter, DD214 or NGB Form 22, transcripts, etc. Applicants may also choose to combine documents into one field for upload.
  • Applications may not be reviewed if specific responses to application questions have not been provided.
  • Each application submission is reviewed independently.

For detailed information about the City’s hiring and background processes, check out the: Quick Guide to Hiring and Background Checks

If you have questions, check out the: Frequently Asked Questions

TOTAL REWARDS

At the City of Oklahoma City, our Total Rewards package is designed to honor your service, fuel your growth, and support every part of your life. We offer:

  • Competitive pay
  • An average of $22,000 annually contributed toward your benefits and retirement
  • A comprehensive package designed to support your health and wellness, financial security, work-life balance, and personal and professional growth and development

Explore all the ways we invest in you: City of Oklahoma City Total Rewards

POSITION DESIGNATION

This job classification has been designated as a safety sensitive job classification in accordance with the Oklahoma Medical Marijuana and Patient Protection Act, 63 O.S., § 427.1 et seq. This means employees in this job classification can be subject to disciplinary action up to and including termination if they test positive for marijuana components or metabolites, even if they possess a medical marijuana license.

JOB SUMMARY

This posting will be used to fill a current vacancy in the Grounds Management Division of the Parks and Recreation Department within the City of Oklahoma City. An eligibility list will be established or supplemented for filling future vacancies per provisions of the American Federation of State, County and Municipal Employees (AFSCME) Collective Bargaining Agreement. An employee in this classification may work alone, as a crew member, or perform as a temporary lead worker to complete the assigned tasks. The primary responsibility of the Parks Trades and Grounds Worker II is to perform journey-level carpentry, masonry/concrete finishing, painting, or welding duties.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Performing journey-level carpentry, masonry/concrete finishing, painting, or welding.
  • Performing chemical spraying of vegetation.
  • Performing a range of tasks using equipment such as Interstate or boom mowers, slope mowers, boom sprayers, tractors with attachments, front-end loaders, skidders, backhoes, excavators, pickups, flatbeds, dump trucks, crack-filling machines, push mowers and lawn edgers.
  • Assuming responsibility for following all safety and maintenance procedures relating to the proper operation and condition of assigned equipment.
  • Assuming lead worker responsibilities, overseeing other employees, equipment, and ensuring the successful completion of projects.
  • Completing daily work orders, safety reports, and other job-related documentation.
  • Performing other duties as assigned.

VETERANS PREFERENCE

Honorably discharged veterans of the United States Active Duty Armed Forces, National Guard, and Reserve Forces who are not currently employed full-time by the City of Oklahoma City and who meet the qualifications for the position shall be given preference. To receive preference, veterans must submit verification of honorable discharge from the United States military service (Department of Defense Form DD214 or NGB Form 22) prior to the closing date of the vacancy announcement.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Possession of a valid Oklahoma Department of Agriculture Chemical Applicator License (category 3A).
  • Possession of a valid Class A Commercial Driver License (CDL).

NOTE: Employees will be required to possess or obtain a valid Class A Commercial Driver License within twelve (12) months as well as a valid Oklahoma Department of Agriculture Chemical Applicator License (category 3A) within six (6) months from the date of hire/promotion/transfer/demotion. Continued employment is contingent upon obtaining and maintaining both licenses within specified time frames.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES - GENERAL

  • Knowledge of and skill in using and operating various ground maintenance tools and equipment.
  • Knowledge of and skill in following safe working procedures and practices.
  • Knowledge of and skill in one or more of the required skills trades of a Park Trades and Grounds Worker II.
  • Skill in maintaining schedule demands and project quality.
  • Skill in making accurate measurements.
  • Skill in reading and following sketches, drawings, or blueprints.
  • Ability to estimate material and equipment needs.
  • Ability to follow oral and written instructions.
  • Ability to perform minor construction repairs such as concrete patching and replacement, wood repair, metal work, or repainting of different surface types.
  • Ability to operate multiple types of construction equipment such as skid steers, front loaders, backhoes, excavators, or other similar equipment.
  • Ability to work independently and with others.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES - CARPENTRY

  • Knowledge of and skill in operating, adjusting, and maintaining power operated carpentry tools and equipment on site and in a shop setting.
  • Knowledge of and skill in use of manually operated carpentry tools and equipment.
  • Knowledge of standard carpentry materials and supplies.
  • Skill in planning and completing carpentry projects.
  • Skill in repair of damaged picnic tables, park benches, signs, fences, etc.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES - MASONRY

  • Knowledge of and ability to follow procedures necessary to properly pour concrete.
  • Knowledge of and skill in following procedures for finishing concrete surfaces.
  • Knowledge of masonry materials and skill in using masonry tools.
  • Skill in determining proper mix and consistency of concrete.

COMPETENCIES

  • One City, One Team (Teamwork/Team Oriented) (1) Recognizes, values, and leverages the ideas, opinions, and perspectives of others; (2) participates willingly and effectively as a team lead or team member; (3) builds consensus; fosters team commitment, spirit, pride, and trust; (4) collaborates with others to accomplish goals and objectives and achieve results; (5) expresses facts, ideas, messages, and information (technical and non-technical) to individuals or groups clearly, concisely, accurately, understandably, with honesty, tact, and diplomacy and in a manner that is appropriate for the intended audience; (6) actively listens, clarifies information as needed; (7) [Core Value One City, One Team] shares information, resources and solutions across departments; (8) [Core Value One City, One Team] asks for help early and offers it often; (9) [Core Value One City, One Team] collaborates across teams before decisions are made.
  • Service First (Customer Centric) (1) Demonstrates commitment to public service; (2) serves and satisfies internal and external customers in a timely and effective manner; (3) establishes, commits to, and maintains high standards for producing quality work products and being responsive to customers; (4) supports the Department/City's mission; develops and executes strategies with the customer in mind; (5) [Core Value Service First] acts quickly and follows through until the job is complete; (6) [Core Value Service First] serves everyone with genuine respect, diligence and professionalism; (7) [Core Value Service First] makes decisions with the people we serve in mind.
  • Respect Always (Conduct) (1) Conducts oneself with the utmost integrity and professionalism; (2) demonstrates humility; (3) encourages people to share their perspectives, ideas, and opinions; (4) makes decisions based on a sense of shared purpose; (5) takes responsibility for actions and decisions; (6) resilient; (7) leans in to challenges and problems with creative solutions; (8) speaks up and challenges the status quo; (9) relies on the character, ability, strength, truth, and transparency of others and the organization; (10) [Core Value Respect Always] listens with curiosity and speaks with care; (11) [Core Value Respect Always] embraces different perspectives and lived experiences; (12) [Core Value Respect Always] gives feedback constructively and receives it openly.
  • Own the Outcome (Execution and Results) (1) Sets well-defined and realistic goals and high standards of performance for self or self and others; (2) displays a high level of initiative, effort, and commitment toward performing work; (3) completes assignments in a thorough, accurate, and timely manner, and delivers results; (4) works with minimal supervision, is motivated to achieve, and demonstrates responsible behavior; (5) demonstrates understanding of all aspects of the job (as specified on the approved job description) and application of accrued knowledge in carrying out duties and responsibilities; technical knowledge; skill in the techniques, equipment, procedures, and work required; (6) [Core Value Own the Outcome] takes initiative to fix it or escalates issues; (7) [Core Value Own the Outcome] follows through on commitments; (8) [Core Value Own the Outcome] speaks up when accountability is missing.
  • Keep Getting Better (Workplace Standards) (1) Takes meal periods and breaks according to policy; (2) ensures sick leave usage does not negatively impact productivity of work unit; (3) notifies supervisor of unscheduled absences; (4) accepts suggestions and supervision with a positive approach; (5) completes work timely and correctly; (6) [Core Value Keep Getting Better] takes time to reflect and act on what is working and what is not; (7) [Core Value Keep Getting Better] learns from mistakes without blaming; (8) [Core Value Keep Getting Better] supports self and other’s development and growth.
  • Safety (1) Complies with all safety policies and practices; (2) promotes a safe work environment; (3) participates in safety meetings; current on completion of safety trainings.

WORKING CONDITIONS - GENERAL

  • Inside and outside exposed to heat, cold, humidity, rain, etc.
  • Possibility of working in cramped or confined spaces and body positions.
  • Subject to working near or around moving equipment or traffic.
  • Subject to working around water, and/or slippery surfaces.
  • Subject to working an irregular work schedule, including weekends and holidays.

WORKING CONDITIONS - CARPENTRY

  • Frequent work on ladders or scaffolding four (4) to twelve (12) feet above ground level.
  • Possibility of working in cramped or confined spaces and body positions when working with ceiling structures.
  • Frequent work near moving machinery and power tools.
  • Exposed to pronounced strain or vibration when using power tools.
  • Exposed to intermittent or continued loud and insistent noises caused by power equipment.
  • Exposed to large amounts of dust in shops and at construction sites.
  • Possible exposure to chemical irritants such as contact cement, adhesives, and cleaning solutions.
  • Subject to working near electrical equipment.

WORKING CONDITIONS - MASONRY

  • Occasional work on ladders and scaffolding more than twelve (12) feet above ground.
  • Exposed to vibration due to use of jackhammers, cutting and demolition equipment.
  • Exposed to steady and loud noise of construction machinery.
  • Exposed to high concentrations of concrete dust.
  • Exposed to allergy-causing agents and cement.
  • Subject to working near moving objects such as traffic and machinery.
  • Subject to working in confined or cramped position such as in crawl spaces under bridge.

Note: Typical City employee working hours are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday. However, working hours vary (may require work to begin before 8:00 a.m. and/or end beyond 5:00 p.m., and/or may require work on weekends and holidays), and are subject to change, based on the duties and location of the position and the business needs of the assigned work unit/department.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS - GENERAL

  • Strength enough to lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 100 pounds.
  • Flexibility enough to bend, twist, and reach to load or unload materials and equipment.
  • Vision enough to read blueprints or drawings and to measure, etc.
  • Stamina enough to exert oneself physically throughout the workday.
  • Mobility enough to continually move one's body from place to place.
  • Speech enough to communicate clearly and distinctly in person and by two-way radio.
  • Hearing enough to understand a conversation in a noisy environment or communicate at a moderate distance.
  • Hearing enough to determine location of sounds and discriminate among various power tools and equipment sounds.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS - CARPENTRY

  • Strength enough to lift, carry, push, or pull materials weighing up to 80 pounds such as cement, plywood, lumber, doors, etc.
  • Balance enough to work from ladders, platforms, scaffolding, etc.
  • Arm-hand steadiness enough to use power and hand tools.
  • Near vision enough to read blueprints and drawings to measure and cut materials per specification.
  • Visual color discrimination enough to match grains of wood.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS - MASONRY

  • Strength enough to lift, carry, push, or pull objects weighing up to 100 pounds, such as cement bags.
  • Flexibility enough to bend, twist, or reach out to finish concrete with trowels or hand floats.
  • Balance and strength enough to remain upright when working on ladders or scaffolding.
  • Far vision enough to observe on-coming traffic.
  • Hearing enough to distinguish direction of sounds, such as moving traffic or equipment.

Note: The working conditions and physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

OTHER DETAILS

Eligibility List: An eligibility list will be established from this posting consisting of applicants who receive a score of 70 percent or better. Multiple selection procedures may be utilized; a minimum of 70 percent or better will be required on each; and the results of multiple selection procedures will be equally weighted. The eligibility list will be in effect for 90 days from the date of the final selection procedure and will be used to fill future vacancies.

Pay Method: City employees are required to receive pay electronically, either via direct deposit or pay card.

Former Employees: If this position is open to external applicants and you are a former employee, you must be eligible for rehire to participate in any selection process. If you are unsure of your rehire status, please contact the Human Resources Department at (405) 297-2530. If your rehire status has been coded “Not Eligible,” “Eligible 3,” or “Conditional,” you will need to request a review of your rehire status through the Human Resources Department’s Employee and Labor Relations Division.

Background Investigation, Drug Testing, Physical Examination: Upon a conditional offer of employment/acceptance of position, the City of Oklahoma City will conduct a criminal history background check for external applicants. Applicants will be provided contact information for any third-party reporting agencies used to collect background information in connection with conditional offers of employment.

If the position accepted includes a driver license (commercial or non-commercial) Job Requirement, the City of Oklahoma City will obtain a Motor Vehicle Report for internal and external applicants.

If the position accepted is safety sensitive and/or a driving position, internal and external applicants will be provided a copy of the City of Oklahoma City's Drug and Alcohol Testing Policy prior to being directed for a drug test. A copy is also available at the link below:

AFSCME CBA Addendum C: Drug and Alcohol Testing Policy

If the position accepted is cyber security sensitive, internal and external applicants will be subject to a Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Interstate Identification Index (III) Fingerprint Background check. Additionally, employees in this job classification must complete Level 4 Security Awareness Training and pass an online certification test.

If the position accepted includes a lift/push/pull/carry Physical Requirement of 25 pounds and greater, internal and external applicants will be directed for a physical examination.

AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

If you require reasonable accommodation at any time during the hiring process, please notify one of the Human Resources Department Representatives by calling 405-297-2530. The City of Oklahoma City will not discriminate against any applicant or employee because of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, actual or perceived sexual orientation, and gender identity and/or expression), national origin, age, disability (mental or physical) and genetic information (including family medical history).

title: Re-integratieconsultant Leeuwarden (Freelance / ZZP)
description:
Vacature Re-integratieconsultant ZZP / Freelance regio Leeuwarden

Als Freelancer bij Staatvandienst ben je verantwoordelijk voor een aantal van onze loopbaantrajecten en werk je vanuit het Staatvandienst DNA. Wij helpen mensen bij loopbaanvraagstukken zoals; talentontwikkeling, outplacement en re-integratie (1e spoor en 2e spoor). In alle gevallen is jouw rol als freelance Loopbaanadviseur cruciaal voor onze kandidaten als het gaat om persoonlijke ontwikkeling, duurzame inzetbaarheid en organisatorische veranderingen.

Jij ziet in ieder persoon kansen en weet samen met de kandidaat deze kansen te vertalen in concrete doelstellingen en acties. Je geeft inzicht in hun persoonlijke talenten en laat ze zien waar hun ontwikkelpunten liggen. Dit doe je door het toepassen van de verschillende methodieken, waar de kandidaat mee in beweging wordt gezet. In het traject wordt er gekeken naar de mogelijkheden op de arbeidsmarkt, waarbij een juiste ‘fit’ voor de kandidaat het belangrijkst is.

Waar houd je je als Loopbaanadviseur (ZZP) mee bezig?

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor een (fluctuerend) aantal trajecten;

  • Bellen met opdrachtgevers om die juiste fit te vinden voor je kandidaat is een must, hoe groter je netwerk hoe makkelijker het is;

  • Je motiveert en activeert kandidaten door ze de juiste tools te geven, de zowel op onze spreeklocaties als via Teams en telefoon vanuit huis;

  • Ons doel? Mensen begeleiden naar (duurzaam) werk. Dit kan door het werkfit maken van een kandidaat of iemand begeleiden in zijn zoektocht naar een nieuwe baan;

  • Gezien het gevarieerde takenpakket schakel jij moeiteloos tussen de rol van adviseur, coach en netwerker en draait je hand niet om voor een rapportage.

Wie ben jij?

Wij zijn op zoek naar een freelance collega die denkt in kansen en doelgericht kan werken. Jij bent sociaal in elk opzicht en weet dit ook in te zetten binnen de commercie. Daarnaast haal jij energie uit het vinden van de juiste fit voor je kandidaten, waarbij de opdrachtgever en het commercieel belang niet uit het oog verloren wordt. Je bent een echte netwerker en een stevige gesprekspartner als het gaat om arbeidsmobiliteit.

Verder:

  • Heb je HBO werk- en denkniveau;

  • Heb je aantoonbare ervaring in onze branche, bijvoorbeeld als re-integratie consulent, loopbaanadviseur of loopbaancoach. Je werkt voor jezelf en je bent ingeschreven bij de KVK.

  • Voor deze vacature is het van belang dat je beschikbaar bent voor minimaal 20 uur, in verband met de caseload;

  • Je woont in de omgeving van Leeuwarden;

  • Een eigen auto en rijbewijs is een must in verband met het bezoeken van klanten en spreeklocaties;

  • Komt jouw werkwijze overeen met de werkwijze van Staatvandienst en pas je in het Staatvandienst team.

Waarom werken bij Staatvandienst?

Staatvandienst begeleidt kandidaten bij het maken van belangrijke keuzes in hun loopbaanpad. Onze consultants geloven ‘dat er altijd meer in mensen zit, dan zij er zelf uithalen’. Als organisatie zijn wij constant vernieuwend, hebben we verstand van zaken en hanteren we een grondige aanpak. Samenwerkend met plezier en aandacht voor elkaar en voor de mensen die wij begeleiden. Kandidaten leren dat zij zelf de regie hebben op hun loopbaan, of zoals zij zeggen: ‘”Je loopbaan, dat ben jij!” Naast hard werken zijn we bij Staatvandienst ook dol op gezellige feestjes (als het straks weer kan). Ons motto: #samenmakenweerwerkvan!

Wij werken met een Freelance overeenkomst op basis van 50/50.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Online
description:
**About The Job

**Flatpay has become one of the fastest-growing payment companies by helping merchants accept payments in-store. Now we're taking the next step.

Online is one of Flatpay's newest and most strategic engineering domains. We're building the products and platforms that enable merchants to accept payments online and grow their businesses in the digital economy.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll play a key role in defining the technical direction of Flatpay's online platform and helping establish the technical and architectural foundations that will support the next phase of Flatpay's growth.

This is a unique opportunity to join at an early stage. While Flatpay already serves merchants at scale, our online platform is still in its early stages. You'll have the opportunity to help launch new solutions, shape how the platform evolves as adoption grows, and learn directly from customers along the way.

If you enjoy building products from the ground up, working close to customers, and seeing your work evolve from first launch to large-scale adoption, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact in a domain that will play an important role in Flatpay's future growth.

**What You'll Do

**

  • Design and build scalable systems that power online payments and commerce experiences
  • Lead feature and platform initiatives involving multiple engineers, driving delivery from discovery through production
  • Take ownership of features from design and implementation through deployment and maintenance
  • Drive architectural decisions and long-term technical improvements
  • Build APIs, services, and integrations that enable online payment experiences
  • Improve reliability, observability, performance, and security across the platform
  • Partner with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to drive technical and product outcomes
  • Mentor engineers through coaching, code reviews, and knowledge sharing
  • Help establish engineering standards and best practices as the Online domain continues to grow

**Who You Are

**

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong experience designing and operating distributed systems
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects involving multiple engineers and influence architectural decisions
  • Experience building scalable backend platforms and APIs
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and helping shape new products and systems
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Experience within payments, fintech, e-commerce, SaaS, or high-scale transaction systems is a plus

You'll be working with technologies such as the following.

We don't expect experience with every technology listed below. We're looking for engineers who can learn quickly and help us build great products.

**Backend

**

  • Java, Spring Boot
  • MySQL
  • REST APIs & Event-Driven Architecture
  • Domain Driven Design
  • Docker, AWS

**Frontend

**

  • TypeScript
  • React
  • TanStack Query
  • Jest
  • Playwright
  • i18n, feature flags

**Platform & Delivery

**

  • GitHub Actions
  • CI/CD
  • AWS ECS
  • Observability & Monitoring

**Why Flatpay?

**As part of our team, you'll join 2,000+ passionate Flatpayers dedicated to shaping the future of payments.

You'll help build a strategic new business area from the ground up, working on products that directly connect merchants and consumers while shaping the future of online payments at Flatpay.

We offer an inclusive environment where engineers are trusted with ownership and encouraged to make an impact.

Our engineering teams work together from our Copenhagen office. We believe that close collaboration, quick feedback loops, and solving problems side-by-side help us build better products, move faster, and create a stronger engineering culture.

We also provide plenty of perks including free slush ice, an on-site gym, a fully equipped gamer room, and much more.

If you're ready to help build and scale the future of payments, we'd love to hear from you.

Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?

title: 2027 - CRM Engineering Intern, Gurugram
description:
We’re seeking a CRM Engineering Intern to help build and improve the Salesforce platform that supports MongoDB’s global Sales organization. You’ll work with experienced engineers and product partners to create scalable CRM capabilities that streamline customer interactions and support business growth.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, test, and document Salesforce features using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative tools, with guidance from senior engineers.
  • Collaborate with product managers and business partners to improve CRM usability and support Sales, Customer Success, and Partner teams.
  • Help debug, deploy, and maintain scalable solutions; participate in peer reviews and design discussions.
  • Take part in Agile ceremonies, including standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
  • Research Salesforce releases, AppExchange solutions, automation, and AI-enabled development tools, and share ideas for improving the platform.

What we are looking for in you

  • In the process of receiving a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Have a minimum of one quarter/semester remaining in university studies after the internship concludes.
  • Interested in Salesforce engineering, CRM platforms, or business systems integration.
  • Bring a problem-solving mindset and curiosity about how technology supports business processes.
  • Communicate clearly, collaborate well, and are eager to learn in a dynamic environment.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or another CRM system is a plus.
  • Understanding of databases, APIs, or data integration concepts is a plus.

What you’ll find at MongoDB

  • Authentic Culture: A workplace where you are encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We believe embracing the power of differences broadens perspectives and fosters innovation.
  • Personalized Mentorship: A mentor, a Program Advisor from the Early Talent Recruitment Team, and an Employee Resource Group (ERG) Guide to support your growth.
  • Career Coaching Sessions: A tailored training program designed for interns’ personal and professional development.
  • Work-Life Harmony: “Bloom for Interns,” with access to mental and physical health benefits, paid time off, free lunch, and more.
  • Impactful Projects: Contribute to meaningful work that makes an impact.
  • Exclusive Networking: Join Speaker Series and Roundtables with executives and department leaders.
  • Vibrant Community: Connect with fellow interns through social events, virtual gatherings, and local activities.
  • Path to Full-Time: Explore a longer-term future at MongoDB, with the possibility of receiving a full-time offer at the end of the summer.

MongoDB internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 10 consecutive weeks, from June through August. Interns follow the “in office” working model and are expected to be in their office location 3–5 days a week.

Because we receive a high volume of applications, it may take up to six weeks to hear back about your application status. We aim to respond sooner and appreciate your patience as we carefully review each application.

About Us

MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. We help organizations of all sizes build, scale, and run modern applications by modernizing legacy workloads, supporting innovation, and enabling AI. Our developer data platform, MongoDB Atlas, is a globally distributed, multi-cloud database available in more than 115 regions across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Atlas allows customers to build and run applications anywhere—on premises or across cloud providers. With offices worldwide and more than 175,000 new developers signing up to use MongoDB every month, leading organizations such as Samsung and Toyota trust MongoDB to build next-generation, AI-powered applications.

MongoDB is committed to providing necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities during the application and interview process. To request an accommodation, please inform your Early Talent Recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: QA/QC Engineer
description:
Location: Imus,Calabarzon,Philippines

The QA/QC Engineer will be responsible for designing quality standards, inspecting materials, equipment, processes, and products, developing quality control systems, and determining corrective actions to ensure specific quality standards are constantly met at all levels of construction projects.

You must be willing to relocate to any of our project sites.

Key responsibilities:

  • Prepare QA/QC plans for new construction and refurbishment work
  • Ensure the establishment of quality procedures including time limits for inspection, sampling and testing of works and other QA/QC requirements
  • Oversee and manage the quality assessment of materials through regular and rigid laboratory tests
  • In consultation with the project staff, review technical specifications and recommend standard construction specifications for all items of works for their effective use in projects’ works
  • Review all standard test forms to be used during laboratory tests, QA testing schedules and procedures and evaluate results as appropriate
  • Review contractor practices and conventional methodologies and make recommendations where remedial action is required
  • Work with project engineers and design consultants for establishing procedures with time limits for the inspection, sampling and testing of works and all other QA/QC requirements
  • Conduct initial survey queries on sources to materials, ensuring quality and quantity is of economic value to the project
  • Performs other responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate.

Qualifications To be successful in the role:

  • Licensed Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in large infrastructure projects.
  • Preferably with Construction Quality Management (CQM) for Contractors certification.
  • Minimum 5 years of onsite construction quality assurance and construction safety surveillance experience on a commercial or military infrastructure project.
  • Demonstrated experience in pre-stressing works and quality control, and experience in different classes of concrete mix-design, under different conditions of construction procedures.
  • Excellent English in written and verbal communication skills.
  • With a valid driver’s license.

Why Planate?

Planate Management Group South East Asia Corp (PMG SEAC) is a multi-disciplinary team of highly skilled and experienced professionals dedicated to providing comprehensive support to our clients. Our mission is to deliver the highest quality and most cost-efficient business support services, contributing to the success of our clients and their organizations globally. We strive to become one of the most reliable and trusted providers of business support services.

Joining the Planate team opens you to an experience working for a Global company where you are among a team that is considered a premier trusted partner for planning, design, engineering, asset management, and professional service solutions anytime, anywhere. We Take Care of Our Own; Personally and Professionally, Up and Down The Line.

We’d love for you to be a part of our Global workforce, helping us serve as an effective and integrated partner to advance every client's mission!

title: Online Data Analyst - Spanish (ES)
description:
TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. As an Online Data Analyst, you will use your knowledge of Spain, together with online research and project guidelines, to review and evaluate map, location, business, and search information. This is a remote, flexible independent contractor opportunity designed for people who can participate regularly each week when tasks are available.

A Day in the Life of an Online Data Analyst

﻿

In this role, you will verify, evaluate, and validate geographic and business information using advanced mapping tools and detailed reference materials.

You may work on a variety of tasks, including:

  • Review and verify map, business, address, and location information
  • Research information using online maps, search engines, directories, and reliable sources
  • Compare information from different sources and determine which result is most accurate
  • Evaluate Spanish and English language search results and information
  • Follow detailed project guidelines when making decisions
  • Work across different task types such as Maps, Search/Relevance, Audio, etc.
  • Provide accurate evaluations that help improve digital products and AI systems

Training materials, guidelines, and examples are provided.

Why Join the program?

  • Fully remote flexibility: Work from home using your own computer and a stable internet connection
  • Structured onboarding: Access comprehensive evaluation guidelines, detailed reference materials, and practical examples before your first live assessment
  • Regular feedback: Performance feedback can help you better understand project requirements and improve your quality and accuracy.
  • Ongoing participation: The project is best suited to contributors interested in participating regularly when tasks are available, rather than only completing occasional tasks.
  • Variety of tasks: Depending on project needs and your qualifications, you may have opportunities to work across different task types.
  • Responsive support team: Our contributor support team can assist with project guidelines, technical questions, and administrative topics.

Qualification path

  • Professional fluency in English and Spanish (native or near-native proficiency required)
  • Have lived in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years
  • In-depth regional, cultural, and geographic knowledge of Spain
  • Willingness to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to understand and apply project guidelines
  • Willingness to participate regularly each week when work is available
  • Stable internet connection and access to a personal computer

Qualification path

To join the project, you will:

  • Complete your contributor profile and submit a brief background overview
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Review the open-book study guide, examples, and evaluation guidelines
  • Complete an open-book qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials if successful

Service Rates

This is a task-based opportunity rather than an hourly-paid position.

Each task has an assigned rate based on its estimated completion time. Based on current task rates and estimated completion times, earnings are approximately equivalent to:

9 EUR per hour **This hourly equivalent is provided as an estimate only.

Actual earnings may vary depending on:

  • The type of tasks completed
  • The volume of available tasks
  • The number of tasks you choose to complete
  • Quality and productivity requirements
  • Your individual pace of work
  • Your level of regular participation

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis.

Contributors have flexibility in deciding when they participate and how much available work they choose to complete, subject to project availability, qualification requirements, and project quality standards.

While there is no fixed work schedule, the project is intended for contributors who can participate regularly and consistently when tasks are available.

This opportunity does not create an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

To apply, please reach us at by sending a copy of your CV along with the following details:

  • Year of Birth
  • Country Origin
  • Current Country of Residence
  • Native language and any additional languages spoken

title: Senior Data Developer
description:
Location: Montréal,Québec,Canada

About the role

AI Platform & Data Engineering builds and operates the data platform behind TS Imagine’s trading, risk, and AI capabilities.

The team brings external and internal data into Snowflake and maintains the shared engineering foundations used across the business: data ingestion, transformation, distribution, monitoring, data quality, regression testing, and production support. We work with complex financial datasets, including instrument reference data, pricing, common data, and corporate actions.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will own production data systems built with Snowflake, dbt, SQL, and Python. You will help modernize established pipelines, improve the platform’s shared capabilities, and contribute to the data and semantic foundations behind TSIQ, TS Imagine’s natural-language AI interface for intelligence and agentic workflows.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and operate pipelines that ingest, validate, transform, and distribute data from vendors, internal systems, APIs, and files.
  • Develop and maintain dbt models and Snowflake data structures supporting trading, risk, analytics, and operational workflows.
  • Build production Python for data ingestion, integrations, orchestration, and engineering tooling.
  • Improve the frameworks used for monitoring, data quality, regression testing, and incident diagnosis.
  • Build and maintain data models and semantic views used by downstream applications and AI interfaces.
  • Investigate production data issues, identify root causes, and implement lasting fixes.
  • Contribute to technical design, code review, engineering standards, and delivery practices.
  • Help other teams adopt effective approaches to building and operating data pipelines on the shared platform.

What we’re looking for

  • Five or more years of relevant data engineering experience, including ownership of production data systems.
  • Strong SQL skills, including data modeling, query design, performance awareness, and debugging complex transformations.
  • Strong Python skills and experience developing maintainable, tested, multi-module applications.
  • Hands-on production experience with Snowflake and dbt.
  • Experience integrating APIs, databases, flat files, or event-driven data sources.
  • Practical knowledge of data quality, monitoring, failure handling, and production support.
  • Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD.
  • Sound engineering judgment: able to balance delivery speed, system complexity, operating cost, and maintainability.
  • Interest in applying AI tools thoughtfully as part of the engineering workflow.

Useful experience, but not required

  • Financial-market data, including security master, instrument reference data, pricing, risk, or corporate actions.
  • Semantic modeling or governed analytics layers.
  • Asynchronous Python and API-heavy ingestion services.
  • Modernizing legacy pipelines or stored-procedure-based data systems.

About the team

AI Platform & Data Engineering is part of TS Imagine’s approximately 40-person AI & Data Engineering organization, with colleagues across North America, EMEA, and APAC. The wider group brings together data engineers, data scientists, quantitative engineers, AI engineers, data analysts, and data stewards.

The team works closely with product, risk, client service, and other engineering teams. Its role is both hands-on and enabling: operating core data capabilities while helping other teams build against them effectively.

Why TS Imagine?

  • Hybrid work model: four days in the Montreal office.
  • Unlimited vacation plus three personal days.
  • Annual bonus and salary review.
  • $1,500 annual training budget.
  • RRSP matching with a 3% company contribution.
  • Comprehensive health insurance.
  • Subsidized public transportation through Opus & Cie.
  • Work on production systems used by global capital-markets clients.

This is not a remote role. Applicants must be based in Montreal and able to communicate in French.

About TS Imagine

TS Imagine provides integrated trading, portfolio, and real-time risk solutions for capital markets. Formed from TradingScreen and Imagine Software, the company serves approximately 500 buy-side and sell-side institutions globally, including hedge funds, asset managers, pension funds, mutual funds, and financial institutions.

title: HAL - Stateroom Steward - UPL
description:

  1. High School Education
  2. Minimum 2 years of experience as Stateroom Steward or equivalent function in the hospitality Industry
  3. Preferred 1 years of shipboard experience as Stateroom Attendant or equivalent function.
  4. Needs to be physically able to carry at least 40 lbs.
  5. Able to work well and communicate effectively with both shipboard personnel.
  6. Ability to multi-task and handle constantly changing priorities.
  7. Basic Knowledge of public health and sanitation protocols related to staterooms.
Note: Other duties as assigned included and not limited to Health, Environmental, Safety and Security responsibilities.

title: Communication Specialist
description:
Are you an experienced communicator who knows how to turn complex messages into clear communication? Are you comfortable working closely with C-level and do you have experience with press relations? Then this could be the role for you.

Nobia Group is one of Europe’s largest kitchen specialists, listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, so if you are comfortable speaking and writing in Swedish, it is a big advantage. Nobia operates across the Nordic region with strong local brands including HTH, uno form, Invita, Sigdal, Marbodal and more.

At Nobia, we are looking for a Communication Specialist to join our team in Tilst, Copenhagen or Jönköping. This is a broad corporate communication role covering both internal and external communication, with close exposure to senior leadership and stakeholders across the Nordic organisation.

You will play an important role in shaping how Nobia communicates – from internal stories and leadership communication to press relations and corporate communication. In this role, you get to work both strategically and hands-on, always with the aim of turning complex topics into communication that is clear, relevant and engaging.


Your role

The role offers a broad scope, a high degree of ownership, and the opportunity to work across different communication disciplines rather than being limited to one channel or area.

As a trusted communication specialist, you are expected to identify opportunities and turn ideas into communication that makes an impact. You will work closely with leaders and colleagues, helping them identify the right messages, develop strong communication and ensure that it reaches the right audience through the right channels.

Your work will include:

  • External communication and press relations – Act as a contact for Danish media, build and maintain relationships with journalists, coordinate media responses and develop press releases.

  • Leadership communication – advice and support senior leaders with communication, including LinkedIn and CEO communication. You will also coordinate and facilitate Town Halls.

  • Internal communication – develop news, articles, campaigns and other content that keeps employees informed, engaged and connected across functions, countries and brands.

  • Change communication – support communication around organisational changes and business transformation, ensuring that complex information is translated into clear and relevant communication for the people affected.

  • Corporate communication – contribute to projects such as the annual report by identifying stories and angles, gathering content and coordinating input from stakeholders across the organisation.

  • Cross-functional communication – work closely with People & Culture, Marketing and Talent Acquisition, including supporting employer branding communication.

About you

You are an experienced communicator who enjoys being close to business and working with people at all levels of an organisation. You are curious and confident in your communication and comfortable taking ownership from idea to execution.

We expect that you:

  • Have relevant experience within corporate communication, preferably from a larger or international organisation. Experience from a listed company or a similar corporate environment is a strong advantage.

  • Have experience with press relations and media handling.

  • Are comfortable working closely with senior leaders and can advise and challenge when relevant.

  • Are proactive and self-driven. You naturally identify stories, opportunities and communication needs rather than waiting for them to come to you.

  • Can manage several different priorities at the same time and still deliver with quality and attention to detail.

  • Enjoy working across countries, functions and brands and are good at building relationships with different types of people.

  • Are an excellent writer in both Danish/Swedish and English, with a strong sense of language, tone, and audience.

  • A degree in communication, journalism or a related field is relevant for the role.


What we offer

You will join a professional and collaborative environment where communication plays an important role in supporting Nobia’s business and transformation. With a broad scope and a high degree of ownership, the role offers the opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and stakeholders across the Nordics and to make a visible impact on how Nobia communicates.

You will be based at our Nobia Denmark HQ in Tilst, Copenhagen or at our office in Jönköping in Sweden, where we offer a great lunch, social activities and events throughout the year. On top of that, you will experience a flexible working environment and plenty of opportunities to grow.


Curious to learn more?

If you are motivated by the opportunity to help shape communication in a Nordic, listed company and believe you can bring both strategic thinking and strong execution to the role, we would love to hear from you.

Please upload your CV and include a short motivation explaining why you are a good match for the position.

We interview candidates on an ongoing basis, so please send your application as soon as possible.

title: Vil du være med til at styrke den digitale tilstedeværelse for en organisation, der hver dag arbejder for at sikre børn en tryg opvækst?
company: DEN SELVEJENDE INSTITUTION SOS BØRNEBYERNE, DANMARK
description:
SOS Børnebyerne søger Senior Web Performance Manager

Hos SOS Børnebyerne søger vi en Senior Web Performance Manager, der kan tage ansvar for vores websites og sikre, at de skaber størst mulig værdi for organisationen og vores støtter. Du får en central rolle i udviklingen og optimeringen af vores digitale platforme med fokus på synlighed, brugeroplevelse, konverteringer og datadrevet optimering. Samtidig bliver du organisationens faglige ressource på web-området og skal bidrage til at styrke de digitale kompetencer på tværs af huset. Du bliver ansvarlig for at drive udviklingen af vores websites i tæt samarbejde med kolleger inden for fundraising, kommunikation og øvrige afdelinger. Vi ser web som både en kommunikations-, engagement- og indtægtsplatform, og du får stor indflydelse på, hvordan vi omsætter digitale muligheder til konkrete resultater. Dine ansvarsområder
  • Eje, drive og videreudvikle SOS Børnebyernes websites med fokus på stabil drift, optimering og brugeroplevelse.
  • Arbejde med SEO, GEO, AI-synlighed, CRO og analyse af brugeradfærd for at styrke trafik og konvertering.
  • Koordinere og prioritere udviklingsopgaver med interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere, samt bidrage til implementering, fejlretning og optimering af web- og kampagnesider.
  • Have ansvar for webtracking, datakvalitet, analyse og performance-rapportering.
  • Bidrage til integrationer mellem website, CRM og øvrige digitale platforme.
  • Drive webrelaterede projekter fra idé til implementering og sikre fremdrift på tværs af interessenter.
  • Rådgive kolleger, dele viden og styrke organisationens digitale kompetencer.
  • Skabe samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder for at udvikle fælles digitale løsninger.
Om dig Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt med drift, udvikling og optimering af websites.
  • Tidligere har skabt resultater igennem konverteringsoptimering og optimering af digitale brugerrejser.
  • Har solid erfaring med SEO og interesse for GEO.
  • Har solid erfaring med tracking og analyseværktøjer som GA4, GTM, Search Console, Clarity eller lignende, og kan bruge dem aktivt til webanalyse og forbedring af digital performance baseret på data.
  • Er en stærk projektleder, der skaber fremdrift og får projekter sikkert i mål.
  • Trives med hands-on opgaver og kan omsætte analyser og idéer til konkrete løsninger.
  • Har lyst til at dele viden og hjælpe kolleger med at lykkes digitalt.
Om os Vi tilbyder et job med mening i en organisation, der hver dag arbejder for at skabe en bedre fremtid for børn verden over. Du får engagerede kolleger med forskellige faglige baggrunde og bliver en del af et uformelt og anerkendende arbejdsmiljø, hvor samarbejde, dialog og udvikling er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vi lægger vægt på, at vores medarbejdere har en fornuftig balance mellem et meningsfuldt arbejdsliv og et velfungerende privatliv. Vi tilbyder derfor flekstid, mulighed for hjemmearbejde (1 dag pr. uge), frokostordning og firmapension med en attraktiv sundhedspakke. Vores kontor ligger centralt på Vesterbro, tæt på offentlig transport. Vi ønsker at være en arbejdsplads med lige muligheder for alle og arbejder aktivt for at fremme mangfoldighed og inklusion. Alle medarbejdere i SOS Børnebyerne skal efterleve vores Code of Conduct og retningslinjer for Safeguarding (beskyttelse mod overgreb, udnyttelse og anden uacceptabel adfærd), så vi sammen bidrager til et trygt og sikkert miljø for de børn, unge og familier, vi arbejder med. Det praktiske Forventet ansættelsesdato: 1. januar 2027. Arbejdstid: 37 timer pr. uge, inkl. ½ times frokostpause. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår: Stillingen er på specialkonsulentniveau. Aflønning sker i forhold til erfaringer og kvalifikationer og efter vores overenskomst med AC-organisationerne, HK og Dansk Journalistforbund. Arbejdssted: Amerikavej 15C, 2. sal, 1756 København V. Ansøgningsfrist: Tirsdag den 3. november 2026. Samtaler: Vi gennemfører to samtalerunder i hhv. uge 46 og 48 og anvender en personlighedsprofil og en case som del af rekrutteringsprocessen. Vil du vide mere Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte fundraisingchef Birgitte Bilde Noël på bno@sosbornebyerne.dk eller telefon 91 17 79 73. Ansøgning Lyder jobbet som noget for dig, og har du det vi søger, så send os en motiveret ansøgning sammen med dit CV. Vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge stillingen - uanset køn og kønsidentitet, seksuel orientering, etnisk baggrund, religion, funktionsnedsættelse eller alder. Vi træffer altid beslutning om ansættelse på baggrund af kvalifikationer, erfaring, kompetencer og organisationens behov.

title: Director, Strategic Services (Atlanta)
description:
Director, Strategic Services – WorkBoardAI

Remote - must be based in the Atlanta area

About WorkBoard

WorkBoard is the pioneer in AI-driven strategy execution solutions, empowering enterprises to align, measure, and achieve their most important outcomes. With our platform, organizations can operationalize strategy in real time, foster alignment across teams, and accelerate growth. Our customers include some of the world’s most innovative companies across technology, financial services, healthcare, and more.

We’re backed by top-tier investors and led by a diverse, mission-driven team that’s passionate about redefining how organizations execute strategy at scale. At WorkBoard, you’ll have the opportunity to join a fast-growing, category-defining company where your work directly impacts how leaders shape the future.

The Opportunity

The direct WorkBoard buyer is typically the CEO or GM of a business unit, and our platform is deployed to all employees under the P&L owner – giving the company an exceptionally large market opportunity.

As the Director of Strategic Services, this role presents a rare opportunity to see first-hand and influence how companies and teams formulate their strategic objectives, operationalize them to drive results, and make a tangible impact on employee engagement and business outcomes. You will form strategic advisor relationships with C-Level Executives, and coach their teams to define, communicate, and operationalize their results achievement.

You will play a pivotal role in making strategic priorities relevant and meaningful at every level of the organization, and being a trusted advisor from pre to post sales. Your results expertise will enable our customers to increase the business results they realize from the WorkBoard platform over time.

The Role

As the Director of Strategic Services, you will provide prospective and new customers with expert advice on how to better execute strategy and maximize performance, drive an excellent platform launch and introduction process and serve as an active guide in the early stages of a customer's journey to define and achieve measurable value that increases over time.

You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and their teams, aligning execution with long-range and short-range goals through scalable, data-driven operating models and high-impact enablement.

What we're looking for:

  • You are business-savvy and draw on your combination of real-world experience and education to work seamlessly and fluently with leaders across a wide range of functional disciplines at large enterprises.
  • You are a self-starter with strong ownership skills, willing to support many customer accounts, deploying impactful strategies to accelerate our clients’ and WorkBoard’s growth.
  • You have a strong interest and experience in strategy development, strategy deployment, and operating model optimization.
  • A minimum of 10 years of work experience and ideally, experience at a strategy firm such as McKinsey, Bain, BCG, or a management consulting firm like PwC, Accenture, Deloitte, or Slalom.
  • A plus if you have worked for a high-growth B2B SaaS company.
  • You have experience in both strategy execution and strategic portfolio management.
  • You have an arsenal of successful tactics for connecting business value to technology. You are genuine, warm, positive, engaging, and empathetic.
  • Proven experience leading enterprise-level implementation or consulting engagements, ideally in SaaS or strategy execution domains.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills; ability to influence at all levels of an organization.
  • Passion for helping organizations achieve their best possible results.

You'll be skilled and super effective at:

  • Leading executive conversations and working sessions.
  • Deck creation, design, and graphical representation of complex concepts for executive-level presentations
  • Leveraging your natural curiosity to quickly understand a client’s business while demonstrating tact and poise under pressure
  • Delivering exceptional customer experience and value to customers, demonstrated by successfully closing contract renewals and partnering with sales to identify and close expansion and new business opportunities
  • Communicating & listening with the ability to credibly and confidently engage executives
  • Understanding complex, matrix organizations and navigating them effectively to create value for both our clients and the company
  • Mapping and understanding existing strategy execution and portfolio management processes and partner with clients on a path forward
  • Engaging various techniques to deepen customer value over time

WITHIN ONE MONTH, YOU'LL:

  • Build a deep understanding of our buyer, their pain points, our methodology and how we work as a team
  • Deep-dive with Customer Success, Sales, and Product Management teams to learn more about our solution, go-to-market and roadmap and the partnership with the Services team
  • Meet with 5 enthusiastic WorkBoard customers and 5 prospective customers to understand senior leadership challenges and how we help
  • Know your client teams and the objectives and key results they are looking to achieve in the quarter and the next year
  • Be a daily user of WorkBoard and SFDC to help drive rocket ship growth
  • Dazzle a WorkBoard expert with your enthusiastic demo
  • Confidently articulate the value, benefits and relevance of our powerful solution easily and effectively
  • Have action plans in place to achieve the Key Results for your business

WITHIN THREE MONTHS, YOU'LL:

  • Guide 15+ clients in setting and aligning an ROI based value journey
  • Be a valued partner by helping more than 40 leaders use WorkBoard’s Agents, Scorecards, Biz Reviews and Meetings in order to run their business for results, on a weekly basis
  • Spend a great deal of time with our amazing customers both in person and virtually
  • Lead white glove enablement sessions with 20 senior leaders
  • Have successfully secured 2 commitments to be a customer reference.
  • Successfully partner with Customer Success to close renewals and identify 3 opportunities for expansion revenue

WITHIN SIX MONTHS, YOU'LL:

  • Have two dozen executive and chief of staff customer relationships that you can tap for insights, references, case studies and thought partnership any time to express the business value WorkBoard is helping them drive for their company
  • Know your customers are continually getting value by creating a successful track-record of closing renewals, securing expansion and up-sell opportunities, and closing services revenue.

THE TEAM

You will be joining a matrixed team focused on igniting and delivering value quickly to our buyers. We are in growth mode, and we are a passionate no-ego bunch that “falls in love” with our customers and is fully dedicated to ensuring their success.

OUR VALUES - WE LIVE BY THE 4 H’S

Humble experts ~ Hungry for the opportunity ~ Intellectually honest ~ Operating as one happy team

A FEW OF OUR AWESOME BENEFITS

  • Flexible PTO & sick days
  • Paid holidays
  • Health insurance
  • 401K with employer matching
  • Quarterly Bonuses based on company performance
  • Bi-weekly All-Hands Meetings
  • And much more!

The US salary range for this full-time position is $150-175k OTE annual salary. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and geographic location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: MedTech Co-Founder / CCO (100 % remote) (m/f/d)
description:
We are looking to hire ambitious entrepreneurs to start and scale their own startups.

We are serial entrepreneurs, for example Paul Müller (founder Adjust, €1.2B exit) and Petter Made (founder SumUp, €8B) who are eager to support outlier personalities and serial entrepreneurs to build €1B+ companies.

Our offer:

  • A salary while you build your startup as you will directly be employed by us. Alternatively, you can opt for up to €500k in funding.

  • 1:1 sparring with unicorn founders on a weekly basis

  • Community: Access to the top 0.1% of founders, peers and investors

  • Team building: Hiring top notch talent supported through our network (over 50,000 professionals)

  • Distribution: Support in reaching product-market-fit and building up a sales force / marketing machine

  • Funding support for securing a multi-million euro funding round within 12 months (on average, EWOR Fellows raise > €2M after our Grand Pitch)

One of our fellows set a record for Europe’s largest pre-seed round by a first-time founder, securing a €12M pre-seed investment.

title: Vil du som SOSU gøre en forskel – når dagen går på hæld?
description:
Bliv vores nye SOSU-hjælper eller SOSU-assistent som aftenvagt I Borgerteams Hornslet

Har du hjertet på rette sted, og trives du med ansvar, faglighed og frihed i hverdagen? Så har vi måske jobbet til dig!

Når dagen går på hæld, og roen sænker sig, har vores borgere stadig brug for nærvær, tryghed og omsorg. Som SOSU i aftenvagten bliver du en vigtig del af deres hverdag – og med din faglighed og menneskelighed er du med til at gøre en reel forskel.

I Borgerteams Hornslet søger vi en engageret og uddannet SOSU til en fast aftenvagtstilling på 30 timer om ugen. Her får du mulighed for at arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar og samtidig være en del af et stærkt team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i fællesskab.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så læs endelig videre!

Et job med frihed, faglighed og fællesskab

Hos os får du ikke bare et arbejde – du får en vigtig rolle i at skabe sammenhæng og kvalitet i borgernes hverdag.

Vi tror på, at god hjemmepleje bygger på tillid, faglighed og ordentlighed. Derfor giver vi dig plads til at bruge din faglighed, tage initiativ og træffe beslutninger i hverdagen, samtidig med at du har et team i ryggen.

Som aftenvagt får du en varieret hverdag, hvor du arbejder selvstændigt og har tæt kontakt med borgerne. Du bliver samtidig en vigtig del af samarbejdet med kolleger og andre faggrupper, så borgerne oplever en tryg og sammenhængende pleje.

💚 Hvad kommer du til at arbejde med?

Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver at:

  • Skabe tryghed, nærvær og kontinuitet for borgere i eget hjem.
  • Arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for at tilrettelægge og løse dine opgaver.
  • Bidrage til borgernes livskvalitet, selvstændighed og mulighed for at klare mest muligt selv.
  • Kommunikere tydeligt og respektfuldt med borgere, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.
  • Dokumentere dine observationer og indsatser og sikre, at vigtig information bliver givet videre.
  • Samarbejde med andre faggrupper – også telefonisk – så vi sammen sikrer den bedst mulige pleje.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan se værdien i de små ting, som gør en stor forskel for det enkelte menneske.

🤝 Hvad får du hos os?

Vi vil gerne være en arbejdsplads, hvor du både trives og udvikler dig. Derfor tilbyder vi dig:

  • En fast stilling med arbejde hver anden weekend.
  • En arbejdsdag med frihed og ansvar, hvor du får mulighed for at bruge din faglighed.
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og deler viden.
  • En grundig introduktion, så du får en tryg start og bliver godt klædt på til opgaverne.
  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og for at bidrage med idéer til, hvordan vi kan gøre tingene endnu bedre.
  • En arbejdsplads i udvikling, hvor dit engagement og dine perspektiver gør en forskel.

Du får stillet bil til rådighed i arbejdet, så du kan komme trygt rundt til borgerne. Kørekort er derfor et krav.

🕒 Hvordan ser din arbejdsplan ud?

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 30 timer om ugen med faste aftenvagter i et 5+2-rul, hvor du arbejder fem dage den ene uge og to dage den følgende uge.

Der kan også være mulighed for en alternativ vagtplan, hvor du arbejder mandag, tirsdag, fredag, lørdag og søndag i lige uger samt onsdag og torsdag i ulige uger.

Foretrækker du en kombination af dag- og aftenvagter eller ønsker flere faste timer? Det vil vi også meget gerne høre om! Vi er åbne for dialog om, hvordan vi finder en løsning, der passer til både dine ønsker og vores behov.

For os er det vigtigste, at du er uddannet SOSU, har lyst til at gøre en forskel og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet.

🌟 Hvem håber vi, du er?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet SOSU og møder borgerne med respekt, omsorg og faglighed.
  • Trives med at arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver.
  • Er god til at samarbejde og ved, hvor vigtigt det er at dele viden med andre.
  • Kommunikerer tydeligt – både mundtligt, telefonisk og skriftligt.
  • Er fleksibel, reflekterende og god til at finde løsninger, når hverdagen ændrer sig.
  • Har blik for sundhedsfremme, forebyggelse og rehabilitering.
  • Har lyst til at bruge IT og velfærdsteknologi som en naturlig del af arbejdet.

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, bidrage og være med til at skabe en god hverdag for vores borgere.

📞 Skal vi møde hinanden?

Det bedste match finder vi, når der er en god mavefornemmelse hos begge parter.

Derfor er du meget velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Katja Warpe Jensen på telefon 23 81 01 77, hvis du har spørgsmål eller har lyst til at høre mere om jobbet.

Du kan også aftale et uforpligtende besøg, hvor du får mulighed for at hilse på os, se arbejdspladsen og få en snak om hverdagen i Borgerteams Hornslet.

Du er velkommen, også selvom du endnu ikke har besluttet dig for at søge. Vi vil gerne give dig mulighed for at mærke efter, om vi er det rette match for dig.

📅 Praktisk information
  • Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale – gerne tidligere, hvis muligt
  • Ansøgningsfrist: 15. november 2026

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at møde dig – og måske byde dig velkommen på holdet i Borgerteams Hornslet!
