title: Hallernes Smørrebrød søger en køkkenchef og udviklingskok til centralkøkkenet i Kødbyen
description:
Om stillingen

Hallernes Smørrebrød søger en køkkenchef og udviklingskok til centralkøkkenet i Kødbyen.

Brænder du for det klassiske danske køkken, og drømmer du om et spændende kokkejob med ansvar, kreativ frihed og arbejdstider, der giver plads til livet uden for køkkenet?

Kan du kombinere kvalitet og kreativitet med effektiv produktion i større skala? Og trives du i en central rolle, hvor du både skal lede et køkkenteam, udvikle nye retter og samarbejde på tværs af en organisation?

Hos Hallernes Smørrebrød får du mulighed for at kombinere din passion for gastronomi med en hverdag, hvor arbejdstiderne typisk ligger mandag til fredag mellem kl. 7.00 og 15.00. Det betyder mere tid til familie, venner og fritid, uden at du skal gå på kompromis med dine gastronomiske ambitioner.

Som køkkenchef og udviklingskok får du en central rolle i Hallernes Smørrebrød. Du bliver ansvarlig for den daglige drift og ledelse af vores centralkøkken, samtidig med at du får mulighed for at sætte dit gastronomiske præg på vores produkter og videreudvikle vores madkoncept. Du bliver et vigtigt bindeled mellem centralkøkkenet, vores afdelinger og vores eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Vi søger derfor en profil, som både har hænderne skruet rigtigt på, kan skabe struktur i en travl hverdag og samtidig har ambitioner om at udvikle det klassiske danske køkken.

Dine nøgleopgaver

  • Daglig ledelse, planlægning og optimering af produktionen i centralkøkkenet

  • Sikre høj og ensartet kvalitet i alle produkter på tværs af vores afdelinger

  • Udvikle og forfine opskrifter, retter og koncepter med udgangspunkt i det klassiske danske køkken

  • Sikre effektive arbejdsgange og produktionsprocesser med fokus på kvalitet, råvareudnyttelse og økonomi

  • Være et stærkt kommunikativt og fagligt bindeled mellem centralkøkkenet, vores afdelinger og ledelsen

  • Samarbejde professionelt og serviceminded med både interne kollegaer og eksterne samarbejdspartnere

  • Lede, motivere og udvikle medarbejderne i køkkenet

  • Sikre overholdelse af fødevaresikkerhed, hygiejne og egenkontrol

  • Deltage aktivt i produktionen og gå forrest som fagligt forbillede

Vi leder efter dig, der

  • Er faglært kok og har solid erfaring fra professionelle køkkener

  • Har erfaring med større køkkenproduktioner og forstår at kombinere kvalitet, effektivitet og struktur

  • Har erfaring med køkkenledelse og trives med at tage ansvar

  • Har en stor passion for det klassiske danske køkken og lyst til at udvikle og nytænke det

  • Er kreativ, kvalitetsbevidst og har et stærkt gastronomisk fundament

  • Er struktureret og har et godt overblik, også når der er mange bolde i luften

  • Kommunikerer klart, professionelt og respektfuldt på tværs af forskellige faggrupper

  • Er samarbejdsorienteret, serviceminded og forstår betydningen af gode relationer, både internt og eksternt

  • Har kørekort (kategori B)

  • Kan opnå den nødvendige sikkerhedsgodkendelse til arbejde hos vores samarbejdspartnere

Det vigtigste for os er, at du både har passionen for maden, forståelsen for driften og evnen til at samle mennesker omkring et fælles mål.

Vi tilbyder

  • Attraktive arbejdstider, typisk mandag til fredag mellem kl. 7.00 og 15.00, med fri de fleste aftener og weekender

  • En arbejdsdag, hvor der er plads til både gastronomiske ambitioner og et godt privatliv

  • En central og indflydelsesrig stilling i en virksomhed med stærke danske madtraditioner og ambitioner om fortsat udvikling

  • Mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på vores gastronomiske retning og produktudvikling

  • En varieret hverdag med både ledelse, produktion, udvikling og samarbejde på tværs af organisationen

  • Dygtige og engagerede kollegaer med stor passion for mad og godt håndværk

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med højt til loftet, korte beslutningsveje og plads til gode idéer

  • Mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling

  • En fuldtidsstilling med løn efter kvalifikationer

Om Hallernes Smørrebrød

Hallernes Smørrebrød har siden 2012 serveret klassisk dansk smørrebrød med respekt for traditionerne, godt håndværk og råvarer af høj kvalitet. I dag har vi flere afdelinger i København og omegn, og vores centralkøkken i Kødbyen spiller en afgørende rolle i at sikre kvalitet, ensartethed og udvikling på tværs af hele virksomheden. Vi er stolte af vores danske madtraditioner, men vi tror også på, at det klassiske køkken kan udvikles og fornyes, uden at miste sin autenticitet.

Ansøgning

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Arbejdssted: Hallernes Smørrebrøds centralkøkken, Kødbyen, København V. Arbejdstid primært hverdage mellem kl. 7.00 og 15.00, hvor der kan forekomme arbejde uden for dette tidsrum efter behov. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt eller efter aftale.

For at ansøge, tryk på “Ansøg nu” og send din ansøgning og dit CV. Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Vær med til at udvikle fremtidens klassiske danske køkken, med respekt for traditionerne, mod på nye idéer og tid til livet uden for køkkenet.

title: Associate Cost Consultant
description:
Why G&T?
Gardiner & Theobald is an independent construction and property consultancy committed to providing world class service to our clients. Our dedicated team of over 1,300 people delivers Cost Management, Project Management and Specialist Consultancy services from a network of UK and US offices bound by a common purpose - to build a better tomorrow.
We define our success by the value we create for our clients, the fulfilling careers we build for our people and our contribution to the communities we work in. Our own long-term business performance aligns profit with purpose, taking social and environmental responsibility for our actions and the legacy we leave behind.
People are central to our mission. Rewarding individuals based on their unique abilities, talent and hard work, we believe in the quality of experiences and investing in a collaborative culture where all can thrive.
We are currently looking for an Associate to support with the growth of the business and the continued delivery of world class service to our diverse client base.
Our Cost Management teams work across a variety of sectors, offering you the chance to work on a wide variety of interesting and stimulating projects with no sector boundaries while our focus on training and development creates the perfect environment in which to progress your career.
Working within a dedicated and dynamic cost team and reporting directly into senior leadership, this is an exciting opportunity to work on high profile projects across the built environment, including office, fit out and hospitality projects.
The ideal candidate will have experience as the day-to-day project contact and who thrives on challenges and client facing roles, being both eager to learn and develop whilst also helping to drive forward our position as an industry leader. Your attention to detail, analytical skills and ability to collaborate with various stakeholders will be paramount to your success in the role and the overall success of the projects.
As an Associate you will have a hand in the development of G&T as a business, building relationships externally and internally and playing a part in recruiting new talent. You will have a large involvement and responsibility in managing a team and multiple high profile projects including managing fee income, budget and resources.
About the Role:
As an Associate your day to day will focus on managing pre and post contract activities ranging from managing procurements and project finances, to cost estimating and ensuring that projects are delivered within budget constraints. Your project experience will enable you to be responsible for a significant portion of projects. You will be encouraged to guide members of the team and play a part in growing the business through participation in the firm’s wider initiatives.
The key responsibilities of the role will include:
Procurement
  • Proficient understanding of core procurement and contract options (e.g., NEC 3/4).
  • Ability to draft procurement strategies setting out how goods or services will be purchased focusing on achieving client objectives.
  • Ability to take market soundings, establish supplier bidding potential, conduct surveys, report their results and develop inputs into procurement strategy.
  • Strong knowledge and experience undertaking compliant procurement events under Public Procurement Regulations (PCR 2015/UCR 2016).
  • Knowledge of new Procurement Act 2023 regulations.
  • Experience in developing and preparing a full suite of tender documents.
  • Ability to lead a tender evaluation process which may include, reviewing and analysing tender returns, chairing evaluation/consensus meetings and drafting evaluation reports for client approval.
  • Negotiating and collating contract documents with Client teams and Suppliers.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement experience with proven ability to communicate effectively at all levels.
  • Exceptional report writing, production and presentation skills including ability to use relevant role related software.
Post-Contract Management:
  • Prepare and present detailed cost reports, cashflow forecasts, and financial analysis to the Client.
  • Manage post-contract change control, including compensation events and claims (preferably NEC 3 & 4)
  • Undertake assessment of works completed for application for payments.
  • Negotiate and prepare final accounts.
Cost Planning, Estimating and Benchmarking:
  • Develop and manage project budgets, ensuring costs are controlled and remain within established financial parameters.
  • Monitor costs of work done and report on budget variances, providing prompt and accurate financial information to the Client.
  • Monitor project budget, pro-actively manage the changes on the project, including project risk registers and contingency with the project team. This will include accurate periodic reporting and presenting of cost data and Cost of Work Done (COWD), accounting for any variances against budget in all commercial reports.
  • Conduct accurate and detailed cost estimates for construction projects, including measurement and consideration of all project factors to inform rates throughout the design stage.
  • Knowledge and ability to prepare and deliver cost plans.
  • Usage of specialist tools and techniques in undertaking cost estimating exercises with understanding of methods/systems used for data gathering, management, storage and keeping data relevant and current.
  • Analyse and evaluate the potential financial impact of design changes, recommending cost-effective solutions.
  • Undertake market testing of costs, including liaising with specialist subcontractors and suppliers.
  • knowledge and ability to develop plans to analyse and to bridge gaps resulting from a benchmarking exercise.
Risk Management:
  • Identify and assess potential risks associated with construction projects, developing strategies to mitigate and manage identified risks.
  • Provide proactive advice to project teams on risk-related issues to avoid disputes and delays.
  • Degree qualified.
  • MRICS highly desirable.
  • Pre and post contract experience.
  • Experience of working under construction contract terms and conditions, preferably NEC or similar.
  • Previous experience working within a consultancy environment strongly desirable.
  • Able to work on own initiative.
  • A strategic thinker with broad problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working in a client focused environment with a personal commitment to the delivery of excellent client service.
  • Able to demonstrate an understanding of market issues and events and their impact.
  • Positive attitude with a willingness to get involved in business initiatives.
  • Experience of Microsoft platforms and CostX
  • Proven Leadership skills providing guidance and advice to team members in their work and professional development.
  • Can work closely with internal teams, the client, and project teams to ensure effective communication and coordination.
  • Experience in office, fit out, hotel, hospitality, retail and framework sectors preferred.
About Us
Collaboration, innovation, and support are at the core of everything we do. As an Associate Cost Consultant, you will be joining a diverse team led by one of G&T’s equity partners and a board member. Our partner-led model allows us to adopt bespoke approaches both in the service we offer to clients and in the development opportunities we offer our people. Within your team you will be given clear direction and positive encouragement at every turn, whilst our commitment to your career development and lifelong learning programmes ensures you have the support, as well as the tools to thrive.
Forward thinking and future focused, we champion social mobility, ethical governance, equality and diversity, creating an inclusive environment where everyone’s unique talents and experiences are valued. Our ESG goals are at the forefront of our business plan, and we are proud to have created social value worth over £26m+ since 2021. Our initiatives include the G&T ESG Committee, dedicated to increasing opportunities and removing barriers for social mobility and equality within the firm, as well as our Next Gen programme which focuses on nurturing the next generation in the industry. Our commitment to realising a more sustainable future is witnessed not only through helping our clients meet their own next zero carbon aspirations but also by reaching our own, with an aim for our firm to be net zero by 2030.

title: Seasonal Retail At Your Service Associate, Metro Center - Downtown
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
About the Role:
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist with strong hands-on expertise in Python, SQL, AI/ML and at least one specialization such as GenAI/LLMs, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, Recommendation Systems or Forecasting.
  • Own end-to-end Data Science/ML solutions from problem definition to production.
  • Develop, optimize and deploy production-grade ML/AI models.
  • Apply advanced Python, SQL, statistics, ML and deep-learning techniques.
  • Work on GenAI/LLM, RAG, NLP, recommendation or other AI use cases as relevant.
  • Build scalable ML pipelines and contribute to system/solution architecture.
  • Work with cloud and MLOps for deployment, monitoring and model lifecycle management.
  • Perform experimentation, model evaluation, error analysis and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with engineering/product teams to deliver measurable business impact.
  • Mentor junior/mid-level Data Scientists and contribute to technical best practices.

  • 5+ years in Data Science / ML / AI.
  • Advanced Python & SQL.
  • Strong ML/statistics fundamentals with deep implementation experience.
  • Expertise in at least one AI/ML specialty.
  • Production ML experience.
  • Strong cloud/MLOps understanding.
  • Good system-design exposure.
  • Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills.
Preferred
  • PyTorch/TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, CI/CD, RAG, LLMs, vector databases and LLM evaluation.

What We Expect
A senior practitioner who can design, build, productionize and own ML/AI.

title: Senior AI Engineer, User Intelligence
description:
Who We Are

We are a well-funded, early-stage technology company on a mission to fundamentally redefine the way the world searches, discovers, and interacts, built on a philosophy that puts the user first at every step.

The user is not simply a means of transaction. They are a valued participant whose data works for them, not against them, enriching their world and their own experience within it, with them retaining full control.

Our mission is underpinned by proprietary, patent-pending technology built on a novel engine and system.

The Problem You Will Be Solving

The internet was built to inform the many, not to serve the individual. Platforms optimize for engagement, extraction, and consumption at global scale. AI has made this model even more efficient, with the user still largely remaining the input, not the full beneficiary.

The problem is not information. The world has never had more. The problem is that people give away a lifetime of data without receiving the personalized experience it should enable.

People should not have to search. They should simply find.

Who You Are

• Highly talented and motivated to build products with people, for people

• You thrive in zero-to-one environments and find genuine satisfaction in creating from scratch

• A fast-paced thinker with a relentless desire to learn, improve, and raise the standard around you

• Able to inspire, elevate, and collaborate; you make the people around you better

• A great communicator; you express complex ideas with clarity, precision, and confidence across all levels of the organization

• Able to transform ideas into working systems and technical milestones with light speed and precision

• Highly ambitious and action-driven; you thrive under pressure and find genuine energy in working at the edge of what is considered possible

• Capable of designing and building production-grade systems in a fourth of the time most experienced and “sane” professionals would consider possible

What You Will Do

• Build large-scale graph systems that model relationships and behavioral patterns from user interaction signals

• Design and operate dynamic graph analytics pipelines for pattern detection and structural analysis

• Build graph neural network architectures to learn rich representations of users and their connections

• Design efficient graph maintenance and serving pipelines for updates, change detection, and low-latency access

• Build privacy-preserving graph infrastructure that supports aggregate insights while protecting individual data

• Apply graph-based techniques to enterprise scenarios involving organizational and relational data

Minimum Qualifications

• MSc in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or Network Science from KTH, Chalmers, Uppsala, or an institution of equivalent standing

• Genuine theoretical depth in graph machine learning; GNNs, spectral methods, graph embeddings, and community detection with clear understanding of assumptions and failure modes

• Experience implementing graph ML methods in PyTorch Geometric, DGL, or equivalent frameworks

• Demonstrated capability to take a sound research approach and engineer it into a system that operates reliably on real data at production scale

• Exceptional candidates from industry backgrounds who have built graph-based systems in production will be considered alongside research candidates

Preferred Qualifications

• PhD in graph machine learning, network science, complex systems, or a directly related field; given significant weight in our assessment

• Research publications in graph ML, dynamic networks, community detection, or spatiotemporal modeling

• Understanding of privacy-preserving techniques applied to behavioral data at scale

• 1–5 years of experience; research depth weighted equally with industry tenure

What We Offer

Expect the most talented, rigorous, and driven colleagues you have worked with; people who lift each other up and hold each other to the highest standard. This company is driven by ideas and innovation, regardless of age, position, or background. The best ideas must win and the people behind them recognized and rewarded.

A home for exceptional people and geniuses within their domain; those who have always known what they are capable of and have been waiting for the environment to prove it to the world, whilst first being seen and supported by their coworkers.

Compensation includes an attractive salary and meaningful equity ownership.



Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work and reach their full potential. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Application

To apply, send your CV/resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on how and why you would like to contribute to our mission. Upon initial acceptance, an online interview will follow shortly.

Please note that all applications and interviews are conducted in English. Fluency in written and spoken English is a requirement for all roles.

All applications are treated with strict confidentiality.

title: Head of Claims - Europe
description:
About Stoïk

Stoïk is a European cyber insurer that combines insurance with prevention. Our policyholders get cover, continuous monitoring and an in-house CERT that responds when an incident happens. We are tech-driven, human at heart, and growing fast across Europe with a challenger spirit.

The role

As European Claims Leader, you will lead our cyber claims function across Europe, for all segments we operate in, up to companies with €1bn in revenue. You will lead a team of claims professionals and handle the most complex losses yourself, from first notification through to settlement.

  • Reports to: the VP Insurance, directly

  • Works closely with: the Underwriting department, the Product Development team, our CERT and other teams across Stoïk

  • Location: based in one of our offices in Barcelona, Madrid, Paris, Munich or Brussels

  • Current team: 3 claims handlers across 3 countries

Responsibilities

Lead the team

  • Manage and develop a team of cyber claims handlers across our European markets.

  • Oversee the team's claims through every stage of adjustment, setting standards for quality, speed and consistency.

  • Run performance reviews, coaching and training, and shape the team's strategy and structure as we grow.

Handle complex claims

  • Handle a personal portfolio of the largest and most complex cyber claims, across all segments.

  • Analyse policy wordings and take coverage positions on complex or disputed claims.

  • Lead settlement negotiations with insureds, brokers, co-insurers and reinsurers.

  • Appoint and manage loss adjusters, forensic experts and external counsel, and challenge their findings.

  • Build and manage our panel of incident response providers and external experts, monitoring their quality, speed and cost.

  • Calculate and validate quantum, including business interruption, incident response costs and third-party liability.

  • Set and review reserves, and approve payments within your authority.

Work across Stoïk

  • Work closely with our in-house CERT on incident response and on lessons learned from claims.

  • Share claims trends and wording issues with underwriting and product teams to improve our risk selection and policies.

  • Report, update and present on claims developments, large losses and portfolio trends to internal and external stakeholders, including senior management, reinsurers and brokers.

  • Take part in audits and support broker relationships.

  • Present at internal meetings and external events, and support underwriters in broker and client meetings.

Requirements

Experience

  • At least 5 years managing upper-middle-market and large corporate claims across Europe or internationally, in-house at an insurer, at a law firm or as a loss adjuster.

  • Proven experience interpreting policy wordings, leading settlements, working with loss adjusters and calculating quantum.

  • Proven cyber claims experience is required; experience in other commercial lines (D&O, PI, FI, property) is a plus.

  • Experience leading or mentoring claims professionals.

  • Working knowledge of the regulatory framework around cyber incidents, including GDPR breach notification and NIS2 / DORA requirements for larger clients.

Background and languages

  • A legal background (law degree or legal practice).

  • Fluent English, plus fluency in at least one other European language, ideally French, Spanish or German. Any additional language is a plus.

How you work

  • A team player who builds trust with colleagues, brokers and partners.

  • Strong organisational skills, able to run a demanding portfolio and a team at the same time.

  • Pragmatic and decisive: you make the right call quickly, and you own it.

  • Accountable for your results and your team's.

  • A confident presenter, at ease with senior management, brokers and industry audiences.

What we offer

  • A senior leadership role shaping cyber claims at one of Europe's fastest-growing cyber insurers.

  • Direct access to our in-house CERT and claims data, and the tools to use them.

  • A senior, autonomous team that values ownership and clear decisions.

  • A competitive salary and benefits package. We share the pay range with candidates before the first interview.

  • Full working flexibility with the willingness to meet at the office on a regular basis.

  • Regular travel across Europe to meet brokers, insureds, our local teams, and to attend industry events.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on why this role interests you to [email or careers page]. We review every application and aim to reply within [two weeks].

Stoïk is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from everyone, whatever their gender, age, origin, disability, sexual orientation or background, and we build our teams on skills and potential.

title: Clinical Laboratory Scientist, Per Diem, Rotating shift
description:
Located in Templeton amongst the oak trees, Adventist Health Twin Cities has been serving northern San Luis Obispo County since 1977. Comprised of a 122-bed acute care facility, our team provides exceptional care in emergency medicine, orthopedics, obstetrics, digestive disorders, wound care, and various medical, surgical and outpatient services. Locals enjoy weekly farmers markets in downtown Templeton, farm-to-fork dining, beautiful landscapes for hiking and biking, and beach days just fifteen minutes away at Cambria and Morro Bay.

Job Summary:

Prioritizes and performs a wide variety of clinical laboratory tests on various biological specimens. Reviews, evaluates, documents and reports results. Preserves confidentiality of patients and follows lab safety and maintenance protocols. Trains and supervises trainees, laboratory assistants and clerks as needed.

Job Requirements:

Education and Work Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in medical technology, clinical laboratory science, biological sciences, chemical sciences or allied health technologies or equivalent: Required
  • Clinical laboratory experience: Preferred

Licenses/Certifications:

  • Valid Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) license in state of employment: Required in CA
  • Current certification from American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP) or National Credentialing Agency for Labs (NCA): Preferred

Essential Functions:

  • Employs positive patient identification procedures to ensure the integrity of each specimen for pre-analytical, analytical and post-analytical testing. Performs proper specimen collection (including phlebotomy procedures as necessary), labeling, handling, preservation or fixation, processing or preparation, transportation and storage. Adheres to Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and other patient confidentiality guidelines and regulations.
  • Prioritizes lab orders according to type (STAT, ASAP, routine and timed studies) and performs various testing (including chemistry, coagulation, hematology, special chemistry, urinalysis, blood bank, serology, immunology, bacteriology, microbiology, referral testing and more) following prescribed quality assurance policies and procedures. Performs, evaluates and documents quality control checks. Reviews testing results evaluating validity of test results in comparison to anticipated results indicated per procedure manual.
  • Reviews and evaluates the validity and accuracy of test results, recognizing the interdependency of tests, the physiological conditions affecting results, patient age and normal values, controls, linearity errors, instrument codes, delta checks and more. Correlates test results with diagnoses and questions incompatible results. Thoroughly documents and communicates test results, expediting all critical values and results to appropriate clinicians.
  • Disposes of contaminated materials and equipment in accordance with policy and assures that work area is properly cleansed after each test. Performs equipment and instrumentation maintenance, troubleshooting and calibration as needed. Inventories and restocks reagents, calibrators, controls and supplies as needed.
  • Participates in the collection and evaluation of data for Performance Improvement evaluations. Documents adverse events using incident reporting tool. Orients, instructs and supervises laboratory assistants and clerks as needed.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Organizational Requirements:

Adventist Health is committed to the safety and wellbeing of our associates and patients. Therefore, we require that all associates receive all required vaccinations as a condition of employment and annually thereafter, where applicable. Medical and religious exemptions may apply.

Adventist Health participates in E-Verify. Visit https://adventisthealth.org/careers/everify/ for more information about E-Verify. By choosing to apply, you acknowledge that you have accessed and read the E-Verify Participation and Right to Work notices and understand the contents therein.

title: Lager- og logistikmedarbejder til forsendelse i Brabrand
description:
Vil du have fast arbejde på lager med forsendelse og intern transport?



Vi mangler en lager- og logistikmedarbejder i Brabrand.



Du lander i et større logistisk setup, hvor varer skal ind, rundt og videre uden bøvl. Hverdagen handler om forsendelser, indlagring og intern transport, så du bliver en del af flowet bag transporten. Arbejdet ligger i Brabrand, og du får en praktisk rolle tæt på både lager og terminaldrift.

Det her er for dig, der gerne vil have en hverdag hvor kroppen bruges, og hvor overblik betyder noget. Du skal kunne tage fat, møde stabilt og holde hovedet koldt, når der er tryk på. Til gengæld får du fast arbejde, ordnede forhold og en løn der er til at forstå.

Det får du

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Din hverdag

Dagen drejer sig om at få varer videre i den rigtige rækkefølge. Du håndterer forsendelser, flytter gods internt og hjælper med pluk og pak, når der er brug for det.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

Når tempoet stiger, er det vigtigt at du siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer. Her bliver stabilitet og overblik hurtigt mærkbart i resten af kæden.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Vi forventer ikke at du har lavet det hele før. Men du skal kunne se en opgave og tage fat.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har erfaring fra lager, logistik eller transport
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt
  • Kan tage fat, når tempoet stiger
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet forsendelse, indlagring eller pluk og pak før. Men det vigtigste er, at du møder stabilt og tager ansvar for det du laver.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.



Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, er opstart hurtigst muligt.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

title: Senior Robotics Research Engineer
description:
We’re building something that doesn’t exist yet. Our startup, backed by teams in London and Milan, is working at the frontier of soft robotics. We’re looking for a Senior Robotics Research Engineer who lives at the intersection of machine learning, control theory, and software, and who wants to teach strange, compliant machines to move, swim, and grasp exactly the way we intend.

Our lab is 20 minutes from Rondo Rataje, Poznań.



You’ll own the simulation, learning, and control stack that every one of our robots runs on. That means building simulators for systems that are hard to model, training policies that survive contact with the real world, and combining learned and model-based control where each works best. You’ll take soft manipulators and underwater bodies from first sim to robust real-world behaviour, and build the tools the rest of the team relies on to run experiments. Occasional travel to London and Milan comes with the role.

  • Have 5+ years of professional robotics software experience, or 3+ years after a PhD in Robotics, Machine Learning for Robotics, Controls, or a related field
  • Have trained and deployed learned policies (reinforcement learning or imitation learning) on physical robots, not just in simulation
  • Have taken a policy from simulation to hardware, and can tell us exactly where the reality gap bit you
  • Are fluent in PyTorch or JAX, and comfortable running large-scale training in GPU-parallel simulators (Isaac Lab, MuJoCo/MJX, Brax, or similar)
  • Know your control theory: state-space methods, LQR or MPC, state estimation, and when a classical controller beats a learned one
  • Write strong modern C++ and clean Python that other engineers can build on
  • Have used ROS 2 on real projects, not just tutorials
  • Care about testing, code review, and reproducible experiments, because your code is the foundation others stand on
  • Are fluent in English
You’ll stand out if you have
  • Experience with robotic manipulation: dexterous grasping, in-hand manipulation, or contact-rich tasks
  • Experience with mobile robotics
  • Force, impedance, or tactile-feedback control
  • Experience modelling soft, compliant, or continuum systems (Cosserat rods, FEM, SOFA, differentiable simulation)
  • System identification, actuator modelling, or domain randomisation for sim-to-real
  • Teleoperation and demonstration data pipelines, or experience with vision-language-action and robot foundation models
  • Embedded and real-time experience (STM32, RTOS, CAN)
Soft robotics is one of the few fields where the hardware hasn’t caught up to the vision yet, and the models, controllers, and learned policies haven’t either. Soft bodies are exactly where hand-written models struggle and learning shines, which makes them one of the most interesting open problems in robot learning. You’d be joining early enough to define how we simulate, train, and control everything we build, not inherit someone else’s stack. Competitive compensation, equity, and work that will end up in your portfolio for the rest of your career.

Potential matters more than a perfect CV.

If you’re strong in robot learning or classical control but still growing in the other, and you want to work on robots that haven’t been built before, apply anyway.

title: Afdelingsleder til Planethuset – et højt specialiseret botilbud for unge og voksne med høretab
description:
Kan du kombinere strategisk overblik med tydelig og nærværende ledelse? Og vil du stå i spidsen for medarbejdere, der hver dag skaber gode rammer for unge og voksne med høretab?

Så er du måske vores nye afdelingsleder på Planethuset.

Du får ansvar for et højt specialiseret botilbud, hvor du skal sikre stabil drift, høj faglig kvalitet og gode betingelser for både borgere og medarbejdere.

Din opgave som afdelingsleder
Du får ansvar for den daglige drift og personaleledelsen af cirka 20 medarbejdere. Du skal skabe rammer for en sammenhængende indsats med udgangspunkt i borgernes behov og medarbejdernes kompetencer. Tegnsprog er borgernes primære kommunikationsform, og der er også døve medarbejdere. Derfor er kendskab til tegnsprog en fordel.

Du skal omsætte strategiske mål til konkret praksis, prioritere mellem akutte behov og langsigtede opgaver og træffe beslutninger, også når hverdagen er kompleks. Det kræver overblik, handlekraft og en ledelsesstil, hvor du både lytter og sætter retning.

Du har også ansvar for et godt samarbejde med kommuner, pårørende, værger og øvrige samarbejdspartnere. Her skal du kunne samle forskellige perspektiver med respekt for borgernes behov, rettigheder og udviklingsmuligheder.

Et stærkt lederfællesskab og gode rammer for opgaven
Du bliver en del af et lederfællesskab med tilbudslederen og tre afdelingslederkolleger på tværs af Tilbud for Børn og Voksne med Døvblindhed og Høretab. I sparrer om ledelse, faglig kvalitet og drift og tager fælles ansvar for en velfungerende organisation.

Planethuset er åbent døgnet rundt. Derfor er tydelig kommunikation og kontinuitet på tværs af vagter og funktioner en vigtig del af ledelsesopgaven.

Du får støtte fra en medarbejder med koordinerende funktion på tværs af de fire afdelinger. Funktionen varetager blandt andet driftsrelaterede opgaver og giver dig bedre mulighed for at prioritere ledelse og udvikling.

Derudover bliver du en del af et bredere fagligt fællesskab i Området for Kommunikation og Specialpædagogik samt i Specialsektoren. Her får du mulighed for at bidrage med dine erfaringer og hente inspiration på tværs af specialiserede tilbud.

Det bringer du med dig
Vi søger en leder, der skaber tillid, tager ansvar og kan samle medarbejderne om en fælles retning.

Du behøver ikke have erfaring fra et tilsvarende tilbud. Til gengæld skal du have lyst til at lære det specialiserede fagområde og arbejdet med mennesker med høretab at kende.

Det er en klar fordel, hvis du har kendskab til eller erfaring med tegnsprog, da det er en helt central del af kommunikationen med både borgerne og døve medarbejdere.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har ledelseserfaring og er tryg ved personaleledelse, herunder at sætte rammer, følge op, give feedback og håndtere svære samtaler.
  • Sikrer overblik og stabil drift og kan prioritere, når hverdagen er uforudsigelig.
  • Kan omsætte strategiske mål til tydelige prioriteringer i hverdagen.
  • Samarbejder konstruktivt med medarbejdere, borgere, pårørende, værger, kommuner og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.
  • Er lydhør, men kan stå fast og træffe svære beslutninger.
  • Arbejder aktivt for høj faglig kvalitet, trivsel og psykologisk tryghed.
  • Bidrager til lederfællesskabet med sparring, videndeling og fælles ansvar.
  • Kommunikerer klart og ordentligt, også når beslutninger er vanskelige.
Du skal være tæt på praksis og samtidig kunne løfte blikket mod tilbuddets samlede udvikling.

Du behøver ikke kunne alt selv. Du skal være nysgerrig, stille spørgsmål og vide, hvornår du skal gå forrest, og hvornår medarbejdernes viden og initiativ skal have plads.

Ledelsesansvaret i Specialsektoren
Som leder i Region Nordjyllands Specialsektor får du et klart defineret ansvar med afsæt i regionens ledelsesgrundlag. Det tydeliggør forventningerne til dig og til dine lederkolleger på de øvrige ledelsesniveauer.

Se, hvad dette betyder for dig som afdelingsleder her: Ledelsesansvar.

Som leder i Specialsektoren bidrager du til vores mission og vision:

Vores mission er at medvirke til, at hvert enkelt menneske, der benytter vores tilbud, får de bedst mulige vilkår for at mestre sin egen tilværelse

Visionen er, at vi vil være kommunernes foretrukne samarbejdspartner og leverandør af specialiserede ydelser.

Læs mere i Specialsektorens Virksomhedsgrundlag.

Vi forventer, at du agerer i organisationen i overensstemmelse med Region Nordjyllands ledelsesgrundlag.

Vi tilbyder dig
Hos os får du ikke bare et hvilket som helst lederjob. Du får et stærkt fagligt fællesskab og kolleger, der brænder for det, de laver. Du bliver en del af et engageret lederteam, hvor vi aktivt bakker hinanden op og tager arbejdsmiljøet alvorligt, også når det handler om døgnets lange stræk.

Vi ser ledelse som en særlig faglig disciplin. Du får gode rammer for ledelse og udvikling, blandt andet gennem en klar strategi, tæt sparring med tilbudslederen og afdelingslederkolleger samt løbende kompetenceudvikling.

Og så giver vi dig et grundigt opstartsforløb. Inden første arbejdsdag får du tilsendt en plan for dit opstartsforløb, ligesom du bliver tilknyttet en mentor, så du kommer godt fra start.

Om os
Botilbud Planethuset er et bo- og aflastningstilbud for 13 unge og voksne fra 16 år med høretab og yderligere funktionsnedsættelser. Tilbuddet er oprettet efter Barnets lov § 43, stk. 1, nr. 6, jf. stk. 3, samt servicelovens §§ 107 og 108.

Afdelingen hører til i Tilbud for Børn og Voksne med Døvblindhed og Høretab, der er et af fire højt specialiserede tilbud i Området for Kommunikation og Specialpædagogik, som ligger i Region Nordjyllands Specialsektor. Sammen med de andre tilbud og funktioner i vores område er vi en del af et landsdækkende helhedstilbud til børn, unge og voksne. Tilsammen tilbyder vi skole, boliger, aflastning, behandling, specialrådgivning og aktivitets- og samværstilbud.

Læs mere om os på vores hjemmeside:

Du kan også møde os og vores søstertilbud Botilbud for Voksne med Døvblindhed på Facebook/Døvblindhed og Høretab og på Instagram: @doevblindhedoghoeretab.

Hvis du vil se mere om Specialsektoren og møde nogle af dine ca. 1500 måske kommende kolleger, kan du kigge med her: Om at gøre karriere i Specialsektoren (rn.dk).

Læs mere om Specialsektoren og mere om Region Nordjylland.

Få mere at vide om døvblindhed på vidensportalen

Det praktiske
Planethuset ligger på Kollegievej 5, 9000 Aalborg.

Arbejdstiden er gennemsnitligt 37 timer om ugen, primært i dagtimerne på hverdage. Du skal dog tilrettelægge dit arbejde, så du også har kontakt med medarbejdere på andre vagter.

Der kan desuden være møder og særlige arrangementer uden for almindelig dagtid, blandt andet med pårørende.

title: Senior Analyst
description:
Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Manual & Functional Testing

  • Review business requirements, user stories, and technical specifications.
  • Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test cases and test scenarios.
  • Perform Functional, Regression, Integration, System, Smoke, and UAT testing.
  • Validate application functionality against business requirements.
  • Identify, document, and track defects through resolution.

Database Testing

  • Perform backend data validation using SQL queries.
  • Validate data integrity, data migration, and database transactions.
  • Verify stored procedures, views, triggers, and database functions.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot data discrepancies across systems.
  • Ensure data accuracy in reports and downstream applications.

Automation Testing

  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium, Playwright, or similar automation tools.
  • Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Execute automated regression testing and analyze results.
  • Enhance test coverage through automation frameworks and reusable scripts.
  • Work closely with developers to improve test automation effectiveness.

Test Management Activities

  • Prepare test plans, effort estimates, and testing schedules.
  • Manage test execution and provide status updates to stakeholders.
  • Monitor testing progress and ensure timely delivery of testing milestones.
  • Track quality metrics, defect trends, and testing KPIs.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams during release cycles.

Agile & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Participate in sprint planning, grooming, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, and Project Managers.
  • Support production releases and conduct post-deployment validation.
  • Provide risk assessments and recommendations to improve product quality.

Required Skills

  • 4-6 years of experience in Software Testing.
  • Strong expertise in Manual Testing and Test Case Design.
  • Hands-on experience in Database Testing and SQL query writing.
  • Experience with Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar automation tools.
  • Strong knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Knowledge of defect tracking and test management tools.

Tools & Technologies

  • Test Management: JIRA, Azure DevOps
  • Automation: Selenium, Playwright
  • Database: SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL
  • API Testing: Postman, Swagger
  • Collaboration: Confluence, Microsoft Teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Enterprise Applications.
  • Exposure to CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
  • Basic knowledge of performance and security testing.
  • ISTQB Certification is an added advantage.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.

Key Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects and priorities.
  • Strong ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.

Experience Required: 4-6 Years
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days Preferred.

title: Bioanalytiker søges til nystartet Fertilitetsenhed på Gynækologisk-Obstetrisk Afdeling i Thisted
description:
Vi søger en dygtig, nysgerrig og engageret bioanalytiker til en vagtfri deltidstilling.



På Gynækologisk-Obstetrisk Afdeling i Thisted har vi længe drømt om at kunne tilbyde fertilitetsbehandling til borgerne i den vestlige del af Region Nordjylland. Nu er vi næsten klar, men mangler en dygtig bioanalytiker som skal varetage sædvurderinger og sædoprensning ved swim-up.

Derfor søger vi pr. 1. december 2026 en bioanalytiker til Gynækologisk-Obstetrisk Afdeling i Thisted. Du vil have hovedfunktion i Thisted, men må påregne, at oplæring og kurser vil være på andre matrikler.

Stillingen er en vagtfri deltidsstilling på 25 timer om ugen, og er tidsbegrænset til et år. Dette fordi, vi er i en opstartsfase, og ønsker mulighed for at kunne modulere Fertilitetsenhedens aktivitet med stigende behov.

Om jobbet

Du bliver en del af det hold, der skal opstarte og udføre fertilitetsbehandling i Thisted. Du vil først og fremmest have funktion i laboratoriet, hvor du varetager sædvurderinger og oprensning af sæd til brug for inseminationsbehandling. Herudover vil du også varetage opgaver i Fertilitetsklinikken og Gynækologisk Ambulatorium.

På sigt vil din funktion primært være knyttet til opgaverne i laboratoriet, men i opstartsfasen vil dine opgaver være mere varierede.

Vi lover dig et godt og trygt arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi sikrer god og omhyggelig oplæring og værner om vores gode samarbejde på tværs af fag- og afdelingsgrænser.

Vi brænder for at etablere fertilitetsbehandling i Thisted, og glæder os til at du bliver en del af Fertilitetsenheden.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et spændende, meningsfyldt og alsidigt job
  • Dygtige og engagerede kolleger
  • Holdånd og et godt og fleksibelt tværfagligt samarbejde
  • Mulighed for at være med til at forme rammerne for den nye Fertilitetsenhed
  • Søde patienter, som sætter stor pris på din arbejdsindsats
Om dig

  • Du er autoriseret bioanalytiker
  • Erfaring inden for fertilitetsområdet er en fordel, men ikke en betingelse
  • Du arbejder systematisk og professionelt
  • Du er venlig, fleksibel og imødekommende
  • Du værner om holdånd og godt samarbejde
  • Du brænder -som os - for tanken om, at hjælpe med at bringe flere børn til verden
Om Fertilitetsenheden i Thisted

Fertilitetsenheden er en del af Gynækologisk-Obstetrisk Afdeling i Thisted. Vi er to læger, en sygeplejerske og to jordemødre, som glæder os meget til -i samarbejde med dig- at kunne tilbyde sædvurdering og inseminationsbehandling i Thisted.

Fertilitetsenheden er godkendt som vævscenter med tilladelse til at udføre sædoprensning ved Swim-up.

Vi er lokaliseret i Gynækologisk Ambulatorium på Aalborg Universitetshospital, Thisted.

Vil du vide mere

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte Cheflæge Kristine Nielsen for en uformel dialog om stillingen. Kristine træffes på mail: kristine.nielsen@rn.dk eller telefon: 97 65 01 11


Det praktiske
Stillingen er ledig til besættelse den 1. december 2026 eller efter aftale. Der er tale om en tidsbegrænset deltidsstilling på 25 timer om ugen.

Du refererer til cheflæge Kristine Nielsen.

Ansøgningsfrist er mandag d. 26. Oktober 2026.
Samtaler forventes afholdt i uge 44.

I Region Nordjylland skal der indhentes reference på alle nyansatte. Referencen skal være fra sidste ansættelsesforhold. Du bedes derfor skrive i ansøgningen, hvem vi må kontakte.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til gældende overenskomst for ikke-ledende personale på sundhedskartellets område, mellem Danske Bioanalytikere og Region Nordjylland.


Lønoplysninger
Som led i reglerne om løngennemsigtighed har du ret til at få oplysninger om den forventede startløn for jobbet.
På Region Nordjyllands hjemmeside finder du oplysninger om lønniveauer fordelt på stillinger og overenskomster samt Region Nordjyllands lønpolitik, der beskriver de objektive og kønsneutrale kriterier, som ligger til grund for lønfastsættelsen.
Hvis oplysningen om lønniveauet endnu ikke er tilgængeligt på hjemmesiden, vil du modtage det på anden vis inden en eventuel ansættelse.

Find oplysningerne på Regionen som arbejdsplads.

Om Region Nordjylland
I Region Nordjylland søger vi hele tiden nye dygtige kolleger, der sammen med os vil arbejde for, at de nordjyske patienter og borgere er i gode hænder. Du bliver en del af et fællesskab med 15.000 kolleger på hospitalerne, det nære sundhedsvæsen, det præhospitale beredskab – og inden for de specialiserede sociale tilbud, regional udvikling og i administrationen. Vi er stolte af vores faglighed og samarbejde på tværs af hele organisationen.

Vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede til at søge jobbet – uanset etnisk baggrund, køn, seksuel orientering, handicap, religion eller alder.

På Job i Region Nordjylland kan du læse mere om os og få et overblik over ansættelsesprocessen trin-for-trin.

title: Surveillance Analyst (Shifts)

title: Senior Analyst
description:
This role is the
operational hub between merchant partners, the loyalty engine, and downstream e-commerce/web teams - ensuring day-to-day and weekly loyalty offers are curated, configured, executed, and reported on without disruption. The role also supports budget operations for marketing, including forecast consolidation and accrual/factor-rate reporting.

Key responsibilities

Loyalty Offer Management
• Engage merchant partners on a frequent (day-to-week/weekly) basis to gather loyalty offer requirements.
• Curate and configure offers within the loyalty engine, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
• Coordinate with downstream partners (e-commerce, website) to communicate offer changes and ensure seamless execution.
• Monitor in-flight offers closely, tracking status and flagging issues before they impact execution.
• Partner with IT to troubleshoot and resolve any technical issues affecting offer setup or delivery.

Reporting & Performance
• Maintain detailed, up-to-date tracking of all offers in progress.
• Prepare and deliver monthly offer performance reporting and presentations to merchant teams.

• Manage accrual reporting, including factor-rate calculations.
• Ensure data feeds supporting offer performance reporting are accurate and clearly communicated to merchant
partners.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Budget & Forecast Operations

Required Experience & Skills

• Strong, proactive communication skills - comfortable managing frequent touchpoints with merchant partners and cross-functional teams (IT, e-commerce, web).
• Detail-oriented, with the ability to track multiple in-flight offers and reporting cycles simultaneously.
• Comfortable working with accrual/factor-rate calculations and financial reporting concepts.

title: Ophthalmic Technician
description:
WHO WE ARE:

Community Healthcare Network (CHN) is a not-for-profit organization providing more than 65,000 New Yorkers with primary and behavioral healthcare, dental, nutrition, wellness, and needed support services.

Our network is made up of 14 federally qualified health centers throughout Brooklyn, the Bronx, Queens, and Manhattan, along with a fleet of mobile vans that bring health services to underserved people in need throughout New York City. We provide judgment-free, high-quality healthcare, without regard to race, religion, orientation, gender identity, immigration status or ability to pay. We turn no one away.

WHAT WE OFFER:

Growth and development: Access to various healthcare professionals and benefits to deepen understanding and interest in the various disciplines involved in community health programming.

Supportive Team culture: Be a part of an interdisciplinary environment where your ideas and work are valued and encouraged.

Comprehensive benefits: Including health, dental and vision insurance, retirement plans, employee assistance programming and more.

POSITION SUMMARY:

You’ll play a crucial role in the patient’s experience with CHN and in helping our doctors diagnose and treat eye disorders. This position is essential in providing excellent patient care service by focusing on each patient's individual needs.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Acquaints all new patients with office procedures to which they will be exposed.
  • Obtains patient history to include chief complaint, history of present illness, past history (ocular and medical), family history (ocular and medical), and history of allergies and medications.
  • You will inform patients of the purpose of all tests personally performed, and how the patient will be affected during the tests.
  • You will be responsible for all the pre-exam elements of the patient visit.
  • You will test and record patients far acuity, near acuity, peripheral vision, depth perception, and color perception
  • You will perform accurate and consistent documentation and measurements utilizing an Auto lensometer, Autorefractor, Humphrey Visual fields, Fundus photography, ONH and Macula OCT, and Corneal Pachymetry.
  • You will help maintain a smooth flow of patients, including communicating with the medical office support staff.
  • Provides telephone support regarding ocular emergencies, prescription refills, scheduling appointments, and patient care questions.
  • Maintain cleanliness in the pretest and exam rooms.
  • Maintain operating integrity of office equipment.
  • Performs other duties as required.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Associate Degree, which includes course work in a Bio-Medical Technician field, and three years of experience in the appropriate bio-medical technician field in an approved hospital or health facility; or
  • High School graduate or GED equivalent, and four years of experience in the appropriate bio-medical technical field in an approved hospital or health facility; or A satisfactory combination of education and experience.
  • Current Certified Ophthalmic Assistant (COA) certification preferred.

title: Specialist, Regulatory Compliance (Serbia)
description:
Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

Make an Impact as a Specialist, Regulatory Compliance at Worldwide

In this global role, you will play a critical part in ensuring essential study documentation is reviewed, approved, and maintained to the highest quality standards before study sites are activated. Your work will directly support the timely start-up of clinical research studies and help maintain compliance with applicable regulations, industry standards, and internal procedures.


Working closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders around the world, you will provide expertise in regulatory compliance and essential document management. You will help drive quality, consistency, and efficiency across projects while contributing to successful study start-up activities.


This is an opportunity to take ownership of document review processes, provide guidance to project teams, and make a meaningful impact on the delivery of clinical research programs.


Where You'll Work

This is a remote role open to candidates based in Serbia. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.


What You'll Do

  • Lead regulatory compliance activities for assigned projects and serve as the primary Regulatory Compliance representative within global project teams.
  • Develop and maintain Essential Document Review Plans, review requirements, country-specific checklists, and project templates to support study start-up activities.
  • Review, assess, and approve essential document packages to ensure compliance with applicable regulations, SOPs, guidelines, and project requirements.
  • Partner with Site Activation, Regulatory Affairs, Site Contracts, Project Leadership, and sponsors to prioritize document reviews and support synchronized study start-up timelines.
  • Identify documentation gaps, communicate corrective actions, and drive timely resolution of issues before document approval.
  • Monitor and maintain project tracking tools to provide visibility into document review progress and approval status.
  • Prepare and submit approved essential documents for Trial Master File filing, as applicable.
  • Support training and guidance for sponsor and CRO personnel on essential document collection, maintenance, and compliance requirements.
  • Escalate quality concerns promptly and contribute to continuous compliance and quality oversight across projects.

What You'll Bring

  • University degree preferred, ideally in a Life Science discipline, with at least 3 years of relevant experience including 1 year in a similar role; or an equivalent combination of education and experience including 4 years in comparable positions and 2 years in a similar role.
  • Knowledge of ICH, GCP, FDA and/or EU regulatory requirements, as well as applicable local regulations.
  • Experience reviewing, managing, and maintaining essential study documentation and regulatory compliance processes.
  • Strong organizational, planning, scheduling, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to identify situations requiring escalation or supervisory input.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to present information clearly and concisely.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, and experience working with electronic document management systems.
  • Proficiency in written and spoken English.

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide! For more information on Worldwide, visit or connect with us on LinkedIn.

title: 070306 - Associate PCB Repair Technician
description:
Who You Are

The Associate PCB Repair Technician is responsible for testing, diagnosing, and repairing various electronic systems, including PCBs to component level to ensure optimal functionality and quality standards. This role involves troubleshooting electronic components, performing detailed inspections, and collaborating with colleagues and engineering teams to resolve technical issues. The technician will also maintain accurate documentation of test results and repairs, contribute to continuous improvement efforts, and ensure compliance with safety and quality protocols.

This position reports to the Manager - Manufacturing in the PCB Repair department.

What You'll Do

  • Test, troubleshoot, and repair Electronic Controls, Assemblies, Drives, and PCBs to component level
  • Conduct functional and performance tests to ensure repairs meet quality standards
  • Perform basic maintenance and repair of test equipment
  • Provide thorough and accurate Documentation of test, repair, and quality information
  • Continuously improve technical skills through training and hands-on experience to stay current with evolving technologies and repair methods

What You Need

  • Associates degree in Electronics Or minimum of two years of hands-on experience repairing electronic assemblies, including printed circuit boards, troubleshooting, diagnostics, and component-level repair with completion of a high school diploma or GED
  • Experience soldering and desoldering through hole and surface mount components
  • Experience reading and understanding schematics and wiring diagrams
  • Experience using basic electronic equipment including but not limited to oscilloscopes and multimeters
  • Apply knowledge of basic electronics principles to identify and resolve issues effectively
  • Ability to analyze Digital and analog circuits for proper function
  • Data Entry for recording and processing repairs
  • Proficient in signal tracing using electronic test equipment such as Oscilloscopes and Multimeters
  • Skilled in operating hand tools and equipment including soldering irons, cutters, pliers, screw drivers, drills, Dremel cutting tools, etc.
  • Ability to perform diagnostics, testing, and repairs with precision and attention to detail
  • Must be able to occasionally lift objects weighing up to 50 pounds and regularly hold and carry items up to 20 pounds, in accordance with safety guidelines

What Would Be Even Better

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, or equivalent technical training in electronic systems and components
  • Experience replacing BGA devices
  • Familiarity with Servo Drives and various Power Supplies and Interfaces
  • Basic computer navigation and Data Entry skills
  • Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve equipment issues efficiently.

It's Your Move

At FANUC America, we are driven by a deep respect for our people and a commitment to building a workplace dedicated to integrity and excellence. We believe that great careers are built through opportunity, growth, and collaboration—and we’re excited to invite talented individuals like you to explore what’s possible with us.

If you're ready to take the next step in your career, we invite you to apply today. We look forward to learning more about you!

We offer market competitive pay and benefits programs, as well as opportunities for advancement, knowledge and skill development, and recognition of individual achievements. In addition, we offer the following benefits to our employees:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Program
  • Life Insurance

  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Wellness Program
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Flexible Benefit Dollars
  • Generous Holiday & Vacation Program

FANUC American is seeking a qualified applicant for the Associate PCB Repair Technician role. The pay range for this position is $47,000- $78,000 per year. The pay range listed is based on both salary and other compensation, including bonuses and profit sharing, that an employee may be paid during their employment with FANUC America. Benefits include medical insurance, 401k savings, paid vacation, vision insurance, dental insurance, tuition reimbursements, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid holidays. title: Acquisition Coach
description:
Role Summary

The Acquisition Coach helps dealership clients buy more used cars through VETTX. This is not a traditional CSM role focused on check-ins and touchpoints. It is a coaching role focused on training, accountability, process improvement, and measurable client results.

Responsibilities

  • Coach dealership buyers and managers on how to use VETTX effectively

VETTX wins when clients consistently buy cars. The Acquisition Coach helps make that happen by teaching the right process, reinforcing best practices, and driving execution.
