  • Current New Hampshire registration as a Nursing Assistant or have completed a board approved Nursing Assistant Education Program (awaiting licensure within 120 days from program’s last day of class).
  • Must be CPR certified.

Work Experience, Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Training or experience and ongoing education specific to nursing activities regarding the pediatric, adult, and geriatric patient populations is required.
  • Familiarity with computer applications required.
  • Must have technical aptitude and a willingness to learn software applications used at AVH.

Physical Requirements

  • Indicates the appropriate physical requirements of this job in the course of a shift. Note: Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Essential Functions

  • Exhibits courteous and cooperative behavior towards patients, families, visitors, volunteers, students, peers, and providers. Anticipates service needs and proactively resolves issues. Consistently holds self and others accountable for meeting patient/customer service standards. Practices service recovery skills.
  • Works openly and collaboratively both inside and outside the department; promotes performance improvement. Follows through on statements and actions in a timely manner. Strives for excellence in all endeavors.
  • Encourages discussion and consensus building. Recognizes and adapts to different view points and opinions; values diversity. Uses “indoor” voice. Avoids interrupting others. Champions change and exhibits flexibility and adaptability.
  • Accepts responsibility for own actions, behaviors and decisions.
  • Consistently optimizes time efficiently and effectively. Reports to work promptly at the beginning of the work shift and prepares to begin work. Returns to work promptly from lunch and breaks. Completes work assignment and departs timely. In compliance with Absenteeism and Tardiness policy.
  • Is viewed as a resource in the department when dealing with issues of systems and resources and accomplishing tasks in the most efficient and effective ways.
  • Provides quality patient care to the medical/surgical and pediatric patients under the direction of a registered nurse.
  • Assists with admitting, discharging and transferring of patients.
  • Assists with lifting, turning, moving, positioning, and transporting patients in and out of beds, chairs, bathtubs, wheelchairs, lifts, etc.
  • Assists patients in ambulating with or without self-help devices, as instructed.
  • Assists in preparing patients for surgery and diagnostic tests.
  • Assists patients with dressing/undressing, daily dental/mouth care, bowel/bladder functions, hair/nail care, and daily bath/skin care as directed.
  • Prepares patients for meals (i.e., wash hands, raise head of bed, position and clean tables, place protective coverings when needed).
  • Delivers and returns food trays.
  • Assists patients with feeding as needed (i.e., cutting foods, feeding, assisting impaired patients).
  • Serves ice water and nourishment as instructed.
  • Reports changes in eating habits to assigned nurse.
  • Responds appropriately to all emergency situations.
  • Records intake and output on proper document, excluding IV’s, JP drains, T-tubes, and new G-J tubes.
  • Collects specimens as instructed.
  • Takes vital signs, oxygen saturations, accuchecks, weights, and stools for occult blood as instructed and records information in computer. Reports all changes in the patients’ condition to the responsible nurse immediately.
  • Assesses the patient for risk or potential of neglect or abuse. Makes referrals as appropriate.
  • Reports complaints of pain to appropriate medical personnel.
  • Makes beds and changes bed linens.
  • Assists patients in preparing for rehabilitation activities and appointments as instructed.
  • Assists with the application of slings, elastic stockings, etc. as instructed.
  • Keeps the patients’ call system within easy reach of the patient and answers calls promptly.
  • Observes for and reports the presence of pressure areas and skin breakdowns to the responsible nurse.
  • Assists with post-mortem care as instructed.
  • Demonstrates technical aptitude. Is familiar with computer applications. Is willing to learn software applications.

Non-Essential Functions

  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Maintains work area in a clean and orderly manner.

About North Country Healthcare (NCH):

North Country Healthcare is a non-profit affiliation of four medical facilities, Androscoggin Valley Hospital, North Country Home Health & Hospice Agency, Upper Connecticut Valley Hospital, and Weeks Medical Center, located in the White Mountains Region of New Hampshire. NCH includes numerous physicians and medical providers at multiple locations. This leading comprehensive healthcare network which employs hundreds of highly-trained individuals delivers integrated patient care through three community hospitals, specialty clinics, and home health and hospice services. NCH remains committed to the health and well-being of the communities we serve.

North Country Healthcare is an equal-opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to the Human Resources department at the affiliate to which you are applying.

Please Note: All new hires are required to attend a mandatory three-day orientation at Weeks Medical Center in Lancaster, NH. This orientation provides essential training, compliance information, and an introduction to our organizational culture to ensure a smooth and successful transition into your role. Attendance on all three days is required for onboarding completion.

Additionally, if Weeks Medical Center is not your designated home base, you will be eligible for travel reimbursement in accordance with our standard travel policy.

title: Permitting Process Liaison - City
description:
PAY AND FAIR LABOR STANDARDS ACT (FLSA) STATUS:

Pay Range: 511NE

Hourly Rate: $28.08 - $42.87

Annual Rate: $58,631.04 - $89,512.56

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

The normal starting pay for this position is the minimum of the pay range listed above. A higher rate of pay may be considered, dependent on the qualifications and experience of the selected applicant and/or the City’s step placement policy.

OVERAGE POSITION

This position is an overage. Funding for this position will be re-evaluated on a fiscal year basis.

APPLICATION, HIRING, AND BACKGROUND

  • When completing the application, applicants will be asked to respond to application questions. These application questions are based on the Job Requirements for the position.
  • Completion of the application questions is required.
  • Applicant responses to the application questions must specifically answer the questions asked.
  • Responses to application questions must be supported by work history/information listed on the application/resume, sufficient to demonstrate qualifications for the position.
  • Applicants may upload only two attachments. Attachments may include, but are not limited to a resume, cover letter, DD214 or NGB Form 22, transcripts, etc. Applicants may also choose to combine documents into one file for upload.
  • Applications may not be reviewed if specific responses to application questions have not been provided.
  • Each application submission is reviewed independently.

For detailed information about the City’s hiring and background processes, check out the: Quick Guide to Hiring and Background Checks

If you have questions, check out the: Frequently Asked Questions

TOTAL REWARDS

At the City of Oklahoma City, our Total Rewards package is designed to honor your service, fuel your growth, and support every part of your life. We offer:

  • Competitive pay
  • An average of $22,000 annually contributed toward your benefits and retirement
  • A comprehensive package designed to support your health and wellness, financial security, work-life balance, and personal and professional growth and development

Explore all the ways we invest in you: City of Oklahoma City Total Rewards

POSITION DESIGNATION

This job classification has been designated as a safety sensitive job classification in accordance with the Oklahoma Medical Marijuana and Patient Protection Act, 63 O.S., § 427.1 et seq. This means employees in this job classification can be subject to disciplinary action up to and including termination if they test positive for marijuana components or metabolites, even if they possess a medical marijuana license.

JOB SUMMARY

This position is located in the Development Center of the Development Services Department within the City of Oklahoma City and is under the general supervision of the Development Center Liaison. The Permitting Process Liaison performs work of a technical nature. Specialized skills relating to commercial and residential construction, engineering, and/or land use, as well as a knowledge of related codes, ordinances, and City policies should be acquired prior to assuming the duties of this position. Essential job functions include: Serving as point-of-contact/liaison to the development community, business owners, and entrepreneurs; representing the City in the plan review process; problem-solving and moving public/private plan review projects forward; responding to inquiries and providing information regarding technical codes, plan review and inspection processes to stakeholders; communicating internally with other City departments and externally with contractors, and consultants to provide construction project information, including licenses, plan review and inspection services.

VETERANS PREFERENCE

Honorably discharged veterans of the United States Active Duty Armed Forces, National Guard, and Reserve Forces who are not currently employed full-time by the City of Oklahoma City and who meet the qualifications for the position shall be given preference. To receive preference, veterans must submit verification of honorable discharge from the United States military service (Department of Defense Form DD214 or NGB Form 22) prior to the closing date of the vacancy announcement.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Two years of experience reading and interpreting construction plans and building codes, using architectural and engineering scales, or National Certification as a Permit Technician; or one year of experience performing duties equivalent to the class of Code Technician with the City of Oklahoma City.
  • Knowledge of relevant building, zoning, engineering, and land use codes and regulations.
  • Skill in communication by phone and orally while maintaining tact and diplomacy.
  • Skill in reading and assessing development plans for compliance with minimum building, engineering, and/or zoning regulations.
  • Skill in interpretation of statutes, codes, and ordinances pertaining to site development.
  • Skill in determining and advising of necessary and feasible plan revisions to effect compliance with codes and ordinances.
  • Ability to foster internal/external relationships to encourage business friendly practices through the City involving the private development process.
  • Possession of a Driver License (Operator).

NOTE: Employee must obtain an International Code Council (ICC) Permit Technician within one (1) year from the date of hire/promotion/transfer/demotion.

COMPETENCIES

  • One City, One Team (Teamwork/Team Oriented) (1) Recognizes, values, and leverages the ideas, opinions, and perspectives of others; (2) participates willingly and effectively as a team lead or team member; (3) builds consensus; fosters team commitment, spirit, pride, and trust; (4) collaborates with others to accomplish goals and objectives and achieve results; (5) expresses facts, ideas, messages, and information (technical and non-technical) to individuals or groups clearly, concisely, accurately, understandably, with honesty, tact, and diplomacy and in a manner that is appropriate for the intended audience; (6) actively listens, clarifies information as needed; (7) [Core Value One City, One Team] shares information, resources and solutions across departments; (8) [Core Value One City, One Team] asks for help early and offers it often; (9) [Core Value One City, One Team] collaborates across teams before decisions are made.
  • Service First (Customer Centric) (1) Demonstrates commitment to public service; (2) serves and satisfies internal and external customers in a timely and effective manner; (3) establishes, commits to, and maintains high standards for producing quality work products and being responsive to customers; (4) supports the Department/City's mission; develops and executes strategies with the customer in mind; (5) [Core Value Service First] acts quickly and follows through until the job is complete; (6) [Core Value Service First] serves everyone with genuine respect, diligence and professionalism; (7) [Core Value Service First] makes decisions with the people we serve in mind.
  • Respect Always (Leads Through Influence) (1) Persuades others; builds consensus through give and take; (2) gains cooperation from others to obtain information and accomplish goals; (3) works with others towards achieving agreements that may involve exchanging resources or resolving differences; (4) understands the concepts, practices, and techniques used to identify, engage, influence, and monitor relationships with individuals and groups connected to a work effort including those actively involved; (5) leads through influence over the process and its results, and those who have a vested interest in the outcome (positive or negative). (6) [Core Value Respect Always] listens with curiosity and speaks with care; (7) [Core Value Respect Always] embraces different perspectives and lived experiences; (8) [Core Value Respect Always] gives feedback constructively and receives it openly.
  • Own the Outcome (Execution and Results) (1) Sets well-defined and realistic goals and high standards of performance for self or self and others; (2) displays a high level of initiative, effort, and commitment toward performing work; (3) completes assignments in a thorough, accurate, and timely manner, and delivers results; (4) works with minimal supervision, is motivated to achieve, and demonstrates responsible behavior; (5) demonstrates understanding of all aspects of the job and application of accrued knowledge in carrying out duties and responsibilities; technical knowledge; skill in the techniques, equipment, procedures, and work required; (6) recognizes opportunities and takes action for improvement to programs, policies, procedures, practices, and processes; (7) understands and is able to apply the principles, methods, and tools of quality improvement; (8) collects, examines, analyzes, and interprets data from a variety of sources; (9) makes data-driven recommendations/decisions and achieves results; (10) effectively achieves results through others to achieve the Department or City's mission; (11) [Core Value Own the Outcome] takes initiative to fix it or escalates issues; (12) [Core Value Own the Outcome] follows through on commitments; (13) [Core Value Own the Outcome] speaks up when accountability is missing.
  • Keep Getting Better (Commitment to Continuous Improvement) (1) Recognizes opportunities for improvement with regard to programs, policies, procedures, practices, and processes; (2) understands and is able to apply the principles, methods, and tools of quality improvement; (3) collects, examines, analyzes, and interprets data from a variety of sources; (4) makes data-driven recommendations/decisions and achieves results; (5) [Core Value Keep Getting Better] takes time to reflect and act on what is working and what is not; (6) [Core Value Keep Getting Better] learns from mistakes without blaming; (7) [Core Value Keep Getting Better] supports self and other’s development and growth.
  • Empathetic Leadership (1) Fosters a workplace where employees are engaged; (2) seeks to know and learn about, and respects the values, attitudes, and beliefs of others; (3) welcomes varied ideas, perspectives, and thoughts when carrying out the work of the organization and making decisions; (4) builds trust through transparency, open communication, feedback, consistency, and humility; (5) seeks to build high performing teams through practices that demonstrate a commitment to hiring the most qualified candidates; promotes advancement opportunities for all (e.g., coaching, mentoring, providing personal and professional development opportunities); (6) resolves conflict and maintains effective working relationships with others through open dialogue, collaboration, empathy, active listening, understanding, tact, diplomacy, and professionalism; (7) treats others with fairness and dignity; (8) demonstrates emotional maturity; and (9) recognizes contributions and celebrates accomplishments. Note: This competency is not applicable for employees who are not supervisors.
  • Judgment (1) Plans, coordinates, and executes business functions efficiently, effectively, and in a fiscally responsible manner; (2) identifies risks and develops and implements measures to avoid, mitigate, or minimize those risks; (3) makes effective, timely, well-informed, objective, and transparent work-related decisions; (4) exhibits emotional maturity and stability, effectively manages conflict, and remains optimistic and calm during stressful situations; (5) uses resources effectively to achieve results aligned with organizational priorities; (6) applies understanding of financial management/budgeting principles to ensure decisions are fiscally sound and responsible and in accordance with policies, procedures, processes, rules, regulations, and laws; (7) makes business decisions that drive positive, fiscally responsible performance; (8) manages ambiguity, business insight, financial acumen, makes decisions using data and insight that achieves the best outcome for the department and City.
  • Talent Development (1) Provides tools, materials, equipment, and resources; (2) provides performance feedback, coaching, mentoring, encouragement, and support; (3) discusses personal and professional goals; (4) provides formal and informal learning and development opportunities that support achievement of personal and professional goals; (5) attracts and develops talent; (6) manages performance throughout the department or City; (7) sets the leadership tone for area of responsibility. Note: This competency is not applicable for employees who are not supervisors.
  • Strategic Thinking (1) Thinks conceptually, imaginatively, and systematically; (2) envisions the future; (3) defines the vision, direction, and goals; (4) develops a road map for achievement; (5) anticipates change and plans for it; (6) considers long-term value and consequences; (7) influences others to achieve results; (8) understands where the organization is headed; knows the organization's mission and functions, and how its social, political, and technological systems work; (9) aligns business strategies to long-term success of the City; (10) sets the vision, direction and compelling course of action; (11) operates effectively within the systems, programs, policies, procedures, codes, ordinances, rules, and regulations of the organization; (12) knows industry and stays ahead of best practices; (13) understands the political environment, management priorities, staff roles and responsibilities, and grasps external factors impacting the organization; (14) identifies when issues need to be escalated to higher authorities and effectively alerts appropriate officials.
  • Agility (1) Values collaboration, communication, and feedback and is flexible and open to new ideas; (2) learns rapidly and transforms learning into action; (3) examines processes and practices to perform work most effectively; (4) demonstrates courage and willingness to take calculated risks; (5) assesses readiness; proposes new approaches, methods, and technologies plans, implements, and evaluates change in a transparent, positive, and thoughtful manner; (6) exhibits emotional maturity and stability, effectively manages conflict, and remains optimistic and calm during stressful situations; (7) rapidly adapts to change and leads others through change, while producing tangible results and identifying new opportunities.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Primarily indoors in climate-controlled environment.
  • Outside occasionally, may be exposed to heat, cold, humidity, rain, etc.
  • Subject to continuous exposure to light and glare from a computer terminal.
  • Subject to constant noise of a computer terminal, copying machine, ten-key, or telephone.
  • Subject to frequent interruptions.
  • Local travel is required for on-site visits/investigations.
  • Occasionally required to work beyond normal work hours.

Note: Typical City employee working hours are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday. However, working hours vary (may require work to begin before 8:00 a.m. and/or end beyond 5:00 p.m., and/or may require work on weekends and holidays), and are subject to change, based on the duties and location of the position and the business needs of the assigned work unit/department.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Near vision enough to read and draft communications such as written, or machine- generated documents, reports, etc.
  • Finger dexterity enough to operate standard office equipment, including a 10-key.
  • Speech and hearing enough to communicate clearly and distinctly in person and by telephone.

Note: The working conditions and physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

OTHER DETAILS

Pay Method: City employees are required to receive pay electronically, either via direct deposit or pay card.

Former Employees: If this position is open to external applicants and you are a former employee, you must be eligible for rehire to participate in any selection process. If you are unsure of your rehire status, please contact the Human Resources Department at (405) 297-2530. If your rehire status has been coded “Not Eligible,” “Eligible 3,” or “Conditional,” you will need to request a review of your rehire status through the Human Resources Department’s Employee and Labor Relations Division.

Background Investigation, Drug Testing, Physical Examination: Upon a conditional offer of employment/acceptance of position, the City of Oklahoma City will conduct a criminal history background check for external applicants. Applicants will be provided contact information for any third-party reporting agencies used to collect background information in connection with conditional offers of employment.

If the position accepted includes a driver license (commercial or non-commercial) Job Requirement, the City of Oklahoma City will obtain a Motor Vehicle Report for internal and external applicants.

If the position accepted is safety sensitive and/or a driving position, internal and external applicants will be provided a copy of the City of Oklahoma City's Drug and Alcohol Testing Policy prior to being directed for a drug test. A copy is also available at the link below:

HRB 25-01 Drug and Alcohol Testing Procedure

If the position accepted is cyber security sensitive, internal and external applicants will be subject to a Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Interstate Identification Index (III) Fingerprint Background check. Additionally, employees in this job classification must complete Level 4 Security Awareness Training and pass an online certification test.

If the position accepted includes a lift/push/pull/carry Physical Requirement of 25 pounds and greater, internal and external applicants will be directed for a physical examination.

AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

If you require reasonable accommodation at any time during the hiring process, please notify one of the Human Resources Department Representatives by calling 405-297-2530. The City of Oklahoma City will not discriminate against any applicant or employee because of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, actual or perceived sexual orientation, and gender identity and/or expression), national origin, age, disability (mental or physical) and genetic information (including family medical history).

title: Global Segment Leader
description:
About Piab Group
At Piab Group we improve our customers' productivity, sustainability, and safety through evolving industrial automation and have done so since 1951. We believe in an automated world where no resources are wasted, and no humans are injured. With annual sales of ~3 billion SEK and more than 1400 employees, Piab is a global organization, serving customers in more than 100 countries from a vast network of subsidiaries and channel partners. Since 2018, Piab Group has been owned by Patricia Industries, part of Investor AB.
Piab serves a wide range of industries, including e-commerce logistics, food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, and automotive, providing innovative vacuum automation solutions tailored to each sector.

You can expect the following with us
Innovative Culture: Be part of a team that thrives on creativity and innovation.
Global Impact: Work with a company that is a world leader in vacuum transport solutions.
Global Presence: Piab has 25+ sales offices and over 900 partners worldwide, ensuring a vast network and global reach.
Sustainable Vision: Contribute to an automated world, promoting safety and efficiency.
Professional Growth: Access opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.
Diverse and Inclusive: Join a workplace that values diversity and fosters an inclusive environment.
Stable employer: As part of Patricia Industries and connected to the Wallenberg family, Piab benefits from strong support and a commitment to long-term growth and sustainability.

Job Mission
As a Global Segment Leader at Piab, you will own and develop the global strategy and roadmap for your assigned segment, ensuring alignment with Piab’s long-term business strategy. You will translate business needs, market requirements, technology developments, and supplier market insights into clear sourcing priorities and strategic actions.
In this role, you will be responsible for shaping the global supplier landscape, driving competitiveness, supporting strategic sourcing decisions, and building long-term supplier relationships that create value for Piab. You will work closely with stakeholders across regions, functions, and geographies to ensure that sourcing decisions reflect QDCF, total cost, risk, technology, and business priorities.
We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented leader with strong strategic, commercial, and analytical capabilities. You take ownership, challenge the status quo, and are comfortable making decisions in a complex and international environment. Strong business acumen, structured problem-solving skills, and the ability to influence and communicate effectively across functions are essential for success in this role.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own and develop the global strategy and roadmap for the assigned segment, aligned with Piab's long-term business strategy.
  • Translate business and market requirements into clear sourcing priorities, technology roadmaps, and supplier strategies.
  • Own the global supplier landscape, including supplier benchmarking, segmentation, competitiveness, and footprint.
  • Identify and drive opportunities for supplier consolidation, diversification, localization, and strategic sourcing.
  • Develop and maintain a forward-looking pipeline of strategic cost, value creation, and competitiveness opportunities.
  • Lead strategic supplier scouting and develop the China / India sourcing funnel where relevant.
  • Own strategic supplier risk management and define mitigation actions to ensure supply resilience.
  • Set direction for major negotiations and strategic sourcing cases.
  • Challenge sourcing recommendations against the segment strategy to ensure alignment with long-term priorities.
  • Ensure QDCF, competitiveness, and total cost are reflected in strategic sourcing decisions.
  • Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with key suppliers and relevant internal stakeholders.
  • Approve and steer major sourcing recommendations and ensure alignment across regions and functions.
  • Continuously monitor market, technology, and supplier developments and translate insights into actions for the segment.

Preferred Competencies
  • Strong strategic, commercial, and analytical capabilities.
  • Global mindset and ability to work effectively across regions, cultures, and functions.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute sourcing strategies.
  • Strong understanding of supplier markets, cost drivers, competitiveness, and total cost.
  • Excellent negotiation skills, with the ability to set direction for major commercial discussions.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and geographies.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear priorities and decisions.
  • Structured and proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to connect sourcing strategies with business objectives.
  • Ability to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and drive change.
  • Comfortable making decisions in a complex, international, and fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to build and maintain long-term strategic supplier relationships.

Experience and Education
  • Experience from strategic sourcing, category management, segment management, commodity management, supply chain, or procurement in an international industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Proven experience in developing and implementing global sourcing or supplier strategies.
  • Experience in supplier market analysis, benchmarking, segmentation, and strategic supplier management.
  • Experience leading or supporting major negotiations and strategic sourcing cases.
  • Experience working with cross-functional and international stakeholders.
  • Understanding of QDCF, total cost, supplier risk management, and supply resilience.
  • Experience with supplier scouting, localization, supplier consolidation, or sourcing from China / India is considered an advantage.
  • Relevant university degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Purchasing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

This is what our employees say about us
"At Piab, I have the chance to leave my own footprint. The low hierarchy means my ideas are heard and valued. #LoveWhereIWork"

How to Apply
If you are passionate about innovation and want to make a difference in the world of automation, we would love to hear from you! Use the following link to upload your CV.

title: Service- og værtskabsansvarlig til Hernings innovative kontorhus
description:
Er du god til at møde mennesker, skabe overblik og til at få opgaver helt i mål?

Hos Innovatorium søger vi en service- og værtskabsansvarlig, der vil kombinere reception og god service med aktiv kundekontakt og øget udlejning af vores mødelokaler. Du får også en vigtig rolle i at koordinere og føre udvalgte projekter og initiativer ud i livet.

Bliv husets ansigt udadtil

Du bliver den første, gæsterne møder, og den faste base, som husets lejere og brugere kan regne med. Med et smil og et overblik sørger du for, at alle føler sig velkomne, og at hverdagen glider ubesværet, uanset om det handler om et hurtigt spørgsmål i receptionen eller en større praktisk udfordring.

Du holder styr på husets kommunikation via telefon, mail og post og tager dig af de mange praktiske henvendelser, der dukker op i løbet af dagen. Samtidig er du spindelvævet i koordineringen af mødelokalebookinger, så rammerne altid er klar, når der skal holdes møder, workshops og arrangementer.

Bag skranken venter en bred vifte af administrative opgaver, hvor du trives med at følge op, skabe struktur og nå dine deadlines. Du står for fakturering, betalinger og oprettelse af nye brugere. Du varetager den daglige kontakt og koordinering med husets serviceleverandører, blandt andet inden for rengøring og planteservice, og følger op på, at de aftalte opgaver bliver løst og spiller sammen med husets dagligdag.

Herudover har du ansvaret for:

  • Understøttelse af arbejdet med at tiltrække flere møder og eksterne brugere, herunder opfølgning på henvendelser om mødelokaler, dagspakker og dagslokaler

  • Koordinering af udvalgte aktiviteter samt opfølgning på nye partnerskaber og samarbejder i huset

  • Gennemførelse af den årlige brugerundersøgelse

  • Udarbejdelse og vedligeholdelse af lettere kommunikationsmateriale som nyhedsbreve, infoskærmsgrafik, invitationer og praktisk information til husets brugere

I tæt samarbejde med direktøren er du med til at omsætte udvalgte idéer og initiativer til konkrete tiltag. Du koordinerer de praktiske opgaver og følger dem til dørs – f.eks. et nyt onboardingforløb eller indsatser, der skal tiltrække flere mødekunder og skabe gentagne bookinger.

Du kan også sætte dit præg på samarbejdsindsatser for kunst og udstillinger, skabe aktiviteter i netværksloungen og følge op på samarbejdet med husets virksomheder og faglige miljøer. Gennem infoskærme og nyhedsbreve holder du husets brugere opdaterede om, hvad der rører sig.

Kort sagt: Du får en alsidig rolle, hvor ingen dage er helt ens, og hvor dit servicegen og dit overblik gør en mærkbar forskel for alle, der bruger huset.

Hvem er du?

Du er serviceminded og imødekommende, og du nyder at gøre en forskel for de mennesker, du møder. Du er struktureret, god til at følge op og typen, der får de sidste detaljer på plads, så opgaverne faktisk bliver afsluttet. Du arbejder selvstændigt inden for tydelige rammer og trives med at veksle mellem faste driftsopgaver og skiftende projekter. Og så tør du kontakte virksomheder og samarbejdspartnere, når der skal skabes nye relationer. Du har en naturlig lyst til at udfordre det vante, og går gerne nye veje når en opgave kalder på en frisk løsning.

Derudover forventer vi, at du:

  • har minimum 2-3 års erfaring fra en lignende stilling, og gerne erfaring med enkle grafiske værktøjer

  • er administrativt stærk og har gode digitale kompetencer, så du hurtigt lærer nye systemer.

  • kommunikerer professionelt både mundtligt og skriftligt på både dansk og engelsk.

  • kan arbejde med data og simple analyser

  • kan udarbejde nyhedsbreve og lettere grafisk materiale

  • har blik for, hvordan information formidles enkelt og professionelt

Din uddannelsesbaggrund kan spænde vidt. Vi lægger vægt på, at du har flere års erfaring, gerne fra en salg- & serviceorienteret rolle, i en større virksomhed med mange kontaktflader. Du har et stærkt servicegen og er vant til en hverdag med mange henvendelser og afbrydelser. Din erfaring gør, at du kan bevare overblikket, prioritere dine opgaver og møde mennesker med ro, imødekommenhed og hjælpsomhed – også når der er travlt.

Hvem er vi:

Innovatorium i Herning er et innovativt erhvervsmiljø, der siden 2002 har samlet etablerede virksomheder, iværksættere og kreative kræfter under ét tag – og navnet betyder “stedet, hvor nytænkere skaber nyt”. Huset tilbyder kontorer, mødelokaler og praktisk service, men er først og fremmest et fællesskab, hvor netværk, sparring og sociale arrangementer er en naturlig del af hverdagen. I dag huser Innovatorium over 100 virksomheder og 500 brugere.

Du bliver en del af vores administrative team, som består af 7 kollegaer herunder Køkken og Facility. Du vil referere til Direktør Katrine Vinther Ross, og har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at ringe på 70 17 04 73.

Ønsker du at søge stillingen skal du sende din ansøgning og dit CV til job@innovatorium.dk. Send venligst ikke CPR-nummer, helbredsoplysninger eller andre følsomme oplysninger. Vi behandler dine oplysninger fortroligt og sletter dem senest 6 måneder efter, at stillingen er besat.

Rollen er en 35 timers stilling med fysisk tilstedeværelse. Ansøgningsfrist er 31. Oktober og vi forventer at inviterer kandidater ind til samtale efter uge 45. Vi forventer at besætte stillingen hurtigst muligt og senest med opstart 1. januar 2027.

title: .Net Developer
description:
Als .Net Developer vertaal je de behoeften en wensen van onze klanten naar technische, gebruiksvriendelijke applicaties. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de (functioneel)/technische analyse en softwareontwikkeling.

Je zal onder andere meewerken aan de verdere uitbouw van het e-loket van één van onze klanten waar burgers en zorgvoorzieningen terecht kunnen voor hun interactie met het departement. Het e-loket is een volledig in-house ontwikkeld platform.

Je maakt deel uit van een team van 25 enthousiaste medewerkers. Je werkt proactief samen met een projectleider en een solution architect om hoogwaardige oplossingen te ontwikkelen. Verder heb je veel contact met je collega programmeurs en de analisten. • Je hebt minimum 5 jaar ervaring als .Net developer in een Microsoft .NET omgeving en beschikt over een bachelor- of masterdiploma in de informatica.
• Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met het ontwikkelen van een SPA front-end en API back-end in .NET Core.
• Je hebt bij voorkeur kennis van moderne databanken en van relationele gegevensbeheertechnieken (SQL, ERD).
• Je bent vertrouwd met application security.
• Je hebt een goede kennis van functionele en technische analyse (UML).
• Je voelt je thuis in de werking van een Agile/Scrum team, ervaring met Azure devops is een pluspunt.
• Je hebt kennis van unit-testing/softwaretesten.
• Je bent een teamspeler en werkt graag samen met collega’s om projecten succesvol af te ronden.
• Je bent creatief en hebt verantwoordelijkheidszin. Je durft initiatief nemen om kwaliteitsvolle oplossingen aan te bieden.
• Naast het Nederlands heb je een passieve kennis van het Engels.

title: Site Contracts Specialist II/Sr - Sponsor dedicated
description:
Site Contracts Specialist II/Sr - Sponsor dedicated

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
    • We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
    • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Administers all contract management processes, including coordination with relevant protocol, informed consent, institution, investigator, vendor, consultant, and customer agreement documents at a project level.
  • May lead (with supervision) multi-country projects including negotiating and preparing contracts, budgets, and related documents for participation in industry-sponsored clinical trials.
  • Provides support to SSUL to agree on country template contract and budget. Produces site-specific contracts from country template. Provide support in submissions for proposed contract and budget for site.
  • Provides support in negotiating budget and contract with site via Site Contracts Service Centre and SSUL with Sponsor until resolution of issues.
  • Performs quality control and arranges execution of CTAs as well as archival of documents into repositories and capture of metadata.
  • Reviews contracts for completeness and accuracy, and ensures that corrections are appropriately made and documented.
  • Provides supports to business development and represents site contracts/Site Start-Up (SSU) at internal or customer meetings.
  • Work with Contract Managers and team members with the active project management of ongoing contract issues; performs follow-up on all outstanding contract issues.
  • Supports in generating amended contract and/or budget documents as necessary, preparing contract management documentation for projects, and streamlining the contract/proposal or internal processes; and initiates and introduces creative ideas and solutions.
  • Works within the forecasted country/site contracting timelines, ensures they are complied with and tracks milestone progress in agreed upon SSU tracking system in real time.
  • Collaborates with internal and external legal, finance, and clinical operations departments, including communicating and explaining legal and budgetary issues.
  • Facilitates the execution of contracts by company signatories.
  • Maintains contract templates and site specific files and databases.
  • Trains and mentors less experienced staff members on departmental Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and ensures quality of team work products. Maintains and updates training material for site contract team.
  • Acts asa communication liaison between site contracts staff and internal and external customers. Provides functional guidance and keeps internal and external teams aware of all contract statuses or pending issues. Prepares correspondence as necessary.
  • Monitors basic financial aspects of the project and the number of hours/tasks available per contract; escalates discrepancies in a timely fashion.
  • Reviews and complies with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs) in a timely manner, keeps training records updated accordingly and ensures timesheet compliance.

Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Public Health, related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Advanced degree preferred.
  • High level of contracts management experience.
  • Experience in a contract research organization or pharmaceutical industry essential.
  • Strong knowledge of the clinical development process and legal and contracting parameters.
  • Strong computer skills in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Customer focused and ability to manage challenging priorities and to remain flexible and adaptable in stressful situations.
  • Excellent understanding of clinical trial process across Phases II-IV and ICH GCP.
  • Good understanding clinical protocols and associated study specifications.
  • Excellent understanding of clinical trial start-up processes.
  • Project management experience in a fast-paced environment.

• Good vendor management skills.

  • Excellent written/oral communication, presentation, documentation, interpersonal skills as well as strong team-orientation.
  • Strong organizational skills with proven ability to handle multiple projects excellent communication.
  • Quality-driven in all managed activities. Strong negotiating skills. Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to mentor, lead and motivate more junior staff.
  • Demonstrate an ability to provide quality feedback and guidance to peers Contribute to a training and Quality assurance plan within SSU and update SOPs/WI.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

title: SMART Repair Technician
description:
Why Join Van Mossel?

We are proud to be part of Van Mossel Automotive Group; an award winning, people orientated, family-owned business that has gained global recognition over a 77-year tenure in the automotive industry.

Van Mossel now operates in over 7 countries and have been named as one of the leading automotive companies in Europe.

At Van Mossel, we believe it’s our people who set us apart and drive our company forward as we continue to grow.

We are seeking an experienced SMART Repair Technician to join our outstanding Bodyshop team at Poole Accident Repair.

As a SMART Repair Technician you will be based at our state of the art, spacious and ultra-modern facility using the latest equipment and working in an excellent environment with a dedicated team.

What you will bring to Poole Accident Repair:

  • Experience in SMART repair, alloy wheels and glass repair.

  • Able to work quickly and efficiently whilst maintaining impeccable standards.

  • Have a minimum of 2 years experience of SMART repairs.

  • Hold a full UK driving licence.

In return for your efforts, you can expect:

  • Competitive Salary of £38,000 plus performance bonus. OTE £50,000.

  • Health Cash Plan - which provides extensive mental health support, GP consultations cash back for dentist fees, opticians, prescription fees, professional care claims as well as private consultations.

  • Mental Health Support - all our managers are trained in Mental Health as well as Mental Health First Aiders across our business to help support you when required

  • Simply Rewards - access to 100+ amazing rewards and discounts, including gym memberships.

  • Contributory Pension with Aviva - you can pay as much as you like into your pension, plus the company contributes as well

  • Life Assurance - peace of mind for your nearest and dearest when they need it the most

  • Vehicle purchase discounts - various ways in which you can purchase a new car from all our brands.

  • Discounts on services and parts - MOT, servicing, parts, accessories and merchandise at reduced rates for you and your family.

  • Local discounts - with local hospitality and leisure brands

  • Holiday allowance - 30 days including bank holidays, time to spend with your friends and family

  • Cycle to work scheme - with the Green Cycle initiative.

  • Refer a friend - to come and work for us and be rewarded up to £2,000, dependant on the role being recruited

  • Career development – industry-leading training from the brand you represent and full ongoing support inhouse with our learning management system

  • Social events - opportunity to get together with your colleagues, recent events have been go-karting, Charity quiz nights, Goodwood, Private cinema trips

Hours of work: Monday to Thursday 07.30 to 17.00 and Friday's 07.30 to 16.00.

If this sounds like the role for you we would love to hear from you.

title: Family Navigator
description:
Job Title: Family Support Navigator

Department: Family Services
Reports To: Family Services Supervisor

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt (Hourly)
Location: Springfield, MA
Employment Type: Grant Funded Full-Time

Salary: $23.00 per hour


About New North Citizens’ Council (NNCC)

New North Citizens’ Council is a community-based nonprofit organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for residents through education, workforce development, family support, and community services. NNCC is committed to equity, inclusion, and culturally responsive service delivery.


Position Summary

The Bilingual Family Support Navigator provides information, referral, service navigation, and family support services to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities and their families in accordance with the Massachusetts Department of Developmental Services (DDS) Family Support Guidelines. Reporting to the Family Services Supervisor, this position helps families identify strengths and needs, develop individualized Family Support Plans, access community resources, and coordinate services that promote independence, family stability, and community inclusion.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

(Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.)


Family Engagement & Service Navigation

  • Provide comprehensive information, referral, and resource navigation services to individuals and families seeking assistance.
  • Work with assigned families to identify their strengths, competencies, needs, preferences, and available resources.
  • Develop and maintain individualized Family Support Plans that reflect each family's priorities, cultural and linguistic values, and personal preferences.
  • Provide short- and long-term service navigation to help families access appropriate supports and services.
  • Assist families in understanding and accessing public benefits, entitlements, community programs, and other available resources.
  • Maintain ongoing communication with assigned families to address changing needs and support progress toward identified goals.

DDS Coordination & Family Support Services

  • Provide services in accordance with DDS Family Support Guidelines and the Guiding Principles of the Family Support System.
  • Collaborate with DDS Service Coordinators to identify appropriate services and supports for referred families.
  • Coordinate flexible funding supports for designated families in accordance with DDS requirements and program procedures.
  • Work closely with the local DDS Area Office to review referrals, service utilization, program capacity, and family support needs.
  • Support effective use of available resources through ongoing communication and coordination with DDS personnel and community providers.
  • Maintain current knowledge of DDS services, eligibility requirements, and available family support resources.

Family Education & Community Resources

  • Identify and maintain current information about local services, public benefits, entitlements, and community resources.
  • Coordinate family training opportunities, support groups, networking events, and other activities that respond to identified family needs.
  • Connect families with community-based organizations and service providers that support individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities.
  • Promote opportunities for family engagement, peer support, and community participation.
  • Maintain working relationships with community partners and service providers to strengthen referral and support networks.

Documentation & Program Compliance

  • Maintain accurate, timely, and confidential records of family contacts, referrals, Family Support Plans, and services provided.
  • Document service navigation activities and family support needs in accordance with NNCC and DDS program requirements.
  • Track and report relevant service information, referrals, and resource utilization as required.
  • Follow applicable DDS guidelines, NNCC policies, and confidentiality requirements.
  • Communicate service needs, barriers, and resource concerns to the Family Services Supervisor.

Professional Development & Collaboration

  • Participate in relevant training sessions, conferences, program meetings, and professional development activities.
  • Maintain current knowledge of intellectual and developmental disabilities, family support practices, community resources, and public benefit systems.
  • Work independently while collaborating effectively with program staff, DDS personnel, families, and community partners.
  • Demonstrate flexibility, sound judgment, cultural sensitivity, and respect for family choice and self-determination.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.


Required Qualifications

  • Associate's degree or a minimum of three years of experience in the human services field, including work with families of children and/or adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities.
  • Knowledge of intellectual and developmental disabilities and the needs of individuals and families receiving support services.
  • Working knowledge of community resources, public benefits, entitlements, and human service systems.
  • Ability to assess family needs, identify appropriate resources, and develop individualized support plans.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to establish positive, respectful relationships with families from diverse cultural, linguistic, and socioeconomic backgrounds.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with computers, internet-based resources, and standard office software applications.
  • Ability to maintain accurate documentation, confidentiality, and professional boundaries.
  • Valid Massachusetts driver's license and reliable transportation for travel to family homes, community locations, and program-related activities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Services, Social Work, Psychology, Education, or a related field.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish and bicultural skills.
  • Previous experience working with the Massachusetts Department of Developmental Services or DDS-funded Family Support programs.
  • Familiarity with DDS Family Support Guidelines and the Guiding Principles of the Family Support System.
  • Experience developing Family Support Plans and coordinating individualized services.
  • Experience facilitating family support groups, training sessions, or community networking activities.

Core Competencies

  • Family Engagement & Support
  • Service Navigation & Resource Coordination
  • Communication & Relationship Building
  • Cultural Responsiveness
  • Organization & Documentation
  • Collaboration & Problem Solving

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

  • Work is performed in office, family home, and community-based settings.
  • Regular local travel may be required to meet with families, DDS personnel, and community service providers.
  • Duties involve frequent computer use, communication with families and providers, and maintaining program documentation.
  • The position may require standing, walking, bending, and transporting program materials weighing up to 25 pounds.
  • The work environment is generally moderate in noise level, with conditions varying during community visits and program activities.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

New North Citizens’ Council is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law.


ADA & Reasonable Accommodation Statement

NNCC is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).


At-Will Employment Disclaimer

Employment with NNCC is at-will and may be terminated by either the employee or the organization at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law.

title: Cyberdivisionen søger leder til Lokal IT Servicecenter på Aalborg Flyvestation
description:
Brænder du for ledelse, IT-drift og en hverdag tæt på Forsvarets operative virkelighed? Har du lyst til at stå i spidsen for et lokalt IT-servicecenter, hvor god service, sikker drift og stærke relationer går hånd i hånd? Så er stillingen som leder for Lokal IT Servicecenter på Aalborg Flyvestation måske dit næste skridt.



Om os

Lokal IT Servicecenter Aalborg Flyvestation er en del af de regionale servicecentre, der dækker Midt- og Nordjylland. Servicecenteret løser lokale IT-opgaver for Forsvarets brugere på Aalborg flyvestation og i områdets øvrige lokaliteter, og arbejder tæt sammen med de øvrige Lokale IT Servicecentre i regionen.

Vi er en del af Cyberdivisionen ved Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse. Opgaverne spænder bredt og omfatter blandt andet brugersupport, drift af administrative netværk, IT-systemer, AV-udstyr, mobiltelefoner og udlån af IT-materiel.

Vores arbejdsdag er præget af tillid, fleksibilitet og frihed under ansvar. Vi lægger vægt på ordentlighed, tydelig kommunikation og en uformel tone, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og tager fælles ansvar for både opgaveløsning og trivsel. Hos os er stabil drift ikke bare teknik. Det er fundamentet for, at de operative enheder kan løse deres opgaver.



Om stillingen

Som leder for Lokal IT Servicecenter på Aalborg Flyvestation, får du ansvaret for den daglige ledelse, drift og udvikling af servicecenteret. Du bliver omdrejningspunktet for et team, der leverer lokal IT-support til kunder og brugere, hvor kravene til service, sikkerhed og driftsstabilitet er høje.

Du vil få ansvar for personaleledelse, prioritering af opgaver, koordinering med brugere og samarbejdspartnere, samt løbende udvikling af arbejdsgange og kvalitet i opgaveløsningen. Du skal kunne skabe overblik, sætte retning og sikre, at medarbejderne har rammerne til at lykkes i en travl hverdag.

Du indgår i regionens ledergruppe og bidrager aktivt til den tværgående udvikling af Lokal IT Service i Midt- og Nordjylland. Det betyder, at du både skal kunne lede lokalt og tænke regionalt. Du skal være med til at skabe ensartede procedurer, styrke videndeling og sikre, at vi bruger ressourcerne klogt på tværs af Lokale IT Servicecentre.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • lede og udvikle medarbejderne i Lokal IT Servicecenter på Aalborg Flyvestation
  • sikre stabil drift, god service og rettidig opgaveløsning
  • prioritere og koordinere support i samarbejde med regionens øvrige Lokale IT Servicecentre
  • understøtte brugerne med IT i et operativt miljø, hvor sikkerhed og tilgængelighed er afgørende
  • bidrage til materielstyring, beholdningsansvar og administrative processer
  • omsætte fælles regionale beslutninger til konkrete lokale handlinger
  • medvirke til et stærkt arbejdsmiljø med trivsel, faglighed og ordentlighed som bærende elementer
Om dig

Vi søger først og fremmest en leder, der kan skabe følgeskab. Du behøver ikke være den dybeste tekniske specialist i rummet, men du skal forstå IT-driftens betydning for brugerne og kunne lede medarbejdere, opgaver og samarbejde med ro, retning og sund dømmekraft.

Stillingen ønskes besat af en med solid ledererfaring, relevant IT-forståelse og evne til at arbejde i en offentlig og sikkerhedspræget organisation.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du kan omsætte din ledelseserfaring til Forsvarets rammer og hurtigt opbygge forståelse for vores kultur, sikkerhedskrav og opgaveløsning.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med DeMars eller tilsvarende materiel- og beholdningsstyring.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • har en it-supporteruddannelse, eller relevant tilsvarende it-erfaring
  • har en inkluderende, tydelig og værdibaseret ledelsesstil
  • kan motivere medarbejdere og skabe holdånd i et fagligt miljø
  • er struktureret, handlekraftig og god til at prioritere
  • har en professionel tilgang, skaber tillid og er samarbejdsorienteret
  • kan kommunikere klart med både medarbejdere, brugere og samarbejdspartnere
  • har forståelse for IT-service, drift, sikkerhed og brugernes behov
  • har en positiv tilgang til hverdagen, uden at miste blik for alvoren i opgaven
Du skal kunne dansk og engelsk til husbehov i skrift og tale. Det er et krav, at du har kørekort kategori B.



Ansættelsesvilkår

Hvis du har en kontoruddannelse eller en anden relevant uddannelse ansættes du i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere.

Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademikeroverenskomsten).

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Arbejdsstedet er i Aalborg.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.



Kontakt og ansøgning

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Regionschef Timmy Nielsen på telefon 21 31 65 51.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Isabella Lund Skjoldborg på telefon 30 44 55 70.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 30. oktober 2026. Ansættelsestidspunktet er hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

Du søger stillingen via linket i opslaget. Vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og uddannelsesbevis. Vær opmærksom på, at bilag kun kan vedhæftes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.



Om Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse

Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) er Danmarks centrale myndighed for forsvarets og beredskabets materiel, it og cybersikkerhed i fred, krise og krig. Vi arbejder for at sikre, at det samlede forsvar er udstyret, opdateret og operativt — i en tid, hvor kravene til hastighed og kampkraft aldrig har været større. Det er os, der anskaffer, driver og bortskaffer materiel og it for Hæren, Søværnet, Flyvevåbnet og resten af Forsvarsministeriets koncern. Det er vores it-medarbejdere, der dagligt er med til at afværge de cyberangreb, koncernen udsættes for. Vi er en mangfoldig organisation med ca. 2.500 medarbejdere — civile og militære — fordelt ud over hele Kongeriget.

  • En konkurrencedygtig løn på 157,62 kr. i timen som faglært og 148,17 kr. i timen som ufaglært

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Business Analyst to join our team full-time in India.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Business Analyst with strong Cards and Payments domain expertise, preferably with hands-on experience working with TSYS or other major card processing platforms. The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, technology teams, QA, and payment processors to define requirements and deliver card payment solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements through stakeholder discussions and workshops
  • Create and maintain BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, and process flows
  • Work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, Developers, QA, and business teams throughout the SDLC
  • Provide functional expertise across credit, debit, and prepaid card products
  • Demonstrate understanding of the card transaction lifecycle, including authorization, clearing, settlement, refunds, reversals, chargebacks, and disputes
  • Work with TSYS/card processing platforms and understand processor integrations and downstream systems
  • Analyze change requests, perform impact analysis, and identify dependencies across applications and teams
  • Support UAT planning, test case reviews, defect triage, and production releases
  • Collaborate with QA teams to ensure requirements are completely covered through functional and integration testing
  • Work with APIs, data flows, interfaces, and system integrations to translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, demos, and retrospectives
  • Maintain requirements traceability from business requirements through development, testing, and production implementation
  • Support investigation and resolution of production issues and business queries
  • Work with payment networks and industry standards, including Visa, Mastercard, and relevant regulatory/compliance requirements

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst / Business Systems Analyst
  • Strong experience in Cards and Payments domain
  • Hands-on experience with TSYS or similar card processing platforms
  • Strong knowledge of credit card, debit card, and prepaid card processing
  • Experience with requirements gathering and documentation
  • Strong knowledge of BRD, FRD, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows
  • Experience with UAT, integration testing, defect management, and release support
  • Understanding of APIs, system integrations, data mapping, and data flows
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence

title: Svejser til MAG og kvalitetssikring i Silkeborg
description:
Er du svejser og vil du have fast arbejde, firmabil og klare opgaver?

Vi mangler en svejser til MAG, MIG og kvalitetssikring i Silkeborg.

Du lander i en større produktionshverdag, hvor der arbejdes med industrielle komponenter og løsninger til blandt andet hydraulik, køling og energi. Det er et sted med flere fagligheder omkring produktionen, så dit arbejde skal passe ind i et flow hvor kvaliteten betyder noget. Du arbejder ikke ude på skiftende byggepladser, men i et setup hvor svejsning, efterarbejde og kontrol hænger tæt sammen.

Rollen passer til dig, der kan tage ansvar for det du afleverer. Du skal kunne svejse ordentligt, få finishen med og sige til hvis noget ikke stemmer. Til gengæld får du en fast plads i en produktionsvirksomhed, hvor ansvar og faglighed bliver taget seriøst.

Det får du

Løn: 195-215 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Silkeborg og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Svejsning, efterarbejde og kvalitetssikring

Din hverdag

Dagen er bygget op omkring svejseopgaver, efterarbejde og kontrol af det du afleverer. Du får emnerne i produktionen, svejser efter den aftalte metode og tager finishen med, før arbejdet går videre. Når noget ikke passer, forventes det at du stopper op og får det afklaret.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • MAG, MIG og MMA-svejsning
  • Efterarbejde og kvalitetssikring
  • Svejseopgaver i industriproduktion

Her tæller det, at du tager ansvar og viser initiativ i hverdagen. Det er sådan kvaliteten holder, og det er sådan produktionen kommer godt videre.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Gerne har mindst 2 års erfaring som svejser
  • Kan arbejde med MAG, MIG eller MMA
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra produktion eller industri. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan lide en hverdag hvor præcision og kvalitet går hånd i hånd.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, er opstarten Hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Det tager to minutter.

title: Fonden for Entreprenørskab : Kommunikationskonsulent
description:
Vil du være med til at udbrede entreprenørskab på alle uddannelsesniveauer? Og vise, hvordan det styrker forestillingsevnen, virkelysten og troen på egne evner?

I Fonden for Entreprenørskab arbejder vi for, at flere børn, unge og studerende får mulighed for at udvikle idéer, omsætte dem til handling og skabe værdi for andre. Entreprenørskab i undervisningen giver kompetencer, der rækker langt ud over det at starte virksomhed, og som gør børn og unge bedre rustet til en verden præget af forandring og kompleksitet.

Nu søger vi en kommunikationskonsulent, der kan være med til at gøre den fortælling synlig og medvirke til at vores initiativer kommer ud og virke i praksis.

Du bliver en del af et ambitiøst kommunikationsteam på seks personer og får en central rolle i at udvikle, planlægge og gennemføre vores eksterne kommunikation.

Om stillingen og opgaverne

Som kommunikationskonsulent får du ansvar for at drive kommunikationen af tre af fondens vigtige områder: kurser, uddelinger og undervisningsmaterialer. Derfor kommer du også til at arbejde meget tæt sammen med det team, der uddeler midler til både uddannelsesinstitutioner og unge iværksættere og udvikler kurser og materialer til entreprenørskabsundervisning.

Samtidig får du ansvar for at udvikle og drive kampagner på sociale medier på tværs af hele fondens arbejde som uddelende, rådgivende og udførende organisation.

Ansvaret for fondens nyhedsbrev ligger også i denne stilling.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med betalte kampagner på sociale medier og kan arbejde strategisk med målgrupper, kreativ idéudvikling og analyse af resultater.

  • Skriver sikkert, varieret og målrettet til forskellige målgrupper og kan gøre komplekst stof let at forstå.

  • Kan planlægge og drive kommunikationsindsatser, eksempelvis ved lancering af nye undervisningsmaterialer eller større uddelinger.

  • Er vant til at arbejde i en hjemmeside-backend og med sociale medier.

  • Har sans for visuel kommunikation og gerne erfaring med Canva eller lyst til at lære det.

  • Har en relevant uddannelse inden for kommunikation og nogle års erfaring fra en lignende stilling.

  • Forstår eller er interesseret i at komme til at forstå lærere på alle uddannelsesniveauer som målgruppe.

  • Interesserer dig for uddannelse, entreprenørskab og samfund.

Som person

  • Arbejder du struktureret og har blik for både detaljen og den større sammenhæng.

  • Er du proaktiv og opsøgende, nysgerrig på kollegernes arbejde og god til at finde og formidle de historier, der fortjener opmærksomhed.

  • Samarbejder du naturligt på tværs af fagligheder og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

  • Sætter du en ære i godt sprog, høj kvalitet og gennemarbejdede leverancer.

  • Bidrager du med energi, engagement, godt humør og lyst til at skabe resultater sammen med resten af organisationen.

Vi tilbyder

Hos os får du mulighed for at sætte entreprenørskab på dagsordenen og skabe synlighed om et område, der gør en forskel for børn og unge i hele Danmark.

Du bliver en del af et lille, fagligt stærkt og ambitiøst kommunikationsteam, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter kommunikationen i fællesskab. Du får stor frihed til at præge dit arbejde og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling.

Vi har hovedkontor i Odense tæt på banegården og et kontor i København ved Rådhuspladsen. Kommunikationsteamet er fordelt mellem de to kontorer, og vi samles i Odense én gang om ugen. Derudover må du forvente rejseaktivitet til arrangementer og aktiviteter rundt om i landet.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er på fuld tid med arbejdssted i Odense.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår aftales efter kvalifikationer.

Vi ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag senest søndag den 1. november 2026.

Ansøg nu

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte kommunikationschef Kristine Barenholdt Bruun på kristine@ffefonden.dk.

title: Bliv Chauffør hos Nobia Danmark
description:

Som chauffør hos os bliver du en vigtig del af kundens oplevelse. Sammen med en kollega leverer du færdige køkkener direkte til vores kunder i hele Norden, med fokus på sikker levering, godt samarbejde og en professionel oplevelse hele vejen.

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til jobbet

Du behøver ikke have mange års erfaring for at søge. Det vigtigste er, at du tager ansvar, trives med fysisk arbejde og har lyst til at være en del af et team.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort kategori C og CE

  • Har EU-kvalifikationsbevis
