title: Children and Young People Service Lead
description:
Role Overview

The Children and Young People (CYP) Service Lead is an expert paediatric nurse with significant experience in paediatrics and service delivery. They will be responsible for providing dedicated, expert strategic direction and clinical leadership on the design and implementation of children and young people services across outpatient and inpatient settings. They will ensure the delivery of high-quality care, which meets professional and regulatory best practice standards for all children and young people accessing services at Fortius Clinic. The CYP Service Lead will design, implement and monitor our pathways, and work closely with consultants and business delivery teams to expand and improve related services. The CYP Service Lead will provide motivational leadership and support a culture of evidence based personalised care throughout the organisation. They should be approachable, accountable, collaborative and contribute to the senior leadership team at Fortius. They will also act as a safeguarding lead and be a subject matter expert for all colleagues.

Key Responsibilities

CYP management and leadership

  • Providing highly visible leadership, implementation and oversight of CYP services and care, ensuring alignment with statutory requirements, national guidance and organisational priorities.

  • Be responsible for the safety, quality and effectiveness of CYP pathways and care, ensuring clinical excellence across inpatients and outpatients

  • Leading the development, delivery, audit and monitoring of CYP services, including WNB data, implementing action plans and presenting assurance metrics.

  • Leading the identification, assessment, documentation and mitigation of CYP risks, through gap analysis and quality improvement measures.

  • Provide expert advice and support in relation to CYP services and care, including safeguarding and liaising with external agencies as required.

  • Leading the development, review and implementation of CYP policies, procedures, guidance and communication strategies.

  • Establish and maintain a network of CYP link practitioners / nurses, and ensure that Fortius has well maintained CYP competencies for all relevant nursing staff.

  • Lead education and training in CYP care, including induction, development programmes, mandatory training and targeted education where required.

  • Providing professional advice and support to managers, clinicians and staff on CYP and safeguarding matters.

  • Preparing reports and assurance updates for senior leadership, governance committees and the Board, including an annual report and programme of development for CYP services at Fortius.

  • Working closely with consultants, the safeguarding committee and the Paediatric Lead Consultant to support them in their role.

  • Collaborating with key stakeholders including; clinical leaders, consultants, business development, quality and governance team and external partners to strengthen and enhance and expand CYP services at Fortius.

  • Lead on regulatory compliance and evidence of best practice for CYP related matters, ensuring we are prepared for external inspection.

  • Pursue professional accreditations for Fortius related to CYP and safeguarding

  • Coordinating / Deputising for the chair in the Safeguarding Committee meetings.

  • Providing direct clinical care and treatment to CYP patients and their families as required

  • Ensure the correct resources /equipment are available to deliver CYP services and the environment is adapted and suitable for CYP services

  • To ensure there is CYP friendly information, health promotion, toys and resources, including for children with autism and neuro diverse conditions

  • To make external links which supports safeguarding for children such as schools and social services

  • To advise on the safe management of medicines for children, and work with pharmacy, nursing and medical colleagues to implement processes

  • To work with consultant colleagues to guide on best practice for CYP care including holistic assessment, documentation and safeguarding

  • To ensure that children, young people and their families are involved in the planning of their care, and that their experience is used to improve services.

Other duties

· Responsible for contributing to the delivery of evidence based exceptional quality care to all patients

· Provide motivational and inspirational nursing leadership through excellent communication, role modelling and staff development

· To establish collaborative working relationships and effective communications between all members of the multidisciplinary team and our consultants

· To be an active and effective member of the senior Fortius leadership team, including taking on lead roles, attending and participating in committees and groups, taking responsibility of areas for development and contributing to the overall delivery of a quality, safe and effective service

· Actively seek out feedback from the team and colleagues, including direct reports and line management, on at least an annual basis

· To lead, support, supervise and instruct the team through the process of change, demonstrating tenacity, drive professional integrity, balance and perspective.

· Mentor and coach nursing staff, supporting their professional development and fostering a learning environment aligned with NMC and RCN standards

· Support staff wellbeing by being approachable, empathetic, honest, respectful, and caring as a manager.

· To ensure that information / decisions are cascaded appropriately to all members of the team through tools such as regular timetabled meetings (for which minutes are produced), newsletters and other relevant communication strategies

· Encourage reflective practice and continuous professional development

· To participate in the education and supervision of students and nursing staff

· Remain up to date with best practice, national changes in guidance and professional regulation. Share and implement this knowledge with the team and hospital.

· Support sustainability agendas and looks for opportunities to protect the planet

· Supports a diverse team and promotes equality and an inclusive workplace

· Where appropriate, interpret and present clinical information to patients and their relatives, demonstrating highest levels of interpersonal and communication skills ensure that patients and their carers have sufficient relevant verbal and written information during the patient’s stay.

· Disseminate national changes or updates in CYP best practice throughout the organisation

· Support the Director of Nursing in their role.

· Participate in recruitment, people management, internal and external investigations.

  • Attend key daily operational huddles / meetings to have oversight of activities and provide trouble shooting advice.

Measurements

  • Regulatory body inspections aiming for Outstanding in CQC

  • Clinical and managerial Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Cost (KPIs), proficient budget management and efficient use of resource

  • Compliance with policies and procedures

  • Patient reported outcome measures, patient satisfaction and experience

  • Adherence to NICE Guidelines, Professional Standards and Best Practice

  • Staff feedback, patient feedback, survey results and personal feedback

  • Training, education and competency compliance in CYP

  • Audit results and quality improvement programmes

This job description is neither exclusive nor exhaustive. The duties and responsibilities may vary from time to time in accordance with operational need or circumstances and in consultation with the job holder.

  • Qualified Children’s nurse and NMC registered

  • Nursing degree

  • Health or leadership related Masters

  • Leadership / management qualification

  • Evidence of post registration education and development

  • Orthopaedic or surgical specialist education

  • Practice assessor qualification

  • Current APLS or EPALS certificate, or willingness to obtain within six months of appointment.

  • Advanced patient assessment qualification

  • Level 4 safeguarding or willingness to achieve within 3-6 months

  • A minimum of 5 years full time experience in children’s nursing

  • Extensive leadership experience

  • Significant clinical experience at least as a band 7 equivalent

  • Independent hospital experience

  • NHS / public hospital experience

  • Extensive surgical / orthopedic nursing experience

  • Inpatient and outpatient nursing experience

  • People management experience including recruiting, giving feedback, managing sickness and appraisals.

  • Experience in investigating incidents and managing initial patient complaints

  • Significant experience at problem solving, risk assessment and preventing operational challenges

  • Experience in consultant engagement and business development

  • Competent IT skills including word, team and excel

  • Quick to pick up new programmes and able to use in house EPR and related systems

  • Able to present work in a user friendly and engaging way

  • Can communicate through email in a polite, professional and easily understandable way

  • Excellent communication skills, ability to demonstrate empathy, de escalate conflict and respond to concerns

  • Able to make rapport with a diverse group of stakeholders

  • Create a sense of calm, safety and trust

  • Motivated, self-directed and ability to act on own initiative

  • Positive attitude, inspiring, demonstrate the Fortius Values

  • Time management, ability to priortise and re priortise

  • Excellent organizational skills

  • Accountable, professional

  • Takes responsibility for making decisions

  • Evidence of professional leadership and management

  • Inspire confidence in others, coaches, supports, directs

  • Flexible, creative, meets the service needs

  • Excellent communication, analytical, and judgment skills.

  • Ability to interpret financial plans and disseminate amongst others

  • Ability to provide clinical supervision and management oversight.

  • Ability to lead / contribute to the creation and implementation of protocols and policy

title: Supervisor - Allerød
description:
Supervisor i Netto – Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for kollegaer og kunder?

Er du klar til at tage ansvar og udvikle dig i et stærkt fællesskab? Som supervisor i Netto får du muligheden for at prøve kræfter med at have ansvar og du er både rollemodel og sparringspartner for dine kollegaer. Du bliver en central del af teamet og er med til at sikre, at butikken altid leverer gode oplevelser for vores kunder – hver dag.

Hvad indebærer jobbet?
Som supervisor har du ansvaret for at butikken er salgsklar og indbydende. Du bidrager til at motivere og støtte dine kollegaer. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Koordinering af vareopfyldning og trimning
  • Sikre korrekt skiltning
  • Kundeservice og betjening ved kassen
  • Bidrage til rengøring, orden i butik og baglokale
  • Områdeansvarlig for et eller flere udvalgte områder
  • Deltage i oplæring af nye kollegaer

Du får en grundig oplæring i Nettos koncepter, så du er godt klædt på til at tage ansvar for kollegaer og opgaver. Du vil på udvalgte vagter skulle være alene om ansvaret åbne eller lukke butikken – og synes at det er en spændende udfordring.

Hvorfor vælge Netto?
Hos os bliver du en del af et stærkt fællesskab med fokus på samarbejde, ansvar, feedback og fleksibilitet. Du får mulighed for at udvikle dig i rollen, lære om detailhandel og tage næste skridt i din karriere.

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er serviceminded og trives med kundekontakt
  • Har lyst til at tage ansvar
  • Kan motivere og støtte et team, hvor vi løfter i flok
  • Er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider (dag, aften og weekend)
  • Har gåpåmod og lyst til at lære nyt

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et job med ansvar og gode udviklingsmuligheder
  • At du kan blive en del af et stærkt team – hvor vi samarbejder og hjælper hinanden
  • Et positivt arbejdsmiljø
  • Feedback fra chefer og kollegaer
  • Fleksible arbejdstider og en stærk teamkultur

Alle de gode grunde til at blive supervisor i Netto
Du får typisk mellem 20 – 40 kollegaer i butikken, og vi oplever ofte, at kollegaskabet udvikler sig til venskaber.

Du kan også glæde dig til:

  • Løn og arbejdsvilkår der følger HK overenskomst
  • Pensionsordning
  • Sundhedsforsikring
  • Masser af gode personalegoder, fx rabatter i Bilka, føtex, Netto, Carl’s Jr. og Starbucks
  • Mulighed for leje af vores feriehuse og lejligheder i ind- og udland
  • Adgang til Salling online personaleshop med 35% rabat
  • Mulighed for at handle i vores fysiske Salling varehuse i Aalborg, Aarhus og snart i København, hvor vi åbner i 2026 med 35% rabat

Bliv en del af Netto-ånden: Sammenhold, engagement og fællesskab
I Netto fylder sammenhold, engagement og fællesskab rigtig meget. Vi kalder det Netto-ånden, og den bliver man hurtigt bidt af. Det er den hjælpende hånd, smilet der stadig sidder fast efter en lang dag, og det er sammenholdet, der får os til at løfte i flok.

Hos Netto skal alle medarbejdere opleve, at de er en del af et stærkt team, hvor de føler sig respekteret, og deres indsats er højt værdsat. Vi tilbyder varierende opgaver, der motiverer og udvikler dig – både til gavn for din fremtid hos os eller andre steder. Vi tager et stort ansvar for at gøre hverdagen bedre for medarbejdere, kunder og det samfund, vi er en del af.

Er du vores nye kollega?
Send din ansøgning online til os via knappen nedenfor. Vi inviterer løbende til samtale, så søg allerede i dag.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Vi søger én produktionsmedarbejder til en virksomhed, der producerer mayonnaisebaserede produkter.
description:
Har du erfaring fra produktion – eller er du bare typen, der godt kan lide at have styr på tingene og tage ansvar?
Så har vi en spændende mulighed i Glostrup.

Vi søger én produktionsmedarbejder til en virksomhed, der producerer blandt andet mayonnaisebaserede produkter, salater og dressinger.
Du får en vigtig og selvstændig rolle i den daglige produktion, hvor du sammen med det øvrige produktionsteam er med til at sikre, at produktionen kører godt og effektivt.

Om jobbet
Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:
- Produktion af salater, dressinger og mayonnaisebaserede produkter
- De daglige produktionsopgaver
- Planlægning og koordinering af egne opgaver
- Rengøring og oprydning i produktionen
- Håndtering af råvarer og færdige produkter
- Arbejde med IT og produktionsplanlægning
- Samarbejde med souschef og den øvrige produktionsmedarbejder
Det er en selvstændig stilling, hvor du får ansvar for dine egne opgaver. Du bliver naturligvis ikke sat alene med det hele fra første dag – du får oplæring i virksomhedens konkrete arbejdsgange, IT-systemer og produktionsplanlægning.

Om dig
Det vigtigste er, at du er stabil, ansvarsbevidst og kan arbejde selvstændigt.
Vi forestiller os, at du:
- Taler og forstår dansk og kan læse danske instruktioner
- Har en god grundlæggende IT-forståelse
- Kan tage ansvar og selv få løst dine opgaver
- Har et godt overblik og kan følge en produktionsplan
- Trives med en aktiv arbejdsdag
- Er indstillet på fysisk arbejde og tunge løft
- Har en positiv og praktisk tilgang til arbejdet
Du behøver ikke kende virksomhedens IT-systemer eller produktionsplanlægning på forhånd. Det lærer vi dig, så længe du har den grundlæggende IT-forståelse og lysten til at lære.

Vi tilbyder
- En selvstændig rolle med ansvar
- God oplæring i virksomhedens systemer og arbejdsgange
- Et lille produktionsteam med tæt samarbejde
- En aktiv hverdag, hvor du kan se resultatet af dit arbejde
- Mulighed for at udvikle dig i rollen
- Gode og ordnede arbejdsforhold
Hvis du trives med ansvar, kan arbejde selvstændigt og gerne vil være en vigtig del af en produktion, kan det være dig, vi leder efter.
Sjællands Vikarservice har mere end 50 års erfaring med at hjælpe virksomheder og medarbejdere med at finde det rigtige match. Vi lægger vægt på ordentlighed, tryghed og gode arbejdsforhold.

title: Senior Therapeutic Radiographer (Guildford)
description:
Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey as a Senior Therapy Radiographer at our state-of-the-art cancer care centre located in Guildford? Join our dedicated team at GenesisCare UK and be part of something extraordinary.

This is a full time, permanent position based at our Guildford centre, you must be available to work Monday - Friday.

As the Senior Therapy Radiographer, you are responsible for supporting all aspects of the pathway of every patient receiving external beam radiotherapy in the centre and to support the Lead Therapy Radiographer/Centre Leader with leadership of their team.   • Experience and understanding of UK radiotherapy
  • Previous experience within all aspects of radiotherapy; quality assurance, pre-treatment, and treatment
  • Evidence of effective staff liaison and co-operative working
  • Evidence of empathetic and a holistic approach to patient care
  • Previous experience working in private health sector – advantageous
  • Prior experience with resolving complaints satisfactorily

  • A range of radiotherapy clinical skills

  • Strong relationship building skills

We take an integrated approach to cancer care, focusing on treating the whole patient, not just the cancer. Our personalised treatment programmes include wellbeing services in partnership with Penny Brohn UK and exercise medicine, proven to enhance patient outcomes.

Collaborating with universities and leading clinicians globally, we're dedicated to researching and developing improved cancer treatments. Our UK clinical trials programme aims to broaden access to new therapies.

We’re passionate about innovation and working together to make great things happen. We make significant investments in our employees to provide opportunities for growth, learning, and development within their roles.

Join GenesisCare UK and shape your future, while shaping the future of cancer care.

title: Plant Maintenance
location: KANSAS CITY, Kansas City, MO, US
description:
Industrial Maintenance
(Non-Union / Hourly)

Department: Maintenance Department

Reports To: Maintenance Supervisor

Location: Kansas City, MO

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Pay Range + other compensation components: $35.35 an hour

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, STD, Life Insurance, Union Pension

Shift (if applicable): 2nd shift 3:00pm-11:00pm will require working Saturday, Sundays, or both with days off during the week.

Position Overview

The Industrial Maintenance worker moves around the production floor, performing preventative maintenance and repairs on various production machines.

Key Responsibilities

The Industrial Maintenance worker shall be responsible for, but not limited to, the following:


  • Repairs and maintains mechanical, air, electrical and hydraulic components of various equipment such as processing, blow molding, filling and material handling equipment, following blueprints, wiring diagrams and specifications and using hand tools, power tools, welders and precision measuring instruments.
  • Visually inspects and listens to machines and equipment to locate causes of malfunctions.
  • Dismantles machines and equipment to gain access to problem areas, using hand tools and power tools.
  • Inspects and measures parts to detect wear, misalignment, or other problems.
  • Removes and replaces worn or defective parts of drive mechanism or hydraulic system, using hand tools and power tools, and following blueprints, diagram, and service manuals.
  • Re-aligns and adjusts components, such as spindles and clutches, using hand tools and following diagrams.
  • Locates damaged air and hydraulic pipes on machine, and measures, cuts, threads, and installs new pipe.
  • Works with operators to start machines and equipment to test operations following repair.
  • Repairs broken parts, using brazing, soldering, and welding equipment and hand tools.
  • May modify computer-controlled functions on various equipment.

Required Qualifications

  • One (1) year experience in Industrial Maintenance setting, or competition of post high school Industrial Maintenance program.
  • Hours: Start times may vary, normally 8 hour shifts per day. (Overtime may be required)
  • Maintain reliable attendance and consistent work hours.
  • Must be willing to work overtime, weekends, holidays, and varying shifts.
  • Minimum age: 18
  • Must be able to pass a drug screen and physical.


Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Will be required to work with and understand hydraulic, air, electrical, and other systems in the plant.
  • Must be able to follow both written and verbal instructions and follow blueprint, wiring diagrams and service manuals and fill out written reports.
  • Possess the ability to work without direct supervision.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Welding- ability to arc and heli weld
  • Electrical- experience with 3-phase writing, electrical controls, and troubleshooting PLC’s
  • Refrigeration- familiar with ammonia refrigeration systems
  • Utilities- understand operation of Boilers and Air Compressors


Required Soft Skills:

  • Coachable and willing to learn.
  • Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.

Competency

  • Must be able to read and write English and perform basic math calculations.
  • Effective time management skills to achieve results through prioritizing demands.
  • Demonstrates critical thinking skills and effective decision-making skills.
  • Strong attention-to-detail and organizational skills.
  • Must demonstrate proficiency in essential tasks and a willingness to learn.

Working Conditions

  • Must be able to stand/walk on your feet constantly during your shift.
  • Must be able to repetitively lift up to 50 to 75 lbs.
  • Must be able to work outside and be exposed to the outside weather/temperature conditions.

About Hiland Dairy – “Farmer Owned. Locally Produced. Since 1938.”

Hiland Dairy was founded in 1938 in Springfield, Missouri, by two men and fifty cows. From its modest beginnings, it grew steadily into a major farmer-owned dairy company serving much of the Midwest and South. By the mid-1940s, Hiland had added its first production plant and distribution center, expanding beyond milk into products like ice cream and butter. In 1955, the company joined the Quality Chekd organization, reinforcing its dedication to top processing standards.

Through the late 20th century, Hiland expanded by acquiring regional dairies across Arkansas, Kansas, Oklahoma, Tennessee, and Texas, increasing its reach and product diversity. Today, its offerings include milk, ice cream, yogurt, sour cream, dips, cheese, juice, and iced tea.

Still farmer-owned, Hiland emphasizes freshness by sourcing milk from nearby farms. The company also invests in sustainability initiatives and community engagement, remaining rooted in its founding values of quality, integrity, and local commitment.

Our Mission:

Hiland will continually strive to provide high quality products that our customers desire at a competitive price. This goal will be accomplished by the following:
• Being better than we have to be — setting high standards in performance and quality control and meeting or exceeding those marks.
• Doing what is right — treating our greatest asset, our people, with dignity and respect. Attracting and retaining high quality people by providing competitive compensation and continually training and upgrading the skills of our people.
• Provide a reasonable return to our owners — by keeping pace with the market in all areas of our business.

title: GU FC Assistant Coach (London)
description:
Girls United Football Association

Assistant Coach (FC) | Job Description


We are Girls United: an organisation that stands for a world with a level playing field, on and off the pitch. We establish grassroots football clubs for girls in multiple locations and use football as a tool to empower individuals.

Being part of the Girls United team means believing in the cause and being invested in the progress of the organisation. Founded on values of equality, inclusion and empowerment, the organisation is a space for innovation, action and growth with positive social impact at its roots. We are growing quickly and undertaking a series of exciting projects.

Reports to: London Programme Lead (FC)

Hours:

U9s - Wednesday and Thursday

U10s - Tuesday and Wednesday
U12s - Monday and Wednesday

U13s - Monday and Wednesday

Sunday - Griffin Sports Ground, 12 Dulwich Village, SE21 7AL (home ground for fixtures)

Must be able to commit to training & match days


Salary: Assistant Coach is £13.50 per hour


Location: South London - Lambeth, Southwark and other surrounding areas

Description: The position of the Assistant Coach consists of delivering structured, age-appropriate training sessions and matchday experiences, with the main focus working with our two teams (same age groups) that are in the girls division of the Tandridge Youth Football League. The position will include delivery of practical sessions, supporting/developing players and working alongside our existing workforce. The position will be for someone who wants to work within an environment to make a positive contribution to the community. Our player pathway also extends onwards from Girls United into local development centres and ETC programmes.

Assistant Coach (FC) will be responsible for (but not exclusive to);

  • attending sessions, events and fixtures agreed in advance with the FC Programme Lead.
  • the ability to support lead coaches who will be delivering parts or whole sessions.
  • building rapport and trust with players, attendees and young people to ensure they continue to engage with Girls United through their programmes. The aim will be to support our community to develop on and off the pitch through the power of football.
  • working collaboratively with other team members including but not exclusive to; other volunteers, sessional staff and contracted staff within Girls United London.
  • supporting in creating and maintaining a positive relationship with community groups and partner organisations (such as venues) to deliver these programmes.
  • supporting the wider team with developing the organisation with new ideas, new programmes and new opportunities of growth, experience and delivery.
  • supporting with league administration on the day (using the League App), supporting with officiating of matches, and providing assistance to our team of players.


Essential and Desirable Qualities and Qualifications:

  • Experience - Someone who has experience with working in grassroots football and with young women and girls (E). Including delivering sessions and a fixture programme (E)
  • Qualifications - FA Level 1 in Football Coaching, including an in-date qualification for Safeguarding Children and First Aid in Football. (E)
  • Experience of league administration such as match cards, player cards and match reports. (D)
  • Communication - someone who is confident to speak and build positive rapport with various people within the community. For example but not exclusive to players, parents, venues, schools, and funders etc. (E)
  • Organisation skills - someone who is able to manage their time effectively and ensure they are punctual in completing their administration tasks alongside attending sessions and other in-person activities. (E)
  • Adaptability and flexibility – work in a fluid, fast-paced and exciting environment of football. Understanding that hours are often across unsocial times such as weekends and evenings due to our contact with the community of players we have within Girls United FA. (E)


Application Process:

  1. Submit CV and cover letter.
  2. A 30 minute phone interview with the London Programme Lead or London Manager.
  3. Practical interview which will consist of a pre-set task and a coaching session. This will help us to assign your skillset to the most suitable coaching level within Girl United but also matching you to the most appropriate age groups.
  4. Final conversation to address any remaining questions and ensure the compatibility of the candidate with the organisation.


Good luck!

title: Principal Cloud Platform Architect - Temp Role
description:
Business Area: Global Technology – Enterprise Platforms and Practices

Location: London

Reporting to: Head of Cloud Platform Architecture

Job title: Principal Cloud Platform Architect

Who we’re looking for

We are seeking a skilled Cloud Architect with a strong focus on core cloud platforms, infrastructure, and security to join the Cloud Architecture Team. As a Cloud Architect, you will play a crucial role in designing and implementing cloud-based solutions and ensuring the scalability, reliability, and security of Schroders cloud platforms. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, develop cloud strategies, and drive the adoption of best practices in cloud computing. If you have a deep understanding of cloud technologies, excellent problem-solving skills, and a passion for building secure and scalable cloud architectures, we invite you to apply for this role.

About Schroders

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.

Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies

Technology at Schroders

There's a huge amount of change going on at Schroders. Technology's shaping our business more and more, so there are many opportunities waiting to be grabbed. And because we're a big financial player, we can put hefty backing behind good ideas. We're a serious business – we have enormous responsibilities to our clients and shareholders. But just because we're suited and booted, that doesn't make us stuffy; our tech teams are friendlier and more informal than you might expect.

The base

We moved into our new HQ in the City of London in 2018. We’re close to our clients, in the heart of the UK’s financial centre. And we have everything we need to work flexibly.

The team

You will be part of the Enterprise Cloud Architecture team working across Azure, AWS and on premises platforms and services. You will be the principal cloud architect and subject matter expert for cloud, responsible for architecting a best-in-class cloud platform across both Azure and AWS public cloud service providers, ensuring that developer and business user experience is always at the forefront of your mind when architecting and designing cloud solutions. You will join a highly technical team who are solely focused on building a leading-edge cloud service who are integral to successful cloud adoption maturity.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop scalable and secure cloud architectures based on industry best practices, focusing on core cloud platforms, infrastructure, and security.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather business requirements and translate them into effective cloud solutions.
  • Accelerate the cloud first strategy through strong architectural building blocks and reusable Cloud patterns.
  • Develop solutions that provide a great engineering user experience from conception through to production go live.
  • Partner with the DevOps CI/CD Toolchain team to ensure that Cloud requirements are incorporated in the toolchain.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams regarding the implementation and deployment of cloud-based applications and services.
  • Evaluate existing cloud infrastructure, identify areas for improvement, and make recommendations for enhancing performance, scalability, and security.
  • Define cloud security policies, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data and applications.
  • Assess the cloud security posture to identify potential risks and implement appropriate solutions for remediation.
  • Manage cloud governance requirements to ensure standards are upheld and cloud service lifecycles are managed.
  • Understand the needs of the Schroders engineering community and ensure solutions address requirements.
  • Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in cloud technologies, infrastructure, and security, and provide recommendations for their adoption.
  • Participate in the selection and evaluation of cloud services, assessing offerings against business requirements and industry standards.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of cloud architectures, processes, and procedures.

The knowledge, experience and qualifications you need

  • Experienced in architecting, engineering, and implementing cloud solutions on Azure and AWS.
  • Experience relating to security across cloud infrastructure and services.
  • Detailed knowledge of the infrastructure stack including Virtualisation, Kubernetes, Windows and Linux as well as Storage, Database and Networking
  • Experience with modern DevOps tooling (e.g., GITHUB, Azure DevOps, Terraform, Azure ARM, Ansible).
  • Familiarity with software development and software development practices (SDLC).
  • Familiarity with modern engineering and agile practices as well as CI/CD.
  • Passionate about building modern cloud services.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams of business analysts, developers, data scientists, and subject matter experts.
  • Experience of working as part of a transformational change programme.
  • Deep understanding of broader cloud ecosystem including Cloud Computing Technologies, business drivers and emerging technologies and trends.
  • Solid interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to self-manage.
  • Open to working in areas outside of your comfort zone, experimenting with new technologies and techniques.

The knowledge, experience and qualifications that will help

  • Understanding of cloud trends and technologies.
  • Understanding of security principles across the wider technology stack.
  • Understanding of infrastructure services and systems.
  • Experience of working in/with cross-functional teams.
  • Cloud certifications for at least Azure or AWS.
  • University degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline.

What you’ll be like

  • A passionate cloud architect who understands the benefits that cloud technologies bring to an Enterprise.
  • An architect who has the hunger and desire to embrace new technologies and continuously learn.
  • An advocate of cloud, cloud adoption and cloud transformation.
  • Someone who embraces collaboration and change.
  • An architect who can apply both a broad lens and has a keen eye for the details.

We recognise potential, whoever you are

Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.

We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.

title: Finance Business Partner
description:
Want to be part of a UK hub, in a global business that is scaling rapidly, evolving fast and radically changing the decades-old delivery universe? If so, read on — we're looking for a Finance Business Partner to join our Controlling team and become a trusted financial partner to one of our key business areas.

Our mission? To switch up the status quo and become the UK’s leading out-of-home business. With a fast-growing network of thousands of smart lockers, hundreds of leading retail partners and the launch of our transformative Send service, we’re bringing freedom to anyone with a parcel.

At InPost UK, we’re building an unparalleled group of talent that’s committed to help us power our mission to reshape the way parcels move, and redefine eCommerce logistics. Our team is packed full of top-notch experts in e-commerce, technology, scale-up growth, sustainability, logistics and supply chain. We’re a passionate bunch with high ambition – we collaborate, innovate, support each other, and leave egos at the door.


About the role:

This is a commercially focused finance role within the Controlling function. The Finance Business Partner is embedded in a specific area of the UK&I business — which may be Network, Commercial, Pricing, Operations, Newstrade or another function depending on team structure — acting as the primary Finance presence for that area. The role is equally outward-facing and inward-facing: outward to the business leaders and budget holders who rely on clear financial insight to make better decisions, and inward to the Financial Accounting team whose ledger outputs underpin everything the FBP produces. It is a role for someone who is commercially curious, analytically rigorous and confident enough to challenge as well as support.

What you’ll be doing:

Finance Business Partnering

• Act as the primary Finance contact for your assigned business area — building a close, trusted relationship with the relevant Director, Head of Function and their leadership team, and positioning Finance as an indispensable partner to how decisions are made in that part of the business.

• Attend leadership and management meetings for your business area — contributing financial perspective in real time, providing challenge where assumptions are stretched or risks are underweighted, and ensuring commercial decisions are made with a clear understanding of their financial consequences.

• Develop a genuine understanding of the commercial and operational drivers of your business area — going beyond the numbers to understand how the business works, what matters to the people you partner, and what the financial data is really telling them.

• Act as a proactive financial adviser rather than a reactive reporter — identifying financial risks and opportunities within your area before they surface in the management accounts, and bringing them to the attention of your business partners and the relevant Head of Finance with clear analysis and recommended actions.

• Support your business area in building financial literacy and cost accountability — helping non-finance leaders understand their numbers, take ownership of variances, and manage their P&L with confidence rather than relying on Finance to interpret everything for them.

Monthly Performance Reporting & Commentary

• Own the production of the monthly financial reporting pack for your assigned business area — ensuring actuals are accurate, variance commentary is insightful and the output gives business leaders a clear, timely picture of performance against plan.

• Write variance commentary that explains rather than describes — going beyond identifying that a number has moved to understanding why it has moved, what it means for the full-year position and what action is or should be being taken.

• Ensure reporting outputs are consistent with the consolidated UK&I management accounts — working with the relevant Head of Finance and other Finance Business Partners to ensure the overall picture is coherent and that intra-business movements are properly explained.

• Continuously improve the quality, relevance and speed of management reporting for your business area — identifying where reports can be made more actionable, where automation can reduce production time, and where new metrics would better serve the business.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Financial Planning

• Own the budget and re-forecast process for your assigned business area — working with budget holders to build robust, well-evidenced plans from the bottom up, challenging assumptions that lack rigour, and ensuring the final plan is deliverable and clearly explained to both the business and the relevant Head of Finance.

• Lead rolling forecast updates for your area throughout the year — maintaining an accurate and current view of the full-year financial outlook, ensuring any material changes to forecast are identified, explained and escalated promptly, and that the forward-looking picture reflects what the business genuinely expects to happen rather than what was planned.

• Provide financial modelling and scenario analysis to support decision-making in your business area — including investment cases, pricing proposals, volume scenario analysis, cost lever evaluation and any other financial modelling required to support commercial or operational decisions.

• Contribute to the UK five-year plan (5YP) for your area — working with your business stakeholders to develop a credible, commercially grounded multi-year financial view that is consistent with the overall UK&I strategic plan.

Working with the Financial Accounting Team

• Build and maintain a strong, collaborative day-to-day working relationship with the Financial Controllers — understanding the accounting basis of the numbers you report, and ensuring that any differences between ledger actuals and management reporting are understood, explained and resolved.

• Provide the Financial Controllers with timely, clear context on business events that will affect the close — including material accruals, one-off items, recharges, timing differences or any other events that should be reflected in the month-end ledger — ensuring the accounting team is never surprised by what the management accounts show.

• Work with the Financial Controllers and Head of Financial Accounting to agree and maintain a clear close governance framework for your area — including cut-off rules, accrual methodologies, inter-entity recharge bases and cost allocation approaches — so that the transition from locked ledger to management commentary is seamless and low-friction.

• Act as the bridge between the business and the Financial Accounting team — translating commercial events into accounting requirements for the Financial Controllers, and translating accounting outputs into business-relevant insight for your stakeholders. The quality of this interface is a direct determinant of the quality of management reporting.

• Participate in joint Financial Accounting and Controlling team meetings, close reviews and planning sessions — contributing a business-facing perspective to ledger governance decisions and ensuring the two functions operate as a single, well-integrated Finance team rather than two separate functions that happen to produce related outputs.

Investment Appraisal & Business Cases

• Support your business area in the preparation of investment and business cases for MCA (Major Capital or Contract Approval) or other governance submissions — providing independent financial evaluation, challenging the robustness of assumptions, and ensuring the financial case is clearly presented and properly supported.

• Build financial models for investment proposals that are rigorous, well-documented and clearly structured — covering P&L impact, cash flow, payback period, NPV/IRR where relevant, and sensitivity analysis around the key assumptions.

• Conduct post-implementation reviews on significant investment decisions approved for your area — assessing whether projected benefits have been delivered and feeding lessons learned back into the investment appraisal process.

Cost Management

• Support budget holders in your business area in actively managing their cost base — providing granular cost centre/department analysis, identifying cost lines that are running ahead of plan, and helping to develop and track cost reduction or efficiency improvement plans.

• Provide regular cost performance analysis to your business stakeholders — going beyond summarising actuals to helping them understand which cost lines are truly controllable in-period and where structural change is needed to deliver a sustainable improvement.

Commercial Analytics & Decision Support

• Produce ad hoc financial analysis and commercial insight to support decision-making in your business area — whether that is a pricing sensitivity analysis, a volume-mix-margin bridge or a profitability assessment — bringing structured financial thinking to commercial questions that might otherwise be decided on instinct alone.

• Develop and maintain a set of financial and commercial KPIs for your business area that go beyond standard P&L reporting — providing the business with leading indicators, efficiency metrics and trend data that enable proactive management rather than retrospective review.

• Use data visualisation and reporting tools (Power BI, advanced Excel or equivalent) to present financial insight in a way that is accessible and engaging for non-finance audiences — prioritising clarity and actionability over technical complexity.

What we need from you:

We’re looking for people who are ready for a fast paced environment, get their kicks out of problem solving and can balance getting today's stuff done, whilst building for the future. We’re looking for people with drive and natural curiosity – who want to do things differently. And do them brilliantly.

Qualifications & Experience

• Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with post-qualification experience in a finance business partnering, management accounting or commercial finance role — with a track record of working directly with senior operational or commercial stakeholders.

• Demonstrable experience of owning a business area's financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting process end to end — producing outputs independently, to timetable and to a standard that genuinely informs decision-making rather than simply satisfying a reporting obligation.

• Experience of financial modelling and investment appraisal — comfortable building scenario models in Excel, challenging the assumptions behind a business case and communicating financial analysis clearly to a non-finance audience.

• Prior experience in a multi-entity, high-volume operational business — logistics, distribution, e-commerce, retail or similar — is highly desirable. Candidates who have partnered both an operational and a commercial business area will be particularly well-suited to the breadth of FBP roles available.

• Familiarity with management reporting and planning tools — Power BI, Anaplan, Adaptive or similar — is an advantage; advanced Excel and the ability to automate or improve reporting processes is expected at this level.

Skills & Competencies

• Commercially sharp — connects financial data to the commercial and operational context of the business quickly, identifies what the numbers are really saying and frames insight in a way that prompts action rather than passive acknowledgement.

• Credible and confident — builds trusted relationships with senior business leaders, asks incisive questions, challenges constructively and is comfortable delivering financial messages that are not always welcome.

• Analytically rigorous — builds robust models and analysis, doesn't round off complexity prematurely, and is precise and transparent about the assumptions underpinning financial forecasts and business cases.

• An excellent communicator — presents financial performance clearly and compellingly to non-finance audiences, writes commentary that is insightful rather than descriptive, and adapts style and register to the audience.

• Genuinely collaborative with the accounting team — understands that the FBP role is only as good as the ledger it works from, actively cultivates the relationship with the Financial Controller, and treats the accounting-to-controlling interface as a shared responsibility rather than someone else's problem.

• Organised and deadline-driven — manages the month-end, forecast and budget cycle simultaneously without losing quality in any area, and plans ahead rather than reacting to the calendar.

• Curious and proactive — stays close to the business, asks questions about what is changing, and surfaces financial implications early rather than waiting for the management accounts to tell the story.

• Resilient under pressure — maintains accuracy and composure during the demanding periods of the financial calendar, and remains solution-focused when priorities conflict or the data is incomplete.

The InPost process:

We pride ourselves on our candidate experience. We want to make this as straightforward as possible, for you and for us! We will try our best to get back to you within a few days to let you know if we’d like to take you to the first stage. This normally involves a 20 minute chat with our Talent Team. If we both feel the connection, you’ll then go through another one or two stages, depending on the level of the role.

At InPost, we love uniqueness. Our strength is our people.

We strive to create an open, equal, inclusive environment in which everyone has the opportunity to flourish and be themselves.

description:
Har du gode skriftlige kompetencer, og kan du ”skære en sag til”? Er du vant til at styre processer med mange bidragsydere og interessenter? Og har du erfaring med at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem ledelsesbetjening og processtyring i et sekretariat? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i ledelsessekretariatet i fagområdet Person i Skattestyrelsen.

En spændende hverdag i et fagligt stærkt miljø
Vi søger 1-2 samarbejdsstærke kollegaer, der med akademisk eller skattefaglig baggrund kan bidrage til sekretariatsarbejdet på personskatteområdet, hvor vi understøtter personskattedirektøren og den øvrige ledelse i fagområdet Person med bl.a. sager til departementet, ministeren og Folketinget.

Som eksempler herpå, er ledelsessekretariatet hvert år bl.a. været involveret i arbejdet med folketingets lovprogram og bidrag til finansloven, ligesom ledelsessekretariatet har bistået med opfølgninger på trippelbeskatning og kryptovaluta, som er i mediernes søgelys lige nu. Vi er således vant til at arbejde med højt profilerede sager.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt op ad ledelsen i Person, og det stiller store krav til dine formuleringsevner, såvel skriftligt som mundtligt, ligesom din evne til at styre en proces end-to-end skal være helt i top, da vi opererer i et komplekst krydsfelt mellem politik, jura, drift og udvikling. Kvalitetsbarren for vores arbejde er således sat højt, og du skal være med til at fastholde kvaliteten og eventuelt løfte den.

Helt grundlæggende er vi med til at løse en central opgave i staten, hvor du vil være med til at understøtte vores velfærdssamfund.

Professionel, proaktiv og processtærk
Vi forestiller os, at du har en videregående uddannelse - gerne med en samfundsvidenskabelig profil - eller en skattefaglig baggrund på tilsvarende niveau. Du har sandsynligvis erfaring fra en offentlig myndighed, hvor du har arbejdet med ledelsesbetjening, hvilket medfører, at du forstår rollen som medarbejder i et sekretariat, ligesom vi gerne ser, at du har forståelse og interesse for politiske, organisatoriske og samfundsmæssige problemstillinger. Er du helt nyuddannet vil vi på ingen måde udelukke, at det kan være dig, vi mangler. For dit potentiale betyder også noget for os.

Du vil skulle bidrage til at sikre en professionel og rettidig minister- og ledelsesbetjening, herunder koordinere og kvalitetssikre lovhøringer, politiske sager og øvrige bestillinger.

For at trives og få succes i jobbet, er det en fordel, at du:

  • er dygtig til at skrive og god til at formulere dig kort og præcist, både skriftligt og mundtligt
  • kan bevare overblikket, når der er mange opgaver og korte deadlines
  • er imødekommende, god til at samarbejde og kan styre processer med mange bidragsydere og interessenter
  • er initiativrig, vedholdende og selvstændig i din opgaveløsning.
Om os
Skattestyrelsen er Danmarks største styrelse med mere end 5.000 ansatte. I fagområdet Person, som er et af syv fagområder i Skattestyrelsen, er vi ca. 1.000 ansatte, og vi arbejder for at sikre, at alle borgere betaler korrekte skatter til tiden.

Du bliver en del af Persons ledelsessekretariat, hvor vi er ca. 15 ansatte, hvis primære fokus er at understøtte den samlede personledelse, som består af en fagdirektør og seks underdirektører.

I ledelsessekretariatet vægter vi frihed under ansvar og behandler hinanden med tillid og respekt. Gennem involvering i beslutninger og tilrettelæggelsen af arbejdsopgaver sikrer vi høj trivsel og et godt arbejdsmiljø - det er fundamentet for vores arbejde. Vi har en fleksibel arbejdstilrettelæggelse, der giver mulighed for god balance i hverdagen.

Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår
Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning, CV og eksamensbevis via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest den 1. november 2026. Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte kontorchef Rasmus Kamp Kongsted på telefon 72 37 29 99.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag.

Inden ansættelse indhenter vi referencer og straffeattest. Der kan indgå en opgavecase samt et testforløb med personanalyse og logisk test for ansøgere, der går videre i processen.

Hvis du går videre til ansættelse i rekrutteringsforløbet, skal du være opmærksom på, at vi foretager en undersøgelse af, om du har gæld, der er sendt til inddrivelse hos det offentlige. Vi undersøger ligeledes, om du har afgjorte kontrol- og/eller straffesager på skatte- og afgiftsområdet. Din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at vi ikke finder oplysninger om dig, der er uforenelige med en ansættelse i Skatte- og Vækstministeriets koncern.

Forventet tiltrædelse er den 1. januar 2027 eller efter nærmere aftale.

Vi sørger for et struktureret og grundigt introduktionsforløb.

For den rette kandidat med de nødvendige faglige og personlige kvalifikationer kan ansættelse ske som specialkonsulent eller chefkonsulent. Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og It-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for Fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet. Du bliver ansat i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner.

Dit arbejdssted er Sorsigvej 35, 6760 Ribe.

title: Hub Coordinator (Pastoral)
description:
Role: Hub Coordinator
Academy: Outwood Alternative Provision Eston
Start Date: November 2026
Salary (Actual Salary): £25,693 to £26,539 per annum
Working Pattern: 37 Hours Per Week, Monday to Friday, Term Time only plus 5 PD days

We wish to appoint a Hub Coordinator to promote, organise and lead a range of opportunities for our underachieving, disaffected and vulnerable students. Focusing on raising aspirations, promoting ambition, re-engaging in education, closing gaps in academic performance and ultimately reintegrating back to mainstream education. The Hub Coordinator will build and maintain excellent relationships with students as well as parents, carers and third party agencies, in order to put students first and increase their chances of success in and beyond the centre.

Welcome from the Principal:

Outwood Alternative Provision Eston is a unique centre providing a safe and nurturing environment for vulnerable students who exhibit challenging behaviours and are at risk of exclusion. We are a dedicated staff body, passionate about providing bespoke, additional support to every student; ensuring their behavioural, social, emotional, or mental health challenges are not a barrier to success. With smaller class sizes, and an adapted curriculum that supports the needs of our students, we prioritise personal development and student well-being without compromising academic progress. We have unconditional positive regard for our students and consider strong, professional relationships as our first intervention. Our behaviour approach promotes telling the truth, taking responsibility, acknowledging harm and being accountable. Our goal is to ensure that all students can succeed and transition to the next stage of their education with confidence and self-belief. If, like us, you believe every student deserves a champion, and you share The Outwood vision of raising standards and transforming lives, we would be delighted to welcome you to our team.

If you have any questions or would like to visit the school, please contact Faye Stephenson on f.stephenson@eston.outwood.com.

As a Hub Coordinator you must have the ability to work with students and have a real interest in the issues faced by the students. You will monitor and support all students in the cohort, both academically and behaviourally. You will work closely with the Leadership Team on improving student behaviour, attendance and outcomes. Day to day, you will work with students to help them to be the best they can be.

The successful candidate needs to be extremely well organised, IT literate and have excellent communication skills both written and verbal. Applicants should have experience of working in a school environment and have a suitable level of knowledge around the issues affecting young people in the local communitie

Candidates must have experience working within a school environment and possess knowledge of issues affecting students and young people, including how to offer supportive assistance. title: AI Product Owner
description:
AI Product Owner

Türkiye, İstanbul | Hybrid | Permanent | Full-time

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are building a dedicated AI Consulting practice to drive enterprise-wide AI transformation, with a strong focus on the Microsoft AI ecosystem (Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Cowork, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry) alongside the SAP AI ecosystem. We are now looking for an AI Product Owner who will be assigned directly to AI projects and drive them hands-on — from the first conversation with users to a working solution in their hands.

In this role, you are the person in the room with the business. You will listen to their problems and requests, and distinguish what genuinely calls for AI from what is better solved through a process change, standard system functionality, reporting, or classic automation. While you listen, you are already shaping the solution in your head — and you use it to steer the conversation, challenge assumptions, and guide stakeholders toward the approach that will actually work.

You will be the bridge between business users and the development team: turning what you hear into clear requirements, user stories, and solution designs, handing them over to developers, and staying with the project until it delivers value. AI is not purely a developer topic — generative AI can be interpreted, applied, and misunderstood in many different ways. That is why you need to be a confident, hands-on user of Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Cowork, and Copilot Studio yourself, so you can demonstrate, prototype, and discuss realistic options with users instead of talking in abstractions.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Computer/Software Engineering, Management Information Systems, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, or Functional/Solution Consultant in enterprise technology or digital transformation projects
  • Proven hands-on experience with end-to-end ERP business processes — especially Finance and Production, as well as Procurement, Supply Chain, and Sales — gained in ERP projects, as a functional consultant, or as a key user
  • Experience in a manufacturing or industrial company, with a solid understanding of production processes (e.g., production planning, shop-floor execution, quality, maintenance) and how they connect to finance and costing
  • At least 2 years of hands-on involvement in generative AI or AI-enabled projects (e.g., Copilot/LLM-based assistants, AI agents, chatbots, document intelligence) — from discovery through go-live
  • Proven ability to run requirement-gathering sessions with business users and turn ambiguous requests into structured requirements, user stories, and solution designs
  • Active, everyday user of Microsoft 365 Copilot, with hands-on experience building or configuring solutions in Copilot Studio and familiarity with Copilot Cowork and agentic Copilot capabilities
  • Solid understanding of generative AI concepts — LLMs, prompt design, grounding/RAG, agents, evaluation, and limitations such as hallucination — and the ability to discuss them clearly with non-technical audiences
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills; comfortable leading meetings with senior business leaders and developers alike
  • Fluent Turkish and professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot and Power Platform
  • Prior experience in RPA or process automation projects, including process analysis and automation opportunity identification
  • Experience writing prompts, agent instructions, and knowledge sources for AI agents, and designing test sets to evaluate AI output quality
  • Product Owner certification (e.g., PSPO, CSPO) or relevant Microsoft certifications (Copilot, Power Platform, or Azure AI)

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Discovery & requirements: Plan and lead discovery meetings, interviews, and workshops with end users, process owners, and business sponsors on assigned AI projects; listen actively to uncover the real problem behind each request
  • Solution shaping in the room: Form an early solution hypothesis while gathering requirements and use it to guide stakeholders — challenging assumptions, proposing alternatives, and setting realistic expectations about what AI can and cannot do
  • Solution design & handover: Translate business needs into clear solution designs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and agent/conversation flows that developers can estimate and build without ambiguity
  • Technology fit: Recommend the right tool for each use case — Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Cowork, Copilot Studio agents, Power Platform, Azure AI Foundry, or SAP AI capabilities such as Joule — and validate feasibility together with technical leads
  • Hands-on prototyping: Use Copilot, Copilot Cowork, and Copilot Studio yourself to build quick prototypes, demos, and prompt experiments that make ideas tangible and validate them with users before development starts
  • Bridge between business and IT: Act as the single point of contact between users and the development team: own the project backlog, answer questions, manage scope changes, and keep both sides aligned throughout delivery
  • Meeting & project facilitation: Run project meetings end to end — kick-offs, workshops, sprint reviews, demos, and status meetings — with clear agendas, documented decisions, and tracked follow-up actions
  • Generative AI expectation management: Explain generative AI behaviour (non-determinism, hallucinations, grounding, data access and permissions, Responsible AI) in plain language, and agree with users on acceptable quality, risk, and human-in-the-loop controls
  • Testing & acceptance: Define test scenarios and evaluation criteria for AI outputs, coordinate user acceptance testing with the business, and sign off solutions against agreed acceptance criteria
  • Go-live & adoption: Support go-live, user onboarding, and training; collect feedback after launch and turn it into improvement iterations for the development team

title: Community Health Worker
description:
SUMMARY:

The Community Health Worker (CHW) is responsible for helping patients and their families to navigate and access community services, other resources and adopt healthy behaviors. The Community Health Worker is a trusted member of and/ or a person who has an unusually close understanding of the community served in the delivery of health-related services through either working directly with providers or their partner organizations. This trusting relationship with the community enables CHW's to serve as a liaison between health and social services and the community to facilitate members' access to community services and improve the quality and cultural competence of services delivered. CHW's build individual and community capacity by increasing health knowledge and self-sufficiency through a range of activities such as outreach, community education, informal counseling, social support, and advocacy.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Engage, motivate, and advocate community members to build knowledge and skills for self- directed change and community development.
  • Builds and maintains collaborative and positive relationships with community, clinic staff, and clinic partners.
  • Provides outreach and education to individuals or groups on topics related to health and health promotion, which may include health prevention screenings, sexual and reproductive health, communicable disease prevention, testing, vaccination, and support services.
  • Provides information and referrals to community resources necessary to improve health or address health-related social needs. Including, but not limited to, food and nutrition, housing security, economic support, and legal services. If CHW is not directly involved in care management, the CHW will refer to care management team for these referrals.
  • Assists and/or navigating patients in accessing health-related services and community resources, such as appointments.
  • Collects data and information as required by the evaluation plan and processes. Provides feedback to evaluation team and program management on evaluation process issues.
  • Uses assigned technology to complete job functions effectively.
  • Maintain and document confidential information.
  • Reports on program implementation, data of individuals receiving assistance, and client stories sharing highlights, challenges, and recommendations.
  • Provides ongoing support and services for clients as needed.
  • Performs other job duties as required by unit lead

OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • All other duties as required and assigned.
  • Flexible with varying hours based on the needs of the department.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills required for contacts within other departments, patients, families, the community, and medical staff

EDUCATION, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES, AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Education: high school graduate or equivalent required. Medical Assistant Certification preferred
  • Strong project leadership skills with goal orientation. Able to work with professional and technical staff to manage large projects and change activities with minimal business interruption and on-time delivery.
  • Advance understanding of hospital operations and clinical functions.
  • Experience in community work, education, health care, or related field preferred
  • Strong project leadership and implementation skills.
  • Strong analytical skills, able to translate concepts into implementation strategies.

Advance understanding of interfaces

  • Understanding of clinical application support processes and ambulatory EHR workflows
  • A flexible and positive attitude
  • A welcoming and nurturing attitude toward our patient population
  • Strong computer skills and basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel
  • Experience in customer service setting
  • Strong verbal and written communication
  • High level of integrity
  • Proficient PC skill
  • Fluency in Spanish preferred.

Basic Life Support

  • Stooping and bending are required.
  • Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, power tools, and to handle other computer components.
  • Some lifting of more than 50 lbs. may be required.
