title: Policy Lead, AI and the Future of Work
description:
About INCO

INCO is a global social enterprise building a more inclusive and sustainable economy. We have helped more than 500,000 people build skills and connect with jobs, supported over 8,000 small business founders, and run programmes in 140 countries. AI skilling is now at the centre of that work, with a focus on people who face barriers to employment.

Running skilling programmes at this scale showed us a gap. Training providers, employers and governments are making big decisions about AI and work with very little reliable, up-to-date evidence. So we have developed a research and data practice on how AI is changing jobs, skills and small businesses, in Europe and around the world, to inform both our own programmes and public policy.

Our latest report, Europe at Work in the Age of Generative AI, analysed 31.2 million unique job postings from across Europe between 2022 and 2025, alongside hundreds of interviews with jobseekers, employers and academics. It looked at which occupations AI is reshaping, how employers' demands are shifting, and what it takes to make sure under-represented groups are not left behind.

The programme

INCO is launching a three-year programme (2026 to 2029) to track AI's real-world impact on jobs, skills and productivity across all 27 EU member states, and to help governments act on what we find. It runs on three connected workstreams:

  1. A dynamic labour demand tracker built from job postings data, tagged to EU occupation and skills classifications and a new AI-skills taxonomy, refreshed on a regular schedule.

  2. Fieldwork with employers, training providers, unions and public employment services, including a repeated employer survey, sector expert panels and productivity studies with partner employers.

  3. Policy analysis of how governments turn labour market signals into decisions, what has worked, and practical tools such as an open scenario-planning toolkit.

The research is delivered with a consortium of 8 to 15 national research partners, with deep coverage of Germany, France, Spain, Italy and Poland and regional clusters covering the rest of the EU. INCO sets the framework, partners collect the data, and INCO consolidates and publishes.

The role

You will own the research side of the programme from start to finish. That means setting the framework every partner works to, keeping a consortium of experienced researchers aligned and on schedule, and turning 27 national pictures into one credible European one.

Most data collection sits with partners. Your job is to make their work comparable, rigorous and publishable, and to be a peer that senior labour economists and sociologists across Europe take seriously. You will work closely with the Head of Policy Engagement, who takes the findings to policymakers.

Key missions on the programme

  • Set the research framework. Finalise the research questions, indicators, sampling approach, interview guides and analysis framework, and bring them together in one research handbook all partners work from. Own the AI-skills taxonomy and its twice-yearly review.

  • Build and lead the consortium. Help identify and select research partners, shape their scopes of work and budgets, onboard them, and run the working groups and review cycles that keep national work consistent. You will lead partners you do not line-manage, so influence matters as much as authority.

  • Oversee data and methods. Act as the quality owner for the job postings pipeline (Cedefop and Eurostat sources, public employment service feeds, commercial data), tagging accuracy and weighting against official statistics. Steer the occupation-level projections, the employer survey panel and the difference-in-differences productivity studies, working with data engineers and partners who run them day to day.

  • Consolidate and publish. Pool national inputs into comparable EU27 series and lead the cross-country analysis. Own the quarterly data refreshes, five semi-annual reports, policy briefs, the annual flagship report and the final EU27 report in 2029.

  • Ground the scenario toolkit in evidence. Make sure the modelling assumptions behind the open scenario-planning toolkit come from the data and fieldwork, and stand up to scrutiny from the labour agencies and ministries meant to use it.

  • Protect research integrity. Keep the work independent and transparent: published methods, coverage and accuracy by country, null results reported alongside positive ones, and sound ethics and data protection (GDPR) practice across partners.

  • Feed the policy work. Give the policy team clear findings, rapid analysis when a labour market story breaks, and a strong voice in the room at convenings with policymakers, social partners and researchers.

  • Report on progress. Track research deliverables and KPIs, contribute to funder reporting, and manage the research consolidation budget.

What we are looking for

Essential

  • Substantial senior experience in applied research on labour markets, skills, the economics of technology or a closely related field.

  • Publications or reports that are credible to both academic and policy audiences.

  • Strong command of quantitative methods: labour market and vacancy data, survey design, and causal inference such as difference-in-differences and event studies. You need to set standards and challenge partners' choices, even if you are not running every model yourself.

  • Comfort with qualitative research, and a sense of how to combine it with quantitative evidence.

  • Good knowledge of European labour market institutions and data (Eurostat, Cedefop, Eurofound, ESCO, ISCO, Labour Force Survey).

  • Excellent written English, and the ability to explain complex findings plainly to non-specialists.

Nice to have

  • A PhD in economics, sociology, public policy or a related field. Not required if your experience speaks for itself.

  • Hands-on experience with online job advertisement data (for example Lightcast, TalentNeuron or Cedefop's Skills-OVATE).

  • Research experience on AI, automation or the digital economy, and familiarity with the AI Act.

  • An existing network in European labour research, for example at universities, IZA, Bruegel, the JRC, Cedefop, Eurofound or the OECD.

  • Polish or another EU language, and knowledge of Central and Eastern European labour markets.

What success looks like

  • First 6 months: research handbook and AI-skills taxonomy agreed, consortium partners contracted and onboarded, first data release from the tracker.

  • End of year 1: first semi-annual report published and cited by policymakers, with a consortium that works as one team.

  • End of year 3: a flagship EU27 report, a dataset and toolkit others reuse, and a research function INCO can build on.

What we offer

  • A senior role with real ownership of a high-profile European research programme, from design to publication.

  • Work that feeds directly into policy and into skilling programmes reaching hundreds of thousands of people.

  • Hybrid working and regular travel across Europe.

  • A mission-driven international team across INCO's activities.

How to apply

Send your CV, a short cover letter and an example of a policy brief or recommendation you wrote, with a few lines on what it changed.

title: Technical Sales Engineer
description:
Who You Are

FANUC Canada Sales Team is seeking a highly motivated, customer-focused Technical Sales Engineer - General Industry, based in Mississauga, Ontario, to help drive revenue growth and enhance buyer engagement. In this role, the candidate will assess manufacturing automation needs, recommend robotic solutions, and manage technical sales for diverse sectors within the General Industry (GI) market. This person will act as the key technical consultant for clients, helping them optimize their factory automation and production lines with FANUC's world-class robotic technology. This role plays a critical part in translating product capabilities into compelling value stories that resonate with technical and business audiences.

The ideal candidate for the Technical Sales Engineer - General Industry position is a technically proficient and customer-oriented professional with a strong commercial mindset. This individual combines engineering expertise with consultative sales skills to evaluate manufacturing processes, review plant layouts, and identify automation opportunities. They confidently recommend and position the most appropriate FANUC robotics automation solutions to meet each customer's specific application. The successful candidate is a trusted technical advisor who can effectively communicate with end users and integrators throughout the sales cycle.

How It’s Done

  • Actively engage with customers to evaluate manufacturing processes, production layouts and operational bottlenecks and recommend appropriate FANUC robotics automation solutions.
  • Support District Managers with application feasibility assessments, robot selection, payload calculations, reach analysis, preliminary cycle-time evaluations, and overall solution development while coordinating detailed engineering activities with Applications Engineering resources.
  • Lead customer-facing technical sales activities throughout the sales cycle, from opportunity identification, qualification, and solution definition to quotation support, negotiation, and order completion.
  • Assist integrator partners with technical positioning, solution development, and competitive differentiation, ensuring successful alignment between customer requirements, FANUC technologies, and integrator capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to expand the use of FANUC technologies within existing accounts by promoting additional automation solutions, applications, and emerging technologies that support customer growth objectives.
  • Process customer technical inquiries and provide timely responses regarding FANUC products ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Applications teams to define technical specifications aligned with customer requirements and obtain expert technical guidance to ensure accurate and effective solution development.
  • Actively support and lead product demonstrations, proof-of-concept testing, feasibility studies, and customer trials at customer facilities or FANUC locations.
  • Establish strategic relationships with manufacturing leaders, plant managers, engineering teams, operations personnel, and executive decision-makers.
  • Maintain and continuously enhance strong technical expertise in FANUC products, robotics, automation technologies, machine vision, industrial AI, software, manufacturing processes, and industrial applications by staying current with existing and emerging technologies through ongoing training, professional development, and hands-on application.
  • Monitor robotics market trends, competitor activities, emerging automation technologies, and customer needs to drive growth opportunities and strategic sales initiatives.
  • Identify, qualify, and develop robotics and automation opportunities within existing and prospective customer accounts in collaboration with District Managers to support revenue growth and market expansion.
  • Develop preliminary automation concepts, solution architectures, value propositions, and return-on-investment (ROI) analyses to support customer decision-making and project approvals.
  • Participate in account planning and strategic sales initiatives by providing technical expertise, application knowledge, competitive intelligence, and market insights.
  • Work with customers to develop long-term automation roadmaps and identify opportunities for future expansion of FANUC technologies across their manufacturing operations.

What You Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Robotics, Automation, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum three+ years of experience in industrial automation, robotics, manufacturing, machine building, systems integration, or technical sales.
  • Proven experience supporting (or selling) capital equipment, robotics, automation systems, or industrial technology solutions.
  • Experience evaluating customer applications, manufacturing processes, and production requirements to develop effective automation solutions.
  • Proven ability to deliver technical presentations and product demonstrations.
  • Experience presenting and discussing automation solutions with multiple levels of customer organizations, including operations, engineering, manufacturing, and executive leadership teams.
  • Fluency in English (spoken and written) is required

What Would Be Even Better

  • proficiency in French is considered an asset.

It’s Your Move

At FANUC Canada Ltd., we are driven by a deep respect for our people and a commitment to building a workplace dedicated to integrity and excellence. We believe that great careers are built through opportunity, growth, and collaboration—and we’re excited to invite talented individuals like you to explore what’s possible with us.

If you're ready to take the next step in your career, we invite you to apply today. We look forward to learning more about you!

We offer market competitive pay and benefits programs, as well as opportunities for advancement, knowledge and skill development, and recognition of individual achievements. In addition, we offer the following benefits to our employees:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Defined Contribution Pension Plan
  • Short-Term & Long-Term Disability Plans
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Generous Holiday & Vacation Program

More information related to benefits offered by FANUC can be found at the hyperlink attached here.

Sponsorship will not be provided for this position

FANUC Canada is seeking a qualified applicant for a Technical Sales Engineer role. The pay range for this position is $80,000 - 127,000 CAD per year. The pay range listed is based on both salary and other compensation, including bonuses and profit sharing, that an employee may be paid during their employment with FANUC Canada.

A compensation package offered to a successful applicant will ultimately be determined by consideration of a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, an applicant’s geographic location, educational attainment, and level of experience.

title: Chief Information Officer
description:
Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. Our unmatched expertise, partnership, and breadth of products allow us to fine-tune solutions that meet the specific needs of everyone from solo practitioners to larger practices. With AI-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community.

Job Description

As Chief Information Officer (CIO), you’ll lead the technology our teams rely on every day. That includes the systems employees use, the enterprise applications that run our go-to-market and financial operations, our data platform, our corporate website, and our cloud infrastructure.

You’ll lead through strong domain owners, and you’ll stay close enough to the technology to set standards, weigh plans, and ask the hard questions. You’ll work alongside our product general managers, product AI organization, security team, and Finance.

What you’ll do

Set direction and own the enterprise systems estate

  • Set priorities for internal technology against company plans, and hold each domain accountable for delivery.
  • Own our enterprise applications, from CRM and marketing automation through ERP and financials, including the quote-to-cash flow between them.
  • Guide enterprise and data architecture, and lead the integration and data engineers who build it.
  • Run one intake, change-control, and planning cadence so a change in one system doesn’t break another.

Lead operations, data, and IT

  • Lead Enterprise Systems and Revenue Operations, aligning systems ownership with operating responsibility for the go-to-market stack.
  • Lead Cloud Operations across corporate and production environments (AWS and Azure), including availability, performance, cost, and security posture.
  • Lead IT and end-user services: service desk, endpoints, identity and access, Microsoft 365, and Workday administration.
  • Own our Snowflake data platform and integrations, with access governance set jointly with Finance.
  • Own the corporate website, including development, vendor relationships, and change control.

Manage risk, spend, and AI

  • Partner with our security team: you’re accountable for posture and execution, and they set standards and audit.
  • Govern internal process automation and AI agents, including approval gates and production-readiness review, in coordination with the product AI organization.
  • Own the technology budget and major vendor relationships, including planning, negotiation, and ROI.
  • Build and retain a high-performing team with a clear owner for every domain.

What you bring

Required

  • 15+ years in technology leadership, with growing responsibility for teams, programs, and budgets.
  • 8+ years directing technical leaders across multiple disciplines.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise and ERP architecture, data modeling, integration, and data engineering.
  • Experience across enterprise applications and cloud infrastructure, leading through domain owners.
  • Experience leading large-scale technology transformation and consolidation.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and SOC 2 in a regulated, data-sensitive environment.
  • A technical foundation, ideally including early-career engineering experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • SaaS or healthcare experience.
  • Hands-on credibility with modern data platforms such as Snowflake.
  • Contract negotiation experience that protects scope and delivers value.


How you work

  • You explain technology in business terms. You build trust with product, finance, legal, and executive partners.
  • You decide, then hold people accountable. You set direction and empower owners to deliver.
  • You respect the budget. You bring the ROI discipline a finance team expects.

Additional Information

While we've outlined some key qualities we typically seek, it's essential to remember that there might be additional unique strengths and talents you possess that would make you an exceptional match for us, even if they're not explicitly mentioned. Studies have consistently highlighted the significance of this principle, particularly for individuals from disenfranchised backgrounds, including women and other marginalized groups. These individuals often hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement, unlike their male counterparts who are more inclined to apply when they meet around 60% of the criteria.

The message we want to convey is that taking a leap of faith and applying can be incredibly rewarding. Your distinct abilities and perspectives could be exactly what we need to create a more diverse and inclusive team. So, don't hesitate—apply today and let's explore the exciting possibilities together!

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

AtEnsora Health, Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging aren’t just words. We celebrate what makes us unique, foster an ecosystem of inclusion for all and harness our talents to promote diversity of thought and action in everything we do.

We instill Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging into the fabric of our CARING culture and business, as we strive to be recognized not only as the leader in healthcare technology, but also for our intentional efforts to promote a diverse community. ​

​We will champion non-discriminatory practices throughout the employee and customer lifecycle; caring for every person regardless of race, national origin, color, religion, disability, sex, orientation, or familial status.

Ensora Healthis an equal opportunity employer.

title: SAP Solution Architect
description:
Join us in shaping the future of manufacturing technology at Nobia Park!

Do you want to help shape the digital architecture of one of Europe's most automated and sustainable kitchen manufacturing facilities? Our state-of-the-art facility spans 123,000 m², is BREEAM-certified, and features AGVs, ABB robots, and a 2 MW solar power plant. More than just an advanced manufacturing site, Nobia Park is the key part of our digital transformation journey.

We are now looking for a Solution Architect to help drive that journey by designing and governing the solutions that connect our manufacturing, supply chain, and business operations. As new technologies, automation capabilities, and systems continue to be introduced, you will play a key role in ensuring a scalable, connected, and future-ready digital landscape.

About the role

In this role you will help connect our SAP S/4HANA landscape, manufacturing execution systems (MES), and production operations. Working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external partners, you will contribute to strategic development initiatives and the continuous improvement of our digital ecosystem.

Key responsibilities include:

Solution Design & Architecture

  • Design robust, scalable, and secure solutions across SAP and MES environments.

  • Translate business and process requirements into high-level solution designs and architecture.

  • Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles and Nobia's digital strategy.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, process owners and end users to understand needs and identify improvement opportunities.

  • Work closely with solution engineers, architects and product owners to deliver integrated solutions and support future roadmaps.

  • Ensure alignment across systems, domains and business functions.

Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure solutions meet architectural, security, compliance, and governance standards.

  • Contribute to architectural reviews, change management processes, and technical decision-making.

  • Maintain clear documentation and traceability throughout the solution lifecycle.

Continuous Improvement

  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and best practices within SAP, MES, and manufacturing technology.

  • Drive modernization, automation, and system integration initiatives across the manufacturing environment.

  • Identify and remove bottlenecks that impact operational efficiency and order fulfillment.

Location: Nobia Park, Jönköping, with an expected on-site presence of at least three days per week. The role includes regular travel to other Nobia locations.

Who you are

To succeed in this role, you are a skilled and proactive Solution Architect who combines a holistic perspective with a strong technical understanding. You can navigate complex environments and turn business needs into practical, long-term solutions.

Collaboration comes naturally to you, and you enjoy building relationships across different functions and levels of the organization. With a structured and analytical mindset, you thrive in environments where continuous improvement, innovation, and cross-functional teamwork are key to success.

We believe you bring:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, with a strong focus on SAP Supply chain management and MES integration.

  • Proven experience in designing and deploying solutions in manufacturing environments.

  • Solid understanding of SAP modules (e.g., PP, MM, QM) and interfaces to MES platforms.

  • Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills.

  • Ability to balance technical depth with business context in discussions.
    Preferred Skills:

  • Familiarity with common MES platforms

  • Deep technical knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, particularly within configured products and highly automated make-to-order (MTO) environments.

  • Experience with industrial IoT, edge computing, or data lakes is advantageous.

  • Knowledge of agile methodologies and product-centric delivery models.

  • Certifications such as TOGAF, SAP Certified Technology Associate, or similar are a plus.

About Nobia

Nobia is Europe’s leading kitchen specialist, with strong brands such as Marbodal, HTH, Sigdal, and uno form. With us, you will become part of a modern organization where quality, safety, and continuous improvement are at the core of everything we do. We offer excellent opportunities for both professional and personal development. Curious to learn more? Visit Nobia Park – Jönköping.

Want to be a part of our journey?

Then we would like to receive your application in English no later than October 18, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Our recruitment process is competency-based and includes assessments to provide both you and us with the best possible conditions for a successful match. As part of the employment process, you will need to demonstrate your right to work within the EU, for example through a passport or a valid work permit. Background checks and drug screening will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.

If you have any questions, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist Josephine Tjernlund (josephine.tjernlund@nobia.com). We look forward to receiving your application!

  • Contract: Een jaarcontract voor 32 - 36 uur per week met uitzicht op een vast contract;

  • Salaris: min. €3.772,- en max. € 5.413,- bruto (o.b.v. 36 uur p.w.);

  • Extra’s: Eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%), vakantiegeld (8%) en onregelmatigheidstoeslag;

  • Reiskosten: een vergoeding á € 0,21 per km, een fietsplan en gratis parkeren (onder voorbehoud);

  • Pensioenopbouw via Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn;

  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Volop mogelijkheden om je persoonlijk en professioneel te ontwikkelen;

  • Collega aandragen? Ontvang eenmalig een aanbrengbonus van € 500,- netto.


Wat ga je doen?
We zoeken een teammanager voor de twee afdelingen met in totaal 25 bewoners. Je zal ongeveer 19 FTE aansturen.
Als teammanager bij onze locatie Berkenstede ben je verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van zorg en de bedrijfsvoering binnen jouw team. Je werkt nauw samen met een kwaliteitsverpleegkundige en bent dagelijks zichtbaar op de werkvloer. Door aan te schuiven bij huiskamergesprekken met bewoners en gesprekken te voeren met medewerkers, blijf je in verbinding en weet je precies wat er speelt.

Je zult leidinggeven aan twee afdelingen: 1 PG afdeling en 1 eerstelijns verblijf cognitief afdeling. De PG afdeling is in transitie naar open PG en wij zoeken een teammanager die visie koppelt aan daadkracht, teams inspireert en zorgprofessionals meeneemt in deze verandering zodat we samen kunnen bouwen aan een open, liefdevolle en veilige leefomgeving voor mensen met dementie.

Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met collega-teammanagers, behandelaren en het team welzijn. Samen pakken we uitdagingen in de zorg aan. Zo organiseren we per kwartaal een thematafel zodat medewerkers ook uitgenodigd worden om mee te denken.


Onze teammanagers hebben een belangrijke taak: de medewerkers stimuleren om tot bloei te komen en hen faciliteren zodat zij hun werk goed en met plezier kunnen doen. Je inspireert je medewerkers en creëert een sfeer waarin ontwikkelen, continue verbetering en samenwerking de basis is waaruit gewerkt wordt. Op deze manier zorg jij dat je medewerkers kwalitatief goede zorg geven aan hun cliënten. Je uitdaging op deze locatie is verbinding maken in/met het team en het team in beweging krijgen.

En verder:

  • Ben je verantwoordelijk voor de bedrijfsvoering van jouw afdeling. Daartoe lever je maandelijks cijfers aan bij de locatie manager m.b.t. de financiën, medewerkerstevredenheid, verloop etc.;

  • Zorg je ervoor dat vrijwilligers, mantelzorgers en familie wordt betrokken bij het leven van cliënten.

Wie ben jij?
Je bent een teammanager die oog heeft voor zowel de professionele als de persoonlijke ontwikkeling van jouw medewerkers. Je bent in staat draagvlak te creëren voor nieuwe ontwikkelingen in de zorg door verbinding te maken met de bewoners, familieleden, mantelzorgers en medewerkers.

Wat vragen wij verder van je?

  • Ben je in het bezit van een relevant hbo-diploma in de zorg (bij voorkeur verpleegkundige) en een hbo-management diploma (of je bent bereid om deze te volgen);

  • Je hebt leidinggevende werkervaring;

  • Je hebt kennis en expertise van de zorgsector, bij voorkeur in de ouderenzorg;

  • Je staat stevig in je schoenen en kunt goed je grenzen bewaken;

  • Je legt makkelijk verbindingen tussen de mensen met uiteenlopende werkstijlen en bezit coachende vaardigheden;

  • Je bent innovatief en denkt in mogelijkheden.

Waar ga je werken?
Je komt te werken op Berkenstede, een modern woon-, zorg- en dienstencentrum aan de Weespertrekvaart in Diemen-Zuid. De centrale hal is een ontmoetingsplek voor bewoners die daar behoefte aan hebben. Je vindt daar onder andere een grand café, kapper, winkeltje en restaurant.

De Faunatoren heeft vijf afdelingen, waarvan vier gesloten (we zijn in de transitie naar open PG) PG-afdelingen en één ELV-afdeling. We zoeken een teammanager voor twee van deze vijf afdelingen.

Je komt terecht in een betrokken team met een veilige werksfeer. Open communicatie, humor en waardering zorgen ervoor dat iedereen zich prettig voelt. Samen werken we aan de beste zorg voor onze bewoners!
Samen met de locatie manager en drie andere teammanagers vorm je binnen Berkenstede het managementteam. Je komt te werken in een leuk en veilig MT dat veel samenwerkt. We varen allemaal dezelfde koers, zo stellen we gezamenlijk onze jaarplannen op. Iedere dag hebben we een dag start met het MT waarin we onze successen delen en bespreken wat ons die dag te wachten staat.

Enthousiast?
Ben jij de teammanager ouderenzorg die wij zoeken, solliciteer dan direct online! Het sollicitatieproces bestaat uit meerdere gesprekken en een assessment.

Direct na je sollicitatie ontvang je van ons een bevestigingsmail. Mocht je deze niet ontvangen hebben, check nog even je ongewenste postvak. Met geschikte kandidaten gaan we zo snel mogelijk met in gesprek, we sluiten de vacature wanneer wij onze nieuwe collega gevonden hebben.


Voor verdere informatie over de functie kan je contact opnemen met onze recruiter, Marloes Alteveer via malteveer@cordaan.nl of 06-4843 0289.

title: D04-26-02 Postdoctoral Fellow in Data-Intensive Radio Astronomy (f/m/d)
description:
JOIN OUR TEAM

With the German Centre for Astrophysics (DZA), a new research institution is being established in the Lusatia region. The aim is to strategically strengthen German astrophysics, promote scientific excellence, and actively contribute to the structural transformation of the region. As a scientific institution with a model character for innovation, the DZA will create new opportunities for strategic leadership in German astrophysics and will have a lasting impact on the transformation of Lusatia.

The German Centre for Astrophysics (Deutsches Zentrum für Astrophysik, DZA) is establishing a large-scale digital platform for data-intensive astronomy. The DZA Data Centre will serve as the operational and scientific engine across key DZA initiatives, including the German SKA Regional Centre, multi-wavelength science archive, and federated science platforms.

The following position is to be filled at the earliest possible date, fixed-term for 3 years in accordance with Section 2(1) of the German Academic Fixed-Term Contract Act (WissZeitVG):

D04-26-02 Postdoctoral Fellow in Data-Intensive Radio Astronomy (f/m/d)

(Remuneration up to German public service pay grade TVöD Bund E13, depending on personal qualifications.)

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conduct competitive research in galactic or extragalactic astrophysics using radio spectral line and/or continuum observations

  • Contribute to the digital infrastructure shaping exascale astronomy

  • Lead high-impact, peer-reviewed scientific research in galactic astronomy, galaxy evolution, and the interstellar medium (ISM) using radio spectral line and/or continuum observations from precursor/pathfinder facilities (e.g., MeerKAT, ASKAP) and large-scale surveys

  • Develop, deploy, and evaluate modern data-intensive pipelines, AI/ML models and methods, and automated data workflows tailored for radio data and multi-wavelength synthesis

  • Drive user-facing operations by defining science requirements, conducting verification, and delivering user support through documentation, help desks, and community training events

YOUR PROFILE:

  • Ph.D. in Astronomy, Astrophysics, or a closely related field (completed or near completion)

  • Demonstrated record of peer-reviewed scientific publications utilizing radio spectral line (e.g., neutral hydrogen, molecular gas) or continuum observations to investigate galactic structures, the ISM, or galaxy evolution

  • Practical experience or concrete plans applying data-intensive techniques, distributed workflows, or AI/ML models or methods to astronomical datasets

  • Strong collaborative skills and enthusiasm for working in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary, and internationally oriented team

  • Fluency in written and spoken English

DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience working with interferometric radio data, spectral cube analysis, or precursor facilities (e.g., MeerKAT, LOFAR, ASKAP)

  • Familiarity with modern containerized workflows (Docker, Singularity), cloud/HPC environments (Slurm, Kubernetes), and/or astronomy science platforms

WE OFFER:

  • The opportunity to help establish Germany's largest research center dedicated to astrophysics.

  • The chance to actively contribute to the scientific and economic transformation of the Lusatia region.

  • Significant freedom to shape a new research and technology division and contribute to pioneering scientific developments.

  • An international, interdisciplinary, and highly collaborative working environment with leading experts from academia and industry.

  • Competitive remuneration in accordance with the German public service pay scale (TVöD Bund), including annual special payments and an attractive benefits package.

  • Flexible working hours, family-friendly working conditions, and opportunities for part-time employment.

  • Direct access to cutting-edge HPC/cloud resources, AI-ready compute infrastructure, and high visibility within the national and international networks.

This position will report to Dr. Toby Brown, Head of the Astronomy Data Centre at DZA.

The DZA is committed to increasing the representation of women in science and therefore particularly encourages qualified women to apply. Applications from severely disabled persons and individuals with equivalent status under German social law are also expressly welcomed. Where candidates are equally qualified, preference will be given in accordance with the applicable legal provisions.

Please submit your application by 29.11.2026 via our online application portal. Upload your complete application documents (cover letter, detailed CV, copies of certificates, two-page statement on current and future research and a possible starting date) and quote the reference number D04-26-02.

title: Senior Product Manager, Shopping Graph
description:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

The brand graph is part of the Google Shopping Graph. It is used by different teams within Google in support of end user experiences or business experiences that utilize brand data. The brand graph team works on identifying merchant brands, product brands, brand data modeling, and brand life-cycle management. We create the central brand taxonomy that goes into the knowledge graph.

In this role, you will help in defining the future of the Brand Graph to drive its strategy. This is a platform Product Manager (PM) role. You will work with engineers to create platform capabilities and a data layer to enable user facing and business facing application features. You will have cross-(PA) product area collaboration skills, communicate clearly, focus on business impact, and strive for AI-assisted productivity.Users come first at Google. Nowhere is this more important than on our Advertising and Commerce team: we believe that ads and commercial information can be highly useful to our users if that information is relevant to what our users wish to find or do. Advertisers worldwide use Google Ads to promote their products; publishers use AdSense to serve relevant ads on their website; and business around the world use our products (like Google Shopping, and Google Wallet) to support their online businesses and bring users into their offline stores. We are constantly innovating to deliver the most effective advertising and commerce opportunities of tomorrow.
  • Define the goal and strategy for the Brand Graph as part of the Google Shopping Graph.
  • Anticipate and determine brand-related shopping graph capabilities.
  • Understand cross-PA expectations and manage cross-PA collaborations related to the Brand Graph.
  • Work with the development team through design, launch, and post-launch monitoring stages.
  • Partner with Shopping Graph Product Management, UX, Engineering, and Program Management teams to analyze and optimize platform usage in support of AI-driven shopping experiences.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
  • 3 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience rapidly iterating, learning and launching innovative products.
  • Experience launching platform features, establishing clear product requirements, and iterating quickly.
  • Experience working collaboratively with Engineering, Legal, Operations, and partner platform teams on cutting-edge technologies.
  • Experience delivering data platform capabilities across various engineering teams, multiple stakeholders, and needs.
  • Demonstrated ability to make robust, data-driven product decisions.
  • Strong willingness to dive deep into complex technical systems to drive broader strategic decisions.

title: People Business Partner
description:
Samskip is a truly international company that innovates the most advanced sustainable and multimodal international transport solutions. With a turnover of more than 800 million euros, 1,450 employees and offices in 24 countries across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, we are one of the largest transport companies in Europe.
Within this structure, Samskip has shaped a comprehensive European network for short-sea, road, railrail, and inland waterway transport. This network provides pioneering sustainable, reliable and cost-effective options for the growing number of customers who demand more environmentally conscious logistics solutions.

As People Business Partner, you are the local People representative for Samskip's rapidly growing Shared Service Center in Romania. You serve as the first point of contact for employees and managers on all local People-related matters and act as the link between the Romanian organization and the Global People Team.
You ensure that local People processes are executed accurately and compliantly while supporting the continuous development of our employees and organization. While much of the administrative processing is performed by external providers, you will coordinate, review and validate these activities and gradually assume responsibilities currently carried out by local management.

Beyond operational responsibilities, you act as a trusted advisor for employees, helping to foster engagement, wellbeing, and a positive workplace culture.
As part of the Global People Team, you will also contribute to international People initiatives and projects, helping Samskip continue its journey towards a truly integrated global People organization.

Responsibilities

The Romanian Shared Service Center has become a critical part of Samskip's operations and continues to grow rapidly. Establishing a local People presence will strengthen employee support, improve compliance and process quality, reduce dependency on operational management for People-related matters, and create a stronger connection between Romania and the Global People Team.

Local People Operations
  • Coordinate and oversee the full employee lifecycle, including onboarding, contract changes, promotions, transfers, leave administration and offboarding.
  • Act as the local liaison towards external payroll and administration providers.
  • Perform pre- and post-validation of payroll and personnel administration.
  • Ensure employee records are accurate, complete and compliant with local legislation.
  • Support local audits and compliance requirements.
  • Manage and coordinate local People documentation and reporting.
Employee Relations & People Support
  • Serve as the first point of contact for employees regarding People-related questions and concerns.
  • Act as a trusted confidant for employees and support the creation of a positive employee experience.
  • Support managers in handling People-related matters in accordance with company policies and local legislation.
  • Conduct onboarding, check-in and exit conversations.
  • Promote employee engagement and wellbeing initiatives.
Local Expertise & Compliance
  • Provide guidance on Romanian labour legislation and employment practices.
  • Monitor legislative developments and advise the People team on potential impacts.
  • Ensure local compliance with employment law, internal policies and procedures.
  • Support absence management and employee wellbeing processes.
Driving the Local People Agenda
  • Coordinate and execute the annual People calendar within Romania.
  • Support engagement surveys, development initiatives and People programs.
  • Identify local People challenges and improvement opportunities.
  • Build strong relationships with local management and employees.
Recruitment & Talent Support
  • Support recruitment activities for the Romanian operation.
  • Coordinate and participate in mass recruitment campaigns when required.
  • Assist hiring managers in attracting and onboarding new talent.
  • Support employer branding initiatives within the Romanian market.
Global People Projects
  • Participate in cross-functional and international People projects.
  • Support implementation and optimization of global People systems and processes.
  • Contribute local expertise to global initiatives.
  • Collaborate closely with colleagues across the Global People Team.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration or a related field.

title: Vendor Personnel
description:
Shift – 24*7 (Rotational)

Critical Infrastructure Engineer – Reliability & Infrastructure Analytics – For backlog and proactive gap fixing (L2/L3)

Role Purpose

The Critical Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for monitoring, managing and improving the reliability of critical infrastructure supporting telecom and data centre operations. The role focuses on ensuring high availability of power, cooling and environmental systems while proactively identifying infrastructure risks, recurring alarms and opportunities for permanent corrective action. The engineer is expected to move beyond reactive incident handling by driving backlog reduction, equipment refresh planning and long-term infrastructure reliability improvements. This aligns with the current CI direction of moving from repeat break-fix to asset-led preventive management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of Critical Infrastructure Engineers/Technicians, ensuring effective shift coverage, operational governance, coaching, workload balancing and adherence to operational standards.
  • Analyze infrastructure trends and proactively identify recurring alarms, noisy sites, aging infrastructure and operational gaps impacting service reliability.
  • Drive Top Talker analysis, identify recurring failure patterns and develop permanent corrective action plans to eliminate repeat alarms and unnecessary dispatches.
  • Review historical incidents, alarm trends and backlog tickets to identify systemic issues and recommend engineering improvements.
  • Prepare and present analytical reports, dashboards and executive summaries highlighting recurring issues, infrastructure risks, equipment performance and operational improvements.
  • Identify End-of-Life (EOL) / End-of-Support (EOS) equipment, evaluate operational risk and prepare structured equipment refresh and replacement plans for management review.
  • Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Vendors and Field teams to drive permanent remediation, equipment replacement and closure of long-pending infrastructure issues.
  • Maintain ownership of backlog reduction initiatives and ensure ageing tickets are continuously reviewed, tracked and driven to closure.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities for automation, operational efficiencies and proactive monitoring enhancements. This aligns with the CI objective of moving from repeat break-fix to asset-led preventive management.

Additional Required Skills

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret operational data, identify trends and convert findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Ability to identify recurring alarms, noisy sites and infrastructure risks using data analysis and operational reporting.
  • Strong leadership and people-management skills with experience managing technical teams, conducting coaching sessions and driving operational governance.
  • Excellent documentation skills with the ability to create and maintain detailed operational records, RCA reports, equipment history, maintenance documentation and knowledge articles that can be used for future troubleshooting, audits and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to prepare executive-level reports and present infrastructure risks, backlog analysis, EOL/EOS recommendations and permanent-fix roadmaps to management.
  • Strong stakeholder-management skills with the ability to coordinate effectively across Operations, Engineering, Vendors, OEMs and Field teams.

Preferred Experience

  • Must have prior experience leading technical teams in a Telecom, Data Center or Critical Infrastructure environment.
  • Experience preparing SOPs, MOPs, RCA documentation, equipment history records, maintenance logs and audit documentation.
  • Experience working with BMS/DCIM/EMS platforms and infrastructure monitoring tools.
  • Exposure to asset lifecycle management, equipment refresh programs and preventive maintenance planning.
  • Experience analyzing recurring infrastructure incidents and implementing permanent corrective actions.

Key Deliverables

  • Reduction in recurring alarms and noisy sites through permanent corrective actions.
  • Proactive identification and reporting of infrastructure risks, ageing assets and EOL/EOS equipment.
  • Improved infrastructure reliability through analytical trend monitoring and preventive maintenance.
  • Reduction in backlog and ageing infrastructure tickets.
  • Comprehensive documentation and knowledge repositories that improve future troubleshooting, onboarding and operational continuity.
  • Strong team performance, governance and continuous coaching to improve operational maturity.

title: Vacature Ervaren Paraveterinair/ Vestigingsverantwoordelijke AniCura Dierenkliniek Rotterdam
description:
Ben jij een ervaren paraveterinair die graag meer verantwoordelijkheid neemt en verder kijkt dan de dagelijkse werkzaamheden in de kliniek? Zie je kansen om werkprocessen te verbeteren, collega's verder te helpen en de organisatie naar een hoger niveau te tillen? En heb je de ambitie om door te groeien naar een rol als vestigingsverantwoordelijke? Dan is dit jouw kans!

Voor AniCura Dierenkliniek Rotterdam zoeken we een ervaren allround paraveterinair voor 32 uur per week, die zich verder wil ontwikkelen richting leidinggeven en praktijkmanagement.

Deze nieuwe functie biedt je de kans om jouw rol samen met ons vorm te geven. We kijken naar jouw ervaring en kwaliteiten, maar ook naar waar onze klinieken behoefte aan hebben. Zo kun je niet alleen jezelf ontwikkelen, maar ook daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan de verdere groei en verbetering van onze organisatie.

Wat ga je doen?

Je combineert jouw werk als allround paraveterinair met een bredere rol in de organisatie van de kliniek. Je blijft betrokken bij de dagelijkse praktijk en krijgt daarnaast de ruimte om meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en verbeteringen door te voeren.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Meewerken in de kliniek: je ondersteunt de dierenartsen, collega's en cliënten en blijft betrokken bij de dagelijkse patiëntenzorg.

  • De dagelijkse organisatie verbeteren: je denkt mee over werkprocessen, planning en samenwerking en neemt initiatief om zaken slimmer en efficiënter in te richten.

  • Collega's ondersteunen en enthousiasmeren: je draagt bij aan een prettige werksfeer, helpt collega's verder en neemt het voortouw waar dat nodig is.

  • De vestiging verder ontwikkelen: je signaleert kansen om de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening en de samenwerking binnen het team te verbeteren en helpt deze ideeën om te zetten in concrete acties.

  • Managementervaring opdoen: je krijgt de mogelijkheid om meer coördinerende en leidinggevende verantwoordelijkheden op je te nemen, passend bij jouw ontwikkeling en de behoeften van de kliniek.

De precieze invulling van je werkzaamheden bepalen we in overleg. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om je kwaliteiten te benutten en je verder te ontwikkelen binnen de kaders en visie van AniCura.

Een nieuwe functie die je zelf mee vormgeeft

Het bijzondere aan deze functie is dat je niet in een vastomlijnde rol stapt. We zoeken iemand die graag meedenkt, kansen ziet en het leuk vindt om samen met ons te ontdekken hoe deze functie de meeste toegevoegde waarde kan bieden.

Waar kunnen werkprocessen efficiënter? Hoe kunnen we de samenwerking binnen het team versterken? En welke veranderingen helpen ons om de zorg en organisatie verder te verbeteren?

Je krijgt de ruimte om hierover mee te denken en zelf het voortouw te nemen bij verbeteringen. Uiteraard doe je dit in samenwerking met collega's en het management, met begeleiding die past bij jouw ervaring en ambities.

Ook de werklocatie bepalen we in overleg. Samen bekijken we waar jouw kwaliteiten het beste tot hun recht komen en waar je de meeste impact kunt maken binnen onze klinieken in Rotterdam.

Werken bij AniCura Dierenkliniek Rotterdam

Je komt terecht in een veelzijdige organisatie met meerdere vestigingen, waar we zowel eerste- als tweedelijnszorg bieden. Binnen onze organisatie werken 19 dierenartsen en 25 paraveterinairen samen aan goede diergeneeskundige zorg.

We bieden een werkomgeving waarin verschillende expertises samenkomen en waar ruimte is om van elkaar te leren. Je werkt samen met ervaren collega's en het management aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze klinieken.

Wie zoeken wij?

We zoeken een ervaren paraveterinair die de dagelijkse praktijk goed kent en klaar is voor een bredere rol binnen de kliniek.

Je herkent jezelf hierin:

  • Je bent een gediplomeerd paraveterinair en beschikt over een geldige CIBG-inschrijving.

  • Je hebt ruime ervaring als allround paraveterinair en weet wat er nodig is om een kliniek goed te laten draaien.

  • Je neemt initiatief, ziet kansen voor verbetering en neemt hierin het voortouw.

  • Je communiceert gemakkelijk, werkt graag samen en weet collega's op een positieve manier mee te nemen.

  • Je kunt overzicht houden, prioriteiten stellen en schakelen tussen de dagelijkse praktijk en organisatorische vraagstukken.

  • Je hebt interesse in leidinggeven, teamontwikkeling en praktijkmanagement. Ervaring met leidinggeven is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een functie met ruimte voor initiatief: je krijgt de kans om ideeën aan te dragen en verbeteringen daadwerkelijk door te voeren.

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden richting vestigingsverantwoordelijke: je bouwt ervaring op met coördinerende en leidinggevende verantwoordelijkheden.

  • Een afwisselende functie voor 32 uur per week: je combineert je vak als paraveterinair met organisatorische werkzaamheden.

  • Een werklocatie in overleg: samen bepalen we welke locatie het beste aansluit bij jouw kwaliteiten en de behoeften van onze klinieken.

  • Een ervaren en betrokken team: je werkt samen met collega's die zich dagelijks inzetten voor goede diergeneeskundige zorg.

  • Begeleiding en ontwikkelmogelijkheden: we kijken welke ondersteuning en opleidingen passen bij jouw volgende stap.

  • Een moderne werkomgeving: onze klinieken beschikken over diverse diagnostische en behandeltechnieken, waaronder digitale röntgen, echografie, bloedanalyse en CT.

  • Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden: een passend salaris op basis van jouw ervaring en verantwoordelijkheden, deelname aan het pensioenfonds en volledige vergoeding van de reiskosten.

Klaar om jouw ambities waar te maken?

Wil jij jouw ervaring als paraveterinair inzetten om niet alleen goede zorg te leveren, maar ook bij te dragen aan een beter georganiseerde en verder ontwikkelende kliniek?

We maken graag kennis met je. Vertel ons wat jou motiveert, welke ideeën je hebt en hoe jij jezelf in deze nieuwe functie ziet groeien.

Wil je eerst vrijblijvend meer weten? Neem dan contact op met:

Cynthia de Graaf - HR
06 – 44 25 28 21
hr.rotterdam@anicura.nl

Sabrina Noordanus - Talent Acquisition Specialist
06 – 27 44 21 26
sabrina.noordanus@anicura.nl

Je kunt natuurlijk ook direct solliciteren met je cv en een korte motivatie.

title: Local Fitness Gråsten – 15 timer
description:
Local Fitness Gråsten – 15 timer

Stillingsbeskrivelse:

Er du god til at skabe overblik, tage ansvar og møde både medlemmer og kolleger med et smil? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter! Vi søger en centeransvarlig til ca. 15 timer om ugen til vores center på Bomhusvej i Gråsten. Stillingen kan både være på fleksjob eller ordinære timer, og der vil på sigt være mulighed for flere timer. Dine primære opgaver bliver rengøring og den daglige drift, men du får også ansvar for bl.a.: – Opfølgning på personalets opgaver og vores app – Personaleplanlægning og møder – Mails fra kundeservice og håndtering af underretninger – Opfølgning på sygemeldinger – Medvirken ved ansættelser i samarbejde med nærmeste leder – Fast værtstid i centeret – Rundvisning og hjælp til nye medlemmer – At være centerets ansigt udadtil.

KRAV: Dansk – Tale/ skrive/ forstå – øvet Uddannelse: Jobbet kræver ingen uddannelse, men har du erfaring fra lign. job er det helt klart en fordel. Arbejdstid: Foregår i tidsrummet mandag til søndag fra: 07.00-20.00 (Arbejdstiden aftales nærmere med arbejdsgiver) Frigørelsesattest: Ja Om jobbet: Som centeransvarlig bliver du den, der sikrer, at centrene altid fremstår indbydende, rent og velfungerende Du bliver bindeled mellem medlemmer, instruktører og områdeleder – og du spiller en central rolle i at skabe den gode stemning, som vores medlemmer elsker. Om dig: Vi leder efter en person, der: – Er mødestabil, selvstændig og positiv – Sørger for at centrene fremstår rengjorte og indbydende – Har lyst til at tage ansvar og skabe gode oplevelser for andre – Trives i et aktivt miljø og elsker at møde folk med et smil – Ikke er bange for at tage fat og give en hånd med, hvor der er brug for det – Har du erfaring med træning, instruktørarbejde eller lyst til at stå for hold, er det et kæmpe plus – og kan give mulighed for flere timer.

Er du interesseret i at blive formidlet til stillingen, bedes du kontakte din rådgiver i fleksjobteamet eller ringe til Sønderborg Kommunes hovednummer på 88 72 64 00 og bede om fleksjobteamet.

title: VMO Analyst
description:
We want to move from a PMO framework to a VMO-based model.
The VMO Analyst’s mission is to add value by creating transparency, supporting/driving information flow and facilitating decision making across our change community and ecosystem. You’ll do this in an environment where we acknowledge that priorities can change, you’ll lead and support rather than control and you’ll focus on the sustainable flow of value and outcomes.

The VMO Analyst’s role will be at the centre of building and establishing a new Value Management Office (VMO). Building this capability is not just about delivering change projects and dashboards. This will be helping to shape and build a new Change operating model. The focus will be on identifying and nurturing the flow of change outcomes and flexibility that add value to Cash Access and to its customers and builds talent, capability and innovation.

Responsibilities


Overview

The VMO Analyst will support the effective management of CAUK’s Change & Transformation portfolio, providing clear, accurate and insightful information to help leaders make better decisions about investment, priorities, capacity, delivery and benefits.

Working within a new, small, collaborative VMO, the role will combine portfolio analysis, governance, reporting, continuous improvement and building new capabilities. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with data, challenging information constructively and turning complex portfolio information into simple, actionable insight. This is a hands-on role in which the individual will help establish and continuously improve CAUK’s approach to portfolio management.

Key accountabilities include:

Portfolio Management & Analysis
  • Building and maintaining robust rolling portfolio planning, roadmaps and cadence in relation to approved change and transformation priorities in adherence with all relevant frameworks, controls, processes and best practice.
  • Analysing portfolio data to identify trends, emerging issues, capacity constraints, dependencies and delivery risk and driving conversations and action with impact leaders and stakeholders
  • Producing portfolio insights and recommendations for senior leaders and governance forums.
  • Supporting portfolio prioritisation and investment discussions through robust analysis and evidence.
  • Helping maintain an enterprise view of change demand, delivery capacity, resource modelling and strategic priorities.
  • Supporting quarterly and annual portfolio planning and re-prioritisation activity
  • Aligning to and developing an enterprise VMO Change Framework, standards and governance (to be defined and shaped), leading through Lean Portfolio Management (e.g. PI Planning) techniques with multiple stakeholders and the wider CAUK change community.
  • Driving collaborative (1st line) risk/assurance activities for projects and teams resulting in course corrections and improved quality.
  • Leading enterprise-wide value (costs/benefits/value) culture and behaviours, working with key business partners on financial performance, value-sizing, budgeting and forecast outturn
Governance and Reporting
  • Coordinating and producing high-quality portfolio reporting and management information.
  • Preparing materials for portfolio governance, investment and leadership forums.
  • Ensuring portfolio information is accurate, timely, consistent and appropriately challenged.
  • Tracking decisions and actions through to completion.
  • Supporting effective governance by ensuring that the right information is available at the right time.
  • Building Change & Transformation reporting, metrics and optics, ensuring they drive insight, are transparent and continue to promote portfolio performance whilst building and optimising appropriate tooling, dashboards and templates.
Financial and Benefits analysis
  • Establishing and supporting tracking of change investment, budgets, forecasts and financial performance.
  • Working with Finance and delivery teams to identify and explain material variances.
  • Supporting benefits tracking, including the identification of expected, realised and at-risk benefits.
  • Helping provide clear insight into whether the portfolio is delivering the value expected from investment.
Risk, dependency and delivery insight
  • Maintaining portfolio-level views of key risks, issues and dependencies.
  • Identifying themes and systemic issues that may not be visible within individual initiatives.
  • Escalating emerging concerns appropriately and support the development of mitigation actions.
  • Providing insight into portfolio health, delivery confidence and areas requiring leadership intervention.
VMO Capability and Continuous Improvement
  • Developing and improve VMO templates, processes, dashboards and management information.
  • Helping establish consistent standards for portfolio reporting and governance.
  • Automating and simplify manual reporting wherever practical.
  • Supporting the development of VMO capability across CAUK by sharing tools, guidance and good practice.
  • Contributing to ongoing evolution of VMO from a reporting function into a proactive value add portfolio
  • Driving team engagement, alignment and communication
  • Promoting a learning organisation in the Change ecosystem (Growth mindsets, Flexible T-shaped profiles, ‘trying stuff’) – upskilling, cultural and behavioural development
  • Playing a lead role in shaping and delivering the target state operating model for enterprise-wide Change

Requirements


Role specific skills
  • Track record of leading in a PMO, VMO, portfolio, programme, change or business analysis environment.
  • Strong analytical thinking, curiosity and problem-solving skills – uses data and evidence to understand problems, identify trends and make sound recommendations. Seeks to understand the story behind the data.
  • Strong verbal and written colleague and stakeholder communication, able and comfortable to report to varied stakeholders, facilitating decision making with participants and senior leaders – able to demonstrate turning complex information into concise, clear messages appropriate for different audiences.
  • Organisation and delivery – manages deadlines effectively and maintains a high standard of accuracy.
  • Experience demonstrating agile leadership and using Lean Portfolio Management tools (tooling) & techniques in order to understand problem statements, continuous improvements and business requirements/features
  • Collaboration – builds effective relationships across business, change, finance and other functions.
  • Strong people leadership and coaching outcomes, resulting in a motivated, energised and focused team – able to energise groups and individuals with flexible people management skills
  • Able to demonstrate negotiation, facilitation, conflict resolution and consultation skills
  • Comprehensive understanding of risk process, standards and procedures
  • Experience of working with technical and non-technical SMEs across a variety of domains
  • Experience of working with agile teams (desirable)
  • Autonomy, self-starting and self-organising, often with limited oversight and in a dynamic and ambiguous environment
  • Continuous improvement – looks for better, simpler and more efficient ways of working rather than simply maintaining existing processes.
  • Knowledge of and ability to keep pace with leading change delivery practices and tooling (incl. 3rd party)
  • Learning agility – is comfortable working in a changing environment and developing new skills and approaches.
  • Commercial and value focus – understands that portfolio management is ultimately about maximising value from investment and organisational capacity.

title: Specialist - Tech Capability (PAPM)
description:
INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT

Chalhoub Group’s Capability Hub is our technology and innovation hub set up with the vision to unite exceptional talent to build technology and capabilities that elevate luxury experiences and define the future of luxury retail.

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

What you'll be doing

This role will be accountable for maintaining stability and operational continuity within an SAP Finance environment ensuring tight SLAs, clear ownership, and minimal business disruption. In their endeavour to excellence, the fundamental values all our employees must possess are Commitment, Integrity, Empathy and Flexibility.

SAP Operational Readiness

• Drive the transition of Finance support services and country management from Oracle to SAP, ensuring business continuity, knowledge transfer, and platform stability during and after go-live.

• Establish scalable, structured BAU processes to support SAP post-implementation, including incident, change, enhancement, and user support workflows.

• Coordinate with the SAP programme team to ensure smooth handover into IT operations, and future-proof support and optimization models. Operational Excellence and Agile Execution

• Design, configure, and implement SAP PAPM solutions to support profitability analysis across shared services and country management support functions.

• Establish and embed a governance framework for SAP post go-live enabling continuous improvement, controlled backlog management, and full visibility on change investment decisions. People, Culture and Capability Building.

• Enable a culture of cross-functional collaboration and shared ownership across IT and Finance teams.

• Continuously enhance SAP PAPM to ensure the accuracy and timeliness of financial performance reporting, enabling informed decision-making across the organization.

• Serve as the strategic liaison between Technology and Finance, ensuring clarity and alignment on transformation initiatives, investment plans, and support capabilities. Finance Data, BI and Analytics Enablement

• Deliver high-quality, real-time financial reporting capabilities to support key stakeholders.

• Simplify and standardize data models, promoting a “single source of truth” approach, while leveraging bots, AI-driven automation, and auto-reconciliation to improve efficiency and accuracy.

• Ensure seamless integration between SAP PAPM and other SAP modules including S/4HANA Finance, Controlling (CO), and Sales & Distribution (SD) & RPA’s.

Technical Solution Design and Implementation Capabilities

• Design PaPM models, allocation logic, driver-based costing, and other performance analytics scenarios.

• Configure SAP PaPM environments, including data sources, rules, allocations, and integrations.

• Able to work on PaPM solutions on Cost Allocations, Transfer Pricing, Pillar 2 and other use cases.

• HANA Native Skills: Proficiency in SAP HANA Data Modeling using HANA

Studio/WebIDE, including building Core Data Services (CDS) Views and understanding AMDP (ABAP Managed Database Procedures).

• Good exposure on Remote Function Calls (RFC), Smart Data Access (SDA) / Smart Data Integration (SDI), OData services.

• Ability to injest data into DataSphere and export/use the same in PaPM.

• Database Querying: Strong working knowledge of SQL scripting for data manipulation and troubleshooting within HANA.

• Familiarity with cloud storage techniques like Azure BLOB storage, Amazon S3 bucket or Google Big Query (GBQ).

What you’ll need to succeed

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering/technology, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting SAP PAPM or SAP Profitability and Cost Management (PCM).

• Strong understanding of profitability analysis concepts, cost allocation methodologies, and performance management frameworks.

• Proven experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling modules.

• Expertise in data modeling, allocation rules configuration, and profitability calculation logic within SAP PAPM.

• Demonstrated ability to translate complex business requirements into technical PAPM solutions.

• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret financial data and provide strategic recommendations.

• Strong communication skills in English.

What we can offer you

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.

Using GenAI in Your Application Process

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

We Invite All Applicants to Apply

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

title: Software Engineer, ios
description:
Get to know the team

Empowered by teamwork, we develop services and tools to serve millions across Southeast Asia. You will be reporting to Engineering Manager II. We offer a on-site role and bases it in Bangalore.

You will develop technical documentation, including code comments, architecture diagrams, and technical guides. You will troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, using debugging tools and techniques to identify and fix problems. You will stay up-to-date with the latest iOS development trends and tools, and apply this knowledge to improve development processes and product quality

The Essential Skills You Will Need:

title: Senior Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Engineer to join our team in Brazil.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

  • Safety & Governance: Implement "Human-in-the-Loop" (HITL) escalation interfaces, confidence thresholds, and strict egress controls to prevent data exfiltration. Ensure all AI solutions comply with security, data privacy, and responsible-AI standards
  • Optimization: Configure "Agent Overrides" and token optimization strategies (e.g., "balanced" vs. "perfectionist" consumption) via configurable workflows
  • End-to-End Development: Lead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI systems across Data Science and AI Engineering domains Contribute hands-on to development activities, from experimentation and prototyping to production-grade implementation
  • Architecture & Pipelines: Architect and implement scalable AI pipelines and LLM-driven applications, including RAG, orchestration, and multi-agent systems

  • Ecosystem Integration: Integrate AI services with enterprise platforms (e.g., Confluence, Jira, GitHub, CRM, ERP) and ensure seamless interoperability
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional engineering, data, and product teams to align technical solutions with client and business objectives
  • Innovation: Drive innovation through internal frameworks and accelerators

Requirements:

  • AI Ecosystem: Extensive experience with Python, LangChain, and LangSmith; familiarity with the Prodigy framework is a significant advantage

  • Data Architecture: Practical experience with Vector Databases (ChromaDB, PGVector) and building ETL "Data Engines" for secure agent consumption via MCP
  • Infrastructure: Understanding of containerization (Docker/K8s) and isolated runtimes such as Firecracker MicroVMs for agent sandboxing
  • Integration: Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise identity providers like WorkOS for multi-tenancy
  • Workflow Orchestration: Experience with Temporal for managing long-running, multi-stage agentic workflows

Desirable:

  • Domain Expertise: Familiarity with Commercial Real Estate workflows (Lease accounting, CAM reconciliation)
