title: Head of Transformation & Implementation
description:
Purpose of the Role



  • The Head of Transformation & Implementation is responsible for translating the Group’s strategic priorities into successful, measurable business outcomes.
    Working closely with senior leadership, the role will lead the Group’s transformation agenda, ensuring that major strategic, operational and technology initiatives are clearly prioritised, effectively implemented, and deliver their intended benefits.
  • This is a hands-on leadership role combining strategy, execution, change management and organisational improvement. The successful candidate will be expected to challenge existing ways of working, simplify processes, drive accountability, and ensure the organisation moves from identifying opportunities to delivering results.
  • The role will lead the central transformation and implementation capability while working through functional leaders who remain accountable for embedding change within their respective business areas.


Key Responsibilities


Transformation

  • Translate Group strategy into a clear portfolio of transformation initiatives, priorities, and implementation plans.
  • Establish a Group-wide transformation roadmap with clear objectives, milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes (KPIs).
  • Support leadership to prioritise resources focused on initiatives with the greatest strategic and financial impact.
  • Identify dependencies, risks, obstacles and competing priorities across the transformation initiatives.
  • Provide concise reporting to the COO, senior leadership and governance forums.

Implementation & Delivery

  • Facilitate the successful implementation of major cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution to final implementation.
  • Establish clear accountability for delivery across business functions using appropriate project management frameworks.
  • Provide guidance where programmes are delayed, objectives are unclear, or accountability is insufficient.
  • Ensure initiatives deliver sustainable business change rather than temporary project outputs.
  • Implement a disciplined, simplified, delivery framework without unnecessary bureaucracy.

Business Process Transformation

  • Identify opportunities to simplify and improve end-to-end processes across, for example, Trading, Operations, Shipping, Risk, Finance and Corporate functions.
  • Drive standardisation, automation and elimination of manual activities.
  • Redesign processes around business outcomes rather than organisational silos.

Technology, Data & AI Transformation

  • Partner with Technology, Data and business leaders to align technology investment with business strategy.
  • Support tech leadership to identify opportunities for AI, analytics and automation to improve productivity and decision-making.
  • Ensure technology programmes are adopted and deliver measurable business value.

Organisational and Cultural Change

  • Support leaders in embedding organisational and process change.
  • Identify organisational barriers to process change and improvement; work with leadership to address them.
  • Support in running the Corporate Transformation Team programme – organisation, execution and implementation.


Performance Measurement

  • Define measurable business benefits before initiatives are approved (define the ‘why’).
  • Track delivery against business cases and financial targets.
  • Develop transformation KPIs covering delivery, productivity, cost, and business impact.
  • Ensure completed initiatives transition successfully into business-as-usual ownership.


Key Result Areas


Success in the role will be measured primarily by outcomes rather than project activity, including:


  • Delivery of strategic transformation priorities on time and against agreed objectives.
  • Financial benefits and productivity improvements realised.
  • Reduction in manual processes and organisational complexity.
  • Improved end-to-end processes across the trade lifecycle.
  • Successful adoption of new technology, data, and AI capabilities.
  • Reduction in project delays and failed or underperforming initiatives.
  • Improved accountability and execution across transformation programmes.
  • Sustainable transfer of completed initiatives into business-as-usual operations.


Personal skills and behaviours required for success in the role


  • Strong leadership, analytical and communication skills.
  • High levels of impact and influence. Able to influence others without direct line authority.
  • Goal oriented, tenacious and results driven.
  • Highly resilient and agile.


Skills and experience necessary for success in the role


  • The successful candidate will combine strong commercial judgement with exceptional execution capability. They should be comfortable operating between strategy and detailed implementation and able to influence senior stakeholders across a complex international organisation.


  • Experience in commodity trading, energy, financial markets, or another transaction-intensive environments would be highly advantageous.


The individual should demonstrate:


  • Significant experience leading complex business transformation and implementation programmes.
  • Strong understanding of commodity trading or comparable front-to-back business processes.
  • Ability to work effectively with Leadership across Trading, Operations, Risk, Finance and Technology teams.
  • Strong commercial and financial judgement.
  • Experience delivering technology-enabled business transformation.
  • Ability to simplify complex problems and translate strategy into executable plans.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, including at senior leadership level.
  • A track record of challenging established practices while bringing people with them.
  • High levels of ownership, engagement, and personal accountability.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability.

title: Senior Microsoft 365 Engineer
description:
POSITION: Senior Microsoft 365 Engineer (Identity, Endpoint & Compliance)

We’re hiring the engineer who’ll own the Microsoft 365 platform at WellStreet, in an environment where identity and data governance are HIPAA obligations and not checkboxes. The governance you put in place is what we’ll run on, and how it gets managed is yours to define.

A week in this job:

Monday you’re designing the sensitivity label taxonomy and the DLP policies that enforce it across Exchange, SharePoint and Teams. Tuesday a clinical vendor needs SSO and SCIM, so you stand it up, and you’re the one who catches that their deprovisioning webhook never fires. Wednesday you close quarterly access reviews on privileged groups, driven off a Graph script you wrote instead of a spreadsheet somebody emails around. Thursday a Critical CVE lands from SecOps and you own the triage and the clock. Friday you take the Intune configuration that has only ever existed in an admin center and get it into the repo.

What you’ll own:

  • Entra ID: tenant architecture, Conditional Access, hybrid identity, privileged access, password protection and SSPR, access reviews
  • Intune: tenant configuration across Windows, macOS, iOS and Android. Compliance and configuration profiles, security baselines, Autopilot, update rings, app packaging.
  • Exchange Online, Teams and SharePoint: tenant configuration, mail flow, transport rules
  • Purview: DLP, sensitivity labeling, retention, audit configuration, eDiscovery, and HIPAA and HITRUST control mapping
  • Enterprise Applications: SSO and SCIM across the portfolio, plus the standard that no app touching PHI runs on standalone credentials
  • Defender: endpoint detection and response on every managed device, Defender for Office 365 anti-phishing and threat investigation, and the unified alert view across the M365 estate. Defender for Servers, Defender for Cloud, and Defender for Identity — the workload security surface — sit with infrastructure.
  • Vulnerability response: CVE triage from SecOps, remediation tracking, weekly report
  • The application portfolio: an accurate catalog, runbooks that work, and the vendors in your domain held to their SLAs and their BAAs

Where the lines are:

Your world is Microsoft 365 and the people who use it: identity for humans, endpoints, collaboration, and governance of the data your users create. Azure cloud infrastructure, the applications running in it, and workload identity sit with our infrastructure side. Entra ID is shared, since it’s identity for both halves, and we split it by what the identity represents — people are yours, machines are theirs. The same split carries into Defender: endpoint and email protection are yours, workload protection on Servers, Cloud, and Identity is theirs.

This job has depth, autonomy and a lot of engineering in it, but the depth runs toward M365 and not toward Azure. If you’d rather be building infrastructure, we’d both prefer to find out now.

How we work, and where we’re going:

Today this tenant is managed largely by clicking in admin centers. That’s what we’re hiring you to change.

We’re building toward version-controlled, API-driven management in an Azure DevOps repo, with Graph and PowerShell as the primary instruments, app-only auth and Key Vault instead of interactive logins, and Python or declarative tooling where they earn their place. We have no illusions about how far that goes, since parts of the M365 surface have solid config-as-code coverage today and parts don’t. What we’re after is that opening a portal becomes a deliberate exception.

We’re not asking for prior GitOps-on-M365 experience. That market barely exists and the tooling is mid-shift. We’re asking for the instinct and the judgment; the specific tooling we’ll work out together.

We use AI heavily across engineering, administration and documentation, and we expect fluency with it, including a clear sense of what has to be reviewed before it touches a tenant holding PHI.

What we need:

  • Five or more years in M365, identity or security engineering, with tenant-level depth in Entra ID and Intune
  • Real Purview configuration experience: writing DLP policies, labeling, retention, eDiscovery. Not just familiarity.
  • Microsoft Graph and PowerShell fluency. This is the one hard technical gate. You automate by default and you’ve built real things against the API. Python is a plus.
  • Version control is where your work lives, and branches and pull requests are normal practice for you
  • You’ve worked against a regulated framework, whether HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2 or PCI, and you can explain a control instead of just naming it
  • You use AI daily and can say where you trust it and where you check it

Nice to have:

Terraform, Bicep or Azure DevOps pipelines. Any exposure to declarative M365 management: Microsoft365DSC, a Terraform M365 provider, the Graph Tenant Configuration Management APIs. Healthcare IT. Owning a vulnerability or patch compliance program. FreshService or a comparable ITSM. ITIL v4. SC-200, SC-300, SC-400, MS-102, MD-102.

Why take this job:

Real platform ownership, plus the mandate and the backing to build an engineering practice around it: version control, review and automation in place of tribal knowledge and portal archaeology. You’re the first dedicated hire for this function, so you’re setting standards instead of inheriting a decade of somebody else’s. As we add engineers, this seat is the obvious lead.

About WellStreet Urgent Care

WellStreet Urgent Care is committed to providing the highest quality patient and customer care. Our technology team plays an important role in supporting the people, systems, and operations that allow our urgent care centers to deliver exceptional service to our patients and communities.

In addition to the above requirements, WellStreet is looking for team members with the following qualities:

  • A positive attitude toward patients, families, and coworkers.
  • Willingness to go the extra mile to create an outstanding experience for customers and to train and lead the center team to do the same.
  • A desire to work in concert with others in an upbeat and supportive atmosphere while reinforcing the WellStreet mission to provide uncompromising service.
  • A compelling desire to serve others, improve your community's health, and have fun every day.

As the platform team, we ensure the uptime and performance of Flink always at 99.99%, provide a cost-effective managed service and also helping the users to debug their Flink application.

Get To Know The Role

As a Lead Platform Engineer, you will lead the design, evolution, and operation of Grab's stream processing platform, with Apache Flink as a core compute engine. You will drive medium to large projects across Data Engineering Platforms, mentor senior engineers, and be a technical go-to person for platform architecture, reliability, and production operations. You will be hands-on across Flink, Kafka, Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, observability, and SRE practices.

You will work onsite at Grab Singapore office, One North, and report to the Head of Engineering, Data Engineering Platforms

Why This Role Matters

Apache Flink is a critical real-time infrastructure layer for Grab. By making stream processing easier, safer, and more self-serve, you will help unlock more real-time signals and turn data into business values across Grab.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Lead platform work that makes stream processing easy, reliable, efficient, and secure across Grab through self-serve capabilities built into the platform.
  • Design and build abstractions, modules, and libraries that lower the barrier to adopting Flink and reduce operational and security toil for users.
  • Improve automation and self-service workflows that allow a small platform team to support many production Flink pipelines at scale.
  • Drive technical design discussions, production readiness reviews, incident learning, and long-term architecture improvements.
  • Partner with Kafka, data lake, metrics, and data governance platform teams to make real-time data pipelines reliable across the broader Grab data ecosystem.
  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, debugging sessions, code reviews, and operational best practices.

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • Minimum of 5 years leading teams or projects in software engineering, data engineering, or platform engineering disciplines.
  • Experience building and operating stream processing pipelines in production with Apache Flink or Spark Streaming.
  • Hands-on engineering experience with Kafka and modern programming languages such as Scala or Java.
  • Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, scalable data processing, reliability engineering, and production operations.
  • Leading technical design, mentor engineers, communicate trade-offs, and lead projects from design to production.

The nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with Kafka Connect, Kubernetes, Go, GitLab CI, AWS, or Terraform.
  • Experience building reusable platform abstractions, SDKs, deployment tooling, or self-service workflows.
  • Experience operating Apache Flink in production, including high availability, checkpointing, safe deployments, and incident response.
  • Experience with a data warehouse or data lake ecosystem such as Spark, Parquet, Iceberg, Delta, or Hudi.

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For at Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Vær med fra starten – bliv studentermedhjælper i Forsvarets nye 3D-print kapacitet
company: Forsvarsministeriet Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelsen ved FPS Ballerup
description:
Vær med fra starten – bliv studentermedhjælper i Forsvarets nye 3D-print kapacitet

Kan du se mulighederne inden for ”Additive Manufacturing” (3D-print), og ser du dig selv i en stilling med brugerunderstøttelse, drift og netværksdannelse? Hvis det er dig, så glæder vi os til at modtage din ansøgning i Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse.

Om os

Forsvaret står midt i en tid, hvor den sikkerhedspolitiske verdenssituation har accelereret den militærteknologiske udvikling, og hvor teknologi og innovation har taget en plads i førersædet. Der er derfor brug for nye kræfter til at drifte og varetage de opgaver, som skal løses via nytænkning og teknologi.

Stillingen er placeret i det nyoprettede kapacitetscenter 3D-print hvor vi arbejder for, at muliggøre brugen af 3D-print til operativt behov, som f.eks. kan være print af midlertidige reservedele, samt understøttelsen af printere og scannere.

Kapacitetscenter 3D-print er blandt fire teams i afdelingen Analyse og Udvikling, hørende under Supply Chain Divisionen. Her har vi til opgave at understøtte en moderne og effektiv Supply Chain, ved at håndtere projekter inden for udvikling af Supply Chain, automatisering, teknologi og analyse. Vi består af ca. 20 ansatte, sammensat af civile og militære medarbejdere, med vidt forskellige baggrunde og kompetencer. Dette ser vi som en af vores største styrker.

Vi har en stor berøringsflade eksternt med Forsvarets enheder og internt i Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse, samt et bredt samarbejde inden for NATO og European Defence Agency (EDA).

Vi tilbyder en fleksibel hverdag, med stor mulighed for selv at planlægge opgaver og tilrettelægge arbejdsrutiner.

Om stillingen

Du kommer til at supporte opbygningen af kapacitetscenter 3D-print, hvor du skal bidrage til at styrke og supporte anskaffelser inden for 3D-print i hele koncernen, samt strukturere brugen af 3D-print med operativ effekt i hele Forsvaret.

Du skal kunne bistå med den praktiske del af 3D-print som fx teknisk tegning, udvikling af prototyper og 3D-print. Sidst skal du kunne supportere brugerne, og støtte ved rekvirering af 3D printere, materialer m.m.

Du vil få mulighed for at skabe en bred kontakt til vores kollegaer på Forsvarets værksteder og operative områder, hvor du skal være god til at danne relationer og opbygge et stærkt samarbejde, for at forstå soldaternes behov og problematikker med reservedele og 3D-print.

Vi forventer, at du som minimum kan arbejde 15 timer om ugen i gennemsnit, og vi sammen med dig finder en balance mellem arbejdsdage og dit studie.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du er i gang med en relevant akademisk uddannelse, eksempelvis som ingeniør. Det er en fordel hvis du har erfaring fra uddannelsen eller en produktionsvirksomhed, hvor du har arbejdet med 3D-print, og du har praktisk erfaring med scanning, teknisk tegning samt udvikling og bearbejdning af 3D-filer.

Som person er du nysgerrig og initiativrig. Du tager ansvar og kan arbejde selvstændigt. Du har en systematisk og organiseret tilgang til dine opgaver, og trives med faste driftsopgaver. Du formulerer dig klart og præcist skriftligt og mundtligt såvel på dansk som engelsk.

Du bliver en succes i stillingen, når du, sammen med teamet, understøtter etableringen af 3D print som en attraktiv og stærk kapacitet, og du bidrager positivt til afdelingens trivsel. Vi tilbyder en stilling, hvor du bliver udfordret på dine kompetencer og får ansvar inden for rammerne af et studiejob.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Som bachelorstuderende sker ansættelsen i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK-overenskomsten).

Din ansættelse som studentermedhjælper på HK-overenskomsten er betinget af, at du er aktivt studerende og kan dokumentere, at du er indskrevet ved en højere læreanstalt eller ved en mellemlang videregående uddannelse (MVU) på en professionshøjskole eller tilsvarende institution.

Ansættelsen er tidsbegrænset til og med endt bacheloruddannelse på HK-overenskomsten.

Som kandidatstuderende sker ansættelsen i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademikeroverenskomsten).

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg.

Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Arbejdsstedet er i Ballerup.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet. Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Kontakt og ansøgning

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionschef Jeppe Foshammer på telefon 2335 4333 eller via mail FMI-SC-SUV12@fiin.dk (efter 1. november 2026 er mailen FMI-SC-CH3D@fiin.dk).

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Louise Goul Avnegaard på telefon 3266 5838.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 8. november 2026. Vi forventer at holde samtaler løbende.

Stillingen er til besættelse pr. 1. december 2026.

Du søger stillingen via linket og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og kopi af uddannelsesbevis. Vær opmærksom på at bilag skal tilføjes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse

Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) er en styrelse under Forsvarsministeriet.

FMI har ansvaret for det samlede forsvars og beredskabs materiel, IT og cybersikkerhed. Det er os, der anskaffer, driver og bortskaffer materiel og IT for såvel Hæren, Søværnet, Flyvevåbnet, Arktisk Kommando, Specialoperationskommandoen, Hjemmeværnet, Beredskabsstyrelsen og resten af Forsvarsministeriets koncern. Desuden bistår vores IT-medarbejdere dagligt i at modstå de cyberangreb, Forsvarsministeriets koncern udsættes for. Vi er ca. 2500 medarbejdere (3/4 civile - 1/4 militære) fordelt ud over hele Kongeriget, med hovedkontorer i henholdsvis Ballerup, Brabrand og Hvidovre.

title: ETK koordinator
description:
Er du skarp på koordinering, detaljer og sagsbehandling, så er jobbet her måske netop noget for dig.

Om os

Frømandskorpset er Danmarks maritime specialoperationsstyrke med hjemsted i Kongsøre skov ved Isefjorden. Vi har et unikt fællesskab kendetegnet af stærk faglig dedikation, loyalitet og åbenhed. Dette er afsæt for et godt, fleksibelt og effektivt samarbejde, både internt i Frømandskorpset og med vores mange eksterne samarbejdspartnere. Det maritime element er vores styrke, men vi færdes også på land og via luften. Vores opgaver spænder bredt over offensive, stabiliserende og forebyggende missioner i internationalt såvel som i nationalt regi. Frømandskorpsets stolthed ligger i at gennemføre specialoperationer på højeste niveau – til gavn for Danmark. Frømandskorpset er en selvstændig myndighed, som er underlagt Specialoperationskommandoen.

Om stillingen

Stillingen som etablissementskoordinator er placeret under Frømandskorpsets Garnisonselement. Opgaverne er primært inden for det etablissementsmæssige område, herunder: administration af den daglige drift som indrapportering af fejl til Partnerelement Kongsøre – administration af håndværkere, Frømandskorpset, Partnerelement Kongsøre og Søværnets Dykkertjeneste. Administration af byggeprojekter og vedligeholdelse af garnisonens bygninger samt udenoms arealer. Stillingen indeholder en høj grad af sagsbehandling inden for ovenstående områder. Stillingen giver gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling, og du får samtidig mulighed for at have stor indflydelse på din dagligdag.

Om dig

Du er engageret, med rutine i sagsbehandling og du behersker anvendelsen af work-zone. Du er god til at planlægge, er helhedsorienteret og du lader dig inspirere til nye udviklingsretninger i din opgaveløsning. Du har fokus på det gode samarbejdsmiljø, er proaktiv og følger selv dine opgaver til dørs. Du har gode diplomatiske- og kommunikative evner både i skrift og tale. Du vil være Frømandskorpsets primære sagsbehandler inden for etablissementsområdet og er derfor den daglige koordinator mellem Frømandskorpsets chef og det lokale partnerelement. Det vil naturligvis være en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til Garnison Kongsøre. Du har lysten til at have et selvstændigt ansvar, og har erfaring inden for etablissement.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) samt organisationsaftalen for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere.

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Dit daglige arbejdssted er Odsherred.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.


Kontakt & ansøgning

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte chef for T&G på mail: FKP-CHTG@MIL.DK

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesforhold, kan du kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Silke Cicilia Rasmussen, på telefon 2043 1029.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 30. oktober 2026 og samtaler forventes at blive afholdt løbende. Stillingen er til besættelse hurtigst muligt.

Du søger stillingen via linket, og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og kopi af uddannelsesbevis. Vær opmærksom på, at bilag skal vedhæftes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed styrker opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede – uanset baggrund – til at søge stillingen.

Om Etablissement- og Terrænkommando

Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen (ETK) støtter og servicerer militære og civile myndigheder under Forsvarsministeriet. Vores opgave er at levere og udvikle attraktive fysiske rammer, som er nødvendige for deres daglige virke.

Vi bygger nyt, vedligeholder, driver kantiner og gør rent på tjenestesteder i hele landet.

Vi har på vegne af Forsvarsministeriets koncern ansvaret for det grønne område, der blandt andet omfatter miljø, energi og naturpleje.

Vores hovedkontor er i Hjørring, men vi har medarbejdere i hele landet. Vi er i alt 1600 ansatte, der tæller både civilt og militært ansatte. Vi er en organisation baseret på stærke fagfællesskaber, og vi prioriterer det tværgående samarbejde højt.

  • Vi har ansvaret for over 600 lokationer spredt ud over hele Danmark.
  • Vi administrer over 6000 bygninger og forvalter øvelsesområder, der samlet set er på størrelse med Mors.
  • Vi bygger og vedligeholder i år for knap en milliard og er blandt andet bygherre på store projekter som campus til de nye F35-kampfly.

title: Medical Officer, MCTHP | PATH
description:
• Location: Port Moresby, PNG

  • Commencement: November 2026

  • Duration of contract: Up to 31 December 2027

  • Open to PNG Citizens only

About the Program

Papua New Guinea (PNG) is among the 30 highest-burden countries for tuberculosis (TB) and drug-resistant TB (DR-TB). Children account for more than 20% of reported TB cases, almost double the global average of 11%, and HIV incidence is rising, particularly among women of reproductive age. Port Moresby General Hospital (PMGH) carries much of this burden. In 2025 it recorded its highest-ever number of child TB cases (~1,200), diagnosed and started on treatment, many of them who reside in the NCD but also referred from Central, Gulf and other provinces.

The Maternal-Child TB/HIV Project (MCTHP) is implemented by the Paediatric Society of PNG (PSPNG) in partnership with PMGH and the UPNG School of Medicine and Health Sciences. It is managed by the PNG-Australia Transition to Health (PATH) program with support from the Australian Government. Its aim is to reduce morbidity and mortality from TB, HIV and TB-related malnutrition among children and mothers in PNG.

About the Opportunity

The project is recruiting a TB&HIV Medical Officer (MO) to support its current priorities:

  • strengthening the TB/HIV cascade of care
  • expanding TB preventive treatment (TPT) among children with HIV
  • re-engaging children living with HIV who have been lost to follow-up
  • preventing mother-to-child transmission of HIV
  • decentralising care for children with HIV & TB
  • Support the MCTHP team in the diagnosis and care of peri-natal women in the O&G unit with presumptive and active TB disease

The MO will work primarily in the Paediatric Well Baby Clinic alongside a team. providing clinical care to children with HIV and integrating TB services such as TPT. MO will have support from other HCW’s and MO will be asked to provide direction and leadership to the team

Beyond PMGH, the MO will run regular outreach to NCD Basic Management Units (BMUs). There they will mentor clinic staff so that children with HIV and/or TB can receive care closer to their home with fewer hospital visits for their families. This will be done with training and support from the MCTHP and PHA partners (NCD-PHA, CP-PHA, etc). The MO will also visit antenatal and HIV clinics to strengthen prevention of mother-to-child transmission (PMTCT) and referral pathways for HIV-exposed and HIV-infected children, and will support outreach to PHA’s

Key Responsibilities

The expected outcomes are:

  • Clinical care of children and families affected by TB and HIV
  • Oversee that the proper registers (contact tracing, presumptive TB, preventive therapy) are filled out and completed. This will be done in conjunction of other members of the team
  • Deliver activity reports and contribution to projects report and presentation, as demonstrated in data recording, analysis and reported on time and to a professional standard
  • Support O&G Colleagues for workup and management of peri-natal women with presumptive TB
  • Provide outreach support to provinces outside of the NCD in conjunction of other members of the team
  • Maintained strong and productive relationships with key staff and counterparts and received satisfactory feedback on performance.

Key working relationships

  • The MO will report directly to MCTHP Program Manager and will be accountable to the MCTHP SMO & PMGH Paediatric Coordinator
  • The MO will be based at PMGH and help coordinate activities between the paediatric HIV clinic (Well Baby Clinic), the JBK TB Clinic and the maternal TB team. As such, the MO will report to and work closely with different departments (Paediatric, Internal Medicine, Obstetrics & Gynaecology) at PMGH
  • MO will provide leadership and oversight to the MCTHP and PMGH team to carry out activities
  • Perform fine needle aspiration and gastric aspiration when required
  • Implement nutrition assessment (MUAC, WFH) indicators at paediatric WBC
  • Attend routine management meetings
  • Compile and collect project data and ensure accuracy, and provide write up and reports when needed (annual reports, etc)

About You

For applications to be considered, a response to the key selection criteria below must be provided.

  • Strong experience with minimum of 2 years experience as Medical Officer

  • Must be a qualified Medical Officer with additional higher qualifications in O&G will be considered an advantage.

  • Exceptional communication skills in building relationships with partners and clients and a proven ability to work independently and as part of a team.

How to Apply

  • Please ensure to address the Key Selection Criteria (About You) in your cover letter, and submit your application online, along with your CV as a single document.

  • Applications must be submitted personally by individuals only. Applications submitted by a company or organisation will not be accepted.

  • The successful applicant will be engaged through an employment agreement determined by Abt.

We welcome and thank all applications; however, only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Closing Date: Sunday, 1 November 2026 (Midday, local time) #LI-AUSBRIT

Abt Global is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to upholding high standards of Child Protection, Anti-bribery and Fraud Protection.

We encourage applications from experienced and capable women, and people with disabilities

title: Senior Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Engineer to join our team full-time in India.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

Responsibilities:

  • Agent Development: Design, build, and test production-grade agents (e.g., Lease Abstraction, CAM Reconciliation) using the Prodigy framework as a baseline
  • SDK & Gateway Engineering: Develop a lightweight Python SDK to interface between agents and the platform Control Plane, abstracting complex LLM routing to providers like AWS Bedrock and Anthropic
  • Knowledge Engineering: Build and configure RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) knowledge bases and GraphDB mappings to provide agents with secure, domain-specific context

title: Intern (Compliance)
description:
Are you ready for your next play? We are bold, respectful, and we deliver, with Impact. Our long-term vision is to raise, deploy and manage funds for climate change mitigation and adaptation that will play a transformative role in our target sectors.

Climate Fund Managers (CFM) is a climate-focused blended finance investment manager operating in emerging markets across Africa, Asia, and Latin America.


We raise and deploy blended climate finance funds, working in partnership to deliver climate-resilient solutions at scale and pace. With over USD 2.8 billion in assets under management, our private equity and private credit facilities address key areas of climate change mitigation and adaptation, including: renewable energy; energy transition and green hydrogen; water, waste and maritime; and sustainable cities and the built environment.


We currently have 50 active projects across our Climate Investor One, Two and Three equity funds and have recently expanded into private credit through the GAIA Climate Loan Fund. Our funds are supported by public and private sector organisations. Public capital is deployed strategically to balance risk and mobilise private sector capital, enabling investment across the project lifecycle - from development to construction and operation.


Established in 2015, we are a joint venture between Dutch development bank FMO and Sanlam InfraWorks of the Sanlam Group of South Africa, with offices in The Hague, Cape Town, Singapore, and Bogotá.


The Role
The Intern will support the Compliance team in strengthening Climate Fund Managers' compliance framework, regulatory governance, integrity risk management processes, and operational effectiveness.


This role provides a valuable opportunity to gain practical exposure to compliance, regulatory oversight, governance, and control activities within an international investment management environment. Working closely with members of the Compliance team, the intern will contribute to a range of projects aimed at enhancing efficiency, improving controls, supporting regulatory compliance, and building scalable compliance processes. The role requires strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, organisational skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.


Key Duties and Responsibilities


  • Support the redesign of our integrity risk processes by improving existing workflows and tools,
    addressing gaps, and eliminating duplicate work.
  • Develop checklists and decision trees to support the integrity risk processes we manage.
  • Create dashboards and tracking tools for regulatory checks and ongoing compliance
    monitoring.
  • Assess opportunities to automate recurring controls and routine compliance activities.
  • Assist with developing templates for reporting and memorandum preparation.
  • Conduct sample testing of compliance files to verify completeness and accuracy.
  • Support the development of training modules, onboarding checklists, and
    compliance/regulatory workflows.
  • Assist with the creation of a compliance and regulatory knowledge library.
  • Support with meetings and oversight tasks in the procurement/delegates process.
  • Support with creating compliance control frameworks.
  • Provide support with selected coordination tasks as required.


Required Qualifications and Experience


  • Recently completed, a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law, Compliance, Risk Management,
    Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated interest in compliance, regulatory affairs, governance, risk management, or the
    financial services/investment management industry.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret information and identify
    trends, gaps, or improvement opportunities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • High level of attention to detail, organisation, and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and
    PowerPoint.
  • Experience with data analysis, reporting tools, SharePoint, or process-mapping tools would be
    advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively, manage multiple tasks, and take initiative in a
    professional environment.


What We Offer
Exposure to a range of compliance and governance activities, the intern will gain practical experience in regulatory compliance, risk management, stakeholder engagement, process optimisation, and compliance operations, while contributing to the continued development of a strong compliance culture across CFM.


Behavioural Competencies


  • Accuracy: Effective handling details information and being consistently attentive to details.
  • Devotion to Quality: Demanding a high quality of provided products and services, acting
    accordingly.
  • Stress Resistance: Being able to handle stress.
  • Planning: Systematically organizing activities and setting time frames, setting priorities.
  • Analysing and Forming Opinions: Being focus on examining matters in a systematic way.
  • Result-oriented: Being focused on achieving objectives and results, persevering in the face of
    adversity.
  • Listening Skills: Being able to gather important information through verbal communication,
    obtaining clarification by asking questions.
  • Service Oriented: Being focused on supporting others in achieving their objectives.

title: (Basis) Psycholoog | Rotterdam
description:
(Basis) Psycholoog – Rotterdam

24 uur per week

Wil jij als behandelaar écht verschil maken? Bij VIVIQ krijg je de ruimte om impact te hebben, op jouw manier. Bij VIVIQ geloven we dat goede zorg voor iedereen beschikbaar moet zijn. Daarom behandelen we naast cliënten op onze vestigingen ook een deel van de digitale wachtlijst, zodat we samen de zorg toegankelijk houden. Samen met een betrokken team help je cliënten vanuit jouw expertise én met aandacht voor de mens achter de klacht. Dankzij onze slimme digitale ondersteuning en efficiënte organisatie houd jij overzicht en rust in je werk.

Wat ga je doen

Bij VIVIQ draait het om behandelen, begeleiden en écht contact maken. Als psycholoog geef je richting aan herstel, met een holistische blik op Positieve Psychologie en Gezondheid. Van daaruit bied je zowel expertise als coaching aan je cliënten. ‘Kort waar kan, lang waar nodig’ is een uitspraak waar jij vorm aan geeft door hen tools te bieden waarmee ze op eigen kracht verder kunnen komen. Je voert zelfstandig behandelingen uit, dit ga je doen:

  • Uitvoeren van (delen van) diagnostiek en intakegesprekken;

  • Behandelen van cliënten binnen de Basis GGZ via digitale consulten;

  • Toepassen van evidence-based behandelmethoden (zoals CGT, ACT, EMDR, schemagerichte interventies);

  • Werken met digitale en blended behandelmodules en e-health tools;

  • Afstemmen en samenwerken met collega’s en regiebehandelaren;

  • Actief deelnemen aan intervisie, reflectie en teamoverleg;

  • Bijhouden van ontwikkelingen binnen het vakgebied en deze toepassen in je werk én persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Je bent een (ervaren) basispsycholoog met een warme, open houding en voelt je thuis in zowel fysiek als digitaal behandelen - afhankelijk wat er nodig is. Je maakt gemakkelijk contact, ook online, en weet een veilige behandelrelatie op te bouwen. Gelijkwaardigheid en eigen regie van de cliënt staan bij jou centraal. Je blijft nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe behandelvormen én naar jezelf als professional.

Je beschikt over:

  • Een afgeronde WO-opleiding Psychologie;

  • Een geldige BAPD en LOGO-verklaring;

  • Ervaring met online behandelen en/of blended zorg;

  • Kennis van en ervaring met één of meerdere doelgroepen binnen de Basis GGZ;

  • Bij voorkeur aanvullende scholing (bijv. CGT, ACT, EMDR, schematherapie).

Wat bieden wij jou

Je sluit je aan bij een enthousiast en vernieuwend team met een missie: de GGZ toegankelijker, efficiënter en menselijker maken. Je werkt hybride vanuit huis en een fysieke locatie in Rotterdam. Je krijgt:

  • Inschaling volgens CAO GGZ;

  • Een werkweek van 24 uur, flexibel in te richten;

  • Ruime opleidingsmogelijkheden (in-company, individueel opleidingsbudget);

  • Ondersteuning door een fijn team met korte lijnen, veel kennisdeling en betrokkenheid;

  • Toegang tot moderne middelen om blended of volledig digitaal te werken;

  • Werken in een ecosysteem met partners die co-creatief bouwen aan een toekomst waarin mensen minder afhankelijk zijn van langdurige GGZ.

Over VIVIQ

Wij geloven dat geestelijke gezondheidszorg beter kan. Sneller, persoonlijker en effectiever. Bij VIVIQ bieden we Basis en Specialistische GGZ, fysiek, digitaal of blended. Digitale behandelingen zijn bij VIVIQ geen ‘extra’, maar een volwaardig onderdeel van zorg waarmee we wachttijden terugdringen en cliënten sneller in beweging brengen. Onze aanpak is gebaseerd op Positieve Gezondheid, eigen regie en herstelondersteuning. We helpen mensen in beweging te komen vóórdat het echt misgaat, zodat ze sterker uit hun traject komen dan ze erin gingen.

Meer weten of solliciteren?

Nieuwsgierig naar deze rol of naar werken bij VIVIQ? Mail gerust naar hr@viviqggz.nl. Nog beter: klik direct op solliciteren, dan plannen we vanuit HR een vrijblijvend kennismakingsgesprek met je in waarin we de eerste vragen kunnen beantwoorden!

title: Product Security Engineer
description:
Product Security Engineer

Location: Bangalore, India
Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Overview

We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled Product Security Engineer to help strengthen and scale our Product Security program across a diverse portfolio of products and operating companies.

This role will be responsible for managing key application security tools, supporting secure software development practices, driving product security metrics and reporting, and partnering with engineering teams to integrate security throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).

A significant focus of this position will be helping to normalize AI Security within existing Product Security processes, ensuring AI-enabled products and services are developed, assessed, measured, and governed using consistent security standards. The successful candidate will work closely with development teams, security stakeholders, and operating companies to improve security visibility, drive adoption of security best practices, and provide meaningful security insights through metrics and reporting.

Key Responsibilities Product Security
  • Partner with software engineering, architecture, DevOps, cloud, and product teams to integrate security throughout the SDLC.
  • Support secure design reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability management, and remediation activities.
  • Provide guidance and consultation on secure software development practices.
  • Assist operating companies in adopting and maturing Product Security standards and processes.
  • Support product security assessments for new technologies, platforms, services, and applications.
Security Tool Ownership and Administration
  • Serve as a primary administrator and subject matter expert for application security tooling, including:
    • Static Application Security Testing (SAST)
    • Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST)
    • Software Composition Analysis (SCA)
    • Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation and management
    • Container security scanning
    • Dependency and supply chain security tools
    • Secrets detection and related security technologies
  • Support onboarding, configuration, maintenance, and optimization of security platforms.
  • Work with engineering teams to integrate security tooling into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows.
  • Evaluate new security technologies and recommend improvements to the Product Security tool ecosystem.
Metrics, Reporting, and Governance
  • Partner with operating companies to collect, validate, analyze, and report Product Security metrics.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and executive reporting.
  • Track and report on key metrics including:
    • SAST coverage
    • DAST coverage
    • SCA adoption
    • SBOM generation and availability
    • Vulnerability remediation performance
    • Security testing coverage
    • Secure development compliance
    • Product Security program maturity
  • Identify trends, risks, gaps, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual Product Security reporting activities.
AI Security Integration
  • Help define and operationalize AI Security requirements and controls within the SDLC.
  • Partner with engineering teams developing AI-enabled products and services to promote secure AI development practices.
  • Assist in establishing AI Security metrics, monitoring, and reporting capabilities.
  • Support governance activities related to AI risk management, model security, data protection, prompt security, and responsible AI practices.
  • Drive the integration of AI Security controls, governance requirements, testing approaches, and metrics into existing Product Security processes, ensuring AI-enabled products are evaluated, measured, and reported using the same disciplined approach applied to traditional software security programs.
Automation and Continuous Improvement
  • Develop scripts and automation capabilities to improve Product Security workflows, data collection, reporting, and operational efficiency.
  • Support integrations between security tools, source control platforms, and reporting systems.
  • Contribute to the development of repeatable processes, documentation, standards, and operational procedures.
  • Assist with internal audits, customer security reviews, and compliance activities as required.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
  • Strong understanding of software development principles and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices.
  • Knowledge of application security concepts, secure coding practices, and vulnerability management.
  • Familiarity with application security technologies including:
    • SAST
    • DAST
    • SCA
    • SBOM generation and management
    • Container and dependency scanning
    • Secrets detection and related security tools
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple teams and operating companies.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting or administering application security platforms such as Veracode, Snyk, CodeSonar, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Familiarity with GitHub, GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD development practices.
  • Experience developing scripts and automation using Python, PowerShell or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with AI security concepts, secure AI development practices, and AI governance frameworks.
  • Experience creating security dashboards, metrics programs, and executive-level reporting.
  • Knowledge of OWASP Top 10, EU AI, CVSS, NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF), and modern application security best practices.
  • Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, GSEC, GWAPT, Security+, or equivalent are desirable.
Success Factors
  • Passion for securing modern software products and emerging AI technologies.
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to manage initiatives with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to build effective relationships across engineering, product, and security teams.
  • Data-driven approach to measuring security performance and driving continuous improvement.
  • Ability to translate technical security findings into actionable business insights.
  • Commitment to helping teams deliver secure, resilient, and trusted products at scale.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of Product Security and AI Security, helping embed security into every stage of product development while advancing the organization's secure adoption of AI technologies.

title: Videnskabelig assistent til forskningsprojekt med fokus på bevægelse i skolen
description:
Vi søger en engageret videnskabelig assistent til en 3-årig stilling ved Institut for Idræt i Forskningsgruppen Movement & Learning ved Institut for Idræt og Ernæring, Københavns Universitet. Stillingen er en 75% ansættelse i relation til nyt forskningsprojekt om bevægelse i skolen. Der er mulighed for opregulering til 100% alt efter kvalifikationer der kan understøtte andre opgaver ved instituttet (fx undervisning eller andre forskningsprojekter).

Som videnskabelig assistent vil du blive en del af projektet ”Partnerskab for idræt og bevægelse i skolen” støttet af Center for Sundt Liv og Trivsel, hvor instituttets forskningsgruppe er en af flere partnere. De andre partnere er bl.a. Dansk Skoleidræt, Danske Skoleelever, Skolelederforeningen m.fl., men også forskningspartneren Steno Diabetes Center i København. Partnerskabet arbejder for at implementere bevægelse i skoledagen på deltagende skoler. Ikke kun nogle årgange på skolen, men for alle på skolen, dvs. med helskoletilgang. Denne forandringsproces og udvikling bliver forskningsmæssigt undersøgt på flere niveauer, men som videnskabelig assistent i projektet skal du fokusere på elevernes udvikling.

Du skal være med til at undersøge på elevniveau, hvordan en helskoletilgang med bevægelse i skolen (WSA-PA) bidrager til elevers trivsel, læring og sundhed. Der anvendes et Difference-in-Differences-design til at undersøge, om elever på skoler, der implementerer WSA-PA, har en mere positiv udvikling i trivsel, læring og sundhed end elever på sammenlignelige skoler.

Individuelle elevmålinger indsamles før og efter to års implementering af WSA-PA blandt elever i 4., 6. og 8. klasse. Effekterne på trivsel, motivation, faglige præstationer, kognition og fysisk aktivitet vurderes ved at sammenligne ændringer over tid mellem WSA-PA-skoler og sammenlignelige skoler.

Se evt mere

Vi tilbyder dig

  • Et spændende og innovativt forskningsprojekt i et stærkt akademisk miljø
  • En åben og inkluderende arbejdsplads med engagerede kollegaer
  • Spændende professionel og personlig udvikling
Vores forskningsgruppe
Som videnskabelig assistent vil du indgå i Forskningsgruppen Movement & Learning som ledes af Lektor Jacob Wienecke. I den forskningsgruppe vil du blive en del af et mindre forskningsteam der har hovedfokus på læring af motoriske færdigheder og læring i skolefagene (akademisk præstationsevne fx i matematik eller dansk) samt kognitive færdigheder. Gruppen mødes regelmæssigt for at drøfte ny evidensbaseret viden inden for feltet bevægelse og læring. Som resultat heraf udvikler vi konstant spændende nye ideer til forskningsprojekter. Vi stræber efter at sikre, at vores projekter bringer har den højst mulige videnskabelige værdi med henblik på at fremme udvikling og forståelse i det omkringliggende samfund, i skolen og i den brede offentlighed.

Arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. bestå af

  • Planlægning af forsøgsdage
  • Gennemførelse af forsøgsdage på skoler
  • Klargøring, opsætning og vejledning af udstyr herunder aktivitetsmålere og tilhørende apps
  • Sikre en korrekt gennemførelse af studieprocedure, herunder korrekt håndtering af data
  • Bidrage til litteratursøgning, databehandling og søgning af ekstern finansiering til videreførelse af forskningen
  • Udarbejdelse af videnskabelige artikler, postere og oplæg
  • Deltagelse i videnskabelige seminarer
Profil
Vi søger en motiveret og engageret kommende forsker med en kandidatgrad indenfor idrætsvidenskab eller anden relevant baggrund. Du må meget gerne have erfaring med lignende forskningsprojekter på børn. Det vil være en fordel med:

  • Forskningserfaring fra lignende forskningsprojekter
  • Gode kommunikative evner i både mundtlig og skriftlig dansk og engelsk
  • Motiveret, ansvarlig og struktureret tilgang til arbejdet
  • Gode samarbejdsevner og selvstændighed
  • Erfaring med kontakt børn, familier og skolepersonale
  • God til personkontakt
  • Erfaring med arbejde med kvantitative studiedesign
  • Kendskab til sikker dataopbevaring, eksempelvis på platformen RedCap.
  • Erfaring med software til analyse af data i R.
  • Erfaring med rapportering, analyse og fortolkning af data.
  • Gerne erfaring med forskningsformidling både skriftligt i form af videnskabelige artikler samt mundtligt
Du behøver ikke at have erfaring med det hele. Det vigtigste er din interesse, lyst og vilje til at indgå i et godt kollegialt forskningsmiljø. Hvis du har erfaring med undervisning på bacheloruddannelsen i Idræt eller lignende kompetencer, og har lyst til løfte opgaver af den type for instituttet, så vil vi gerne vide mere om det.

Primære supervisor er lektor Jacob Wienecke, wienecke@nexs.ku.dk

Start: 1. januar 2027 eller snarest derefter

Varighed: 3 år

Ansættelsessted
Ansættelsesstedet er Institut for Idræt og Ernæring, Københavns Universitet, i forskningsgruppen Movement & Learning

Ansættelsesvilkår
Den gennemsnitlige ugentlige arbejdstid er 28 timer pr. uge.

Stillingen er tidsbegrænset til en periode på 3 år.

Løn, pension og øvrige ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til overenskomsten mellem Skatteministeriet og Akademikernes Centralorganisation (AC) eller en anden relevant organisation. Den nuværende månedlige løn starter på 34.211,01 DKK,. 4.576,89 EUR (August 2026 niveau). Afhængigt af kvalifikationer kan der forhandles tillæg. Arbejdsgiveren indbetaler derudover 18,07 % til din pensionsordning.

Stillingen er omfattet af Stillingsstrukturen for Videnskabeligt Personale ved Universiteterne (2026).

Spørgsmål
For yderligere spørgsmål kontakt venligst Jacob Wienecke via email på wienecke@nexs.ku.dk.

Ansøgningsprocedure
Din online ansøgning skal indsendes ved at klikke på “Søg stillingen” nedenfor.
Derudover skal din ansøgning indeholde følgende dokumenter/vedhæftninger – alle i PDF-format:

  1. Motiveret ansøgning (maks. to sider), hvor du redegør for, hvordan du kan bidrage til forskningsgruppen og forskningsprojektet.
  2. CV med oplysninger om uddannelse, arbejds- og forskningserfaring, undervisningserfaring, sprogkundskaber, evt. publikationer og abstrakts, og andre relevante kvalifikationer for stillingen (maks. fire sider).
  3. Kopi af originalt kandidatbevis og karakterudskrift på originalsproget.
  4. Publikationsliste.
Ansøgningsfrist: 30. oktober 2026


Vi forbeholder os retten til ikke at tage hensyn til materiale modtaget efter fristen og ikke at behandle ansøgninger, der ikke lever op til ovenstående krav.

title: Systemförvaltare Cosmic
description:
Vill du arbeta med IT som gör verklig skillnad? Som systemförvaltare hos oss är du med och utvecklar de digitala verktyg som vården använder varje dag.

I rollen arbetar du med att förbättra vårdsystemet Cosmic utifrån vårdverksamhetens behov och teknikens möjligheter. Genom din förståelse för vårdens arbetssätt bidrar du till lösningar som gör vardagen enklare för både vårdpersonal och patienter.

Du arbetar med flera system där Cosmic är det största. Arbetet sker i mindre arbetsgrupper med fokus på exempelvis vårddokumentation, behörigheter, läkemedel, utskrifter samt beställningar och svar. En viktig del av rollen är att säkerställa att systemen fungerar och att stötta användare genom att vara andra linjens support.

Du deltar även i utvecklingsprojekt och samverkar med vårdverksamheten och externa leverantörer. Verksamhetens behov och användarnas dagliga arbete i systemen är alltid i fokus. Tjänsten omfattar hela länet och din placering är i Kalmar, Oskarshamn eller Västervik.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av att arbeta med vårdsystem och digital utveckling inom vården. Du har en eftergymnasial, legitimerad, utbildning inom hälso- och sjukvård. Vi ser gärna att du har deltagit i projekt och arbetat med processledning. Har du arbetat som användarstöd för vårdsystem eller har erfarenhet av Cosmic är det meriterande.

Du gillar att arbeta i team, tar egna initiativ och arbetar självständigt. Du är analytisk, noggrann och strukturerad och har förmåga att se helheten i processer och flöden. Du fångar upp nya behov och bidrar till att systemen utvecklas så att de på bästa sätt stöttar vårdverksamhetens processer. Du gillar att lösa problem och kommunicerar tydligt och lyhört, både muntligt och skriftligt på svenska.

Din framtida arbetsplats

Jobba med IT som gör samhällsnytta! IT-förvaltningen finns till för att underlätta för de olika verksamhetsområdena så att de kan sätta patient och invånare i fokus. Det ställer extremt höga krav på den IT vi levererar. Vårt uppdrag är att ansvara för en tillgänglig och säker IT-miljö samt att i nära samverkan med Region Kalmar läns alla verksamheter driva och stödja arbetet med digitaliseringens möjligheter. I IT-förvaltningen finns cirka 180 medarbetare på orterna Kalmar, Oskarshamn och Västervik.

Region Kalmar län ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, tandvård, folkhögskolor, kultur, kollektivtrafik och regional utveckling. Vi är över 7 000 medarbetare som alla jobbar tillsammans för ett friskare, tryggare och rikare liv för länets invånare. Hos oss får du många förmåner och ett av Sveriges bästa kollektivavtal. Vi möter människor i livets alla skeden och har ett meningsfullt och utvecklande arbete – varje dag.

Region Kalmar län erbjuder alla medarbetare en anställning på 100%. Om du arbetar deltid men önskar arbeta heltid kan utökning av tjänst erbjudas vid annan arbetsplats.

Vi vill att du bifogar CV, personligt brev och för tjänsten relevanta utbildningsbevis till din ansökan. För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen i Region Kalmar län vill vi att du söker tjänsten i vårt rekryteringssystem och inte via e-post eller i pappersformat.

Vi tar gärna emot samtal från dig som är intresserad av jobbet men tackar nej till dig som säljer annonser och rekryteringstjänster.

title: Compensation & Benefits Partner
description:
Nobia Group is one of Europe’s largest kitchen specialists, listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, with strong and well-known brands across the Nordic region, including HTH, uno form, Invita, Sigdal and Marbodal.

We are looking for an experienced Compensation & Benefits Partner to shape and drive Reward strategy, governance and compensation practices across Nobia Group, ensuring a fair, competitive and transparent approach to rewarding our people.

Reward is a strategic enabler that enable us to attract and retain the right people, recognise contribution and make consistent, data-driven and well-informed decisions.

You will report directly to the EVP, Chief People & Culture Officer of Nobia and work closely with colleagues across Nobia, local People & Culture teams and external partners.

What you’ll be doing

At Nobia, we are developing our Compensation & Reward framework across countries and brands. As Compensation & Benefits Partner, you will own and drive key Reward initiatives, including compensation structures, benefits, job architecture, incentive programmes, market benchmarking, analytics and Reward governance.

A unique aspect of this role is direct involvement in Remuneration Committee and Board-level Reward matters. You will prepare analyses and recommendations that inform executive compensation decisions and gain exposure to senior leadership and governance processes in a listed company.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Drive compensation processes – lead annual salary review process, incentive cycles and other key Reward activities across Nobia, ensuring consistency, governance and alignment with business priorities.

  • Own incentives and benefits programs – design, develop and continuously improve bonus programmes, company car policies and other benefits across the organisation.

  • Lead Global Job Structure development – drive the implementation and continued development of Nobia’s Global Job Structure, ensuring consistency across roles, levels and countries.

  • Shape salary structures – develop and maintain country-specific salary structures and pay ranges, supporting a consistent and competitive approach to compensation.

  • Drive pay equity and transparency initiatives – analyse compensation outcomes, identify risks and opportunities, and provide recommendations that support fair, transparent and well-founded pay practices.

  • Lead market benchmarking activities – manage participation in compensation surveys, analyse market trends and provide insights that support Reward decisions.

  • Deliver reward analytics and reporting – translate complex Reward data into clear insights, recommendations and decision materials for senior leaders, Executive Committee members and the Board.

  • Act as a trusted Reward advisor – partner with local People & Culture teams and business leaders across countries, providing guidance on Reward frameworks, policies and processes.

  • Strengthen Reward governance and continuous improvement – enhance Reward processes, tools and data quality, while driving greater consistency, efficiency and governance across the Group.

  • Contribute to strategic Reward projects – lead and support strategic initiatives including executive compensation, long-term incentive programmes, pay transparency requirements and broader Reward transformation projects.

Your skillset for performance

We are looking for someone who combines strong analytical skills with curiosity, structure and the ability to turn data into meaningful insights. - This role is well suited for a Reward professional who enjoys combining strategic Reward design with hands-on execution and is comfortable working independently in a high-visibility role with significant exposure to senior leadership.

To succeed in this role, you bring:

  • Proven experience in Compensation & Benefits, Total Rewards or a similar Reward function, ideally within an international organisation.

  • Strong expertise in compensation strategy, salary structures, market benchmarking, incentive programmes and Reward governance.

  • Experience developing or managing job architecture, job evaluation, grading methodologies or organisational frameworks.

  • The ability to analyse complex data, identify trends and translate insights into clear recommendations for decision-makers.

  • Experience preparing high-quality analyses, reports and decision materials for senior leadership, Executive Committees, Remuneration Committees or Boards.

  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders and influencing decisions through data, insight and professional judgement.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build credibility across functions, countries and organisational levels.

  • A structured and proactive approach, with a strong sense of ownership and continuous improvement.

  • Experience working in an international or multi-country environment and navigating diverse market conditions and regulatory requirements.

  • Excellent Excel and analytical capabilities, with strong attention to detail and data quality.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

What we offer

You will join a professional and collaborative People & Culture environment where Reward plays an important role in supporting Nobia’s business and transformation.

With broad scope and high ownership, the role offers the opportunity to develop your Reward expertise while working closely with colleagues and stakeholders across the Nordic organisation.

You will be based at our Nobia Denmark HQ in Tilst, where you can look forward to a great lunch, social activities and events throughout the year. On top of that, we offer a flexible working environment and plenty of opportunities to grow both professionally and personally.

Curious to learn more?

If you are motivated by the opportunity to help shape Reward in a Nordic, listed company and believe you can bring strong analytical skills, business understanding and a proactive mindset to the role, we would love to hear from you.

Please upload your CV and include a short motivation explaining why you are a good match for the position.

We interview candidates on an ongoing basis, so please send your application as soon as possible.
