title: Junior Service Delivery Coordinator (Maternity Cover)
description:
This is a maternity cover with a potential chance to turn permanent with good performance, with an ever growing team.


Role Purpose

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Service Delivery Coordinator as part of our Sofia Delivery team. As the principal customer contact for orders in the delivery process you will be responsible for upkeeping the standards of excellence that EXA customers have come to expect. You will be the liaison between various departments within the wider operational team, and across the EXA organization. You will be responsible for supporting all admin aspects of the delivery process using EXAs CRM Salesforce. The successful applicant will possess strong admin, demonstrating a can-do attitude with a good eye for detail, and the ability to work to tight deadlines. The ideal candidate will be customer focused, and comfortable interacting daily with clients, vendors, and all key stakeholders to ensure a smooth delivery process.


Key responsibilities

  • Be a team player in a cross functional role by providing primary point of customer contact during the delivery process. Coordinate all delivery related tasks using EXA CRM Salesforce.
  • Upkeep of all order records with accuracy and attention to detail being a critical success tool, Ability to work with stakeholders to identify expected delivery dates, manage the order process to minimise any risks of not hitting the expected delivery dates, identify any risks and work to resolve any known issues internally or external.
  • Manage multiple system tasks and varying work volumes simultaneously and prioritise accordingly from order receipt to order activation.
  • Provide regular accurate order(s) progress updates to customers via email or phone. Ensure updates are recorded in sales force and relevant order related date fields and milestones are accurate.
  • Ensure smooth customer handover when services are ready for use, coordinate testing and turn up where required. Ensure all 3rd party documents and handover information has been logged and a clean order record is available for EXA NOC team should they require to review the service for troubleshooting at any stage.


Individual Profile

This is a cross functional role, working with all teams across EXA as part of the wider operations group. This role has responsibility for representing EXA to our customers and ensuring delivery interval commitments are consistently met. It is essential that the candidate can build and maintain strong relationships internally and externally. This is highly beneficial in successfully managing the order to activate process.


In addition, we require the following skills and qualities:

  • Professional and articulate
  • Able to communicate effectively
  • Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines
  • Ability to work as a team to meet monthly revenue / billing targets
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Flexible and self-motivated
  • Team player

Essential Criteria

  • Fluent written & spoken English
  • Experience in data entry
  • Experience in a customer facing role with strong customer service ethos

Desirable Criteria

  • Knowledge of Telecoms an advantage
  • Salesforce experience an advantage
  • Presentation or project tracking experience an advantage


Our Working Environment

Here at EXA, we believe the future includes everyone, we are open to all applications to create an environment and culture that includes one and all. We are a proud global community, that wants to drive diversity of thought though our employees and culture. We want you to come as you and make yourself and EXA successful.

Due to the amount of applications, we may not be able to respond to all applicants. If you do not hear from EXA in 3 weeks after applications, you have been unsuccessful.

All successful applicants will go through background screening.

title: Insegnanti di Italiano L2
description: About the School - OU.LOCATION: Florence Bilingual School (FBS) is a bilingual Italian/English school that has been active since 1973. Accredited by Cambridge International, FBS promotes an educational approach and curriculum aimed at the development of each student’s confidence, creativity, and autonomy. Since 2021, FBS has been part of the international Cognita Schools group, an extraordinary community of diverse yet connected schools spanning sixteen different countries. With 50 years of experience, our school offers a high-profile education that skilfully combines tradition and innovation. We prepare students to succeed in life by cultivating a global perspective and a fervent passion for learning. We design our educational approach to ensure that students develop the skills necessary to thrive in their personal growth journey, offering them an experience of learning excellence. The school now has an exciting opportunity for an experienced JOB.TITLE to join our fantastic team. About Cognita: Cognita is a global leader in independent education. Founded in 2004, we are a growing community of 90 schools in 21 countries - in Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia and the Middle East - serving more than 100,000 students. Each of our schools are proudly unique, however our collective purpose is to create an environment where everyone can, "Thrive in a rapidly evolving world". At Cognita, we know every student is unique. We nurture their distinct personalities and strengths. We support them academically, socially, and emotionally, wherever they are in the world, wherever they’re starting from. And each and every one of our schools is unique too. We protect what’s special about them, while offering them rich knowledge, opportunities, and best practices. And they get to be part of something bigger. We open their classrooms to the collective wisdom of 90 schools in 21 countries, ensuring every child gets an education that’s, quite literally, world class. It’s an individual approach that empowers every school, teacher and student to focus on what they do best and thrive. About the Role: As an Italian L2 Teacher, you will play a vital role in helping non-native-speaking students develop the language skills and confidence they need to thrive both academically and socially. You will assess students' language abilities, plan engaging and differentiated lessons, and deliver high-quality Italian language instruction through individual, small-group and classroom teaching. Working closely with the Inclusion and Italian L2 Coordinator, class teachers and families, you will support students' integration into school life while fostering a welcoming, inclusive and culturally aware learning environment. You will monitor progress, provide constructive feedback, adapt teaching resources to meet individual needs, and contribute to students' overall wellbeing and success. This is a part-time, fixed-term contract position (22%). Salary: €364.29 per month Hours: 0.22 FTE To view a full Role Profile, click here . Who We Are Looking For: You are a qualified teacher with experience teaching Italian as a second language and a passion for helping students from diverse linguistic and cultural backgrounds succeed. You combine excellent communication and classroom management skills with patience, empathy and creativity, enabling you to adapt your teaching to different ages, abilities and learning styles. You enjoy working collaboratively with colleagues and families, are committed to continuous professional development, and are motivated by creating engaging learning experiences that build students' confidence and independence. A strong commitment to safeguarding, inclusion and student wellbeing is essential. How to Apply: Complete this application before the closing date: 23:59 CEST (UTC+2), Sunday 1st November 2026 . Cognita Schools are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed. We are an equal opportunities employer committed to diversity and treating all employees with dignity and respect regardless of background. Early applications are encouraged, we reserve the right to interview and appoint prior to closing date for the right applicant.

title: Learning Management System (LMS) Administrator
description:
The LMS Administrator is responsible for the effective administration, optimisation, and continuous improvement of the HAAS Learning Management System (Totara), ensuring the platform remains accurate, reliable, compliant, and user-focused. The postholder plays a key role in enabling high-quality learning and development across the organisation by maintaining learning content, user access, system integrity, and reporting capabilities that support workforce development, regulatory compliance, and organisational performance.

Working closely with the Learning and Development team and key stakeholders across HAAS, the LMS Administrator provides expert operational support, manages system processes and data quality, responds to user enquiries, and delivers meaningful learning analytics and reports. The role contributes to the ongoing enhancement of the learner experience by identifying opportunities to streamline processes, improve system functionality, and maximise engagement with digital learning solutions.

The successful candidate will be a highly organised and customer-focused professional with strong technical aptitude, attention to detail, and a passion for learning technologies. They will act as a trusted point of expertise for system users, helping to ensure that the LMS delivers an accessible, efficient, and effective learning environment that supports organisational objectives.

Essential Criteria

  • Proven experience in an LMS administration or learning systems support role.

  • Strong attention to detail, with a commitment to data accuracy and quality.

  • Confidence working with digital systems and managing system processes.

  • Ability to produce clear reports and respond to ad‑hoc data requests.

  • Strong customer‑service mindset with the ability to support users at all levels.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills with experience collaborating with SMEs.

  • Strong understanding of LMS administration, including back-end configuration, workflows, and user management.

  • Experience creating and interpreting LMS dashboards and reporting tools.

  • Ability to extract, analyse, and present data clearly to support decision making and compliance monitoring.

  • Confident troubleshooting LMS or data issues with technical teams or vendors

  • Flexible, proactive, and able to work effectively as part of a dispersed team – travelling occasionally when required.

  • Evidence of relevant CPD in digital learning, learning technology, or L&D.

  • General IT skills and ability to use software effectively.

  • Driven and flexible.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience administering Totara, Moodle, or a comparable LMS.

  • Familiarity with e‑learning content standards (e.g. SCORM, xAPI).

  • Experience working in a regulated, compliance‑driven, or contract‑led environment.

  • Basic understanding of learning and development or training delivery contexts.

  • Experience writing operational guidance, process documentation, or technical content

Please note that we reserve the right to close this vacancy early should we receive a sufficient number of applications.

Ingeus is a leading human services provider helping people, business and communities thrive through employment, skills and health & wellbeing services. We are a trusted partner to government and industry delivering services that create positive social impact and transform lives.

title: Intern, Software Engineer
description:
Get to Know the Team

The Commercial Systems team builds and operates software and data systems that support Grab's commercial operations. The team manages Salesforce and develops applications, integrations, and workflow solutions in partnership with business, product, and engineering teams. Its work helps commercial teams manage partner interactions and day-to-day processes.

Get to Know the Role

As a Software Engineer Intern, you will contribute to engineering projects in one of five areas: Backend Engineering, Full-Stack Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, or AI Automation.

Your work will depend on your assigned track and may include developing and testing software, data pipelines, or automation solutions. This internship is fully on-site at Grab's One North office in Singapore and Full-Time from Jan to May / June 2027. You will report to an Engineering Manager.

The internship will give you practical experience applying your technical foundations to team projects, with opportunities to learn through collaboration and code reviews. If you're ready to apply your skills to real engineering work, we encourage you to apply.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • You will design and develop applications, services, data pipelines, or automation solutions aligned with your assigned engineering track.
  • You will work with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers to clarify requirements and translate them into scoped technical work.
  • You will participate in code or design reviews and apply feedback to improve the quality, maintainability, and security of your work.
  • You will document technical designs, application logic, system components, or data flows relevant to your project.
  • You will investigate bugs, performance issues, or production incidents and work with the relevant engineers to resolve them.
  • You will use approved AI tools for activities such as code exploration, testing, documentation, or analysis, and review their outputs for accuracy and suitability.

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • You will be pursuing, or have recently completed, a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • You will have working proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Java, Python, C++, JavaScript, Swift, or Kotlin.
  • You will understand data structures and algorithms and be able to apply them to technical problems.
  • You will be familiar with software development practices, including version control such as Git, and writing or running tests.
  • You will be able to explain your technical approach and record relevant information in code reviews or project documentation.
  • You will have experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows, and contribute new ideas.

Good to Have

Experience in one or more areas relevant to your preferred track:

  • Backend Engineering: Backend frameworks such as Go, Java/Spring, Django, or Flask; databases such as PostgreSQL or MongoDB.
  • Full-Stack Engineering: Semantic HTML, CSS for layout and responsive design, JavaScript (ES6+, DOM, asynchronous programming), or a framework such as React, Vue, or Angular.
  • Data Engineering: Data modelling, SQL, ETL, data warehousing, or distributed computing frameworks such as Spark.
  • AI Automation: Experience using AI tools in code or design reviews.

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer our Interns:

  • Comprehensive Medical Insurance: We got you covered with medical insurance plans.
  • Leave Entitlement: Enjoy a range of leave options including Annual Leave, Medical Leave, and Hospitalization Leave.
  • Flexible Work Arrangements: Benefit from a flexible work schedule that allows you to balance your academic commitments and personal life.
  • Community Involvement: Get involved in community service through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) programs.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique

title: Tysk- og dansktalende kundeservicemedarbejder til turismevirksomhed
description:
Er du servicemindet til fingerspidserne, og elsker du ferier og rejser? Så har vi jobbet til dig!

Hos Campaya hjælper vi hver dag et stort antal feriegæster med at finde den helt rigtige feriebolig. Mange finder selv deres feriebolig eller sommerhus på en af vores udlejningsportaler, mens andre har brug for hjælp undervejs. Det er her, du kommer ind i billedet.

Lige nu leder vi nemlig efter vores næste stjerne til kontoret i Horsens. Her skal du hjælpe vores gæster med at finde den helt rigtige feriebolig til deres næste ferie. Du får et job, hvor du hver dag kan gøre en positiv forskel for mennesker, der drømmer om deres næste ferie.

Vi forventer, at du

  • taler og skriver dansk og tysk.

  • kan kommunikere med og yde god service på engelsk til gæster fra hele verden.

  • møder mennesker med et åbent og positivt sind og er handlings- og løsningsorienteret.

  • er passioneret omkring rejser og sætter en ære i at hjælpe folk med at få den bedst mulige ferie.

  • er fortrolig med IT og hurtigt lærer nye systemer.

Din uddannelse er ikke afgørende, men erfaring fra et lignende kundeservicejob er en fordel. Det vigtigste er, at du taler dansk og tysk og brænder for at gøre en positiv forskel for vores gæster ved at hjælpe dem med at finde den helt rette feriebolig.

Vi tilbyder

  • et afvekslende fuldtidsjob med base på vores kontor i Horsens.

  • en hverdag med fuldt fokus på noget af det bedste her i livet - nemlig ferie og rejser.

  • et job, der kan balanceres til dit øvrige liv. Arbejdstiden ligger hovedsageligt på hverdage i dagtimerne. Derudover indgår vagttelefon uden for normal arbejdstid cirka hver 6.-7. uge samt enkelte weekendvagter i højsæsonen.

  • kolleger, der sætter en ære i at være hjælpsomme og positive over for både kunder og samarbejdspartnere.

Om Campaya

Campaya Sommerhusudlejning er danskejet og har hvert år siden 2013 hjulpet mange tusinde danske og udenlandske feriegæster med at finde indkvarteringen til deres ferier.

Vores udlejningsportal findes på ti forskellige sprog, og vi udlejer et meget stort antal ferieboliger i hele Europa.

Vores kontor ligger på Erhvervsbyvej 11 i Horsens, hvorfra du også får dit fremtidige virke. Der vil være mulighed for hjemmearbejde i nogen grad, men arbejdet kommer primært til at foregå fra kontoret.

Sådan søger du

Send en kort ansøgning om, hvorfor du passer til jobbet, sammen med dit CV til fsb@campaya.eu. Spørgsmål om stillingen kan også sendes hertil.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når vi har fundet vores nye kollega.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
Location: Bengaluru,Karnataka,India

Who are we?

Founded in 2014 by Khadim Batti and Vara Kumar, Whatfix is a leading global B2B SaaS provider and the largest pure-play enterprise digital adoption platform (DAP). Whatfix empowers companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments across the application lifecycle, from ideation to training to the deployment of software. Driving user productivity, ensuring process compliance, and improving user experience of internal and customer-facing applications.

Spearheading the category with serial innovation and unmatched customer-centricity, Whatfix is the only DAP innovating beyond the category, positioning itself as a comprehensive suite for GenAI-powered digital adoption, analytics, and application simulation. Whatfix product suite consists of 3 products - DAP, Product Analytics, and Mirror. This product suite helps businesses accelerate ROI on digital investments by streamlining application deployment across its lifecycle.

Whatfix has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40+ countries.

Customers: 700+ enterprise customers, including over 80 Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Microsoft, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions.

Investors: Raised a total of ~$270 million. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million led by Warburg Pincus with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer Investments, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners.

  • With over 45% YoY sustainable annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, Whatfix is among the “Top 50 Indian Software Companies” as per G2 Best Software Awards.

  • Recognized as a “Leader” in the digital adoption platforms (DAP) category for the past 4+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group.

  • The only vendor recognized as a Customers’ Choice in the 2024 Gartner® Voice of the Customer for Digital Adoption Platforms has once again earned the Customers’ Choice distinction in 2025. We also boast a star rating of 4.6 on G2 Crowd, 4.5 on Gartner Peer Insights, and a high CSAT of 99.8%

  • Highest-Ranking DAP on 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ North America for Fourth Consecutive Year

  • Won the Silver for Stevie's Employer of the Year 2023 – Computer Software category and also recognized as Great Place to Work 2022-2023

  • Only DAP to be among the top 35% companies worldwide in sustainability excellence with EcoVadis Bronze Medal

  • On the G2 peer review platform, Whatfix has received 77 Leader badges across all market segments, including Small, Medium, and Enterprise, in 2024, among numerous other industry recognitions.



Solutions Engineer

Solutions Engineer is a highly strategic, high-exposure role that will drive the use of Whatfix, being a trusted consultant to our customers by guiding them during the product's implementation, and internally evangelizing on the diverse use cases of Whatfix implementation. You will drive the onboarding, product solution-ing, end-to-end implementation of the product, to deliver a seamless user experience.

What you will be doing

  • Develop, test, and maintain robust code for various features, ensuring functionality across different environments and platforms.
  • Design scalable and maintainable software architectures that support the Product's growth and evolution, considering future feature additions and integrations.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot complex technical issues within the Application, applying problem-solving skills to devise and implement effective solutions.
  • Work with our customers to configure, test & integrate Whatfix solutions into enterprise applications
  • Acquire and Leverage your knowledge across various Enterprise Applications to define the framework for Whatfix Implementation
  • Pilot new feature releases to directly influence the overall Product development roadmap
  • Work cross-functionally in collaboration with different departments, including Product, Customer Success, Sales, Customer Support, and Marketing

What are we looking for?

  • BTech CSE, BTech IT / ITES, MTech, BCA, or MCA with No Backlogs.
  • Excellent Problem solving skills.
  • Full-Time work experience - At least 3 years of Work experience in Web Technology (HTML, JS, CSS), APIs and Databases
  • Experience on other Languages and Frameworks will be an added advantage.
  • Good Knowledge on Software Architecture and Design Patterns.
  • Impeccable verbal and written communication skills (Very Important)
  • Ability to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders while dealing with complex situations.

Note:

  • At Whatfix, we thrive on the power of collaboration, innovation, and human connection. We strongly believe that working together in our office (five days a week) fosters open communication, builds a sense of community, and fuels innovation. This ensures open communication, strengthens our sense of community, and enables us to achieve our collective goals effectively.
  • At the same time, we recognize the importance of flexibility in balancing personal and professional priorities. To support this, we offer the option to work from home up to two days per month.
  • In any situation that requires additional flexibility, we’re open to considering exceptions on a case-by-case basis to ensure you’re supported in managing both work and life seamlessly.
  • We strive to live and breathe our Cultural Principles and encourage employees to demonstrate some of these core values - Customer First; Empathy; Transparency; Fail Fast and scale Fast; No Hierarchies for Communication; Deep Dive and innovate; Trust is the foundation; and Do it as you own it.
  • We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse people because of and not in spite of the differences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

title: Salgskonsulent med byggefaglig forståelse
description:
Har du en håndværksmæssig baggrund og lyst til at bruge din faglige viden i dialogen med kunder? Motiveres du af at finde den rigtige løsning og følge den hele vejen fra opmåling og tilbud til færdig ordre?

Om Dansk Carport System

Dansk Carport System A/S har mere end 20 års erfaring med fremstilling af carporte, redskabsrum og overdækninger. Produkterne fremstilles i galvaniseret stål og kan pulverlakeres i forskellige RAL-farver. Med egen produktion leverer virksomheden kundetilpassede løsninger, hvor funktion, kvalitet og et godt visuelt udtryk går hånd i hånd.

Om stillingen

Som salgskonsulent bliver du en vigtig del af et lille hold, hvor vejen fra kundens ønske til den færdige løsning er kort. Du rådgiver både private og professionelle kunder, herunder boligforeninger, byggefirmaer, kommuner og andre offentlige kunder.

Du håndterer henvendelser via mail, chat og telefon samt betjener kunder i udstillingen. Nogle ved præcis, hvad de ønsker, mens andre har brug for din hjælp til at se mulighederne og vælge den rette løsning. Når der er stille i indbakken, tager du selv initiativ til at kontakte potentielle kunder.

Konkret kommer du til at arbejde med

  • Salg og rådgivning til private og professionelle kunder.

  • Håndtering og opfølgning på henvendelser via mail, chat, telefon og i udstillingen.

  • Opmåling hos kunder og vurdering af bygningens konstruktion.

  • Omsætning af mål og kundebehov til enkle tegninger til værkstedet.

  • Udarbejdelse af tilbud og opfølgning på salgsaktiviteter og pipeline.

  • Oprettelse af ordrer og koordinering med produktionen.

  • Opsøgende kontakt til blandt andet boligforeninger og byggefirmaer.

Hvem er du?

Du kommer med en byggefaglig forståelse – måske er du uddannet tømrer, murer eller smed, eller også arbejder du med salg og optegning, eksempelvis i køkkenbranchen. Din titel er ikke afgørende. Det vigtigste er, at du kan bruge din praktiske viden til at forstå kundens behov og omsætte dem til en løsning, der kan produceres.

  • Du har kendskab til byggeri og forstår, hvordan huse og konstruktioner er bygget op.

  • Du kan foretage opmålinger og læse eller udarbejde enkle tegninger.

  • Du har sans for salg og er god til at finde den rette løsning for kunden.

  • Du arbejder selvstændigt, tager initiativ og følger dine opgaver til dørs.

  • Du har ordenssans, blik for detaljen og kan bevare overblikket over flere tilbud og ordrer.

  • Du møder kunder og kolleger på en tillidsvækkende, nærværende og ligefrem måde.

  • Du er tryg ved at bruge en pc. Erfaring med Excel eller Google Sheets er en fordel.

  • Du kommunikerer sikkert på dansk i skrift og tale.

En hverdag med frihed, ansvar og tæt samarbejde

Du bliver en del af en virksomhed med syv medarbejdere, hvor alle hjælper hinanden, og hvor der er kort fra beslutning til handling. Du arbejder tæt sammen med rådgiverne og produktionen, så der er sammenhæng i processen fra den første samtale til levering.

Arbejdstiden ligger som udgangspunkt mandag til torsdag kl. 8.00–16.00 med lidt tidligere afslutning fredag. Din base er kontoret og udstillingen i Randers SV. Cirka én gang om måneden kan der være en opmålingstur, eksempelvis til Sjælland, som du selv planlægger.

Du får en alsidig rolle med stor frihed under ansvar og mulighed for at lære af kolleger med forskellige faglige baggrunde.

Vil du vide mere?

HR Company varetager rekrutteringen af den nye salgskonsulent til Dansk Carport System. Når du trykker på ”Ansøg”, bliver du derfor ført videre til vores rekrutteringssystem.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Head of Recruitment Winnie Sønderkær Rechnagel på Winnie@hrcompany.dk eller telefon +45 4412 8209.

title: Functional Analyst
description:
Als Functional Analyst vorm je de brug tussen business en functionele behoeften van de business en de technische realisatie door de ontwikkelteams. Je combineert inzicht in processen, analysevaardigheden en technische expertise om kwalitatieve oplossingen te ontwerpen. Je werkt nauw samen met business stakeholders, ontwikkelaars, testers en de Product Owner.

Je bepaalt mee de scope van middelgrote tot complexe development-projecten en je bewaakt de functionele samenhang van de oplossing.

Je fungeert als aanspreekpunt voor functionele verduidelijkingen gedurende het volledige traject, van analyse en ontwerp tot en met ontwikkeling, validatie en productie-name.

De toepassingen worden ontwikkeld in .NET & Azure Cloud aan de hand van Scrum-methodologie. Je beschikt over een masterdiploma of een gelijkwaardige expertise. Je weet minstens 3 jaar ervaring in een gelijkaardige functie aan te tonen.

Je hebt ervaring in Agile/Scrum en een goede kennis van Agile-methodologieën.

Je hebt een diepgaande kennis van analysemethoden en modelleertechnieken (UML, BPMN, XML en webservices). Je hebt ervaring in het bieden van ondersteuning bij E2Etesting.

Kennis van API-analyse (REST/SOAP), databankmodellering (relationeel & logisch), SQL-queries en Sparx Enterprise Architect vormt een meerwaarde. Ook ervaring met het analyseren en reviewen van technische specificaties, kennis van Microsoft Azure DevOps en ervaring met TDD en BDD zijn troeven.

Afhankelijk van het team of project waarin je terechtkomt, kan je rol een bijkomend business, functioneel of technisch accent krijgen.

Ervaring in het domein van de sociale zekerheid is een extra troef.

Je hebt uitstekende relationele en communicatieve vaardigheden, weet complexe problemen te ontleden en heldere oplossingen te formuleren naar verschillende stakeholders.

Je combineert een sterk analytisch en synthetisch denkvermogen met organisatorisch inzicht, waardoor je efficiënt en kwalitatief werkt.

Je bent in staat om zowel autonoom als in teamverband projecten tot een goed einde te brengen, neemt initiatief en handelt proactief. Daarbij toon je je flexibel, schakel je ook vlot en ga je constructief om met verandering.

Je werkt gestructureerd, neemt verantwoordelijkheid en levert kwaliteitsvol werk op binnen de vooropgestelde deadlines. Tot slot ben je leergierig en continu gericht op verbetering.

Je hebt een goede kennis van het Frans en begrijpt het Engels.

title: Seasonal Retail At Your Service Associate, Newport Centre - Jersey City
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Ungebehandler til Kolding Rusmiddelcenter
description:
Socialfaglig behandler til Stofbehandlingen unge team, Kolding Rusmiddelcenter.

Vi søger en kollega til Koldings Rusmiddelcenter Ungebehandling med start 1.januar 2027.

I Ungebehandlingen arbejder vi med ambulant rusmiddelbehandling, herunder MOVE, for unge i alderen 14-30 år, der har et problematisk forbrug af rusmidler. Vi møder unge med forskellige livssituationer og udfordringer, men med et fælles ønske om forandring. Gennem individuelle behandlingsforløb arbejder vi med motivation, trivsel og mestring af hverdagen. Vores mål er ikke blot at hjælpe de unge med at reducere eller ophøre med deres rusmiddelforbrug, men også at støtte dem i at skabe en meningsfuld hverdag og komme videre i livet.

Arbejdssted:

Rusmiddelbehandlingen, Center for Rusmiddelbehandling og Socialt Udsatte, Kolding kommune, Nørregade 1, 6000 Kolding

Arbejdstid:

37 timer.

Mandag 8.00-16.00, tirsdag 8.00- 15.00, onsdag 8.00-15.00, torsdag 8.00-18.00 og fredag 8.00-13.00.

Ansættelsestidspunkt:

1.januar 2027.

Om jobbet:

Hos os bliver du en del af et engageret team, hvor faglig sparring, humor og samarbejde er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes sammen – med den unge, familien og vores samarbejdspartnere. På Kolding Rusmiddelcenter arbejder vi helhedsorienteret ud fra den kognitive metode.

Som rusmiddelbehandler vil du få en central rolle i behandlingsforløb, hvor både motivation, stabilisering og afklaring er nøgleord. Der samarbejdes med og omkring den unge både sundhedsfagligt og socialfagligt.

Stillingen er funderet i Stofbehandlingens unge team, hvor du vil blive en del af et team på 3 socialfaglige medarbejdere. Det skal forventes at der er en fleksibilitet i forhold til andre opgaver på Rusmiddelcentret.

Du kommer til at indgå i et større tværfagligt team med social - og sundhedsfagligt kollegaer.

Det kommer du til at arbejde med:

  • Individuelle samtaler med unge

  • Udarbejdelse og opfølgning på behandlingsplaner

  • Tværfagligt samarbejde med interne og eksterne aktører

  • Varetage struktureret dokumentation og journalisering i Nexus

  • Gruppebehandling og/eller pårørendesamarbejde

  • Deltagelse i behandlingsmøder og supervision

  • Bidrage til udviklingen af vores fælles faglige praksis

Området Rusmiddelbehandling er ikke for alle. Men for de rigtige bliver det sjældent ”bare et arbejde”.

Vi håber, du kan genkende dig selv i dette:

Du er socialfagligt uddannet – f.eks. socialrådgiver eller socialpædagog – og har lyst til at arbejde med unge, der har brug for en fagperson, som både kan skabe struktur og stærke relationer.

  • Møder mennesker med respekt, nysgerrighed og tydelighed

  • Kan skabe tillid og fastholde relationen – også når den bliver udfordret

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og trives i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde

  • Er fagligt reflekterende og nysgerrig på egen praksis

  • Ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger

  • Erfaring med Kognitiv behandling og/eller MI.

Erfaring med rusmiddelbehandling er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære området at kende og bidrage med din socialfaglige viden.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • En god og spændende arbejdsplads hvor vi vægter højt humør og høj faglighed.

  • Ordnede forhold og fokus på trivsel.

  • Mulighed for flekstidsaftale.

  • Faglig sparring med andre socialfaglige behandlere og andre faggrupper.

  • Godt arbejdsmiljø.

  • En arbejdsplads og kultur hvor visionen Selvværd og Sammenhæng, styrer alle aktiviteter.

Du vil ved opstart modtage oplæring og der vil blive lavet et introprogram til dig.

Hvem er vi?

Rusmiddelcentret i Kolding kommune består af:

Stofbehandling og Alkoholbehandling, herunder ungeteam, et voksenteam og et sundhedsteam. Derudover har vi et værested for stoffrie borgere og en socialsygeplejerske tilknyttet. Sammen varetager vi behandlingen for mere end 600 borgere fra 14 år og op, jf. Servicelovens §101/§101a samt Sundhedslovens §141 og §142.

Vi arbejder ud fra kommunens fælles vision "Selvværd og Sammenhæng". Det er en vision, som alle medarbejdere opfylder ved at have en adfærd, der afspejler de fem leveregler:

  • Tal et sprog alle mennesker forstår

  • Alt inden for din radar er dit ansvar

  • Det er borgerens/ den unges plan

  • Sæt fællesskabet i spil

  • Gå borgeren i møde

title: Ingeniør til Kapacitetscenter Electronic Warfare
description:
Vil du være med til at styrke Forsvarets operative kapaciteter inden for Electronic Warfare?

Lyder det som noget for dig, så har du nu mulighed for at blive sagsbehandler ved Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelses.



Om os

Kapacitetscenter Electronic Warfare indgår, som et af fire kapacitetscentre.

Du bliver en del af et højt specialiseret team på 12 medarbejdere, både militære og civile, med forskellige faglige baggrunde og kompetencer. Vi arbejder tæt sammen om opgaverne, deler vores viden og bruger hinandens kompetencer på tværs af fagområder.

Vi har ansvaret for anskaffelse, implementering, drift og udvikling af forsvarets landbaserede Electronic Warfare kapaciteter.

Forsvaret er under rivende udvikling, hvorfor der er kort vej fra idé til handling, så du får derfor gode muligheder for at præge både opgaveløsningen og kapacitetscenterets udvikling. Hverdagen er præget af høj faglighed, tæt samarbejde og faglig sparring. Omgangsformen er med fokus på gode relationer, fællesskab og ikke mindst humor.

Kapacitetscentret er placeret i selvstændigt kontorområde med eget laboratorium til understøttelse af vores opgaver. Derudover er der oprettet test- og målefacilitet, således vi har mulighed for at verificere, at det vi laver opfører sig som forventet.



Om stillingen

Som ingeniør i Kapacitetscentret vil du:

  • indgå i vores team for teknisk sagsbehandling af mandbårne og køretøjsindbyggede systemer, herunder henholdsvis efterretningsindhentnings- og force protection teknologier

  • planlægge og gennemføre møder med leverandører, systemhuse samt nationale og internationale samarbejdspartnere, herunder foretager markedsundersøgelser og vurdering af nye Electronic Warfare teknologier

  • foretage teknisk/faglig vurderings af leverandørers løsninger ift. brugerkrav og aktiv deltagelse i anskaffelsesprocessen for nye kapaciteter

  • forestå planlægning, tilrettelæggelse samt gennemførelse af Kapacitetscenterets aktiviteter indenfor Electronic Warfare, herunder deltagelse i vores planlagte test og målinger ved systemhuse og i terræn

  • forestå driften af eksisterende kapaciteter, i tæt samarbejde med vores operative samarbejdspartnere

  • være en aktiv del af vores studie- og udviklingsgruppe, med deltagelse i vores test og måleopgaver

  • efter ansættelsen, modtage den fornødne efteruddannelse i de systemer, du vil få ansvaret for



Stillingen indebærer omkring 40 rejsedage om året i Danmark og udlandet. Rejserne varierer fra kortere ture på 1-3 dage til enkelte ophold på 2-3 uger.


Om dig

Vi forventer, at du er uddannet ingeniør indenfor f.eks. trådløs kommunikation og motiveres af at arbejde med komplekse systemer.

Du er ingeniør med erfaring, evt. nyuddannet, fra et eller flere af følgende områder:
Måling på radiosystemer, antenneinstallationer, RF-måleteknik, forståelse for RF-systemer og modulationsformer, opbygning af testudstyr samt integration af tekniske systemer.

Kendskab til SAP/DeMars er en fordel.

Du har en stærk teknisk profil med lyst og evne til at sætte dig ind i fagområderne og til at styrke Kapacitetscentret med din ingeniørmæssige faglighed.

Du arbejder struktureret, er grundig med en helhedsorienteret tilgang til opgaveløsningen og har evnen til at bevare overblikket.

Du er i stand til selvstændigt at kunne håndtere omfangsrige og komplekse sager, men vil også indgå i teamsamarbejde med øvrige kollegaer.

Du kan formulere dig klart og tydeligt i skrift og tale på både dansk og engelsk. Erfaring med internationalt samarbejde er en fordel.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har kørekort kategori B og evt. erfaring fra området.



Ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademikeroverenskomsten).

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Arbejdsstedet er i Ballerup.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.



Kontakt og ansøgning

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Peter Bisgaard på telefon 5172 7389 eller mail FMI-LA-CHFEW@MIL.DK.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Isabella Lund Skjoldborg på telefon 3044 5570.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 30. oktober 2026. Ansættelsestidspunktet er hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

Du søger stillingen via linket i opslaget. Vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og uddannelsesbevis. Vær opmærksom på, at bilag kun kan vedhæftes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.



Om Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse

Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) er Danmarks centrale myndighed for forsvarets og beredskabets materiel, it og cybersikkerhed i fred, krise og krig. Vi arbejder for at sikre, at det samlede forsvar er udstyret, opdateret og operativt — i en tid, hvor kravene til hastighed og kampkraft aldrig har været større. Det er os, der anskaffer, driver og bortskaffer materiel og it for Hæren, Søværnet, Flyvevåbnet og resten af Forsvarsministeriets koncern. Det er vores it-medarbejdere, der dagligt er med til at afværge de cyberangreb, koncernen udsættes for. Vi er en mangfoldig organisation med ca. 2.500 medarbejdere — civile og militære — fordelt ud over hele Kongeriget.

title: Hardware Systems Integration Engineer, Pixel Phone
location: New Taipei, Banqiao District, New Taipei City, Taiwan
description:
As the Hardware Systems Integration Engineer, you will play a critical role in the entire lifecycle of Pixel products, managing the electrical design from early architecture through launch. This involves defining and validating electrical systems and managing architecture selection for Google's future devices. Your key responsibilities include collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate cutting-edge technologies and optimize product performance, power, and thermal behavior. You will develop solutions for complex electrical system issues and drive product electrical design to mass production. This includes defining the Engineering Requirement Specification (ERS), assisting in software bring-up, and ensuring successful manufacturing and testing onsite. You will also manage relationships with suppliers and manufacturing partners.

title: ITTF/WTT Finance Executive
description:
Role Overview

This role is a multifaceted position designed for a detail-oriented professional who can manage both the standard accounting cycle and the specialized nuances of prize money disbursements. You will be responsible for the integrity of the ledger and ensuring all stakeholders—from vendors to prize winners—are paid accurately and on time.


Key Responsibilities


Accounts Receivable & Credit Control

  • Invoicing: Generate and distribute accurate invoices and credit notes.
  • Debt Collection: Proactively follow up on overdue payments via phone and email while maintaining professional stakeholder relationships.
  • Reconciliation: Perform routine bank reconciliations to ensure all incoming receipts are correctly allocated.
  • Reporting: Prepare aged debt reports and provide regular updates on "at-risk" accounts to management


Accounts Payable

  • Processing: Verify, code, and enter supplier invoices into the accounting system.
  • Disbursements: Prepare weekly or bi-monthly payment runs (via bank transfer).
  • Vendor Relations: Resolve billing discrepancies and respond to inquiries regarding payment status.
  • Expense Management: Audit and process employee expense claims in alignment with company policy.


Prize Money Management

  • Calculation & Validation: Verify winner eligibility and calculate net prize payouts based on event results.
  • Tax Compliance: Manage withholding tax requirements (e.g., W-8BEN/W-9 forms) and ensure local/international tax reporting is accurate.
  • Distribution: Execute prize payments securely and maintain a detailed audit trail of all disbursements.
  • Communication: Act as the point of contact for prize-related financial queries from winners or agents.

Month-End Closing

  • Assist with posting journals and updating of monthly schedules.
  • Assist with annual/quarterly submission of VAT/GST filing
  • Assist with audit and tax compliance matters

Required Qualifications & Skills

Experience : 1-2 years of experience in a broad finance role covering both AR and AP. Open to fresh graduates.

Education: Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., ACCA, CPA, or CIMA) are a plus.

Technical Proficiency: Advanced Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUPs) and experience with accounting software (e.g., Xero, Zoho Expense, Approvalmax, etc).

title: VVS-montør til varmeinstallation og ventilation i Nørre Alslev
description:
Vil du have ordentlig løn, firmabil og et godt team omkring dig?

Vi mangler en VVS-montør i Nørre Alslev til varme, service og ventilation.

Du lander i et VVS-setup, hvor opgaverne spænder fra spjæld og service til nybyg, renovering, varmeinstallation og ventilation. Kunderne ligger både i private boliger, industri og erhverv, så hverdagen kræver en VVS-montør der kan skifte gear uden at tabe overblikket. Arbejdet skifter mellem selvstændige opgaver, makkerpar og team, alt efter hvad opgaven kræver.

Her får du firmabil, et godt team omkring dig og en hverdag hvor ordentligt arbejdsmiljø ikke bare er noget der står på papiret. Kørekort er nødvendigt, fordi du kører selv ud til opgaverne. Du får plads til at tage ansvar, men du står ikke alene hvis noget skal vendes med en kollega.

Det får du

Løn: 220-245 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Nørre Alslev og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 5 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Service, varme og ventilation

Din hverdag

Opgaverne spænder mellem planlagte installationer og serviceopgaver, hvor der skal handles hurtigt og tænkes praktisk. Når spjæld fylder dagen, handler det om at få fejlsøgt, løst og meldt ordentligt tilbage, før næste opgave kalder. På installationsopgaverne arbejder du mere i forløb, hvor rækkefølge og koordinering betyder noget.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Arbejder med VVS på industri og erhverv
  • Laver VVS på nybyg og renovering
  • Kører spjæld og serviceopgaver
  • Arbejder med varmeinstallationer
  • Løser opgaver med ventilation og klima

Der er et godt team omkring dig, så du kan sige til hvis noget ikke stemmer. Det er den slags hverdag hvor stabilitet, ordentlig dialog og godt håndværk betyder mere end store armbevægelser.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du behøver ikke kunne alt. Men du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine aftaler.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har erfaring som VVS-montør
  • Kan arbejde alene, med makker og som del af et team
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet service, varmeinstallation eller ventilation før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan tage fat og levere arbejde du kan stå inde for.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Tag fat nu - vi skal bruge en VVS-montør mere i Nørre Alslev, og det kunne sagtens være dig.

title: Service and Installation Engineer
description:

This includes (but is not limited to) the setup, troubleshooting and repairing of robots and peripheral devices. You will manage installation, startup and debugging of the system/unit which will require travel to our various customer locations. You’ll need to rely on your technical expertise to successfully troubleshoot hardware, electrical and software issues.

How It’s Done

  • Provide timely reports that include progress, issues, status updates, and on-site planning
  • Provide prompt, professional and courteous solutions to customer problems

  • Provide cross functional support to various departments, including project management, process engineering and controls and software engineering
  • Develop and conduct informal on-site system training
  • Assist in the overall process improvement

What Would Be Even Better

It’s Up To You

At FANUC America Corporation we are passionate about our customers, our employees, and the work we perform. We maintain a workplace where individuals can be proud of, where talents are embraced, and results are encouraged and supported.

We are looking for talented people who value integrity, informed decision-making and collaboration. If you believe you are one of those talented people, and are interested in being considered for a career at FANUC America, we invite you to apply today!

We offer market competitive pay and benefits programs, as well as opportunities for advancement, knowledge and skill development, and recognition of individual achievements. In addition, we offer the following benefits to our employees:

title: Specialpædagoger til Børne - og Ungehjem Lysningen
description:
Vi søger pædagoger til to faste fuldtidsstillinger på 37 timer • Dag- og aftenvagter • Arbejde hver 3. weekend

Vil du være med til at skabe en tryg, struktureret og meningsfuld hverdag for børn og unge med autisme, ADHD og intellektuel funktionsnedsættelse? Og motiveres du af høj faglighed, tæt kollegial sparring og gode muligheder for kompetenceudvikling?

Så kan du være en af vores nye pædagoger på Lysningen.

Om Lysningen

Lysningen er en del af Center for Børne- og Ungehjem i Aarhus Kommune og ligger på Aarslev Møllevej 19 i Brabrand. Vi er et børne- og ungehjem for børn og unge mellem 6 og 17 år med autisme, ADHD og intellektuel funktionsnedsættelse.

Vores pædagogiske arbejde tager afsæt i det enkelte barns udviklingsniveau, behov, ressourcer og perspektiv. I hverdagen har vi fokus på at skabe rammer for socialt samvær, nærvær, leg og sansemæssige aktiviteter.

Om jobbet

Som pædagog på Lysningen bliver du en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor vi sammen skaber sammenhæng og udviklingsmuligheder i børnene og de unges hverdag.

• Du bliver en del af et team, som sammen varetager kontaktpædagogfunktionen for 3–4 børn og unge.

• I samarbejde med barnet eller den unge og familien udarbejder I individuelle mål og handleplaner, som omsættes til konkret pædagogisk praksis i hverdagen.

• Du får egne ansvarsområder og deltager sammen med kollegerne i de praktiske opgaver på afdelingen.

• Du indgår i et tæt samarbejde med forældre, sagsbehandlere, skole, psykiatri og andre fagprofessionelle omkring barnet eller den unge.

Faglighed og udvikling

Hos os skal faglig udvikling være en del af arbejdet. Vi prioriterer en grundig introduktion, løbende faglig sparring og kompetenceudvikling. Centeret har egne instruktører, og som ny medarbejder bliver du inden for de første år uddannet i blandt andet SVS, ATLASS, Studio III og MBSR.

Vi søger dig, der

• Er uddannet pædagog og gerne har erfaring med målgruppen

• Kan arbejde individuelt og målrettet specialpædagogisk med blik for det enkelte barns forudsætninger og behov

• Trives i tydelige og strukturerede rammer og samtidig kan være kreativ, reflekterende og nysgerrig på, om praksis kan gøres anderledes

• Kan bevare ro, overblik og faglighed i situationer, hvor børn og unge kan reagere kraftigt, herunder med selvskadende eller udadreagerende adfærd

• Har lyst til at bidrage aktivt til fælles faglighed, samarbejde og udvikling og kan give og modtage faglig sparring

• Kan organisere og strukturere din egen tid og kommunikere tydeligt både mundtligt og skriftligt

• Kan varetage opgaver med hygiejne og pleje i forhold til målgruppen

• Møder børn, unge, familier og kolleger med nærvær, nysgerrighed og respekt

Vi tilbyder

• En arbejdsplads med fokus på faglighed, kvalitet og et godt arbejdsmiljø

• Et grundigt og fagligt introduktionsforløb

• Gode muligheder for kompetenceudvikling og efteruddannelse

• Et arbejdsmiljø med plads til faglig refleksion, sparring og fælles udvikling

• Et arbejde med ansvar, selvstændighed og mange tværfaglige samarbejdsrelationer

• Et respektfuldt og involverende samarbejde med børnene og de unges forældre

Om stillingerne

Vi søger to pædagoger til faste fuldtidsstillinger med en gennemsnitlig arbejdstid på 37 timer om ugen. Arbejdstiden er skiftende og omfatter dag- og aftenvagter samt weekendarbejde hver 3. weekend.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst med SL på døgnområdet. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer.

Stillingerne er til enhver tid betinget af en tilfredsstillende offentlig straffeattest.
Stillingerne er til enhver tid betinget af en anmærkningsfri børneattest.

Hvis du vil vide mere:

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til Afdelingsleder Mathias Svenstrup på telefon 41 86 44 35.

Ansøgning

Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfrist: 10. november 2026

Samtaler: forventes afholdt i uge 47

Opstart: januar 2027

title: Asset Protection Detective, Broward Mall - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an Asset Protection Detective, you will help protect company assets, reduce shortage, and support a safe, customer-focused shopping environment. Using surveillance, investigative tools, and strong partnerships with store teams and law enforcement, you will identify and respond to theft, recover merchandise, and help protect our customers, colleagues, and business.

Why This Role Matters

Asset Protection Detectives play an important role in reducing loss while maintaining a safe and welcoming store environment. Through training, observation, investigation, and de-escalation, this role helps protect company assets, support colleagues, and ensure customers can shop with confidence.

How Our Asset Protection Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They greet teammates with a warm hello. Before they get started, they review updates and department information so they're fully informed and ready to engage with confidence.

  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.

  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

What To Expect

  • Use surveillance techniques, investigative tools, and reporting systems to help identify theft, dishonest activity, and shortage trends.

  • Partner with Asset Protection leaders, store teams, and law enforcement to support investigations and protect company assets.

  • Apply de-escalation tools and sound judgment to help maintain a safe environment for customers and colleagues.

  • Prepare clear documentation, statements, and evidence to support investigations, audits, and legal proceedings.

  • Support team readiness by training colleagues on protocols that help protect company assets.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Help protect customers, colleagues, and company assets by identifying, investigating, and responding to theft and dishonest activity.

  • Use surveillance techniques to support the apprehension of shoplifters and dishonest employees, while following company policies and legal requirements.

  • Recover stolen merchandise and provide statements, evidence, and documentation to support investigations.

  • Prepare timely and accurate reports related to theft incidents, investigations, audits, and assigned activities.

  • Build strong partnerships with store colleagues, Asset Protection leaders, and law enforcement to support investigations and shortage reduction.

  • Maintain compliance with company policies and legal standards related to apprehensions, searches, and evidence preservation.

  • Testify in court for criminal and civil cases, as needed.

  • Respond to alarm calls, support special assignments, and facilitate first aid for customers and colleagues when needed.

  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Skills That Matter

Must Have

  • Ability to observe, identify, and respond to suspicious activity in a retail environment.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with customers, colleagues, leaders, and law enforcement.

  • Ability to use sound judgment, de-escalation tools, and company procedures to support a safe environment.

  • Ability to handle proprietary, sensitive, and confidential information with discretion and integrity.

  • For jobs in New York, a current New York State Security Guard License is required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in retail, customer service, asset protection, security, investigations, or law enforcement.

  • Ability to prepare accurate reports, statements, and documentation related to incidents and investigations.

  • Experience using surveillance systems, reporting tools, or investigative technology.

  • Ability to train or coach colleagues on asset protection protocols, shortage reduction, or safety practices.

Physical Activities You Will Perform

  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

  • Position requires prolonged periods of standing/walking around store or department.

  • May occasionally involve reaching above eye level, stooping, kneeling, or crouching.

  • Must be able to apprehend shoplifters.

  • Ability to sustain long periods of time enclosed in surveillance areas.

  • Frequently lift/move up to 30lbs.

  • Requires close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

title: Director of AI Engineering, Internal Products
description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

As the Director of AI Engineering, Internal Products at Via, you'll lead an engineering team that builds high-impact internal products using AI-native development practices, while pioneering a platform that enables people across the company to create their own software with AI agents. We call these empowered employees “nano engineers.” This is an opportunity to shape a new engineering discipline, solve problems across the business, and multiply our capacity to innovate.

About the Role:

  • Build products that make our business run better, from internal systems supporting Finance, HR, and Operations to tools that help field teams coordinate work, surface operational insights, resolve exceptions, manage resources, and make better decisions in real time
  • Work closely with the people doing the work, understand their needs firsthand, and turn those insights into products that deliver measurable business impact
  • Rethink software development in the age of AI, using coding agents, AI-assisted development, automated testing, and new engineering workflows to accelerate the journey from identifying a problem to delivering a solution
  • Lead the development of our AI-powered internal development platform, building the integrations, permissions, infrastructure, testing, deployment, and governance needed to make employee-created software reliable and useful
  • Recruit, develop, and lead exceptional engineers, and define the architecture, engineering standards, operating model, and culture that will allow the team to scale its impact
  • Partner with leadership across the company to identify the highest-impact opportunities for software and AI, and challenge conventional assumptions about what to build versus buy

About You:

  • An exceptional engineering leader with a strong technical foundation and experience building and shipping production software; you’ve led engineers, made sound architectural decisions, and delivered systems that people depend on
  • An AI-native builder who actively explores and uses modern AI coding tools and agents, and is excited to rethink how an engineering team should operate
  • A pragmatic systems thinker who understands security, permissions, integrations, observability, testing, and maintainability, and knows how to apply the right level of rigor to each use case
  • A product thinker who cares about the problem being solved, not just the technology, and can turn ambiguous needs into useful products
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; you’re happy to move between strategy, architecture, hands-on building, and working directly with business teams
  • An organizational multiplier, excited about enabling other people to solve problems independently

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base Salary Range: $250,000 - $290,000 per year plus variable pay and equity as part of a total compensation package. Final compensation will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills.
  • Comprehensive health coverage, with low-cost dental and vision plans.
  • A 401(k) with company match and vesting.
  • Fully paid parental leave for new parents, with extended leave options.
  • Additional benefits (mental health, pet insurance, and other wellness perks).
  • 20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually.

There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of public mobility. Ready to join the ride?

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Internship in Communication
description:
Nobia is a Nordic organisation with employees across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland. Among other brands, Nobia owns the kitchen brands HTH, uno form and INVITA.

We work across production, stores and offices in four different countries, which makes clear and targeted internal communication essential to us. Our communication should not only inform. It should create connection, shared understanding and engagement across functions, professional areas and borders.

As a Communication Intern, you will play an important role in ensuring that the right messages reach the right employees through the right channels.

Your role
We are looking for a curious, proactive and engaged intern who wants hands-on experience with internal communication in practice.

You will become an active part of our day-to-day communication work and, among other things, work with:

  • Developing news, articles and other content for internal channels

  • Planning, executing and creating strategic change communication

  • Coordinating and communicating internal events and campaigns

  • Further developing and using our internal channels, including:

    • Intranet

    • Internal employee magazine

    • Internal screens in our offices, which we want to make even better use of

You will have the opportunity to work creatively, strategically and operationally – and become an important contributor to ensuring clear, relevant and targeted communication across the organisation.

About you
You are approachable, positive and thrive in a varied working environment. At the same time, you work in a structured way and take responsibility for your tasks.

We imagine that you:

  • Are passionate about communication and can turn complex messages into clear and easy-to-understand communication

  • Work independently, proactively and take initiative

  • Have a good understanding of different target audiences and can adapt messages accordingly

  • Have a flair for writing and an eye for linguistic quality

  • Are fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken

As you will be identifying and developing stories from across the organisation, it is important that you are a strong relationship-builder and enjoy working with many different types of people.

We imagine that you are currently studying communication, journalism or a related field. Most importantly, however, you are curious, interested in communication and eager to learn. Experience with InDesign and/or Canva is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What we offer
You will be based at Nobia’s Danish head office in Tilst and become part of an ambitious People & Culture team with a strong professional and social community across HR consultants, business partners and students.

During your internship, our most important task is to ensure that you gain relevant experience and concrete skills that you can take with you. We therefore place strong emphasis on providing opportunities for sparring, feedback and development through weekly 1:1 meeting with your manager.

In addition, we offer:

  • A supportive learning environment with a high level of professionalism

  • An internship with responsibility and real influence

  • Modern office facilities in Tilst

  • Free lunch

Practical information
Does this sound like you?

Please upload your CV along with a short motivation explaining why you are a good match for the position.

Application deadline: We interview candidates on an ongoing basis, so please send your CV as soon as possible.

Position type: Student internship

Location: Nobia’s Danish head office in Tilst, near Aarhus

Start date and duration: We expect you to start in January/February 2027 for a period of 4–5 months, working 30–37 hours per week. We will of course take into account if you need to work on your thesis or other assignments during the internship. The internship is unpaid, but you will be included in our lunch scheme at no cost.

Questions: If you have any questions about the internship, please contact our Communication Manager, Maria Kjær Christensen, on +45 53 60 70 76 or mkc@nobia.dk.
