JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Case Management- Perform admission and continued stay reviews on patients to determine the medical necessity of severity of illness and intensity of service for certification of admission and continued stay. This is done utilizing the approved medical management criteria tool i.e. Interqual. Record all required documentation on patient review forms and in computerized systems to maintain a record of the review and the coverage obtained for a patient. Maintain pertinent statistical data as required by the department. Interface with the Admitting Department and/or the Financial Counseling departments to identify correct insurance, coordination of benefits information, effective dates of coverage, pre/admission notifications/authorizations for certification of inpatient admissions. Interface with other members of the health-care team regarding the implementation of discharge planning and the certification justification documentation of patient stays, advising them of external/third party requirements and criteria. Communicates with third party payers to certify inpatient stays. Using data extrapolated from electronic systems, attempt to recognize issues that potentially cause a delay in discharge i.e. poor documentation of SI/IS, delay days and the cause thereof etc.
  • Authorization Process- Works closely with respective parties within the organization to facilitate interaction between medical center personnel and payer personnel to overturn potential and/or final denials. Assists with the retrospective review of records for patients who have insurance changes that impact the authorization of the inpatient encounter. Works with identified Revenue Management Cycle members to obtain reimbursement through the revised/new certification of patient stays. Reviews timeliness, accuracy and security of new information.
  • Compliance- Assist Director in meeting current JCAHO, Medicaid, Medicare, and other third-party payer standards and requirements. Maintains knowledge of changes as impacts regulatory/accrediting compliance for reimbursement. Assist Director in the reporting of information as set forth in the PI plan, i.e., appropriateness of admissions and continued stay reviews including when known, the over and under utilization of resources. Participate in payer, Revenue Management Cycle and interdepartmental meetings to promote knowledge, troubleshoot, problem shoot and resolve issues as relates to utilization management. Serves as an educational and communications resource to Administration, Department heads, physicians and other necessary groups regarding the utilization review/management activity and process. Keep the department manager informed of problems as necessary.
  • Training & Education- Serves as an educational and communications resource to Administration, Department heads, physicians, and other necessary groups regarding Utilization Review.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

title: Platform Administrator
description:
Platform Administrator

Position Summary

The Platform Administrator serves as a trusted advisor and technical administrator for ServiceChannel customers, ensuring platform configurations are maintained, optimized, and aligned to business requirements. This role partners closely with customers, Facility Coordinators, Customer Success, Product Management, and Support teams to implement configuration changes, support platform enhancements, and drive adoption of ServiceChannel capabilities. This position is responsible for administrative configuration, user management, customer-requested updates, and communication regarding platform performance and enhancements.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Platform Administration

  • Configure and maintain ServiceChannel platform settings based on customer requirements.
  • Modify and manage user access, permissions, and administrative settings.
  • Implement customer-requested updates within approved platform modules.
  • Maintain dashboard settings, workflows, and issue list configurations.

Customer Consultation & Support

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for platform administration requests.
  • Review customer enhancement requests and collaborate with internal stakeholders to evaluate solutions.
  • Provide customers with updates on enhancement requests and platform initiatives.
  • Communicate ServiceChannel system performance issues and platform updates to customers and internal stakeholders.

Configuration Management

Support configuration and administration within:

  • Locations & Provider Assignments
  • Asset Management
  • Refrigerant Tracking
  • Site Planning
  • Inventory
  • Projects
  • Supply Manager
  • Preventative Maintenance configuration
  • Business Hours settings
  • Invoice and Proposal workflows
  • Auto Invoice Approval processes
  • Dashboard administration
  • Issue List configuration

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Customer Success Managers, Product teams, Support teams, and Facility Coordinators to deliver customer solutions.
  • Participate in customer meetings related to platform administration and optimization.
  • Document platform changes and maintain configuration records.
  • Escalate issues and risks appropriately to leadership and technical teams.

Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of experience in SaaS administration, customer support, system administration, facility management technology, or related fields.
  • Experience managing customer-facing technology solutions.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and customer requests simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred

  • ServiceChannel platform experience.
  • Zendesk experience.
  • Knowledge of facilities management workflows.
  • Experience with workflow automation and business process optimization.
  • Experience supporting enterprise customers.

Success Measures

  • Customer satisfaction and platform adoption
  • Configuration accuracy and quality
  • Request turnaround time
  • SLA adherence
  • Reduction in configuration-related escalations
  • Customer retention and expansion support
  • Stakeholder satisfaction

title: Teammanager ouderenzorg - d’Oude Raai - Amsterdam Zuid
description:
Voor de woonzorglocatie d’Oude Raai in de Amsterdamse Pijp is Cordaan op zoek naar een teammanager.

Ben jij een ervaren teammanager die stevig in de schoenen staat en duidelijkheid brengt? Weet jij hoe je mensen meeneemt in verandering, met oog voor de mens maar ook met de kracht om grenzen te stellen? Wil je samen met je teams bouwen aan verdere professionalisering en goede zorg? Dan is deze uitdaging als teammanager iets voor jou!

Wat ga je doen?
Als teammanager ouderenzorg geef je leiding aan twee somatische afdelingen en een PG-afdeling. Je bent zichtbaar, bewaakt de kwaliteit van zorg en zorgt voor een cultuur van goede samenwerking, eigenaarschap en professionaliteit.

Je werkt met teams waarin collega’s met verschillende culturele achtergronden, ervaringen en werkstijlen samenwerken. Jij weet mensen met elkaar te verbinden en verschillen als kracht te benutten.

Je geeft warm zakelijk leiding: je bent betrokken en benaderbaar, maar ook duidelijk over verwachtingen, afspraken en verantwoordelijkheden. Je brengt structuur en richting, spreekt medewerkers aan wanneer dat nodig is en stimuleert hen om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Zo help je de teams verder te groeien in professionaliteit, samenwerking en werkplezier.

Je bent veel op de afdelingen aanwezig, weet wat er leeft en voelt de dynamiek binnen je teams goed aan. Je ziet waar verbetering mogelijk is en weet medewerkers mee te nemen in veranderingen.

Jouw belangrijkste taken en verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Leidinggeven aan zorgteams, met aandacht voor kwaliteit, continuïteit en werkplezier.

  • Medewerkers stimuleren en inspireren om samen te werken en actief mee te denken over verbeteringen.

  • Het gesprek aangaan wanneer iets beter kan: eerlijk, duidelijk en altijd met respect.

  • Zorgen voor verbinding met bewoners, hun naasten, mantelzorgers, vrijwilligers én je diverse team.

  • Verbetervoorstellen doen op basis van wat je ziet en hoort op de werkvloer.

  • Maandelijks rapporteren aan de locatiemanager over de financiën, medewerkerstevredenheid, verloop etc.

Wat krijg je van ons?
We bieden je een uitdagende positie binnen een organisatie die de ambitie heeft de beste zorgverlener en zorgwerkgever van Amsterdam en omgeving te zijn. Daarnaast bieden wij je:

  • Contract: Een jaarcontract voor 32 - 36 uur per week met uitzicht op een vast contract;

  • Salaris: min. €3.772,- en max. € 5.413,- bruto (o.b.v. 36 uur p.w.);

  • Extra’s: Eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%), vakantiegeld (8%) en onregelmatigheidstoeslag;

  • Reiskosten: een vergoeding á € 0,21 per km, een fietsplan en gratis parkeren (onder voorbehoud);

  • Pensioenopbouw via Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn;

  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Volop mogelijkheden om je persoonlijk en professioneel te ontwikkelen;

  • Collega aandragen? Ontvang eenmalig een aanbrengbonus van € 500,- netto.

Wie ben jij?
Je bent een ervaren en daadkrachtige leidinggevende die weet hoe je teams sterker maakt. Je communiceert duidelijk, bent consequent en weet wat nodig is om rust en richting te brengen.

Tegelijk ben je benaderbaar en heb je oog voor wat mensen beweegt. Jij weet dat goede zorg stevig leiderschap mét hart voor mensen vraagt. Je hebt affiniteit met het werken in een multiculturele omgeving en weet hoe je verbinding maakt met mensen met verschillende werkstijlen en achtergronden.

Verder breng je mee:

  • Minimaal 3 jaar leidinggevende ervaring in de zorg

  • Een relevant hbo-diploma (zorg, bedrijfskunde of management)

  • De vaardigheid om balans te houden tussen mensgericht en resultaatgericht werken

  • Het vermogen om teams mee te nemen in verandering en ontwikkeling.

  • Een innovatieve blik: je denkt in mogelijkheden, ziet kansen en neemt anderen daar in mee.

Waar ga je werken?
Woonzorgcentrum d'Oude Raai ligt in één van de gezelligste buurten van Amsterdam, aan de Ferdinand Bolstraat. Het is een levendige en toegankelijke locatie met de Albert Cuypmarkt om de hoek en het Sarphatipark op loopafstand.

Onze 91 ruime appartementen bieden bewoners een comfortabele en veilige woonomgeving. 4 etages zijn speciaal ingericht voor bewoners met dementie en 2 etages voor bewoners met een lichamelijke aandoening.

Er worden veel sociale en culturele activiteiten georganiseerd en d’Oude Raai speelt ook een belangrijke rol in de wijk. Het is een fijne plek om te wonen én te werken, met een goede mix van professionaliteit, betrokkenheid en Amsterdamse gezelligheid.

Samen met de locatiemanager, je collega teammanager en de facilitair teammanager vorm je binnen 'd Oude Raai het managementteam.

Enthousiast?
Ben jij de teammanager ouderenzorg die wij zoeken? Solliciteer dan direct online! Het sollicitatieproces bestaat uit meerdere gesprekken en een assessment.

Direct na je sollicitatie ontvang je van ons een bevestigingsmail. Mocht je deze niet ontvangen hebben, check nog even je ongewenste postvak. Met geschikte kandidaten gaan we zo snel mogelijk met in gesprek, we sluiten de vacature wanneer wij onze nieuwe collega gevonden hebben.

Voor inhoudelijke vragen over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Anne-Mieke Rustenburg via 06-2558 6809. Voor meer informatie over de sollicitatieprocedure kun je contact opnemen met Marloes Alteveer (recruiter) via malteveer@cordaan.nl of 06-4843 0289. Wij helpen je graag verder!

Sollicitatievoorwaarden

title: Future Roles: ATG Operator - 2962
description:
We are currently forward planning for future roles that may become available as ATG (Automatic Ticket Gateline) Operator. If you are successful in your application, you will be placed in our Talent Bank for up to six months. If a suitable opportunity becomes available during that time, you may be offered a role.
You could be located at any station between Ipswich & Colchester.
Positions may be available as Static or Relief roles, on either a full-time or part-time basis. Static roles offer a consistent shift pattern, giving you visibility of your shifts for the full year. Relief roles provide flexibility, with weekly rosters issued one week before the shift.
Please only apply if you can meet the following essential requirements and working arrangements:
  • You will be working an average of 35 hours per week. This role is shift-based and includes early starts, late finishes, weekends, and bank holiday working. Earliest shift starts from 0500 and latest finish 2300. Finish time could be extended on stadium event days.
  • You must be able to arrange your own transport to ensure timely arrival for early and late shifts.
  • Applicants must be over 18 years of age
  • Employment is subject to Right to Work and DBS checks, and where applicable, a medical assessment
Kickstart Your Career with Greater Anglia!

Are you looking to launch your career in a dynamic and supportive environment? Greater Anglia, a key player in the railway network from London Liverpool Street to the East of England, is offering an exciting opportunity to join our team. With our new, modern, and environmentally friendly trains, now is the perfect time to join us as we elevate the customer travel experience. Full training and uniform will be provided.

Step into an exciting opportunity with our Customer Service Team as an Automatic Ticket Gate (ATG) Operator. You’ll be the friendly face of Greater Anglia, delivering exceptional customer service while helping passengers travel smoothly and safely.
  • Assist in the operation of the Gateline, providing information and assistance to customers
  • Ensuring the safe, tidy and efficient operation of the gates
  • Helping to prevent ticketless travel and fraudulent activity
  • Reporting any faults and issues promptly
  • Able to safely operate customer access ramps and assist passengers with their luggage.
  • Providing support to mobility/ visually impaired customers, who may need to hold your arm or lean on you for guidance.
We’re Looking for Candidates Who:
  • Have a friendly, approachable demeanor with the ability to communicate effectively
  • Are calm under pressure, able to think on their feet, and able to handle various situations
  • Possess a “can-do” attitude and enjoy working as part of a team
  • Take pride in providing top-notch customer service and passionate in ensuring customer safety
  • Have team spirit and bring your unique self to strengthen our team and foster a positive work environment.
What’s In It for You?
  • Travel Discounts: Enjoy free travel on Greater Anglia and 75% off with other train operators, plus discounts for eligible family members too!
  • International Adventures: After 12 months, unlock discounted international travel for you and your family.
  • Exclusive Discounts: Access the GA Hapi App for deals on shopping, dining, and fun days out.
  • Vouchers for Loved Ones: Get 12 annual discount vouchers for family and friends to enjoy.
  • Wellbeing Support: 24/7 employee assistance, eyecare vouchers, flu jabs, and physiotherapy services.
  • Pension Perks: Start with a Defined Contribution pension, with the option to upgrade to a Final Salary pension after 2 years.
  • Family-Friendly Policies: We’ve got you covered with maternity, paternity, adoption leave, and shared parental leave after 26 weeks.
  • Save While You Spend: Cycle to work and tech purchase schemes once you pass probation.
  • Car Scheme: Eligible colleagues can access our Electric Vehicle Salary Sacrifice Scheme, offering a hassle-free way to drive a new or pre-loved electric vehicle.

The closing date for all completed applications is on Friday 23rd October 2026.
*Please note vacancies can close earlier due to high influx of candidate applications*

At Greater Anglia we are proud of the work that we do. We’re investing to help shape the future of rail in the UK and being a part of our team gives you every opportunity to contribute to the journey we are on.

title: AI Engineer
description:
YOUR MISSION AT VOI

As an AI Engineer at Voi, you will build and own the AI platform that our business depends on. Close to 400 colleagues use Voi’s AI platform every day, and teams across the company have already built over 300 apps on our in-house app-building platform.

This is a hands-on builder role in a small, senior team where your work will have company-wide impact. You will keep our existing AI platform fast, secure, and reliable, while building the next generation of capabilities that help Voi move faster, work smarter, and continue leading in applied AI.

You will:

  • Own and improve Voi’s AI platform, including our in-house app-building platform, Claude stack and future AI capabilities.

  • Build robust backend services and full-stack, user-facing features that make the platform reliable, scalable, and easy to use.

  • Develop the next layer of AI infrastructure, such as agentic platforms, enterprise search, knowledge bases, knowledge graphs and open-weight model access.

  • Strengthen security, identity and access control across the platform, including permissions, security reviews, audits and integrations with company systems.

  • Work closely with the AI team, platform team and colleagues across Voi to understand needs, test ideas and ship useful tools quickly.

  • Help decide what we build, buy or integrate, with a focus on control, long-term value and avoiding vendor lock-in.

  • Explore the AI landscape and bring promising ideas into the platform when they are ready to scale.

WHAT YOU NEED TO EMBARK

We are looking for an experienced engineer who enjoys building platforms that many people rely on. You combine strong backend skills with product thinking, sound judgement, and the ability to work closely with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

We believe you bring:

  • Strong experience building and running robust, scalable internal platforms, ideally including AI platforms.

  • A solid backend engineering background, with experience building applications and services at scale.

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs in production, such as agents, tool use, MCP, RAG, search or evaluation.

  • Full-stack ability and a good sense of UX, especially when building tools for non-engineers.

  • Good understanding of identity, authentication and access control, or a strong interest in going deeper in this area.

  • A practical builder mindset, with the ability to turn ideas into working software and iterate quickly.

  • Autonomy, ownership and good judgement in open-ended technical areas.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to different audiences.

Don’t meet every requirement? If you are excited about this role and our mission, and have relevant, transferable skills, we encourage you to apply – even if you don’t check every box.

WHY VOI?

Working at Voi is more than just a job; our People Promise includes a personal voyage where you will grow as a professional and be a part of a team and culture that builds something meaningful for society. In addition to this, you’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Own a platform that is already critical to how Voi works and shape what comes next.

  • Join Europe’s #1 micromobility operator and one of the fastest-growing scale-ups.

  • Help build agentic, knowledge and open-model infrastructure from the ground up.

  • Work in a small, senior team with high trust, fast decisions and a clear mandate.

  • Get “skin in the game” through our employee options programme.

  • Enjoy unlimited free Voi rides and a dog-friendly office.

  • Work together with inspiring, motivated and fun colleagues towards a common goal.

  • Join the micromobility revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution.

title: Digital Product Owner
description:
At the Vitrolife Group, we work every day to unlock the full potential of science and technology to reduce the barriers towards building a family. Together we help our customers and their patients to fulfill the dream of having a healthy baby.

Vitrolife Group is a global provider of medical devices and genetic services. Based on science and advanced research capabilities, we develop services and products for personalized genetic information and medical device products. We support our customers by improving their clinical practice for the patient's outcome of fertility treatment.

Build Laboratory Digital Products That Actually Matter

We are looking for a Digital Product Owner who wants to take real ownership of laboratory digital products and deliver meaningful outcomes. This role is for someone who values clarity, focus, and impact, and is comfortable making decisions in a regulated, fast-paced research and clinical environment.

As a Digital Product Owner, you will define the product vision and priorities for one of our key laboratory digital products. You will work closely with lab scientists, QA/compliance, data stakeholders, and IT to ensure we build solutions that deliver the greatest value to our users and business.

Your Mission

  • Own and communicate a clear product vision aligned with lab goals and regulatory requirements.

  • Translate strategic initiatives into a prioritized, outcome-driven backlog.

  • Ensure delivered features create real lab value while maintaining compliance and data integrity.

  • Act as the primary interface between the laboratory and development IT teams.

What You Will Do

  • Define and continuously refine the product roadmap.

  • Prioritize the backlog based on value, risk, and dependencies.

  • Write and refine user stories with clear acceptance criteria and validation requirements.

  • Accept delivered work and ensure quality, compliance, and value realization.

  • Engage with stakeholders to align expectations and manage trade-offs.

  • Use data and feedback to guide product decisions and improvements.

What You Bring

  • Experience as a Product Owner, Laboratory IT Product Manager, or similar role.

  • Strong understanding of agile ways of working and laboratory delivery.

  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on backlog management.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Comfort making decisions and setting clear priorities in a regulated environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with LIMS, ELN, or enterprise platforms (ERP/CRM) in a lab context.

  • Experience working under GLP/GMP or similar conditions.

  • Familiarity with data-driven product development and KPIs relevant to lab operations.

Why Join Us

  • Real ownership and mandate, not just a title.

  • Laboratory products with real users and real impact.

  • Cross-functional teams with strong technical capabilities.

  • A culture that values clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • Private medical insurance, employee discounts, and additional benefits.

Please note that the interview will be conducted in English.

Vitrolife Group is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities.


Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

We are currently approximately 1 100 colleagues worldwide, with headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden. Vitrolife Group's products and services are available in more than 110 countries through our own presence in 30 countries and a network of distributors. Vitrolife Group is a sustainable market leader and aims to be the preferred partner for IVF-clinics by providing superior products and services with the vision of fulfilling the dream of having a baby. The Vitrolife share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm.

title: Social- og sundhedsassistent til dagvagt på Baldersbo Plejehjem
description:
Vil du have et job med mening, hvor du kan bringe din faglighed i spil og yde nærværende pleje og omsorg? Vil du være en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi finder de gode løsninger sammen, og hvor du får engagerede og ambitiøse kolleger med høj faglighed og som alle bidrager til det gode arbejdsmiljø? Så har vi jobbet!

Når du træder ind på Baldersbo Plejehjem mærker du en god atmosfære, hvor ro, fællesskab, god energi og trivsel er nøgleord – og et sted, som er rart at være. Dagvagten er præget af et godt samarbejde, høj grad af tillid og lavt sygefravær. Vi lykkes med at finde løsninger sammen, og vi går alle på arbejde med en positiv tilgang til beboere og kolleger.

Vi er en blanding af social- og sundhedsassistenter, sygeplejersker, social- og sundhedshjælpere, ledere, udviklingssygeplejerske, rengøringspersonale, servicemedarbejdere, flexjobber og enkelte ufaglærte. Vi har også elever og studerende og ansvarlige vejledere.

Fælles for os alle er, at vi arbejder mod det samme mål, nemlig at vores borgere har en god hverdag. Vi ønsker medarbejdere, der arbejder med høj faglighed og som tør lære, med, af og om hinanden.

Huset består af fem somatiske afdelinger og tre demensafdelinger, det er på en af de somatiske afdelinger vi søger en ny kollega.

Du bliver en del af et fast team, men vi arbejder også tæt sammen på tværs af huset, hvor vi hjælper og støtter hinanden. Fælles for os alle er ønsket om at skabe tryghed, trivsel og den bedst mulige pleje og omsorg for vores beboere.

Vi er optaget af den nye ældrelov om selvbestemmelse og livskvalitet. Vi har fokus på den enkelte beboer og dennes behov og arbejder bevidst med faglig videndeling og samarbejde – også på tværs af vagthold – hvor omdrejningspunktet er, hvad der er bedst for beboerne.

Baldersbo Plejehjems kerneopgave er:
Vi lykkes, når beboere og andre brugere af Baldersbo Plejehjem oplever, at vi sammen understøtter borgeren i at leve sit liv!

Du får en leder, der går op i det gode arbejdsmiljø og medarbejderne, som oplever selvstændighed og føler sig set. Tillid og psykologisk tryghed er vigtige nøgleord, og hun mener, at den gode relation, anerkendelse og samskabelse er afgørende for den gode trivsel og høje kvalitet i opgaveløsningen. Hun har en åben tilgang og ser altid muligheder. Og så har hun blik for, at arbejdsliv og privatliv skal hænge sammen.

Du er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent, og du er en teamplayer, der forstår vigtigheden af god kommunikation og videndeling. Vi er afhængige af hinanden, og der er behov for en høj grad af tillid, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og samarbejder om hele tiden at blive dygtigere både som individer og som team. Samtidig kan du arbejde selvstændigt og træffe beslutninger på egen hånd inden for dit eget kompetenceområde.

Vi arbejder med FS3 og omsorgssystemet Cura, det er derfor en fordel, hvis du kender det, og ellers skal vi nok lære dig op i det. Vi holder daglig triage i alle vagtlag, og der er plads til fordybelse og læring samt undervisning og kurser. Vi vægter beboerne højt og ser hemmelighed og trivsel som vigtig parameter for alle.

Vi kan tilbyde en arbejdsplads med højt til loftet, hvor der både er, og skal være, plads til at grine og plads til at diskutere faglige dilemmaer.

Vi glæder os til at tage imod dig og få dig godt ombord.

Praktiske oplysninger
Vagtplanrul er tilrettelagt med weekend hver 3. uge. Og du vil selv være med i tilrettelæggelsen af dit vagtrul.

Ansættelse pr. 1. november 2026.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Vi indhenter straffeattester samt referencer fra tidligere ansættelser i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

Ansøgningsfristen er fredag den 30. oktober 2026

Vi afholder løbende samtaler.

title: SIEM / SOAR-specialist inom logghantering
description:
Vi är specialister på bemanning och konsulttjänster inom IT och teknik – från lovande talanger och konsulter med bred kompetens till erfarna specialister med djup expertis.

För dig som kandidat innebär vi en trygg partner som erbjuder spännande uppdrag, personlig utveckling och nära kontakt med våra rådgivare. Vi ser till att du får rätt uppdrag för din kompetens och dina ambitioner – alltid med människan i centrum.

För våra kunder betyder det att vi är en pålitlig leverantör som snabbt kan matcha rätt kompetens med rätt behov. Utöver vår egen starka konsultorganisation har vi även ett utökat partnernätverk, vilket gör att vi kan erbjuda ännu större flexibilitet och bredd i leveransen.

Samarbete och kvalitet präglar allt vi gör, och våra kärnvärden sammanfattas i vårt löfte: Empowering the Nordics through people.

Eccera har 300 anställda och kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö och Linköping. Vi är medlem i Almega Kompetensföretagen och följer deras tecknade kollektivavtal med Unionen.

Vill du utveckla säkerhetsövervakning och logghantering med Guardsix?

Eccera söker nu en erfaren SIEM / SOAR-specialist med gedigen erfarenhet av Guardsix (tidigare Logpoint) för ett konsultuppdrag med fokus på logghantering, säkerhetsövervakning och automatiserad incidenthantering. Du får en central roll i att etablera en stabil grund för organisationens säkerhetsövervakning och skapa förutsättningar för fortsatt utveckling av plattformen.

Rollen kan utföras på distans.

Som konsult på Eccera får du en trygg anställning och samlar på dig värdefull arbetslivserfarenhet på uppdrag hos våra kunder. Din konsultchef stöttar dig i din utveckling där du hela tiden fyller på med nya erfarenheter och kunskaper. En utmärkt möjlighet att göra karriär.

Om uppdraget

För att stärka förmågan inom säkerhetsövervakning och logghantering behöver kunden förstärka sitt team med specialistkompetens inom Guardsix. Uppdraget omfattar etablering, konfiguration och vidareutveckling av plattformen, med fokus på att skapa en strukturerad och ändamålsenlig lösning för insamling, analys och hantering av loggar och säkerhetshändelser.

Du kommer att arbeta med integration och onboarding av loggar och larm från applikationer, servrar, tjänster och andra relevanta säkerhetsverktyg. En viktig del av uppdraget är att säkerställa god datakvalitet genom normalisering och berikning av loggdata, exempelvis med information från EDR- och NDR-lösningar.

Rollen omfattar även utveckling av detektioner, larmregler och use cases samt etablering av SOAR-funktionalitet genom playbooks och standardiserade incidentflöden. Du kommer att ta fram dashboards och operativa vyer som stödjer analys, övervakning och uppföljning. Arbetet innefattar också test och verifiering av lösningar, dokumentation av konfigurationer och arbetssätt samt kunskapsöverföring till interna resurser.

Målet är att etablera en stabil och väldokumenterad grundstruktur i Guardsix som möjliggör fortsatt utveckling och effektiv förvaltning av plattformen.

Din bakgrund

Vi söker dig som har minst 5 års erfarenhet av implementation och införande av större lösningar inom logghantering hos företag eller organisationer med flera dotterbolag eller förvaltningar och komplexa beroenden mellan många system. Du har även minst 5 års erfarenhet av produkten Guardsix (tidigare Logpoint).

Du har minst 3 års erfarenhet av SIEM-funktionalitet i Guardsix (tidigare Logpoint) eller motsvarande verktyg, där du har arbetat med exempelvis logghantering, korrelation, detektioner, larmregler och utveckling av säkerhetsrelaterade use cases. Därutöver har du minst 1 års erfarenhet av SOAR-funktionalitet i Guardsix eller motsvarande verktyg, med fokus på automatisering, playbooks och standardiserade flöden för hantering av larm och säkerhetshändelser.

Du har en god förståelse för hur loggdata samlas in, struktureras, normaliseras och berikas från olika system och säkerhetsverktyg. Du är van vid att arbeta med integrationer, kvalitetssäkring av loggflöden och utveckling av lösningar som stödjer en effektiv och tillförlitlig säkerhetsövervakning.

Vem är du?

Som person är du strukturerad, analytisk och självgående. Du har förmågan att sätta dig in i komplexa tekniska miljöer och omsätta verksamhetens behov till fungerande och hållbara lösningar. Du arbetar metodiskt med implementation, test och dokumentation och har ett kvalitetsmedvetet förhållningssätt till både tekniska lösningar och etablerade arbetssätt.

Du trivs med att ta ansvar för tekniska leveranser och att samarbeta med både tekniska specialister och interna intressenter. Du har också förmågan att förmedla kunskap och skapa förutsättningar för att andra ska kunna vidareutveckla och förvalta lösningen efter att uppdraget avslutats.

Låter det som ett uppdrag för dig?

Har du gedigen erfarenhet av Guardsix, SIEM och SOAR och vill bidra till att etablera en stabil grund för kvalificerad säkerhetsövervakning? Då vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med dig!

Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan eller kontakta oss för mer information om uppdraget.

Vad vi erbjuder

På Eccera får du de verktyg du behöver för att nå dina mål. Vi erbjuder alla våra konsulter kvalificerade utbildningar och certifieringar inom den senaste tekniken. Vi sätter stort värde på att våra medarbetare hela tiden ska fortsätta att utvecklas. Därför erbjuder vi dig möjligheten att lägga upp en individuell utbildningsplan, där vi bekostar såväl studiematerial som själva certifieringarna. Under din utveckling kommer vi matcha din kompetens mot rätt uppdrag i takt med att du avancerar.

title: Schools and Community Engagement Officer
description:
Help inspire Scotland’s next generation of digital talent!

Are you a natural people person who loves building relationships, engaging with young people and making a difference?

At QA, we’re looking for an enthusiastic and proactive Schools & Community Engagement Coordinator to help us connect young people across Scotland with exciting apprenticeship opportunities.

You’ll be at the heart of our schools and community engagement activity, working with educators, community organisations and apprenticeship ambassadors to raise awareness of apprenticeships and inspire young people to take their first steps towards a career in digital and technology.

What you’ll be doing

  • Building strong relationships with schools, colleges, community groups and youth organisations across Scotland.

  • Attending and delivering engaging careers events, presentations and workshops to promote apprenticeship opportunities.

  • Recruiting, coordinating and supporting our network of Apprenticeship Ambassadors.

  • Planning and organising events, including coordinating resources, materials and ambassador attendance.

  • Working closely with our Marketing and Recruitment teams to develop creative ways of reaching and engaging young people.

  • Supporting QA’s Tech for Futures and EduQate engagement programmes.

  • Monitoring engagement activity, gathering leads and reporting on event outcomes.

Measuring your impact

You’ll play an important role in helping us grow our apprenticeship talent pipeline across Scotland. Success in this role will be measured through key performance indicators, including the partnerships you develop, young people you engage with and the number of potential candidates progressing from initial engagement to apprenticeship applications.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone who is confident, organised, creative and passionate about helping young people succeed.

You’ll bring:

  • Experience delivering presentations, workshops or events.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to build relationships with a wide range of people.

  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and work independently.

  • Confidence using Microsoft Office, digital systems and social media.

  • A proactive, enthusiastic approach and a genuine interest in supporting young people.

  • Experience working with schools, young people, community organisations or within the early careers sector would be an advantage, but isn’t essential.

  • A full UK driving licence and access to a reliable vehicle are essential, as regular travel across Scotland is required. Occasional evening events may also be involved.

  • The successful candidate will be required to complete appropriate pre-employment safeguarding checks.

Why QA?

At QA, we’re passionate about unlocking potential. As a leading provider of digital and technology training, we help people develop the skills and confidence to build successful careers.

You’ll be joining a collaborative and supportive team, with the opportunity to make a genuine difference to young people’s futures while developing your own skills and experience.

What we offer

  • 27 days’ annual leave (including 4 days for festive closure), plus bank holidays.

  • Hybrid working, with 2 days per week in our Glasgow office.

  • Early Friday finish at 4pm.

  • Holiday buying scheme.

  • Pension scheme.

  • Medicash plan and Wellhub access.

  • Employee Assistance Programme.

  • Private medical insurance at corporate rates.

  • Employee discounts and Cycle to Work scheme.

  • 3 personal development and training days each year.

  • 2 charity days annually.

  • Access to QA’s digital learning resources and professional development opportunities.

Ready to make a difference?

If you’re passionate about inspiring young people, creating opportunities and helping shape Scotland’s future digital workforce, we’d love to hear from you.

Equality, Diversity & Inclusion

QA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a Disability Confident Employer. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

As part of our Disability Confident commitment, applicants with a disability who meet the essential role criteria will progress to the next stage of the recruitment process. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

title: Registered Dietitian
description:
Inova Mount Vernon Hospital Clinical Nutrition is looking for a dedicated Registered Dietitian to join the Team. This full-time role will be day-shift working various days located in Alexandria, VA.


The Registered Dietitian provides safe and therapeutic nutritional care in a comprehensive and systematic manner. Provides clinical services and act as a resource to physicians, nurses and other professional healthcare team members, to provide patients with optimum nutritional care.

Inova is consistently ranked a national healthcare leader in safety, quality and patient experience. We are also proud to be consistently recognized as a top employer in both the D.C. metro area and the nation.

Featured Benefits:

  • Committed to Team Member Health: offering medical, dental and vision coverage, and a robust team member wellness program.
  • Retirement: Inova matches the first 5% of eligible contributions – starting on your first day.
  • Tuition and Student Loan Assistance: offering up to $5,250 per year in education assistance and up to $10,000 for student loans.
  • Mental Health Support: offering all Inova team members, their spouses/partners, and their children 25 mental health coaching or therapy sessions, per person, per year, at no cost.
  • Work/Life Balance: offering paid time off, paid parental leave, flexible work schedules.

Registered Dietitian Responsibilities:

  • Performs a comprehensive assessment by interpreting multiple, sometimes conflicting, data and synthesizing their interrelationships.
  • Formulates an individualized nutrition plan of care based on assessment findings and interpreting trends in patient populations to achieve best practice.
  • Anticipates nutritional intervention issues, monitors patient tolerance to nutrition therapy and responds when standards of nutrition care recommend changes.
  • Coordinates the nutrition care plan with the physician and other healthcare providers while serving as a resource in the integration of the nutrition care plan into the comprehensive plan of care for the patient.
  • Communicates with the healthcare team members, patients and families to maximize patient outcomes.
  • Collaborates with the multidisciplinary team to increase practice knowledge and incorporate that knowledge into the nutrition plan of care.
  • Provides education to physicians, residents, nurses and other healthcare providers to optimize nutrition therapy outcomes.
  • Incorporates research findings into nutrition practice standards, may develop/revise patient education programs when applicable, and participates in the development and revision of patient education materials.
  • Assesses the educational needs of patients/families and provides appropriate nutrition education/counseling.
  • Provides education to physicians, residents, nurses, and other healthcare providers to optimize nutrition therapy interventions and outcomes. Incorporates research findings into nutrition practice standards, may develop/revise patient education programs when applicable, and participates in the development and revision of patient education materials.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree minimum if licensed before 1/1/2024; Dietitians registered after 1/1/2024 must hold a Master's Degree

  • Certification: Registered Dietitian (RD) within 3 months; Basic Life Support (BLS) from American Heart Association (AHA)

title: Audio-Visual Project Manager
description:

Conti LLC - Audio Visual Division Fort Lauderdale, Florida

This role serves as the primary point of contact between clients, field personnel, subcontractors, vendors, and internal departments to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

The ideal candidate will possess strong project management capabilities, technical knowledge of audio-visual systems, and the ability to effectively coordinate multiple stakeholders throughout all phases of project delivery. This position offers the opportunity to work on a wide variety of AV integration projects including corporate facilities, healthcare environments, educational institutions, hospitality venues, municipal facilities, transportation infrastructure, command centers, and other commercial applications.

title: Technical Asset Planner - Distilling
description:
Job Title: Technical Asset Planner - Distilling

Function: Distilling

Location: Invergordon Distillery, Invergordon, Scotland – multi-site role covering Whyte & Mackay’s five distilleries and maturation sites.

Job Level: (Internal Reference Only) 4

Contract: Full Time / Permanent - Monday to Thursday, 08:00am – 4:30pm & Friday, 08:00 – 14:00 (38 hours p/w) Some evenings and weekend work, travel within the UK will be required.

Role Reports to: Engineering Manager

Date vacancy will close: Friday, 30th October 2026. Where we receive high numbers of applications we may close vacancies early. If you think this is the right opportunity for you please don't delay in applying!

Who we are:

Born in Glasgow, made in Scotland and enjoyed around the world. Whyte and Mackay is home to a collection of multi-award-winning global whisky brands led by The Dalmore, Fettercairn, Jura and Tamnavulin. Our mission is to be a driving force in whisky, renowned for building brands that stand-out. Enabled by our brilliant community of 675 colleagues, reaching across 17 countries and counting. We're led by our values, continuing to grow and invest and looking for great talent to join our brilliant community. Ready to hear more?

What the opportunity looks like:

The Technical Asset Planner – Distilling is responsible for planning, organising and coordinating engineering and maintenance work across Whyte & Mackay’s five distillery and 2 maturation sites.

The role ensures that maintenance activities, engineering tasks, statutory work, shutdown activity and contractor work are effectively scoped, risk assessed, permitted, scheduled and ready for safe execution.

A key part of the role is to control and manage the permit to work system, ensuring that all tasks have suitable risk assessments and method statements submitted in time, reviewed appropriately and included within the agreed work plan before execution.

Engineering and maintenance planning

  • Plan and coordinate engineering and maintenance work across the distillery and maturation estate, ensuring activities are clearly scoped, prioritised, scheduled and aligned with operational requirements.

Work scheduling and plan governance

  • Develop and maintain short, medium and longer-term maintenance plans covering preventive maintenance, corrective work, statutory tasks, contractor activity, shutdown works and operational access requirements.

Permit to work management

  • Control and manage the permit to work system for engineering and maintenance activities, ensuring permits are prepared, reviewed, authorised and issued in accordance with company procedures and site safety requirements.

RAMS coordination and compliance

  • Ensure all planned tasks have suitable and sufficient risk assessments, method statements and required supporting documentation submitted, reviewed and approved in advance of work being added to or released from the plan.

Shutdown and outage planning

  • Support the planning and coordination of shutdowns, outages and major maintenance windows, ensuring work packs, permits, RAMS, materials, services, contractors and access requirements are prepared in advance.

Contractor work coordination

  • Coordinate contractor maintenance and engineering activities so that contractor work is planned, documented, risk assessed and integrated into site schedules without compromising safety, production or compliance.

Maintenance system and data management

  • Maintain accurate planning information within the CMMS or maintenance management system, including work orders, task status, priorities, resource needs, completion updates and backlog visibility.

Planning meetings and cross-functional coordination

  • Lead planning meetings with engineering, production, HSE and site teams to agree priorities, resolve constraints, confirm work readiness and communicate planned activity clearly.

Compliance, safety and risk control

  • Ensure engineering and maintenance work is planned in accordance with health and safety requirements, statutory obligations, site rules, permit requirements and company engineering standards.

Continuous improvement

  • Identify and deliver improvements to planning discipline, permit compliance, maintenance readiness, shutdown preparation, contractor coordination and workflow efficiency across the estate.

Skills and experience that will help you be a success:

For this role we're looking for:

  • Experience in engineering planning, maintenance planning, maintenance coordination or engineering administration within manufacturing, process, utilities, food and drink, spirits or a similarly regulated operational environment.

  • Engineering qualification, apprenticeship, HNC/HND or equivalent experience in a relevant engineering discipline is desirable.

  • Good understanding of maintenance planning principles, work order management and planned maintenance routines.

  • Experience using a CMMS, EAM or computerised maintenance management system.

  • Strong understanding of permit to work systems, safe systems of work and contractor control is desirable.

  • Practical knowledge of risk assessments, method statements and supporting documentation requirements.

  • Experience coordinating maintenance contractors and multi-discipline engineering tasks.

  • Understanding of statutory inspection requirements and maintenance compliance activities.

  • Ability to coordinate multiple workstreams across different sites and stakeholder groups.

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise competing requirements and challenge incomplete work requests constructively.

  • Awareness of mechanical, electrical, controls, utilities and process equipment maintenance requirements.

  • IOSH, NEBOSH, permit to work, contractor control, risk assessment or CMMS training would be advantageous.

We believe that everyone has the potential for growth in our roles! You may feel you don't tick every box for this role, but if you believe you have relevant experiences that could help you succeed we'd much rather you apply rather than rule yourself out based on any self-limiting beliefs!

Why join us:

We offer a competitive salary, bonus package, life assurance, competitive pension, excellent product allowance, 35 days annual leave, plus enhanced family friendly policies. Our Rewards & Benefits page has further information.

Our application process:

If you like what you’ve read and want to explore this opportunity further, please apply before the closing date listed at the top of the advert.

Our team read each and every application, therefore you'll hear back from us in due course.

Candidate guidance on the use of AI in the application and screening process can be found on our career site.

Should you require any adjustments to our recruitment process to help you be at your best then please contact us at HRTeam@whyteandmackay.com and we'll do what we can to support.

  • er fortrolig med IT og hurtigt lærer nye systemer.

Din uddannelse er ikke afgørende, men erfaring fra et lignende kundeservicejob er en fordel. Det vigtigste er, at du taler dansk og tysk og brænder for at gøre en positiv forskel for vores gæster ved at hjælpe dem med at finde den helt rette feriebolig.

Vi tilbyder

  • et afvekslende fuldtidsjob med base på vores kontor i Glostrup.

  • en hverdag med fuldt fokus på noget af det bedste her i livet - nemlig ferie og rejser.

  • et job, der kan balanceres til dit øvrige liv. Arbejdstiden ligger hovedsageligt på hverdage i dagtimerne. Derudover indgår vagttelefon uden for normal arbejdstid cirka hver 6.-7. uge samt enkelte weekendvagter i højsæsonen.

  • kolleger, der sætter en ære i at være hjælpsomme og positive over for både kunder og samarbejdspartnere.

Om Campaya

Campaya Sommerhusudlejning er danskejet og har hvert år siden 2013 hjulpet mange tusinde danske og udenlandske feriegæster med at finde indkvarteringen til deres ferier.

Vores udlejningsportal findes på ti forskellige sprog, og vi udlejer et meget stort antal ferieboliger i hele Europa.

Vores kontor ligger på Sydvestvej 15, 2600 Glostrup, hvorfra du også får dit fremtidige virke. Der vil være mulighed for hjemmearbejde i nogen grad, men arbejdet kommer primært til at foregå fra kontoret.

Sådan søger du

Send en kort ansøgning om, hvorfor du passer til jobbet, sammen med dit CV til fsb@campaya.eu. Spørgsmål om stillingen kan også sendes hertil.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når vi har fundet vores nye kollega.

title: Industritekniker til CNC-bearbejdning og finish i Skive
description:
Er du industritekniker og vil du have frihed under ansvar?



Her arbejder du med CNC-bearbejdning og kvalitet i Skive.



Du lander i en CNC-afdeling, hvor komplekse metalemner og prototyper er en fast del af hverdagen. Opgaverne ligger i produktion for industrikunder, og der arbejdes med både bearbejdning, automatisering og finish. Holdet er større end et klassisk værksted, men rollen kræver stadig at du kan tage ansvar for dine egne opgaver. Der er frihed under ansvar og kollegaer omkring dig, når noget skal vendes fagligt.

Det gode ved rollen er kombinationen af præcision og selvstændighed. Du får lov at nørde med CNC, måleteknik og kvalitetssikring uden at dagen bliver ren maskinpasning. Personaleforeningen og kollegaskabet fylder også, så jobbet ikke kun handler om emner, mål og tolerancer.

Det får du

Løn: 200-250 kr. i timen

Arbejdsområde: Skive og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 60 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: CNC, måleteknik og selvstændigt ansvar

Din hverdag

Når en opgave er klar, arbejder du med emnet gennem bearbejdning, måling og justering. Du bruger din faglighed til at holde styr på finish og tolerancer, og du siger til hvis noget ikke stemmer. Der er plads til at tage egne beslutninger, når processen kræver det.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • CNC-bearbejdning af tekniske metalemner
  • Måleteknik og kvalitetssikring undervejs
  • Arbejde med specialer, automatisering og finish
  • CAD og CAM af fixturer og hjælpeværktøjer
  • Afvikling og justering af CNC-programmer

Når tolerancerne driller, forventes det ikke at du gætter dig frem. Du tager dialogen, får styr på næste skridt og afleverer noget du kan stå inde for.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har erfaring som industritekniker, CNC-operatør eller fra lignende metalproduktion
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt ved maskinerne
  • Arbejder systematisk med måling og kvalitet
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt

Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med CNC-bearbejdning, CAM eller komplekse emner før. Det vigtigste er, at du tager ansvar og holder hovedet koldt, når præcisionen tæller.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.



Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.



Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.



Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Tag fat nu - vi skal bruge en industritekniker mere i Skive, og det kunne sagtens være dig.



Specialer, automatisering og finish, CNC-bearbejdning, Måleteknik og kvalitetssikring

title: BI/Analytics Developer
description:
BI/Analytics Developer
Company: Qualitrol
Location: India
Reports To: Manager, Revenue Operations
About Qualitrol
Qualitrol is the global leader in electrical condition monitoring and protection solutions, trusted by utilities in more than 120 countries. Since 1945, we have pioneered innovations that deliver real-time insights, prevent failures, and ensure the reliability of the world's energy grid. With over 4 million installations worldwide, our monitoring technologies safeguard critical assets, extend equipment life, and reduce operational risk. Our expert service teams bring decades of hands-on experience, offering diagnostics, training, and consulting to help customers make smarter, data-driven decisions. Represented on global standards bodies, Qualitrol is recognized as a trusted advisor shaping the future of grid reliability. For over 80 years, our mission has remained clear: protecting power systems with reliable solutions that keep the lights on.
Job Description
We are seeking a BI/Analytics Developer to drive Qualitrol's Business Intelligence strategy through advanced analytics and AI-enabled tools. This role is pivotal in transforming raw Salesforce, Oracle, and forecast data into consolidated, actionable dashboards — including a unified rollup view for regional sales directors — while leveraging Microsoft Copilot, Fabric, Power BI, and Power Automate.
Key Responsibilities
● Build the data foundation first: semantic models, KPI definitions, data source mapping, and presentation standards, agreed with business owners and approved by the Manager, Revenue Operations.
● Lead data strategy and AI-driven analytics by applying Copilot, Fabric, Power BI, and other Power Platform tools to deliver scalable insights.
● Champion AI adoption among sales and commercial peers and leadership, leading pilot projects that demonstrate productivity gains from AI-enabled tools — this is a change-management responsibility, not just tool usage.
● Design, develop, and optimize BI solutions, including dashboards, reports, and data models that integrate Salesforce CRM data.
● Build and maintain consolidated regional-director dashboards spanning pipeline, forecast, and KPI data across all regions.
● Apply advanced analytics and AI to uncover trends, predictive insights, and opportunities for smarter decision-making.
● Establish governance standards for data quality, security, and best practices across enterprise BI platforms.
● Provide Power BI, analytics, and AI training and enablement to sales and commercial teams to drive self-service adoption.
● Support the Commercial Operations Digitization Portfolio, including the Pricing Analytics & PVM Tool and related initiatives.
● Manage BI tool subscriptions and licensing (e.g., Inforiver) as part of the reporting portfolio.
Additional Requirements
● Regular availability during agreed hours that overlap the US Eastern workday, for payout cycles, meetings, workshops and sales leadership reviews.
Minimum Qualifications
● 3+ years of experience in commercial data analytics, BI, or a related role.
● Proven expertise in Microsoft Power BI, Fabric, and Power Automate.
● Experience integrating Salesforce CRM data into BI solutions.
● Experience with order forecasting and plan modeling.
● Familiarity with large language models (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude).
● Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear business insights.
Preferred Qualifications
● Proficiency in Python or SQL for data analysis.
● Experience with Oracle ERP.
● BS/MS degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or an equivalent field.
● Direct or indirect experience supporting sales or commercial teams.

title: Risk Lead
description:
Hacksaw Markets is a B2B prediction-market platform that operators can use to offer prediction markets under their own brands. Most markets are listed and settled automatically. A shared order book creates a rare view of exposure across markets, operators and participants. At launch, the Risk Lead will cover operations risk, quantitative risk and surveillance, then grow the function into a round-the-clock desk. You will lead the Risk desk alongside Markets, Settlement, Operators and Compliance, starting hands-on and building the team as the platform expands.

What you will own

  • Define limits across markets, operators and participants, plus the policies that trigger automatic or manual halts.
  • Halt markets, cancel trades or change limits when conditions require it, documenting each decision.
  • Design surveillance rules for insider patterns, wash trading and coordinated activity across operators.
  • Own margin methodology and stress testing until the quantitative function expands.
  • Write incident reviews that change a rule, a process or a tool.
  • Build the desk across operations risk, surveillance and quantitative risk.

What you bring

  • Trading-risk or exchange-risk experience in an exchange, clearing house, sportsbook or trading environment.
  • First-hand experience halting a market and defending the decision afterwards.
  • Comfort with SQL and the judgment to recognise when a number is wrong.
  • The ability to write policies that engineers can implement and regulators can understand.
  • Fluent English and calm leadership under pressure.

Why Hacksaw Markets

  • A genuine build-stage mandate with direct influence over product, operating model and culture.
  • An ambitious team supported by established technology, operating experience and long-term capital.
  • The opportunity to help create trusted infrastructure for a category moving rapidly into the mainstream.

Ready to apply?

Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant market, system, product or operational challenge you have owned.

*By applying for this position, you consent to the collection and processing of your information for recruitment purposes*

title: Erhvervssupporter til Storkunde erhverv i Vrå
description:
Kunne du tænke dig at arbejde med erhvervskunder i forskellige brancher?

Nu har du chancen for at blive en del af vores team i Storkunde erhverv i Vrå, hvor vi ser frem til at byde en ny kollega velkommen.

Om Storkunde erhverv
Vi er et team på 11 engagerede kollegaer, der arbejder tæt sammen for at sikre høj kvalitet i vores arbejde, så vi kan være med til at skabe gode resultater for sparekassen.

Vi værdsætter et godt kollegaskab, trivsel og glæde på vores arbejdsplads, og vi er altid klar til at hjælpe hinanden, når der er behov for det.

"Vi har en solid teamånd i afdelingen, hvor tillid og engagement er vigtigt for os. Vi tror på, at vi gennem involvering og nærvær skaber et motiverende miljø, som danner grundlag for at skabe gode resultater. Vi drager fordel af de forskellige erfaringer og perspektiver, som hver enkelt kollega bidrager med, og i vores arbejdsdag fokuserer vi på at skabe gode kundeoplevels_er,"_ siger afdelingsdirektør Mikkel Vesteraa Jensen.

Vi holder til på Sparekassen Danmarks hovedkontor i Vrå, og vi har et tæt samarbejde med sparekassens øvrige specialistfunktioner. Vi fungerer også som sparringspartner for vores andre erhvervscentre rundt omkring i Danmark.

Kunderne er spredt ud over hele sparekassens markedsområde, men størstedelen er at finde i Nordjylland og Hovedstadsområdet. De er repræsenteret bredt i forskellige brancher – herunder ejendomsfinansieringer i forskellige selskabskonstruktioner, sektorselskaber, sparekassens samarbejdspartnere med flere.

Om jobbet
Som erhvervssupporter får du en varieret arbejdsdag med både faste og skiftende opgaver.

Nogle opgaver er udelukkende administrative, mens andre er i tæt samarbejde med rådgiverne og kan kræve direkte kundekontakt. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du trives med begge dele.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • onboarding af nye kunder i samarbejde med rådgiverne, så de bliver godt overført og forankret hos os
  • udarbejdelse og håndtering af dokumenter
  • personlig og telefonisk kontakt til kunder i forskellige sammenhænge
  • håndtering af kreditforeningssager
  • assistance til rådgiverne i den løbende opfølgning.

For at klare dig godt i rollen er det her vigtigt at vide
Vi forestiller os, at du allerede har erfaring med at arbejde med erhvervskunder.

Herudover forestiller vi os, at du har følgende profil:

  • Du er serviceminded og får energi af at hjælpe andre.
  • Du udviser tillid til andre og lægger vægt på, at andre også kan have tillid til dig.
  • Du prioriterer dine opgaver og planlægger din egen tid.
  • Du er god til at føre en professionel og personlig kundedialog.
  • Du træffer beslutninger baseret på sund fornuft.

Det tilbyder vi dig
Vi tilbyder et job med gode muligheder for både personlig og faglig udvikling. Vi har samtidig fokus på trivsel i hverdagen og fleksibilitet, så arbejdsliv og privatliv kan hænge godt sammen.

Om sparekassen

Sparekassen Danmark er en garantsparekasse.

Med vores 403.000 kunder og mere end 1.900 medarbejdere er vi blandt de fem største pengeinstitutter i Danmark. Du finder os på hele 73 adresser i Jylland, på Fyn og i København.

Vi driver pengeinstitut ud fra tre værdier: Ambitiøs, sund fornuft og tillid.

I praksis betyder det, at vi er ambitiøse i forhold til at gøre en forskel i kundernes liv. At den enkelte har frihed til at bruge sin sunde fornuft i den daglige drift. Og at vi udviser gensidig tillid til hinanden, til vores kunder – og til de beslutninger, der bliver truffet.

Du kan læse mere om sparekassens formål og værdier, og hvad du kan forvente at opleve som medarbejder i sparekassen, på vores karrieresite. Klik hér.
