title: Data Scientist
description:
Nordnet redefined the financial world as the first digital bank in Europe. Now we are about to do it again—this time by putting AI at the heart of our strategy. You'll embark on a challenging journey alongside skillful teams of sharp and committed colleagues.

We're searching for a Data Scientist to join Nordnet's AIR (AI & Research) function, working embedded within one of our cross-functional teams. Your mission: Bring the best possible AI capabilities to life as robust solutions, both internally and for our customers.

The Setup

You'll be working in a full-stack team with different competencies and together tackle the full lifecycle—from exploring possibilities to deploying production features. Our technical foundation is Google Cloud Platform, where we've deployed internal and customer facing GenAI features. Now we're scaling what works and developing new capabilities.

This is not a theoretical role; you're a builder and problem-solver who thrives on iteration. You'll report to our Data Science Manager while working daily with developers, analysts and designers.

What You'll Do

Build and maintain production AI pipelines from experimentation through deployment and monitoring.

Collaborate with engineers throughout the development cycle—you'll work together on architecture and implementation in an iterative fashion.

Drive quality through evaluation, metrics, and testing of AI solutions.

Champion AI Governance - Ensure compliance with the bank's regulatory framework by clarifying AI concepts and risks

This is you

You take pride in your work and are driven by curiosity—you want to continuously learn and grow.

You likely have:

  • Experience with LLMs, GenAI and agentic AI

  • Python skills for both exploration and production code.

  • SQL proficiency for data analysis and pipeline building.

  • Knowledge of ML/AI evaluation, metrics, and best practices.

  • Experience with ML/AI in cloud environments (GCP experience is a plus).

We also get excited if you have:

  • Experience working embedded.

  • Comfort presenting technical work to diverse audiences.

  • Interest in finance, investing, or personal finance.

We think that you have 3+ years experience working as a Data Scientist, ML Engineer or AI Engineer with a University degree in data science, computer science, mathematics, engineering or similar field.

We offer

  • Work in a product-focused environment with direct impact

  • Growth opportunities as a data scientist in a fast-moving AI space

  • Competitive salary and compensation

You'll work in a Nordic environment with high ambitions and a strong focus on delivery, product development, and technology.

Culture is built and cared for, each day by everyone. We're proud of ours. Having a flat organization where anyone can talk to anyone creates a warm and friendly atmosphere worth protecting. We believe in a culture where every effort counts and where everyone is recognized—a culture embracing our core values of passion, simplicity, and transparency on all levels, no matter who you are or what you do.

We are over 900 employees in Stockholm, Oslo, Helsinki, Copenhagen and Frankfurt.

Visit us on , , , and .

Application

We will start interviewing immediately. Please note that we do only accept applications through our recruitment system, hence no email applications will be considered.

If you have questions, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner lovisa.malmberg@nordnet.se

We want to inform you that Nordnet conducts credit and background checks as well as a drug test on the final candidate.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Digital Product Leader
description:
Älmhult is where IKEA began in 1943 and remains a place where people from around the world come together to work, live and experience IKEA.

At IKEA Älmhult AB, around 270 co-workers run and develop IKEA Museum, IKEA Hotell, Bölsö, restaurants, cultural experiences, workplaces and outdoor areas that welcome and support co-workers, guests and the local community. And there’s more to come. At the beginning of 2027, we’re opening a new kind of museum for furniture design, and in 2028, our new IKEA Hotell will open its doors.

With our roots in Småland and our eyes on the future, we continue to develop our businesses, experiences and places – making Älmhult an even better place for the next generation.

And this is where you come in.

As a Digital Product Leader, you will lead the development and implementation of viable, valuable, feasible, and desirable digital products. You will be accountable for the product backlog (build, edit, and maintain) and prioritization, for solution requirements through user stories to meet business needs and user experience.

You will create and communicate a product vision and act as the bridge between our business partners and product teams where you'll collaborate closely with your colleagues in the business, UX designers and Solution Architects to prioritize the product backlog and define OKRs (Objectives & Key Results).

You'll work alongside your colleagues to ensure UX, data and technology is connected. While representing the needs of the IKEA stakeholder community, you'll be the voice of our users, ensuring that our efforts consistently deliver maximum value to the business.

The job implies responsibilities for goal setting, roadmap and vision, marketing, selling, budget and services and support for delivering great customer satisfaction.

The key job assignments are

Leading the product team
Defining how to deliver the wished business value
Technical development and operations in collaboration with engineering and IT operations
Build product and services that customers love
Through our culture and values lead by example and influence others to become high performing

Qualifications

You are the type of person that can manage to see the big picture and the details. You have strong collaboration and communication skills, that builds trust and partnership with your stakeholders, to reach our common goals. You inspire, listen and give direction to the team, partners, and stakeholders.

You thrive in complex environments, you see them as an opportunity to clarify and simplify. You are curious and open-minded, naturally building bridges between teams.

To be successful in this role, the following knowledge, skills and experiences would be valuable:

Solid software Product Management experience leading a cross-functional team
Strong understanding of marketing and/or content management technologies
Strong ability to create and communicate a product vision, mission and product strategy
Strong ability to lead, inspire, and empower team members while delivering with speed and employing an agile approach to development, both internally and externally. Serve as an ambassador for agile practices and product culture within your team and across transversal teams.
Strong ability to communicate and create trustful relationships in collaborative processes as well as visualizing concepts and ideas
Ability to handle complexity and solve problems through simplicity
Passionate about technology and trends that create better solutions and bring business and user value
High entrepreneurial drive: Stretching boundaries, challenging what already exists, always striving to develop a better digital landscape
Previous experience in tech companies and/or retail will give you an extra edge

We look forward to receiving your application – CV and letter of motivation – in English, latest by 27 of October. Kindly note that due to GDPR and Data Privacy, we do not accept any applications via email.

This role is full-time assignment (40-hours per week) and based in Älmhult, Sweden. This role sits in the Operations team at IKEA Älmhult AB and you will report to the Operations Manager.

At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers dreams and needs. At IKEA, we’re all on the same project.

If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

title: Mission & Complex Systems Engineering Graduate - October 2027 start
description:
Job Title: Mission & Complex Systems Engineering Graduate

Contract Type: Permanent

This role requires security clearance, to be able to obtain this you should be a British National or lived in the UK for 5 or more years continuously

Location: In terms of location, this role will be based from either our Bath or Fareham office, we are happy to explore flexible and hybrid working arrangements. Please note that travel to customer sites or to attend meetings will be required.

About BMT

BMT is dedicated to solving some of the most important engineering challenges of our time. Our people use their technical excellence to deliver practical, meaningful solutions that make a real difference.

We are committed to building a safer, more efficient, and more sustainable future. Diversity, equity, and inclusion are central to our mission, shaping our culture and supporting our purpose. Learn more about us at www.bmt.org.

Why Work for Us?

Joining BMT means joining a company that invests in you. As an Employee Benefit Trust (EBT) organisation, we’re independent and free from external shareholders — allowing us to reinvest in our people and make decisions that support long‑term success.

You’ll have access to a wide range of benefits that support your health, family life, financial wellbeing, and personal development, including:

  • Private Medical Insurance (including family cover)
  • Enhanced Pension
  • 18 weeks’ enhanced maternity pay (after 1 year’s service)
  • Family‑friendly policies
  • Inclusive and supportive culture
  • Annual Wellbeing Fund for hobbies and personal interests
  • 26 days' annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Holiday trading
  • Retail and lifestyle discounts
  • Professional subscriptions paid
BMT is looking for Graduates to join our Mission & Complex Systems engineering team as a Graduate Mission & Complex Systems Engineer.

You are likely to thrive in this role if you enjoy open-ended technical problems, can communicate complex ideas clearly, and are motivated by work that has real-world impact for our customers. We do not expect you to arrive with detailed defence-domain knowledge; we are looking for interest within the defence and security domain, evidence of technical curiosity, sound judgement, collaboration and the ability to learn quickly. If you would like to work with a diverse, collaborative team to help support the creation, realisation, and transition into service of new Defence systems alongside the UK’s Armed Forces, this role may be for you.

Working within the Wider Operational Systems Group.
At BMT, our values shape everything we do. We are looking for curious, motivated graduates who are passionate about solving complex engineering and technology challenges that make a real difference. While much of our work supports the UK Defence sector, we draw on expertise from a wide range of complex and safety-critical industries, including maritime, energy, infrastructure and nuclear, enabling us to bring fresh thinking and innovative solutions to our customers' most demanding problems.

To be successful in this role, you will:
  • Be passionate about science, technology, engineering and problem-solving, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to others.
  • Act with integrity, earning trust through professionalism, respect and accountability.
  • Think creatively and innovatively, approaching challenges with curiosity, agility and a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Thrive in collaborative environments, building effective relationships with colleagues, customers, stakeholders and end users.
  • Be excited by the opportunity to contribute to projects that have meaningful impact across defence and other complex systems domains.
We're looking for graduates who have:
  • A STEM degree with strong analytical skills and an understanding of engineering principles.
  • An ambition to work within and contribute to the UK Defence domain and other complex, safety-critical industries.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills.
  • A customer-focused approach and commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes.
  • The motivation to continuously develop your skills and work towards Chartered Engineer status or other relevant professional qualifications.
  • British nationality or a minimum of five years' continuous residency in the UK (required for Security Clearance eligibility).
Desirable, but not essential:
  • Experience of robotics, mechatronics or autonomous systems.
  • Knowledge of networking, network architecture or network engineering.
  • Engineering management experience or understanding.
  • Exposure to complex systems or highly regulated sectors beyond defence, such as nuclear, energy or critical national infrastructure.
If you’re ready to use your skills to help tackle meaningful challenges and contribute to a more sustainable future, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and join a team that values innovation, inclusion, and long‑term impact.


We only accept applications via our ATS. CVs sent directly to HR or operational teams will not be considered. Any unsolicited candidates will be treated as direct applications, with no fees payable.

title: Practitioner
description:
Role: Practitioner, Work and Wellbeing

Salary: £31,600 per annum plus on call allowance - permanent

Location: Guernsey, Channel Islands

Contract/Hours: Fixed Term Contract until 31st November 2027 - Full time – 37 hours a week (part time considered)

We would expect a degree of flexibility around working hours to meet the demands of the service and service users, including occasional weekend or evening work..

Why Action for Children?

We are one of the largest children’s charities in the UK and have been making a difference to the lives of the UK’s vulnerable children for over 150 years.

Find out more about Action for Children here: Action for Children and on LinkedIn, Facebook or YouTube to get to know us better.

The difference is what you do. You can learn more about why we do it, by checking out our 'Driven by Love' video.

A bit about the role

The Guernsey Youth & Housing Project provides vital support to young people across the Bailiwick aged 13–25. As a Practitioner, you will play a key role in empowering young people by delivering personalised support and evidence‑based interventions tailored to their individual needs. The role works with young people who may be at risk of developing challenges related to substance use, helping them strengthen their personal, social, emotional, and economic wellbeing. In this role, you’ll work collaboratively with young people to develop personalised plans and invest time in building meaningful, trusting relationships that support their growth and future aspirations.

You will also support our Nightstop programme including the recruitment and support of volunteers and support young people and families who may benefit from mediation to prevent homelessness.

You will also contribute to the wider preventative work of the service by delivering training and educational sessions to young people and professionals, enabling them to confidently recognise concerns and direct young people to the most appropriate support.

Our service takes pride in being welcoming, accessible, and grounded in respect. We value young people as individuals and are committed to providing professional, non‑judgemental, and confidential support that encourages informed and healthy decision‑making.

How you'll help to create brighter futures

  • Provide a high‑quality service to young people, centred on building positive, trusting relationships and supporting their development.
  • Deliver evidence‑based, personalised interventions, offering support on a one‑to‑one basis, in small groups, and within classroom settings.
  • Deliver training and awareness sessions to professionals and community partners, helping them respond effectively to the needs of young people.
  • Maintain strong working relationships and effective communication with colleagues across the service, as well as with external agencies and partner organisations.
  • Organise and manage daily work objectives, ensuring tasks and responsibilities are completed efficiently and to a high standard

Let's talk about you

In the role of Young Persons Practitioner, we're ideally looking for someone who has:

  • Post qualification experience of working directly with children and young people in one‑to‑one settings, small group environments, or classroom sessions, providing meaningful support, guidance, and encouragement.
  • Strong understanding of safeguarding practice, with hands‑on experience applying safeguarding policies and procedures to ensure the safety and wellbeing of young people.
  • Experience delivering targeted interventions and initiatives, including completing assessments, creating support plans, and conducting reviews to support positive outcomes.
  • Resident of Guernsey, with the legal right to live and work within the Bailiwick.

Why Action for Children?

Every child should have a loving home, food, warmth, the chance to grow and learn - the support to cope with life’s challenges. But too many children don’t. By bringing your passion and unique skills and experience, you’ll help us change that where it really matters.

We've been driven by love to take action for children for over 150 years, giving them the protection and practical help they need. A lot’s changed since 1869. But what children really need, hasn’t. So as long as children need us, we’ll be here.

Will you join us?

Help with your application

If you require any support with the application process, please contact Sarah Manderfield at recruitmentservice@actionforchildren.org.uk quoting reference 13867

Please note, we are unable to offer sponsorship for this role.

Diversity, equality and inclusion

At Action for Children, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and able to thrive. We know that racism and discrimination create barriers, and we’re taking active steps to challenge these inequalities in our organisation and in the communities we serve.

We strongly welcome applications from people who are Black, Asian, or from other racialised and ethnically marginalised communities, as well as disabled people, who are currently under‑represented in our workforce. We are committed to removing barriers in our recruitment processes and ensuring fair access to opportunities.

We also encourage applications from men, who are under‑represented in our Children’s Services roles. We recognise that people hold multiple identities, and we value the richness this brings to our team.

Job Description

See below for further information about working with us:

Action for Children Employee Benefits

AfC Commitment Statement

Make a Difference - A Career in Residential Services

title: Social- og sundhedshjælpere til Københavns Kommunes Vikarkorps – bliv en del af noget større!
description:
Vil du have friheden til selv at vælge dine vagter, timer og arbejdssteder – uden at stå alene?
Hos Københavns Kommunes Vikarkorps får du reel medbestemmelse over dit arbejdsliv og et nærværende fællesskab, du kan være stolt at være en del af. For vi er mere end et vikarkorps, der matcher dig med en vagt.

Du kan komme forbi til en kop kaffe, deltage i vores dialogmøder, møde andre vikarer og få faglig sparring, når du har brug for at vende en svær situation. Her er der plads til både fleksibilitet, faglighed og fællesskab.

Som vikar hos os får du stor medbestemmelse og indflydelse på dit arbejdsliv. Du vælger selv dine vagter og kan holde fri, når det passer dig.

Prøv kræfter med hjemmeplejen og/eller plejehjem
Som vikar i Københavns Kommune kan du vælge vagter i hjemmeplejen og på plejehjem. Du får mulighed for at møde forskellige borgere og kolleger og bruge din faglighed i forskellige rammer.

I hjemmeplejen møder du borgerne i deres eget hjem, hvor du er med til at skabe tryghed, nærvær og kvalitet i hverdagen. På plejehjemmene bliver du en del af hverdagen omkring beboerne og bidrager til omsorg, trivsel og gode stunder.

Du kan vælge det område, der passer bedst til dig, og få variation i dit arbejdsliv – samtidig med at du udvikler dine faglige kompetencer.

Du bestemmer – vi har vagterne
Med vores selvbetjeningsløsning og VKS-app har du altid overblik over ledige vagter og dine egne vagter. Her kan du nemt sætte dig på de vagter, der passer dig. Du kan arbejde

  • dagvagter (kl. 07.00-16.00): Til dig, der ønsker at arbejde i dagtimerne – både på hverdage og i weekender.
  • aftenvagter (kl. 13.00-24.00): Til dig, der ønsker at arbejde i hjemmeplejen – for vikarer med og uden kørekort.
  • nattevagter (kl. 21.00-08.00): Til dig, der ønsker at arbejde på plejehjemmene.
Du bestemmer selv, om du vil arbejde meget eller lidt. Måske har du brug for mange timer i en periode – måske har du brug for at holde helt fri i en anden.

Det er netop dét, der gør vikarkorpset til et attraktivt valg for dig, der ønsker et arbejdsliv med stor frihed.

Du står aldrig alene
Vi er et nærværende vikarkorps, hvor du altid har mulighed for at få en snak med os. Vi kender København, de forskellige arbejdssteder og vores vikarer – og vi er tilgængelige, når du har brug for sparring eller har spørgsmål.

Når du tager en vagt, bliver der så vidt muligt taget hensyn til din profil, dine kompetencer og din transporttid. Det betyder, at du ikke bare bliver sendt et tilfældigt sted hen.

Vi ved også, at det betyder noget, at tonen er respektfuld, og at man føler sig velkommen – også når man er vikar.

Vi leder efter dig, der

  • er uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper
  • leverer pleje og omsorg med høj faglig kvalitet
  • er stabil, fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst
  • trives med, at arbejdsdagene ikke nødvendigvis er ens
  • møder borgere og kolleger med respekt og et positivt livssyn
  • gerne har erfaring fra ældreområdet efter endt uddannelse.
Et fagligt fællesskab, du kan bruge
Inden for dine første 14 dage får du en tre-fiire4 timers introduktion i vikarkorpset, så du bliver klædt på til rollen. Du har også mulighed for at deltage i vores dialogmøder tirsdag eller torsdag, hvor vikarer mødes og deler erfaringer fra hverdagen. Her er der plads til

  • faglig sparring
  • vidensdeling
  • dialog om konkrete situationer
  • erfaringsudveksling med andre vikarer.
Det giver dig mulighed for både at lære af andre og dele dine egne erfaringer.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og indenfor rammerne af lokal løndannelse.

Mere information
Har du spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte vikarkorpset på 35 30 30 10.

Upload dit CV samt dit uddannelsesbevis sammen med din ansøgning.
Lyder det noget for dig? Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Søg via linket senest fredag den 11. december 2026

title: Data Engineering Manager
description:
Lead the people, platform and engineering standards powering the next chapter of data at Vanquis

We’ve invested significantly in modernising our technology landscape and strengthening our data capabilities. The opportunity now is to evolve, optimise and scale our Snowflake data platform, while building the engineering capability, standards and controls needed for what comes next.

As our Data Engineering Manager, you’ll lead and develop a team of Lead Data Engineers while overseeing multiple engineering squads delivering data products across Vanquis.

You’ll combine strong people leadership with deep technical expertise, helping shape our Snowflake platform, Data Vault 2.0 modelling approach and wider engineering standards. You’ll have visible influence across quality, cost, resilience, governance and the continued development of our Data Engineering capability

There's More to the Story

Vanquis is evolving.

We’re investing in our people, modernising how we work and building new capabilities across the business. This role offers the opportunity to help shape a significant data platform, develop engineering leaders and influence decisions that support important regulatory, commercial and strategic outcomes.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead, support and develop Lead Data Engineers and multiple engineering squads
  • Shape our Data Vault 2.0 modelling approach and wider engineering standards
  • Influence how we operate and evolve our Snowflake platform at scale
  • Strengthen platform controls across access, masking, classification and environment management
  • Improve platform resilience, observability and cost governance
  • Oversee portfolio planning, dependencies, risks and service handovers
  • Champion automation, CI/CD and streamlined engineering practices
  • Collaborate across Technology, Architecture, Governance, Risk, Security and Operations to deliver trusted data products

Why this role matters

Our data platform supports important regulatory, commercial and strategic outcomes across Vanquis.

You’ll be accountable for the quality, cost, resilience and governance of data across your portfolio, helping ensure our platform remains controlled, efficient and capable of supporting changing organisational needs.

Reporting to the Senior Data Engineering Manager, you’ll work with Data Engineering leaders, Architecture, Data Governance, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, Security, Operations, Service teams and third-party delivery partners. You’ll also contribute to the Enterprise Design Forum and Architectural Community of Practice, giving you the opportunity to influence decisions beyond your immediate portfolio.

The Data Engineering Principles we build around

  • Automation First - Improve flow and reduce unnecessary manual processes.
  • Controlled by Design - Build quality, security, resilience, cost and compliance into engineering decisions.
  • Shared Ownership - Collaborate from initial design through to service handover.
  • Continuous Improvement - Use insight, metrics and constructive challenge to improve how we work.
  • Developing Capability - Invest in engineering leaders and create opportunities for people to grow.
  • Engineering with Purpose - Connect technical decisions to meaningful outcomes for customers, colleagues and the business.

The tools and technologies helping us shape what’s next

  • Data Platform - Snowflake, including multi-account architecture, platform operations and warehouse strategy
  • Data Modelling - Data Vault 2.0, semantic modelling and data-product ownership
  • Transformation Tooling - Coalesce, dbt or comparable metadata-driven transformation platforms
  • Platform Controls - Role-based access control, data access, masking and classification
  • Platform Management - Observability, resilience, consumption management and cost governance
  • Engineering Practices - CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automation and continuous improvement
  • Significant data engineering experience, including leadership of engineers or senior technical contributors
  • Deep Snowflake experience at scale, including platform architecture, access controls, operations and cost governance
  • Strong Data Vault 2.0 knowledge, with experience shaping, applying or owning modelling standards
  • Experience using Coalesce, dbt or another metadata-driven transformation platform
  • Experience leading, developing and building engineering capability
  • Experience overseeing complex delivery across multiple teams, priorities and dependencies
  • An understanding of engineering within a regulated, controlled or similarly complex environment
  • The ability to influence senior stakeholders and communicate technical subjects clearly
  • Experience working with third-party partners or geographically distributed teams

You don’t need to match every point perfectly. We’re interested in the technical expertise, leadership experience and transferable knowledge you can bring, as well as your commitment to learning and developing others.

Useful, but not essential

  • Experience within financial services or another regulated sector
  • Experience of semantic modelling, analytics enablement or internal data marketplaces
  • Experience managing onshore, offshore or third-party engineering teams
  • A relevant degree, although equivalent practical technical experience is equally valued

This is an opportunity to broaden your influence across a significant data engineering portfolio.

You’ll develop engineering leaders, shape standards across multiple squads and gain exposure to technical strategy, platform governance, cost management and senior stakeholder engagement.

As Vanquis continues to strengthen its data capability, you’ll have the scope to deepen your expertise and develop towards broader senior engineering, data or technology leadership opportunities

Why Vanquis?

  • Up to 10% Pension Contribution
  • LinkedIn Learning

Ready to shape what’s next?

If you’re looking for an opportunity to lead talented engineering teams, influence the evolution of a significant Snowflake data platform and help shape the future of Data Engineering at Vanquis, we’d love to hear from you.

The Next Chapter Starts With You.

Unsolicited CVs submitted without prior agreement from Vanquis Talent Acquisition will be considered direct applications and no agency fees will be payable.

title: Financial Risk Analyst

title: Lead Client Service Monitor
description:
Hope Mission Statement

The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

Position Purpose and Summary

Interim housing sites run 24 hours a day, seven days a week. The quality of each shift depends a lot on who is leading it. The Lead Client Services Monitor (LCSM)holds the floor. Acting as a leader, collaborator, and an important voice into continuous process improvement.

Reporting to the Program Manager or Assistant Program Manager, the LCSM is the on-shift leader for Client Service Monitors across assigned Hope the Mission interim housing sites. This role makes sure that safety protocols, wellness checks, documentation, and site procedures are followed consistently every single shift — and is the first to respond when they aren't. The LCSM leads by example and acts as a bridge between non-management, management, and site operations. When an incident happens, when a participant escalates, when a staff member needs guidance in the moment, the LCSM handles it until a manager arrives or the situation is resolved.

The persons in our interim housing communities deserve consistency at every hour of the day. This role is how that consistency gets delivered.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Shift Leadership & Site Operations

  • Serve as the on-shift lead for all Client Service Monitors; provide real-time direction, guidance, and support throughout the shift

  • Complete required wellness checks, site walk-throughs, and safety protocols every shift without exception

  • Monitor site activity and address safety concerns, policy violations, and operational issues as they arise

  • Maintain heightened attention in high-traffic or high-risk areas of the site during assigned shifts

  • Conduct pass-down huddles at shift transitions to ensure clear communication and operational continuity

  • Communicate shift updates, incidents, and follow-up needs to site leadership and incoming shift staff

Incident Response & Emergency Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for incidents, participant escalations, and emergencies during the shift

  • Manage emergency situations — including medical emergencies, overdoses, and evacuations — until leadership or first responders arrive and assume command

  • Ensure all incidents are documented accurately, completely, and submitted on time in accordance with agency protocols

Documentation & Compliance

  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of Daily Activity Reports (DARs) and all other required shift documentation

  • Enforce compliance with agency policies including incident reporting, contraband control, and infection control protocols

Staff Development & Support

  • Model trauma-informed, harm-reduction, and professional conduct at all times

  • Assist with onboarding, training, and coaching of new Client Service Monitors

  • Support schedule coverage, shift coordination, and staff accountability as directed by management

  • Collaborate with case management and leadership staff to support participant safety and stability

Other General Duties

  • Provide leadership coverage during evenings, weekends, and holidays as scheduled

  • Perform other duties as assigned

Skills

  • Strong leadership and decision-making skills

  • Excellent situational awareness and crisis response abilities

  • Trauma-informed communication and de-escalation skills

  • Ability to coach, guide, and support frontline staff

  • Strong organizational and documentation skills

  • Ability to remain calm and professional in high-stress situations

  • Proficiency with basic computer systems and documentation tools

  • Ability to lead with integrity; upholding organizational mission and values.

  • Working knowledge of evidence-based service delivery models, including Motivational Interviewing, Harm Reduction, Housing First, and Trauma-Informed Care.

title: Maintenance Team Lead
description:
Maintenance Team Lead

Onsite – Manchester TN

Who We Are:

PurposeBuilt Brands, rooted in a legacy dating back to Weiman, stands as a pioneer in crafting top-tier products for specialty surfaces. Our beloved brands, including 30 Seconds, PF Harris, Weiman, Goo Gone, Green Gobbler, Biokleen, Gonzo, Magic, Wright’s, Stone Care International, Urnex, Five Star, and Micro-Scientific, are preferred choices among consumers and seasoned professionals alike.

At PBB, we seek to hire employees who bring a level of engagement, drive, and performance that pushes business forward. We work together and are motivated by positive results, while continuously thriving in a scrappy environment. We believe our greatest assets are the talented and passionate employees who are motivated by our purposeful work. Our company may be 60 years old, but the real growth is just getting started.

The Role:

To oversee and ensure the effective operation, preventative maintenance, and timely repair of all facility equipment and systems. This includes leadership and coordination of a maintenance team to maintain filling equipment, packaging equipment, pumps, mixers, fork trucks, and the physical structures of the building(s).

What You Will Do:

  • Lead the maintenance team in the execution of all general maintenance tasks, both preventative and reactive. This includes overseeing the operation and testing of filling equipment, pumps, mixers, compressors, labelers, sleeving equipment, and general facility/building maintenance.
  • Schedule and oversee PM tasks according to the maintenance calendar.
  • Ensure all PM checklists are updated and maintained in compliance with production department and GMP requirements.
  • Maintain and update the complete library of parts and consumables.
  • Assist in recommending equipment and parts for Continuous Improvement (CI) projects to enhance overall Operational Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
  • Supervise the operation of heavy equipment including fork trucks, scissor lifts, and boom lifts.
  • Oversee the use of power and fabrication tools.
  • Ensure all maintenance activities are completed safely and efficiently.
  • Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice

What You Will Bring:

  • Proven leadership and team management skills.
  • Flexible and adaptable in managing a wide range of maintenance duties and functions.
  • Strong mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic/hydraulic systems repair and maintenance skills.
  • Effective communication skills (verbal and written) for coordinating with vendors and upper management.
  • Competency in general computer usage and email.
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills.
  • Availability to work off hours, overtime, and holidays as needed for repairs, rebuilds, and PMs during scheduled downtimes.
  • Ability to effectively lead and motivate a team.

Benefits:

PBB offers a wide range of benefits because we understand no two employees are the same. We want our employees to feel empowered to set their day up for success, whether that's in the office or remote.

What We Offer:


Generous paid time off

Competitive salaries and bonus incentives

Competitive medical, dental, & vision insurance

Pet insurance

Annual fitness stipend

Unmatched employee discount on all products

title: Project Manager Internal & External Logistics
description:
Join us in shaping the future of logistics at Nobia Park!

At Nobia Park, we're building one of Europe's most modern manufacturing environments. Our new factory combines advanced automation, digitalization, and lean operations to create a highly efficient and future-focused production setup.

We are now looking for a Project Manager Internal & External Logistics to play a key role in developing and optimizing logistics processes across our manufacturing and supply chain operations. This is a unique opportunity to join a large-scale transformation journey where technology, processes, and people come together to create the factory of the future.

Where we are right now

Nobia Park is continuing its journey toward becoming a highly integrated and digitally enabled manufacturing environment. As operations evolve and new capabilities are introduced, logistics plays a critical role in ensuring efficient material flow from inbound deliveries through production to outbound distribution.

In this role, you will help develop and optimize internal logistics operations, including warehousing and picking, as well as external logistics processes such as consolidation and distribution. Working closely with operations, supply chain, and IT, you will contribute to both continuous improvements and long-term development initiatives.

About the role

As Project Manager Internal & External Logistics, you will drive logistics-related projects and process development within our MES (2020 insight) and on occasions SAP/4HANA. Acting as the link between business operations and system development, you will ensure that business needs are translated into efficient and scalable logistics solutions.

The role combines project management, process development, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement in a dynamic manufacturing environment.

Your responsibilities

  • Translate business needs into effective solutions within MES and SAP systems.

  • Work closely with production teams to develop and implement efficient logistics flows.

  • Lead and participate in cross-functional workshops to improve processes and ways of working.

  • Provide second- and third-line support, working closely with support teams to troubleshoot issues and drive resolution.

  • Drive change initiatives and help ensure new processes are successfully adopted across the organization.

  • Contribute to the development of future system and process landscapes within logistics and supply chain

  • Manage, coach, and support one direct report, ensuring clear priorities, development, and engagement.

Location: Nobia Park, Jönköping, this is an onsite position

Who you are

To succeed in this role, you are a structured and collaborative professional who enjoys working at the intersection of business processes, technology, and operations. You are comfortable navigating complex stakeholder environments and can balance strategic thinking, project delivery, and day-to-day operational support.

You enjoy solving problems, making improvements, and creating solutions that have a real impact on business performance. You build strong relationships and communicate effectively with stakeholders across different functions and levels of the organization. Most importantly, you are motivated by being part of a transformation journey where you can influence the future design and development of logistics processes.

We believe you bring

  • At least two years' experience within Logistics, Supply Chain, or Manufacturing environments.

  • Understanding of logistics processes such as warehousing, material flow, picking, transportation, and distribution

  • Experience with process design, system configuration, or solution development within manufacturing or supply chain environments.

  • Experience working with SAP S/4HANA, preferably within Transport Management (TM), Warehouse Logistics, or related manufacturing systems.

  • Experience leading projects, process improvements, or business development initiatives

  • The ability to bridge business requirements and technical solutions

  • Experience leading teams or coordinating cross-functional initiatives.

  • Fluent in both Swedish and English.

It is highly desirable if you have experience with Azure DevOps

About Nobia

Nobia is Europe’s leading kitchen specialist, with strong brands such as Marbodal, HTH, Sigdal, and uno form. With us, you will become part of a modern organization where quality, safety, and continuous improvement are at the core of everything we do. We offer excellent opportunities for both professional and personal development. Curious to learn more? Visit Nobia Park – Jönköping.

Want to be a part of our journey?

Then we would like to receive your application in English no later than October 18, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Our recruitment process is competency-based and includes assessments to provide both you and us with the best possible conditions for a successful match. As part of the employment process, you will need to demonstrate your right to work within the EU, for example through a passport or a valid work permit. Background checks and drug screening will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.

If you have any questions, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist Josephine Tjernlund (josephine.tjernlund@nobia.com). We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Pædagogisk medarbejder til Modtagecenter Sandholm
description:
Vil du være en del af verdens største humanitære organisation, hvor medmenneskelighed er kerneværdien, og har du et stærkt engagement i at skabe tryghed og trivsel for børn i en sårbar livssituation – på en anderledes og helt særlig arbejdsplads, hvor din indsats hver dag gør en mærkbar forskel?

Røde Kors asylafdeling søger en pædagog eller pædagogisk medarbejder til Børnehaven på Modtagecenter Sandholm.

Sandholm er modtagecenter for asylansøgere i Danmark og huser både enlige samt familier med og uden børn. Børnene har meget forskellige baggrunde, hvilket stiller krav til høj pædagogisk faglighed og stærke relationskompetencer.

Det pædagogiske arbejde tager afsæt i Asylpædagogikken – en anerkendende og struktureret tilgang med fokus på tryghed, relationer og børns trivsel.

Du bliver en del af et professionelt og erfarent team med fokus på fagligt samarbejde og fælles pædagogisk praksis.

Vores overordnede opgave er at skabe en tryg, meningsfuld og værdig hverdag med fremtidsperspektiv for børnene, mens de befinder sig i asylfasen.

Læs mere om Modtagecenter Sandholm her.

Om opgaven
Stillingen omfatter pædagogisk arbejde med fokus på børns trivsel og udvikling i tæt samarbejde med forældre, kollegaer og centrets tværfaglige aktører som f.eks. socialkoordinator, psykologer og sundhedspersonale.

De konkrete opgaver består bl.a. i at:

  • Sikre udviklende, trygge og pædagogisk kvalificerede dagtilbud for børn
  • Indgå aktivt i børnehavens daglige drift og opgaveløsning
  • Støtte og vejlede forældre med fokus på at bevare og styrke forældreevnen
  • Observere, vurdere og dokumentere børns trivsel og udvikling med henblik på at identificere særlige fysiske, psykiske eller sociale behov
  • Medvirke til udarbejdelse og opfølgning på pædagogiske handlingsplaner for børn og unge med særlige behov

Kort om dig
Du har en relevant pædagogisk uddannelse samt erhvervserfaring fra f.eks. Børnehave eller Klub – gerne fra et multikulturelt miljø. Du er motiveret af at arbejde professionelt med børn i udsatte livspositioner og er er god til at etablere trygge og tillidsfulde relationer til børnene og deres forældre.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at:

  • Du er ansvarsbevidst og arbejder struktureret og målrettet i din opgaveløsning. Du trives i en hverdag præget af forandringer og formår at omstille dig i en kontekst med høj grad af omskiftelighed.
  • Du har stærke samarbejdskompetencer og kan indgå konstruktivt i samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder. Din pædagogiske tilgang er kendetegnet ved nysgerrighed, refleksion og rummelighed.
  • Du kommunikerer klart og professionelt og har gode skriftlige kompetencer på dansk ift. dokumentationsarbejde. Du taler engelsk på samtaleniveau, og kendskab til andre sprog vil være en fordel.
  • Endelig har du gode digitale kompetencer og er vant til at arbejde med IT-systemer i det daglige.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et alsidigt og udfordrende job i en politisk styret organisation med et stærkt humanitært værdigrundlag
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på trivsel, tværfagligt samarbejde og videndeling
  • Et stærkt fællesskab med kompetente, engagerede og motiverede kollegaer
  • Mulighed for at gøre en konkret og meningsfuld forskel i børns og familiers liv

Praktiske oplysninger og ansættelsesvilkår

title: 500702 - Research and Development Engineer
description:
Who You Are

In this role as a Motion Control Engineer to join the R&D Controller Software Development Team. You will design, develop, maintain, and support motion control and path planning features for FANUC robot controllers. You will lead the development of enhancements to FANUC's External Motion Command capabilities and the FANUC ROS 2 Driver, enabling customers to integrate and control FANUC robots in increasingly complex automation environments.

You will be working closely with Product Management and global engineering teams to define feature requirements, drive development from concept through release, and ensure successful deployment of new capabilities. You core responsibilities will encompass software architecture and development, feature validation and quality assurance, in addition to customer support and continuous improvement based on customer feedback and field experience.

You will need to draw upon your technical leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and passion for delivering robust, high-quality solutions that meet evolving customer needs.

How It’s Done

  • Implementation and maintenance of motion features and enhancements relating to motion planning and control
  • Develop new features for FANUC ROS 2 Driver capabilities and external motion streaming
  • Detailed specification, design, and documentation of enhancements to robot controller motion software
  • Test plan development and testing of motion system software, and robot performance
  • Providing consulting and support to customers, distributors, and FANUC personnel outside of the development group in the following areas:
    • Customer applications involving robots and controllers
    • FANUC Motion system operation and robot performance
  • General involvement in long term technical developments involving FANUC products

What You Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Robotics or Electrical Engineering
  • 1+ years relevant industry experience in one or more of the following areas of interest:
    • Embedded systems software
    • Robotics (Kinematics, Dynamics, Path Planning, etc.)
    • Motion Control Systems, Dynamic Feedback Control
  • Proficiency in ROS 2, computer networking, Docker, and Linux OS
  • Experience with C#, C++ and scripting languages
  • Practical understanding of Classical and Digital Control Theory
  • Practical understanding of Robot Kinematics and Dynamics.
  • Practical understanding of Robot Motion Planning. Prior experience preferred.
  • Knowledge or ability to develop a Robotics Application (a practical application of a robot to perform a useful task)

What Would Be Even Better

  • Programming experience with FANUC robots
  • Robot Off-line Programming knowledge or skills
  • Experience with Nvidia Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Omniverse
  • Scientific Software Development ability with a high-level language (C or similar)

It’s Your Move

At FANUC America Corporation we are passionate about our customers, our employees, and the work we perform. We maintain a workplace where individuals can be proud of, where talents are embraced, and results are encouraged and supported.

We are looking for talented people who value integrity, informed decision-making and collaboration. If you believe you are one of those talented people and are interested in being considered for a career at FANUC America, we invite you to apply today!

title: VVS-montør til service og spjæld i Rødekro
description:
Vil du have firmabil, ordentlig løn og fast arbejde som VVS-montør?



Vi mangler en VVS-montør til service og spjæld i Rødekro.



Du lander i et VVS-setup hvor servicearbejde og spjæld er den klare retning. Holdet er lille nok til at man kender hinanden, men opgaverne er faste nok til at der er brug for en ekstra montør. Arbejdsområdet er Rødekro og omegn, så hverdagen ligger tæt på det sønderjyske. Du arbejder med almindelige VVS-opgaver, hvor kunderne forventer at aftaler holder og at tingene bliver løst ordentligt.

Firmabilen følger med, og lønnen ligger på 220-240 kr. i timen. Kørekort er nødvendigt, fordi du kører ud til opgaverne. Der er ikke lagt op til korte forløb eller tilfældige vikariater. Her søger vi en VVS-montør, der kan blive en fast del af hverdagen.

Det får du

Løn: 220-240 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Rødekro og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 5 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Service, spjæld og VVS-opgaver

Din hverdag

Når en serviceopgave er aftalt, handler det om at finde fejlen, få løst det praktiske og melde klart tilbage hvis noget kræver mere end et hurtigt spjæld. Du har firmabil til opgaverne, og du skal kunne tage ansvar for at møde stabilt og få dagen til at hænge sammen.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Udfører spjæld og service på VVS-opgaver
  • Fejlfinder og løser mindre VVS-opgaver hos kunder
  • Laver service på vand, varme og afløb
  • Monterer sanitet og laver mindre reparationer
  • Siger til hvis en opgave kræver mere tid eller andre materialer

Med mindst 3 års erfaring ved du, hvornår en VVS-opgave skal løses med det samme, og hvornår der skal meldes tilbage før der arbejdes videre. Det er den slags overblik, der gør hverdagen nemmere for både kunderne og dem du arbejder sammen med.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du behøver ikke kunne alt. Men du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine aftaler.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 3 års erfaring som VVS-montør
  • Har kørekort
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt
  • Kan tage fat på service og spjæld
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med spjæld og service før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan lide en hverdag hvor opgaverne skal løses ordentligt hos kunden.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.



Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om Hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.



Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.



Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Det tager to minutter.

title: Specialpædagog til et børnehus hvor Nest pædagogik er det bærende element
description:
Vil du understøtte 6 børn med specialpædagogiske behov?

Om jobbet

Børnehuset Pilegården har oprettet en ny gruppeordning for børn med specialpædagogiske behov pr. 1. maj 2025 og til den gruppe søger vi en specialpædagog. Vi søger dig, der vil være med til at sætte dit præg og har lyst til at øve, lære og udvikle dig – sammen med os.

Hvem er vi

Pilegården er et børnehus hvor indsatsen for det forpligtende fællesskab betyder meget i hverdagen for både børn og voksne. Vi har mange positive erfaringer med at fungere i mindre enheder i huset og samtidig arbejde på tværs af vuggestue og børnehave med fælles fokus. Vi har god plads i vores grupperum og har værksted og motorikrum, som vi deles om. Vores store grønne legeplads har udgang til et unikt naturområde med mark, å, vådområde og køer på græs. Vi samarbejder med vores naturvejleder enten i Naturhuset Bistruphus eller hjemme i børnehuset. Vi har eldrevne ladcykler, så det er nemt at komme rundt, på længere ture og til Bistruphus. Vi har 15 minutters gang til Birkerød Station og busstop tæt.

Om jobbet

Du vil have din base i en gruppe med 6 børn med specialpædagogiske behov og bliver en del af et team af i alt 4 pædagoger, der arbejder specialpædagogisk. Den specialpædagogiske indsats udføres i tæt samspil med det øvrige børnehus, hvor I vil arbejde tæt sammen for at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn i børnefællesskabet. Vi arbejder ud fra princippet om, at den trygge rede et barn har brug, kan alle børn have gavn af. Derfor arbejder hele børnehuset ud fra Nest-pædagogikkens værdier, tilgange og metoder.

Vi arbejder i tæt samarbejde med PPR, og modtager løbende supervision.

Om dig

Vi er et godt match, hvis:

• Du er uddannet pædagog gerne med specialpædagogisk erfaring med børn i 3-5 års-alderen

• Du har specialpædagogisk viden og kompetencer.

• Du kan se dig selv i et børnehus, hvor Nest-pædagogik er det bærende element.

• Du har interesse i at arbejde inkluderende og med udgangspunkt i børnefællesskabet

• Du er opsat på at samarbejde i et professionelt læringsfællesskab - i huset og tværfagligt

• Du har blik for at inddrage og samarbejde med forældre

• Du har lyst til at øve, lære og udvikle dig – sammen med os.

Om Pilegården

Hvad kan du forvente af os:

• Vi er fagligt ambitiøse og har mod på at prøve nye tiltag

• Vi er et hus med en rar grundstemning og en medarbejdergruppe med ambitioner for at børnene trives og lykkes i vores rammer

• Vi vægter forældresamarbejde højt

• Vi har fastlagte strukturer for dagen og året samt traditioner som fælles pejlemærker for årets gang

Uddannelse er en selvfølge – ikke et gode

I forbindelse med at vi bliver et Nest-børnehus kompetenceudvikles hele personalegruppen både før, under og efter opstart.

Uddannelse er en selvfølge - ikke et gode

Vi prioriterer at kompetenceudvikle alle vores pædagoger og pædagogmedhjælpere.

Om Rudersdal Kommune

I Rudersdal Kommune tror vi på, at vi kun lykkes i fællesskab. Derfor er det vores mål, at alle kommunens medarbejdere og ledere i alle opgaver - og i fællesskab - arbejder for at skabe bæredygtige løsninger, der giver værdi for borgerne, virksomheden og det samfund, vi er en del af. Se vores film om Rudersdal Kommunes strategi og værdier ”Vi lykkes kun i fællesskab” HER

Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuldtid og start snarest muligt. Ansættelse sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

Ansøgning, samtale og kontakt

Du søger jobbet ved at klikke på knappen "Søg stilling" nedenfor.

title: School Enroll & Mktg Admin-NC
description:
Who We Are

Charter Schools USA (CSUSA) is one of the largest and highest ­performing education management companies in the United States, proudly serving over 82,000 students in over 150 schools in four states. Founded by Jonathan Hage in 1997, CSUSA's mission is a Relentless Commitment to Student Greatness in School and in Life™. CSUSA provides an academically rigorous education to students equipping them with real world readiness, prepared for college or career after graduation. With an unwavering dedication to the success of students from every background, CSUSA is closing the gaps in achievement and opportunity, keeping our promise of Strong Minds, Good Hearts™.

Job Purpose

To join a team of people with the mission: Relentless Commitment to Student Greatness in School and in Life ™. If you love inspiring and motivating young learners and want to put students first in education, CSUSA is the right place for you. We deliver on our promise of Strong Minds, Good Hearts™ through an education model that gives every student the opportunity for success. The NC School Enrollment & Marketing Administrator (Regional SEMA) plays a crucial role in recruiting and retaining students in their assigned school(s), striving to meet or exceed enrollment targets by executing M&E strategies. They also represent an assigned market for outreach purposes and are the local lead of expertise on M&E processes and systems. As such, this individual has additional responsibilities in the development and compliance to M&E strategies and processes/systems where needed at schools in their market, to help that market's enrollment performance, and working with other schools' Registrars in doing so. The role is ultimately responsible for M&E performance at their assigned school(s), with the support of the principal,state leaders and the National Marketing and Enrollment Team and is guided to assist in market performance with the direction of the Area M&E Manager and assigned state deputy.

How You Will Impact Education

Market Lead and Subject Matter Expert

  • Identify, attend, and participate in community outreach events to build and increase the number of interested families/leads for the market schools; performed inside and outside of normal school hours.
  • Identify and collaborate with community organizations that can ultimately become a partner and lift the CSUSA schools' reputation, identity, and awareness.
  • Works with public relations agencies and local media to promote market events, accolades, and differentiating opportunities.
  • Acts as back-up and coaching support to M&E processes and systems, as well as district SIS systems and policies

Builds Awareness of Assigned School(s)

  • Understands and can effectively communicate to families and community stakeholders on charter schools, Charter Schools USA, and the school's identity, mission, and vision.
  • Works with school leadership to help refine the school's identity and ensure the school properly represents its identity.
  • Develops, updates, and modifies marketing plans regularly in collaboration with school and state team and ensures they are within the school budget.
  • Identify and collaborate with community organizations that can ultimately become a partner and lift the school's reputation, identity, and awareness.
  • Identify and purchase school promotional items from the marketing toolkit in consideration of the marketing budget.
  • Review and leverage local consumer research to ensure marketing strategies align with family interests.
  • Monitors competition, offerings, and market changes.
  • Identifies school stories, testimonials, and thought leadership opportunities to write and promote on-site and socially.
  • Works with public relations agencies and local media to promote school events, accolades, and differentiating opportunities.

Generates Conversion of Family Interest Into Ultimate Application and Enrollment

  • Develops, implements, and monitors strategies to promote the identity of the school and build the trust of families interested in the school.
  • Builds a healthy list of interested families by utilizing various strategies and events to generate interest.
  • Develops a content strategy to strengthen the school identity and improve family engagement.
  • Collaborates with school staff and teachers to create the website and social content.
  • Publishes content on the website and social platforms and monitors associated engagement metrics.
  • Plans and coordinates marketing efforts for student recruiting and facilitates and coordinates with the school leadership and the registrar to plan the school's information sessions, tours, open houses, orientations, etc . while ensuring the consumer experience is exceptional.
  • Co-plan with school leadership to offer family incentives to increase lead volume.

Manages Application & Registration

  • Work towards building the application volume beyond the school target and programmatic capacity to ensure we have a waitlist and a fully enrolled school.
  • Develops, implements, and monitors various enrollment strategies to improve application volume such as family referrals, etc.
  • Works with Registrars to manage the application pipeline through various enrollment reports and the student registration system and ensures enrollment policies and processes are followed including seats being offered promptly.
  • Coordinates with the National Marketing and Enrollment team regarding the yearly marketing and enrollment schedule including intent to return, open enrollment, and lottery dates, and communicates with school M&E stakeholders and school staff.
  • Develops and provides internal stakeholders with training and materials so they can properly support the enrollment function during key M&E yearly milestones, such as intent to return, start of year calls, warm body count, etc.

Collaborates to Improve Retention, Loyalty & Advocacy

  • Works with school leadership to develop and execute retention strategies on existing students with the ultimate goal of improving retention, start rates, and minimizing withdrawals.
  • Continuously monitors and ensures the school adheres to CSUSA policies on withdrawals.
  • Develops and executes family communication campaigns that improve engagement and retention campaigns by utilizing forms and reminder letters, emails, and texts.
  • Coordinates with principal and other staff members on student withdrawals and looks for trends and reasons to lower withdrawals.
  • Engage the school team to support the start of the year Pre-First Day and warm body counts.
  • Identify, implement, and monitor various advocacy strategies to capture testimonials, identify ambassadors, and leverage raving fans.

Marketing and Enrollment Team Membership

  • Develop marketing and enrollment team at the school to serve as partners towards achieving marketing and enrollment goals for the school.
  • Identify school members who can assist M&E functions and cross-train them to support M&E activity and act as a backup if needed.
  • Provide status updates, reports, and progress on marketing and enrollment-related projects to school leadership regularly.
  • Communicate and collaborate with school leaders and M&E Area Managers on strategies, plans, and goals.

Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Has coaching and mentoring skills
  • Is comfortable with multi-tasking and working within a matrix environment
  • Has the ability, comfort, and success with speaking to prospective families and community partners to influence them to apply and enroll or partner with the school.
  • Has the ability to strategically use insights and metrics from social media (e.g. Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, YouTube) and digital marketing to promote the school and CSUSA.
  • Has an understanding of how to engage and optimize content through Social and Digital Media.
  • Demonstrates proficient experience with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Student Information System (SIS), CRM, Adobe Acrobat, and Canva.
  • Has the ability to adapt and incorporate emerging software technology into daily use.
  • Possesses detailed knowledge of Federal, State, and local requirements for K-12 schools and charter school law preferred.
  • Has the ability to work and interact with individuals at all levels of the organization.
  • Has the ability to organize, prioritize and manage multiple priorities.
  • Has the ability to establish a set of operating principles and routines; driving projects to completion, while insisting on the highest level of quality.
  • Possesses excellent communication skills: oral (including presentations), written, interpersonal (active listening), negotiating, and
  • Has the ability to respond to management direction, and to solicit feedback to improve performance.
  • Possesses good knowledge of company and departmental policies and procedures.
  • Leads by example in adherence and knowledge of the CSUSA and the school's vision, mission, and values demonstrated by the commitment to act in an ethical manner using behaviors that promote a team concept.
  • Follows through on duties and projects assigned.
  • Participates in and completes training programs offered to increase skill and proficiency related to assignments.
  • Reviews current developments, literature, and technical sources of information related to job responsibility.
  • Ensures adherence to good safety procedures.
  • Demonstrated experience in social media and digital marketing on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and YouTube. Understanding of engaging and optimized content.
  • Excellent customer service skills.
  • Excellent organization, time management, and follow-up skills.
  • Must be able to present a professional office with great customer service skills.
  • Must have a positive attitude and be able to collaborate with others, while helping to maintain a pleasant working environment.
  • Must be detail-oriented.
  • Ability and willingness to work successfully with students, parents, and staff.
  • Excellent references including attendance and punctuality.
  • Demonstrates excellent oral (including presentations), written, interpersonal (active listening), skills and ability in negotiating and influencing; professional phone etiquette.
  • Proactive and takes initiative. Thinks creatively. Drives projects to completion. Insists on the highest level of quality.

Job Requirements

  • 4-year college degree/equivalent experience (required) or higher (preferred).
  • Previous sales or marketing background required.
  • Previous School Enrollment and Marketing Administrator, Registrar, or equivalent experience desired.
  • Minimum of 3-5 year's experience years relevant experience.
  • Being bilingual is a plus, but not required.

May perform other duties as assigned.

Work Environment

While performing the responsibilities of this position, the work environment characteristics listed below are representative of the environment the employee will encounter:

  • Usual office working conditions.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Travel within or outside of the state.
  • Light work: Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force as frequently as needed to move objects.

FLSA Overtime Category

Job is exempt from the minimum wage and overtime provisions of the Fair Labor Standards Act.

title: Arbetsterapeut till Team Aktiv Primärvårdsrehab
description:
Vi erbjuder dig en arbetsplats med god och utvecklande arbetsmiljö, med kompetenta, positiva och drivna arbetskamrater, samt närvarande chefer. Det är viktigt för oss att vi tillsammans förbättrar våra patienters livskvalitet. Vi har ett stort engagemang för vårt uppdrag och för oss är det viktigt att vi trivs tillsammans.

Därför erbjuder vi dig en bra introduktion med mentorskap, det är viktigt att vi kan ge dig rätt stöd för att du ska kunna komma in i arbete på ett tryggt sätt.

Vi erbjuder även en utvecklande lärandemiljö, kompetensutveckling, flexibla arbetstider och ett generöst friskvårdsbidrag.

Arbetsuppgifter

Vi arbetsterapeuter på Team Aktiv arbetar tillsammans med fysioterapeut och dietist.

Som arbetsterapeut inom Primärvårdsrehab träffar du patienter i alla åldrar och med olika typer av diagnoser. Du möter patienter i deras hem eller på vår mottagning, enskilt eller i team. Hos oss är du som arbetsterapeut en viktig del i rehabiliteringen av våra patienter.

Team Aktiv Primärvårdsrehab har sedan 1995 drivit rehabilitering för befolkningen i Hässelby-Vällingby. Hos oss arbetar arbetsterapeuter, dietister och sjukgymnaster/fysioterapeuter som tillsammans utvecklar och ansvarar för verksamheten.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

  • Aktivitets- och funktionsbedömning/utredning/träning, ge råd och stöd om egenvård.

  • Demensutredning som en del i basal demensutredning i samarbete med husläkare.

  • Förskrivning av hjälpmedel och information om produkter och teknik.

  • Bedömning av bostad och närliggande miljö och miljöinriktade åtgärder som t ex bostadsanpassning.

  • Handrehabilitering individuellt eller vid gruppbehandling som t.ex. Artrosskola.

  • Samverkan med andra vårdgivare, handleda och stödja anhöriga och vårdpersonal

  • Handleda studenter.

  • Dokumentation i journalsystem Take Care.

Kvalifikationer

Du skall vara legitimerad arbetsterapeut med svensk legitimation. Det är meriterande om du har arbetat inom primärvård, har B-körkort samt har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, men störst vikt är personlig lämplighet.

Personliga egenskaper

Vi söker dig som:

  • har lätt att samarbeta med kollegor, patienter/anhöriga, hemtjänst och andra vårdgivare/aktörer kring patienten.

  • är ansvarstagande, ha lätt att arbeta självständigt och strukturerat.

  • vill bidra till utveckling och förnyelse av arbetet.

  • vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Övrig information

Vi kommer gå igenom ansökningarna under ansökningstiden och kallar löpande till intervju, därför vill vi gärna att du söker så fort som möjligt.

title: Dedicated Team Leader for Mechanical Engineering Team
description:
Polyteknik AS is expanding, and we are therefore searching for an excellent leader for our competent mechanical engineering team. The mechanical engineering team designs highly advanced production systems for the semicon/mems/sensor and ICT industries primarily in Europe.

Tasks

Our team of mechanical engineers takes Polyteknik’s advanced production systems from initial concept through detailed design to the production-ready BOM. The team currently consists of 7 people. Polyteknik has grown rapidly the recent years and continues to expand, and the mechanical engineering team will grow with it. One of your tasks as team leader will be to drive the development and expansion of the team.

You will manage the team and, in close collaboration with the process and automation engineers, physicists and skilled technicians, design and construct advanced PVD systems. The job involves coordination of a wide range of mechanical engineering tasks from idea generation to overviewing the design of complete systems involving structural, electrical, vacuum, and pneumatic components as well as ensuring the documentation and user manuals for the systems.

Other tasks

  • Further development and implementation of the different Polyteknik design standards
  • Resource and task planning for the team
  • Ensure knowledge sharing and coordination with the other teams at Polyteknik
  • Ensure that best practice is shared and efficient work methods are adapted across the team

Your profile

  • Degree in Mechanical engineering or similar relevant education
  • Preferably with a vast practical technical knowhow
  • Proven management skills and a dialogue inviting people person
  • Interest in design and vast experience with 3D construction in Solidworks
  • Analytical and structured work approach and accustomed to working with deadlines
  • Good at cooperating across tasks and teams, internally and externally, to achieve common goals
  • Ready to obtain new knowledge about high vacuum technology, high temperature materials, and plasma processes
  • Experienced communicator in Danish and English as not all team members speak Danish and most of our systems are exported and many suppliers are international

About Polyteknik AS

Polyteknik AS is a Danish PVD systems manufacturer with an innovative and best service approach. With more than 30 years in business, an international reference list, and an excellent platform of technology, Polyteknik AS has proved to be an appreciated partner in the thin film industry.

We strive to meet our customers’ needs and demands through highly qualified personnel. We strive to deliver premium products and services with uniform high quality and thus being our customers’ first choice. Our ambition is to be a reliable partner in all aspects of co-operatives.

Polyteknik AS has more than 80 dedicated and highly skilled employees and is based at our brand-new HQ in Hjallerup, a 20 minutes’ drive north of Aalborg. The job requires daily attendance at Polyteknik AS’s facility to exchange knowledge and best practice with team members and colleagues.

For more information on our company please visit our website .

title: Senior Software Developer – Västerås
description:
