title: Murer til fliser og renovering i Aalborg Ø
description:
Er du murer og vil du have firmabil, fast arbejde og fliser i hænderne?



Vi mangler en murer i Aalborg Ø til fliser, nybyg og renovering.



Du lander i et større setup, hvor murerarbejdet skal være pænt, præcist og til at aflevere ordentligt. Fliser er hovedopgaven, men der kan også være arbejde på nybyg og renovering, så du får ikke kun den samme type opgave uge efter uge. Arbejdet ligger i Aalborg Ø og omegn, og kørekort er nødvendigt, fordi du skal kunne møde ind og komme videre til opgaverne.

Det her er for dig, der kan tage fat uden at skulle holdes i hånden hele dagen. Du får firmabil, ordnede lønforhold og en hverdag, hvor du bruger dit fag rigtigt. Der er faglig tyngde omkring murværk, materialer og finish, så det du laver, skal kunne tåle at blive kigget efter i kanten.

Det får du

Løn: 200-220 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Aalborg Ø og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Fliser, nybyg og renovering

Din hverdag

Dagen er bygget op omkring flisearbejde, hvor rækkefølge, underlag og finish skal sidde i skabet. Nogle opgaver er lige til, andre kræver at du tænker dig om, før du går i gang. Du skal kunne skifte mellem fliser, nybyg og renovering uden at miste overblikket.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Lægger fliser og klinker, så resultatet står skarpt
  • Arbejder på nybyg, når der er behov for ekstra hænder
  • Tager del i renoveringsopgaver med murerarbejde
  • Holder styr på afslutninger, fuger og kanter
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer på opgaven

Det vigtigste er, at du afleverer pænt arbejde og møder stabilt. Hvis en opgave ændrer sig undervejs, tager du dialogen i tide, så den ikke ender som bøvl senere.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har erfaring som murer
  • Har arbejdet med fliser før
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt
  • Kan tage ansvar for kvaliteten i dit eget arbejde

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet både nybyg og renovering. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan lide en hverdag, hvor fliser og ordentligt håndværk fylder mest.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.



Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om Hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.



Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.



Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Det tager to minutter.



Fliser, Nybyg, Renovering

title: Ungarbejder - 7 timer - Ikast
description:
Introduktion

Er du under 18 år? Og drømmer du om at få et job, der giver lidt ekstra penge til dig selv hver måned? Så er du måske vores nye ungarbejder!

På #teamlidl bliver du en del af et seriøst godt sammenhold. Og som ungarbejder i Lidl får du et Lidl-tillæg på 5 kr. mere i timen.*

Mød din nye kollega Katrine
”Jeg er så glad for at arbejde i Lidl! Her er plads til alle, og alle bliver hørt. Vi har et rigtig godt team, hvor alle er gode til at hjælpe hinanden. Selve arbejdsmiljøet består af gode kunder, søde kollegaer og en flot butik,” fortæller Katrine, der er 17 år gammel og ungarbejder i Lidl.
Kan du bidrage til godt humør, fællesskab og en god service? Så er det måske dig, vi står og mangler!
På #teamlidl kommer du på hold med verdensklasse kollegaer. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter. Vi går nemlig op i, at du lærer tingene rigtigt fra start, at du lykkes i dit job, og at du bidrager til et stærkt sammenhold med dine kollegaer.

Grænseløse karrieremuligheder
Som ungarbejder er der mange forskellige udviklingsmuligheder hos os. Har du f.eks. ambitioner om at gøre karriere i dagligvarebranchen? Så er jobbet som ungarbejder det perfekte sted at starte. Din erfaring som ungarbejder vil nemlig kun være en fordel, hvis du senere ønsker at søge ind på vores elevuddannelse, som vi mener, er Danmarks suverænt bedste! Det er ligeledes en stor fordel at have butikserfaring, hvis du drømmer om at arbejde på vores hovedkontor.

* Ift. den overenskomstmæssig takst pr. marts 2026.

Om jobbet

Som ungarbejder hos os skal du, først og fremmest, hjælpe dine kollegaer, så vores kunder altid får en god indkøbsoplevelse i butikken. Du ved, at du har gjort dit arbejde godt, når du har ydet en god service – og det gør dig glad! Dine opgaver er blandt andet at:

  • Give vores kunder en god oplevelse i butikken sammen med dine kollegaer

  • Få butikken til at shine, ved at fylde op og trimme hylderne så de altid står snorlige

  • Få varerne scannet hurtigt gennem kasseapparatet med et smil på læben

  • Svinge moppen, når gulvet er beskidt

Om dig

Når du starter i Lidl, får du en grundig oplæring i butikken. Derfor er det ikke afgørende for os, at du har erfaring, men vi forventer, at du:

  • Er under 18 år, dog ikke yngre end 15 år

  • Har afsluttet 9. klasse

  • Er smilende og har masser af god energi

  • Har gåpåmod, klør på og vægter teamspirit højt

  • Møder til tiden og er interesseret i at gøre dit arbejde godt

  • Har mulighed for at arbejde eftermiddag, aften og i weekenden

Vi tilbyder

Udover at du får verdensklasse kollegaer, får du som ungarbejder også:

  • Et Lidl-tillæg på 5 kr. mere i timen*

  • Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

  • Løn og vilkår efter gældende overenskomst med HK

  • Erfaring med at samarbejde i et team og erfaring med service - hvilket vil give dig en stor fordel i dit videre arbejdsliv

  • Fleksible arbejdstider, så du let kan kombinere jobbet med skole og fritidsaktiviteter

  • Et spændende og varieret job med fart over feltet!

  • Gode karrieremuligheder, hvor du får forudsætningerne for at lykkes

  • Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.

Vil du med på #teamlidl?

Nu ved du forhåbentlig endnu mere om #teamlidl og jobbet som ungarbejder, end du gjorde i forvejen! Er jobbet som ungarbejder i Lidl noget for dig? Så send dit motiverede CV allerede i dag!

Sådan søger du stillingen:

  • Klik på ”Søg nu”

  • Udfyld formularen

  • Vedhæft dit motiverede CV

Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på jobilidlvest@lidl.dk eller tlf. 7635 0535, mandag – torsdag 8.00 – 15.00/ fredag 08.00 – 14.00

Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV!

YouTube video

00:27

Transskription

Der er ikke nogen bedre følelse end når der er ordentlig tingene og Når alting står snur lige nede i butikken handler det for mig om at hjælpe kunderne og at gøre mit til at vi har en indbydende butik at det samtidig sker i samarbejde med de bedste kollegaer det gør det bare fedt at gå på arbejde

Lidl Danmark K/S

Profilvej 9, Kolding

  • Lær at gøre en forskel for andre

    Hos Lidl er vi kendt for at være 100% kundevenlige, men for os handler det om meget mere end blot at scanne varer hurtigt. Det handler om ægte relationer, tillid og om at møde mennesker i øjenhøjde.

    Når du arbejder i en af vores butikker, bliver du vores vigtigste ansigt udadtil. Hos os lærer du at tale med alle typer af mennesker, yde service med et smil og bevare det gode overblik. Det er sociale og personlige færdigheder, du kan tage med dig og bruge i hele din fremtidige karriere.

    Et stærkt fællesskab i ryggen

    Du står aldrig alene med opgaverne. Vi vinder som et samlet hold og støtter altid hinanden med et smil, når tempoet er højt. Du får en grundig oplæring i vores enkle rutiner, så du føler dig helt tryg, uanset om du står ved kassen, bager friskt brød i bake off afdelingen eller hjælper til på gulvet.

    Et trygt springbræt for din selvtillid

    Jobbet i butikken styrker din selvtillid. Gennem den daglige kontakt med vores kunder og tæt sparring med din butikschef lærer du at tage et personligt ansvar og tro på dine egne evner. Det giver dig de bedste rammer og et stærkt fundament for hele din fremtidige karrierevej.

title: Project Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Join us in driving connectivity forward!

At One Mobility Group, we bridge worlds—combining nearly a century of German automotive engineering precision with the innovation power of the globe's largest electronics and ICT manufacturer. This unique positioning makes us the strategic partner for end-to-end mobility solutions—from initial concept design to large-scale manufacturing. Our comprehensive portfolio spans the full spectrum of electrified mobility, including power distribution systems, high- and low-voltage modules, safety components, and advanced charging solutions. We specialize in integration expertise that seamlessly connects data, power, and sensing – redefining what’s possible in intelligent, connected mobility.

At One Mobility, you will join a vibrant international team of 10,500 people, working together in 17 countries across Europe, Asia, North America, the Middle East, and Africa. Step into a culture where inclusivity is the foundation, where your ideas are trusted and supported, your passions are nurtured, and the spirit of collaboration is encouraged.

We move fast, think differently, and empower our people to deliver breakthrough solutions.

We are looking for

Project Manager (m/f/d)

in Product Life-cycle Management (PLM) Function

at one of our locations in EMEA region - Germany (Reutlingen)

Your tasks:

  1. Project Planning

  • Define project scope, objectives, assumptions, constraints, and deliverables in alignment with customer and organizational requirements.

  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Estimate and coordinate required project resources, including personnel, equipment, tooling, materials, and budget.

  • Establish project governance structure and project execution strategy.

  • Create and maintain the overall Project Plan, ensuring alignment with Quality, Cost, Timing (QCT), and profitability targets.

  • Coordinate project kick-off activities and ensure alignment among all stakeholders.

2. Project Execution and Coordination

  • Lead and steer the Project Core Team, including:

    Application Engineering

    Purchasing

    Account Management

    Launch Management

    Project Quality

    Project Logistics

    Project Controlling

  • Ensure execution of all project activities according to established plans and milestones.

  • Coordinate project-related activities with customers, suppliers, and internal functions.

  • Drive completion of project deliverables through cross-functional collaboration.

  • Manage Engineering Changes and Engineering Change Notices throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Ensure proper communication and alignment between customer requirements and internal execution teams.

  • Support prototype, validation, industrialization, and launch activities.

3. Monitoring and Control

  • Track project progress against approved plans, schedules, budgets, and milestones.

  • Monitor and report Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to Quality, Cost, Timing, Scope, and Customer Satisfaction.

  • Control project budgets, investments, development costs, tooling expenditures, and launch expenses.

  • Identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and opportunities.

  • Develop mitigation and recovery plans to address project deviations.

  • Maintain project action item lists, risk registers, and issue logs.

  • Provide periodic project status reports to customers, management, and project stakeholders.

  • Escalate critical risks, issues, and schedule impacts as required.

4. Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary customer interface throughout project execution.

  • Communicate project status, milestones, risks, recovery plans, and achievements to customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Ensure alignment and accountability within the Project Core Team.

  • Lead project review meetings, milestone reviews, and governance meetings.

  • Facilitate decision-making and resolution of project conflicts.

  • Escalate critical project concerns to management when project objectives are at risk.

  • Build and maintain effective relationships with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

5. Project Closure

  • Validate completion of all contractual, technical, quality, and commercial deliverables.

  • Ensure successful completion of PPAP submissions, customer approvals, and launch requirements.

  • Coordinate project handover to operations and serial production teams.

  • Verify achievement of project profitability objectives and identify improvement opportunities.

  • Document and communicate Lessons Learned for future project applications.

  • Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, customer requirements, and internal procedures.

  • Complete project closure documentation and obtain required approvals.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering), Business Administration, or related field

  • 5+ years of experience in automotive industry

  • 3+ years of experience in Project Management

  • 3+ years of experience in new product launches

  • Knowledge of APQP, IATF16949, PPAP, FMEA, project planning tools (e.g. MS Project)

  • Good command of English AND German

  • Experience in projects with automotive OEM customers

  • IPMA Level D (or higher) or PMP (or higher) certification is preferred

Our offer:

  • A permanent, full-time position

  • A mixed team of fresh talent and long-standing employees

title: Junior Programmamanager Mijnbouwschade | Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat
description:

Wij zijn voor het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (EZK) op zoek naar een Junior Programmamanager Mijnbouwschade. Binnen het programma Herstel werk je aan een maatschappelijk relevante opgave: het herstellen van schade aan woningen als gevolg van voormalige steenkoolwinning in Zuid-Limburg.

In deze rol ondersteun je samen met de programmamanager de uitvoering van het programma Herstel in Natura (HIN). Het programma richt zich op het coördineren van herstelwerkzaamheden aan woningen met aanzienlijke mijnbouwschade. Je bewaakt de voortgang, samenhang en resultaten van meerdere projecten en draagt bij aan het realiseren van de programmadoelstellingen.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Coördineer je samen met de programmamanager het programma Herstel.

  • Bewaak je de voortgang van meerdere Herstel in Natura-projecten.

  • Zorg je voor samenhang tussen verschillende projecten en deelresultaten.

  • Ondersteun je projectleiders bij het realiseren van projectdoelstellingen.

  • Draag je bij aan planning, rapportage en financiële bewaking van projecten.

  • Stem je af met betrokken stakeholders binnen het programma en de organisatie.

  • Lever je een bijdrage aan het behalen van de strategische doelstellingen van het programma.

Wat vragen wij?

Eisen:

  • Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding.

  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare ervaring met werken binnen een programma- en projectstructuur.

Aanvullende wensen:

  • Je hebt ervaring met planning, rapportage en financiële bewaking van projecten.

Informatie

Start: 27 oktober 2026

Aantal uur: 28 tot 36 uur per week

Lengte opdracht: 5 maanden met optie tot verlenging

Locatie: Den Haag

Vorm: ZZP

Contact

title: Medewerker Bediening (oproep), Torendael, Amsterdam
description:
Ben jij gastvrij, houd je van afwisseling en maak je graag mensen blij? Bij Vivium krijg je de kans om jouw enthousiasme in te zetten op een plek waar persoonlijke aandacht centraal staat. Je draagt bij aan een warme, huiselijke omgeving waar bewoners met dementie zichzelf kunnen zijn en genieten van kleine, waardevolle momenten.

Van af 1 november 2026 tot en met eind mei 2027 zijn wij op zoek naar een medewerker bediening op oproep basis.

‘‘Voor mij draait gastvrijheid om meer dan eten en drinken serveren. Het gaat om aandacht, een warm welkom en ervoor zorgen dat bewoners en hun familie zich echt thuis voelen. Dat maakt mijn werk iedere dag waardevol.’’

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zorgt voor een warm welkom, een fijne sfeer en een glimlach op het gezicht van onze bewoners en hun gasten!

In deze afwisselende en levendige functie versterk je het horecateam van locatie Torendael. Hier komen bewoners en hun familieleden samen om te genieten van een smakelijke lunch, een gezellig diner of een hapje en drankje in het café. Met jouw gastvrije houding en oog voor persoonlijke aandacht maak je van ieder bezoek een prettig moment.

Je werkzaamheden zijn lekker afwisselend: je treft voorbereidingen, serveert drankjes, bereidt kleine maaltijden en snacks en helpt bij de kassawerkzaamheden.

Geen dag is hetzelfde! Met jouw enthousiasme, inzet en persoonlijke aandacht draag je bij aan een plek waar bewoners zich thuis voelen en waar iedereen welkom is.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je bent servicegericht, vriendelijk en flexibel inzetbaar;

  • Werken in een verpleeghuis lijkt je leuk, omdat je affiniteit (en eventueel al ervaring) hebt met ouderen met dementie;

  • Je hebt goede sociale vaardigheden en beheerst de Nederlandse taal;

title: Energispecialist til Facility Management
description:
Energispecialist til Facility Management

Vil du være med til at styrke energieffektiviteten i kommunens bygninger og omsætte energidata og teknisk viden til konkrete forbedringer?

Facility Management i Faaborg-Midtfyn Kommune søger en energispecialist, der kan bidrage til at udvikle vores arbejde med energistyring, energioptimering, teknisk dokumentation og drift af kommunens bygninger.

Du får en central specialistrolle med fokus på energianalyser, EED, EPBD, energioptimering og DKV. Samtidig bliver du en vigtig faglig sparringspartner for kolleger og samarbejdspartnere på tværs af Facility Management.

Stillingen kombinerer teknik, data, analyse, dokumentation og praktisk driftsforståelse, og du får gode muligheder for at omsætte din faglighed til konkrete resultater i kommunens bygninger.

Om Facility Management

Facility Management driver, vedligeholder og udvikler kommunens bygninger og tekniske installationer. Vores opgave er at sikre velfungerende, sikre og energieffektive rammer for kommunens aktiviteter.

Du bliver en del af et tværfagligt miljø med tekniske specialister, håndværkere, teknisk service, rengøring og sikringsområdet. Vi lægger vægt på faglighed, samarbejde, ansvar og en praktisk tilgang til opgaveløsningen.

Som følge af stigende krav til energistyring, dokumentation og myndighedsopfølgning styrker vi nu området med en energispecialist, der kan være med til at sikre både den daglige opfølgning og den langsigtede udvikling.

Dine primære opgaver

Du får ansvar for at understøtte og koordinere arbejdet med energi, energidata og teknisk dokumentation.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Analyse og opfølgning på el-, vand- og varmeforbrug.
  • Identifikation, beregning og dokumentation af energibesparelser.
  • Analyse af forbrugsmønstre, afvigelser og brugeradfærd.
  • Udarbejdelse af energirapporter, nøgletal og ledelsesinformation.
  • Formidling af energidata og besparelsesmuligheder til ledere, brugere og samarbejdspartnere.
  • Arbejde med EED, EPBD og øvrige relevante energikrav.
  • Energioptimering af bygninger og tekniske installationer.
  • Bidrag til renoverings-, ombygnings- og byggeprojekter med fokus på energi og drift.
  • Tværgående samarbejde med øvrige fagområder i Facility Management.
DKV, dokumentation og myndighedskrav

Du får desuden en central rolle i arbejdet med drift, kontrol og vedligehold samt dokumentationen af kommunens tekniske installationer.

Opgaverne omfatter blandt andet:

  • Vedligeholdelse og udvikling af DKV-dokumentation.
  • Opfølgning på lovpligtige eftersyn, kontroller og brandsyn.
  • Koordinering og opfølgning på relevante myndighedskrav.
  • Opfølgning på serviceaftaler og samarbejde med eksterne leverandører.
  • Planlægning og dokumentation af drifts- og vedligeholdelsesaktiviteter.
  • Sikring af kvalitet, struktur og sporbarhed i den tekniske dokumentation.
Tekniske og tværgående opgaver

Stillingen er bredt funderet i den tekniske drift, og du vil derfor også blive involveret i opgaver inden for blandt andet:

  • CTS og BMS.
  • Ventilations-, varme- og øvrige tekniske installationer.
  • Teknisk drift og vedligehold.
  • Tværgående udviklings- og optimeringsprojekter.
  • Andre relevante opgaver inden for energi og teknisk drift.
Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har en solid teknisk forståelse for bygninger og tekniske installationer.
  • Har interesse for energistyring, energioptimering og bæredygtig bygningsdrift.
  • Arbejder systematisk og trives med data, analyser og dokumentation.
  • Kan omsætte komplekse data og tekniske problemstillinger til konkrete løsninger og anbefalinger.
  • Kan formidle resultater og energidata på en enkel og forståelig måde.
  • Arbejder struktureret, tager ansvar og følger dine opgaver til dørs.
  • Er nysgerrig og motiveret for løbende at udvikle din faglighed.
  • Trives i et tværfagligt miljø med mange forskellige samarbejdspartnere.
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig bidrage aktivt til fælles løsninger.
Din baggrund

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund kan være forskellig. Du kan eksempelvis være energiteknolog, maskinmester, installatør, driftstekniker, elektriker eller VVS’er med relevant videreuddannelse, eller du kan have opbygget tilsvarende kompetencer gennem praktisk erfaring og efteruddannelse.

Det afgørende for os er ikke en bestemt uddannelsestitel. Vi lægger vægt på din tekniske forståelse, analytiske tilgang og interesse for energi og bygningsdrift samt din motivation for at udvikle dig inden for området.

Vi tilbyder

  • En central specialistfunktion med betydning for kommunens energi- og bygningsdrift.
  • Mulighed for at præge og videreudvikle energiarbejdet i Facility Management.
  • Et selvstændigt ansvarsområde med faglig indflydelse.
  • Et stærkt tværfagligt miljø med tæt kontakt til både drift og specialister.
  • En varieret hverdag med en kombination af analyse, teknik, udvikling og praktisk problemløsning.
  • Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling.
  • Engagerede kolleger og et arbejdsmiljø, hvor samarbejde og faglig sparring vægtes højt.
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst og principperne om lokal løndannelse.

Vil du vide mere?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller arbejdsområdet, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Teknisk driftsleder Lasse Schmidt Almlund
Telefon: 72 53 21 61
Mail: lalml@fmk.dk

Ansøgning

Ansøgningsfrist: 15.11.2026 kl. 23.59

Forventet tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt eller efter aftale

title: Replenishment Intern
description:
Driven by the passion to improve the quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as the market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation to reach more people, more effectively.

As a replenishment intern, you will support the team in ensuring inventory availability to meet business and customer requirements. You will be given the opportunity to gain hands-on exposure to inventory planning, replenishment, supply and shortage management, cross-functional coordination and improvement tasks, as assigned. You will also assist planners with daily operational activities, report preparation and follow-up of supply and inventory issues.

  • Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve replenishment processes and reporting efficiency.

What you bring

  • Good experience in using ERP systems and analysing work processes

Who we are

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.

Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.

With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.

title: Community Grants Scheme (CGS) Project Officer_ Western Province Partnership |APSP
description:
• Location: Daru, Western Province

  • Commencement: November 2026

  • Duration of contract: Up to 28 February 2030

  • Open to PNG Citizens only

About the Program

The Australia PNG Subnational Program (APSP) is an enabling mechanism comprising three separately designed programs including: Bougainville Partnership (BP), Kokoda Initiative Partnership (KIP), and the Western Province Partnership (WPP). Each program has its own outcomes, theory of change, operational approach and separate monitoring and evaluation systems.

The APSP includes the Subnational Governance Implementation Plan (SGIP) that proposes a scalable foundational delivery model of subnational engagement. The SGIP is referenced in the APSP Contract and Strategic Framework as the continuation of the current network of subnational advisers (SNA) in the Western Province, Highlands, Sepik’s and Morobe.

There are five high level outcomes which span all programs:

  • Output one: Effective gender-centred programs delivered for Bougainville, Kokoda, and Western Province

  • Output two: Support DFAT to coordinate Australian inputs in selected subnational contexts.

  • Output three: Technical assistance targeted at key institutions and policy reforms.

  • Output four: Rapid programming of resources in support of DFAT priorities.

  • Output five and six: Analysis, learning, and adaptation.

Managed by Abt Global under a single contract from 2026 -2030, the centralised approach aims to drive value for money by realising back-office efficiencies, ensuring gender equality is consistently embedded across each program, and creating opportunities for learning and adaptation between programs.

About the Program Activity

The Western Province Partnership (WPP) is a component of the Australia-Papua New Guinea Subnational Program (APSP). The objective of the WPP is for Australia and Western Province to foster stronger ties and improve coordination to support human and economic development, enabling infrastructure and regional security.

The WPP will work toward the realisation of the following end of program outcomes (EOPO) by 2030:

  1. Women and men participating in program activities have diversified livelihoods from agriculture and fisheries.

  2. Targeted communities collaborate to strengthen welfare, production, and resilience.

  3. Women contribute to decision-making and take on leadership roles in targeted provincial, district, and community structures.

  4. Policy and practice at provincial and district levels are directed towards delivery of minimum priority services.

The WPP is nested under the Western Province Strategy which aims to unify Australia’s development assistance and captures Australia’s whole-of-government engagement.

The main components of the South Fly Resilience Plan have transitioned to the WPP into the following to contribute to achieving the 4 key outcomes above:

  1. Water, Sanitation and Hygiene Program (WASH)

  2. Economic Initiative Program

  3. Community Grants Scheme Program

  4. Gender Empowerment and Advocacy Program

  5. Rangers Program

  6. System Strengthening for Provincial and District Administration

  7. Disability Support Program

About the Opportunity

Under the direction of the CGS Manager, the Project Officer supports the administration and implementation of community grants throughout the grants cycle.

The Project Officer will support the capacity development of local actors (WPA personnel, South Fly District Community Development Workers (CDW), community groups, as necessary) through learning-by-doing in community development and in all aspects of the grants cycle.

Incumbents will prioritise good governance, financial compliance, high-quality community development methodologies, GEDSI (gender equality, disability and social inclusion), and health and safety in all aspects of their work.

A key function of the position will be the demonstration of a visible and systematic commitment to achieving gender equality at Abt and for achieving against agreed gender equality performance objectives.

Key Responsibilities

The Project Officer will be responsible for;

  • Support and train Ward Development Committees and community groups to deliver participatory community development activities and to administer community grant funds with a high degree of compliance to program requirements.

  • Ensure the implementation of systematic and scheduled monitoring of grants.

  • Deliver capacity development and training strategies consistent with program requirements and with the capacity strengthening needs of Ward Development Committees and grantees.

  • Integrate Gender Equality, Disability, and Social Inclusion and Democratic Governance approaches into all aspects of the delivery of training and support to WPA/SFD personnel, CDWs and grantees.

  • Represent the program in a way entirely consistent with the program’s Code of Conduct.

  • Support WPA/SFD personnel, CDWs and grantees to develop project plans and budgets consistent with approved activities.

  • Prepare schedules for inclusion in grant agreements.

  • Support WPA/SFD personnel, CDWs and grantees to undertake monitoring and evaluation and prepare reports of the same.

  • Working collaboratively with Procurement and Administration Officers, support all aspects of procurement and logistics associated with training, fieldwork and grant implementation.

  • Prepare reports as directed.

  • Comply with program Health, Safety and Security requirements and ensure that grantees and partners are conversant with the same.

  • Prepare monthly output plans and other plans as directed.

Safeguarding

  • Support partner compliance with all relevant policies and procedures regarding environmental and social safeguards.

Other

  • Compliance with DFAT and Abt Associates policies.

  • Participate in communities of practice, as relevant.

  • Support program close out and novation activities.

  • Any other reasonable duties as directed by the CGS or EIP Managers

Key working relationships

Reporting to:

  • Community Grants Scheme – Manager

Working alongside:

  • WPP Senior Management Team

  • Logistics & Administration Officer

  • Finance and Administration Officer

  • Implementing Partners – WPP

About You

For applications to be considered, a response to the key selection criteria below must be provided.

Qualifications

  • A relevant undergraduate degree in community development, project management or a related discipline.
  • At least five (5) years’ relevant experience in community project implementation or management, including practical experience in community engagement, project planning, budgeting, monitoring and reporting. Experience administering community grants is desirable.

Knowledge

  • Knowledge and ability to undertake a project and program cycle management tasks, including development procedures/approaches.
  • Demonstrated understanding of operational, logistics and financial procedures.

Skills/Experience

  • At least five years’ relevant experience in community project implementation or management, including practical experience in community engagement, project planning, budgeting, monitoring and reporting. Experience administering community grants is desirable. Demonstrated ability to proactively deliver results for the program;
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multi-cultural team;
  • Demonstrated commitment to promoting gender equity and social inclusion in all aspects of this role;
  • Excellent administrative and operational skills and experience, including working knowledge of Microsoft Office and online project management tools;
  • Good communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills;
  • Excellent time management and organisational skills;
  • High level of attention to detail;
  • Punctual, responsible and reliable.

Personal Attributes

  • Delivers Results

  • Builds Internal and External Customer Satisfaction and Loyalty

  • Develops People

  • Sets Vision and Direction

  • Demonstrates Sound Financial and Business-Related Practices

  • Builds Teams and Cooperation

  • Promotes Technical Excellence and Quality

  • Promotes Diversity

  • Acts as a Role Model

How to Apply

  • Please ensure to address the Key Selection Criteria (About You) in your cover letter, and submit your application online, along with your CV as a single document.

  • Applications must be submitted personally by individuals only. Applications submitted by a company or organisation will not be accepted.

title: QA tester
description:
QA / Applications Test Engineer (.NET Specialist)

Job Description

We are looking for a versatile and meticulous QA / Applications Test Engineer with a strong background in testing .NET applications alongside web, API, and legacy enterprise software. In this role, you will design, implement, and execute comprehensive manual and automated testing strategies to ensure the highest quality, reliability, and security across our software ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will feel equally comfortable testing core C#/.NET desktop or web applications as they do validating third-party integrations, backend databases, and non-.NET auxiliary applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Test Strategy & Execution: Create, maintain, and execute comprehensive manual and automated test cases for .NET (C#, .NET, Oracle) applications as well as broader enterprise software.
  • Automation Engineering: Build and extend scalable automation frameworks using tools like Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress (with C# or JavaScript/TypeScript) to reduce manual regression overhead.
  • API & Integration Testing: Validate RESTful and SOAP web services using utilities like Postman or SoapUI, ensuring seamless end-to-end data flows between .NET systems and external applications.
  • Defect Management: Identify, isolate, record, and track software bugs using Jira or Azure DevOps (TFS). Work closely with cross-functional development teams to ensure quick resolution.
  • Database Verification: Write and run complex SQL queries to perform backend data validation, verify data integrity, and check migration workflows.
  • CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites into DevOps build pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure Pipelines) to facilitate continuous testing.

title: Power Market Analytics – Analyst
description:
About Argus

Argus Analytics forms one half of the advisory division of Argus Media Group. Comprising a global team of 90 analysts, we provide clients with analysis, data and forecasts across 35 commodities and markets spanning oil & gas, chemicals, fertilizers, generation fuels, metals and energy transition solutions. Our work is firmly focused on market fundamentals — considering end-to-end value chains, international trade flows and macroeconomic trends. Our value proposition centres around the quality of our analysts, the depth of our data and our ability to leverage Argus’ wider strengths, including 55 years of commodity markets expertise, unrivalled global networks and proprietary datasets.

What will you be doing

As part of the continued expansion of our practice, we are currently looking for a passionate, driven and energetic subject matter expert, to help develop our long term power advisory capability. This role will support us in developing analysis that will form the basis of our advisory work.

This is a great opportunity for someone with a background in Power analysis and forecasting to play a leading role in the development of new services and to position themselves as a market expert in an area that is vital to the development of our business.

Key responsibilities

  • Shape & deliver consultancy advisory work for clients in the power sector, including price & market due diligence, regulatory response and investment support engagements

  • Develop and continuously improve fundamental power market models (supply, demand, dispatch, price formation). Translate modelling outputs into clear market views and price forecasts

  • Maintain current knowledge of major drivers and trends across the power industry . Identify and quantify key market risks (policy, fuel pricing, capacity shifts)

  • Support client-facing deliverables (reports, consulting, presentations)

  • Take ownership of specific market segments (e.g. Germany, UK, or Iberia)

  • Build strong understanding of other Argus Generation Fuel services, data and capabilities, to help ensure market views are consistent across our offerings

  • Work with stakeholders across other Argus teams, including Analytics, to ensure relevant knowledge is shared and used effectively. Act as Subject Matter Expert where needed

  • Contribute to development of Argus view on ways in which power markets will develop through energy transition

Skills and Experience

  • Educated to degree level (2.1 or above) from a leading university. Further education (e.g. Masters) a plus

  • Strong understanding of Power markets, how they operate and key market trends, gained through 3-5+ years in the industry. Experience of using third party Energy Modelling Software (e.g. Plexos) beneficial

  • Highly numerate with experience analysing comprehensive datasets quickly and meticulously with excellent attention to detail and accuracy focus.

  • Intellectually curious and able to demonstrate structured problem solving and analytical skills.

  • Exceptional communication and relationship building skills.

  • Strong IT skills including advanced Excel and PowerPoint. Awareness of other statistical and programming languages such as R is an advantage.

  • Ability to handle multiple tasks to deadline and to meet targets.

  • Flexible in approach, highly motivated and willing to contribute to the growth of Argus’ Consulting Services.

What’s in it for you

Our rapidly growing, award-winning business offers a dynamic environment for talented, entrepreneurial professionals to achieve results and grow their careers. Argus recognizes and rewards successful performance and as an Investor in People, we promote professional development and retain a high-performing team committed to building our success.

  • Competitive salary and company bonus scheme

  • Group pension scheme

  • Group healthcare and life assurance scheme

  • Hybrid working environment (three days in office)

  • 25 days annual holiday with incremental increase up to 30 days

  • Subsidised gym membership

  • Season ticket travel loan

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Flexible benefits platform (ability to buy additional medical cover, life assurance, dental cover, holiday, critical illness, travel insurance & health screening)

  • Extensive internal and external training

title: Customer Experience Executive (Part time)
description:
We’re looking for hardworking, driven, and passionate candidates to join our team as we get set for further growth in 2026, helping our owners to maintain their high quality properties, and to ensure our guests receive the very best customer service whilst staying with us.

Are you passionate about customer service and looking for a new, exciting challenge? If you answered yes, then look no further, this role is just what you are looking for.

As a Customer Experience Executive at Prestige Lodges, Allerthorpe, you will play a vital role in delivering exceptional experiences for both our guests and lodge owners. You’ll bring a genuine passion for customer service and strong problem-solving skills, managing guest check-ins and check-outs, holding on-site meetings with owners, and providing support via phone, email, and social media.

This is a hands-on role, working “on the ground” to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the lodges. You’ll support the wider property management team, maintain compliance standards, and focus on maximising customer satisfaction and owner confidence throughout every stage of the journey.

By combining proactive guest engagement, responsive owner support, and hands-on property management, this role ensures that every interaction and every property under your care reflects our commitment to delivering outstanding service, maintaining property standards, and creating memorable experiences for both guests and owners at Prestige Lodges, Allerthorpe.


Working Hours

This is a part-time role working 2 days per week (7.5 hours per day, 15 hours per week), on a four week rotating rota which includes weekend work. Your normal working hours will be between 9:00am and 7:00pm.


On-Call Requirement

As part of the role, you will participate in an on-call rota, during which you will be available to assist guests with telephone enquiries until 8:00pm. On-call shifts are separate from your normal working hours and will be paid in addition to your regular salary through an enhanced supplement payment.


Salary

£26,000 FTE


To be considered for this role, you MUST have:

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving, negotiation, and conflict resolution abilities.
  • Customer and owner-focused mindset with a drive to exceed expectations.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and remain calm under pressure.
  • Awareness of property compliance, health, safety, and operational standards.
  • A Hands-on, proactive approach with the ability to work independently on-site.
  • Ability to liaise with the public and clients professionally.
  • Be an efficient communicator with a professional and customer orientated approach.
  • Complete problem-solving skills, analytical skills, & decision-making skills.
  • In depth ability to understand data & identify trends and patterns..
  • Able to work unsupervised and on own initiative.
  • Competent with the use of information technology.
  • Organised and can prioritise tasks.
  • A friendly and enthusiastic attitude.

And Day to Day? …….. You will be responsible for:

Guest-Facing Responsibilities:

  • Welcome guests on-site, handling check-ins, and providing guidance about the property and local area.
  • Build strong relationships with guests to enhance their holiday experience.
  • Handle enquiries and complaints promptly, taking ownership and resolving issues both on-site and remotely.
  • Support guests during their stay, offering solutions and assistance when needed.
  • Assist guests with bookings, guidance on accommodation, and holiday-related queries.
  • Respond to guest reviews, investigate concerns, and implement corrective measures.
  • Maintain accurate records of all guest interactions and feedback.

Owner-Facing Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain strong, professional relationships with property owners, providing regular updates and on-site meetings as required.
  • Manage owner enquiries, including invoicing, property performance, maintenance, and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with the Onboarding team to transition new properties into the portfolio.
  • Confidently resolve owner challenges and complaints on-site and remotely, ensuring satisfaction.
  • Prepare reports for your owners, line manager, or Director regarding property performance, guest feedback, and operational concerns.
  • Complete quarterly calls or on-site meetings with your owners to ensure the property is performing and we are maximising their profits, keeping their property and performance on track.

On-Site & Operational Responsibilities:

  • Act as the first point of contact for guests and owners visiting Prestige Lodges Allerthorpe.
  • Ensure lodge properties are guest-ready.
  • Conduct on-site inspections, handovers, and property checks when needed.
  • Support emergencies at the property, ensuring safety protocols are followed.
  • Liaise with other departments to resolve operational issues.

General Duties:

  • Work collaboratively with other departments to ensure smooth business operations.
  • Participate in training and development activities as requested.
  • Take ownership of problems and ensure they are resolved efficiently for both guests and owners.

Who is Host & Stay?

Host & Stay is based in Saltburn-by-the-sea and provides full service holiday home property management to over 1000 properties across the UK. Host & Stay was born from a love and passion for property, and a desire to lead the change in an age old industry.


Our vision is simple, to help property owners maximise their income, maximise their returns, and reduce their fees and their hassle. We are on a mission to make the UK one of the most popular, guest centric holiday destinations in the world – but not at the expense of holiday homeowners paying high management fees and seeing very little, if any return on their investments. We want our customers and communities to succeed and thrive.


We have ambitious plans for further growth and impact, and we need the right people to take this leap with us. It may be challenging at times, but you can be assured that it is going to be rewarding and inspiring. After all, we are changing lives, every day, in all that we do.

Why choose us?

The team here at Host and Stay genuinely care about the work we do to transform the lives of our customers and we think this is a pretty big reason to love your career at Host and Stay.


Our people are our best asset, so we want to make sure your wellbeing is the best it can be. Our responsibilities as an employer extend beyond the workplace, we want to make sure we can help and support you when you need it most.


Any Questions?

If you have access requirements you would like us to be aware of, please contact the Recruitment Team on e: recruitment@hostandstay.co.uk - we will be happy to help!

title: Faglig koordinator til Sirius Moltkesvej
description:
Vil du være med til at styrke fagligheden og skabe et stærkt samarbejde på et specialiseret botilbud?

Hos Sirius Moltkesvej søger vi en uddannet pædagog eller socialrådgiver, der har lyst til at tage et større fagligt ansvar og være med til at udvikle både den pædagogiske praksis og samarbejdet i medarbejdergruppen.

Vi er i gang med at opbygge fagligt stærke teams, hvor kompetencer, samarbejde og et fælles menneskesyn går hånd i hånd. Som faglig koordinator får du en central rolle i den udvikling.

En faglig nøgleperson tæt på praksis

Du bliver en vigtig sparringspartner for den daglige leder og dine kolleger med ansvar for at understøtte den faglige kvalitet og skabe sammenhæng i hverdagen.

Medarbejderne arbejder i 12- og 24-timers vagter, og derfor er gode overleveringer, fælles faglige tilgange og tydelig kommunikation afgørende.

Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver at:

  • Understøtte den socialfaglige kvalitet, dokumentation og arbejdet med beboernes mål.

  • Koordinere overleveringer og bidrage til personalemøder og faglige drøftelser.

  • Vejlede kolleger i pædagogiske metoder og konkrete faglige dilemmaer.

  • Bidrage til onboarding af nye medarbejdere og udviklingen af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab.

Det er ikke en ren koordinatorstilling bag et skrivebord. Du vil også have tid tæt på beboerne og dine kolleger i den daglige praksis. Vi tror på, at god faglig koordinering kræver indsigt i den hverdag, man er med til at udvikle.

Stillingen er en gennemgående funktion med arbejdstid primært mandag til fredag i dagtimerne, men der kan forekomme weekendvagter i rul.

Hvem er du?

Du er uddannet pædagog eller socialrådgiver og har gerne erfaring fra det specialiserede socialområde, særligt botilbud eller arbejdet med borgere med komplekse støttebehov.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Har en solid faglighed og kan omsætte metoder, refleksion og dokumentation til god praksis.

  • Er relationsstærk og kan motivere, vejlede og samle kolleger om fælles mål.

  • Arbejder struktureret, tager ansvar og tør udfordre vaner med respekt og faglig nysgerrighed.

Du behøver ikke have været koordinator før. Det vigtigste er, at du har faglig tyngde, kan skabe tillid og har lyst til at gøre andre dygtigere.

Om Sirius Moltkesvej og Den Socialfaglige Organisation

Sirius Moltkesvej ligger i Ruds Vedby og er et specialiseret botilbud efter servicelovens §§ 107 og 108 for voksne med komplekse støttebehov.

Vi arbejder ud fra værdierne respekt, inddragelse, trivsel, fællesskab og faglighed og et menneskesyn, hvor alle har ret til et meningsfuldt liv og til at blive mødt med respekt, uanset forudsætninger og udfordringer.

Som faglig koordinator skal du være med til at sikre, at vores værdier kan mærkes i mødet med beboerne, i de faglige beslutninger og i samarbejdet mellem kolleger.

Du får mulighed for at præge den faglige udvikling, tæt sparring med den daglige leder og mulighed for kompetenceudvikling. Vi tilbyder desuden løn efter kvalifikationer, pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring.

Praktisk information

Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Kørekort til almindelig bil og tilfredsstillende straffe- og børneattest er et krav.

Har du lyst til at tage fagligt ansvar og være med til at gøre en forskel på Sirius Moltkesvej? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

title: Tool, GSE & Facility Coordinator
description:

The primary focus of this role is the management of tools and ground support equipment. Depending on operational requirements, the role may also involve supporting facility management activities. In addition, the position includes responsibility for handling smaller projects and related tasks.

title: Radiology Assistant, Full-time, Day shift
description:
Located in Templeton amongst the oak trees, Adventist Health Twin Cities has been serving northern San Luis Obispo County since 1977. Comprised of a 122-bed acute care facility, our team provides exceptional care in emergency medicine, orthopedics, obstetrics, digestive disorders, wound care, and various medical, surgical and outpatient services. Locals enjoy weekly farmers markets in downtown Templeton, farm-to-fork dining, beautiful landscapes for hiking and biking, and beach days just fifteen minutes away at Cambria and Morro Bay.

Job Summary:

Supports technologists with ongoing patient care, including assisting, transporting, moving and supervising patients in the radiology department. Helps manage the imaging department's patient flow.

Job Requirements:

Education and Work Experience:

  • High School Education/GED or equivalent: Required
  • Associate’s/Technical Degree or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Preferred
  • Experience in hospital setting: Preferred

Essential Functions:

  • Safely transports and assists patients between other departments and waiting areas. Assists patients from wheelchair to exam table, stretcher or toilet and back as needed. Provides direct patient care as directed by technologists or radiologists, in conjunction with all imaging procedures.
  • Reviews physician orders, researches lab values and provides patient education as directed by technologists.
  • Helps manage the imaging department's patient flow. Familiarizes self with all department computer systems and programs, under the supervision of technologists. Transports and assists patients between other departments and waiting areas. Position and assists patients on and off exam tables and escorts patients to the restroom. Familiarizes self with the hospital's "Lift" equipment.
  • Processes paperwork, prints and logs camera QC for nuclear medicine. Develops and assembles films in preparation for reading. Assists the imaging clerical staff as needed. Adheres to Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and other patient confidentiality guidelines and regulations.

title: Vil du have et jordemoderliv med tid, nærvær og faglig stolthed? Så kom og vær med hos os i Gødstrup!
description:
Lige nu søger vi:

  • Jordemødre til 3 faste stillinger fra 1.1.2027 på fødegangen, fuld tid

Hos os kan du glæde dig til:

  • Tid til både fødslen og familien
  • Én jordemoder til én fødende - hver gang
  • Variation i dine opgaver (fx konsultation, mobiljordemoder, akutklinik mv., barselsgang)
  • Tæt sparring i alle vagter fra både jordemodersupervisor og fra dine kollegaer – du står aldrig alene
  • Indflydelse på dit skema (8, 9 eller 12 timers vagter, flest D/A eller flest D/N
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab med plads til grin og faglige diskussioner

Faglig og organisatorisk profil

Vi har nu været på det nye hospital i Gødstrup siden 2022, og vi nyder vores nye flotte rammer i ”Familieklyngen” med omkring 3100 fødsler:

  • Fødegang, akut klinik og barselsgang ligger tæt sammen med fælles kaffestue
  • Fødegang og OP ligger helt tæt op ad hinanden
  • Alle 8 fødestuer er indrettet som interaktive fødestuer med lokale naturstemninger fra vores 6 kommuner, og med mulighed for at spille parrenes individuelle musik
  • Alle barselstuer er indrettet med dobbeltseng (kan skilles ad i en akut situation)
  • Jordemoderkonsultationer, familieambulatorie og klinik for gravide ligger samlet i stueetagen
  • Vores faciliteter booster oxytocin både under fødslen og på barselsstuerne til glæde for vores familier, og også til glæde for os som personale. Derudover har vi en fremragende udsigt og mulighed for dejlig 1 times gåtur rundt om Gødstrup sø
  • Stærkt samarbejde med Børn & Unge og afsnit for syge nyfødte og tidligt fødte
  • NIDO er vores nye forskningsenhed, som danner rammen om et stærkt forskningsmiljø på hospitalet

Det er vigtigt for os, at vores familier oplever en høj kvalitet, som tager udgangspunkt i det enkelte pars ønsker og muligheder. Vi tror på, at sikkerhed, relationer og atmosfære er vigtige og nødvendige ingredienser i en stærk svangreomsorg. Vi har 5 kendt jordemoderordninger, fordi vi oplever, at kontinuitet og kendthed har betydning for relationerne. Færre fødselslæsioner, reduktion af blødning pp. og ”Flere gode vaginale fødsler” er nogle af de faglige pejlemærker, vi fokuserer målrettet på i et forbedringsperspektiv.

Vi arbejder for, at parret styrkes i troen på egne evner. Vi er der for dem, også når de er i hjemmet. Vi har et mobilteam, bestående af jordemødre/sygeplejersker, som varetager hjemmebesøg for både første- og flergangsfødende. Førstegangsfødende vælger selv, hvornår de vil hjem efter fødslen: direkte fra fødegangen med 2 hjemmebesøg af mobilteamet, blive 24 timer på barselsgangen med 1 besøg i hjemmet, eller om de har behov for flere dage på barselsgangen. Vi tror på, at det giver parrene tryghed selv at vælge, og at vi kan tilbyde dem besøg i deres egne rammer. Samtidig styrker det vores muligheder for at yde ekstra omsorg til de mere sårbare og komplicerede familier.

Som et led i hospitalets vision om at skabe Danmarks bedste læringshospital har vi på barselsgangen et ”obstetrisk studieafsnit” for medicin-, sygepleje- og jordemoderstuderende. Studieafsnittet varetager opvågningsforløb og barselspleje af elektive sectii.

I ”Afsnit for tab og aborter” varetager et fast team af jordemødre omsorgen for par, som mister. Supervision er en fast del i teamet, ligesom det er for andre teams i afdelingen. Der er ligeledes mulighed for individuel supervision for alle medarbejdere ved behov.

Vi er af Dagens medicin blevet kåret som bedste fødeafdeling 9 år i træk. Det forpligter, og vi gør os umage med fortsat at levere høj kvalitet og sammenhængende forløb i hele afdelingen.

Arbejdsopgaver og ansvarsområde

Vi arbejder bevidst på at være en psykologisk tryg arbejdsplads, hvor alle føler sig trygge i at dele ideer, fejl og kritik. Vi er optaget af, at hele afdelingen gør et godt stykke arbejde og at vi lærer af hinanden. Vi har en uformel tone på tværs af ledelseslag og faggrupper, og vi elsker et godt grin i alle vagter. Vi har masser af gode ideer, som vi skaber sammen, og som vi tør prøve af. ALLE medarbejderes ideer og bidrag har vi brug for, så vi kan fastholde vores super gode fødested - og vi vil glæde os til DIT bidrag. Vi elsker at diskutere fag og forløb med hinanden på tværs af faggrupper, og kollegial sparring foregår i alle vagter uanset anciennitet.

Vi har kliniske jordemodersupervisorer døgnet rundt, og har et berigende samarbejde med afdelingens læger. Vores stærke tværfaglige samarbejde er grundstenen i vores afdeling. Fødeafdelingen og barselsafdelingen (som har både jordemødre og sygeplejersker ansat) arbejder tæt sammen, og hjælper hinanden i travle vagter og ved sygdom.

Som ny jordemoder i vores afdeling indgår du i et struktureret introduktionsprogram med mentorordning, supervision og færdighedstræning, så du bedst muligt kommer godt ind i både den faglige og sociale kultur.

Se funktionsbeskrivelse jordemoder fødegang

Se introduktionsprogram

Personprofil

Vi forventer, at du

  1. Er fagligt dygtig og engageret og er opdateret både teoretisk og praktisk
  2. Vil være en del af en ”bidragskultur”, hvor det forventes, at alle bidrager til at skabe en god arbejdsplads og et godt fødested
  3. Er stabil og fleksibel. Du skal kunne trives med variation i arbejdet, men vi tilstræber altid at fleksibiliteten så vidt overhovedet muligt tilpasses dine præferencer.
  4. Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men samtidig med stor team ånd
  5. Er positiv og imødekommende med et godt humør
  6. Evner nærvær med parrene og formår at styrke og støtte dem - ud fra deres behov
  7. Arbejder konstruktivt og åbent med nye ideer. Du formår at give og få feedback både af kollegaer og ledere
  8. Har dansk autorisation som jordemoder

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi rigtig gerne høre fra dig – også hvis du bare er nysgerrig og vil ringe og høre mere.

title: Facilities Associate - Cambridge

You're comfortable working independently, using your initiative and responding to changing priorities throughout the day. You'll also be a confident communicator who enjoys helping people and working as part of a collaborative team.

Most importantly, you'll bring a positive attitude, strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining the high standards that Welbeck is known for.

  • Contribute directly to outstanding guest experiences and outcomes

title: Kok / Cater / ufaglært kok søges til The Grill i Bowl'n'Fun Esbjerg
description:
BOWL'N'FUN OG RESTAURANT THE GRILL ESBJERG SØGER NETOP NU EN KOK/CATER/UFAGLÆRT KOK MED ERFARING

Vi søger en engageret, kvalitetsbevidst kok, cater eller ufaglært, der samtidig kan arbejde i et højt tempo. Vil du arbejde inden for køkkenbranchen, og vil du være med til at lave mad til de mange gæster, der dagligt besøger Bowl'n'Fun & The Grill?

Vi er en familierestaurant der stræber efter at levere de bedste buffeter, hvor alle aldersgrupper bliver præsenteret for både livretter, men også nye og spændende tilberedninger. Vi arbejder aktivt med både smag og det visuelle udtryk i vores buffeter.

Vi søger kok / cater / ufaglært kok der er klar på nogle gode og spændende arbejdstimer i køkkenet. Du møder ind omkring middagstid og starter forberedelsen af alle retter til buffeten. Hen på eftermiddagen møder køkkenmedhjælper/buffist ind og hjælper med det sidste, samt få opsat en fantastisk buffet. I løbet af aftenen er det kokkens og buffistens vigtigste opgaver at opretholde den flotte buffet samt lave et ”show” ved den store indendørs grill, hvor alt kød grilles og herefter skæres for overfor gæsten.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et arbejde med stort kollegialt fællesskab
  • Fantastiske personalegoder, der giver dig mulighed for at give dig selv og familien gode oplevelser i alle vores centre i Danmark.

Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

Vi arbejder hver dag med at lave gode gæsteoplevelser lige fra køkkenet til forlystelser, bar og restaurant. Vi er ét stort team der elsker at hjælpe hinanden for netop at levere de bedste gæsteoplevelser.

  • Du har en passion for god madlavning, og trives i et køkken hvor der til tider kan være fart over feltet, men hvor vi samtidig hjælper hinanden for at opnå et fælles mål.

  • Du søger et arbejde hvor stemningen er god og humøret er højt
  • Du trives med at arbejde efter koncept

Køkkenuddannelse er ikke et krav, men selvfølgelig en fordel. Vi kan godt lide at arbejde med medarbejdere der har en passion for det de laver.

Lidt praktiske informationer

  • Der er mulighed for både fuldtid og deltid.
  • Opstart efter aftale. Vi indkalder løbende udvalgte kandidater til samtale, så send din ansøgning allerede idag.

title: Macro Research Analyst
description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

About the role

As a Macro Research Analyst, you will join Binance Research and help shape how the market understands digital assets. You will produce original research across macro, crypto, and industry themes, develop the narratives that frame the market's story week to week, and connect the macro and traditional-finance backdrop to the crypto economy. Your work will reach a global audience under one of the most widely read research brands in crypto, drive media coverage and institutional engagement, and feed the strategic intelligence relied on across the business. You will work closely with the wider research and content teams and build relationships with partners across the industry.

Responsibilities

  • Produce and own institutional-grade research across macro, crypto, and Binance-related themes, developing original ideas, frameworks, and new methodologies, including work that connects the macro and traditional-finance backdrop to the crypto economy.
  • Build rigorous models and clear visualizations from market data, public on-chain data, and other sources to support the team's research and decision-making across the business.
  • Act as a proactive thought leader: stay ahead of market trends, risks, and opportunities, form original views early, and help shape the conversation on the themes that matter to the market and to Binance, from the macro backdrop and market structure to tokenization, DeFi, and institutional adoption.
  • Work with teams across the business to track and align narratives, ensuring their market developments roll up into the team's research, and the team's research in turn feeds Binance's broader narrative and supports their goals.
  • Build the team's external research network and share insights across the industry, amplifying the reach and distribution of research content and strengthening its positioning.


Requirements

  • 3+ years in crypto research or a closely related role, or 5+ years in consulting, venture capital, or traditional finance, such as investment banking, asset management, or capital markets.
  • A deep understanding of macro and markets, and a feel for how the macro and traditional-finance backdrop connects to the crypto economy.
  • A track record of original thinking: forming differentiated views, building new frameworks, and shaping the narratives that set the agenda.
  • Ability to source, clean, and structure large datasets from multiple sources: including market data providers, and proprietary internal data, to produce publication-ready analysis
  • Proficiency in data processing and analysis tools for financial modeling; Python or R for data manipulation and visualisation, and familiarity with SQL or data querying is a plus.
  • Driven and collaborative, with a strong work ethic and the ability to thrive in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field is a plus; CFA is a plus.

Why Binance

  • Shape the future of finance
  • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
  • Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
  • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
  • Competitive salary and company benefits
  • Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

By submitting a job application, you acknowledge that you have read our Candidate Privacy Notice.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Join us as a Health and Wellbeing Officer, responsible for managing all aspects of medicine, first aid, and medical assistance to students and staff. This role is fundamental in creating a safe and healthy environment, demanding meticulous attention to medical protocols, statutory reporting (RIDDOR), and proactive health promotion across the academy.

description:

Part-time - up to 20 hrs per week

  • Assessment: Evaluate student progress and provide feedback to help them improve their

  • Studio Management: Oversee and manage the music production studio, ensuring it has the necessary hardware and software for student learning. Conduct routine inventory checks and review equipment safety protocols.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Perm)
description:
Job Title: Senior AI Engineer

Reports to: Practice Head: Data, AI and Automation

ROLE OVERVIEW


As an AI Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI-driven solutions using advanced language models like GPT-3.5 and GPT-4. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to build applications that solve complex business challenges, optimize model performance, and ensure accuracy through rigorous evaluation metrics. Additionally, you will stay up-to-date with the latest AI advancements and contribute to the continuous improvement of our AI capabilities, while also mentoring junior team members.


TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE

Strong knowledge and extensive experience in:

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining applications powered by LLM models such as OpenAI’s GPT 3.5 or GPT 4 and various other providers.
  • Utilizing orchestration libraries such as Langchain to build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) applications.
  • Working with SQL and Azure SQL databases for data manipulation and retrieval.
  • Implementing and managing vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, and Chroma for retrieval capabilities within applications.


Strong knowledge and understanding of:

  • Advanced retrieval techniques and chunking strategies within RAG applications to improve model efficiency.
  • Evaluating AI models using robust metrics to ensure high accuracy and performance.


BEHAVIOURAL COMEPTENCIES

  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-oriented.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic, and collaborative environment.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and able to adapt to change.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Passion for learning new technologies and staying up to date with the latest trends in data science and machine learning.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and collaboration skills.
  • Shows promising leadership abilities.
  • Strong business acumen.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work independently on complex projects.
  • Design and implement complex predictive models or algorithms to drive business growth and improve customer experiences.
  • Identify patterns and trends in data to drive insights and recommendations for business decisions.
  • Design experiments and A/B testing to validate hypotheses and assess impact of data-driven solutions.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior and intermediate data scientists.
  • Be involved in project management and strategic decision-making.
  • Be involved in data pipeline architecture design and implementation Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, design solutions, and implement models.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.


MINIMUM EXPERIENCE NEEDED TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE

  • A minimum of 5 years of software development experience, with a proven track record of deploying robust applications.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and familiarity with SQL and SQL Databases.
  • Experience with Langchain and its components such as Document Loaders, Text Splitters, Retrievers, Chains & Agents.
  • Experience with vector embeddings either through third-party providers like OpenAI or other open sources embeddings models like Word2Vec.
  • Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, or similar.
  • Understanding of advanced retrieval techniques and chunking strategies within RAG applications is highly desirable.
  • Knowledge of Generative AI evaluation metrics and managing hallucinations.

title: Quant Risk Analyst
description:
Hacksaw Markets is a B2B prediction-market platform that operators can use to offer prediction markets under their own brands. Every operator has a credit line, and every market creates exposure. In this Quant Risk Analyst role you will own the quantitative methods that protect the platform without immobilising more capital than necessary working directly with the Risk desk, Settlement, Operators and operations engineering.

What you will own

  • Own margin and collateral methodology for binary contracts across operators.
  • Build stress tests for correlated outcomes, large market volumes, data failures and counterparty stress.
  • Set and review position limits and accountability levels for market makers with a versioned history.
  • Calibrate the thresholds that determine how many approvals are required before funds move.
  • Turn quantitative methodology into specifications that engineers can implement.

What you bring

  • Quantitative risk experience in an exchange, clearing house, sportsbook or trading firm.
  • Hands-on work with margin, stress testing, collateral or credit.
  • Strong Python or R and SQL skills, plus comfort with probability and correlated binary outcomes.
  • The ability to explain a model to non-quantitative leaders and regulatory stakeholders.
  • Fluent English and strong written documentation.

Why Hacksaw Markets

  • A genuine build-stage mandate with direct influence over product, operating model and culture.
  • An ambitious team supported by established technology, operating experience and long-term capital.
  • The opportunity to help create trusted infrastructure for a category moving rapidly into the mainstream.

Ready to apply?

Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant market, system, product or operational challenge you have owned.

description:
