title: Medarbejdere søges til nyt midlertidigt § 107 botilbud
description:
Nogle arbejdspladser bliver man en del af, andre får man lov til at bygge fra bunden - og den mulighed kan du nu få.

Til januar 2027 åbner Engbo, Egedal Kommunes nye botilbud for unge voksne med autisme og psykiske funktionsnedsættelser. Derfor søger vi 8-10 medarbejdere, som har lyst til at være med helt fra begyndelsen. Her bliver du ikke bare ansat som medarbejder - men som medskaber af en kultur, et fællesskab og en faglig praksis, som skal kendetegne Engbo i mange år frem.

Om Engbo

På Engbo møder vi unge voksne, som ofte har oplevet nederlag, ensomhed, psykiske udfordringer eller vanskeligheder med at finde deres plads i voksenlivet. Fælles for dem er, at de har et udviklingspotentiale. De kommer ikke til Engbo for at blive boende, men for at udvikle sig og blive i stand til at leve et selvstændigt liv i egen bolig.

Vores opgave er derfor at skabe de rammer og læringsmuligheder, der gør dem i stand til på sigt at leve et mere selvstændigt liv i egen bolig.

Det kræver medarbejdere, der kan kombinere faglighed med tålmodighed, struktur med fleksibilitet og støtte med troen på, at mennesker kan mere, end de selv tror.

Hvad bliver din opgave?

Du bliver en vigtig del af beboernes hverdag og udvikling.

Du skal blandt andet støtte dem i at:

  • Skabe struktur og overblik
  • Mestre hverdagens praktiske opgaver
  • Udvikle sociale færdigheder
  • Indgå i uddannelse og beskæftigelse
  • Opbygge fællesskaber og relationer
  • Tage større ansvar for eget liv

Målet er ikke at gøre tingene for beboerne, men at gøre dem i stand til selv at gøre det.

Fagligheden på Engbo

Vi arbejder ud fra et fælles fagligt fundament med afsæt i:

  • Strukturpædagogik
  • Low Arousal
  • Recovery
  • Kognitive tilgange
  • ADL-træning
  • Social færdighedstræning
  • FIT

Fælles for vores metoder er, at vi arbejder målrettet med progression og udvikling, og at vi løbende undersøger, om vores indsats faktisk hjælper borgerne videre.

Hvem søger vi?

Du har en relevant social-, sundheds- eller pædagogfaglig uddannelse.

Måske er du pædagog, ergoterapeut, psykomotorisk terapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent/ hjælper. Det vigtigste er dog ikke din titel.

Det vigtigste er, at du:

  • Er nysgerrig på og kan reflektere over egen praksis, og evner at tilpasse din indsats, hvis ikke den skaber progression
  • Kan bevare roen i komplekse situationer
  • Tror på menneskers udviklingspotentiale
  • Har lyst til at være med til at bygge noget nyt
  • Kan skabe en samarbejdsrelation der gør borgeren i stand til at profitere af den faglige indsats

Derfor skal du vælge Engbo

Hos os får du ikke bare en stilling, du får mulighed for at sætte dit aftryk på et helt nyt tilbud fra første dag. Du bliver en del af et tværfagligt fællesskab med fokus på faglig udvikling, supervision, refleksion og samarbejde. Derudover bliver du en del af et sted, hvor ambitionen er klar: At hjælpe mennesker til at skabe og leve deres eget liv.

Om stillingerne

Vi søger 8-10 medarbejdere til Engbos opstart fordelt på:

2 vågne nattevagter

7 vagter/ 7 fridøgn

Dag- og aftenvagter ligger i et rul i tidsrummet 7-22 alle ugens dage.

Tiltrædelse er pr 1. januar 2027

Vil du vide mere?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, Engbo eller vores faglige tilgang, er du velkommen til at kontakte Mischa Rastad Andersson på mail: Mischa.andersson@egekom.dk eller på tlf. 2343 2847

Ansøgningsfrist: 4. november 2026

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt: 9., 10., 11. november 2026

Vi glæder os til at høre, hvordan du med din faglighed og dine erfaringer kan bidrage til at skabe Engbo sammen med os.

title: Støtte til et barn på 1.5 på vores panda stue
description:
Brænder du for at skabe trygge, udviklende og nærværende rammer for de yngste børn? Har du lyst til at arbejde på en lille, visiteret vuggestuestue med plads til max 7 børn? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en 30 times støtteperson til et barn på 1.5 år som går i vores vuggestue.

Barnet har diabetes hvilket gør at man skal holde styr på barnets blodsukker.

På stuen har de allerede styr på hvordan man forholder sig til barnet, så man behøver ikke at have et forudgående kendskab til diabetes. Du vil blive godt oplært.

På Pandastuen møder du børn med forskellige forudsætninger og behov. Som medarbejder får du en central rolle i at være med til at tilrettelægge, gennemføre og evaluere den pædagogiske praksis, så den understøtter det enkelte barns trivsel, udvikling, læring og deltagelsesmuligheder.

Vi arbejder ud fra et ressourceorienteret og anerkendende børnesyn, hvor vi tager afsæt i barnets nærmeste udviklingszone og tror på, at alle børn gør det bedste, de kan, i de rammer de er en del af.

Du vil helt sikkert for mulighed for:

• Et meningsfuldt job hvor du er med til at gør en forskel

• Et fagligt stærk og støttende team

• Mulighed for læring og udvikling indenfor specialpædagogikken

• En vuggestue med hjerterum, nærvær og fokus på børnenes individuelle behov

Om dig

Vi søger en engageret og omsorgsfuld pædagogmedhjælper til vores pandastue hvor vi arbejder med børn der har brug for en start på institutionslivet i en lille ramme.

Hos os får du mulighed for at være med til at gøre en forskel for de børn der har brug for ekstra støtte i hverdagen

Den primære opgaver vil være:

• At skabe en tryg og stimulerende hverdag for børnene

• At understøtte børnenes udvikling og trivsel i samarbejde med pædagogerne på stuen

• At være medskabende til en hverdag med nærvær og anerkendelse i højsæde

Vi søger en pædagogmedhjælper, der:

• Er tålmodig, omsorgsfuld og engageret

• Har interesse for og muligvis erfaring med børn med særlige behov

• Kan arbejde struktureret og samtidig være fleksibel

• Har gode samarbejdsevner og en positiv tilgang til hverdagen

Om Frederik Clausens vænge

Pandastuen er en del af et børnehus med 98 børn fordelt på to almene vuggestuegrupper, én mindre vuggestuegruppe med særligt fokus på tidlig indsats samt tre børnehavegrupper. Vi er beliggende i naturskønne omgivelser i Holte, hvor naturen er en aktiv del af vores pædagogiske arbejde.

I børnehuset Frederik Clausens vænge tror vi på, at de stærkeste udviklingsmuligheder skabes gennem nærværende relationer, høj faglighed og et blik for barnets ressourcer. Vi arbejder ud fra devisen om at der altid skal være mulighed for til at forme et meningsfuldt læringsmiljø for børn, som har brug for en tryg og specialiseret start på institutionslivet og at vi altid er refflekterende over egne handlinger.

Uddannelse er en selvfølge - ikke et gode

Vi prioriterer at kompetenceudvikle alle vores pædagoger og pædagogmedhjælpere.

Om Rudersdal Kommune

I Rudersdal Kommune tror vi på, at vi kun lykkes i fællesskab. Derfor er det vores mål, at alle kommunens medarbejdere og ledere i alle opgaver - og i fællesskab - arbejder for at skabe bæredygtige løsninger, der giver værdi for borgerne, virksomheden og det samfund, vi er en del af. Se vores film om Rudersdal Kommunes strategi og værdier ”Vi lykkes kun i fællesskab” HER

Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuldtid og start d.1.11.26. Ansættelse sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

Ansøgning, samtale og kontakt

Du søger jobbet ved at klikke på knappen "Søg stilling" nedenfor.

title: Kravledare IT
description:
Om oss På Techrytera AB börjar rekryteringen med dig. Vi är ett bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag med spetskompetens och ett tydligt fokus inom IT och Engineering. Med vår branschkunskap och nära dialog med både kandidater och kunder skapar vi träffsäkra matchningar där rätt kompetens möter rätt behov.

Vi tror att en riktigt bra matchning inte bara handlar om en rollbeskrivning – utan om dina erfarenheter, din potential och vad du faktiskt vill utvecklas inom. Därför utgår vi alltid från individen. Genom att förstå din bakgrund, dina drivkrafter och dina ambitioner kan vi koppla ihop dig med uppdrag och roller hos våra kunder där du får rätt förutsättningar att utvecklas och göra skillnad.

Vårt mål är att bygga långsiktiga och meningsfulla samarbeten – både för dig som kandidat och för våra kunder.

Arbetsbeskrivning Organisationens IT-plattformar behöver genomgå omfattande tekniska, strukturella och processorienterade förändringar för att möta framtida krav på tillgänglighet, säkerhet och kapacitet.

Som kravledare deltar konsulten i ett eller flera IT-projekt inom organisationen. Projekten kan omfatta både egenutveckling och införande av standardsystem och bemannas av verksamhetsspecialister samt interna och externa IT-resurser.

Konsulten ansvarar för att ta fram en plan för kravarbete, leda workshops, samordna kravaktiviteter med projektteamet och rapportera kravhanteringens framdrift till projektledaren.

Organisationen tillämpar en etablerad projektmodell som är anpassad efter verksamhetens behov. Arbetet styrs även av interna riktlinjer, anvisningar och instruktioner. Konsulten ska följa organisationens kravprocess, vilken är dokumenterad inom ramen för dess IT-förvaltnings- och produktionsmodell.

Organisationen har behov av en erfaren kravledare med dokumenterad förmåga att leda kravarbete och med god kommunikativ förmåga. Uppdraget innebär att hålla samman och leda arbetet med att ta fram nya och förändrade verksamhetsprocesser kopplade till nya IT-stöd inom en verksamhetskritisk teknisk division.

Uppdraget avser en resurskonsult som förstärker organisationens löpande verksamhet. Arbetet leds och styrs av organisationen.

Arbetsuppgifter

I uppdraget ingår följande arbetsuppgifter:



Ge metodstöd inom kravhantering till verksamhetsspecialister och kravställare avseende både funktionella och icke-funktionella krav.



Ge metodstöd inom kravhantering till projektgruppen.



Planera och leda kravworkshops samt säkerställa enhetlig dokumentation av resultatet.



Säkerställa att kraven kommuniceras och förankras hos och mellan berörda kravställare.



Samordna krav och samverka med verksamhetsarkitekter, IT-arkitekter, förändringsledare och övriga medlemmar i projektteamet.



Säkerställa att kraven är formulerade på ett testbart och, i förekommande fall, upphandlingsmässigt korrekt sätt.



Säkerställa att kravuppfyllnaden kan verifieras genom testfall som tas fram i samarbete med testledare.



Ta fram digitalt utbildningsmaterial för berörda förändrade processer.



Bidra till vidareutveckling av kravprocesser och kravstrategier i samarbete med andra krav- och testledare inom organisationen.

För mer utförlig information om uppdragets omfattning, förutsättningar och konsultkrav hänvisas till tillhörande underlag.

Uppdragsperiod



Preliminärt startdatum: 2027-01-01



Slutdatum: 2027-12-31



Förlängningsoption: Uppdragsgivaren har rätt att förlänga avtalet med upp till ett år, som längst till och med 2028-12-31.

Ska-krav

Konsulten ska uppfylla följande krav:



Erfarenhet av kravanalys och kvalitetssäkring: Minst 10 års arbetslivserfarenhet av kravanalys eller kvalitetssäkring inom IT-projekt, varav minst 8 år med funktionella och icke-funktionella krav i rollen som kravledare och/eller kravanalytiker.



Workshopledning: Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av att leda workshops för kravinsamling.



Kravhanteringsverktyg: Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av minst ett av följande verktyg: Azure DevOps, Jira, ReqView eller motsvarande.



Processer och arbetsflöden: Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av att ta fram och dokumentera arbetsflöden och processer vid IT-förändringar, exempelvis enligt Astrakanmetoden eller motsvarande.



Energibranschen: Minst 2 års arbetslivserfarenhet av kravställning och digitaliseringsfrågor inom anläggningsinformation för energibranschen.



IT-förvaltning: Minst 1 års arbetslivserfarenhet av PM3 inom IT-förvaltning.



Certifiering: Certifiering enligt IREB och/eller REQB. Certifieringen ska kunna bifogas anbudet.

Meriterande krav

Det är meriterande om konsulten har:



Offentlig sektor: Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av kravställning inför upphandling inom offentlig sektor.



Säkerhetsklassad verksamhet: Minst 1 års arbetslivserfarenhet från verksamhet med hög skyddsklass och säkerhetsklassad information.



Processmodellering: Intyg eller certifiering inom processmodellering enligt Astrakan.



Verksamhetsutveckling: Intyg eller certifiering inom verksamhetsutveckling enligt Astrakan.



Scrum Master: Certifiering som Scrum Master.



E-utbildning: Erfarenhet av att ta fram e-utbildningar för nya arbetsprocesser i minst 2 projekt.

Ansökan När du söker via Techrytera AB söker du inte bara ett jobb – du påbörjar en dialog om din fortsatta karriär. Vi vill lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och dina ambitioner för att kunna matcha dig med rätt möjligheter hos våra kunder.

Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan eller hör av dig till oss så berättar vi mer. Vi ser fram emot att hitta nästa steg i din karriär tillsammans med dig.

title: Laboratorieassistent søges til spændende kvalitetsopgaver
description:
På vegne af AB Neo søger vi en omhyggelig og ansvarsbevidst laboratorieassistent til et vikariat på 1-4 måneder.

Om jobbet

Du bliver en del af kvalitetsarbejdet og får en varieret hverdag med både praktiske laboratorieopgaver, prøvehåndtering og administrative opgaver. Du refererer til Quality Manager og har et tæt samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af virksomheden.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Udføre analyser og kvalitetskontrol af råvarer og færdigvarer.

  • Modtage, kontrollere og mærke råvarer samt tjekke tilhørende dokumentation.

  • Registrere varemodtagelser og analysedata.

  • Kontrollere nye råvarer og følge op på eventuelle afvigelser.

  • Håndtere prøver, holdbarhedstest og eksportdokumentation.

  • Udarbejde analysecertifikater til kunder og logistik.

  • Sørge for orden og rengøring i laboratoriet.

Hvem er du?

Du arbejder grundigt og struktureret og har øje for detaljerne. Du trives med opgaver, hvor præcision og korrekt dokumentation er vigtigt, og du tager ansvar for at få dine opgaver afsluttet.

Derudover lægges der vægt på, at du:

  • Arbejder systematisk og har en god ordenssans.

  • Trives med både praktiske og administrative opgaver.

  • Er samarbejdsorienteret og har en positiv tilgang til hverdagen.

  • Har grundlæggende IT-kundskaber.

  • Behersker dansk og kan læse og forstå dokumentation på engelsk.

Det er et krav, at du har erfaring med laboratoriearbejde og kvalitetskontrol. En laboratoriefaglig baggrund er en fordel, og vi lægger vægt på, at du er omhyggelig og har en god forståelse for kvalitet.

Hvad tilbyder AB Neo?

Du bliver en del af en mindre virksomhed med engagerede kolleger, korte beslutningsveje og et godt fagligt fællesskab.

Derudover får du:

  • En alsidig hverdag med forskellige opgaver og ansvar.

  • Et tæt samarbejde med kollegaer på tværs af virksomheden.

  • Mulighed for at opbygge erfaring med laboratoriearbejde og kvalitetskontrol.

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på kvalitet, innovation og samarbejde.

Praktisk information

  • Ansættelse: Vikariat på 1-4 måneder.

  • Løn: Efter kvalifikationer.

Søg jobbet

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Har ovenstående fanget din interesse, søger du stillingen ved at vedhæfte et opdateret CV og en motiveret ansøgning. Du kan også skrive en kort tekst om dig selv i ansøgningsteksten ovenfor.

Temp-Team A/S varetager denne rekruttering, og al henvendelse skal gå gennem Temp-Team.

Grundet GDPR modtager vi ikke CV og ansøgning via e-mail.

Temp-Team

Temp-Team A/S er et landsdækkende rekrutterings- og bemandingsbureau. Vi har mere end 45 års erfaring inden for rekruttering til faste jobs og vikarløsninger og dækker et bredt udsnit af brancher. Vi har fokus på høj kvalitet og tæt, personlig kontakt til både kandidater og kunder.

Vi er en del af JuhlerGroup – en international koncern.

title: Data Engineer | Azure & Databricks [Remoto - Brasil]
description:
A DBServices é uma empresa que possui raízes profundas tanto em Portugal quanto no Brasil, refletindo uma ligação sólida entre os dois países.
Em constante crescimento, a DBServices destaca-se por atender grandes empresas em Portugal, nos Estados Unidos e no Brasil, consolidando sua presença internacional e ampliando seu impacto no mercado global.

Estamos buscando um(a) Data Engineer para atuar em um projeto global de dados na área de Procurement, apoiando a evolução de um Data Lake corporativo. O objetivo é ampliar a cobertura das fontes e dos dados disponíveis, reduzir tratamentos manuais e garantir integrações confiáveis, com dados harmonizados entre operações de diferentes países e continentes. Você será responsável pelas entregas back-end até produção, com autonomia técnica e seguindo padrões e regras de negócio definidos em conjunto com as áreas envolvidas.

Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto
Idioma: inglês fluente

Atividades

  • Levantar requisitos de dados junto à área de negócio e aos times responsáveis pelas fontes, traduzindo regras funcionais em especificações técnicas
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações via APIs, conectores e mecanismos de extração, respeitando permissões, limitações das fontes e padrões corporativos
  • Investigar lacunas em extrações e queries existentes, incorporando novas colunas e entidades da origem até as camadas de consumo
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines ETL/ELT e workflows automatizados, com dependências, agendamentos, cargas incrementais e reprocessamento seguro
  • Desenvolver notebooks e scripts em SQL, Python e PySpark em ambiente Azure e Databricks
  • Implementar arquitetura medallion (Bronze, Silver e Gold), criando e otimizando tabelas e views Gold com regras de negócio documentadas
  • Manter um modelo canônico global, harmonizando nomenclaturas, tipos, datas, fusos horários, moedas, unidades de medida e cadastros, preservando o vínculo com os dados de origem
  • Implementar controles de qualidade, reconciliação com as fontes, tratamento de duplicidades, integridade referencial e gestão de alterações de schema
  • Versionar código no Azure DevOps e apoiar code review, testes e esteiras CI/CD entre ambientes
  • Monitorar execuções, falhas e desempenho dos pipelines, com logs, alertas e rotinas de recuperação, otimizando processamento e custos
  • Documentar integrações, mapeamentos origem-destino, dicionário de dados, linhagem e procedimentos operacionais

Requisitos

  • SQL avançado: joins, CTEs, subqueries, funções de janela, agregações e otimização de consultas
  • Python e PySpark para processamento distribuído, automações e notebooks, com código modular, testável e documentado
  • Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics e Databricks
  • Azure DevOps e Git para versionamento, code review e automação de testes e deploys
  • Integração com APIs REST: autenticação, paginação, tratamento de erros, limites de requisição e cargas incrementais
  • Modelagem relacional e analítica (granularidade, chaves e relacionamentos), ETL/ELT e arquitetura Data Lake/Lakehouse em camadas
  • Harmonização de dados entre sistemas e regiões, mapeamento origem-destino, modelo canônico e dicionário de dados
  • Qualidade e governança de dados, rastreabilidade e boas práticas de acesso seguro e gestão de credenciais
  • Inglês fluente para interação técnica e documentação

Diferenciais

  • Integração com ERPs e plataformas corporativas, como SAP ECC/S/4HANA, Microsoft Dynamics 365, ServiceNow ou Coupa
  • Conhecimento de dados de procurement: fornecedores, requisições, pedidos de compra, contratos, sourcing, condições de pagamento e savings
  • Delta Lake, CDC, evolução de schema e otimização de processamento em Spark
  • Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Key Vault e soluções de catálogo e linhagem de dados
  • Experiência em projetos globais
  • Espanhol
  • Práticas de DataOps e metodologias ágeis

Na DBSPT você encontrará:

  • Ambiente Colaborativo: Valorizamos o senso de comunidade, onde as ideias são compartilhadas e as conquistas celebradas em equipe.
  • Trabalhe de qualquer lugar: Aproveite a liberdade e a flexibilidade para trabalhar onde se sentir mais produtivo e confortável.
  • Conexão Global: Você terá a oportunidade de interagir com pessoas de diferentes países e culturas, expandindo sua rede de contatos e visão de mundo.
  • Apoio à Saúde Física: Por meio do Totalpass e Mediquo, oferecemos recursos e programas focados no seu bem-estar físico.
  • Cuidado com a Saúde Mental: O Team Care disponibiliza iniciativas e ações para apoiar seu equilíbrio emocional e mental no dia a dia.

Why DBServices?

At DBServices, we design, develop, and support cutting-edge digital platforms that drive innovation for leading companies across IT, Banking, Retail, Government, Healthcare, and other industries in Europe and the Americas. Our expertise empowers businesses to grow, adapt, and lead in dynamic markets.

Trusted by industry leaders like Worten, Sonae, Edenred, Natixis, Farfetch, Glintt, Efacec, Segurança Social, and McDonald's, we deliver solutions that make a real impact.

Join us and be part of a global team that's shaping the future of digital transformation.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineers at Thoughtworks build, maintain and test the architecture and infrastructure for managing machine learning applications. They are involved in supporting and contributing to the design of the end-to-end applications and products. They are responsible for building core capabilities including technical and functional machine learning systems and applications, being the anchor for functional streams of work and are accountable for timely delivery.

As a senior machine learning engineer, you will work on the latest tools, frameworks and offerings while also being involved in enabling credible and collaborative problem solving to execute on a strategy.

Due to the nature of the projects and specific client security clearance, this role requires the successful candidate to be a Singapore Citizen or PR of Singapore.

Job responsibilities

  • You will contribute to design and drive the development of robust scalable architectures and infrastructure for deploying and managing machine learning (ML) applications, ensuring high availability, performance and security
  • You will collaborate with data scientists and engineers to translate business needs into effective and efficient ML systems and applications
  • You will own the development and maintenance of core functionalities within ML applications, including ML pipelines, model training and deployment, and monitoring and evaluation
  • You will drive the functional stream of work by providing technical expertise, handling team discussions and ensuring timely delivery of assigned tasks
  • You will stay ahead of the curve by actively exploring and implementing the latest tools, frameworks and offerings in the ML landscape
  • You will facilitate collaborative problem solving within the team by actively listening, communicating effectively and mentoring other engineers
  • You will contribute to the development and execution of the team's overall ML strategy, aligning technical capabilities with business objectives
  • You will proactively identify and address challenges related to ML systems and applications, proposing solutions and implementing improvements

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

  • You have experience in writing clean, maintainable and testable code, demonstrating attention to refactoring and readability of the code
  • You are proficient in scripting languages such as Python or Shell for automation and task streamlining
  • You have knowledge of distributed systems and scalable architectures to handle large-scale ML applications
  • You have experience with building, deploying, and maintaining ML systems using relevant ML techniques and platforms, i.e.: Scikit-learn, Tensorflow, MLFlow, Kubeflow, Pytorch
  • You have experience with building, deploying and maintaining ML systems and experience with application of MLOps principles and CI/CD to ML
  • You have experience in machine learning engineering and data science, are familiar with key ML concepts, algorithms and frameworks, and understand ML model lifecycles
  • You have experience with designing and operating the infrastructure required to run different types of ML training and serving workloads, i.e.: on-premise vs. cloud infrastructure, infrastructure as code, monitoring, etc.
  • You have hands-on experience with on-premise and cloud services for building and deploying ML pipelines, i.e.: Azure, AWS, GCP or Databricks and associated ML managed services

Professional Skills

  • You understand the importance of stakeholder management and can easily liaise between clients and other key stakeholders throughout projects, ensuring buy-in and gaining trust along the way
  • You are resilient in ambiguous situations and can adapt your role to approach challenges from multiple perspectives
  • You don’t shy away from risks or conflicts, instead you take them on and skillfully manage them
  • You are eager to coach, mentor and motivate others and you aspire to influence teammates to take positive action and accountability for their work
  • You enjoy influencing others and always advocate for technical excellence while being open to change when needed

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment

At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.

Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.

We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment.

About Thoughtworks

Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.

title: Pre-Sales Solutions Architect
location: Bristol, England, United Kingdom; London, England, United Kingdom
description:
Job title: Pre-Sales Solutions Architect

Location: London / Bristol - Hybrid

Salary: £94,000 - £117,000

Team: Commercial

Reporting To: Head of Client Solutions

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.


Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners.

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What will I be doing?

As a Pre-Sales Solution Architect, you’ll sit at the intersection of technology and commercial strategy, shaping how prospective clients understand, adopt, and succeed with the Kaluza platform.

Working closely with Pre-Sales Consultants, you’ll lead the technical aspects of sales engagements — from running deep-dive sessions on architecture and data models, through solution design, to handing off to implementation teams during the contracting phase. Your primary focus will be designing each client’s “to-be” architecture and defining integration patterns, ensuring solutions meet business requirements while making the best use of Kaluza’s current and planned capabilities.

No two engagements are the same. You may support early-stage prototypes, present at client sites, or advise our Product Architecture team on emerging market needs and common integration patterns. This is a varied, high-impact role that will stretch your technical expertise, client management skills, and platform knowledge in equal measure.


Your key responsibilities will include:

Discovery & Solution Design:

  • Lead discovery workshops to understand current and target technical architectures
  • Translate complex requirements into solution designs that maximise client value and enable successful implementation
  • Develop a deep understanding of each client’s technical landscape and transformation goals to design optimal “to-be” architectures
  • Estimate work packages to set implementation programmes up for success

Tender & Proposal Excellence:

  • Collaborate with product and technology teams to evolve base solution architectures and deliver compelling technical presentations
  • Provide key technical input into tender responses and customer proposals
  • Partner with Pre-Sales Engineering to shape and design proof-of-concept exercises
  • Travel to client sites across the UK, Europe, and beyond as required

Product Advocacy:

  • Act as a bridge between market demand and Kaluza’s engineering teams, ensuring client needs are reflected in the roadmap
  • Ensure proposed solutions align with core platform capabilities and strategic direction

Measurable Outcomes:

  • Advise clients on achieving measurable business outcomes through a data-driven approach
  • Support commercial conversations by helping quantify the value of the platform


About You

You’re a technologist with a strong focus on business outcomes who thrives at the intersection of strategy and execution. You’re comfortable running deep technical sessions with architects while also articulating a clear strategic vision to C-suite stakeholders.

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Enterprise SaaS Experience: Proven experience delivering complex enterprise software implementations
  • Exceptional Communicator: Able to distil complex concepts into clear, persuasive messages for a wide range of stakeholders
  • Technical Experience: Experience building and architecting systems, including some of:
    • Architecting solutions on AWS
    • Finance and billing platforms
    • API technologies such as GraphQL and webhooks
  • Customer-Centric & Analytical: Focused on solving the right problems and using data to measure success
  • Agile & Autonomous: Comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced, evolving environment while managing multiple workstreams
  • Industry Expertise: Experience working within regulated energy retailers, particularly across billing, metering, and settlements systems
  • Mission-Driven: Motivated by the role technology plays in the global energy transition

What will set you apart:

  • Enterprise SaaS Background: Experience architecting SaaS solutions in the energy industry
  • Architectural Experience: Experience designing large-scale, impactful software systems
  • Energy Retail Experience: Experience working with or for a large energy retailer


Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.


Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.


From us you’ll get

  • Pension Scheme
  • Discretionary Bonus Scheme
  • Private Medical Insurance + Virtual GP
  • Life Assurance
  • Access to Furthr - a Climate Action app
  • Free Mortgage Advice and Eye Tests
  • Perks at Work - access to thousands of retail discounts
  • 5% Flex Fund to spend on the benefits you want most
  • 26 days holiday
  • Flexible bank holidays, giving you an additional 8 days which you can choose to take whenever you like
  • Progressive leave policies with no qualifying service periods, including 26 weeks full pay if you have a new addition to your family
  • Dedicated personal learning and home office budgets
  • Flexible working — we trust you to work in a way that suits your lifestyle
  • And more…

Even better? You’ll have access to these benefits from day 1 when you join.


We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working at Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn.

You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.

title: Assistant Supervisor, South Shore Plaza - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Assistant Supervisor will be responsible for prioritizing the customer experience through active supervision and enhancing the service culture. As part of the Store Leadership Team, you will have a key role in communicating expectations and priorities to associates. You will help create a fun and engaging store environment for customers and associates. As an advocate for the customer, you will role model and provide fast feedback on how to make every customer experience optimal. You will be an expert in satisfying the customer and driving results through promotional and Omni selling initiatives. This position leads to Sales and Customer Experience Manager or Operations and Visual Merchandising Manager.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

What You Will Do

  • Provide Active Supervision by continually circulating the selling floor, directing and redirecting colleagues while supporting daily leadership priorities to optimize the customer experience and support sales volume.
  • Manager customer service issues to completion
  • Manager customer flow throughout the building on high traffic days and reassign resources as needed
  • Lead store activities to ensure customer readiness and exceptional presentation standards.
    • Alert Sales and Customer Experience Manager or Operations and Visual Merchandising Manager of any opportunities that are not aligned with this goal.
  • Role model ability to build lasting customer relationships ― provide colleagues with fast-feedback and redirection to foster the same behaviors, and recognize colleagues for practicing them
  • Execute store opening and closing procedures; access to alarm systems and keys
  • Manage workload reports; lead a process if necessary
  • Help build a proactive and solution-oriented customer centric culture in the store to ensure consistent customer experiences
  • Meet with Sales and Customer Experience Manager or the Operations and Visual Merchandising Manager sales floor activities or support activities to monitor
  • Oversee colleague execution and completion of daily Fulfillment responsibilities
  • Provide feedback and contribute observations via SCX and OVM at colleague quarterly check-in
  • Have practical knowledge of store systems ― POS, MPOS, RF equipment, MyClient, MyStore App ― and ability to educate others
  • Assist colleagues with timekeeping issues (ex. clocking corrections, paid time off requests, etc.)
  • Assist Colleague Support in resolving employee relations issues
  • Regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities

Who You Are

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required
  • 1-2 years related experience
  • Strong interpersonal skills with proven ability to communicate and share information with diverse groups of customers and peers
  • Resourceful self-starter, works well independently as well as part of a team, and able to adapt quickly to changing priorities
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule with retail hours, including day, evening, weekends, and/or holidays

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • Prolonged periods (at least two consecutive hours) of standing/walking around the store or department
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology necessary to perform job duties, including handheld electronic equipment
  • Frequently lift/move up to 50lbs.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Project Officer, WINGS
description:
Location: Kolkata,West Bengal,India

Title: Project Officer, WINGS

Location: Kolkata

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer

Employment Status: Full Time

Last update: 15th October 2026

Trickle Up has been enabling extremely poor people to build resilient livelihoods and emerge from the cycle of poverty adopting graduation approach. We target those who are most socioeconomically excluded across Asia, Africa, and the Americas- women, youth, people with disabilities, indigenous people, refugees, and other vulnerable groups who live beyond the reach of most social services and development programs. We drive large-scale change for these populations by partnering with governments, global institutions, and local organizations. In FY19, we reached 170,000 people across 19 countries. We have been registered and operating in India since 2005; our current footprint is focused on Jharkhand and Odisha States, where we reached 129,000 people in FY19. Reporting to the CEO, the Project Officer leads Trickle Up’s efforts within a priority state to scale Trickle Up’s evidence-based approach to graduating people out of ultra-poverty and contribute to Trickle Up’s continuous programme innovation efforts. We are seeking a highly motivated development professional with significant expertise in livelihood development for vulnerable populations, government partnerships, and training and managing partners.

This is an excellent opportunity for the right individual, who is energetic, motivated and desires to expand his/ her skills and expertise in Program Management in the NGO sector working with the poorest of the poor. Trickle Up provides professional growth opportunities for qualified professionals who are seeking to develop and broaden their technical and management skills and who will be working with a highly dynamic, fast-paced and energetic team.

Position Overview:

Principal functions

Program Implementation:

· Lead implementation of programs in the slums of Kolkata to scale Trickle Up’s approach to graduating vulnerable populations out of ultra-poverty.

· Manage the successful execution of a multi-stakeholder projects in compliance with requirements, regulations, and good practices.

· Provide handholding support to women slum dwellers to come up with individual and group micro businesses.

· Ensure market linkage for the individual and group businesses.

· Contribute to the development of monitoring and evaluation systems..

· Regularly communicate program progress, results, and lessons learned to colleagues, partner organizations, and donors to support organizational learning and external representation.

· convergence with government departments to facilitate working of the women enterprise and its sustainability.

Partnerships for quality programming:

· Explore possibilities of partnership with skill training institutions for skill building of women slum dwellers.

· Build the visibility of Trickle Up and identify new opportunities for partnership through representation in technical forums, working groups, and other forums.

· The program officer shall also be accountable for the IEC and Communication plan compliance for individual donors and Trickle Up in the intervention areas.

· Advise key stakeholders on good practices for graduating people out of ultra-poverty.

· Support the work of Trickle Up’s alliance of grassroots partner organizations through training and ongoing coaching to build the capacity of partner employees to plan, manage, execute, and learn from programs.

Program Innovation:

· Contribute to the design of innovative, evidence-based programs that enable people to graduate out of ultra-poverty and contribute to the sector’s knowledge base.

· Contribute to the development of research objectives and partnerships to produce rigorous, actionable research for Trickle Up and strategic partners.

· Utilize monitoring and evaluation data and lessons learned to inform adaptive management of programs.

Training and Capacity Building:

· Develop training modules and implement and lead the capacity-building of individual and group entrepreneurs

· Build coaching models across programs and monitor the progress of project participants based on the coaching provided on all aspect including skills building

· Support development of training and knowledge tools for improvising coaching in the intervention community with focus on areas of WaSH, functional literacyand other indicators followed by Trickle Up for well being of life.

· Building capacity of participants on mobile technology integration, accessing government schemes, and market information.

Market Assessment & Value Chain Analysis

· Organise and manage the market assessment & value chain analysis conducted by third party and providing necessary information to the consultant.

· Coordination & Communication between Trickle Up team and consultant in order to conduct the assessment and analysis.

· Organise meeting with SMT of Trickle Up to update the progress of the same.

· Implementation of recommendation provided by the consultant and accordingly identify the skills set needs to be developed by participants

Budget Management

· Ensure effective and timely monitoring and appropriate expenditure of project budget.

· Ensure budgets cover costs, including M&E, admin, overhead, and communications

· Ensure Budget is managed appropriately. Expenses are coded and spent on time and correctly

Staff Management

· Ensure that all direct reports have clear roles and responsibilities and are held accountable for delivering results

· Ensure direct reports have support and tools they need to effectively do their jobs well

· Recruit, train and support staff

M&E Management

· In coordination with the MERL Lead, ensure that projects properly collect and analyze data in a timely manner

Reporting, donor compliance and Learning initiatives:

· The Project officer shall be the first node of data management and reporting as per the agreed Monitoring & Evaluation timeline of the program.

· The Project officer shall be responsible to support the rolling out of the learning initiatives agreed in the program and also provide feedback on the system at regular interval of time as agreed in the M & E timeline for the program.

Qualifications

Academic:

  • Post-graduation or equivalent in Social Work/Sociology/Rural Development

Working Experience:

· Demonstrated 7 years Program Management experience at field level working with field-based staff to ensure timely and quality program facilitation for international NGO;

· Overall experience managing livelihood ( Women lead micro enterprises) and/or gender focused programs working in partnership with local NGOs and/or CBOs.

· Experience working in partnership with government and state/national level entities (e.g. NRLM)

· Proven experience of handling projects involving linkages with market, industries, NGOs, National/State/ local organizations and government;

Others:

· Deep commitment to Trickle Up’s core values and ability to model those values in relationships with colleagues and partners.

· Prior experience working in teams in a leadership role.

· Prior experience working in Odisha

· Experience with training highly desirable.

· Ability to travel frequently within the country.

· Ability to prioritize, organize and carry out multiple tasks efficiently under pressure and with little supervision; ability to accept supervision.

Knowledge and skills

• Strong writing and verbal skills in English, Bengali and exemplary communication skills.

• Skills in data analysis (quantitative and qualitative), and ensuring data quality, integrity and efficiency of collection.

• Skills in designing and implementing monitoring and evaluation systems, and distilling findings and learning for a range of audiences.

• Knowledge of digital approaches of program monitoring and evaluation.

Behavioral competencies

• Strong attention to detail

• Able to prioritize, manage multiple tasks, and consistently meet deadlines

• Works well both independently and as a member of a team

• Optimistic, creative, and solutions-oriented; tackles challenges with maturity and accountability

• Superb people skills and diplomatic demeanor

• Understands the challenges and opportunities of working in a small nonprofit setting

• Demonstrated commitment to mission-driven work

TRAVEL Requirements

Must be able to travel domestically at least 50% of the time to remote areas, at short notice.

Salary and Benefits:

· Commensurate with qualifications and experience

To Apply:

• To be considered, all candidates must fulfill the above prerequisites, provide a complete CV, covering letter referencing the required functions, skills and experience, and a writing sample, preferably a sole authored piece related to research or evaluation. Incomplete application will not be accepted.

Web Link :

Applications will be considered on a rolling basis until 31st Oct 2026. We are sorry that we are unable to entertain phone calls related to this posting. Trickle Up India Foundation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce and extend equal opportunity to all applicants and employees regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability, or any other status protected by law.

title: Human Resource Business Partner - UK
description:
Why Join Us Now
This is an exciting time to join Gresham’s People & Culture team. As a private equity-backed business that has grown through a series of mergers and acquisitions, we are now bringing our people, processes and practices together under our One Gresham programme.
You will play a hands-on role in that journey: harmonising people policies and ways of working across previously separate organisations, supporting organisational design work, and helping to build a single, consistent employee experience. If you thrive on pace, change and the opportunity to shape how an organisation works, this role offers genuine scope to make a visible impact while working as a business partner to support our teams and Gresham meet their goals.

Job Purpose
The People & Culture Business Partner is an integral part of the People & Culture team, working in partnership with global, functional teams to deliver high-quality, commercially focused and legally compliant people support.
This role provides end-to-end generalist HR support across the employee lifecycle, combining strong operational delivery with trusted advisory support to people managers and stakeholders. You will play a key role in enabling the business to deliver its objectives by embedding effective people practices, supporting organisational change and post-acquisition integration, and ensuring a consistent, positive employee experience across One Gresham.
As a trusted partner, you will provide specialist coaching, guidance and influence to managers, maintaining excellent standards across core HR activity while contributing to the harmonisation and continuous improvement of people processes and ways of working.
Key Responsibilities
  • Provide comprehensive business-as-usual HR support to people managers and stakeholders through the practical application of people policies, procedures and initiatives.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to managers, offering pragmatic and commercially sound guidance on performance management, conduct, absence, wellbeing and employee relations matters.
  • Contribute to the One Gresham programme, supporting the harmonisation of people policies, terms and conditions, processes and practices across acquired businesses.
  • Provide advisory and hands-on support on organisational design and change management activity, including restructures, role changes, consultation and resourcing decisions.
  • Support and coach people managers through organisational change, ensuring a consistent, fair and engaging employee experience.
  • Partner with managers to manage employee relations cases effectively, building confidence and capability in people management.
  • Support managers with short-, medium- and long-term resourcing needs, including recruitment, role design, workforce planning and succession planning.
  • Assist with recruitment, selection, onboarding and development activity to ensure high-quality hiring and effective integration of new starters.
  • In conjunction with Reward and Benefits colleagues, support the delivery of reward, pay review and recognition processes.
  • Maintain accurate people data, records and documentation, ensuring compliance, data integrity and consistency across HR systems and processes.
  • Work collaboratively across the People & Culture team to share knowledge, ensure smooth handovers and maintain operational excellence.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency and quality within core HR processes and the employee experience.
Key Skills and Experience
Essential
  • Full CIPD qualification or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Significant experience delivering generalist HR support in a commercial environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of UK employment law and HR best practice.
  • Experience supporting organisational change, such as restructures, consultation or organisational design.
  • Proven ability to manage day-to-day HR operations independently and at pace.
  • Commercially minded, with the ability to identify risks and implement practical solutions.
  • Confident using HR systems and analysing people data to inform decision-making.
Desirable
  • Experience in a private equity-backed or investor-led environment.
  • Experience of mergers, acquisitions or post-acquisition integration, including harmonisation of terms and conditions or TUPE.
  • International HR exposure, Netherlands, US and APAC.
Attributes
  • Able to build strong working relationships and credibility at all levels of the organisation.
  • Highly customer-focused, with a pragmatic, solutions-driven approach.
  • Strong emotional intelligence, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively.
  • Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Proactive, adaptable and energised by working in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Self-motivated, able to work autonomously while collaborating effectively with the wider team.
Key Stakeholders
  • Chief People Officer
  • Executive Leadership Team
  • Senior Leadership Team
  • People managers
  • Employees
  • People & Culture team
  • Third-party suppliers and external partners

title: Erfaren Konstruktionsingeniør til ISC i Kalundborg
description:
Er du konstruktionsingeniør og har solid erfaring med projektorienteret arbejde? Trives du med at arbejde med konstruktioner indenfor både byggeri, infrastruktur og industri? Ønsker du at bringe dine evner i spil i en familieejet virksomhed, hvor vi arbejder på tværs som én helhed?

Så søger vi dig og dine kompetencer på vores kontor i Kalundborg, der især er beskæftiget med byggeri til industrien på Vestsjælland.

Fagligt fællesskab og forskelligartede opgaver

Du kommer til at indgå i et mindre team, som er en kombination af både nyuddannede og kollegaer, der har høj anciennitet. Du vil blive en del af en afdeling, der især fokuserer på at levere høj kvalitet og faglig sparring og derudover vil du indgå i et tværfagligt samarbejde med vores syv geografisk spredte afdelinger i Danmark, hvor du vil opleve at få en stor berøringsflade i organisationen.

Vores projekter spænder bredt inden for byggeri, industri og infrastruktur, og du vil få rig mulighed for at beskæftige dig med forskelligartede opgaver.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Vi søger en kompetent ingeniør til projektering af både træ-, beton- og stålkonstruktioner, og vi ser dig i rollen som bygværksprojekterende eller afsnitsprojekterende.

Dine daglige arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Beregninger af konstruktioner, herunder også geotekniske konstruktioner.
  • Design af samlingsdetaljer.
  • Udarbejdelse af statisk dokumentation.

Vi arbejder projektorienteret, og arbejdet udføres i tæt samarbejde i projektgrupper, hvor vi samarbejder med ingeniører fra andre faggrupper samt kunden. Du vil have mulighed for at udvikle dig til fagleder eller projektleder, hvis dette er et ønske.

Dine kvalifikationer

For at få succes i denne rolle, skal du komme med en god erfaring som konstruktionsingeniør og trives med projektorienteret arbejde. Du skal have evnen til at organisere og håndtere flere opgaver med forskellige deadlines samtidigt, mens du sikrer fremdrift i projekterne.

Det er også vigtigt, at du har gode samarbejdsevner og værdsætter at arbejde tæt sammen som et team, hvor vi skaber de gode resultater gennem vidensdeling og en proaktiv tilgang til projekter.

Vi forventer, at:

  • Du er uddannet ingeniør med speciale indenfor bærende konstruktioner (diplom eller civil).
  • Du har flereårig erhvervserfaring som rådgiver.
  • Du har god statisk forståelse og har kendskab til udformning af statisk dokumentation jf. SBi 271.
  • Du har gode skriftlige og mundtlige formuleringsevner på dansk.

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis:

  • Du har erfaring som bygværksprojekterende.
  • Du har erfaring med programmerne Matchcad, Autodesk ROBOT eller Revit
  • Du har projektledererfaring eller lignende.

Tryg arbejdsplads med højt til loftet

Hos ISC får du en fantastisk mulighed for at fordybe dig i spændende projekter samt at videreudvikle dine kompetencer. Vi gør en dyd ud af at passe godt på vores medarbejdere, så alle har de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle deres faglige kunnen. Derfor står alle vores dygtige og erfarne ingeniører og bygningskonstruktører klar til både at lære fra sig og lade sig inspirere af netop dine ideer og input.

Derudover kan du se frem til:

  • Betalt sundhedsforsikring og sundhedspakke
  • Flekstidsordning
  • Firmapensionsordning
  • Løn efter kvalifikationer
Kend os på bygbare projekter med gennemtænkte løsninger

ISC er en familieejet ingeniørvirksomhed, hvor viden, relationer og rådgivning er kernen i alt, vi gør. Vi værdsætter en hverdag, hvor vi bliver fagligt udfordret og bliver klogere sammen i et stærkt fagligt fællesskab. Vores organisationsstruktur er karakteriseret ved, at vi er en fleksibel størrelse, hvor der er plads til dialog på tværs.

Det er en værdi for ISC at levere bygbare projekter med gennemtænkte løsninger, og vi arbejder sammen på tværs af firmaets syv kontorer for at kunne det.

Vores faglige kompetencer gør os til en foretrukken rådgiver indenfor sektorer som vedvarende energi, olie & gas, byggeri & anlæg, industri samt infrastruktur.

Du vil derfor blive en del af en veletableret organisation, der har eksisteret siden 1967 - hvor holdånd i hverdagen og en professionel indstilling er afgørende for, at vi kan levere den kvalitet, vi er stolte af.

Lyder det som en stilling for dig?

Send os din ansøgning allerede i dag. Vi ser frem til at læse din ansøgning og lære dig og bedre at kende.

Vi behandler din ansøgning med omhu og giver dig en tilbagemelding, så snart vi har vurderet alle kandidater.

Din person og erfaring er unik, og vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge stillingen.

title: Systemingenjör inom mekanik och akustik
description:
Om jobbet

Vill du arbeta med tekniska systemlösningar inom mekanik och akustik? Vi söker en systemingenjör till ett långsiktigt uppdrag hos vår kund i Finspång.

Du arbetar med projektspecifik design av akustiska kapslingar, luftintag och avgassystem. Rollen omfattar tekniska specifikationer, leverantörsdialog och konstruktionsgranskningar samt stöd vid installation och driftsättning.

Arbetsuppgifter

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:

  • Utforma och anpassa systemlösningar för akustiska kapslingar, luftintag och avgassystem utifrån projektens krav.

  • Ta fram och arbeta med tekniska specifikationer.

  • Föra teknisk dialog med leverantörer och följa upp tekniska frågeställningar.

  • Delta i konstruktionsgranskningar, så kallade design reviews.

  • Ge tekniskt stöd vid installation och driftsättning.

Vem är du?

  • Du har en relevant teknisk bakgrund inom mekanik, energi eller processteknik.

Du bör även ha någon av följande kompetenser

  • Kunskaper i CAD.

  • Erfarenhet av COMOS.

  • Kunskaper inom KKS/ISA.

Personliga egenskaper

Du tycker om att sätta dig in i tekniska krav och omsätta dem till fungerande lösningar. Du arbetar strukturerat med specifikationer och detaljer och ser hur de olika delarna påverkar helheten.

I samarbetet med leverantörer och andra tekniska funktioner kommunicerar du tydligt och tar initiativ till att reda ut frågor. Du följer upp sådant som behöver lösas och har ett praktiskt perspektiv på hur systemen ska installeras och tas i drift.

Villkor

Du är anställd hos Q och jobbar som konsult på heltid i kundens verksamhet. Det finns goda möjligheter att på sikt övergå till en anställning direkt hos dem.

Notera: Vi hanterar endast ansökningar som skickas in via vår karriärsida.
Vänligen registrera din ansökan där för att säkerställa att den tas emot och behandlas korrekt.

Observera även att bakgrundskontroll kan förekomma som en del av rekryteringsprocessen.

Vi genomför urval löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan. Ansök via länken i annonsen.

title: Seasonal Retail At Your Service Associate, Millcreek Mall - Erie
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Operations & People Assistant
description:
Operations & People Assistant

We’re looking for an Operations & People Assistant to work across the Involved Group, the collective behind globally renowned dance and electronic music labels including Anjunabeats and Anjunadeep, spanning label services and distribution, music publishing, events promotion and artist management.

This is a varied, hands-on role within our Operations & People team, helping to keep our offices and studios running smoothly, supporting our health and safety and compliance obligations, and delivering the day-to-day administration that underpins a great employee experience – from onboarding and benefits to training, wellbeing and social events.

Working closely with colleagues across Operations, People and Technology, you’ll be a first point of contact for employee queries and a dependable pair of hands across our sites. Reporting to the People & Culture Director, our Operations & People Assistant helps make Involved a safe, well-run and welcoming place to work.

Location: Bermondsey, London

Working pattern: Full-time (Monday–Friday) – hybrid working between our lively Bermondsey office and home-working.

____________________________



Who we are:

Based in Bermondsey, the Involved group of companies includes:

  • Involved Productions, home of globally renowned independent dance and electronic music labels Anjunabeats, Anjunadeep and Anjunachill, as well as our label and distribution services.
  • Involved Live, the touring and events company responsible for a portfolio of international events, festivals, and all-night-long showcases, creating unforgettable experiences for fans globally.
  • Involved Publishing, a progressive independent music publisher, representing cutting-edge producers, writers and artists from around the world.
  • Involved Management is a boutique artist management company that is responsible for steering the careers of Above & Beyond, Lane 8, Le Youth and Dusky.

We offer careers, not just jobs, and our team embrace the entrepreneurial spirit, independent mindset and respectful culture we have created, building community and connection through music.

____________________________





Our Operations & People Assistant is responsible for:

  • Facilities & Office: Supporting the smooth running of our multiple sites, including locking and unlocking the office daily, managing office keys, noting necessary repairs and handling minor maintenance (such as lightbulb changes), helping with seating logistics and other office changes, and supporting our relationships with suppliers, contractors and tenants.

  • Business Operations Support: You’ll also provide cover for other team members during periods of leave, and may occasionally be required to support on reception, managing office visitors, managing postage and couriers, replenishing office supplies, managing equipment logs, and keeping the communal office spaces in good order.

  • Health, Safety & Compliance: Supporting statutory fire safety compliance across all our sites (including fire risk assessments and emergency lighting tests), coordinating hearing protection and hearing testing, supporting our annual and new-joiner DSE assessment process, and supporting our data protection compliance.

  • People administration: Being a first point of contact for employee queries, maintaining staff sickness and leave records in our HR portal, administering our HR systems, and managing the People department email inbox.

  • Employee life cycle: Handling employee life cycle administration, supporting new starter office onboarding, enrolling new hires in benefits, and responding to benefits enquiries.

  • Recruitment: Coordinating recruitment administration and taking part in interviews, including filtering applications and conducting phone screenings.

  • Learning & Development: Supporting our performance appraisal processes, managing compliance training process and record-keeping, and helping with organisation and logistics of workplace training, workshops, and other learning and development initiatives.

  • Meetings, Events & Travel: Handling company meeting administration, supporting our social calendar and team-building events including planning, and keeping our company calendar up to date. You will occasionally support on arranging business travel for staff members.

  • Culture, Inclusion & CSR: Supporting our inclusion initiatives and CSR activity, including charity partnerships and sponsored team events.

  • General Administration: Managing our AIM membership, and providing data entry and wider administrative support to the Operations & People team.

This list is not exhaustive – we may ask you to go beyond your job description on occasion, and we hope the role will change and develop with you.

____________________________



About you:

The ideal candidate for this role will likely have:

  • previous experience in an administrative, operations, HR or office support role.
  • an interest in building a career in HR, people operations or office management.
  • familiarity with HR information systems such as BambooHR.
  • an awareness of, or interest in, workplace health and safety.
  • an understanding of, or interest in, data protection, global mobility, and business compliance.
  • excellent organisational skills, with the ability to juggle a varied workload and prioritise effectively.
  • strong accuracy and attention to detail.
  • the ability to communicate well with a wide range of people, and the judgement to know when to escalate a concern or ask a question.
  • excellent written communication skills, and a friendly, approachable manner.
  • discretion when handling confidential information.
  • a proactive, hands-on approach and a problem-solving mindset.
  • an understanding of, or interest in, the music industry.

____________________________





What we offer:



  • A competitive salary (£35k)
  • Participation in our Profit Share Scheme
  • 25 days annual leave
  • A benefits package to support your wellbeing, including access to local gyms and fitness classes, and subscription to health apps including Calm, Headspace and Strava
  • A collection of enhanced family policies to support your family life
  • The opportunity to attend a variety of live events
