title: Activation Lead
description:
Vi er Europas ledende podkastplattform. Hos oss finner du prisbelønte, eksklusive originalserier, lydbøker og podkaster. Vi samarbeider med noen av de beste og mest spennende skaperne i Europa, og publiserer over 700 episoder hver måned – alt drevet av innovativ teknologi og lytteropplevelse. Vi skaper samtaler som samler oss. Bli med på reisen!

Dette er rollen

Har du et strategisk og kreativt markedshode, liker å utvikle gode markedsplaner og motiveres av å lede et team mot målbare resultater? Som vår nye Activation Lead hos Podimo Norge vil du ha ansvar for et team som skal lede aktiveringen av våre podkaster. I tillegg vil du ha ansvar for en egen portefølje som du selv aktiverer ut i markedet. Det handler om å påvirke brukeren gjennom hele forbrukerreisen, fra ferdigprodusert podkast til lytting hos sluttbrukeren. Vi ser etter deg som brenner for markedsføring og underholdning, trives med å kombinere strategi og gjennomføring, og drives av å skape resultater!

Hos oss jobber du tett og tverrfaglig med teamene våre innen innhold, sosiale medier, PR og global vekst for å utvikle effektive kampanjer, sikre gode lanseringer og kontinuerlig optimalisere resultatene.

Du vil lede tre aktiveringsansvarlige og sette den strategiske retningen for showlanseringer og reaktiveringer på porteføljenivå. Du vil også være en viktig sparringspartner for teamet, bidra til faglig utvikling og bygge gode relasjoner med profiler og produksjonspartnere.

Rollen er basert på kontoret vårt i Oslo og rapporterer direkte til Head of Commercial i Norge.

Dette vil du gjøre:

  • Definere strategi og utvikle konkrete markedsplaner for showlanseringer, reaktiveringer og skaperengasjement i Norge, basert på målgrupper og publikumsinnsikt.

  • Sette tydelige mål og sikre effektive kampanjer på tvers av kanaler, som bygger merkevaregjenkjennelse og når de riktige målgruppene, i tett samarbeid med Head of Commercial, SoMe, PR og Growth.

  • Lede, motivere og utvikle de tre aktiveringsansvarlige i teamet, med tydelige prioriteringer og fokus på faglig utvikling.

  • Følge opp KPI-er, analysere kampanjeresultater og bruke innsikten til å optimalisere aktiviteter og prioritere ressurser.

  • Bygge gode relasjoner med profiler og produksjonspartnere, og bidra i forhandlinger knyttet til promotering i avtaler med profiler.

  • Ha oversikt over innholdsporteføljen og videreutvikle arbeidsmetoder og markedsplaner basert på resultater og læring.

  • Eie resultatrapporteringen overfor interne interessenter og ledelse, og identifisere nye profiler og muligheter som kan drive vekst.

Dette er deg

Du vil trives hos Podimo hvis du er nysgjerrig, vennlig og handlekraftig. Du brenner for underholdning og markedsføring, og motiveres av å utvikle gode ideer til tydelige planer og målbare resultater. Du liker å skape retning, få med deg folk og utvikle et team som lykkes sammen. Du kombinerer strategisk forståelse og kreativitet med en strukturert tilnærming, og lar data og resultater veie tyngre enn magefølelsen når du tar beslutninger.

  • Du har god markedsføringsforståelse og evner å kombinere strategisk tenkning med kreativitet og gjennomføring.

  • Du er strukturert, flink til å prioritere og liker å omsette mål og strategier til konkrete planer.

  • Du er opptatt av målbare resultater, bruker data og analyser aktivt i beslutningene dine og er nysgjerrig på hva som driver effekt.

  • Du er en tydelig og inkluderende leder som motiverer andre, skaper felles retning og ønsker å utvikle både mennesker og team. Du har gjerne erfaring med å lede mennesker, men trenger ikke ha lang ledererfaring.

  • Du har gode relasjonelle egenskaper og trives med å samarbeide på tvers av fagområder og bygge relasjoner med profiler og samarbeidspartnere.

  • Du har god forståelse for underholdning, media, merkevarebygging og hvordan man skaper engasjement rundt innhold og profiler.

  • Du behersker norsk og engelsk flytende, både skriftlig og muntlig, og evner å balansere globale rammeverk med lokale behov og muligheter.

Dette er fordelene

  • ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) for alle ansatte

  • Hyggelige kontorlokaler sentralt i Oslo

  • Gratis online terapitimer via

  • Digg lunsj med skikkelig fine kollegaer

  • Muligheter for læring og personlig utvikling i en raskt voksende bransje

  • Mulighet til å jobbe fleksible tider og delvis remote

  • Sjansen til å gjøre en reell forskjell i et voksende internasjonalt selskap

Dette er oss

Podimo ble grunnlagt i København i 2019, og er en plattform for podkast- og lydbokelskere - og for skapere av lydinnhold. I appen vår har du en hel verden av podkaster og lydbøker lett tilgjengelig. Inntektsdelingsmodellen vår belønner skapere for å lage innhold folk faktisk vil høre på - enten de har et stort publikum eller en nisje.

Vi er en modig og nysgjerrig gjeng. Vi ser verdien i det hver enkelt bidrar med, og respekterer kollegaers ideer, meninger og tid. Vi jobber med integritet og ydmykhet, og tror vi blir best når vi er best sammen.

Vi brenner for å oppdage, skape og nerde over gode historier. Vi støtter skaperne våre tett og har stor respekt for prosessen deres når vi hjelper dem med å realisere de mest spennende ideene og historiene. Vi elsker det vi gjør - og viktigst av alt, vi har det gøy mens vi gjør det.

Vi ønsker å bygge et selskap og en kultur som speiler mangfoldet i verden vi lever i: mangfold av talent, stemmer, ideer og perspektiver. Det gjelder for merkevaren vår, innholdet vårt, skaperne våre og teamene våre.

Hos Podimo er du velkommen som den du er - uansett hvor du kommer fra, hvordan du ser ut, eller hvilke historier du har på øret.

title: Research Lead, AI and the Future of Work
description:
About INCO

INCO is a global social enterprise building a more inclusive and sustainable economy. We have helped more than 500,000 people build skills and connect with jobs, supported over 8,000 small business founders, and run programmes in 140 countries. AI skilling is now at the centre of that work, with a focus on people who face barriers to employment.

Running skilling programmes at this scale showed us a gap. Training providers, employers and governments are making big decisions about AI and work with very little reliable, up-to-date evidence. So we have developed a research and data practice on how AI is changing jobs, skills and small businesses, in Europe and around the world, to inform both our own programmes and public policy.

Our latest report, Europe at Work in the Age of Generative AI, analysed 31.2 million unique job postings from across Europe between 2022 and 2025, alongside hundreds of interviews with jobseekers, employers and academics. It looked at which occupations AI is reshaping, how employers' demands are shifting, and what it takes to make sure under-represented groups are not left behind.

The programme

INCO is launching a three-year programme (2026 to 2029) to track AI's real-world impact on jobs, skills and productivity across all 27 EU member states, and to help governments act on what we find. It runs on three connected workstreams:

  1. A dynamic labour demand tracker built from job postings data, tagged to EU occupation and skills classifications and a new AI-skills taxonomy, refreshed on a regular schedule.

  2. Fieldwork with employers, training providers, unions and public employment services, including a repeated employer survey, sector expert panels and productivity studies with partner employers.

  3. Policy analysis of how governments turn labour market signals into decisions, what has worked, and practical tools such as an open scenario-planning toolkit.

The research is delivered with a consortium of 8 to 15 national research partners, with deep coverage of Germany, France, Spain, Italy and Poland and regional clusters covering the rest of the EU. INCO sets the framework, partners collect the data, and INCO consolidates and publishes.

The role

You will own the research side of the programme from start to finish. That means setting the framework every partner works to, keeping a consortium of experienced researchers aligned and on schedule, and turning 27 national pictures into one credible European one.

Most data collection sits with partners. Your job is to make their work comparable, rigorous and publishable, and to be a peer that senior labour economists and sociologists across Europe take seriously. You will work closely with the Head of Policy Engagement, who takes the findings to policymakers.

Key missions on the programme

  • Set the research framework. Finalise the research questions, indicators, sampling approach, interview guides and analysis framework, and bring them together in one research handbook all partners work from. Own the AI-skills taxonomy and its twice-yearly review.

  • Build and lead the consortium. Help identify and select research partners, shape their scopes of work and budgets, onboard them, and run the working groups and review cycles that keep national work consistent. You will lead partners you do not line-manage, so influence matters as much as authority.

  • Oversee data and methods. Act as the quality owner for the job postings pipeline (Cedefop and Eurostat sources, public employment service feeds, commercial data), tagging accuracy and weighting against official statistics. Steer the occupation-level projections, the employer survey panel and the difference-in-differences productivity studies, working with data engineers and partners who run them day to day.

  • Consolidate and publish. Pool national inputs into comparable EU27 series and lead the cross-country analysis. Own the quarterly data refreshes, five semi-annual reports, policy briefs, the annual flagship report and the final EU27 report in 2029.

  • Ground the scenario toolkit in evidence. Make sure the modelling assumptions behind the open scenario-planning toolkit come from the data and fieldwork, and stand up to scrutiny from the labour agencies and ministries meant to use it.

  • Protect research integrity. Keep the work independent and transparent: published methods, coverage and accuracy by country, null results reported alongside positive ones, and sound ethics and data protection (GDPR) practice across partners.

  • Feed the policy work. Give the policy team clear findings, rapid analysis when a labour market story breaks, and a strong voice in the room at convenings with policymakers, social partners and researchers.

  • Report on progress. Track research deliverables and KPIs, contribute to funder reporting, and manage the research consolidation budget.

What we are looking for

Essential

  • Substantial senior experience in applied research on labour markets, skills, the economics of technology or a closely related field.

  • Publications or reports that are credible to both academic and policy audiences.

  • Strong command of quantitative methods: labour market and vacancy data, survey design, and causal inference such as difference-in-differences and event studies. You need to set standards and challenge partners' choices, even if you are not running every model yourself.

  • Comfort with qualitative research, and a sense of how to combine it with quantitative evidence.

  • Good knowledge of European labour market institutions and data (Eurostat, Cedefop, Eurofound, ESCO, ISCO, Labour Force Survey).

  • Excellent written English, and the ability to explain complex findings plainly to non-specialists.

Nice to have

  • A PhD in economics, sociology, public policy or a related field. Not required if your experience speaks for itself.

  • Hands-on experience with online job advertisement data (for example Lightcast, TalentNeuron or Cedefop's Skills-OVATE).

  • Research experience on AI, automation or the digital economy, and familiarity with the AI Act.

  • An existing network in European labour research, for example at universities, IZA, Bruegel, the JRC, Cedefop, Eurofound or the OECD.

  • Polish or another EU language, and knowledge of Central and Eastern European labour markets.

What success looks like

  • First 6 months: research handbook and AI-skills taxonomy agreed, consortium partners contracted and onboarded, first data release from the tracker.

  • End of year 1: first semi-annual report published and cited by policymakers, with a consortium that works as one team.

  • End of year 3: a flagship EU27 report, a dataset and toolkit others reuse, and a research function INCO can build on.

What we offer

  • A senior role with real ownership of a high-profile European research programme, from design to publication.

  • Work that feeds directly into policy and into skilling programmes reaching hundreds of thousands of people.

  • Hybrid working and regular travel across Europe.

  • A mission-driven international team across INCO's activities.

Vi arbejder med udgangspunkt i vores fælles værdi- og medarbejdergrundlag. Du vil opleve at tillid, respekt og samarbejde er genkendelige værdier. Ligeledes at tværfaglighed og rehabiliterende tilgang er vigtige grundsten.

title: Senior HCL Digital Experience (DX) / WCM Developer - Full remote (Tech)
description:
We are looking for a Senior HCL Digital Experience (DX) / WCM Developer to join our team and contribute to the development, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise portals built on HCL Digital Experience.

The successful candidate will be responsible for designing and developing components, integrating services and APIs, troubleshooting technical issues, and optimizing platform performance, while contributing to robust and scalable technical solutions.

SKILLS🤹:

Mandatory Requirements:

  • 5–8 years in enterprise web development, preferably with specific hands-on experience in HCL DX/WCM

  • Hands-on experience with HCL Digital Experience (DX) or HCL Portal.

  • Strong knowledge of HCL Web Content Manager (WCM).

  • Proven experience designing and developing components within HCL WCM.

  • Strong proficiency in Java / Java EE.

  • Experience with portlet development and JSF.

  • Solid knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.

  • Experience with jQuery, AJAX, and the Dojo toolkit.

  • Experience integrating systems through REST APIs.

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to identify and resolve application performance issues.

  • English leves C1 or higher

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience with HCL DX version 9.5.

  • Experience with Digital Asset Management (DAM).

  • Experience in application monitoring, log analysis, and complex issue resolution.

  • Knowledge of enterprise application architecture.

  • Experience administering and optimizing enterprise portals.

TASKS 🚀:

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize enterprise portals based on HCL Digital Experience (DX) and HCL Web Content Manager (WCM).

  • Design, develop, and configure components, templates, and functionalities within HCL WCM.

  • Implement backend solutions using Java and Java EE, including portlet development and JSF.

  • Integrate external services and systems through HCL WCM and Digital Asset Management (DAM) REST APIs.

  • Develop and maintain web interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, and AJAX.

  • Work with the Dojo toolkit to develop and maintain existing frontend functionalities.

  • Analyze monitoring metrics, identify performance bottlenecks, and troubleshoot system issues.

  • Investigate incidents, diagnose complex technical problems, and implement effective solutions.

  • Contribute to the design of application architectures, development strategies, and platform administration procedures.

  • Ensure the quality, stability, maintainability, and performance of developed solutions.

SCHEDULE 🕘:

  • 08h-17h from Monday to Friday (flexible)

  • Full remote

CONDITIONS 🌱:

  • Salary package based on your profile.

  • Flexible compensation plan (free of income tax) where we provide you with medical insurance, public transport ticket and childcare check.

  • Discounts in gym network: Wellhub

  • Training catalogue.

  • Referral program

Our goal is that you are well in every way!

title: IT-specialist med säkerhetsprofil –bygg och säkra Musts kritiska IT-miljöer
description:
Vill du ha ett meningsfullt arbete och bidra till ett säkrare Sverige i en osäker värld? Militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten (Must) söker nu en IT-specialist med säkerhetsprofil till Systemavdelningen. Systemavdelningen etablerar, driftsätter, förvaltar och utvecklar IT-system med höga krav på säkerhet och separation. Rollen kombinerar systemadministration, automation, virtualisering, nätverk och IT-säkerhet, och du bidrar till Musts operativa verksamhet med teknik i framkant.

Du arbetar i team med korsvisa beroenden men är också bekväm med att lösa utmaningar på egen hand. Arbetsmetoden (agilt, vattenfall eller annan projektform) anpassas efter uppdragets karaktär och mål.

Vi erbjuder ett meningsfullt arbete med tydligt samhällssyfte. Tekniska utmaningar i separerade miljöer med höga säkerhetskrav – sådana du sällan möter någon annanstans.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

Bygga, konfigurera och förvalta IT-system och tjänster i Linux- och containermiljöer med höga krav på säkerhet och separation
Utveckla och automatisera infrastruktur och driftuppgifter med scripting, konfigurationshantering och infrastruktur som kod
Arbeta med virtualiseringsplattformar
Stödja IT-säkerhetsarbetet genom teknisk härdning, underlag till ackreditering och framtagning av IT-säkerhetsspecifikationer
Dokumentera system, konfigurationer och förändringar på ett strukturerat och spårbart sätt
Bidra till avdelningens samlade tekniska förmåga och kompetensutveckling

Personliga egenskaper

Du har ett genuint teknikintresse och vill förstå hur saker fungerar, inte bara att de fungerar. Säkerhet är för dig ett förhållningssätt, inte ett verktyg du plockar fram vid behov.

Du är lösningsorienterad och kreativ. När något krånglar ser du möjligheter snarare än hinder och hittar nya vägar framåt utan att göra avkall på säkerheten. Samtidigt är du metodisk, noggrann, och dokumentation samt uppföljning är en naturlig del av ditt arbetssätt.

Du är resultatorienterad och driver ditt arbete hela vägen i mål. Du är samarbetsorienterad, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till att teamet lyckas, men trivs också med att ta egna initiativ och arbeta självständigt.

Du har hög personlig integritet och förstår att diskretion kring arbetsuppgifterna är en grundförutsättning i rollen.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

Kvalifikationer

Relevant utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet införskaffad på annat sätt som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
Minst tre års yrkeserfarenhet som IT-specialist eller i liknande roll
Erfarenhet av virtualisering (t.ex. VMware, KVM eller Citrix)
Aktuell erfarenhet av containerteknologi och infrastruktur som kod
Aktuell erfarenhet av Linux-servermiljö
Goda kunskaper i scriptspråk och automation
God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift

Meriterande

Erfarenhet av IT-säkerhetsarbete, t.ex. härdning eller ackrediteringsprocesser (KSF, ITSS)
Erfarenhet av nätverk och IT-infrastruktur
Erfarenhet av liknande arbete inom Försvarsmakten eller annan myndighet med höga säkerhetskrav

Ovan ställda kvalifikationer ska på begäran kunna verifieras genom intyg, referenser samt arbets- eller urvalstester.

För att myndighetens uppdrag ska vara framgångsrikt förutsätts att alla medarbetare uppträder enligt den värdegrund som finns. Försvarsmaktens värdegrund slår vakt om alla människors lika värde, rättvisa och jämlikhet och främjar demokrati och mänskliga rättigheter (läs mer på ).

Övrigt

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning som inleds med provanställning om sex månader

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Arbetsort: Stockholm

För upplysningar om befattningen eller rekryteringsprocessen kontakta:

hkv-rekrytering-must@mil.se, vänligen skriv ”IT-specialist med säkerhetsprofil SL” i ämnesraden.

Fackliga företrädare

Fackliga representanter nås via hkv-rekrytering-must@mil.se

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-11-13. I ditt CV och personliga brev vill vi att du beskriver på vilket sätt du uppfyller våra efterfrågade krav och meriter. Du ansöker via .

Ansökningar till denna befattning kommer endast tas emot via Försvarsmaktens webbplats. Militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten (Must) är en del av Försvarsmaktens högkvarter i Stockholm. Vi ger regeringen och Försvarsmakten kvalificerade beslutsunderlag om omvärldsutvecklingen och hot mot Sveriges och Försvarsmaktens säkerhet. Vår vision är ”Ett säkrare Sverige i en osäker värld”. Must är en kunskapsorganisation och erbjuder både spännande och för Sverige angelägna arbetsuppgifter. Här arbetar både officerare och civila experter inom olika områden, t ex statsvetenskap, IT, ekonomi, teknik, matematik och HR.

En stor del av Must verksamhet omfattas av sekretess och vi ber dig därför att inte berätta att du sökt jobb hos Must för andra personer än dina närmaste. Läs gärna mer om Must och vår verksamhet

Varje dag och varje timme gör våra medarbetare insatser som påverkar andra människors liv, både i stort och smått, och både på hemmaplan och runt om i världen.

Försvarsmakten ger dig möjlighet att utvecklas som människa och växa i din professionella roll. Vi är en ansvarstagande arbetsgivare och har en öppen organisation där vi ställer upp för varandra.

I Försvarsmakten finns en stark värdegrund som bygger på öppenhet, resultat och ansvar. Professionell utveckling och personlig hälsa värdesätts och uppmuntras. Det finns goda förutsättningar för intern karriärrörlighet, friskvård och bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv.

Försvarsmakten tillvaratar de kvaliteter som mångfald och jämn könsfördelning tillför verksamheten. Vi välkomnar därför sökanden med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter i våra rekryteringar.

En anställning hos oss innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Vanligtvis krävs svenskt medborgarskap.Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt 3 kap i säkerhetsskyddslagen. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. I anställningen ingår även en skyldighet att tjänstgöra utomlands. Innebörden av detta varierar beroende på typ av befattning.

Till ansökan om anställning ska CV och personligt brev bifogas. Om du går vidare i anställningsprocessen ska alltid vidimerade kopior av betyg och intyg uppvisas.

Samtal från externa rekryteringsföretag och säljare undanbedes.

title: Har du flair for teknik og fejlfinding? Bliv en del af Metroens signalteam
description:
Har du erfaring med fejlfinding på mekaniske eller elektriske anlæg eller andre tekniske systemer? Trives du samtidig i et team, hvor man hjælper hinanden og løser opgaverne sammen?

I Metroens ATC-afdeling (Automatic Train Control), arbejder vi med en bred vifte af driftskritiske systemer, hvor signalteknik og teknisk infrastruktur spiller tæt sammen. Arbejdet udføres om natten og er planlagt som en 4-dages arbejdsuge med start søndag eller mandag aften.

**Om jobbet

**Som tekniker bliver du en del af vores ATC-afdeling, som har ansvar for drift og vedligehold af Metroens automatiske togstyrings- og signalsystemer. Her arbejder vi med tekniske anlæg, hvor el, mekanik, styring og kommunikation mellem systemer hænger tæt sammen.

**Du Kommer Blandt Andet Til At Arbejde Med

**

  • Vedligeholde elektriske anlæg, herunder perrondøre og signalsystemer
  • Servicere mekaniske komponenter som skiftespormaskiner og track circuits
  • Fejlsøge systematisk på driftskritiske anlægIdentificere fejl i kommunikation og samspil mellem tekniske systemer
  • Analysere driftsdata, logfiler og fejlhistorik
  • Registrere vedligehold, fejl og udbedringer i SAP PM

Du behøver ikke have arbejdet med signalsystemer eller Metroens anlæg tidligere. Vi sørger for et grundigt oplæringsforløb, hvor du lærer Metroens systemer at kende og får opbygget de nødvendige kompetencer inden for signal- og togstyringsteknik.

**Vi Søger Dig, Der

**

  • Har en faglig uddannelse, fx som elektriker, industrielektriker, elektronikfagtekniker, elektronikmekaniker, automatiktekniker, mekaniker mv.
  • Har erfaring med drift, vedligeholdelse og fejlfinding på tekniske anlæg
  • Er vant til teknisk fejlfinding og arbejder systematisk med tekniske problemstillinger
  • Har kørekort til kategori B og kan opnå den nødvendige helbredsgodkendelse
  • På sigt kan indgå i en rådighedsvagtordning

Du har en god teknisk systemforståelse og kan se sammenhænge mellem forskellige komponenter og anlæg. Samtidig er du en teamplayer, der trives med tæt faglig sparring, men også kan tage selvstændigt ansvar for dine opgaver.

**Du Skal Søge Stillingen Fordi

**

  • Du får et varieret teknisk job med udfordrende fejlfindingsopgaver, en 4-dages arbejdsuge og et grundigt oplæringsforløb med mulighed for at specialisere dig inden for signalsystemer
  • Du vil have mulighed for faglig udvikling i en organisation fyldt med passionerede specialister
  • Vi prioriterer din trivsel og arrangerer sociale aktiviteter på tværs af virksomheden
  • Vi sætter fokus på dit helbred og tilbyder massageordning samt tilskud til fitness og lignende sundhedsrelaterede tilbud
  • Ansættelse i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem Dansk Industri, Dansk Metal og Dansk El-Forbund med en lokalforhandlet lønpakke

**Har du spørgsmål til stillingen?

**I jobbet refererer du til Ledende tekniker, Claus Bak Andersen og du får base på vores lokation i Denmark. Du er velkommen til at kontakte os på mail hr@metroservice.dk for spørgsmål.

Vi værdsætter mangfoldighed og opfordrer alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge - uanset baggrund. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! Send dit CV via linket senest den 19. oktober 2026.

Bemærk: Du bedes uploade din straffeattest til din karriereprofil inden den første samtale. Straffeattesten og øvrige personoplysninger behandles fortroligt og i overensstemmelse med GDPR.

title: 🧱 Flisemurer i Brønshøj – Kan du lægge fliser, der sidder lige i skabet? 🚿
description:

Er du skarp med fliseklipperen, har øje for detaljerne og ved, at et flot badeværelse kræver mere end bare en god fuge? 😎

Vi søger dygtige flisemurere i Brønshøj, der elsker godt håndværk og trives med en hverdag, hvor opgaverne varierer.

Her kommer du til at arbejde med alt fra badeværelser og renoveringer til tilbygninger og pudsearbejde – primært hos private kunder, hvor kvalitet og ordentlighed betyder noget.

Vi leder efter håndværkere, der kan tage ansvar for deres arbejde, tænke selv og levere et resultat, de kan være stolte af.

Du får en alsidig hverdag med opgaver som:

  • 🏠 Tilbygninger – forskellige mureropgaver i forbindelse med udvidelse af boliger.

  • 🔧 Renovering – istandsættelse og forbedring af eksisterende boliger.

  • Har erfaring med almindelige mureropgaver.

  • Er kvalitetsbevidst og har øje for detaljerne.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar.

  • Er mødestabil og har en positiv indstilling.

  • Trives med at arbejde hos private kunder og møder folk på en ordentlig måde.

Det vigtigste er, at du kan dit håndværk og sætter en ære i at aflevere et flot resultat.

💪 Hvad kan du se frem til?

  • ✅ Varierende arbejdsopgaver inden for fliser, badeværelser og renovering.

  • ✅ Arbejde hos private kunder med forskellige projekter.

  • ✅ Mulighed for at bruge flere sider af dit murerfag.

  • ✅ En hverdag, hvor kvalitet og godt håndværk er i fokus.

  • ✅ Løn efter kvalifikationer.

📞 Er du klar til nye mureropgaver?

Hvis du kan lægge fliser, så både kunden og vaterpasset bliver tilfredse, vil vi gerne høre fra dig! 😄

title: Platform Adminstrator
description:
Platform Administrator

Position Summary

The Platform Administrator serves as a trusted advisor and technical administrator for ServiceChannel customers, ensuring platform configurations are maintained, optimized, and aligned to business requirements. This role partners closely with customers, Facility Coordinators, Customer Success, Product Management, and Support teams to implement configuration changes, support platform enhancements, and drive adoption of ServiceChannel capabilities. This position is responsible for administrative configuration, user management, customer-requested updates, and communication regarding platform performance and enhancements.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Platform Administration

  • Configure and maintain ServiceChannel platform settings based on customer requirements.
  • Modify and manage user access, permissions, and administrative settings.
  • Implement customer-requested updates within approved platform modules.
  • Maintain dashboard settings, workflows, and issue list configurations.

Customer Consultation & Support

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for platform administration requests.
  • Review customer enhancement requests and collaborate with internal stakeholders to evaluate solutions.
  • Provide customers with updates on enhancement requests and platform initiatives.
  • Communicate ServiceChannel system performance issues and platform updates to customers and internal stakeholders.

Configuration Management

Support configuration and administration within:

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Participate in customer meetings related to platform administration and optimization.

  • Escalate issues and risks appropriately to leadership and technical teams.

Qualifications

Required

  • Experience managing customer-facing technology solutions.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and customer requests simultaneously.

Preferred

Success Measures

title: Senior User Experience Designer
description:
Senior UX/UI Designer

Design the future of journalism.

Newsrooms across the world are being transformed by AI, automation, and entirely new ways of creating content. At Stibo DX, we are building the platform that powers that transformation. We are looking for a Senior UX/UI Designer to help define the next generation of newsroom technology and shape how journalists plan, create, and publish stories in the age of AI.

The role

Cue is the platform newsrooms around the world run on - planning, producing, and publishing everything they make. We are taking it into its next generation, and we are looking for a senior designer to lead that work end to end.

This is a rare kind of design problem: deep, professional, high-stakes tooling used all day, every day, by people who will tell you exactly what is wrong with it. You will own discovery through delivery in a product team - framing the problem, shaping the concept, prototyping, validating, and shipping design that holds up in production.

You will not be designing alone. In Aarhus or Copenhagen, you will join our UX team, which is small and tight-knit: we critique each other’s work, share research openly, and set the quality bar together. You will own your product area, with people close by to think it through with.

Why now

AI is changing our users’ job and ours at the same time, and we find that genuinely exciting.

Journalists are moving from producer to curator - steering, selecting, and taking responsibility for far more output than any newsroom could hand-craft before. That shift only works if the human stays meaningfully in the loop, and designing that loop is one of the most interesting problems in media software right now: where the machine drafts, where the person decides, and how trust is earned at every step.

The same shift is reshaping how we work. We design with AI tools daily, and we are still figuring out what good looks like. If that is a question you want to be inside of, this is a good seat.

What you’ll do

  • Run discovery and turn findings into clear product direction
  • Concept, prototype, and validate - fast, at the right fidelity
  • Deliver production-ready design in close collaboration with engineering
  • Contribute to and strengthen our enterprise design system
  • Map user journeys and facilitate workshops with cross-functional teams
  • Define and track behavioral metrics to close the loop on what you ship

What you bring

  • 7+ years in product design, with senior ownership of complex products
  • Master’s degree in design & innovation, user-centric product development, service design, or similar
  • Proven work across discovery, conceptualization, prototyping, validation, and design delivery
  • Hands-on experience building and contributing to an enterprise design system - this is essential
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills
  • A pragmatic approach: you make progress with what is in front of you

title: Financieel Medewerker | Hendrik-Ido-Ambacht | 24 uur
description:
Bij Ecoresult krijg je de ruimte om zelfstandig te werken, verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en samen met onze Financieel Controller de financiële administratie verder te professionaliseren.

Je hoeft geen kennis van natuur of ecologie te hebben. Sterker nog: als je bij ons werkt, krijg je die interesse vanzelf. Voor je het weet staat er een verrekijker naast je bureau en kijk je samen met collega's naar een zeearend, rode wouw of groepje kraanvogels.

Over Ecoresult

Ecoresult is een ecologisch adviesbureau met ruim 50 betrokken collega's. We werken iedere dag aan een natuurinclusief Nederland. Onze ecologen en projectleiders houden zich bezig met onder andere ecologisch onderzoek, natuurwetgeving, biodiversiteit en de begeleiding van projecten waarin mens en natuur samenkomen.

We zijn een groeiende en informele organisatie met korte lijnen. Mensen krijgen bij ons veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid. Dat geldt ook voor onze financiële administratie: we vinden het belangrijk dat de basis klopt, maar kijken ook steeds hoe we dingen slimmer en beter kunnen organiseren.

En de natuur? Die kom je vanzelf tegen. Het is bij ons heel normaal dat een verrekijker op een bureau ligt om samen even een bijzondere vogel te bekijken. Op ons bedrijventerrein in Hendrik-Ido-Ambacht gaan we bovendien regelmatig op zoek naar insecten en planten voor onze 1000-soortenchallenge. Je hoeft dus geen natuurkenner te zijn. Een beetje nieuwsgierigheid is genoeg.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Financieel Medewerker ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse financiële administratie van Ecoresult. Jij zorgt ervoor dat financiële gegevens correct, volledig en op tijd worden verwerkt en houdt in de gaten of alles klopt.

Je werkt nauw samen met jouw collega Margé. Jullie zijn samen verantwoordelijk voor de financiële administratie en zorgt dat de administratie op orde is.

Je werkzaamheden zijn afwisselend. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het verzorgen en controleren van de verkoopfacturatie.

  • Het verwerken en controleren van inkoopfacturen in GRIPP en Exact.

  • Het voorbereiden van betaalbatches en bewaken van betaaltermijnen.

  • Het beheren van debiteuren en crediteuren en opvolgen van openstaande posten.

  • Het verwerken van begrotingen en financiële gegevens in de administratie.

  • Het uitvoeren van controles en aansluitingen tussen verschillende administraties en systemen.

  • Het ondersteunen bij maand-, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen.

  • Het voorbereiden van gegevens voor de accountant en het voorbereiden van de btw-aangifte.

  • Het beantwoorden van financiële vragen van projectleiders, collega's, klanten en leveranciers.

  • Het signaleren van afwijkingen, fouten en mogelijke financiële risico's.

  • Het ondersteunen van de Financieel Controller bij rapportages en analyses.

  • Het meedenken over hoe we onze financiële processen slimmer en efficiënter kunnen maken.

Wat willen we dat je meebrengt?

We zoeken iemand die zorgvuldig werkt, graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en het prettig vindt om zelfstandig zijn of haar werk te organiseren. Je vindt het belangrijk dat dingen kloppen en bent niet bang om door te vragen als iets niet duidelijk is.

Je hoeft niet alles al te kunnen. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je een goede financiële basis hebt, zelfstandig kunt werken en nieuwsgierig bent naar hoe processen beter kunnen.

Verder breng je mee:

  • Mbo+ of hbo werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een financiële of bedrijfseconomische richting.

  • Ervaring met financiële administratie.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en vindt het belangrijk dat gegevens volledig en correct zijn.

  • Je kunt goed zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op.

  • Je signaleert afwijkingen en wacht niet af wanneer iets niet klopt.

  • Je kunt helder communiceren met collega's, projectleiders, klanten en leveranciers.

  • Ervaring met Exact en/of GRIPP is een pluspunt.

  • Je vindt het leuk om mee te denken over het verbeteren van financiële processen.

Wat bieden we jou?

Je krijgt bij Ecoresult een zelfstandige functie waarin je een belangrijke rol speelt binnen onze financiële administratie. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en mee te bouwen aan een professionele financiële organisatie.

Daarnaast bieden we:

  • Een salaris tussen € 3.500 en € 5.000 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van je ervaring.

  • Een dienstverband van 24 uur per week.

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband wanneer de samenwerking van beide kanten goed bevalt.

  • 25 vakantiedagen op basis van 40 uur.

  • Flexibele werktijden.

  • Een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling via BeFrank, volledig betaald door Ecoresult.

  • Een laptop en mobiele telefoon van de zaak.

  • Een AI-abonnement om je werk slimmer en efficiënter uit te voeren.

  • Een fietsplan.

  • Dagelijks vers fruit, snacks en een goed gevulde koelkast.

  • Een tafeltennistafel voor een potje tussendoor.

  • Een gezellige theecorner.

  • Een jaarlijks tweedaags teamuitje.


Jouw werkplek

Je werkt vanuit ons kantoor in Hendrik-Ido-Ambacht, waar je onderdeel bent van de dagelijkse dynamiek van Ecoresult. Je werkt veel samen met de Financieel Controller, directie, projectleiders en collega's uit verschillende teams.

Je hoeft dus geen natuurliefhebber te zijn om bij ons te starten. Maar de kans is groot dat je na een tijdje vanzelf uit het raam tuurt om een vogel te spotten.

Bijzonderheden

Reageren kan tot: 11 november 2026
De selectiegesprekken vinden plaats op woensdagochtend 18 november 2026

Enthousiast geworden?

Zie jij jezelf in deze rol en lijkt het je leuk om onderdeel te worden van Ecoresult? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Heb je vragen?

Neem contact op met Reshma Shewdoelare via 06 26 45 25 23 of reshmashewdoelare@ecoresult.nl


Solliciteer en vertel ons waarom jij onze nieuwe Financieel Medewerker wilt worden.

title: Software Engineer III, Embedded, Pixel Core USB
location: New Taipei, Banqiao District, New Taipei City, Taiwan
description:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Pixel Core USB team designs and delivers the end-to-end USB connectivity, charging, and Type-C software architecture across Pixel phones, tablets, and accessories. We ensure seamless interoperability with first-party and third-party accessories, robust host and device modes, high power-efficiency, and long-term hardware port health across every stage of the product lifecycle.

As an Embedded Software Engineer on the Pixel Core USB team, you will contribute across multiple layers of the Android and Linux system software stack—from low-level device drivers to the HAL and Android framework. You will take ownership of critical USB subsystems, including power management states (AP suspend, SoC hibernation), USB audio offload, recovery mechanisms, and automated validation frameworks to ensure high product reliability and performance for current and upcoming Pixel phones and tablets.

Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our Devices & Services team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences for users. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make our user's interaction with computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. Whether finding new ways to capture and sense the world around us, advancing form factors, or improving interaction methods, the Devices & Services team is making people's lives better through technology.

  • Develop, maintain, and debug Linux kernel drivers from scratch and HAL interfaces to enable new USB controllers used in Pixel product roadmap.
  • Implement and optimize USB host/device power states, including AP suspend during USB audio offload, low-power hibernation modes, and fast recovery paths across system resets.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional hardware, software, and SoC teams during pre-silicon emulation and post-silicon bring-up for next-generation Tensor platforms.
  • Identify systemic issues for USB and contribute clean, maintainable patches in Linux upstream that are easier to maintain over several generations on Tensor SoCs.
  • Design and automate test suites to prevent regressions in USB tethering, audio, and device enumeration. Drive root-cause analysis and triage for factory, dogfood, carrier, and partner-reported issues.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (C or C++), or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
  • 2 years of experience working with embedded operating systems, Linux kernel development, or device driver architecture.
  • Experience with embedded debugging tools (e.g., JTAG, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, ftrace, or GDB).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
  • Experience with the USB Specification (USB 2.0/3.x, USB Type-C, USB Power Delivery, or USB Audio Class).
  • Experience with Design Ware Controller (dwc) stack.
  • Experience reading hardware spec sheets to infer hardware capabilities with understanding of Linux kernel userspace interface.
  • Embedded development experience in Linux and experience developing and automating test suites for embedded peripheral interfaces and host/device topologies.
  • Prior track record of contributing to upstream open-source communities (Linux kernel or AOSP).

title: Orthopedagoog / Psycholoog –  Papendrecht
description:
Heb jij passie voor leerontwikkeling en voel jij je helemaal thuis in een schoolse setting? Word jij blij van leerlingen een goede of nieuwe start te geven in de maatschappij? Kom dan bij ons in Papendrecht werken als orthopedagoog of psycholoog voor 24 - 32 uur per week.

Dit ga je doen

Als orthopedagoog/psycholoog geef je dyslexiebehandelingen (ernstige dyslexie; ED) en voer je diagnostiek uit volgens het Protocol Dyslexie Diagnostiek & Behandeling.

  • Je begeleidt en behandelt individuele leerlingen op laagdrempelig en tegelijkertijd professioneel niveau. De meeste behandelingen vinden plaats op scholen en daarnaast ben je werkzaam op de vestiging waar je je collega’s van je team treft.

  • Je stelt behandelplannen en tussentijdse evaluaties op en onderhoudt goede contacten met ouders en school.

  • Je werkt met een innovatief zorgaanbod, zoals de door ons ontwikkelde digitale behandelmethode voor dyslexie: Spiek.

  • Ook houd je je bezig met netwerken op jouw scholen waarbij je de diensten van Opdidakt aan hen kenbaar maakt, zowel de dyslexiezorg als de diensten binnen schoolservice. Belangrijk is dat je het contact hierna warm houdt en ervoor zorgt dat zij Opdidakt willen blijven inzetten.

Dit bieden wij

We bieden je een afwisselende functie in een enthousiast en gedreven team. Daarnaast:

  • Ontvang je van ons in eerste instantie een contract voor bepaalde tijd, met de intentie om jou daarna voor onbepaalde tijd aan onze organisatie te verbinden.

  • Bieden we je een salaris dat past bij jouw kennis en ervaring van €3.118,- tot € 4.757,- bruto op basis van 40 uur per week.

  • Bouw je elk jaar opleidingsdagen op om je verder te ontwikkelen. Lees hier meer over ons opleidingsbeleid. Ben je benieuwd naar de opleidingen en cursussen die je kan volgen? Bekijk dan ons ontwikkelpad.

Leer ons kennen

Over Opdidakt

Opdidakt ondersteunt kinderen en jongeren die vastlopen in hun ontwikkeling. Dit doen we middels behandelingen op zowel didactisch als op sociaal-emotioneel gebied. Zo helpen we kinderen en jongeren een goede start te maken in de maatschappij. Ook doen wij onderzoek naar leerproblemen, zoals dyslexie, dyscalculie en intelligentie. Lees hier meer over Opdidakt.

Over Mental Care Group

Opdidakt, Mentaal Beter en HSK zijn allemaal onderdeel van Mental Care Group. Met meer dan 2000 medewerkers door het land zetten wij ons iedere dag in om de beste zorg te bieden aan onze cliënten, van jong tot oud en van Groningen tot Maastricht. Samen staan wij sterk voor een mentaal gezond, vitaal en veerkrachtig Nederland. Lees hier meer over Mental Care Group.

  • Je hebt een afgeronde master orthopedagogiek of kinder- en jeugdpsychologie.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met onderzoek en/of begeleiding bij leerproblematiek.

title: Creative and Digital Director
description:
Creative and Digital Director

Taher Inc. | Job Description

Location: Remote eligible with periodic onsite presence in Minnetonka, Minnesota
Department: Marketing
Reports to: Vice President of Marketing

Position Summary

The Creative and Digital Director leads the creative expression and digital presence of Taher, Inc., bringing our food, people, nutrition initiatives, and client partnerships to life. This hands-on leader translates marketing strategy into compelling design, social media, video, website content, and campaigns across K--12 education, business and industry, and manufacturing.

Working with the Vice President of Marketing, this role builds consistent creative standards and a reliable content process that connects corporate priorities with stories from our locations. The Director combines strong creative judgment with the ability to personally produce content, manage projects, and measure results.

Essential Responsibilities

Creative Direction and Brand Execution

  • Translate approved brand and marketing strategy into cohesive visual concepts, campaigns, and materials for digital and print channels.
  • Create and oversee graphics, presentations, sales collateral, signage, recruitment materials, and other branded assets; maintain practical templates and an organized asset library.
  • Partner with internal design and communications colleagues and external vendors to manage creative quality, priorities, deadlines, and production.

Social Media and Content Production

  • Own day-to-day corporate social media planning, publishing, community engagement, and reporting across approved platforms.
  • Build and maintain an editorial calendar featuring culinary innovation, nutrition programs such as Food4Life, employee stories, client partnerships, and company initiatives.
  • Personally develop copy, graphics, photography, and short-form video; coordinate larger shoots and specialized production as needed.
  • Create a simple process for Food Service Directors and field teams to submit stories, photos, and videos, supported by clear content guidelines and approval steps.
  • Confirm appropriate permissions and approvals before publishing content featuring students, employees, clients, or client locations; escalate sensitive comments and issues through designated channels.

Digital Experience and Campaign Performance

  • Manage website content and coordinate updates with internal stakeholders and external web partners to keep information accurate, engaging, accessible, and consistent with the brand.
  • Execute digital campaigns supporting brand awareness, business development, client engagement, and recruiting; coordinate paid media and email campaigns as assigned.
  • Monitor engagement, website traffic, campaign responses, and other relevant measures; use results to improve content and recommend where to invest effort and budget.

Collaboration and Project Management

  • Partner with Human Resources on employer branding, recruiting campaigns, and employee stories, and with sales and operations on client-facing materials.
  • Manage creative requests, production schedules, vendor relationships, and assigned budgets; communicate priorities and resolve competing deadlines.
  • Support executive storytelling, industry events, and company announcements with timely creative and digital materials.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, graphic design, communications, digital media, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Seven or more years of progressive experience in creative, digital marketing, or brand content roles, including experience leading projects and directing creative work.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating visual design, social media content, digital campaigns, and storytelling, with examples of personal contributions and results.
  • Hands-on proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud or comparable professional design tools, video editing software, content management systems, social media publishing tools, and digital analytics.
  • Strong writing, editing, visual judgment, project management, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to balance creative direction with daily production and manage multiple priorities across a geographically dispersed organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in foodservice, hospitality, education, consumer brands, manufacturing, or another business with multiple locations.
  • Experience photographing food, producing short-form video, supporting employer branding, and enabling local teams to contribute content.
  • Experience with SEO, paid social, email marketing, agency management, and responsible use of AI-assisted creative tools with human review.

Measures of Success

Success includes a consistent brand across channels, a dependable publishing cadence, stronger engagement with relevant audiences, timely delivery of quality creative work, and a sustainable flow of approved field content. Campaign goals and performance targets will be established with the Vice President of Marketing.

Work Environment and Application Materials

This position offers remote work capability. Onsite presence at Taher's corporate office in Minnetonka, Minnesota, may be required approximately once per month for collaboration, planning, meetings, or content production. Additional onsite visits and travel to client locations, production facilities, and company events may be required based on business needs. Occasional work outside standard business hours may be needed for events or time-sensitive campaigns. Candidates should submit a resume and portfolio or links to relevant work, identifying their role in each example.

title: SSA søges til Solvang Plejecenter
description:
Bliv en del af et nærværende og engageret aftenteam på Solvang
Hos Plejecenter Solvang får du mulighed for at udfolde din faglighed blandt engagerede kolleger i et varmt og åbent miljø med stor respekt for borgernes individuelle behov. Her arbejder vi for, at vores borgere bliver set, hørt og forstået – første gang. Vi hjælper hinanden og tror på værdien af fællesskab i hverdagen.

Sådan ser vi dig og dine kompetencer
Vi forestiller os, at du allerede ved meget om demenssygdomme og har lyst til løbende at styrke og udvikle din viden. Du trives med at tage ansvar, skabe overblik og samarbejde med både borgere og kolleger om at skabe trygge rammer. Din høje faglighed kan mærkes – og du bevarer altid fokus på borgerne. Du møder både borgere og kolleger med en åben og ærlig dialog, skriftligt og mundtligt, og du har lyst til at lære nyt, udvikle dig og dele din viden i den daglige sparring. Hvis du også har erfaring som praktikvejleder, er det en fordel.

Dine arbejdsopgaver i aftenteamet
Som social- og sundhedsassistent hos os får du en hverdag, hvor du har ansvar for at de borgere der er dårligst, får den korrekte sygeplejefaglige assistance og at du kan koordinere tværfagligt omkring den enkelte borger. Opgaverne spænder fra personlig pleje og guidning til observation, triage og faglig sparring af sygeplejeindsatser for borgere med kognitive udfordringer. Du samarbejder tæt med kolleger om at skabe tryghed og stabilitet for dem, vi er her for, og du kan forvente stor opbakning og tværfaglig sparring fra erfarne kollegaer.

Det kan du forvente af os
Hos Solvang bliver du en del af et åbent, imødekommende og refleksivt team, hvor vi hjælper og løfter hinanden – både i hverdagens udfordringer og succeser. Vi vægter en respektfuld dialog og et trygt arbejdsmiljø, både for vores borgere, pårørende og i det daglige samarbejde internt og eksternt. Vi tilbyder grundig introduktion og støtte, uanset dit erfaringsniveau. Arbejdspladsen ligger naturskønt på Ore, tæt på både vandet og stationen, med let adgang til offentlig transport.

Praktisk info og hvordan du søger
Stillingen er på 28-32 timer pr. uge og vagterne ligger primært i aftentimerne. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte plejecenterleder Gitte Andersen på telefon 55 36 36 99.
Ansøgningsfrist: 26. oktober 2026.

Ansættelsesdato: snarest eller senest 1. januar 2027.

Vordingborg Kommune

Vordingborg Kommune er en attraktiv og moderne arbejdsplads beliggende i Danmarks vildeste natur. Her langs Danmarks længste kystlinje mellem historiske købstæder og stærke fællesskaber er vi omtrent 4000 ansatte, der arbejder for at gøre vores kommune til et endnu mere grønt og attraktivt sted at bo og leve.

Vi har fokus på, at hverdagen skal hænge sammen og tilbyder rammerne om et liv i balance. Her får du mange kvadratmeter for færre penge, du kommer tæt på kysten, i spektakulær natur – med et meningsfuldt job. Så kom og vær med!

Problem Solving – Identifies and resolve problems in a timely manner; gathers and analyzes information skillfully; develops alternative solutions; works well in group problem solving situations; uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.

Teamwork – Contributes to building a positive team spirit.

Attendance/Punctuality – Is consistently at work and on time, works with receiving managers to ensure work responsibilities are covered when absent.

Qualifications: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education &Experience: High School Diploma or equivalent. Minimum Five years of driving and receiving experience.

Skills: Dispatch Assistant should be detailed oriented, have good organizational skills, be a team player, and a good communicator.

Provide a positive and professional attitude to all customer, vendors, and employees.

Computer Skills: To perform this job successfully, an individual should have basic knowledge of Eclipse software and Microsoft Office

Certificates & Licenses: Forklift Certified

Clean DMV record in accordance with company insurance requirements.

Base pay is just one piece of the total rewards program offered by Edges Electrical Group. title: VIP Corporate Travel Agent (US-Based, Remote)
description:
This is a fully remote, US-based position, open tocandidates residing in the New Jersey

About Us

For 40 years, Encore Corporate Travel has helped CFOs, CPOs, and travel leaders reimagine business travel—simpler, smarter, and more personal.

With 24/7 Traveler Services, proprietary technology, proactive program management, and integrated Meetings & Events, Encore delivers clarity, control, and care across every experience.

As a proudly woman-owned, independent company, Encore moves fast, solves harder problems, and grows with intention, never compromising on the personalized service that sets it apart.

A VIP travelerdoes not want to be asked twice.

The windowseat booked without a reminder. The hotel loyalty number applied before theythink to mention it. The connection they hate, avoided on instinct becausesomeone remembered the last three times it went wrong. That is not service.That is being known, and it is the difference between an agent and a resource.

VIP CorporateTravel Agents at Encore exist because being known does not happen by accident.Dedicated and complex accounts do not land with this role because policyrequires it. They land because the traveler learned, itinerary after itinerary,that their preferences are never an afterthought here.

The Role

As a VIP Corporate Travel Agent, you manage new bookings and changes across air, hotel, rail, and car for Encore's most demanding travel clients: name changes, date shifts, itinerary rebuilds, all handled inside the client's travel policy and inside the traveler's expectations. You carry sensitive, private information with the same care every time, not just when someone is watching.

This is not a booking role. It is a relationship role wearing an agent's title.

What You'll Do

Own every VIP itinerary, start to finish. You book and rebuild international air, hotel, rail, and car reservations, and you do it fluently in the loyalty programs that matter to the traveler holding the ticket.

Protect what's sensitive and keep it compliant. You complete document verification and pre-check for every traveler in your care, advise on entry requirements before they're asked about, and keep every reservation inside the client's policy without being told twice.

Anticipate before they ask. You learn each traveler's preferences and hold them across every booking. An air request with a night away from home is an opening to offer the right hotel, not an afterthought. You close the loop other agents leave open.

Raise the standard for the team. You're a resource to your colleagues, not just your travelers. You answer questions before they're fully asked, and you share the tips and tricks that turn a good file into a clean one. Dedicated and complex accounts land with you because that reputation is earned, one file at a time.


Requirements

What You Bring

Required

  • Extensivetravel industry experience (20+ years), with demonstrated expertise in US domestic travel, international itineraries, fare rules, and loyalty program mechanics
  • Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Advanced, current knowledge of travel industry rules and processes, including document requirements and entry rules that shift by destination
  • The soft skills to guide a traveler to resolution in the fewest exchanges possible, and the persuasive, precise writing to do the same with colleagues and other teams
  • A customer orientation strong enough to build lasting relationships with travelers who do not tolerate friction
  • Ownership of mistakes: you correct them without waiting to be asked
  • The organizational discipline to manage multiple complex or dedicated accounts at once without missing a detail, and to meet service level agreements on every interaction

An asset

  • Formal travel school training
  • Prior experience supporting dedicated or high-complexity accounts specifically
  • Deep knowledge of US-based corporate travel programs and compliance requirements

Shift Options

Available schedules (Eastern Time):

  • Monday to Friday: 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. ET
  • Monday to Friday: 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET

Who Thrives Here

The travelers Encore's VIP agents serve are busy, well-informed, and unforgiving of friction. They will not explain their preferences twice. They want someone who already has the answer ready, not someone still looking for it.

The agents who thrive in this role take that personally, in the best way. They close a file only when it's actually closed. They treat a colleague's question as worth answering fully, because the next complex account might land on that colleague's desk instead of theirs.

If precision and anticipation are how you measure a good day at work, this is where that gets rewarded.

title: Kloakrørlægger til no-dig og rørlægning i Vordingborg
description:
Vil du have firmabil, fast arbejde og kloakopgaver med tyngde?



Vi mangler en kloakrørlægger til no-dig og rørlægning i Vordingborg.



Du lander i et større entreprenørsetup, hvor kloakarbejde går hånd i hånd med jord, beton og anlæg. Opgaverne spænder fra private kunder til erhverv og industri, og pladserne kan ligge flere steder på Sjælland. Der arbejdes både med nye afløbsinstallationer, udvidelser af kloaksystemer og mindre serviceopgaver som dræning, rensning og tv-inspektion. Miljøet tænkes med, når løsningen giver mening, især når materialer kan genbruges.

Rollen passer til dig, der gerne vil have ansvar i marken og kan holde styr på både rør, samlinger og dokumentation. Du får firmabil og bliver en del af et sted, hvor komplekse opgaver kræver præcision og grundighed. Det er kloakarbejde for en fagperson, der hellere vil lave det rigtigt første gang end lappe efter bagefter.

Det får du

Løn: 200-220 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Vordingborg og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Kloak, no-dig og dokumentation

Din hverdag

Dagen bliver styret af de kloakopgaver, der er planlagt på pladsen, og du arbejder med rørlægning, samlinger og dokumentation efter opgaven. Når arbejdet kræver det, bliver løsningen valgt, så der også tages hensyn til miljø og genbrug af materialer. Du skal kunne holde hovedet koldt, når en opgave viser sig at være mere kompleks end først antaget.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Lægger rør og laver samlinger
  • Arbejder med renovering, no-dig og service
  • Udfører test, tæthedsprøvning og dokumentation
  • Opbygger fald og arbejder med brønde
  • Reparerer og omlægger kloak

Det vigtige er, at samlinger, fald og dokumentation holder, så næste led ikke skal gætte sig frem. Hvis noget ikke stemmer på pladsen, siger du til i tide.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 3 års erfaring med kloakarbejde
  • Har kørekort B
  • Kan arbejde sikkert med rørlægning og samlinger
  • Er omhyggelig med test, tæthedsprøvning og dokumentation
  • Møder stabilt og siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet no-dig, tv-inspektion eller service før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan tage ansvar for en kloakopgave fra start til aflevering.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.



Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.



Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.



Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

title: Staff Research Scientist, AI Alignment
description:
As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

In this role, you will serve as a key researcher for regional AI safety research, establishing a technical presence dedicated to AI alignment. You will bridge foundational academic breakthroughs with core engineering execution to ensure next-generation AI models are robust, trustworthy, and safe. You will act as a key liaison, building and coordinating highly impactful research partnerships with academic institutions, government stakeholders, and regional engineering hubs across the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region. You will also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing findings.

  • Serve as the lead researcher for regional AI safety research, defining and driving a foundational research agenda in AI alignment and developing advanced computational intelligence technology to adapt to new trends and threats.and socio-technical systems.
  • Lead local interactions and liaise directly with APAC academic institutions, government bodies, and key external stakeholders to establish and coordinate joint research partnerships.
  • Oversee the strategic integration of localized safety breakthroughs, evaluation protocols, and alignment methodologies into core engineering frameworks and frontier AI models.
  • Collaborate closely with regional engineering teams, global research pillars, and cross-functional partners to navigate fast-moving technology policy and regulatory landscapes.
  • Participate in the regional research community, publish foundational research in scientific venues, represent Google in regional research forums, and mentor students or visiting researchers.

Minimum qualifications:

  • PhD degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience with research agendas across multiple teams or projects.
  • Experience in machine learning, adversarial machine learning or evaluating frontier AI systems, which includes but not limited to supervised learning, unsupervised learning and reinforcement learning, ML interpretability, adversarial robustness, ML safety, generative models, agentic AI, multi-object optimization.
  • One of more scientific publication submission(s) for conferences, journals, or public repositories (such as CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience establishing research partnerships or liaising with external stakeholders, academic institutions, or government bodies.
  • Demonstrated experience understanding technology policy, regulatory compliance, and regional cultural nuances within the Asia-Pacific (APAC) landscape.
  • Track record of successfully coordinating joint academic research initiatives and integrating advanced research breakthroughs into scalable engineering frameworks.
  • First-authored publications in top machine learning, safety/security tracks in machine learning or AI conferences, or HCI conferences.

title: Game Client Technical Lead
description:
ENJOY Gaming is a software provider focused on creating high-quality digital entertainment experiences, including Slots and Live Games. Our team brings together experienced professionals in game development, product, and design, driven by a passion for innovation and quality.

At ENJOY Gaming, we value ownership, excellence, and drive. These principles shape the way we work, collaborate, and build products.

Join us and be part of our innovative journey in the gaming world!

We are looking for a Game Client Technical Lead with a passion for creative game design and systems engineering. You won't just be pulling tickets from a backlog: you'll be the technical authority for our products. You will lead two completely different engineering ecosystems: the highly optimized, memory-sensitive world of game clients and the backend infrastructure. You will bridge the gap between creative vision and technical reality, ensuring that the incredible experience enjoyed by players is powered by a robust, secure, and scalable backend.

What You Will Do:

  • E2E Game Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain complete game features. You will seamlessly integrate scalable server-side backend services with high-performance client-side gameplay and UI logic

  • Decoupled Systems: Design a flexible, modular backend that efficiently serves data to various frontend game clients, ensuring seamless integration regardless of the client engine used

  • Full-Stack Optimization: Balance performance across the entire product. Optimize server-side load management and database queries while simultaneously managing client-side memory and frame rate stability across a wide range of devices

  • Unified Observability: Implement robust real-time data collection, logging, and crash reporting, to track the user journey from client-side actions to back-end server responses

  • System Health & Proactive QA: Monitor the entire stack to swiftly detect, diagnose, and resolve cross-domain issues - whether they originate as client-side crashes or backend server bottlenecks

  • Security & Risk Mitigation: Implement E2E security protocols for secure client-server communication. Protect sensitive user data on the server while deploying client-side risk mitigation, such as anti-cheat mechanisms and exploit prevention

  • Act as the Technical Translator: Serve as the core bridge connecting UI/UX designers, Game Designers, and engineering leadership. You will help translate creative requirements into actionable code while ensuring the backend can support those designs

  • Elevate the Team: Mentor developers in modern client-side and backend techniques, fostering a culture of high-quality code and technical ownership

  • Set the Standard for Documentation: Create and maintain a unified knowledge base covering both sides of the stack - from API specs and server infrastructure to engine integration manuals

  • Drive Agile alignment: Holistically scope features during sprints, ensuring technical requirements align with business goals while actively managing and reducing technical debt



What to Expect:

  • Strong Planning and prioritization: You will organize the plan so that you and the team can seamlessly shift gears from optimizing a memory allocation issue in the morning to designing a stateless architecture handling thousands of concurrent players in the afternoon

  • Stakeholder management: You will work with product owners and game designers to translate their vision into technical reality, reviewing mechanics and proposing a viable, performant alternative

  • Architecture engineering: You will marshal monitoring telemetry to ensure the servers stay up during massive traffic spikes and adjust the approach to facilitate high availability

  • Product engineering: You will balance the demands of shipping features fast against the necessity of keeping the codebase clean, scalable, and modular



Who You Are:

  • 6+ years of development experience and 1+ year of leadership experience

  • iGaming/Gambling experience will be a huge plus

  • Strong understanding of game client architecture

  • Experience with state machines, game flow, and real-time systems

  • Proven Full-Stack Expertise: Deep professional experience in both game client development and understanding/experience with scalable server-side backend architectures

  • High Tolerance for Complexity: You are comfortable diving into ambiguous problems and designing systems from the ground up

  • Proactive Problem Solver: You find and fix memory leaks, architecture flaws, or security vulnerabilities before they ever impact a player

  • Exceptional Communicator: You can explain complex backend constraints to non-technical stakeholders and break down creative requirements into clear engineering tasks

  • Experienced Leader: You have a track record of mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and leading projects through the full software development lifecycle

  • Fluent English + Ukrainian or Russian - must‑have

Stack:

  • Languages: Pixi, TypeScript, JavaScript (), React

  • Frontend Graphics & Animation: WebGL rendering, 2D skeletal web animation

  • Real-time Communication & Messaging: WebSockets, Event streaming brokers, Remote Procedure Calls

  • Video Streaming: Ultra-low latency (sub-second) video streaming architecture utilizing WebRTC, WHIP, RTMP, and SRT for real-time ingest, combined with H5Live, Low-Latency HLS, MoQ, and ABR for global browser-based playback

  • Databases & Storage: Relational (SQL), Document (NoSQL), In-memory caching, Columnar/Analytics databases

  • Infrastructure & Orchestration: Cloud infrastructure, Containerization, Container orchestration

  • Observability & Monitoring: Distributed telemetry, Log aggregation, Time-series monitoring dashboards

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Python

  • CI/CD & Automation: Automated CI/CD pipelines, API integrations

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Salary in EUR: with annual performance reviews to recognize your growth

  • Flexible Remote Work: balance productivity and comfort

  • Comprehensive Benefits: including medical insurance, psychologist support and Polish, Slovak speaking clubs

  • Generous Paid Time Off: 20 working days of paid vacation, plus 10 additional paid days off, 10 paid sick days, and all national holidays in your country

  • Professional Development Support: reimbursement for courses, trainings, and certifications

  • Well-being Perks: support for language classes, sports, massages, or life coaching

  • 6-Month Probation Period: a standard period to ensure a strong mutual fit for both you and the company


Please note that feedback on your application will be provided within two weeks if a positive decision is made regarding your candidacy.
